summary: A 22-year-old driver crashed into a bridge foundation and fled on foot while allegedly driving under the influence; the 23-year-old passenger sustained a serious arm injury.
A car driven by a slightly intoxicated woman collided with a pedestrian in Ferlach, resulting in serious injuries to the pedestrian.
Unregistered car caught fire on a meadow in Pöckau, Arnoldstein; no injuries reported.
A car caught fire, likely due to parts of fired fireworks, resulting in a total loss.
Multiple injuries and property damage due to pyrotechnic devices during New Years celebrations in Niederösterreich, Austria.
A 17-year-old was stabbed in the leg by an unknown attacker in Steyr, Austria.
A 22-year-old man was injured when a firework exploded near his buttocks during a private New Years Eve party.
An 18-year-old man threatened a 17-year-old woman with a knife after a party dispute and later drove home under the influence of alcohol, leading to a revoked license.
A fire was caused by a firework battery discarded in a paper container, which spread to two cars and a house facade.
A 23-year-old man fired several shots into the air from a moving car in Salzburg-Lehen, two blank guns were confiscated, and he faces charges.
A large waste container on a construction site in Kaprun caught fire; cause undetermined.
A woman accidentally hit a street supervisor with her car, causing a minor knee injury.
A hedge fire occurred near a holiday apartment in Walchen, likely caused by a stray firework; no injuries were reported.
Four individuals in Graz were investigated and partially detained for allegedly fraudulently claiming social benefits worth hundreds of thousands of euros over years.
A man placed hot firework batteries in a plastic water barrel in a wooden shed, causing it to melt and ignite, resulting in a fire and significant property damage but no injuries.
A smoldering fire occurred at a landfill in Roppen, likely caused by improperly disposed ash residues.
A car lost control due to a tire blowout in the Brettfalltunnel, hitting the tunnel wall; two men were injured, and the driver was found to be under the influence of alcohol.
A man sexually harassed a 24-year-old woman in Innsbruck by approaching her from behind and touching her inappropriately.
A 29-year-old driver lost control of his car on the B83 road in Kärnten, collided with a traffic sign, and was found to be under the influence of alcohol.

A 33-year-old man lost control of his vehicle in Klagenfurt city center, likely due to high speed, and struck a tree; his 24-year-old girlfriend in the back seat was injured. He was found to be under the influence of alcohol and had his drivers license temporarily revoked.
A 26-year-old woman lost control of her car on Gurktaler Bundesstraße, causing a crash, fled the scene on foot, and was later found to be intoxicated.
A pyrotechnic device likely caused a roof fire, which residents almost fully extinguished before firefighters arrived. No injuries.
Pyrotechnic waste ignited a garbage bin fire, extinguished by the fire department. No injuries reported.
A garbage bin fire extended to a building facade but was extinguished by residents with a fire extinguisher. No injuries.
A car driven by a 35-year-old Bulgarian man hit two Iraqi men who were crossing the street, resulting in one sustaining minor injuries and the other being seriously injured.
A 55-year-old man crashed his car into a tree in Oftering while under the influence of alcohol, resulting in injuries.
Two garbage bins caught fire in Gmunden, likely due to a disposed firework; police contained the flames and firefighters extinguished the fire.
Two paper containers were set on fire in Salzburg by unknown perpetrators; the fire was extinguished by BF Salzburg authorities.
A fire broke out in a residential building in Roppen; all six occupants, including a baby, evacuated safely, but the house suffered significant damage and is uninhabitable.
Shots fired with a blank pistol by an 18-year-old Italian man in Innsbruck, leading to police intervention and a temporary weapons ban.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a grocery store in Zirl, causing property damage; stolen items remain unknown.
A small fire caused by fireworks broke out in Maurach am Achensee, injuring a teenager and requiring fire department intervention.
Unknown individuals used firecrackers to destroy a mailbox and damage a roof and other property in Höchst, including further incidents in Rheinstraße.
Police disrupted a loud party; attendees attacked officers, resulting in injuries and arrests.
A man was arrested while attempting to break into an apartment with a crowbar and is suspected of attempting to break into other apartments and vehicles.
An 87-year-old man found his 82-year-old wife deceased in their home in Ybbs an der Donau; no evidence of external fault; autopsy ordered.
A neighborly dispute in Aspang-St. Peter led to a verbal threat and a gunshot fired into the ground; no resistance was offered by those involved.
A 24-year-old man in Bezirk Lilienfeld behaved aggressively towards family members and police officers, resulting in his arrest and a recorded blood alcohol level of 1.4 promille.
A man in Pottendorf was injured by the explosion of a firework set off by an unknown person.
Police stopped a party in a courtyard in Gloggnitz due to Covid-19 and pyrotechnics law violations.
A 17-year-old motorcyclist in Austria collided with a barrier due to lack of vehicle lighting and suffered fatal injuries.
A 33-year-old climber got stuck in the snowy Bosruck mountains North face and was rescued with a helicopter after sliding and losing his phone.
A nine-year-old boy fell from a ski slope in Dachstein West, Austria, and was injured.
A drunk driver collided with a tree and was injured in Oftering.
A 25-year-old man caused a traffic accident on B311, tested at 0.58 promille, and was injured.
A farm building in St. Gallen, Austria, was completely destroyed by fire due to leftover remnants of a battery firework; no injuries occurred.
A 30-year-old man was severely injured when a rocket exploded in his hands while clearing up New Years fireworks.
Uninhabited weekend house caught fire; no injuries reported; fire was extinguished and a total loss was prevented.
Carbon monoxide leak in an alpine hut caused health issues, with multiple people hospitalized.

A non-notified anti-Covid measures demonstration involving approximately 800 participants occurred in Innsbruck, disrupted by about 100 left-wing activists, leading to police intervention to deescalate tensions.
Fire broke out in a house in Roppen, no injuries were reported, house is uninhabitable.
A 21-year-old man suffered severe facial burns in a fireworks accident in Fügen and was taken to a hospital in Innsbruck.
Fire at a company site in Steinach am Brenner caused damage to a woodchip heating system, likely due to a technical defect; no injuries reported.
A 32-year-old man was lightly injured after a confrontation with a group of juveniles who were setting off fireworks near his residence.

Two teenagers in Innsbruck fired rockets and threw firecrackers from a building, posing a danger to pedestrians. Police seized pyrotechnic items and gas pistol ammunition; one teen faces legal consequences under the Weapons Act.
A 43-year-old man died in a traffic accident after his car veered off the road and collided with a parked truck.
House fire in Perchtoldsdorf resulted in three people being rescued and hospitalized with minor injuries from potential smoke inhalation.
Two 12-year-olds injured by a pyrotechnic accident in Pottendorf, requiring hospitalization.

Garbage bins caught fire in Schärding, endangering a nearby wooden hut and necessitating fire department intervention; likely caused by improperly disposed fireworks. A similar fire occurred in an old paper container in St. Florian during New Years Eve.
A drunken 18-year-old Austrian attacked police officers and others in the Kramergasse area of Imst, leading to his arrest after a violent altercation.
Several individuals involved in property damage and attempted burglary were apprehended following a police operation at Reumannplatz, Vienna.
A 16-year-old girl was attacked and molested by an unknown male who fled when a car approached.
A man broke into a pharmacy in Amstetten, stealing money and other items, and later admitted to additional thefts from vehicles; he was arrested and stolen goods were partially recovered.
A man in St. Veit/Glan violated a barring order, stole car license plates, attacked police officers, and was found possessing drugs.
Three youths caused significant damage to glass in a railway underpass by igniting a pyrotechnic device.
Three young adults caused damage to various property in Höchst using pyrotechnic devices, resulting in 17,778 Euros in damages.
A car slid off a steep embankment in Mittelberg while ascending a municipal road; no injuries were reported, and minor property damage occurred.
Police stopped a car driven by a 36-year-old man near Eisenkappel and found drugs, including heroin, after a passenger also had substances on them.
Two cars collided on a snowy road in Kärnten, causing injuries to both drivers and significant vehicle damage.
Three sledging accidents occurred in Semmering, Austria, injuring three individuals including a child who needed airlift to the hospital.
A human smuggler was arrested after a car chase ending in Austria; one person was injured after the driver lost control and crashed into a guardrail.
Police broke up a loud gathering of nine Romanian nationals violating COVID-19 restrictions in an apartment in Linz.
A 53-year-old Romanian man caused a disturbance in a store in Linz and was arrested for violating a residency ban in Austria.
A 60-year-old man died while performing forestry work after being struck by a falling tree.
Traffic violations in Gaißau and Hallein involving intoxicated drivers and a driver without a valid license using stolen license plates.
A car driven by a woman collided with a moped ridden by a teenager in a roundabout, causing minor injuries to the moped rider.
Fire caused by exploding lithium batteries was extinguished in Mittersill; no injuries reported.
A fire broke out in a wood chip silo at a hotel in Rehbach, likely caused by a malfunction in the backfire safety system, with no injuries reported.
An 85-year-old driver collided with an 81-year-old pedestrian crossing a dark, unlit road, resulting in the pedestrians death.
An avalanche blocked the Defereggentalstraße in St. Jakob im Defereggen; no injuries or property damage occurred.
A car partially buried by an avalanche on Felbertauernstraße was freed by nearby rescue forces; no injuries or damage occurred.
Police found drugs, a stun gun, and cash during a traffic stop; a driver was suspected of drug influence, and both occupants faced charges.
A fire completely destroyed an alpine hut in Innerkrems, with no injuries reported and the cause suspected to be a chimney or heating defect.
A drunk driver in Launsdorf caused a traffic accident by falling asleep and overturning his car, resulting in minor injuries.
A driver lost control in a curve, resulting in minor injuries and a positive alcohol test of 1.7‰.
A car collided with a bicycle in Purgstall, causing injuries to the cyclist who was taken to the hospital.
Head-on collision between two cars in Geinberg caused severe injuries to two drivers and one passenger.
Driver, who switched seats with passenger, found driving under influence of drugs and without a license; vehicle had non-functioning brakes, and both individuals were reported to authorities.
A truck driver on the A9 in Traboch was stopped due to dangerous driving and found heavily intoxicated; his license and keys were confiscated.
Intruders broke into a third-floor apartment in Graz and stole cash and jewelry.
A 73-year-old man was seriously injured in a skiing accident on a blue slope in Tirol and was airlifted to the hospital.
A 41-year-old man was severely injured when a steel chain snapped during a towing attempt with tractors, hitting him in the head.
A man was seriously injured during forest work in Zwettl when part of a tree struck his leg.
Collision during sledding accident on Bödele slope resulted in injuries to a 17-year-old girl, while a 36-year-old man involved remained uninjured.
Unknown perpetrators vandalized objects with graffiti in Ötztal-Bahnhof using neon pink spray paint.
Ten road signs and town signs were stolen by unknown perpetrators in Kumberg between January 2 and January 7, 2021.
A locksmith scammed a man in Imst and another in December 2019 by overcharging and disappearing.
Three individuals were injured in a rear-end collision involving two cars on the A8 motorway near Peterskirchen, Austria.
An intoxicated driver in Vienna was arrested after behaving aggressively, threatening officers, and resisting during his detention.
Police arrested a 27-year-old Serbian man wanted for drug trafficking during a routine vehicle check in Vienna.
Cannabis smell during a traffic stop led to drug-related charges and license revocation for the driver and passengers.
A snowboarder collided with a skier on a slope in Hermagor, injuring the skier and fleeing the scene without providing assistance.
A 37-year-old man lost control of his tractor due to icy roads, resulting in a crash and severe injuries in Kleinzell im Mühlkreis; he was rescued and hospitalized.
Three suspects attempted to break into a residence in Salzburgs Old Town via a balcony; two were apprehended immediately, and the third was later arrested.
Three unidentified men demanded money from a 16-year-old local in Grödig and fled after receiving a three-digit sum.
A 23-year-old German man fell out of a window of an apartment building in Flachauwinkl, sustaining serious injuries. No indication of external fault was found, and investigations are ongoing.
A 23-year-old pedestrian was fatally injured in a traffic accident when hit by a car in Schladming. The driver was unharmed but in shock.
A 41-year-old mountain biker fell and injured his shoulder during a descent in St. Radegund near Graz.
Overheated cooking oil caused a kitchen fire in a house in Berndorf, Bruck an der Mur. No injuries occurred, and damage was contained by the resident and firefighters.
Two ski tourers collided with a steel cable used for slope grooming, resulting in one serious leg injury.
Ice plate from truck injures car driver on Arlberg Schnellstraße; vehicle totaled, truck driver unidentified.
A collision between skiers in Zillertal Arena resulted in injuries, with one skier fleeing the scene.
A 28-year-old Italian man suffered a severe leg injury after falling while sledding alone in Obertilliach.
A 56-year-old woman climbing on Leiterweg in Hohenems was struck by falling rocks and sustained injuries but managed to call for help and was rescued by helicopter.
A 15-year-old German skier suffered severe injuries after crashing into a slope barrier at Trittkopf in Zürs, Vorarlberg, and was airlifted to hospital.
A man found suspected war material in a forest, which was later identified as a British pipe bomb and removed by a military disposal team.
A man aimed a blank gun at police officers but was disarmed and arrested without further incident.
Police dog successfully apprehends two men suspected of burglary in a building.

A demonstration at Heldenplatz in Vienna involving around 2,000 participants protested COVID-19 measures, with violations of health guidelines and spontaneous unregistered gatherings causing temporary traffic disruptions.
Canopy of a leisure goods store collapsed under snow load in Villach, causing heavy damage to at least four parked cars.
Car accident in Pyhra; a woman and her son were injured after their vehicle hit a tree.
A group of six female hikers from Bezirk Neunkirchen got lost while descending Sonnwendstein and were rescued by search and rescue teams.
63-year-old man lost control of his car, causing it to overturn; he was rescued and airlifted to a hospital with undetermined injuries.
Police issued 13 fines at a local venue in Wildon after Covid-19 measures were violated, including consumption of food and drinks on-site and lack of hygiene measures.
20-year-old driver crashed a van, fled the scene, leaving his injured passenger behind, then turned himself in to the police later; minor alcohol involvement noted.
A 26-year-old man was severely injured during forestry work after being struck by a falling tree.
An 83-year-old man drove his car off a road and down a 20-meter embankment in Köflach, resulting in minor injuries and requiring rescue by firefighters.
A chimney fire occurred in a residential house in See, Tirol, and was quickly controlled by the fire department; no injuries reported.
Fire incident involving a mobile toilet unit on a forest playground in Aldrans; cause under investigation.
A skier in Pfons injured her knee while ascending and was airlifted to a hospital; no foul play involved.
Partial roof collapse at a sports store in Matrei in Osttirol due to heavy snow load; no injuries reported.
A 15-year-old girl had a sledding accident in Söll, suffering injuries to her right ankle and was airlifted to a hospital.
Police intercepted a drug deal involving a 56-year-old woman and a 20-year-old man near a subway station; small amounts of cannabis were seized and the man was arrested while the woman was reported.
A police service dog bit a 5-year-old boy on the arm at a property in Hermagor, Austria, after the dog possibly reacted to the childs screaming and movement.
Two vehicles collided at an intersection on the B 17 in Wiener Neudorf, injuring both drivers.
An 80-year-old pedestrian was seriously injured after being hit by a car while crossing the street in Adlwang.
A group of Austrian tourists were attacked by a group of Dutch tourists outside a bar in Westendorf, leaving two Austrian men injured, one of them temporarily unconscious.
Snow chains were stolen from a tractor used to prepare a toboggan run in Leisach, involving vehicle lifting by unknown perpetrators.
A man reported being attacked with a telescopic baton by an acquaintance, who then stole his car, phone, and cash. The suspects were later apprehended.
Arrests made in drug trafficking case involving an African group smuggling heroin and cocaine from Vienna to Klagenfurt; main suspects detained, and evidence seized.
A 46-year-old man and his son were threatened with a folding knife by a 25-year-old man during a theft in Guntramsdorf before the suspect was caught and arrested.
Multiple reports were filed for COVID-19 violations at a restaurant in Wildon, where guests consumed food and drinks onsite, protective measures were disregarded, and alcohol was openly sold.
Three young women caused intentional damage to a parked car in Leogang as retaliation for alleged false statements.
Two Israeli passengers were caught with 86 kilograms of Khat at Vienna Airport during a customs check.
Two individuals impersonated police officers and illegally stopped a driver on the road in Bad Ischl, prompting the driver to flee and report the incident to police.
A 25-year-old man was attacked by a 57-year-old woman and her two sons in Maxglan, Salzburg, over disapproval of a relationship, resulting in serious facial injuries.
A cyclist hit a pedestrian in Maishofen and fled the scene without providing assistance.
A car accident in Nenzing resulted in two minor injuries as the car overturned after hitting an embankment.
A 23-year-old man lost control of his car and collided with a tree, sustaining serious injuries.
In Vienna, two elderly victims were tricked by unknown individuals pretending to inspect water damage to steal valuables and cash.
Burglars broke into a couples apartment in Klagenfurt, stealing cash and jewelry by breaking a safe.
A 62-year-old care home resident with alcohol dementia was reported missing. He was later found confused and hypothermic in a field and taken to the hospital after rescue efforts.
A tractor with a trailer slid down a steep slope, overturned, and caused injuries to both occupants in Kirchberg an der Pielach.
A 55-year-old woman slowed down to turn left, causing a collision by a 52-year-old woman driving behind; both drivers sustained injuries and a male passenger had minor injuries.
A carbon monoxide leak in Zwettl district led to the death of a 64-year-old man and hospitalization of other family members and a doctor. Investigations are ongoing.
23-year-old driver under the influence of alcohol and drugs caused a traffic accident in Asten, injuring a 39-year-old woman and damaging both vehicles.
A 31-year-old man hit a 20-year-old Danish man in the face and was temporarily arrested for aggressive behavior.
Vehicle lost control due to slushy road, collided with a snowbank and overturned, injuring two people.
A traffic accident occurred in Kaprun where two cars collided, one fell into a river, resulting in one person with minor injuries.
Collision between a car and a tram at a crossing in Graz, causing minor injuries to the car driver.
A train collided with a car that had stopped on railway tracks; no injuries were reported.
34 vehicles were involved in multiple traffic accidents due to black ice on the S 6 highway in both directions, causing injuries and road closure.
A pedestrian was seriously injured in a traffic accident in Innsbruck after being struck by a car.
Two individuals became stranded in rough terrain during a ski tour in Obertilliach and were safely rescued by search and rescue teams.
A 21-year-old woman and a 26-year-old man, both German skiers, collided at the Talstation in Fieberbrunn, resulting in severe injuries and hospitalization.
A Dutch man sledding in Sölden veered off the trail and hit a rock and tree, sustaining injuries and requiring a helicopter evacuation.
A car accident occurred on Appenzeller Straße in Götzis involving a woman and a child who were injured; the driver tested positive for alcohol.
Unknown perpetrator broke into a house in Obervellach, damaged property, and stole items; partial loot was left behind.
A 28-year-old woman reported being assaulted by her 32-year-old partner in Klagenfurt; he was later apprehended and detained.
A 53-year-old Slovenian man fell from a height of five meters while attempting to resolve a mechanical issue in a high rack at a company, sustaining serious injuries.
A skier fell and was seriously injured during a descent in the Flattnitz ski area.
Collision of two cars in Horn District, Austria injured three people who were taken to hospital.
A 25-year-old skier collided with a 10-year-old girl on a ski slope in Göstling Hochkar, resulting in injuries for both.
A 52-year-old man was severely injured by a falling tree while performing forestry work in Pottendorf.
An employee in Linz was caught illegally printing e-payment cards worth 300 euros for personal use due to financial troubles and later confessed to the crime.
Two masked burglars attempted to break into a shop in Steyrermühl but failed due to the robust entrance door.
Police discovered forged license plates and fake driving licenses during checks in Suben and Linz, and a man in Linz was caught with a small amount of Crystal Meth and attempted to flee.

A traffic accident occurred in Haiming where a car driven by an 18-year-old woman veered off the road, hit a fence, and resulted in injuries to her and a 17-year-old passenger as well as significant damage to property and the vehicle.
Fire broke out in a barn in Nikolsdorf; no persons or animals harmed but the barn was severely damaged.
Two 12-year-old girls fell uncontrollably into a ravine while sledding, and were rescued by the mountain rescue team in Schwaz, Tirol.
A 19-year-old driver lost control on a snowy road in Matrei in Osttirol, colliding with another car. The other driver was injured, and the 19-year-old tested positive for alcohol.
A 49-year-old man triggered an avalanche while ski touring near Zwölfernieder in Neustift im Stubaital, was carried down 400m, and was recovered with injuries by a rescue helicopter.
A 34-year-old man attempted three break-ins into lockers at a store in Vöcklabruck but stole nothing and was later arrested by police.
A 21-year-old lost control of his car on a snowy road in Bad Leonfelden and collided head-on with another vehicle, injuring a 45-year-old woman.
Telephone fraud involving a gas station employee tricked into revealing PIN codes for cards.
Police intervened at an apartment in Vienna due to loud partying; nine teenagers violated COVID-19 regulations.
Police arrested a man in a psychotic state for assaulting an emergency medical worker after being found unresponsive and becoming aggressive upon regaining consciousness.
A 36-year-old man was arrested for breaking into multiple businesses in Vienna; stolen goods were recovered.
A fire was intentionally or negligently caused by an open flame at the former Gösserbräu Inn in Spittal/Drau.
A 28-year-old woman was caught shoplifting in Knittelfeld and injured a store employee during her attempted escape. She was arrested on-site by the police.

A carbon monoxide leak in Schweiggers, Zwettl district, led to the death of a 64-year-old man and the hospitalization of several family members and a doctor due to exposure; investigations suggest a mechanical defect in a solid fuel stove.
An elderly woman in Linz-Land was overcharged by two men for an incomplete lock replacement service.
Two teenagers attempted to break into a shop and cigarette machines, with further crimes and a planned robbery uncovered through investigation.
Two vehicles collided on a road in Feldkirchen district, causing injuries to both drivers and major vehicle damage.
Three 16-year-old males allegedly used firecrackers to damage a cigarette machine and stole cigarette packs before being caught by police.
Two separate stabbing incidents occurred in Vienna involving alcohol-fueled disputes, one over a video and another over a conversation about a woman, leading to arrests and severe injuries.
A man was followed into a bar, dragged out, beaten, robbed of cash and a bank card, and later escaped into a taxi that was damaged as the attackers fled.
Fire caused by a heater in an apartment; 94-year-old man injured and hospitalized.
A man broke into newspaper vending machine cash boxes with a hammer, stole money, and was arrested in possession of heroin.
Police conducted a drug-related operation in Vienna, arresting a man caught selling cannabis and detaining two others with small quantities of the substance.
A 38-year-old Serbian man suffered serious injuries after a ski fall and was flown to a hospital.
Christmas tree caught fire in Feistritz im Rosental, likely due to a candle nearby; one woman and her son transported to hospital for suspected smoke inhalation.
A car accident occurred in Sierning involving two vehicles, resulting in four people being injured and transported to the hospital.
A 44-year-old driver was found with 0.92 promille alcohol and no valid license during a routine traffic check.
Police discovered marijuana, a scale, packaging materials, a blank-firing gun, and cash in a parked vehicle with four young occupants.
A Serbian teenager was caught stealing at Salzburg Hauptbahnhof, found with drug traces and a knife during police inspection.
Driver caught speeding at 113 km/h in a 50 km/h zone in Brunn, stopped after a search and reported.
Two men suffered minor injuries in a fire that started in a hobby room of an uninhabited building and spread to the wooden roof structure.
A fire broke out in a wooden upper floor of a house in Bodendorf, causing significant damage but no injuries as residents evacuated safely.
A 66-year-old skier fell and sustained severe injuries while skiing downhill in the Schwabenbergarena in Turnau.
Car accident involving two vehicles resulted in three injured individuals, two seriously injured and one lightly injured.
A 17-year-old was robbed by two offenders in an apartment building entrance in Innsbruck; one suspect was later arrested, and the other is still being investigated.
A taxi driver collided with a cyclist in Innsbruck, causing the cyclist to sustain a serious hand injury.
An unknown perpetrator broke into an apartment in Innsbruck, searched through rooms, and stole a significant amount of cash.
Intoxicated man attacked a hotel owner after being denied entry, resisted arrest, and caused injuries to police officers during the intervention.
A 26-year-old driver was caught speeding at 144 km/h in a 70 km/h zone and had their license temporarily confiscated after multiple traffic violations.
A woman got lost during a hike in Diex and was found unharmed during a large search operation.
An 80-year-old man lost control of his car while adjusting the radio, resulting in an off-road accident; the driver was uninjured while his passenger sustained injuries and was hospitalized.
A head-on collision on the B9 near Fischamend resulted in the death of a 35-year-old man and his 34-year-old wife, while a 24-year-old truck driver sustained serious injuries.
A scooter rider fell in a curve; a helpers car rolled away after he forgot the handbrake.
A car collided with a truck trailer on the A8 highway in Pram, causing the car to get trapped and be dragged for 200 meters; two individuals were injured.
A woman slipped while trying to board a bus in Eferding and was run over by the rear wheel, sustaining serious injuries.
Driver stopped on A1 near Raststation Kasern for using incorrect license plates on a newly purchased car and possessing a drivers license reported as lost.

A 22-year-old Italian man was threatened with a knife in an attempted robbery but managed to flee before being caught, assaulted, and pushed onto the street by three unknown perpetrators in Salzburgs Lehen district.
A 15-year-old moped driver in Köstendorf was stopped by police for multiple vehicle violations, leading to a confiscation and technical inspection.
Misinterpreted cries for help near Mönchsberg in Salzburg led to a police search operation involving officers and a helicopter, later clarified as a resident calling for their cat.
Two men were injured in a collision on the A9 near Wundschuh, Austria, caused by a severely intoxicated driver who touched a small truck and both vehicles were damaged.
A train attendant in Matrei am Brenner was threatened with a knife by a man without a ticket, who was later apprehended and taken to the police station.
A technical defect caused a fire in a buss rear brake system, but all passengers evacuated safely.
A 24-year-old Austrian threw a chair and decorations from an apartment building, destroying them.
A 13-year-old skier collided with another child on a ski slope in Damüls, resulting in a broken leg for the teenager.
A candle caused a fire in a houses upper floor; no injuries but significant damage.
A collision occurred between a 64-year-old man and a teenage female skier on a ski slope; the man later required medical treatment.
A car in a parking garage in Innsbruck was broken into, and only an open cigarette pack was stolen.
A 23-year-old driver was seriously injured in a car accident while attempting to avoid a collision on Salzburger Straße in Wels.
A 54-year-old Austrian driver veered off the road in Tux, crashing into a streambed and sustaining minor injuries; alcohol test was positive.
A 29-year-old Italian man was attacked by a group of five people and robbed outside a club in Innsbruck. Two suspects, aged 17 and 18, were identified and arrested.
Two suspects, one 17-year-old and one 21-year-old, robbed a victim in Villach, using an airsoft gun to simulate a firearm, and were subsequently apprehended.
Partial collapse of a storage hall in Spittal an der Drau; no public access and no injuries reported.
A 26-year-old woman caused a disturbance at a homeless shelter in Vienna, physically attacked police officers, and bit one officer, leading to her arrest.
A 16-year-old fired a blank gun in Geusaugasse before fleeing; police later caught him with ammunition, marijuana, a fake student ID, and cigarettes.
An 82-year-old man mistook the basement stairs for the WC entrance in a restaurant, fell, and was injured. He was rescued by guests and transported by helicopter to a hospital.
A 33-year-old woman fell while skiing in Hochrindl and was temporarily unconscious; she was airlifted to Klagenfurt clinic.
A heavily intoxicated truck driver was stopped near St. Pölten Land after being observed driving erratically on the A1 highway.
A collision between two skiers in Göstling-Hochkar resulted in serious injuries to one individual, who was airlifted to a hospital.
A 22-year-old driver was seriously injured after losing control of his car, hitting barriers, and sliding into a tunnel at Knoten Korneuburg.
House fire caused by a candle, two residents sustained injuries to hands and arms, building and contents damaged.
Five seasonal workers had a verbal dispute that escalated into a fight, resulting in serious injuries to two individuals in Saalbach.
A man broke into a drugstore in Salzburg-Schallmoos, smashed a window, and was caught by police on site.
Unknown perpetrators broke into an office building in Seekirchen and stole coins from a coffee machine.
After a traffic accident in Salzburg, a 31-year-old hit a 54-year-old with a car door during a dispute, causing a rib contusion.
Apartment fire in Salzburg; a father and his three children evacuated and were hospitalized for suspected smoke inhalation. The cause is under investigation.
Car collided with an LPG gas pump after a fight at a gas station in Graz, causing a gas leak; no injuries reported.
A 33-year-old male driver caused a traffic accident in Imst, injuring a 47-year-old woman, and fled the scene; he was later found and tested positive for alcohol.
Collision on ski slope in Sillian, causing injury to a Croatian skier; the second party left without stopping.
A 25-year-old Austrian man was arrested in Rietz for drug and firearm offenses following a police search that uncovered drugs, weapons, and related items.
Car accident in Wörgl caused by driver falling asleep, resulting in multiple injuries.
Ski collision between a 13-year-old girl and an unknown skier, resulting in the girl suffering a collarbone fracture.
Suspect jumped through first-floor window during drug-related operation in Vienna and was arrested after attempting to flee.
A man was found handling a blank-firing pistol in public, leading to its confiscation and his reporting to the authorities.
A suspected burglar was found in the basement of an apartment building, where he allegedly broke into a storage unit and consumed alcohol.

A heavily intoxicated man armed with a CO2 pistol was apprehended in a multi-family house in Wörgl following a written plea for help thrown out of a window by his partner.
An intoxicated driver caused a collision in Hohenems by crashing into a truck, which then hit another car; one passenger was injured and all vehicles were significantly damaged.
Uninhabited house caught fire likely due to a technical defect, causing damage in the low six-figure euro range.
Thieves cut open truck tarpaulins in St. Marienkirchen and stole laptops from one truck.
Unknown perpetrators stole numerous electronic devices from a company site in Salzburg-Liefering.

A man intentionally hit his ex-partner with a loader vehicle, causing severe injury, and fled the scene. He was arrested two days later.
A 16-year-old was arrested for attempting to explode a cigarette vending machine with pyrotechnics in Vienna.
70-year-old pedestrian hit by a car while crossing the street, resulting in minor injuries.
Two men followed an 81-year-old pensioner into his building, assaulted him using a chokehold, and robbed him; they were later arrested in a bus with the stolen cash.
A 13-year-old boy was severely injured and hospitalized after being hit by a car on Breitenfurter Straße in Vienna while crossing against a red pedestrian light.
An unknown person entered an unlocked holiday home and stole a wallet with cash, documents, and bank cards.
A man fell 4 meters from a ladder while cleaning hay, sustaining severe injuries and requiring rescue and medical aid.
A 37-year-old worker fell from a 4-meter-high ladder while fixing a board and sustained serious injuries.
Two-car collision at a crossroads in Prambachkirchen resulted in one person injured and taken to the hospital.
An 84-year-old cyclist was fatally hit by a delivery van that fled the scene in Sierning.
A 58-year-old woman from Lungau committed multiple frauds between 2014 and 2019, causing a financial loss of around 40,000 euros.
Cyclist collided with a trailer in Salzburg, sustaining a minor hand injury and was taken to the hospital. The driver initially did not notice the accident.
Traffic checks were conducted in Anthering by police and technical experts, resulting in six administrative offense reports.
A 93-year-old woman was hit by a car and injured while crossing a road without a crosswalk.
A car lost control and collided with a tree while avoiding a school bus, injuring a passenger.
Collision between a car and a moped in Graz resulted in the serious injury of the moped driver.
A bus in Graz made an emergency stop to avoid a collision with a turning car, causing a 67-year-old woman to fall and suffer life-threatening injuries.
A car accident occurred on the A13 highway near Schönberg when an Italian driver lost control and collided with a German vehicle, causing injuries to the German driver and his wife.
A German paraglider crashed shortly after takeoff near Gaislachkogel in Sölden and was rescued with serious injuries.
Collision between a car and a van in Lienz caused injuries to three individuals and heavy damage to both vehicles.

A garage in Batschuns caught fire, with no injuries reported; the cause is under investigation.
A 57-year-old woman was injured while exiting a ski lift in Lech/Zürs after her ski became entangled with another skiers, causing her to fall. The other skier left the scene without stopping.

A 38-year-old woman collided with another vehicle on Schweizerstraße 91 in Dornbirn after briefly turning to check on her children; both cars were severely damaged and several persons were taken to the hospital with unconfirmed injuries.
A 78-year-old woman cycling on the wrong side of the road collided with a car exiting a driveway; she sustained minor injuries.
Collision between a car and two pedestrians on Wienerbergplatz in Vienna, resulting in injuries to the pedestrians.
Man without a valid drivers license drives under influence and refuses medical check; repeats offense the same day after key was temporarily confiscated.
Police intervened in a gathering of 15 youths in an apartment violating Covid-19 measures, claiming it was a business meeting.
Four youths were rescued after getting lost in steep terrain during a sledding trip in Arnoldstein, located using a police helicopter with a thermal camera.
A 27-year-old woman was injured during a ski tour in Zell Pfarre after falling and hitting a tree; she was airlifted to a hospital after self-evacuating to a shelter.
A peaceful demonstration with around 600 participants in Wiener Neustadt, Austria resulted in 30 reports and one temporary arrest due to Covid-19 regulations.
A 31-year-old man got lost during a mountain hike on Traunstein and was rescued uninjured by the mountain rescue service after contacting his partner for assistance.
A drunk driver crashed into a house wall and fled but was later found by police and taken to the hospital.
Oil left on the stove caused a fire in an apartment, extinguished by the owner and firefighters, with two residents sustaining minor injuries.
Two skiing accidents occurred involving off-piste descents; both injured individuals were airlifted to the hospital.
A peaceful demonstration with around 500 participants occurred at the Grenzübergang Saalbrücke in Salzburg. One person was arrested due to an ordinance violation.
A 24-year-old man in Straßwalchen was found driving without a license, possessing drugs and a knife despite a weapons ban.
Two men collided and were injured while skiing near Grünwaldkopfbahn in Obertauern.
A 51-year-old woman suffered severe injuries in a ski collision with a 21-year-old skier in Dienten am Hochkönig, Salzburg.
A head-on collision occurred between two cars in Wagrain, injuring a 66-year-old man, while a 62-year-old woman remained unharmed. Both vehicles were significantly damaged.
Unidentified perpetrators exploded a metal trash can using a pyrotechnic device, causing significant damage but no injuries, in Graz.
Two hikers were rescued by a police helicopter near Eisenerz after getting stranded without proper equipment on Seemauer.
An intoxicated man damaged a bus, made obscene gestures, spat at a store employee, and issued death threats in Graz after being asked to wear a mask.

A hair dryer caught fire in a bathroom in Stans, causing smoke. An 82-year-old resident evacuated and was hospitalized for suspected smoke inhalation. The fire extinguished itself, and firefighters ventilated the apartment.
Illegal dumping of garbage including expired food and medications in Ampass, Ebenwald parking area.
Unknown individual vandalized hotel entrance in Innsbruck, causing substantial damage.
Avalanche occurred in St. Jakob iD at Kahorn, prompting a search effort with no buried persons found.
A 65-year-old cyclist collided with a man exiting a tram in Innsbruck, resulting in the woman suffering severe injuries and requiring hospital treatment.
A fire destroyed a clubhouse in Uderns, no injuries reported; investigation ongoing.
Avalanches triggered during a ski descent at Schafbodenkopf; no injuries or victims detected after safety search.
An 84-year-old cyclist died in a traffic accident in Sierning after being hit by a van. The driver fled the scene but was later identified and will be charged.
A 6-year-old girl was bitten and injured by a dog while walking home from kindergarten in Lustenau.
Police found numerous guests in a restaurant violating Covid-19 regulations by not wearing masks and ignoring social distancing; the owner is facing charges for the third time.
A man was scammed into paying €500 in cryptocurrency for a fake lottery win.
A 25-year-old woman from Vienna was injured in a skiing accident at Hochkar after a snowboarder collided with her ski, causing her to fall.
Austrian driver caught speeding at 223 km/h in a 130 km/h zone on A 2 near Wr. Neustadt.
Three 18-year-olds were arrested for allegedly setting a wooden equipment hall on fire in Graz, causing significant property damage but no injuries.
Unknown vandals damaged a parked car in Innsbruck by smashing the windshield and scratching the vehicle.
A fire destroyed a community building in Uderns, likely caused by a technical defect, with no injuries reported.
A 21-year-old man was found dead due to suspected drug consumption, confirmed by autopsy and toxicological analysis.
An explosion caused by unknown individuals blew a 40 kg metal trash can out of its anchoring, scattering metal parts across 40-50 meters in Graz.
A 19-year-old man caused a car crash on Südring in Klagenfurt, injuring another young man, then fled the scene on foot.
Physical altercation between several individuals in a nightclub in Klagenfurt resulted in minor injuries.
A 40-year-old man was rescued from the outside of a bridge railing in Linz by police officers after being spotted by an off-duty detective. He was later taken to the hospital.
A 56-year-old pedestrian was hit by a car in Vorchdorf; the driver fled the scene.
Two intruders broke into a house in Tennengau, confronted the elderly owner, physically restrained her, and stole a small amount of cash before fleeing.
Police report a reduction in twilight burglaries in Austria due to targeted measures, with a 7.6% decrease in cases from November 2019 to February 2020, including 46 cases in Tirol.
A 40-year-old man physically assaulted his 39-year-old partner in an apartment in Villach, causing injuries. A restraining order was issued against him.
Three prisoners attempted to escape from the Graz-Karlau prison but were prevented by coordinated actions of the police and prison staff.
Group of five teenagers attempted to rob a 13-year-old; three were arrested and two handed over to their mothers.
An intoxicated driver caused multiple accidents, fled the scene, resisted police intervention, and was arrested.
A 25-year-old man from Villach crashed his car into a tree on the B 94 road in Sonnberg, was trapped in the vehicle, and later tested positive for alcohol.

A 15-year-old skier suffered severe injuries after falling down a steep embankment while skiing off-piste at Hochkar ski area in Göstling an der Ybbs. He was airlifted to a hospital after being assisted by mountain rescue.
A 26-year-old woman lost control of her car on the B 40 in Maustrenk, causing it to veer off-road and crash; she sustained injuries and was hospitalized.
19-year-olds car overturned and landed in a creekbed in Königstetten; she was rescued and hospitalized with injuries of unclear severity.
A 27-year-old German man was arrested at a truck stop for violating a residence ban and driving without a license.

A jogger was hit by a car and injured in Ottensheim, transported to hospital by helicopter.
Three teenagers attempted to break into a car in Salzburg, damaging the vehicle and were detained by the owner until the police arrived.
Cyclist injured after colliding with a chain and falling on a marked crossing in Salzburg.
Fire set in a public restroom in Leoben by an unknown perpetrator, no injuries reported.
A traffic accident occurred involving a medical transport vehicle and a car in Graz, resulting in minor injuries to two passengers.
Fire broke out in the basement of a house, two residents treated for suspected smoke inhalation.
An 18-year-old German skier was injured in a collision with an unknown skier in the Horberg ski area; the other skier fled the scene.
Two unidentified individuals broke into a house in Ellmau, stole an unopened wallet, and fled on foot despite a pursuit. A police search was unsuccessful.

A 15-year-old skier was injured after a collision with an unknown female skier who fled the scene in Lech, Austria.
Two drivers in Vienna were stopped under suspicion of driving under drug influence; one possessed 100g of marijuana and both had their licenses revoked.
A man wielded an ice pick at a metro station, threatened bystanders, and was later apprehended and sent for psychiatric evaluation.
An 18-year-old suspected drug dealer was arrested in Vienna with heroin and cash; additional items were seized in a house search.
A fire broke out in an elderly mans apartment in Ferlach; he was rescued and treated for suspected smoke inhalation.

An elderly couple in Villach physically attacked each other during a dispute, causing injuries. The wife, who fell from her wheelchair, was hospitalized, and a restraining order was issued against the husband.
Two vehicles collided head-on in Pitten, Austria; drivers injured, child passenger unharmed.
A gathering in Enns with 25 adults and 20 children violating COVID-19 measures was dispersed by police.
A 25-year-old man in Braunau am Inn became aggressive toward bystanders and police during an accident investigation, leading to his temporary arrest.

Unapproved public demonstration with approximately 150 participants. Police enforced Covid-19 regulations, conducted multiple checks, and issued 22 administrative fines. No arrests or criminal charges.
A 17-year-old skier was seriously injured in a high-speed fall at a ski area in Spital am Semmering and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 27-year-old ski tourer fell and sustained a severe knee injury; airlifted to a hospital for treatment.
A 38-year-old German woman was assaulted and robbed of a small sum of cash by two unidentified men, suffering minor injuries during the incident.
A 37-year-old driver hit a 12-year-old girl at a pedestrian crossing in Innsbruck, causing injuries of unspecified severity.
Unknown perpetrators attempted to blow up an ATM in Klausen-Leopoldsdorf, causing significant damage to the building.
Two intoxicated men performed a Hitler salute and shouted Nazi slogans at the police in front of bystanders, resulting in the arrest of one of them and legal action against both under Austrian law.
Two buses and a concrete wall in Kaltenbach were vandalized with spray-painted graffiti by unknown individuals.
Two minors ignited paper in a sink in a public restroom, causing smoke and soot damage amounting to over €25,000. No injuries were reported.
A 45-year-old womans belongings were stolen, including a bank card, which was later used for payments in Felixdorf and attempted in Baden and Oeynhausen.
A driver was caught speeding at 229 km/h on the A2 highway near the SCS city border, found to have 1.08‰ blood alcohol content, and had their drivers license temporarily revoked.

A 21-year-old man crashed his company truck on the Innerfraganter Landesstraße, hitting road markers and a tree before the truck overturned. He sustained serious injuries and was rescued and taken to the hospital.
A 17-year-old driver swerved to avoid an oncoming vehicle, hitting a traffic post and streetlight, ending up in a ditch; the other driver fled the scene.

A 50-year-old man threatened another guest with a soft gun during an argument in a Mayrhofen bar; police intervened and issued a provisional weapons ban.
A 24-year-old worker accidentally shot a nail into his hand with a pneumatic nail gun while assembling wooden crates in Völkermarkt and was taken to the hospital after initial treatment.

A 34-year-old man attempted to shoplift and attacked supermarket employees when confronted, later exhibiting disorderly behavior towards police.
A 62-year-old man set fire to a newspaper stand and later threatened police officers with a knife. He was arrested and is now in custody.
A 13-year-old boy on a bicycle was mildly injured in a collision with a car on a pedestrian crossing.
Two Slovenian women were rescued on the Feistritzer Spitz mountain after becoming exhausted and disoriented during their ascent.
A fire, likely caused by a candle, broke out on a balcony in Ossiach, damaging floorboards and shattering a window before being extinguished by firefighters.
Two 21-year-old men were arrested after throwing stones onto cars on the A2, causing damage to windshields but no injuries. They admitted to the act and a similar incident on January 31, 2020.
A 38-year-old man was severely injured by a tree during logging work near Gassarest and was airlifted to a hospital after self-alerting emergency services.
A car was detected driving at 208 km/h instead of the permitted 130 km/h on S 6 in Natschbach-Loipersdorf, Bezirk Neunkirchen, and reported to authorities.

A fire broke out in the ceiling of the Casino in Linz, causing evacuation of 120 people but resulted in no injuries. The cause was likely technical and not intentional.
A fire broke out in the ceiling of a casino in Linz, leading to the evacuation of about 120 people, including hotel guests, with no injuries reported.
A heavily intoxicated man in Kuchl assaulted a person, caused disturbances, and resisted police officers, injuring two of them during his arrest.
A burglary occurred in a single-family house in Salzburg-Maxglan where a jewelry box and several wristwatches were stolen.
A sledding accident in Werfenweng resulted in two women falling 100 meters down a steep slope and getting seriously injured. Emergency services rescued them and airlifted them to the hospital.
A three-vehicle collision in Liezen left a woman injured and required her extraction by the fire department.
A 32-year-old man was caught and arrested for breaking into a car dealership in Graz. He had stolen mobile phones and was detained by police with the assistance of a canine unit.
Fire broke out in a chicken stall, causing significant damage to structures while sparing people and animals.
A 27-year-old ski tourer suffered a broken leg in a fall and was airlifted to the hospital by helicopter.
A 78-year-old man in Graz was robbed by three unidentified suspects who stole his wristwatch and fled.
LED fog lights and parking sensors were stolen from a parked car at Spieljochbahn parking lot in Fügen.

A collision between two skiers in the Hochzillertal ski area left a 42-year-old Dutch man severely injured and transported to the hospital, while the other skier, a 59-year-old Austrian, remained uninjured.

Driver and passenger of a vehicle with Dutch plates were stopped and checked; passenger arrested for outstanding warrant.

Man wanted for human trafficking arrested in Traun, used forged ID during detention.

Car accident caused by abrupt braking to avoid a jaywalker; one driver injured and significant damage to vehicles.

A woman attempted to sell a puppy illegally for €150; the police intervened, detained the seller, and transferred the puppy to an animal shelter.

An intoxicated bus driver caused minor damage by hitting traffic items, asked passengers to leave, collected debris, and left the scene; police later confirmed alcohol involvement.

A 21-year-old man impersonated a police officer at Hohenems train station, conducted fake searches, and stole mobile phones and other items from teenagers; he was apprehended and charged with robbery and impersonation.
Collision between a skier and a 10-year-old girl on a ski slope resulted in injuries; police seek witnesses.

A cyclist in Altenberg was fatally hit by a car on February 8; the cyclist, a 29-year-old Czech national, later died in the hospital from head injuries.
Ski collision involving a 14-year-old and a minor resulted in an arm fracture; other party left without sharing personal information.

Car crashed into garden shed in Pabneukirchen, leaving three injured.

A 20-year-old Afghan male was caught and arrested by police for breaking into a club house in Graz, Bezirk Geidorf early in the morning.

A 62-year-old Austrian woman and a 31-year-old Austrian man collided on the Inntalautobahn near Volders; the womans car flipped, and all involved were injured to an unspecified degree. Alcohol was detected in the male drivers system.

An 80-year-old man was caught driving with a laser blocker on the A10 Tauernautobahn near Villach, leading to confiscation of the device and an imminent report.
A 50-year-old man operating a Skidoo collided with a skier and his daughter on a piste in Kärnten, causing injuries; a positive alcohol test was recorded.

Collision between a 54-year-old woman and a 15-year-old boy while skiing at Petzen ski area resulted in serious and minor injuries respectively.

A 47-year-old German skier lost control on a steep slope in Kühtai ski area and collided with a 50-year-old Austrian woman, causing serious injuries to her.

A skiing accident occurred at Schlick 2000 ski area in Telfes involving a 12-year-old boy and an 11-year-old girl, resulting in minor and serious injuries respectively; two unidentified skiers fled the scene.

Collision between two skiers on intersecting slopes in Lech resulted in a severe injury to a 58-year-old man.

55-year-old skier collided with an unknown teenage girl on a ski slope and suffered a serious injury.
A 22-year-old French skier sustained severe spinal injuries after falling headfirst during a ski accident in Lech.
A 28-year-old Romanian man was arrested for several burglaries following a successful manhunt by Viennas Criminal Investigation Department.
A car crashed into a ditch at a roundabout, injuring the passenger, while the driver remained unharmed.
A 22-year-old woman collided with a car on B86 Villacher Straße in Villach after the other driver abruptly braked, causing her injuries and light vehicle damage. The other driver fled the scene.
A mudslide blocked Katschbergstraße B 99 in Seeboden, heavily damaging a passing car but causing no injuries.
A 19-year-old woman caused a traffic accident in Villach by ignoring a red light and colliding with another vehicle; one passenger was slightly injured.
A man physically assaulted his ex-girlfriend during an altercation in his apartment in Villach; the woman damaged a table. Both were reported to authorities.
Two skinned fox carcasses were found in a roadside ditch, suspected to have been shot and disposed of by an unknown perpetrator.

A 48-year-old truck driver from Vienna was seriously injured after his vehicle hit a concrete barrier, overturned on a slope, and came to a stop in the opposite direction on the A5 highway in Mistelbach. He was rescued using hydraulic tools and hospitalized.
A truck with a trailer veered off the road into a ditch causing injuries and environmental impact near Tulln.

Four Serbian nationals were caught in Suben with counterfeit license plates and registration certificates during a vehicle inspection.
Two skiers collided near a base station in Leogang, sustaining injuries and requiring hospital transport.

A fire broke out near a garden house in Wörgl, quickly extinguished by firefighters; cause under investigation.
An unidentified woman stole a winter jacket from a clothing store in Igls, ran away when confronted by the owner, but ultimately fled on a bus leaving behind another suspected stolen item.
A 12-year-old boy fell off a sled track in Achenkirch, sustaining severe injuries after colliding with a tree; he was airlifted to a clinic for treatment.
Car and van collision in Götzens resulted in injuries to a 52-year-old woman and significant damage to both vehicles.
A 43-year-old man, presumably intoxicated, attacked a 34-year-old food stand worker with a screwdriver but was disarmed by colleagues and arrested by police shortly thereafter.
Two robbery incidents occurred in Vienna; one involved threats with a knife, and the other included verbal threats and physical violence, but no money was stolen.
A 26-year-old man fell during a traditional parade in Vomp, suffering severe head injuries, exact circumstances unknown.
A snowboarder attacked a British man with a ski pole on a ski slope in Rohrberg, causing head injuries.
A transporter collided with a moped in St. Martin/Innkreis causing serious injury to the moped rider.

Two men were arrested for attempted burglary in a pharmacy following a witness report in Viennas Innere Stadt.
A woman in Linz was caught with drugs in a car. Her husband was driving under the influence of drugs with their child present.
A 22-year-old Hungarian man was arrested in a shelter for threatening and spitting at employees; cosmetics and alcohol were confiscated from him.
A 30-year-old man was arrested in Viennas Sonnwendgasse for burglarizing at least 30 cellars and possessing drugs.
A 49-year-old Polish man was arrested after breaking into a recycling center and stealing 18 old batteries.

Fire at a farm in Perg caused by unknown reasons destroyed a telehandler and a caravan, damaged a roof and affected a stall housing 80,000 chicks, with 20,000 possibly affected by smoke and temperature drop.

A strong gust of wind blew the flat roof of a residential building onto a meadow and two parked cars in Linz, causing damage but no injuries.
Chimney fire in vacation home in Bad Hofgastein, no injuries, toddler taken to hospital as precaution for smoke inhalation.
A motorcycle sidecar veered off the road, overturned, and landed on the railway tracks, causing minor injuries to the rider and temporary rail closure.
A 72-year-old pedestrian was fatally struck by a car while crossing the road; first aid efforts were unsuccessful.
A worker was found dead in a recycling plant after being struck by a falling cable drum; an investigation and autopsy have been initiated.
Fire partially destroyed the roof of a house caused by a cigarette; no injuries were reported.
A Ukrainian truck driver was found in Landeck with a manipulated tachograph and a vehicle with 70 technical defects; the vehicle was impounded and further travel prohibited.
A 30-year-old worker sustained severe head injuries when a falling wooden pallet struck him while operating a forklift in a warehouse in Dornbirn.
A man threatened another man with a knife during a parking dispute, was detained by police, and was found with a blank-firing gun; the knife was not located.
A man drove as a wrong-way driver on A2 in Arnoldstein and was stopped; he tested positive for alcohol.
A roof structure collapsed due to heavy snow load, lightly injuring two women and rendering the house uninhabitable.
A Romanian man was arrested at the Suben border crossing in Austria for being wanted by Interpol for embezzlement and possessing a forged Romanian drivers license.
A Pakistani asylum seeker fled during an identity check at Wels train station but was apprehended after a short escape.
A 30-year-old pedestrian was hit by a car at a crosswalk during snowfall in Ried im Innkreis and hospitalized with unspecified injuries.
A car skidded off the wet and slightly snowy road, crashed through a garden fence, and hit a parked car. The driver sustained injuries and was hospitalized.
A car driver was injured and trapped between two trucks following a collision involving multiple vehicles near Thalheim bei Wels.
A propane gas bottle caught fire in an underground garage in Salzburg-Nonntal, leading to evacuations and temporary traffic disruption. The fire was extinguished without injuries.

A domestic altercation in Salzburg led to injuries and police involvement. A 26-year-old woman drove without a license under the influence of alcohol, refused a breathalyzer test, and assaulted officers, resulting in her arrest.

A car rear-ended another at an intersection in Graz, the driver and passenger fled the scene. The driver was found to be intoxicated and without a license, and the car had been taken without the owners consent.
A car skidded off the road in Fließ; the driver jumped out and was unharmed.
A man without a drivers license and under the influence of drugs was stopped by police after attempting to evade them.
Two vehicles of a taxi company in Telfs had three tires slashed and an antenna removed.
Police conducted a house search in Vienna-Donaustadt, seizing 204 grams of cannabis prepared for sale; two suspects were reported on temporary release.
Multiple people were found consuming alcoholic beverages without masks or social distancing in a Klagenfurt bar; the uncooperative owner was briefly arrested to establish identity.
A 55-year-old man slipped on icy ground while delivering to a supermarket in Bruck an der Leitha, sustaining head injuries.
A fire broke out in a homes bathroom in Mureck due to heat from a sauna oven, with no injuries reported.
A 40-year-old Norwegian man was assaulted at the entrance of a local venue in St. Anton aA by a 32-year-old Dutchman, resulting in severe head injuries.
A 16-year-old on an e-scooter was hit by a car driven by a 67-year-old woman in Wolfsberg. The driver left the scene, and the teenager suffered minor injuries.
A 58-year-old woman was hit by a reversing car in a parking lot in Villach, causing a serious shoulder injury. The driver fled the scene.
A 27-year-old man was arrested in Vienna-Brigittenau for dealing heroin and cocaine and caught in the act.
Two suspects were apprehended on Laxenburger Straße with over 1 kg of cannabis; they were taken into custody.
Kitchen fire in Glanegg, two people taken to hospital for smoke inhalation; fire extinguished before spreading to roof.
Garbage bin fire in Salzburg-Schallmoos, extinguished by fire department, bin severely damaged.
A taxi driver hit an Italian pedestrian crossing the street in Reith bei Kitzbühel; one person was injured and taken to the hospital for treatment.
Two neighbors attacked each other, one threatened the other with a knife, police intervened, and one officer was injured during the arrest.
Three men vandalized ÖBB trains with graffiti in Vienna; one suspect was caught with spray cans and suspected cannabis.
A 24-year-old man died after losing control of his vehicle on winter roads and hitting trees in Gmunden district.
A car with summer tires slipped and hit a traffic sign in a roundabout in Salzburg; no one was injured.
A fire completely destroyed a farmhouse barn in Weerberg; no injuries reported.
Police dissolved a party in a student dormitory in Innsbruck involving 20 Erasmus students violating COVID-19 regulations.
A pedestrian was hit and injured by a car while crossing the street in Vienna.
Three Afghan teenage men were arrested in Vienna with 500 g of cannabis and cash after a taxi driver overheard them discussing a drug deal.
A Polish man suspected of planning hotel room burglaries was arrested in Vienna after suspicious behavior, possessing burglary tools and cannabis.
A delivery truck skidded off an icy road in Hintertheißenegg and fell into a steep forest area; the driver sustained injuries and was rescued by firefighters and airlifted to the hospital.
A 58-year-old farmer suffered a severe leg injury during logging work in Ferndorf, Kärnten, when a tree trunk broke and hit him; he was airlifted to the hospital.
A truck skidded on an icy road in Abtei, leading to a head-on collision with a car; one person was injured and taken to the hospital.
A woman lost control of her car on an icy road in Feistritz/Gail, causing it to overturn. She sustained injuries and was taken to the hospital.
A 65-year-old Romanian woman hid underwear in her jacket, attempted to leave a store in Mattighofen without paying, assaulted an employee who confronted her, and was later apprehended by police.
A Ghanaian woman attempted to apply for an E-Card using a stolen British passport at the BFA Linz, Oberösterreich and admitted to the theft.
A 56-year-old man died in a workplace accident in Pettenbach during the delivery of heating oil under unclear circumstances.
Two locals were involved in a car crash on Hochkönig Straße, resulting in injuries and vehicle total loss; alcohol was a contributing factor.
Collision between a car and a local train at a railway crossing in Uttendorf; minor damage to train, potential total loss for the car, no injuries.
A delivery van reversed into a 23-year-old pedestrian in Saalfelden, causing injuries requiring hospital treatment.
Two cars collided in Niederwölz, resulting in three injuries; one driver was slightly alcohol-impaired.
An unknown man attempted to snatch a 16-year-old girls handbag in Graz, but failed and fled without loot after her resistance and the help of two bystanders.
A falling rock damaged a car on the L 302 in Gratkorn, causing a total road closure; no injuries reported.
A garbage bin caught fire due to disposed ash; no injuries, minimal damage.
A 42-year-old female pedestrian was fatally struck by a truck in Graz while crossing a parking entrance.
A man in Innsbruck was attacked and robbed by unknown individuals on a public street, sustaining minor facial injuries.
A car lost control and collided with an oncoming vehicle on the B187 in Lermoos, injuring a passenger who required rescue and medical attention.
A theft occurred in Mayrhofen where an unidentified man stole a wallet with cash and a bank card from an unlocked house.
A driver was caught speeding at 174 km/h in a 50 km/h zone despite adverse weather conditions in the Triester Straße area of Vienna; they face legal consequences.
Two swans causing traffic disruption at Floridsdorfer Brücke were safely relocated to the Danube Island by police.
A candle left insufficiently extinguished caused a minor fire and smoke development in a Wolfsberg apartment, leading to a fire department response; no injuries occurred.

Police stopped a 39-year-old driver from Linz on the A1 motorway in Altlengbach, who showed signs of drug impairment; a drug test was positive, and the driver was found with an illegal weapon (brass knuckles).
An 83-year-old man was injured in a house fire in St. Leonhard am Forst; fire was extinguished by local fire departments and the man was hospitalized.
Two cars collided head-on, one driver had to be freed by firefighters, and both were hospitalized with injuries in Krems-Land district.

A 42-year-old woman went missing from a care home in the Bezirk Gmunden. A search operation involving firefighters, police, and rescue dog teams was launched, and she was found unharmed near Bahnhof Gmunden.
A masked man with a firearm robbed a gas station in Linz, threatening an employee and fleeing with stolen cash.
A drunk driver collided with another vehicle, causing severe damage and injuring both drivers.
A 20-year-old man was injured during forestry work in Tamsweg and rescued by helicopter.
39-year-old driver led police on a 30 km high-speed chase, caused an accident, and ended the escape with a crash. He was heavily intoxicated and lacked a driving license.
Fire broke out in a multi-apartment building in Graz, killing one person and prompting rescue operations for six individuals. Investigations are ongoing.
A smoldering fire originated in a silo due to a homemade heating drying system; no injuries were reported but significant property damage occurred.
A 94-year-old pedestrian in Hall in Tirol was hit by a bus while crossing the street, sustaining unspecified injuries and being hospitalized.
A 64-year-old man suffered severe hand injuries while operating a wood milling machine at his workshop in Virgen and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 20-year-old German worker fell approximately 10 meters while working on a building chimney in Lermoos, sustaining a thigh fracture.
A worker fell 3 meters while operating a crane on a construction site in Dornbirn, sustaining serious injuries.
ISO-certification for police communication centers completed in Vorarlberg, Austria, making it the first EU country with such certification.
Laser/Radar blocker found in a car and a forged driving license discovered at border controls in Burgenland, Austria.
Four Czech nationals were stopped in Puchenau, their car searched revealed stolen goods including whiskey, razors, clothing, and candy; one suspect had an active warrant.
A pedestrian was lightly injured after allegedly being hit by a small truck in Graz; police are seeking witnesses to clarify differing accounts.
Unidentified individuals broke into a parked concrete mixer truck in Kirchbichl, stealing a high-value radiomatic receiver and transmitter, and caused significant damage.
A tobacco shop employee was tricked by a fraudster pretending to be a supplier, resulting in a loss of 2000 euros through fake voucher codes.
A 24-year-old cyclist was injured in a traffic accident when a car driver failed to notice her while entering a roundabout in Salzburg.
Three unidentified assailants in St. Pölten attacked a deliveryman, stealing his cash earnings. Later, three suspects, aged 16, 17, and 19, were arrested and partially confessed.
A series of criminal acts were conducted targeting a 29-year-old resident in St. Aegyd am Neuwalde, including vandalism, arson, and a gun offense, all linked to a prior dispute.
A 27-year-old man attempted to rob a womans handbag and slapped her when she refused to give money; passersby detained him until police arrived.

A 26-year-old man attacked a 45-year-old neighbor with a taser during an argument in a multi-family house in Klagenfurt, lightly injuring him. Police found cannabis plants and dried cannabis in the attackers apartment.

A 20-year-old driver attempted to overtake another car and collided head-on with an oncoming vehicle. Both drivers were injured and taken to the hospital. The road was temporarily closed for recovery operations.
Two drivers injured in a car collision at an intersection in Leonding, Austria.
Two people were injured in a head-on car collision in Deutschfeistritz, with emergency services dispatched to the scene.
Several high-value bicycles were stolen from a bike shop in Feldbach during the night after accessing via a side door.
Two men were caught breaking into a residence in Vienna-Hietzing, with tools and cash seized; they are suspected of other crimes.
A 9-year-old boy collided with a car at a pedestrian crossing and sustained minor injuries in Vienna.
A 21-year-old Bulgarian woman was observed attempting pickpocketing during a police operation and was arrested in Viennas city center.
Traffic operation in Vienna led to multiple charges, including 17 drugged drivers, 2 drunk drivers, and various traffic violations.
Two court bailiffs were attacked and injured by a woman during an eviction attempt in an apartment in Vienna.
Two unidentified male suspects stole a wallet from a shopping cart in a supermarket in Bezirk Villach Land, causing a loss of several hundred euros.
A fire broke out along the Tauernbahn railway near Penk, likely caused by sparks from a passing freight train, burning an area of 1500m².
A skiing accident occurred at Nassfeld where a 19-year-old Polish skier collided with a 13-year-old German snowboarder after his ski binding opened, leading to her injuries.
A cyclist was injured after being struck by an excavator arm and falling down an embankment.
Truck with trailer in tilted position detected on A2 highway near Velden, later found with structural and brake issues, along with other violations. Driver fined.
A car collided with a truck and another vehicle in Ternitz causing injuries to the 79-year-old driver, possibly influenced by alcohol.
A 73-year-old man lost control of his car on the A2 highway due to a medical emergency and collided with another vehicle, causing minor damage; he was airlifted to a hospital with suspected stroke.
Trick theft incidents and a traffic accident resulting in personal injury occurred, and authorities are seeking additional victims and witnesses.
A 24-year-old male crashed his car into a garden fence in Wippenham, sustaining severe injuries and causing environmental damage from vehicle fluids.
A rolling van on the A1 highway caused two collisions involving other vehicles, injuring an 18-year-old passenger. One driver tested with 1.02 promille alcohol level.
Collision between two skiers at a chairlift exit resulted in a serious knee injury for a 54-year-old German woman.
A skier fell due to poor visibility and injured his hip while freeriding in Mauterndorf. Rescue efforts involved local Freeriders, mountain rescue, and a helicopter evacuation.
A major fire broke out in a production hall in Oberndorf, likely caused by overheating of machinery, resulting in significant damage but no injuries.
Two work machines were stolen in Wals, Austria; the incident occurred between 12:00 and 13:00 on February 12, 2020.
A woman attacked her former partner with a kitchen knife, injuring his hands and thigh.
A fire broke out in the first floor of a single-family house, caused possibly by a technical defect in a dryer; no injuries reported, damage amount unknown.
A 47-year-old man was injured during woodwork activities in his own forest when a log attached to a winch struck his leg after being blocked against a tree.
A car caught fire on the A2 motorway in Gleisdorf, with no injuries reported. Firefighters extinguished the blaze completely.
A forest fire near Gleichenberger Kogel in Bad Gleichenberg affected around 5,000 m²; no injuries reported, and investigations into the cause are ongoing.
A 64-year-old Austrian skier fell approximately 50 meters while mountain climbing in Obertilliach, sustaining severe injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 13-year-old boy in Biberwier was injured by a snow blower, leading to severe finger injuries and requiring hospitalization.
A car driven by a 24-year-old German woman lost control and collided with a truck and another car, causing injuries to three individuals and significant damage to the vehicles.
Police warn of two scams: fraudulent calls claiming to be Microsoft support and fake SMS claiming to be from DHL requesting payment and personal data.
A fire broke out in the basement of a company in Lustenau, severely affecting stored yarn; authorities are investigating the cause.
A 57-year-old man was seriously injured on a construction site in Feldkirch after slipping on muddy ground and losing control of a crane, causing bricks to fall on him.
Three masked suspects committed armed robbery at a supermarket after closing and locked staff in a room before fleeing.
A 28-year-old man was arrested after attacking a 30-year-old woman during a confrontation in a rented apartment in Vienna.
A protest in Eisenstadt addressed concerns about lockdown measures and led to four fines for rule violations.
A collision occurred on Miegerer Straße in Ebenthal when a car crossed into the opposite lane due to sun glare, leaving one woman injured and significant vehicle damage.
A 20-year-old driver hit a 21-year-old pedestrian on a crosswalk in Villach, causing injuries. The pedestrian was taken to the hospital.
A skiing collision occurred between a 13-year-old from Klagenfurt and a 20-year-old from Graz. The 13-year-old was injured and taken to a hospital, while the 20-year-old remained unharmed.
A 19-year-old skier from Vienna fell on the Spitzeck slope in the St. Oswald ski area, suffering a severe leg injury and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 25-year-old man lost control of his car in Randegg, causing it to overturn several times and resulting in serious injuries.
A Romanian truck driver attacked another truck driver with a knife, causing a hand injury; the suspect was arrested after a pursuit.
A 41-year-old climber died after falling 300 meters on Traunstein during his descent via the Mairalmsteig route.
Two cars collided at an intersection in Linz-Land, resulting in three individuals being injured and transported to the hospital.
A 32-year-old woman faced severe injuries due to a domestic dispute in Saalfelden; her husband was issued a restraining order.
A skiing collision in Kleinarl resulted in a South Tyrolean woman being injured; the male skier involved left without exchanging information.
A 62-year-old man caused a fire in Wagrain after leaving a wood-fired stove unattended; the fire was extinguished by firefighters and no injuries were reported.
An 84-year-old man was injured in a collision between a car and a truck on L 211 in St. Peter am Ottersbach, Austria.
An 80-year-old skier fell and was rescued by emergency services after being stranded in the alpine terrain during his descent from Waxriegelhaus.
A 25-year-old Hungarian man was severely injured in Silz while attempting to repair a trucks container roll-up door and was trapped between the loading ramp and the truck trailer.
A 15-year-old girl slipped and fell 16-18 meters over a steep cliff during a hike in Götzis, sustaining injuries. She was airlifted to the hospital, while a boy stuck above was rescued by helicopter.
A construction worker found suspected war materials, prompting police to secure the area and explosives experts to safely remove a large tank shell.
Three parked vehicles in Gerlos had their rear windows smashed by an unknown perpetrator.
COVID-19 border controls were implemented in Tirol, Austria, with 459 people temporarily denied exit due to lacking a negative SARS-CoV-2 test.

Police officers in Vienna saved the life of a 2-year-old girl experiencing a febrile seizure by using an old method of applying lemon juice to her lips, which helped loosen her clenched jaw and restore consciousness.
A 49-year-old man caught throwing a stone at a window; linked to 10 similar incidents of vandalism in recent months.
Four intoxicated individuals were involved in a physical altercation in Salzburg, leading to injuries and legal charges.
Police deployed media liaison officers for assemblies in Vienna on February 13, 2021.
