A fire broke out in a loaders cab on a company premises, possibly due to a technical defect, causing significant damage. The fire was extinguished by staff before firefighters arrived.
A car accident occurred in Schandachen, Austria, where a driver and two passengers sustained injuries, with one requiring airlift to a hospital.
Two people injured in a head-on collision involving two cars in Vöcklabruck district, both hospitalized.
Two 17-year-olds in Graz vandalized vehicles, set fire to trash bins, and attempted to ignite another bin while under the influence of alcohol, resulting in police apprehension.
Police attempted to stop a driver speeding through multiple towns who eventually fled but was apprehended using a patrol car and pepper spray, with no injuries reported.
A man stole a perfume tester, threatened a security guard with a knife during his escape, and was later apprehended by police.
Two teenagers threatened four others with a pistol and stole €10, later apprehended with the stolen money and a gas-powered pistol.
A 17-year-old and two others robbed a phone from a 16-year-old during a failed cannabis purchase in Klagenfurt.
Two women from Vienna were rescued from rugged terrain near Weißensee by a mountain rescue team after becoming stranded during a hike.
Three youths damaged a car in Klagenfurt and fled; a separate man was arrested for drug possession and had a warrant for his arrest. A police officer was injured during the pursuit.
A farmer sustained severe leg injuries while logging in a forest; rescue teams and a helicopter were involved in his evacuation.
A 16-year-old snowboarder collided with a 14-year-old skier on the slopes of Gerlitzen, causing the skier to be injured and airlifted to a hospital.
A multi-vehicle traffic accident involving a Czech semi-truck and several other vehicles in Hollabrunn caused severe injuries to two individuals and minor injuries to others.
A truck caught fire on the highway near St. Florian, burning completely; cause unknown.
A 19-year-old man was seriously injured after being hit by a car while attempting to retrieve a dead cat from the road.
A car collided with a turning truck at Pötschenpass, overturning and injuring the elderly occupants; the road was temporarily closed for recovery.

A school group of 12 children and their teacher were rescued from steep terrain near Krippenstein. Helicopters and mountain rescue teams were involved in the operation. Two children sustained minor injuries.

A 40-year-old woman was found dead after a fire incident in Weibern, Upper Austria. Her husband and another woman discovered her in the house, which was filled with smoke. Both rescuers sustained smoke inhalation injuries. The cause of the fire is under investigation, with no signs of foul play.
Police halted two vehicles in Pongau before midnight; drugs and paraphernalia were found with the drivers, who were reported and substances confiscated.
A 52-year-old driver veered off the road on Filzmooser Landesstraße and landed in a creek; he was rescued by emergency services and taken to a hospital.
A 79-year-old woman died in a car accident after driving off-road and tumbling 200 meters down steep terrain; her son found the vehicle and her body later in the afternoon.
A woman in Leibnitz was robbed of her handbag after being pushed to the ground, sustaining minor injuries.
A lorry driven by a Hungarian man went off the road on the A9, spilling diesel due to a damaged tank. No injuries were reported.
Fire broke out in a heating plant boiler, causing damage of unknown extent but was quickly extinguished by fire departments. No one was injured.
A 49-year-old pedestrian was seriously injured in Graz after being hit by a car driven by a 78-year-old woman who lost control at an intersection.
Thieves stole cash from wallets in a sports centers locker rooms in Telfs, Austria.
A Spanish man was robbed at gunpoint by an unknown assailant who only took a pack of cigarettes in Innsbruck.
A man in Jenbach attempted to kick a one-year-old girl but missed; he was arrested and found responsible for vehicle damage on the same day.
A 34-year-old Russian man had a skiing accident in Zillertal Arena, Rohrberg, suffering a head trauma and shoulder injury.
A 45-year-old Danish skier fatally fell into a creek bed while skiing at Stubaier Glacier in Neustift, despite rescue efforts.
Firefighters addressed reignited hotspots in the roof of a previously burnt building in Lustenau.
A 19-year-old German tourist assaulted two taxi drivers in Lech after refusing to pay a taxi fare and attempting to flee; he was intoxicated and temporarily arrested.

A fire was detected in the heating room of a residential building in Rankweil, causing limited damage. No injuries were reported and the fire was quickly extinguished. Investigation into the cause is ongoing.
Fire broke out in Lustenau at a building with a pizzeria and apartments. All residents evacuated safely, one suffered suspected smoke inhalation. Fire was extinguished by firefighters.
A British skier was found unresponsive near a ski slope in Zürs. Immediate resuscitation efforts were made, and the victim was stabilized and transported to a hospital.

Two suspected drug dealers were arrested in Vienna at Westbahnhof and Mariahilfer Straße. One sold heroin, while the other sold cocaine. Both were caught with drugs and cash. Five buyers were also reported.
A male driver in Unterfrauenhaid caused a traffic accident due to alcohol intoxication, hitting a parked car and resulting in both vehicles being totaled. He had a blood alcohol level of 2.06‰.
Unknown perpetrators vandalized vending machines at the Pyramidenkogel observation tower in Keutschach.
Unknown perpetrators broke into self-service cash registers for agricultural products, stealing coins and causing damage.

A chimney fire escalated into a roof fire causing significant damage to a house and rendering it uninhabitable in Lavamünd, Austria. Firefighters faced challenges due to water shortage, but no injuries were reported.
A 22-year-old skier triggered an avalanche during a ski tour, was carried 250-300 meters, sustained minor injuries, and was rescued by emergency services.
A driver was caught speeding at 170 km/h in a 70 km/h zone and tested with an alcohol level of 0.66 promille.
Two drivers in Austria were stopped by police for driving under the influence of drugs, specifically cannabis, leading to the revocation of their driving licenses.
A farmer in Bezirk Steyr-Land was attacked by a bull in his barn, resulting in injuries and hospitalization.
Two intoxicated drivers were caught in Salzburg driving under the influence; one as a wrong-way driver and the other over the alcohol limit.
Two skiers triggered an avalanche on Sonnblick, contacted police, and were rescued by helicopter without injuries.
A Slovenian man was arrested for behaving aggressively and harassing customers and staff in a shop near Graz Main Station.
A Romanian man assaulted a security guard with brass knuckles after being denied entry to a gas station in Graz due to COVID restrictions, resulting in his arrest.
A 63-year-old man was seriously injured after falling 150 meters down steep terrain during a ski tour.
A 49-year-old woman was injured during a ski tour and airlifted to the hospital.
Two men attempted to return tampered PCs under false names in Innsbruck; drugs were found during a house search.
A 27-year-old Austrian skier fell while descending from the Ederplan peak in Dölsach, injuring his left knee; he was airlifted to the hospital.
An 88-year-old driver slid off an icy road, went down a slope, was trapped in his car, and was rescued by firefighters.
A Nigerian man was arrested in Linz for selling marijuana to two individuals.
Burglary at the Talstation of Brandstadllift in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser; thieves broke into the building, accessed the cashier room, removed and opened a safe, and stole cash.
A 49-year-old man reported being threatened, injured with a knife, and robbed by a 37-year-old acquaintance in Vienna. The suspect was arrested and the victim hospitalized.

A 24-year-old woman was caught stealing food from a self-service store in Gmünd; the stolen items were found in her car along with evidence of other violations including driving without a license and using invalid license plates.
Police conducted COVID-19 regulation checks at ski area access roads; various violations and fines issued.

Two men from Carinthia were arrested after stealing a cordless drill from a hardware store in Judenburg; further investigations revealed multiple related thefts of tools in Styria, Carinthia, and Lower Austria.
An animal trap was illegally set in Neuhofen/Krems, and a cat was injured but rescued by firefighters and taken to a veterinarian.
A 51-year-old man manipulated a camera at a farm shop, stole cash and food items, ran over a shop owners foot during escape, and was later found mildly intoxicated with stolen goods in his car.
A house fire broke out in Hirtenberg early in the morning; occupants evacuated safely, and the fire was extinguished. The homeowner was treated for suspected smoke inhalation.
A fire broke out in a farmhouse in Alberdorf, requiring nine fire brigades. A male body was discovered in the burned section, and investigations are ongoing.
A man attacked a 47-year-old Turkish man at Hanuschplatz, stole his wallet, and fled on foot with cash.
A man falsely reported his car stolen in Zell am See after failing to remember where he parked it; he later admitted to driving under the influence with a blood alcohol level over 1.5 promille.
A car collided head-on with a truck on a snow-covered road, resulting in the death of the car driver. The truck driver was unharmed.

A 28-year-old woman crashed her car on Gailtal-Schattseitenstraße, resulting in the vehicle overturning and her being trapped. Emergency services rescued her and transported her to the hospital where a positive alcohol test was recorded. Her drivers license was revoked.
Three suspects threw bottles and bricks at parked police cars in Wels, causing damage, and fled in a grey VW Golf.
A 72-year-old driver collided with a 33-year-old pedestrian at a crosswalk, causing injuries requiring hospital treatment.
Police stopped a speeding driver on the A23 in Vienna after detecting multiple traffic violations and driving at a top speed of 144 km/h; the drivers license was temporarily confiscated.

Burglars broke into two adjacent houses in Klagenfurt, stealing jewelry, savings books, and documents of unknown value from one house; theft in the second house remains uncertain as the owners are on vacation.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a terraced house in Klagenfurt a.W. by forcing open the patio door and stole various jewelry of unknown value.
A 25-year-old man was caught driving at 131 km/h in a 70 km/h zone on the August-Jakschstraße in Klagenfurt a.W. by a police laser device and will be reported.
17-year-old driver in Linz without a valid license fled police during routine vehicle check, caused minor accident before being detained.
An intoxicated Slovak truck driver crashed through multiple bridge railings, caused extensive damage to fields and road facilities, and was found with a 1.5‰ BAC level in Hochburg Ach.
A 60-year-old worker fell approximately five meters and was severely injured due to a snapped steel cable of a freight elevator in Sattledt.
Three Afghan asylum seekers in Linz were arrested for organized drug dealing, selling 18 kg of cannabis and ecstasy from 2017 to 2019.
Attempted burglary of a vending machine at Mittersill railway station thwarted by witness; suspects fled.
A 17-year-old attempted to steal a wine bottle, injured a store detective during escape, and was detained.
A mattress caught fire in a dorm room after a heat lamp tipped over; no injuries and minimal damage.
A dryer caught fire in the basement of a house in Graz; no injuries were reported.
A 76-year-old man fell from a ladder about 3.5 meters high and sustained serious injuries while retrieving feed on a farm.
A grass field near LKH Graz caught fire, likely caused by a discarded cigarette, and was extinguished without injuries or significant damage.
A 76-year-old womans wallet was stolen in Wörgl, but the thief was quickly apprehended by the police with the help of a shop assistant.
An 80-year-old driver collided with a snowplow on Kühtaier Straße, causing injuries and significant damage.
Four vehicles were involved in a serious traffic accident at a crossroads in Nüziders, resulting in severe injuries and a hit-and-run incident by a truck driver.
An American snowboarder went off the marked ski route in Lech and became stuck in deep snow, requiring rescue by a police helicopter. He was unharmed.
Two men displayed aggressive behavior during a police check, with one attempting to flee and attacking an officer with his elbow; both were arrested.
Illegal gambling discovered in an apartment; gaming machines and a cash dispenser were confiscated, investigations ongoing.
A woman reported years of domestic violence by her husband, who admitted to physical abuse. After being evicted from their home, the husband threatened her for calling the police.

A fire caused by smoldering cigarette remnants in a flowerpot damaged a wooden planter and partially destroyed the facade of a house in Velden am Wörthersee; the fire was extinguished by the fire department and a passing motorist.
Fire incident occurred in a companys heating system in Ludmannsdorf, Klagenfurt Land; no injuries reported.
Collision between two cars in Wr. Neudorf involving a drunk driver; injuries reported.
A 28-year-old woman fell and sustained injuries while sledding on the Erlebnisrodelbahn at Zauberberg. She was transported to the hospital after initial rescue efforts.

A 39-year-old Romanian national was arrested during a border check at Leopoldschlag-FGP while entering Austria from the Czech Republic on a Romanian bus. The arrest was based on an order from the public prosecutors office in Linz, and the man was handed over to Linz authorities and later transferred to the Linz prison.
Around 120 participants of an unauthorized gathering in Wels moved through the city center, resulting in multiple citations and one arrest for aggressive behavior.
A 21-year-old man drove off the road, hit a tree, and was seriously injured, but discovered only hours later.
Around 130 people participated in an unregistered protest walk in Salzburg, complying mostly with COVID-19 regulations; police issued at least 18 fines but no arrests or criminal charges were made.

Multiple alpine accidents occurred in the Hohe Veitsch and Aflenzer Bürgeralm areas, with individuals suffering injuries due to falls on icy terrain. Rescue operations were conducted, including a helicopter evacuation.
A car caught fire near a residential house in Bad Aussee, resulting in total damage. Firefighters extinguished the blaze; a technical defect in the engine is suspected as the cause.
Head-on collision between vehicles in Wörgl caused by dangerous overtaking, involving multiple injuries and a car catching fire.
A fire broke out in a warehouse of a carpentry workshop in Matrei in Osttirol, and firefighters managed to control it with no injuries reported.
A car crash occurred in Fügen, Austria, at the intersection of Sonnenweg and Pankrazbergstraße. Both drivers sustained injuries, and both vehicles suffered significant damage.
A roof fire broke out in Dornbirn, caused by an overheated chimney, resulting in significant property damage but no injuries.
A fridge caught fire in Ludesch due to smoldering ashes placed in a cardboard box on top of it; one person suspected of smoke inhalation.
A residential building in Feldkirch caught fire, resulting in significant damage and making the property uninhabitable. No injuries to persons or animals were reported.
A 19-year-old man died by suicide by jumping from the tower of the Araburg castle ruin in Kaumberg, Austria.
A 28-year-old man with a blood alcohol level of 1.4 ‰ caused a car accident in Helpfau-Uttendorf, rolling the vehicle with two children onboard. No one was injured.
Unknown offenders broke into a company premises and stole about 70 new truck tires.
A 35-year-old man in Scheibbs crashed his car while driving under the influence of alcohol, overturning the vehicle. He sustained a minor injury.
A 27-year-old man threatened his employer to set the workplace on fire and resisted arrest, injuring two officers; tested positive for THC.
Police cars were damaged by individuals throwing beer bottles and bricks; four suspects identified, with some attempting evidence tampering and false testimony.
A 36-year-old woman attacked a police officer during a dispute and was arrested.
A 56-year-old woman lost control of her car on the B211 in Rohrau, Austria, colliding with a parked car and overturning her vehicle. She sustained injuries and was hospitalized.
A 20-year-old driver in Salzburg was caught with cannabis and an illegal knife during a traffic stop.
A kitchen fire occurred in a nursing home in Schladming, caused by overheated oil, and was extinguished by staff and firefighters.
Police intervened in Kufstein after a man threatened another with a kitchen knife and injured him; weapons and disguised firearms were seized.
Two intoxicated German men slid on a protective snow cannon mat down a ski slope in Söll, losing control and crashing into a parked car; one was injured.
Smoke from burnt food in an oven triggered a fire alarm in Feldkirch, leading to a fire brigade response. The resident was treated for potential smoke inhalation.
An armed robber threatened a bank employee in Doppl/Leonding and fled with cash in a plastic bag.

Two workers in Eferding were injured during steel cutting when sparks ignited car parts, causing a fire. They attempted to extinguish it but failed, and the fire brigade controlled the fire. Both suffered from smoke inhalation, and one had a burn injury.
A 27-year-old woman drove off-road and crashed into a guardrail due to alcohol impairment; she sustained minor injuries and her dog remained unharmed.
A 31-year-old woman tragically died after falling against a departing subway train at the Am Schöpfwerk station.
Kitchen fire caused by overheated oil in a house; one man hospitalized for suspected smoke inhalation, no further injuries.
A 47-year-old intoxicated man in Feldkirchen, Austria disrupted public order, vandalized a door, and resisted arrest after returning to the scene repeatedly.
A 58-year-old man lost control of his pickup truck, collided with parked vehicles, and was ejected through the windshield. He sustained injuries and was hospitalized.
A 22-year-old snowboarder in Skigebiet Hochkar was rescued from an alpine emergency after sliding about 200 meters on snow masses and being unable to ascend due to steep terrain.
A 70-year-old man lost control of a vintage tractor on a steep road, causing it to overturn and eject him, resulting in serious injuries.
A truck carrying hazardous materials was stopped on the A5 in Mistelbach for failing to comply with transport regulations, and the driver lacked necessary certification.
An armed masked man robbed a tobacco shop in Neunkirchen, escaping with cash while the employee remained unharmed.
18-year-old man in Linz was caught driving without a license or registration; he had taken license plates from another vehicle for a test drive.
A 12-year-old boy was robbed at knifepoint for his cellphone and smartwatch on a train near Vöcklabruck.
Three bus passengers were injured after an abrupt brake maneuver by a bus driver to avoid a collision with a car that ran a red light in Wels.
A 19-year-old skier under the influence of alcohol got stranded on a ski slope and was rescued uninjured using a piste machine.
A 61-year-old man disposed of stove ashes in a forest in Weiz district, Austria, causing a dry leaf fire affecting 3000 sqm.
A 21-year-old Syrian man entered a homeless shelter in Innsbruck multiple times despite a ban and acted aggressively. He resisted arrest and injured two police officers before being detained.
A 15-year-old German skier lost control on a slope in Sölden, slid downhill, and suffered injuries after crashing. She was rescued by helicopter and taken to a hospital.
Fire occurred in a chimney of a multi-family house; no injuries or damage reported.
A 30-year-old German skier lost control and collided with a snow lance, suffering serious chest injuries despite protective padding.
A skier in Lech/Zürs collided with another skier, causing injuries to the first skiers shoulder before the second skier fled the scene.

A 55-year-old man was seriously injured while working on storm-damaged wood in a forest in Schwarzenberg when a log piece struck his leg. He was rescued by the mountain rescue service and flown to a hospital.
A woman in Vienna threatened her husband with a knife, leading to her arrest and injuries for both.
A 15-year-old, accompanied by two friends, shot a blank gun at a building in Vienna. The suspects were apprehended in a tram, and a blank gun with ammunition was seized by police.
A 7-year-old girl went missing after school, initiated a large-scale search operation, and was later found safe by a man who brought her to safety.
Unidentified individuals scratched a high-value car parked in a carport in Klagenfurt using a sharp object.
A 42-year-old driver hit a 14-year-old pedestrian in Villach, causing injuries for the latter who was taken to the hospital.
Pilot made an emergency landing at Klagenfurt airport after the aircraft suffered damage mid-flight; no injuries were reported.
A car collision at an intersection in St. Bernhard-Frauenhofen resulted in injuries to three individuals who were transported to a hospital.
A 57-year-old woman suffered severe leg injuries after falling while skiing and was rescued by mountain rescue services and transported to a hospital.
Carnival celebrations in Ebensee with violations of COVID-19 regulations, fines issued, and two drivers had licenses revoked.
A 20-year-old Afghan man in Linz was arrested for drug dealing, including selling heroin and marijuana to minors, with some drugs found in his apartment.
A fire caused significant damage to a house; a woman suffered smoke inhalation but escaped with neighbors help.
A 16-year-old girl threatened to kill her brother during a police interview and was subsequently arrested and detained.
Fire caused by overheated cooking oil damaged a kitchen and parts of an apartment in Graz; no injuries reported.
British nationals caused disturbance and resisted police, with some fleeing and others arrested.
A plastic flower pot on an external windowsill in Innsbruck caught fire, with melted plastic causing further combustion below. Firefighters extinguished the blaze with no injuries reported.
A fire broke out in a workshop building in Reutte due to a suspected electrical short circuit; no injuries were reported, and the fire was managed by the fire brigade.
Controlled chimney fire in a residential house, no injuries or significant damage reported.
A 57-year-old foreman suffered a rib fracture after losing balance and falling against a construction formwork in Westendorf.
Collision between a skier and a snowmobile on a ski slope led to serious injuries for the skier.
During a ski jumping event, a 32-year-old intoxicated man was involved in a scuffle and briefly detained near the venue.
Unknown perpetrators stole five chainsaws and a table saw from four farms, causing significant financial damage.
Fire broke out in a single-family house in Salzburg Liefering, quickly extinguished by firefighters; no injuries, suspected arson.
An 18-year-old man was robbed and assaulted by two 17-year-olds near a nightclub in Röthis; suspects fled but were later identified by the police.
A 91-year-old man was drugged and robbed in his home by a woman and potentially others pretending to visit with good intentions.
A 70-year-old man lost control of his vintage tractor on a steep road and was ejected, suffering severe injuries that led to his death days later.
A 29-year-old man repeatedly drove without a license in Freistadt, using a company vehicle with a fake license copy. He was stopped, the vehicle key was confiscated, and he faces charges.
Masked and armed man robbed a bank in Doppl, threatened a staff member, obtained cash, and fled on foot. Suspect later arrested.
Two suspects robbed a victim and were later arrested with drugs involved.
Police conducted a coordinated action against reckless drivers, resulting in 17 traffic citations, two license plate confiscations, and fines collected totaling over €2,000.
Unsecured bicycles were stolen and significant damage was caused to a railway barrier in Ferndorf; suspects partially admitted to the theft but denied the vandalism.
A 40-year-old woman fell approximately 3 meters into a stall after overlooking an open floor hatch on a farm in Seeboden and sustained unspecified injuries.
A brawl occurred in a nightclub in Regau involving four men who attacked each other with glasses and bottles, resulting in three injuries of unspecified severity.
A 19-year-old driver under the influence fled after crashing into a traffic light post, causing damage to property in Traun.
A car crashed into a house in Straßwalchen, severely injuring the driver and causing major property damage.
A construction container caught fire due to a likely technical defect in a heater; no injuries reported.
A multi-family house caught fire in Gleisdorf; police and firefighters evacuated residents and extinguished the blaze.
Two vehicles collided on a snowy road near Ternberg, resulting in three injuries and requiring emergency services for rescue and vehicle recovery.
A 51-year-old man was injured in a van accident on the A1 after being cut off by another car, causing his vehicle to skid and crash into barriers.
Attempted break-in at a jeweler in Salzburg; suspects were checked nearby.
31-year-old Czech man suspected of repeated fraud targeting hospitality businesses across Austria.
A fugitive female prisoner was arrested during a drug crime control operation and handed over to judicial authorities.
Two fire incidents in Vienna injured multiple people; one caused by a defective battery and another likely by a burning candle.
A 15-year-old driver evaded police, drove recklessly, attempted to ram police vehicles, and was arrested after a chase involving gunfire from officers.
Alcohol-impaired driver caused a traffic accident, injured two people, and fled the scene before being stopped by police.
Two skiing accidents occurred in the Bad Kleinkirchheim ski area; a 17-year-old fell on her own and a Dutch woman was severely injured after a collision with an unidentified skier.
Several individuals stole bicycles and possibly damaged a railway barrier; investigations are ongoing.
Overloaded animal transporter carrying ponies, a horse, and a foal with insufficient space was stopped in St. Valentin; the driver lacked required documentation and was fined.
A car driven by a 44-year-old woman overturned and landed on its roof; she was rescued and flown to the hospital with injuries.
A 44-year-old driver struck a 61-year-old cyclist at an intersection in Tribuswinkel, causing injuries that required hospitalization.
A 27-year-old Slovak truck driver with 1.5 per mille alcohol level was stopped on the A 4 Ostautobahn and had his license confiscated.
A 40-year-old skier was seriously injured after being struck by another skier on a downhill slope at the Hochkar ski area and was airlifted to the hospital.
A 44-year-old woman lost control of her car in Peygarten-Ottenstein, leading to it overturning; she was airlifted to a hospital with injuries.
A 37-year-old man went missing during a mountain tour on Traunstein, prompting a search operation with helicopters and ground teams.
Driver in Kaprun was found driving under influence with 2.22 promille; his license and car keys were confiscated.
Overloaded Serbian-registered truck stopped and weighed, showing significant safety violations; driver and owner will face legal actions.
A man was injured when a 20-ton steel block swung unexpectedly during crane operation.
Two Austrian men destroyed snow poles and damaged 10 streetlights in Ehenbichl before being caught by police.
A 21-year-old Austrian lost control of his vehicle on Paß-Thurn-Straße, crashed into a concrete wall, and was found to be heavily intoxicated.

A 17-year-old skier left the marked ski route at Kriegerhorn in Lech and fell 60 meters over shrubs and rocky terrain, suffering serious injuries. He was rescued by helicopter and transported to a hospital.
A car flipped and landed on its roof near a stream; a 44-year-old woman was rescued and airlifted to a hospital with injuries of unknown severity.
A 37-year-old man went missing during a mountain tour at Traunstein; he fell about 500 meters while attempting to descend steep terrain. His body was later found after a search operation.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a business in Rum, stealing cash from a coffee machine and a safe containing money and securities.
Two vehicles collided on a snowy road in Ternberg, injuring three individuals who were taken to the hospital.
Police rescued an abandoned young dog found in a vacant house in Simmering, Vienna.
An elderly woman in Vienna was tricked by a scammer impersonating a police officer into handing over a bag with cash and gold.
A man suffered a cardiac arrest due to choking on a peanut but was successfully resuscitated with a defibrillator and CPR.
Three young men assaulted and robbed a man on the street; all suspects have been identified and apprehended.
Two unknown perpetrators broke into an accommodation facility in Wolfsberg, stole cash from a cash register and a furniture safe, and fled. A police search was unsuccessful.
A man broke into a shop in Salzburg-Mülln, stole tobacco products, and fled towards Mönchsberg before the police arrived.
A shoplifter in Viennas Jägerstraße was found carrying narcotics and a knife, and attacked officers during apprehension.
An e-scooter collides with a pedestrian causing minor injuries to both individuals in Vienna.
Collision on a highway involving a tractor and a car, leading to injuries and vehicle damage.
A 12-year-old British boy was injured in a skiing accident on a slope in Bad Kleinkirchheim and airlifted to a hospital.
A 54-year-old womans car was hit by a 73-year-old mans car, which then veered off the road, overturned, and ended in a field, causing injury and vehicle damage.
Unknown perpetrators entered a residential house in Ruden through an open door and stole several thousand euros in cash.
An 8-year-old boy was bitten in the face by a Saint Bernard dog while feeding cows in Schrattenbach, resulting in injuries and requiring airlifting to a hospital.

A 41-year-old man was injured while performing forestry work in Hollenstein an der Ybbs. A tree likely snapped back and buried him, resulting in indeterminate injuries. He was airlifted to a hospital after contacting emergency services.
A 39-year-old man fell into a five-meter-deep shaft in Obernberg and was rescued by firefighters after intensive efforts.
A man fired a signal flare causing a small hillside fire which was extinguished by the fire department.
A 60-year-old truck driver and a 39-year-old car driver collided at an intersection in Hörsching, resulting in severe injuries to the car driver.
A 68-year-old woman was injured in a skiing accident when a child collided with her skis and caused her to fall.
A truck damaged its fuel tank, spilling diesel into the sewer system in Graz. Emergency services contained and cleaned the contamination.
A car caught fire due to welding work inside a warehouse but was extinguished by the fire brigade; no injuries reported.
Two skiers collided on a slope leading to serious injuries for a man and unspecified injuries for a woman.
A 17-year-old German snowboarder sustained severe head injuries in a solo accident while descending at Großglockner Resort in Matrei, Austria.
Father and son were injured in a sledding accident after colliding with a barrier on a toboggan run in Kals am Großglockner.
Three vehicles collided on the A12 in Innsbruck due to abrupt traffic stop, causing significant damage but no injuries; road was closed for 50 minutes for cleanup.
A car caught fire on Rheinstraße 35 in Bregenz; firefighters extinguished the fire, and no injuries were reported.
Two skiers collided at a busy intersection in Zürs, resulting in one sustaining head injuries and requiring helicopter evacuation.
A female skier at Lech am Arlberg fell and injured her knee in a collision caused by an unidentified male skier who left the scene without stopping.
Police conducted vehicle checks in Burgenland municipalities to improve road safety, resulting in multiple violations mainly for speeding.
High-value bikes were stolen from a store in St. Johann in Tirol; one suspect was arrested after GPS tracking led to a transporter on the highway.
A candle left burning caused a fire in an apartment in Dornbirn, resulting in smoke intoxication for two residents who were hospitalized.
Man posed as a healthcare worker conducting fake COVID-19 tests, potentially searching for valuables in a womans apartment.
Groundbreaking ceremony for a new police training center in Koblach, Vorarlberg.
A man threatened and attacked police officers with scissors in Vienna, leading to his arrest after use of pepper spray.
A 57-year-old woman collided with an oncoming car while overtaking a tractor on the St. Pauler Landesstraße, causing injuries to both drivers and significant vehicle damage.
A garbage container caught fire near a kindergarten in Knittelfeld, causing damage to the building but no injuries.
A man in Vienna became aggressive during a traffic stop, kicked an officer, and was arrested under suspicion of drug influence.
Two heavily intoxicated drivers were stopped by police after acting suspiciously and driving erratically; one tested for 1.48 ‰ alcohol and both were fined and had their licenses revoked.
A parking control officer was attacked by a man during a vehicle inspection, resulting in minor injuries. The suspect was reported to authorities.
An elderly woman was deceived into handing over her savings to a man who pretended to be a police officer claiming her daughter was involved in a traffic accident.

A 79-year-old man died in a car accident on B 50 near Bernstein. His SUV went off the road, hitting trees and injuring both him and his 73-year-old companion. He passed away from internal injuries; she remains hospitalized but stable.
A 3-year-old boy was injured in an accident after running onto a road and colliding with a car in St. Stefan im Gailtal, Hermagor.
Unidentified perpetrators broke into an apartment in a multi-party house in Klagenfurt, searched the premises, and stole various jewelry items.
A 19-year-old Dutch man suffered serious injuries after falling in the Funpark during a ski descent at Nassfeld/Hermagor.
A 4-year-old boy suffered a severe leg injury after falling during a ski descent in the Gerlitzen area and was transported to the hospital.
A 23-year-old Hungarian man was fatally injured when his parked small truck began rolling downhill, trapping him under the vehicle.
A woman lost control of her vehicle inside the Kreuzensteintunnel and collided with a barrier, causing injuries to her and her son, while the dog in the car died.
A driver was caught speeding almost twice the limit on B1 in Traun; his license was confiscated and he faces charges.
A 66-year-old driver lost control of his car due to health issues, causing a crash; he was airlifted to a hospital with unspecified injuries.
Traffic violations including speeding and insufficient distance between vehicles were recorded during distance and speed monitoring on highways A10 and A1 in Salzburg.
A collision occurred between two cars on the Murtal Bundesstraße, causing injuries to a 12-year-old girl and two drivers.
A 19-year-old woman lost control of her car, veered off the road, slid down a slope, and crashed into a tree, sustaining severe injuries.
A paper waste container in Innsbrucks Pradl district caught fire, likely due to external interference. The fire brigade quickly extinguished the blaze, with no injuries reported.

A wrong-way driver on the A12 highway in Schönwies was stopped by police after driving approximately 1.1 km in the wrong direction. The driver claimed his navigation system instructed him to turn around.
A 20-year-old Dutch man was hit on the leg by an unmanned sled on a toboggan run in Hoch Imst, causing a bone fracture.
Four Serbian workers were found using forged identity cards in Stams during a police inspection on a construction site.
Construction kick-off for a new police training center in Vorarlberg with a ceremony led by officials.
A 79-year-old man died and his 73-year-old partner was injured in a car crash near Bernstein after their SUV veered off the road and collided with trees.
A physical altercation occurred between Dutch and English nationals after a verbal dispute at a local venue, resulting in one person seriously injured and three others lightly injured.
A 29-year-old man went missing in Loibltal, and a search operation involving rescue teams and a helicopter located him uninjured but very cold at 1100 meters altitude.
A car collided with a cyclist in Domgasse, Klagenfurt, causing injuries to the cyclist who was transported to the hospital.
A man was caught stealing cosmetic items from a store and assaulted the store detective before being detained by police.
Four suspects were arrested in Vienna for allegedly committing a distraction theft against an elderly woman and possessing marijuana.
A 72-year-old woman was critically injured while crossing the road, and an 8-year-old boy was injured in separate car accidents in Vienna.
A 26-year-old suspect fled through a window after being caught shoplifting, resisted arrest violently, and injured three police officers before being detained.
A forest fire caused by a lightning strike occurred in a remote area in Bad Eisenkappel, Austria; it was extinguished by fire brigades.
Unknown suspect broke into a cellar compartment in an apartment building and stole an expensive e-bike.
A drunk driver caused a head-on collision in Braunau, Austria, and continued driving despite losing a tire; minor injuries were reported.
A 36-year-old woman was hit by a vans side mirror while walking with her son in Munderfing, resulting in an unspecified shoulder injury.
Two cars collided at an intersection on the B127 in Bezirk Rohrbach, injuring both drivers who were transported to the hospital.
A smoldering fire occurred in a wood chip heating system at a farm in Pettenbach, involving approximately ten cubic meters of wood chips, extinguished by seven fire brigades.
A woman deceived a tobacconist in Salzburg-Itzling into making multiple Bitcoin transfers, resulting in a loss of over one thousand euros.
Unknown perpetrators forcibly broke into a companys basement depot in Tamsweg, stealing two e-scooters and LED lighting parts, causing damage worth several hundred euros.
A dryer caught fire in a single-family homes laundry room, injuring a 79-year-old woman during her attempt to extinguish the flames.
A 24-year-old driver fell asleep briefly and collided with barriers on the A9 highway, causing minor injuries to himself and serious injuries to his passenger.
A 21-year-old man is suspected of damaging three cars and breaking glass of a door following substance use and a fit of rage.
A 25-year-old German skier was severely injured in a spinal area after jumping onto an air cushion in Zillertal Arena ski resort and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 53-year-old Dutchman suffered severe spinal injuries after veering off a sledding track in Hainzenberg and landing on his rented sled.

Two skiers, a 71-year-old German and a 47-year-old Englishman, collided while skiing at Skijuwel Wildschönau, resulting in injuries of unspecified severity and requiring helicopter transport to the hospital.
Collision between two snowboarders in Schlick 2000 ski resort; one sustained injuries and the other fled without exchanging information.
Collision between a car and a moped resulting in injuries to the mopeds driver and passenger.
Rockfall occurred, damaging a railing; no injuries reported.

A 72-year-old woman was hit by a car at Sonnbergplatz/Obkirchergasse in Vienna while crossing the road and sustained life-threatening injuries; she passed away from severe head injuries the following evening.
An elderly man was approached by an unknown woman on the street in Vöcklamarkt, donated money, and later realized the cash was stolen after an embrace.
A 25-year-old man threatened the Vienna police via emergency call, claimed to have weapons, and was arrested without resistance after his apartment was opened; no weapons were found.
A 63-year-old woman was injured by a falling tree during logging activities near Groß Siegharts, assisted by two acquaintances.
A car collision occurred on Schloßseestraße, Oeynhausen, resulting in injuries and a positive alcohol test for one driver.
Unidentified individuals damaged a wooden ski rack and overturned a cargo tricycle in Kirchberg, causing fuel spillage; later, two Dutch suspects were identified.
Unknown perpetrator vandalized a staircase with graffiti at a school in Sölden.
An unknown male sexually harassed and touched an 8-year-old girl in Bad Vöslau before fleeing. Local search was unsuccessful.
Event organized by the Vienna Police to recruit interested individuals through discussions and short presentations.
A 49-year-old skier collided with a 9-year-old boy on a slope at Nassfeld ski area, resulting in injuries to the woman and no harm to the boy.
Driver fled after a car accident involving collision with a tree, leading to police search and environmental contamination cleanup.
A 48-year-old cyclist without a helmet fell in Salzburg-Gneis, suffering a head injury, and tested for over two promille alcohol levels before being hospitalized.
A fire caused by an electric heater damaged a room and a balcony in Schruns without injuries reported.
Multiple drug dealers and accomplices were arrested in Vienna during an operation, with drugs, cash, and a weapon seized.
Four individuals were arrested for pickpocketing tourists in Vienna, with stolen items returned to victims.
A 25-year-old intoxicated man assaulted his 33-year-old ex-partner at a parking lot in Villach, causing multiple injuries.
A collision between a skier and a young girl occurred in the Gerlitze ski area, causing injuries to the skier who was hospitalized. The girl left the scene.

A hydraulic oil spill occurred on a construction site parking lot in Spittal/Drau due to a burst hydraulic hose, with approximately 100 liters of oil contained by fire brigade using oil-binding agents.
A 48-year-old man was injured in a tunnel construction site in St. Paul im Lavanttal during crane stone-lifting operations.
A suspected CO leak in Hinterbrühl caused the evacuation of a residential building and left a child hospitalized due to suspected CO poisoning.
A 24-year-old driver in Bezirk St. Pölten Land lost control of his car on B 39, flipped over into a stream bed, and was hospitalized after sustaining injuries.
A collision occurred between two cars, causing serious injuries to a 63-year-old woman and minor injuries to a 71-year-old man.
A toilet paper roll was set on fire in a school bathroom in Baden, leading to smoke development and evacuation. Nine students received medical evaluation.
A 20-year-old man was attacked by a group of four men near Volkshaus after being followed by a larger group in Linz.
A drunk driver fled the scene after damaging a parked vehicle but was quickly apprehended by police.
A Hungarian skier slid off the piste at high speed, hit a tree, and was injured; he was assisted by a German skier and transported to the hospital via helicopter.
High-value optical devices were stolen during a hunting and fishing exhibition in Salzburg.
Two cars collided during a turning maneuver in Eugendorf, resulting in minor injuries for drivers and total damage to the vehicles.
A bus passenger in Salzburg fell and was injured due to sudden braking caused by traffic congestion.
Cannabis and drug paraphernalia were seized during police investigations at an apartment in Mittersill; the resident is being reported to authorities.
A forest machine caught fire at high altitude causing significant damage but no injuries; firefighters prevented it from spreading.
A 64-year-old man suffered a severe knee injury during forestry work when a winch cable snapped against his legs, requiring rescue after crawling to a nearby street for help.
Teenagers in Leibnitz were reported for assaulting, threatening, blackmailing, and robbing fellow students since September 2019.
55-year-old Austrian man died after slipping and falling several hundred meters during a solo snowshoe hike near Spitzköfele.
A security guard was stabbed in the hand by a 24-year-old Somali man in Innsbruck. The suspect was identified and arrested shortly after the incident, and the weapon was found in his backpack.
An 82-year-old man accidentally injured both hands while using a wood splitter in Mühlbachl, requiring hospital treatment.
A 10-year-old skier collided with an 11-year-old skier at a piste crossing in Zürs, resulting in injuries including a breastbone contusion and a fibula fracture.
A car accident occurred on the A14 in Vorarlberg when a vehicle hit barriers and skidded across lanes; both occupants were hospitalized.
An 84-year-old cyclist in Dornbirn collided with a car, sustaining severe injuries and was airlifted to a hospital; both vehicles were heavily damaged.
A taxi driver in Klagenfurt was found with drugs, counterfeit money, and illegal weapons during a traffic stop and subsequent house search.
A car accident occurred in Gaaden as a vehicle skidded off the road and collided with a barrier, but the driver was unharmed.
A man threatened a group with death, fired a gun towards them, and fled the scene. He was later arrested, and weapons were confiscated.
An unknown female caller tricked a store employee in Kundl into providing eight prepaid card codes, causing financial loss.
Intoxicated man attacked with a knife by two unknown assailants after a disturbance; victim hospitalized with non-life-threatening injuries.
A 56-year-old intoxicated man reported being threatened with a gun during an argument; police found a blank pistol during a search and charged a suspect.
An intoxicated man resisted police intervention and assaulted officers, injuring three during his arrest in Donaustadt, Vienna.
A collision between two cars at an intersection in Graz caused minor injuries to two passengers and significant damage to the vehicles.
Three arrests were made in Vienna involving an ex-Yugoslav group related to international drug trafficking with heroin and cash seized.
A truck with serious technical issues was stopped and removed from traffic in Leitersdorf, Austria after posing a danger on the road.
A vehicle without tires was stopped near the Salzburg-Süd exit; the driver was found with 1.34 promille alcohol and license was confiscated.
Two Slovak men were arrested after stealing car keys from a mans jacket and attempting to search the vehicle for valuables.
A man who caused financial losses of millions of euros through currency trades in 2015 turned himself in at a Vienna police station.
Two individuals were caught and arrested after breaking into 15 cellar units and preparing stolen items for transport.
Police escorted the family of a 3-year-old boy experiencing severe seizures to a hospital, ensuring timely medical care.
An unknown woman stole gemstones from a jewelry store in Klagenfurt by feigning interest in purchasing them.
A 63-year-old farmer was seriously injured by a tree during logging work in Friesach, Austria, and was airlifted to Klagenfurt hospital.
Fire broke out in a residential care facility basement in Geinberg, leading to injuries and evacuation challenges.
A child collided with a 78-year-old Czech skier on the Hochwaldabfahrt slope, causing the skier to suffer a hip fracture and requiring helicopter transportation for medical treatment.
Two men attempted to attend a German integration test in Ried im Innkreis using fake asylum cards; one fled upon being questioned, and the other was detained and confessed to being paid for the act.
Police discovered two indoor plantations for growing marijuana plants, confiscating cannabis, other drugs, and plants exceeding legal THC limits in Gmunden.
A car driven by a 45-year-old woman with her daughter flipped in a field after sliding off the road; both were slightly injured.
A skier in Obertauern crashed 90 meters down a cliff and suffered fatal injuries after missing the correct descent route.
A 35-year-old male was injured in a skiing accident during a descent on Gruber-Hirnkogel, resulting in helicopter transportation to the hospital.
A man robbed a store in Leoben using two stun guns to threaten an employee before fleeing on foot with cash.
Two moped riders resisted police intervention and fled. They endangered an officer but no injuries occurred.
Collision at Keplerbrücke, Graz injured two women due to driver running a red light.
A grass field caught fire due to a short circuit caused by a detached grounding wire; no injuries reported.
A 67-year-old British woman was injured in a collision with an unidentified skier on a slope in Hochgurgl ski area and was airlifted to a hospital.
A snowboarder avoided a collision with an unknown skier in Sölden, fell off the slope, and was seriously injured while the other person fled.
A 48-year-old Dutch man suffered a thigh fracture after falling 10 meters off a sledding track in Jerzens, requiring airlift to hospital.
A 10-year-old German skier and his 40-year-old father collided on a ski trail in Brunnalm, St. Veit im Defereggen, leading to a serious thigh injury for the child, who was airlifted to the hospital.
A fire broke out in Purgstall, likely caused by smoldering particles from tobacco or a candle.
Drivers caught speeding excessively in Schwechat and Perschling; one driving at 234 km/h and another speeding excessively multiple times, leading to fines and temporary license revocation.
A 14-year-old Austrian boy was seriously injured in a skiing accident in Fiss.
A 22-year-old German man fell 150 meters on icy ground while hiking alone near Berggasthof Hochhädrich, Vorarlberg, leading to his death.
Fire broke out in a basement of a residential care facility in Geinberg, leading to evacuation via balcony due to heavy smoke. Five residents were hospitalized with minor injuries.
A missing 10-year-old boy was found safe after a police search involving phone tracking.

A 17-year-old without a valid license led police on a high-speed chase through multiple towns, causing property damage and committing several traffic violations. He and his passengers were also fined for breaching COVID-19 regulations and trespassing on railway tracks.
Multiple traffic violations in the Hallein district, including speed infractions and possession of Crystal Meth.
A fire caused by a cigarette burned a 73-year-old man and his caregiver in Lermoos; the man later died from his injuries.
Four masked individuals forced their way into a mans apartment, searched it, threatened him with a knife, and stole cash and personal items; they were later apprehended.

A car was stolen from a gas station parking lot in Brunn am Gebirge with the keys left inside. Police apprehended the suspect, a 25-year-old with a history of offenses, after he drove the stolen vehicle under the influence of alcohol and caused an accident.
A car accident occurred in Hohenems where a driver lost control and hit a garden wall twice, sustaining injuries of unknown severity.
A man was found on the roof of a residential building handling what appeared to be a rifle, which was later confirmed to be an airsoft gun.
A 16-year-old German woman attacked station staff and police officers at Heiligenstadt Station, was found with illegal substances, and was arrested.
A 38-year-old man was arrested in Vienna for inappropriately touching a 12-year-old girl and reportedly sexually harassing a 38-year-old woman in 2019.

A dispute involving around 50 people occurred in Klosterneuburger Straße, resulting in minor physical altercations and police intervention. Four participants were reported, and four injured men received medical assistance on-site.
A collision occurred on Millstätter Bundesstraße as a truck attempting to avoid a crash swerved into oncoming traffic, causing injuries to the drivers and passengers.
Two men from Steiermark collided during a ski descent at Klippitzthörl, both injured and transported to hospitals for treatment.
A 6-year-old child fell approximately 60-70 meters during a descent after a climbing tour in Drachenwand, suffering fatal injuries.
Driver fled from police in Braunau; eventually located, tested positive for alcohol intoxication and lacked valid driving authorization.
A car spun out of control and collided with a barrier on the A8 highway in Austria, injuring two individuals.
Police stopped a driver on the highway in Salzburg who ignored their signals and was found to have a high alcohol level of nearly two per mille.
A driver was caught speeding at 123 km/h in a 50 km/h zone near Pass Lueg and reported by police.
An uninhabited wooden outbuilding in Gniebing burned down completely with no injuries; firefighters prevented the flames from spreading to nearby areas.
A collision occurred where a car hit a cyclist at an intersection, resulting in severe injuries for the cyclist.
Car collision during turning maneuver on B69; three people, including a nine-year-old child, sustained severe injuries and required hospital treatment.
A trailer carrying diesel fuel detached from a car, overturned, and spilled 150 liters of fuel, leading to environmental cleanup and legal consequences for the driver.
Overheated cooking oil caused a kitchen fire, resulting in smoke inhalation injuries to a bedridden 92-year-old woman.
A 16-year-old Syrian boy in driver training collided with another car after a priority violation in Baumkirchen, causing injuries to both drivers and damages to both vehicles.
A fight broke out between four men in a hotel in Sölden, leaving two injured, and one of them threatened another with shooting, leading to a provisional weapons ban.
A 32-year-old man caused a forest fire in Unterpinswang, Austria, while attempting to burn fecal matter; firefighters extinguished the blaze without injuries.
A Serbian man was threatened and a shot fired with a blank gun during a verbal altercation in a car in Wörgl. The suspect later surrendered the weapon and confessed.
A 10-year-old German skier collided with a 74-year-old Romanian skier on a slope, causing injuries to the child.
Fire in a single-family home in Vienna led to one fatality; caused by improper use of a stove.
Driver caught using mobile phone illegally during traffic check had no valid license; passenger detained for unpaid fines and illegal stay.
An 18-year-old man broke into a car dealership in Vienna, fled from police but was caught with the help of a service dog and arrested.
Driver was caught driving the wrong way on a highway under alcohol influence, stopped by police and had their license revoked.
A store employee in Illmitz was caught stealing food and delicacies from shelves since December 2020, detected through video footage and apprehended carrying stolen goods in his jacket.
A 93-year-old woman in Feldkirchen fell in her garden, broke her knee, and was rescued from her first-floor apartment via fire department ladder due to a narrow staircase.
A 67-year-old man fell on a cross-country skiing trail in Flattnitz and sustained serious injuries.
A fire broke out in a building next to the Perchtoldsdorf police station, spreading to the stations roof. The fire was controlled by firefighters without injuries but caused significant damage.
A 74-year-old car driver died in a collision with a truck in Biedermannsdorf; his passenger was injured and transported to the hospital.
Driver and passenger were found with cannabis and drug paraphernalia during a traffic stop; drivers license confiscated due to drug influence.
A lost woman was found in the forest with the help of police coordination and mobile tracking.
A driver was found under the influence of THC and cocaine during vehicle inspections, had their license plates and drivers license confiscated, and will be reported.
A 41-year-old intoxicated man resisted arrest in Salzburg, leading to minor injuries to an officer.
A 37-year-old man in Feldbach threatened and attacked his family, leading to his arrest and detention.
Woman in Graz behaved aggressively during a fare inspection, assaulted a staff member, fled the scene and was arrested by police.
Two skiers collided on a ski slope in Haus im Ennstal, both suffered minor injuries.
Three men attempted to steal copper pipes from a construction site in Lienz but fled after being confronted by workers.
A pedestrian and an unknown cyclist collided on a sidewalk in Innsbruck. The cyclist insulted the pedestrian and fled south without providing his information or assisting the injured pedestrian.
A 27-year-old driver collided with an 11-year-old girl at a pedestrian crossing, causing severe injuries to the child.
Two youth damaged a glass roof at Götzis train station by throwing an object, likely a glass bottle.
A 76-year-old woman fell and sustained severe injuries after her dog pulled her while walking on a grassy slope in Großdorf.
Police in Vienna conducted a traffic control operation identifying 22 drivers under the influence of drugs, issued alcohol-related violations, and confiscated illegal substances and a weapon.

Two cars collided in Steinbach, Gmünd district, resulting in injuries to five people. Alcohol tests were negative, but one driver lacked a valid license and is being reported for negligent bodily harm.
A fight broke out among teenagers at a carnival parade in Kalsdorf, leading to injuries and the arrest of a heavily intoxicated 22-year-old who resisted police.
A 52-year-old Dutch woman was seriously injured after falling on a black run and hitting avalanche barriers; she was airlifted to a clinic in Innsbruck.
A 17-year-old and his mother were threatened and assaulted by an unknown man during a traffic confrontation in Schruns, Vorarlberg.
Multi-vehicle collision with three injured persons on A14 in Wolfurt caused by sudden braking in traffic.
A mentally ill man committed a robbery at a gas station in Kirchschlag using a kitchen knife, and later stole goods from a supermarket. He was apprehended by police near his residence.

A 54-year-old man was arrested in Graz for aggressive behavior during a police operation, obstructing officers and threatening them. Cannabis was found on him, and he attributed his actions to alcohol and drug use.
A valuable cordless drill and accessories were stolen from a construction site in Brixen im Thale.
A 72-year-old man fell and was run over by a horse carriage in Bad Ischl, resulting in fatal injuries.
Two Romanian men were arrested for multiple organized thefts of high-value goods in several Austrian federal states between February 15 and 22, 2021.
A man was arrested in Vienna for possessing and intending to distribute large amounts of heroin, with drugs and cash seized from his backpack and hotel room.
Two individuals were arrested in Amstetten for robbing a 16-year-old using a blank pistol to steal headphones; the stolen goods were later recovered.
Armed robbery took place at a bank in Rainbach im Innkreis; suspect was later caught and admitted guilt due to financial struggles.
Two skiers collided at the Bergeralm ski area in Steinach am Brenner, causing serious leg injuries to one and shoulder injuries to the other.
A 14-year-old cyclist was injured near Vituskirche in Oberregau after swerving to avoid a car; the driver fled the scene.
Two suspects attempted to evade police during a drug trafficking investigation, with one throwing drugs out of a window and trying to escape. Both were arrested, and drugs and cash were seized.
A 1-year-old boy was successfully resuscitated by police officers after he stopped breathing, and was later taken to the hospital.

During a traffic stop in Vienna, police found approximately six kilograms of suspected cannabis in a vehicle. The driver was impaired and had his license temporarily confiscated, later being reported at large.
A man robbed a betting shop in Vienna using a gas pistol, stating personal debts and addiction as a motive; the suspect was later identified and arrested after DNA evidence led to his confession.
A car hit a pedestrians foot on the sidewalk in Villach and fled the scene.
A 23-year-old man hit an 18-year-old with a bottle in the face causing a bleeding wound; the suspect initially fled but was later identified and will be charged.

A car collision occurred at the LB2/L8032 intersection in Bezirk Horn, resulting in critical injuries to three individuals. Two vehicles collided head-on after one driver ignored a stop sign, leading to all occupants being extricated by firefighters and transported to hospitals via ambulance and helicopter.
Two Hungarian employees of a restaurant in Saalfelden engaged in a verbal and physical altercation after consuming alcohol, resulting in injuries of undetermined severity.
Two men threatened a 19-year-old to steal his cash; later, police intervened in assault incidents involving several individuals.

A 26-year-old man was found spreading Nazi ideology online and possessing drugs worth thousands of euros along with a weapon. An indoor marijuana growing setup was also seized during the investigation.
A 21-year-old man was critically injured after crashing his car into a group of trees near Bad Schwanberg, Bezirk Deutschlandsberg.
A woman was caught stealing a handbag and wallet from hospital lockers but returned the items when confronted, later arrested by police.
A subway train touched a wheelbarrow left on the track, causing deformation of the wheelbarrow and minor paint damage to the train; no injuries occurred.
Unknown perpetrators set fire to a plastic garbage bin near a house in Poggersdorf, which was extinguished without injuries.
Two Hungarian men were arrested during a traffic stop in Klagenfurt on suspicion of stealing old electronics worth thousands of euros from a business in Unterkärnten between February 17 and 23, 2020.
A 66-year-old driver caused a collision on Drautalstraße due to falling asleep at the wheel, resulting in injuries to herself, another driver, and a passenger.
A Czech man attempted a hike in Ebensee, Austria but ended up stuck in rugged terrain near Traunsee. He was rescued via helicopter after falling and losing gear.
A 33-year-old Czech hiker got stranded in pathless terrain during his descent from Spitzlstein in Ebensee and had to be located via light signals amid a storm.
A 14-year-old fell through plexiglass on a rooftop and was injured in Linz.
A man was pushed off a carnival float during a verbal altercation, hit his head, and later attempted to drive while intoxicated, damaging multiple parked cars.
Two individuals were injured in a car collision in Kaprun and taken to the hospital.
Fire department intervened in Graz due to burnt food on a stove; no injuries and apartment was empty at the time.
An intoxicated man attacked police officers during a confrontation in Deutschlandsberg; both officers were injured during the incident.
A 49-year-old driver under alcohol influence crashed her vehicle on the B 145 highway, causing injuries to her and her passenger, and significant property damage.
A fire broke out in a rooftop apartment in Prutz, Austria. The building was evacuated, and five people were hospitalized with suspected smoke inhalation.
A 39-year-old German man lost control of his sled on a closed toboggan run and fell into a forest, hitting a tree and sustaining serious injuries.
A chimney fire broke out in a hotel in Kramsach but was quickly extinguished by the fire department; no injuries occurred and minor property damage was reported.
Three individuals broke into a storage area of a supermarket in Dornbirn, stealing expired food worth €750 before being apprehended by police.
Three masked men verbally threatened employees of a jeweler in Vienna and fled with stolen goods of undetermined value.
A 28-year-old woman was killed by her partner after being initially assaulted; he later confessed and was arrested by police.
Innerkremser Landesstraße was closed due to the risk of a landslide.
A woman from Klagenfurt reported being a victim of a scam after transferring thousands of euros to an alleged man from Amsterdam she met online who claimed he needed money to move to Austria.
Building facade caught fire in St. Andrä, likely caused by a bucket of ash, resulting in thousands of euros in damage.
A taxi driver collided with a cyclist at a junction in Klagenfurt, injuring the cyclist who was taken to the hospital.
Two masked individuals armed with a handgun robbed a gas station in Wiener Neustadt, tied up staff, stole coins, and fled on bicycles.

A 9-year-old girl was approached by an older man in a red car, asking her to get into the vehicle. She informed her mother, and the man left the scene. Police are investigating and increasing patrols.
A 58-year-old woman suffered severe injuries after skiing off the marked piste and colliding with a tree at Hochkar.
A drunk driver collided with another car in a curve, injuring two passengers.
A 20-year-old driver without a license fled a traffic control in Bezirk Linz-Land, displayed aggressive behavior toward police, and was later detained after being suspected of drug impairment.
Two men injured in forestry accidents in Maria Neustift and Tragwein, one trapped by a falling tree and another struck by a tractor.
A driver in Wels was stopped without a valid license and showed signs of drug impairment, refusing a clinical examination.
Truck got stuck in Salzburg, damaging overhead power lines and causing traffic jams.
Unknown perpetrators posing as Microsoft employees made fraudulent calls attempting to gain remote access to victims computers by tricking them into installing software and sharing personal data.
A 50-year-old man was injured in a workplace accident when a truck-mounted basket tipped over and hit his left leg during roof work.
A light aircraft made an emergency landing in a field after engine failure; the pilot was uninjured.
A 70-year-old cyclist was critically injured after being struck by a truck while crossing Kalsdorfer Straße; the cyclist was airlifted to LKH Graz.
A 56-year-old man fell 50 meters during forest work in the Kesselfallklamm, suffering serious injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.
A fire broke out in the upper floor of a house in Graz caused by a cigarette; one person suffered a mild inhalation injury.

A multi-car collision occurred on the A12 in Innsbruck involving a 24-year-old driver, a pregnant 34-year-old driver, and a 17-year-old driver. One woman was injured, others were in shock, and severe vehicle damage was reported.

A wet snow avalanche occurred in Haslachgraben near Kals am Großglockner, blocking the Kalser Landesstraße L 26. No injuries were reported, and the road was temporarily cleared and reopened before being closed again due to avalanche risk.
A veterinarian in Ebbs was seriously injured after being kicked by a horse while taking a sample, resulting in head injuries and hospitalization.
A farmer in Lingenau was injured when his tractor overturned while spreading manure, requiring emergency rescue and airlift to a hospital.
Burglars broke into multiple stores in St. Veit/Glan, stealing sports equipment, clothing, mobile phones, and cash from a safe.
Two suspects assaulted and robbed a teenager in Wals Himmelreich, taking a small amount of money.
An 11-year-old girl died from electrocution while taking a bath in Dornbirn. A charging cable and mobile phone were involved.
A man attempted to break into a car and was later apprehended near the scene; tools and a small amount of drugs were found on him.
Three unknown male suspects committed a robbery at a jewelry store in Viennas Inner City and fled towards Kupferschmiedgasse after verbally threatening the staff.
A man found a suspected World War II tank grenade at a cemetery in Vienna, prompting police to secure the area and involve the bomb disposal unit.
A 22-year-old woman died in a car accident after her vehicle veered off the road and struck a tree in Haslau an der Donau.
A 57-year-old Slovak man stole a wallet from an elderly woman in a supermarket in Graz and resisted arrest when caught by a store detective. He was later detained by police.
A situation involving alleged communication with a child in Stattersdorf was investigated and resolved by the police, determining no threat was present.
Four Lithuanian nationals were arrested for multiple burglaries at bike shops in various Austrian states following the alert of an observant witness.
An intoxicated driver collided with a police car in Uttendorf, fled the scene, later admitted to causing the accident; two officers were slightly injured.
775.5 grams of cocaine were seized in an apartment; a suspected 21-year-old dealer was arrested after being observed selling drugs in Vienna-Wieden.
A woman attempted to acquire medication with a forged prescription, became aggressive, and attacked a police officer when confronted.
A 55-year-old man got stranded on a mountain near Mondsee, Austria, and was rescued by emergency services after getting stuck in difficult terrain after dark.
A motorcyclist and a small truck collided during an overtaking attempt in Hengsberg, leading to serious injuries for the motorcyclist who was airlifted to a hospital.
Two Czech suspects attempted to use counterfeit 200 Euro notes and stole goods in multiple shops in Weiz.
Two workers were buried waist-deep in a trench in St. Pölten and rescued by firefighters. They sustained injuries of an undetermined grade.
Accident between two alcohol-impaired drivers resulted in six injuries; all were taken to hospital and licenses revoked after positive alcohol tests.
Fire broke out in a garage beneath residential apartments; 15 people were evacuated safely by firefighters and the fire was quickly controlled.
Attempted burglary at a bank in Saalfelden through a basement window; no theft occurred as the suspects fled before police arrived.
A 52-year-old woman was deceived by unknown individuals into making fake investment deposits.
A 27-year-old woman resisted police, assaulted an officer, and attempted to flee; she was arrested and charged with multiple offenses.
A 38-year-old Iraqi man wanted for various financial crimes was arrested by police in Vienna-Alsergrund and transferred to a detention facility.
Three individuals arrested during traffic stops in Vienna for immigration violations and outstanding fines.
Three men were arrested in Klosterneuburg after being caught with stolen goods from a residential burglary.
A man stole coins from a church donation box in Loosdorf, attempted to flee, and injured an officer during his arrest.
Two individuals were severely injured in a traffic accident at the intersection of L1087 and B141, involving two vehicles. Both were hospitalized, and the road was closed for 1.5 hours.
A 78-year-old pedestrian was hit and injured by a car, and the driver fled the scene. Police are seeking witnesses.
A 69-year-old man fell several meters while working in a building and was seriously injured.
A dispute in Oetz led a 59-year-old man to attack a 65-year-old with a stick and throw pebbles, causing minor injury.
A chimney fire occurred in a single-family house in Außervillgraten, firefighters managed it without injuries.
A 61-year-old Austrian man died in Going am Wilden Kaiser after falling from a platform while operating a shredder.
A pedestrian was struck by a car at Mitterweg, Innsbruck, suffering injuries and transported to the clinic.
A woman attacked her son with a power strip and meat cleaver, slightly injuring him; she had a high alcohol level.
Afghan-origin group sold large quantities of cannabis and ecstasy mainly to teenagers in Klagenfurt, with proceeds partially sent to Afghanistan.
A 14-year-old girl was injured when she suddenly crossed a street and was hit by a car in Klagenfurt.
A drunk driver crashed into a streetlight and his car was left blocking both lanes in Linz.
A woman threatened a man with a knife at Linz Hauptbahnhof, demanding 50 euros. After a brief altercation, the victim was slightly injured. The suspect was arrested and the weapon confiscated.
A 65-year-old man harassed and inappropriately touched a 21-year-old woman in a shop in Schärding. He was apprehended and arrested after attempting to flee.
A man slipped on an icy ski slope during an inspection, slid 400 meters downhill, and was injured. He was airlifted to a hospital.
Two skiers collided while descending a slope in Obertauern, resulting in injuries and requiring rescue services.
Four people sustained minor injuries in a multi-vehicle collision on the Grazer Bundesstraße B 67 in Gratkorn.
A fire broke out on the terrace of a residential house and spread to the house; no injuries were reported, and the fire was extinguished by the fire department.
A man sustained severe head injuries when a falling tree branch struck him during forestry work in a steep forest area in Sankt Michael in Obersteiermark.
Avalanche blocked the Felbertauernstraße requiring road clearance and temporary traffic disruptions.
A forest fire broke out in Telfs near the Sauweide area, affecting 350 m² and was extinguished successfully without injuries.
A 73-year-old man caught a burglar attempting to enter his apartment, leading to the arrest of three suspects who possessed burglary tools matching the scene.
A 25-year-old British hotel employee severely injured a 22-year-old colleague in a physical altercation.
Police stopped a vehicle in Leutschach and found three illegal immigrants. The driver and passenger were suspected of human smuggling.
A 55-year-old dog owner and a 51-year-old property owner engaged in a physical altercation on the property owners field, resulting in injuries to both parties of undetermined severity.
A 47-year-old Serbian suspect was arrested during a traffic stop in Vienna, found with burglary tools and linked to three apartment burglaries from 2017 to 2019.
45-year-old man in Braunau district fell from first floor of a construction site and was airlifted to hospital with injuries.
A male body, estimated to be between 50 and 60 years old, was found in Oedtsee, Traun; identity and cause of death are under investigation.

Two luxury vehicles were stolen during a break-in at a car dealership in Vienna. One vehicle was recovered on the same day, and the second was found during a traffic stop, leading to the arrest of an 18-year-old suspect. The suspect confessed to planning to sell the vehicles to fund a luxurious lifestyle.

Two men were arrested for human smuggling in Maria Enzersdorf after a high-speed chase. Seven Syrian nationals, smuggled into Austria, were found in their van. Another accomplice was later arrested in St. Pölten.

A 16-year-old damaged property including an information monitor, a train display, and a snack machines glass panel at the Brunn-Maria Enzersdorf train station using a stone. He later confessed to the offense.
A German driver lost control of his car on B171 in Reith im Alpbachtal, veered off the road, and sustained injuries; a positive alcohol test was reported.
Unknown perpetrator set a stroller on fire in the basement of an apartment building, causing soot damage.
A car accident occurred involving two vehicles, resulting in three injuries with all victims taken to local hospitals for treatment.
A physical altercation occurred outside a bar in Dorfgastein involving two locals and a Hungarian, resulting in injuries and charges of bodily harm.
Landslide blocked B163 Wagrainer Straße completely; no injuries reported.
A kitchen fire in Wolfsberg caused by burning cooking oil led to injuries for the resident who attempted to remove the flaming pan.
A 15-year-old was hit by a car while crossing the road and was injured in Pressbaum, Lower Austria.
A car collided with a train at a railway crossing, injuring the driver and two passengers, while the trains crew and passengers remained unharmed.
A 25-year-old man died after his car veered off the road and crashed over a guardrail, being trapped inside the vehicle until emergency responders arrived.
Four individuals arrested for trafficking Substitol in Viennas 6th district.
Two vehicles collided on Wagramer Straße in Vienna, causing one car to overturn, with minor injuries reported and the driver of one vehicle testing positive for alcohol.
A 2-year-old girl was critically injured after falling from a second-floor window in Vienna; the mother was charged for neglect.
A 13-year-old accidentally caused an explosion with a pyrotechnic device, injuring himself and requiring airlift to a hospital.
A 16-year-old Belgian skier lost control and collided with a stationary group, resulting in severe injuries to himself and minor injuries to another.

A 70-year-old driver lost control of his car on L 19 in Prottes, crashed into a concrete pipe, and was seriously injured. He was freed from the overturned car by the fire department and taken to a hospital.
Two cars collided on LB 55 in Krumbach, resulting in two severe injuries and several minor injuries; road was closed for hours.
A 19-year-old woman was found dead in an apartment in Heidenreichstein, no external injuries observed, investigation ongoing.
Pedestrian struck by a delivery truck in Perchtoldsdorf resulting in a serious injury.

A verbal dispute between a 78-year-old man and his 42-year-old son turned violent, resulting in the father being killed by the son in Linz-Land. The suspect was arrested at the scene and largely confessed.
A pedestrian was hit by a van in Ried im Innkreis and sustained injuries of undetermined severity.
A 21-year-old man was thrown against a shop window by an 18-year-old during a carnival event, causing him injuries.
Unknown perpetrators placed a trash can and snow pole on railway tracks, causing a freight train to collide and necessitate emergency braking.
A 35-year-old man fell about five meters during cleaning work at a tank facility, sustaining serious head injuries.

A Dutch driver accidentally drove onto train tracks in Fieberbrunn, leading to a collision with a train. No injuries occurred, but the car was totaled and the train was damaged. The driver tested positive for alcohol.
Driver in Musau used a second drivers card to fake compliance with driving and resting times.
A 18-year-old man crashed his car while driving downhill, causing it to overturn and land on a house wall; he was injured and taken to a hospital.
A 48-year-old woman fell and slid 100-150 meters during a ski tour on Schöberspitze in Innerschmirn; she was injured and rescued by helicopter despite initial weather difficulties.
A man driving at high speeds to evade a traffic stop caused a property damage traffic accident in Egg, narrowly avoiding a head-on collision.
An elderly driver struck a pedestrian at a crosswalk in Hörbranz, causing head injuries to the pedestrian.
