A skier collided with a 33-year-old female skier from behind on a blue slope in Lech, causing her injuries. The male skier fled the scene without providing any details or assistance.
A 44-year-old Libyan man was arrested at Hauptbahnhof for involvement in a series of thefts and possession of a fake Italian ID.
A collision occurred between a motorcycle and a car in Vienna, causing severe injuries to the motorcyclist and significant vehicle damage.
Cannabis plants and a micro-plantation were discovered and confiscated in a mans apartment in St. Veit an der Glan following an anonymous tip about a strong cannabis smell.
A hedge in Spittal/Drau caught fire due to a misdirected rocket fired by four boys, causing damage.
A large rock, weighing several hundred kilograms, fell onto the Grafensteiner Straße from the Sattnitzzug Massif in Grafenstein; no injuries occurred, and the rock was removed with assistance.
Two teenage motorbike riders collided on Klagenfurter Straße in Wolfsberg, resulting in injuries and hospitalization.

A 77-year-old man accidentally caused a fire in his homes basement in Radenthein while heating an alcohol distillation kettle. The fire was extinguished without involving the fire department, resulting in property damage.
A 15-year-old boy was hit by a car while crossing the B44 in Pressbaum, resulting in injuries and hospitalization.
Police and firefighters rescued a 72-year-old woman from a fire in her apartment; she was hospitalized with injuries and the apartment and others were damaged.
Plastic container and nearby building facade were set on fire, causing damage in Linz; no injuries reported.
Two individuals under the influence of drugs were stopped by police in Linz-Land district, one of them fled on a bicycle, while the other was found with cannabis during a vehicle inspection.
A tractor collided with a parked car, tearing the cars roof and causing minor injuries to the cars occupants.
Motorcycle collided head-on with a car on Landshaager Straße in Bezirk Rohrbach, resulting in severe injuries to the motorcyclist and minor injuries to the car driver.
A 60-year-old motorcyclist slipped in a curve, got his leg trapped under the motorcycle, and was injured near St. Ulrich bei Steyr.
A driver in Maishofen was stopped for unsafe driving, admitted to smoking cannabis, and was found with a small quantity of cannabis during a police search.
A garbage bin was set on fire in Dr.-Hans-Lechner-Park in Salzburg; the fire was extinguished by the fire brigade.
A car collided with a stationary police vehicle on B159 in Anif-Niederalm, causing minor injuries to the police officers and vehicle damage.
Two men attempted to cross the border with forged COVID-19 tests and were reported for document forgery.

A 21-year-old forestry worker was seriously injured after being struck by a felled tree and trapped in steep, snowy terrain near Ramingstein. He was rescued and airlifted to the hospital with severe injuries.
A 41-year-old worker sustained facial injuries from an angle grinder accident while cutting a metal pipe on a construction site.
Several trash containers caught fire in Graz causing damage to nearby vehicles and a building facade.
A man got lost during a hike on the Prof. Sinwel via ferrata near Schwoich and was rescued by mountain rescue teams after a nighttime search.
A large rooftop avalanche in Matrei iO buried a municipal street under snow; no people were injured, but significant property damage occurred.
A scammer impersonated a Microsoft service technician, gained remote access to a companys computer in Kirchberg in Tirol, and conducted unauthorized money withdrawals.
A 52-year-old skier was injured during a ski tour descent and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 48-year-old member of a tour group fell 30 meters over rocky terrain and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 70-year-old man struck a 7-year-old boy on a pedestrian crossing in Innsbruck, causing minor injuries.
A 27-year-old mountaineer fell into a crevasse and died during a ski tour descent on Großvenediger.
A 19-year-old woman was found dead in an apartment in Heidenreichstein; no signs of external injuries or foul play were initially detected, and further investigations are ongoing.
12-year-old boy fell down a slope in Schröcken while skiing, sustaining injuries and was airlifted to the hospital.
A 23-year-old woman with a baby stroller was hit by a reversing SUV at a pedestrian crossing in Hall in Tirol, and the driver fled the scene.
A man injured another with a headbutt, damaged a car with a knife, issued verbal threats, and fled the scene; authorities arrested him the next day and seized weapons and drugs.
A 75-year-old man in Bezirk Wels Land fell while loading manure onto a trailer, suffered a head injury, and later died in the hospital.

A Slovenian truck transporting undeclared toxic hazardous materials was stopped in Vorarlberg, revealing unsecured dangerous goods and technical vehicle deficiencies, leading to fines and the cargo transfer.
A metal donation box was found in a forest area in Oberpinswang with no signs of forced entry and its origin remains unknown.
Invitation to a press conference about 100 years of police command in Vorarlberg.
A woodpile and two straw stacks caught fire near railway tracks in Asten, causing train disruptions and no injuries.
Police discovered cannabis, drugs, and cultivation equipment in an apartment in Oberndorf; two men will be charged.
A carnival float in Kundl caught fire, completely destroying the float and its inventory and causing minor damage to a tractor and a wooden facade. No injuries were reported.
A fire broke out on a truck carrying a quad in Schruns, spreading to the truck before being extinguished by the fire department.
A man attempted to steal from an unlocked car in Krumpendorf but was caught and reported to the police.
Three individuals attempted to shoplift clothing worth nearly 600 EUR and sweets from a store but were caught and arrested.
A 45-year-old man was arrested at Praterstern, Vienna, due to an active arrest warrant related to property and drug offenses.
A Polish truck with severe technical defects and an unlicensed driver was stopped on the A 2 motorway in Wiener Neudorf, resulting in license plate removal and a fine.
A 59-year-old man died during forestry work after being struck on the head by part of a tree.
A 76-year-old woman was tricked into believing she was helping a relative and handed over 27,000 euros in cash and two gold coins to a scammer.
An 83-year-old pedestrian was hit by a car while crossing a crosswalk in Traun, sustaining injuries of unspecified severity.

A 35-year-old driver lost control of his car on the L528 road in Wallern an der Trattnach, hitting a fence, colliding with another car, and ultimately crashing into a garage. The driver was slightly injured, and a 59-year-old passenger was seriously injured.
A 31-year-old driver caused a traffic accident in Salzburg on Berchtesgadener Straße and fled the scene; he was later stopped by German police and found to be intoxicated.
An intoxicated 18-year-old was found sleeping in a car he allegedly vandalized in Feldbach.
A man in Innsbruck was caught with 23 stolen shoes in his car trunk, taken during his job as a delivery driver.
A 23-year-old German man was hit by a freight train in Kufstein/Zell; he had a positive alcohol test and no memory of how he got there.
A 50-year-old German snowboarder collided with a 16-year-old French snowboarder in Kühtai, resulting in serious injury to the womans shoulder.
A car accident occurred in Gries i. Sellrain involving two vehicles, causing minor injuries to two individuals.
A man operating a wheel excavator in Silz veered off a forest path and fell 30 meters into the woods, later experiencing health issues and being transported to the hospital.
A 77-year-old skier collided with a barrier on a ski slope in Gargellen, resulting in severe injuries and was airlifted to the hospital.
A 14-year-old Dutch snowboarder collided with a 19-year-old German skier in Schröcken, resulting in the snowboarder sustaining back injuries and being airlifted to a hospital.
Police in Simmering arrested a man wanted by Interpol for making threats, with potential extradition to North Macedonia and a six-month prison sentence.
A Polish man (36) died after heavy alcohol consumption in an apartment in Vienna-Favoriten. Two others, also intoxicated, were involved, with one arrested for suspected failure to provide assistance.
Collision between a cargo bike and a car resulted in light injuries to the 71-year-old car driver.
A registered gathering in Eisenstadt involved a discussion on lockdown and COVID-19 measures, resulting in three administrative police reports.
Police identified and searched two suspects in Bleiburg and Eberndorf for possessing and selling drugs online, recovering narcotics, utensils, medications, and stolen goods.
A tractor rolled down a slope, overturned, and caused significant property damage, but no injuries were reported.
A car and a truck collided during an overtaking maneuver, causing total damage to both vehicles and minor injuries to one driver.
A 77-year-old man collided with a train while driving his car, sustained injuries, and train operations were interrupted for two hours.
A 20-year-old driver lost control of his car, collided with a tree, and crashed into a side arm of the Traun River; all five occupants were injured but managed to escape.
Man in Linz was punched in the face after knocking on a window, resulting in head and face injuries; perpetrator fled.
Motorcyclist collided with a car at high speed in Gmunden district; both drivers were injured, with the motorcyclist severely hurt.
A 47-year-old man was severely injured when a decayed ash tree unexpectedly fell and struck him during forestry work in Kirchdorf district.
A 48-year-old skier from Graz was severely injured after colliding with a steel cable on a ski slope at Hohen Zinken in the Lachtal ski area.
A car collided with a train at an unguarded railroad crossing; the driver was slightly injured.
A garage building caught fire after the owner burned a wasp nest, leading to the complete destruction of the structure.
Two vehicles collided on Hochkönigstraße, causing one car to overturn; both drivers were injured and hospitalized.
A worker fell from an 8-meter-high wooden platform during construction work in Kufstein and suffered serious injuries.
A man disposed of an oil-water mixture in a stream and field, causing environmental pollution. The fire department contained the spill and the man will be charged.
Unknown individual disposed of hot ash containing nails, causing a fire in a forest in Breitenbach.
A 49-year-old skier in Skiwelt Wilder Kaiser, Ellmau, fell uncontrollably on the slope, hit his head on a wooden post, and suffered severe head injuries. He was airlifted to a clinic in Innsbruck.

A 56-year-old man drove over a level crossing despite a red light, causing his car to be struck by a locomotive. He sustained minor injuries and was hospitalized. The car was totaled and the locomotive was damaged.
A 27-year-old Austrian man was arrested in Vienna for selling cannabis and possessing a prohibited weapon.
A house in Furth an der Triesting caught fire leading to severe injuries for a resident trying to retrieve belongings.
A 14-year-old tried to steal a backpack and attacked multiple people, including police, in Kufstein.
A 16-year-old admitted to setting fire to a wooden barn in Volders, causing minor damage; no injuries were reported.
A car collision occurred on Kobernaußer Landesstraße, resulting in two injuries.
A worker in Kufstein fell from an 8-meter high wooden platform, sustaining severe injuries and later passing away in the hospital.
Driver was caught speeding at 211 km/h on the A2 highway in the Baden district.

An 18-year-old driver in Graz, showing signs of drug impairment, refused a drug test and had his drivers license temporarily confiscated after erratic driving and past offenses, including a hit-and-run incident.
Police conducted a traffic control in Bregenz, focusing on older vehicles, identifying multiple violations, including technical defects and drug-impaired drivers.

A 22-year-old Czech man was arrested in Maria Enzersdorf for smuggling 10 Syrian nationals into Austria, who had illegally entered from Hungary. The car experienced a tire puncture, nearly causing a collision, which led to their capture and the smugglers temporary escape.
An intoxicated man caused damages in an apartment and was arrested by police in Salzburg-Schallmoos.
Truck carrying toilet paper slid off snowy road on highway, blocking lanes; highway closed temporarily for recovery operation.
A 19-year-old woman lost control of her car, which overturned, injuring her while the passenger remained uninjured.

During a drug operation at Jägerstraße subway station, police intercepted a man selling drugs. The man fled and resisted arrest, injuring an officer. Drugs and cash were seized, and the man was detained.
A 26-year-old Serbian man was arrested in Vienna after being found in possession of cocaine and heroin, along with fake Croatian passports and significant cash.
A 34-year-old woman was seriously injured after being run over on Niederdorfer Straße, with subsequent medical care and investigations ongoing regarding why she was on the road.
A semi-trailer detached from a truck on the A 10 highway, leading to a fatal collision with a car; the car driver was killed.
A 24-year-old man struck a 17-year-old girl who crossed the road unexpectedly in Klagenfurt.
A head-on collision on B119a in St. Georgen/Walde injured two drivers, one of whom had to be rescued from the vehicle by the fire department.
An 87-year-old driver collided with a truck on a road in Pregarten, causing significant vehicle damage and requiring the driver to be extricated and hospitalized.
A man suffered severe hand injuries during forestry work in Ternberg when a tree got entangled, and he was pulled several meters by a winch.
A fire broke out in the kitchen of a house in Elixhausen, causing no injuries. The cause remains unknown.
Lorry driver lost concrete on road due to technical defect, causing traffic disruptions.
Two ski tourers lost orientation due to heavy snowfall and were rescued by mountain rescue teams and alpine police near Ischgl.
Fire occurred in an apartment in Inzing due to a cable fire; no injuries but significant property damage.
An unknown offender broke into a company building in Innsbruck-Rossau, searched offices, and stole cash and a cash box.
A 38-year-old man attempted to break into a perfume shop using a motorcycle mirror and was caught and arrested on-site.
Intoxicated man jumped on a moving car, attempted to damage its windshield with a knife, and damaged two additional vehicles; he was arrested without resistance.
A 17-year-old cyclist fell on a bike path in Klagenfurt, suffered serious injuries, and tested positive for alcohol.
Protests took place in St. Pölten and Hainfeld concerning COVID measures and freedom of speech; police made several detentions and issued fines.
A 4-ton boulder posed a threat to a building and road in Gmunden, prompting the construction of a protective wall using tree logs and a crane.
Two drivers were stopped in Hörsching for suspected drug influence while driving; both tested positive for THC and were deemed unfit to drive by a medical doctor.
A drunk driver with 2.42 promille crashed through a wildlife fence, damaged his car, spilled 40 liters of fuel, and caused environmental contamination.
A head-on collision occurred in Freindorf caused by an intoxicated driver; two individuals were injured and taken to the hospital.
A 250 kg WWII-era bomb was found and safely detonated in Rechberg without injuries or damages.
Police broke up a party in a house cellar in Piesendorf involving 15 youths from different households violating COVID-19 measures.
Nighttime vehicle controls in Salzburg focused on Tuningszene; six speed violations reported with a maximum recorded speed of 83 km/h.
Unknown individuals vandalized large flower pots in Absam and Thaur, attempted arson, but failed.
A man fired a gas-airsoft pistol from a car in Münster, leading to the weapon being confiscated and a temporary weapons ban.
A 6-year-old girl skiing in Kartitsch left the piste, lost control, and suffered a severe leg injury requiring hospital transport.
A fire in a care home in Absam caused by a cigarette was extinguished by staff before the arrival of firefighters.
A vehicle caught fire in a workshop in Innsbruck due to a technical defect, causing significant damage.
Six Belgian teenagers caused damage to a hotel facade in Maria Alm by throwing eggs, resulting in significant financial damage.
A tree fell on a moving car due to a storm, causing total damage to the vehicle; no injuries occurred.
An Italian man was arrested for selling low-quality jackets and handbags at inflated prices while pretending to be a fashion designer.
A dispute between German and Croatian skiers at a parking lot in Hermagor escalated into a physical attack by four Croatians, injuring two Germans.
Police in Vienna conducted inspections for COVID regulation violations, encountered resistance from a 15-year-old who injured three officers, and responded to a party with over 100 attendees.
Two drivers in Eisenstadt were stopped for driving under the influence of drugs and their provisional licenses were revoked.
A woman falsely claimed her car was stolen after a crash, later admitting her husband drove the vehicle.
A large rock threatening to slide down a hill in Gmunden was stabilized by constructing a protective barrier using logs, with coordinated efforts from local authorities and a private company.
A 21-year-old driver under the influence of THC was stopped by police in Hörsching, and his 23-year-old friend who came to pick him up was also found to be under the influence of THC.
A 29-year-old Croatian man was arrested in Vienna for suspected drug trafficking, with heroin, cocaine, cannabis, phones, and cash seized.
Four drivers were caught excessively speeding on the A2 motorway; the highest speed recorded was 253 km/h in a 130 km/h zone. Violators were reported to the local authorities.
A fire caused in a kitchen destroyed a house, making it uninhabitable, with damages amounting to approximately 150,000 euros.
An unknown individual defaced a church, chapel, and shrine in Pfarrkirchen using orange and pink chalk, with football-related messages.
A specialized mountain bike track was stolen by unknown individuals from the marketplace between 21:30-23:59.
Authorities conducted health-related exit controls in Mayrhofen, checking vehicles and individuals, with 22 individuals denied exit due to missing negative PCR tests.
Two 11-year-olds and one 21-year-old caused damage to flower pots and a school facade in Absam and Thaur, with no connection between the incidents.
Four suspects attacked and robbed a group of men in Graz-Liebenau, with violence including physical assault and forcing victims into the Mur river.
26-year-old Serbian man arrested in Vienna for drug trafficking; authorities seized cocaine, heroin, cash, and fake IDs.

An intoxicated driver lost control of his vehicle during a storm in Pichl bei Wels, causing it to overturn multiple times in a field. He initially resisted medical attention but was eventually transported to a hospital with a confirmed 1.06‰ BAC.
A car collision occurred in Koppl involving two vehicles, one driver was injured and taken to the hospital.
A man punched a 26-year-old in the face during an argument between fan groups in Salzburg, causing an eye injury.
An intoxicated skier got lost near Turracher Höhe and was found lightly injured by firefighters after a search operation.
A car slid off the road due to winter conditions and fell 80 meters into a steep forest; the driver was unharmed.
A 25-year-old woman lost control of her car on a slippery road and crashed into a stream in Alpbach. She was rescued by the fire department and taken to a hospital with unspecified injuries.
Traffic checks in Salzburg-Liefering and Bergheim revealed two impaired drivers under the influence of drugs, with one also showing alcohol traces and cocaine residue.
Two teenage suspects arrested following an assault and robbery of a youth in Vienna. Two other suspects are still at large.
A parking surveillance officer was attacked by a man who later became aggressive towards police; arrest required pepper spray and special forces intervention.
18-year-old offered cannabis to undercover police officers and was temporarily detained.
A 21-year-old woman in Klagenfurt fell while riding a moped and was injured without external influence.
Six trees fell due to strong wind in Grafenstein, damaging a house and property without causing injuries.
An elderly woman was robbed by a cyclist who stole her handbag and fled in Klagenfurt.
A collision occurred involving two vehicles on LB22 in Scheibbs District, leaving one man trapped and airlifted to a hospital and one woman taken to a local hospital after first aid.
72-year-old driver lost control of his car, which veered off the road, overturned, and landed in a ditch; he was injured and taken to a hospital.
A 20-year-old man lost control of his car in Naarn, crashed into a tree, and died at the scene despite resuscitation attempts.
A head-on collision on L515 in Rainbach im Innkreis resulted in the death of a 26-year-old female driver, while the truck driver and his passenger remained uninjured.
An unknown person threw a stone at a car window, causing injuries to two young women inside.
Minor disturbances and assaults occurred in Salzburg after a football match; fans assembly and march were peaceful.
A 26-year-old German man was injured in a car collision with a 54-year-old due to slippery conditions on a road in Pinzgau.
A drunk 45-year-old man fired multiple shots with a blank gun in Graz, prompting police intervention and his arrest.
A driver stole fuel from a gas station and was pursued by police before being stopped, showing significant alcohol intoxication.
A 72-year-old man surprised two burglars in his house, resulting in a scuffle where he was lightly injured. The burglars fled with a phone and some cash.
An unknown cyclist collided with an 11-year-old pedestrian, injuring her, and fled the scene.
A man was severely injured during forestry work when he slipped with a chainsaw and cut his left calf.
A 17-year-old skier fell 20 meters into a creek bed off-piste in Hahnenkamm, triggering a snow slide. He was partially buried, rescued by his companion, and airlifted to a hospital with hypothermia.
A 24-year-old Austrian male was injured by a falling tree during forestry work and was flown to the hospital with severe leg injuries.
An 85-year-old driver accidentally accelerated onto a sidewalk and hit a house wall in Innsbruck; no injuries reported, drivers license temporarily revoked.
Employees noticed a burning smell in Lech/Zug; firefighters identified and extinguished a smoldering electrical fire in a kitchen wall.
A semi-truck with numerous severe technical defects was pulled over and taken out of service at the border crossing in Vorarlberg.
Information about the issuance of eCards with photos for non-Austrian citizens in Feldkirch, assistance by local authorities, and requirement to visit the registration office with specific documents.
Three suspects caught after breaking into a supermarket in Vienna and later another suspect was detained after trying to trespass on a companys premises.
A 17-year-old skier from New Zealand got stranded in an avalanche-prone area at the Stubai Glacier and was rescued unharmed by professionals.
A skiing collision in the Kötschach-Vorhegg area involving a 51-year-old woman and a 58-year-old man resulted in injuries, and both were airlifted to BKH Lienz hospital.
A 23-year-old male driver under the influence of THC got his car stuck in a forest area; his license was confiscated due to drug impairment and fatigue.
A pedestrian was hit by a car at a crosswalk in Vösendorf and the driver fled the scene. The victim sustained serious injuries.
A 56-year-old man fell and slid 250-300 meters while descending the Schneeberg mountain; he was treated on-site and airlifted to a hospital with unspecified injuries.
A motorcycle accident in Karlstein an der Thaya resulted in serious injuries when a woman was thrown after losing control of the bike.

A car crashed into a power pole in Linz; the pole was damaged, causing a power outage in nearby homes. The driver, an 18-year-old learner, confused the gas and brake pedals. No injuries occurred, and emergency services restored the situation.
A 31-year-old male climber died after falling while abseiling in the Tennengebirge mountain area.
A man in Hallein admitted to using drugs during a traffic stop; he was found unfit to drive and will be reported.
A ski collision in Obertrauern resulted in a 47-year-old man suffering a broken clavicle; the other skier was unharmed.
A Slovak seasonal worker fell in alpine terrain during a solo hike, was critically injured, and rescued after a complex search operation involving helicopters and rescue teams.
A 36-year-old paraglider pilot got stuck in a tree during a training flight and was rescued uninjured after an hour.
A 49-year-old man fell and severely injured his left forearm while hiking, but managed to descend and seek help before being taken to the hospital for surgical treatment.
An 18-year-old woman died and her 16-year-old brother was injured in a sledding accident in alpine terrain near Schladming, Austria.
Two skiers collided on Planai in Schladming, causing severe injuries to both; a 16-year-old girl hurt her shoulder, and an 18-year-old boy injured his spine.
A 51-year-old driver in Innsbruck hit a 72-year-old pedestrian at a crosswalk, causing severe injuries.
A cyclist collided with a car after failing to notice the car turning into a parking lot, resulting in the cyclist sustaining serious facial injuries.
Two cars collided head-on in Mieders, causing injuries to three people and significant vehicle damage.
A car caught fire on the Kugelweg in Fraxern and was extinguished by the local fire department. No one was injured.
Unknown perpetrator damaged a window at the Pfarrkirche Seefeld.
Police conducted checks in Viennas city center targeting group gatherings violating COVID-19 regulations.
An intoxicated motorcyclist and his passenger were seriously injured in a crash in Vienna.
A 35-year-old man was robbed of his wallet by a 16-year-old attacker in Linz. The suspect, who also carried marijuana, was identified and detained by police.
A 74-year-old woman in Linz was targeted in an internet fraud by a scammer posing as a Microsoft employee, resulting in a financial loss of 12,106.96 euros.
A skier collided with a 49-year-old woman from behind on a slope in Silvretta Montafon, causing her to fall and sustain injuries. The perpetrator fled the scene.
A 51-year-old driver struck a 72-year-old pedestrian on a crosswalk in Innsbruck, causing severe injuries to the pedestrian.
A hit-and-run traffic accident involving a pedestrian occurred in Vösendorf, leaving a 52-year-old man seriously injured. The driver of the vehicle was later identified and partially admitted guilt.
Burglars broke into a perfume shop in Bruck an der Leitha, stealing perfumes worth tens of thousands of euros. Three Romanian suspects were arrested later in Vienna.
A man from Graz pushed another man to the ground in a pub in Schiefling, then kicked him in the face before leaving. The victim was injured and taken to a hospital.
A car overturned on the exit ramp to a rest area in Hohenems; no driver was found, and investigations are ongoing.
A 16-year-old male threatened police officers at Wien Mitte station after interfering with their duties; he later stated he was intoxicated and apologized.
A 24-year-old man fired several shots into the air with a blank gun on the street and aimed at police but was apprehended without injury.
A 33-year-old man from Bezirk Völkermarkt was seriously injured while cutting tree trunks in his forest plot and was flown to the hospital.
A Finnish skier, 22, was injured in a skiing accident in St. Oswald, Radenthein and airlifted to a hospital.
A 33-year-old man was seriously injured while cutting tree trunks in his woodland parcel and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 61-year-old man was seriously injured during forestry work in Bezirk Villach when a tree trunk hit him, but he managed to call for emergency assistance and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 23-year-old man was caught red-handed during burglaries in Kronstorf, Linz-Land, linked to a series of thefts since November 2019; stolen goods and evidence were found.
Two motocross riders collided on a public road, resulting in serious injuries for both.

An intoxicated Hungarian man in Saalbach attempted to drive his car while heavily drunk, collided with a parked vehicle, and fled on foot. He was later found with 1.6 per mille alcohol in his system and no drivers license.
A 44-year-old man fell approximately 3 meters from a ladder and sustained serious injuries while working.
A fire broke out in a residential house in Ratschendorf, injuring a couple with smoke inhalation. The husband extinguished the fire with a fire extinguisher. The house suffered heavy smoke damage.
An 18-year-old was fatally struck by a slightly intoxicated driver after stepping onto the road following an accident with a deer.
Two men, aged 67 and 63, were seriously injured in a car accident in Bärnbach when their vehicle veered off the road, hit a water culvert, and came to a stop on the road.
Unidentified animals attacked a sheep herd, killing 12 on a fenced pasture in Ligist.
A 40-year-old man in Innsbruck touched women inappropriately and addressed them obscenely; police arrested him.
A 21-year-old Italian skier fell into a steep forested area outside the secured slope and was airlifted to a hospital with suspected spinal injuries.
Garage roof blown off and tree uprooted due to strong winds in Schönberg im Stubaital. No injuries or damage to items.
A man fell from a roof while clearing ice in Obertilliach and was flown to a clinic in Klagenfurt with severe injuries.
A car driven by an 18-year-old with four passengers crashed near Bersbucherwald, injuring all five occupants; the vehicle was totaled and emergency services responded.
In Klösterle, a 67-year-old skier was injured after being hit from behind by another skier who fled the scene.
A 17-year-old confessed to setting fire to the traditional Funken in Lauterach using gasoline after attending a party.
A funken tower in Lauterach was intentionally set on fire by an unknown perpetrator, resulting in heavy damage; no injuries were reported.

A Slovak man was found sleeping in a car inside a garage he had broken into. He was arrested, and stolen goods were found in the car. He also attempted to break into another house and caused significant damage.
Unknown individuals removed a disco ball from a clubhouse roof in Innsbruck and threw it into a river, causing damages in the four-figure euro range.
A 17-year-old driver without a license under strong drug influence was caught with stolen license plates and cannabis in Innsbruck; the passenger was also under drug influence.
An e-bike was stolen from a basement storage unit in Innsbruck between February 29 and March 1, 2020.
A border checkpoint between Austria and the Czech Republic in Mitterretzbach - Hnanice was announced to reopen for certain vehicles and individuals during specified hours.
A 23-year-old man assaulted a 27-year-old man during a birthday party in Villach, causing injuries that required hospital treatment.
A 23-year-old driver involved in a car accident in Salzburg was found to have a blood alcohol level of 0.9‰, resulting in the suspension of his drivers license.
A 45-year-old woman was found hypothermic and shocked after attempting to walk from Großarl to Werfen.
A 17-year-old driver lost control of his car and overturned it, suffering injuries. He was slightly intoxicated. The car was destroyed.
A border crossing between Austria and Czech Republic was opened for specific transport modes during limited hours.
Multiple speeding violations were recorded in Linz, including cases of excessive speeding and street racing, resulting in license suspensions and numerous charges.
A pedestrian was severely injured in a traffic accident involving two vehicles in Vienna. Both the pedestrian and a driver tested positive for alcohol.
A 52-year-old man died in a traffic accident after his small truck veered off the road in Laxenburger Straße, Vienna, hitting signs and overturning.
Two cars collided at an intersection in Spittal/Drau, injuring both drivers and causing significant property damage, including to a garden fence.
A woman driving in Mörtschach lost control of her car on a snowy driveway, causing the vehicle to overturn and leaving her with injuries.
A snowmobile accident occurred in Bad Kleinkirchheim during which a 64-year-old driver lost control and was injured while his passenger remained unhurt.
A 52-year-old German skier was seriously injured after a self-inflicted fall on the Muldenabfahrt slope in Bad Kleinkirchheim.
A car collided with a moped at an intersection in St. Martin, causing injuries to the 15-year-old moped driver.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a company premises in Korneuburg, opened a safe, and fled without stealing anything.
Car collided with a horse transporter in Schleißheim, causing one serious injury, minor injuries to others, and significant damage to both vehicles.

Two skiers were seriously injured after colliding on the Achter Jet piste in Flachau; they were airlifted to the hospital.
A garage in Sankt Peter-Freienstein caught fire, destroying the structure and two vehicles without causing injuries.
An apartment fire killed a 76-year-old man, caused extensive property damage, and left five cats missing. Investigation underway; potential suicide suspected.
A severe car accident involving three vehicles occurred on B 320 in Stainach-Pürgg, Austria. Four people were injured, including a 4-year-old child who was critically injured.
A pedestrian was severely injured after being hit by a car and thrown onto another vehicle in Köflach.
A traffic accident involving four cars on B 317 in Unzmarkt resulted in five minor injuries, caused by a 77-year-old driver veering into oncoming traffic due to microsleep.
A 24-year-old Polish skier was injured after a fall in the Funpark Giggijoch in Sölden and was airlifted to Innsbruck clinic.
An Irish skier fell approximately 50 meters off piste into a forest at the Ahorn ski area in Mayrhofen, suffering serious injuries and being airlifted to a clinic.
Five illegal Afghan migrants were found in a locked trailer in Nussdorf Debant and transported to a hospital while the driver was arrested on suspicion of smuggling.
A 69-year-old man fell about 20 meters into Messnertobel in Silbertal, suffering fatal head injuries. No signs of foul play were found.
An 86-year-old driver crashed into a garden wall in Nenzing after attempting to overtake a 46-year-old driver who was turning into a driveway, resulting in severe injuries and vehicle damage.
Three Romanian nationals were arrested for suspected burglary at a used clothing container in Vienna.
A 50-year-old man threatened a worker with an axe during a noise-related argument in Vienna, the worker escaped, and the man was arrested.
A 41-year-old Bulgarian man suspected of multiple counts of fraud was located and arrested by crime investigators in Vienna.
Attempted burglary of a coin machine at a gas station in Grafenstein, suspect caught and arrested with knives in possession.
A 70-year-old pedestrian was injured after being hit by a car while crossing the road in Wolfsberg.
A man suffered severe head injuries after being struck by a metal rail while loading a table onto a trailer.
A car accident occurred on L 60 near Waidhofen an der Thaya, causing injuries to three individuals, including a 2-year-old child, and temporary road closure.
A car accident occurred in Vöcklabruck, resulting in minor injuries to a driver and his family after a collision at a crossroads.
A driver under the influence of drugs fled police control, drove recklessly endangering others, and was apprehended in a parking garage.
An 86-year-old man drove off the road, crashed down a slope, and ended up in a creek; both him and his wife were injured.
A Romanian citizen was detained at the Suben border checkpoint due to a warrant related to a violation of residence prohibition.
Cannabis and drug paraphernalia were found during a vehicle check in Glanegg, Salzburg, leading to charges against a 21-year-old woman.
A 51-year-old man was hit by a car on a sidewalk and injured; the driver fled the scene without stopping.
Suspicious meat pieces potentially used as poison bait found near a dog park in Graz; police investigating.
An overheated wood stove caused a small fire in a residential building in Kelchsau, leading to minor damage but no injuries.
A German man was defrauded when he paid for a multifunctional kitchen appliance online but never received the product.
Unidentified perpetrators broke into multiple firms in Gleisdorf, stealing cash, jewelry, and valuables totaling several thousand euros.
Three suspects were arrested in Vienna for dealing cocaine, along with possession of firearms and drug paraphernalia.
A 13-year-old boy caused a fire in a forest by igniting materials, damaging young trees and grassland, and eventually admitted to the act.
Unidentified individuals stole food from a self-service store in Silz and fled by car; weapons were found discarded during pursuit.
A man was caught attempting a break-in at a café; police found burglary tools and a disguised stun gun.

A man threw a burning pyrotechnic device at a tree in Lehener Park, Salzburg, causing it to catch fire. Firefighters extinguished the fire, partially removing the trunk. The suspect has not been found.
Fire broke out in a multi-occupancy house, including its carport and a vehicle; no injuries reported, cause under investigation.
Two cars collided at an intersection, causing serious injuries to one driver and minor injuries to the other. A dog involved fled but was later found.
A cyclist was severely injured in a traffic accident when a car driver hit her at a cyclist crossing. She suffered a severe arm injury and was hospitalized.
