A Romanian semi-truck with dangerous mechanical defects was stopped by police on the A1 highway near Melk. Inspection revealed missing parts and jury-rigged fixes. The vehicle was barred from further travel and fined.
A 44-year-old man fell through a roof during work on a warehouse in Kirchberg am Wechsel, suffering serious injuries.
A 30-year-old worker fell from a roof in Neumarkt an der Ybbs, sustaining serious injuries and was airlifted to a hospital in Vienna.
A truck veered off the road and crashed down an embankment, causing light injuries to the driver and a road closure until 16:30.
A Romanian man stole food items by hiding them under a swimsuit and fled the scene; he was later caught with a fake drivers license.
A 58-year-old Hungarian man sustained a minor cut injury in a workplace altercation involving a Stanley knife in Wals.
A barn in Mariazell caught fire, but no one was injured as the owner evacuated the cows and firefighters extinguished the blaze.
Two cars collided on a municipal road in Mooskirchen, leaving a 73-year-old man severely injured while two others remained unhurt.
A 47-year-old man was killed by a falling tree during forestry work in Unterfresen, Austria.
A construction worker fell from a balcony on a building site in Graz, sustaining serious injuries.
Two intoxicated Hungarian men were involved in a physical altercation outside a guesthouse in Scheffau, leading to injuries.
A 50-year-old Austrian woman died in a car accident when her vehicle hit a concrete pillar on the B 182 in Gries am Brenner.
Two traffic accidents occurred in Innsbruck; one involving a car and an e-bike, and another involving two cars, causing injuries to individuals.
A 63-year-old German skier fell approximately 50-60 meters during a ski tour in St Jakob iD and was rescued with difficulty due to harsh weather conditions.
Strong winds caused a 1400 sqm roof and windows damage in Fulpmes, handled by fire services without injuries.
A Danish snowboarder collided with another skier at Valfagehr ski area and later sought medical treatment for a suspected broken collarbone.
Three Nigerian nationals were arrested in Wien-Brigittenau on suspicion of drug trafficking; authorities seized 133 grams of cocaine and cash during a house search.

A man attempted to evade police in Vienna, driving dangerously and causing damage to police vehicles before being arrested. He was found to be under the influence of drugs and without a driving license.
A swan with a fishing hook in its beak was rescued by Vienna water police and transferred to the city wildlife aid for treatment.
A 39-year-old man was arrested for transporting four individuals without valid travel documents in Horitschon, Austria after being spotted in the Nikitscher Wald.
A tractor and attached logging wagon caught fire in Glasing, causing significant damage; the fire was extinguished by firefighters with no injuries reported.
A small aircraft had to make an emergency landing in a snowy field after a propeller detached mid-flight; no injuries occurred but the plane was damaged.
A forest fire in Villach burned half a hectare of newly afforested land, challenging the firefighters due to snow and requiring helicopter assistance to extinguish.
Two skiers collided on a slope in Bad Kleinkirchheim, resulting in injuries and medical evacuation.
A Czech worker fell 3.5 meters from a truck in Groß-Siegharts, sustaining serious injuries; medevaced to Horn hospital.

A Greek truck driver was caught manipulating his tachograph 11 times to bypass legal driving and rest time regulations, with 22 severe violations and significant vehicle defects leading to license plate removal.
A 67-year-old woman drove the wrong way on the Innkreisautobahn A8, causing a dangerous situation before being stopped by other drivers and the police.
Pedestrian and BMW driver collided at a crosswalk in Wels; pedestrian later reported pain and sought medical attention.
A woman was injured during a hike on the Traunstein mountain and was rescued by police and mountain rescue teams.
Four senior ski tourers were rescued after getting disoriented in the dark on the Rumplerrunde ski tour near Simonyhütte.
An elderly woman drove into oncoming traffic due to sun glare, leading to a collision involving two other vehicles and resulting in injuries in Leonding.
A 52-year-old worker got his arm trapped in a composter machine and sustained severe injuries while working in the Vöcklabruck district. He was freed by a colleague and the facility operator.
Foreign truck transporting hazardous liquids without required safety equipment was stopped and fined near Werfen, Austria.
Police conducted traffic checks and suspended the licenses of three individuals due to suspected drug impairment after tests and medical evaluations confirmed their unfitness to drive.
A 36-year-old man was arrested in Graz for damaging seven cars with a knife and hammer.
A 42-year-old man was seriously injured during forestry work when a stone hit him and caused him to fall downhill.
Firefighters responded to a forest fire in 6410 Telfs, affecting 800m² of woodland; cause unknown but possibly linked to dryness and an ignition source.
Fire occurred in an apartment building in Telfs, causing smoke and minor property damage; no injuries reported.
An acetylene gas cylinder caught fire during cutting work in Söll, requiring response from firefighters and EKO Cobra; no injuries or damages occurred.
A car accident in Lauterach involved three vehicles, causing minor injuries to four people and significant vehicle damage.

Scammers impersonating Microsoft employees executed a tech support scam in Vorarlberg, Austria, tricking victims into granting remote access to their computers to steal sensitive data and demand payments.
A fire broke out in a rental facility in Braunau am Inn, likely caused by a technical defect; the fire spread due to stored materials and wall construction. No foul play suspected.

Police discovered an illegal gambling operation in a basement apartment, apprehended a suspect who violated asylum restrictions, found stolen property and a small amount of marijuana, and confiscated illegal gambling machines.
Two Bulgarian nationals were arrested in St. Pölten for multiple acts of money-changing fraud in Niederösterreich, confessing to several incidents and being linked to a broader fraud operation.
A 17-year-old fled from police on a moped, ignored stop attempts, and endangered pedestrians before being apprehended in Freistadt.
Three individuals stole cosmetics from multiple stores in Gmunden and Braunau; two were apprehended, while the third suspect remains at large.
24-year-old man died in a car accident in Traiskirchen after veering off the road and hitting a tree.
A 26-year-old man began vandalizing a bar, injuring two patrons and attacking police officers before being arrested.

In Klagenfurt, a 32-year-old man and a 29-year-old were involved in a physical altercation in a city center venue; the 29-year-old was injured and hospitalized, while the 32-year-old acted aggressively and was later taken into custody after further incidents involving drunk driving and police station vandalism.
A drunk driver crashed into a power transformer in Ansfelden and was injured, testing 1.22 per mille alcohol.
Burglars broke into a company office in Klagenfurt, searched through the premises and stole two cash boxes containing money.
A truck carrying hazardous materials without proper labeling or equipment was stopped and multiple violations were found.
Five suspected drug dealers were detained in Vienna; drugs and cash were confiscated.
A 30-year-old man drove off the road, collided with a streetlight and tree, and was rescued by the fire department with injuries.
A 50-year-old man was injured by a falling tree during forestry work in Göpfritzschlag and was airlifted to the hospital.
A driver was caught speeding at 230 km/h on the A1 motorway near Aurach am Hongar, Austria.
Two individuals were stopped in Weng im Innkreis during a human smuggling operation from Vienna to France.
A woman in Freistadt district brought an unsafe explosive material to a waste collection center; it was safely burned by the bomb disposal unit.
A van collided with a truck on a rainy road; the truck driver was injured and hospitalized.
An intoxicated driver caused a hit-and-run accident, damaged road infrastructure, and was later stopped by other drivers in Mauterndorf; a breathalyzer test showed over two promille.
A fire broke out in the basement of a building in Hallein, possibly due to an electrical defect; the fire was extinguished and residents were evacuated with no injuries reported.
A 17-year-old pedestrians foot was run over by a car in Graz; police are searching for the driver and witnesses.
A car caught fire in a garage after welding work, causing damages and minor injuries to the car owner while attempting to extinguish the fire.
A melted coffee machine caused smoke development in a house in Debant; no injuries, minor property damage.
Car caught fire due to a technical defect in Telfs garage; fire extinguished with no injuries reported.
Two cars collided on Kitzbüheler Straße in Kirchberg, causing injuries to two individuals, one of whom tested positive for alcohol.
A 21-year-old German skier fell on a descent at Pitztaler Glacier outside the marked slopes, sustaining a shoulder dislocation and being airlifted to a clinic in Imst.
A 62-year-old German skier fell and fractured his thigh after skiing over a rock on the Pitztal Glacier in unorganized ski terrain.
Man suffered burns from an explosion while using a grinder on a metal barrel containing flammable residues.
A collision involving a snowblower, a truck, and a bus resulted in light injuries for the truck driver and significant vehicle damage.
A man attacked his neighbor with a knife in Nickelsdorf but ended up injuring himself. The EKO Cobra unit was deployed, and the suspect was persuaded to leave his home before being arrested.
A traffic accident occurred in Villach involving a sudden brake by an unknown driver, leading to a rear-end collision and significant property damage but no injuries.
An 83-year-old driver hit a 76-year-old pedestrian on a crosswalk in Treffen, causing serious injuries.
A woman in Spittal/Drau fell victim to a lottery scam, providing voucher codes worth hundreds of euros to an unknown caller who promised a prize, which she never received.
A motorcycle collided with a car at the intersection, causing severe injuries to the rider.
Fatal collision between a truck and a car in Horn District, Austria, resulting in one fatality and one minor injury.
Unknown individuals clogged and set fire to a public toilet in Gmunden, causing heavy smoke development.

A 78-year-old man in Linz accidentally fired his handgun during a police firearms inspection. The bullet struck a gun cabinet and got lodged in the wall, narrowly missing officers. No injuries occurred, and authorities confiscated eleven weapons, two of which were unregistered. The man was charged and issued a temporary weapons ban.
Attempted robbery of a 21-year-old womans phone in Linz; suspects fled after a bystander intervened.
A 37-year-old driver in Wagrain was found to have over 1.5 promille alcohol level during a traffic stop, resulting in license suspension and a report to authorities.
An intoxicated woman fell out of a moving truck on the B117 road in St. Gallen, sustaining minor injuries.
Four intoxicated Somalis in quarantine damaged a window, fled, and were detained for aggressive behavior. One tested positive for COVID.
Car driver was involved in a collision with trucks while attempting to exit the A 12 highway in Kufstein, causing heavy property damage and traffic congestion.
An 81-year-old German skier fell and slid approximately 280 meters, sustaining severe injuries, and was airlifted to a clinic.
A kitchen fire in Lienz caused by a forgotten pot resulted in severe property damage and one person hospitalized for suspected smoke inhalation.
Unidentified individuals cut a propertys fence, entered an electrical companys site, and stole about 800 kg of copper cable from a container.
A man falsely claimed to be a bomb planter at St. Pölten train station, causing a major police operation and train traffic disruption.
An 81-year-old cyclist was injured in a collision with an unidentified vehicle at a Bregenz intersection; the driver left the scene without stopping.
A 43-year-old man was arrested in Vienna-Donaustadt for drug trafficking with a significant amount of drugs and cash seized.
A man attacked and threatened his ex-partner with a knife in Vienna. He was arrested for dangerous threats and violating weapon restrictions.
A man was pursued by police in Vienna after driving recklessly under the influence of drugs, endangering others, and carrying several illegal weapons. He was eventually arrested.
A 35-year-old suspect was arrested in Vienna-Floridsdorf for committing multiple robberies at shops, including using a knife and a baton, with financial motives.

During a heavy traffic inspection, officers discovered a manipulation device altering driving data in a Dutch truck. The drivers admitted to using it and were charged with falsifying evidence and multiple administrative violations.

A 50-year-old man was injured by a gunshot in the Bezirk Baden area, attributed to his brothers handling of an illegal firearm. Both men attempted to mislead authorities about the incident. Weapons and ammunition were seized, and legal actions followed.

Two individuals posed as plainclothes officers and attempted to rob a 44-year-old man in Braunau. The victim resisted, and the suspects fled. A 15-year-old and a 17-year-old were later identified as the perpetrators.
A 28-year-old driver collided with construction signage on the Südautobahn likely due to microsleep, resulting in injuries and significant damage.
A 32-year-old man drove off the L82b road in Guttaring, crashed into a forest, sustained serious injuries, but managed to rescue himself and go to a hospital.
A drunk driver crashed into a fence in Meiselding and continued driving with a damaged car before being tracked down at home.
Fatal car accident occurred when a man lost control of his vehicle, left the road, and struck a tree. He died at the scene despite resuscitation attempts.
A car accident in Radstadt involving a 24-year-old man and a 78-year-old woman resulted in the man being injured while the woman remained unharmed.
A fire broke out in a woodchip storage building, causing significant damage, including to a tractor inside. No injuries were reported.

Four men were arrested after attempting to defraud a 75-year-old woman by overcharging for purported roof repairs, demanding up to 24,000 euros. A bank employee reported suspicious behavior, leading to their apprehension.
A grassland fire covering approximately 10,000 m2 broke out in Siegendorf. It was quickly extinguished by local firefighters. No people or property were harmed.

A 16-year-old was stopped during a traffic check in Bezirk Klagenfurt for modifications on his moped that allowed speeds over 100km/h; license plate and registration were confiscated and driving was prohibited.
A 26-year-old man threatened and assaulted his mother and engaged in a violent altercation with his brother in Bezirk Klagenfurt, resulting in injuries. A restraining order was issued against him.
Two juveniles were caught damaging a houses fence and admitted to vandalizing cars with stones on separate occasions.
Unknown offenders broke into a ground floor apartment in Villach by forcing open the terrace door and stole coins worth several hundred euros.
A car accident occurred in Feistritz im Rosental causing injuries to two drivers and significant vehicle damage.
A fatal head-on collision between a car and a truck occurred in Schönkirchen-Reyersdorf, resulting in the death of a 68-year-old woman and injuries to the 34-year-old truck driver.
A head-on collision occurred on L 89 near Mauer bei Amstetten, resulting in the death of a 29-year-old woman. Her 6-year-old daughter and the driver of the other vehicle sustained minor injuries.
Serious accident on S5 involved a truck and multiple cars, injuring two drivers and causing heavy damage.
A 15-year-old moped rider collided with a parked truck in Marbach during rainfall and suffered severe injuries to the head and chest.
Three workers were lightly injured in a fire caused by gas explosion in an industrial facility in Kematen an der Ybbs, with minor damage to the production system.
Four people, including two children, were injured in a car accident in Kronstorf, Austria, involving a collision and one car being propelled against a house.
A 14-year-old boy in Linz stole underwear from a store and struck a security guard who tried to detain him.
A car crash occurred involving a woman and her two sons who were injured when their car collided with a truck in Allhaming.
Joint technical inspection of over 1000 trucks on A10 resulted in three being deemed unsafe due to oil leaks and suspension damage; fines and reports issued.
A 27-year-old Hungarian driver was slightly injured after a collision involving a semi-truck and another car on the Puntigamerbrücke in Graz, leading to traffic disruptions.
A car driven by an intoxicated man collided with a train; the driver was slightly injured and train passengers were in shock.
An unidentified perpetrator robbed cash at knifepoint from a grocery store in Telfs, Tirol, without causing injuries.
A 26-year-old German skier lost control on a slope in Alpbach and sustained a broken femur; he was airlifted to a hospital.
24-year-old man fell from a roof during carpentry work in Walchsee, sustaining serious head injuries, and was airlifted to the hospital.
Bicycles and a small amount of cash were stolen from a bike shop in St. Johann in Tirol.
An elderly woman received a fraudulent phone call from a person pretending to be a police officer, but the scam attempt failed.

A 13-year-old girl walking her dog in Ferlach was followed by a white van. The driver stopped, exited shirtless, and gestured for her to approach. She fled and reported the incident to police, but no injuries occurred.
A 66-year-old driver in Villach collided with a 39-year-old pedestrian crossing a crosswalk, causing minor injuries.

A 52-year-old woman was injured in a ski tour accident on Teuchlspitze when she slipped on an icy section, injuring her knee. She was rescued by Christophorus 7 helicopter and taken to the hospital for treatment.
A 20-year-old Bulgarian man was arrested at the border crossing Suben for stealing a car in Holland on March 3, 2021, which he confessed to acquiring through deceit.
A moped rider abruptly braked and was hit by a car, resulting in injuries and hospitalization.
A 78-year-old man got trapped between trees while cutting a beech in Schalchen and was rescued hours later by emergency services.
Police responded to a call in Leondig where a woman was found injured after falling in her home; she was taken to the hospital.
A 34-year-old German woman fell and died during a mountain tour near Aggenstein in Grän, Austria.
A 27-year-old Moroccan man suspected of shoplifting in Schwaz was aggressively resisting arrest, leading to injuries of two police officers.
A calf in a cattle pen in Kramsach caught fire after becoming entangled with a heat lamp; the farmer extinguished the fire, but the calf did not survive.
A 77-year-old man fell from a ladder while descending from a garden house roof in Alpach, sustaining injuries and was airlifted to a hospital in Innsbruck.
A 30-year-old Belarusian driver was stopped on the A12 in Tirol for multiple traffic violations, driving an unregistered vehicle, under influence of alcohol and drugs, and without a license.
Unidentified offenders dumped hydraulic oil into a public canal in Tulln an der Donau.

A 17-year-old male threatened a woman with a knife to steal money in Zeiselmauer, Austria. He also threatened another woman during his escape, hit a bystander who tried to photograph him, and resisted police arrest. The suspect was detained and the weapon and money were recovered.
Twelve people were found violating Covid-19 measures in a club with loud music and alcohol.
A 16-year-old was assaulted by two teenagers after being asked about his religion in Graz, resulting in minor injuries.
A Romanian man was arrested in Wels for shoplifting and fencing; stolen items were found in his vehicle, and he admitted to transporting stolen goods to Romania.
Two Georgian nationals were arrested on suspicion of committing multiple commercial thefts in Salzburg, Lower Austria, and Upper Austria after a vehicle search revealed stolen items.
Three men were arrested for attempting to break into a construction site container in Vienna, with burglary tools confiscated and no items stolen.
A 67-year-old man died in a car accident in Allhaming after his rental car collided with a tunnel portal.
A 39-year-old woman collided with another vehicle while overtaking on the B3c Alte Donau Straße, resulting in minor injuries to both drivers and significant vehicle damage.
Two Italian truck drivers were caught manipulating driver cards to exceed legally allowed driving hours; fined €10,000 and charged with evidence falsification.
A collision occurred between a car and an e-scooter at the intersection of Schubertring and Johannesgasse in Vienna, resulting in the e-scooter rider being hospitalized with a suspected arm fracture.
Two arrests in Vienna during anti-drug operation for cocaine and cannabis trafficking.
A 43-year-old Austrian man wanted for not returning to a correctional facility in Lower Austria was apprehended peacefully during a routine police check.

Two incidents in Vienna where individuals resisted police, injuring officers during arrests; one involved aggression during a drug inquiry and the other followed a reported physical assault on a pedestrian.
A man attempted to evade police in Klagenfurt, resisted arrest, injured an officer, and was found with cocaine, stolen goods, and a forged ID.
Driver without a license and in an unregistered car evaded police, speeding up to 100 km/h, but was eventually stopped and taken to the police station.
A kitchen fire caused by overheating fat occurred in a residence in St. Andrä; the resident extinguished the fire but significant smoke damage required fire department intervention.
Two workers fell 5.5 meters from a scaffold after a material failure on a construction site, resulting in one severe and one minor injury.
A man rear-ended a womans car in Traun and fled the scene after she mentioned calling the police. He was later identified and found to lack a valid drivers license.
A truck exceeded the height limit at a checkpoint on the S10 near Götschka-Tunnel, causing a traffic disruption and subsequent driver violations for wrong-way driving.
Two cars collided at a crossroads, causing minor injuries to a 40-year-old man and significant damage to both vehicles.
Unregistered demonstration in Graz caused temporary traffic disruptions; no incidents or violence reported.
Kitchen fire in a single-family home caused by an unattended pan with oil; no injuries reported.
A 55-year-old man was seriously injured during forestry work when his leg got caught between a log and a tree.
Five Somali men tried to enter a care facility in Innsbruck, threw stones, and threatened staff with wooden planks and broken glass bottles. They were later apprehended by police.
A collision occurred at the intersection of Schusterbergweg and Arzler Straße in Innsbruck when a 24-year-old driver failed to yield, injuring a female driver.
A 40-year-old man was seriously injured when a 180kg concrete ring fell and hit his hand on a construction site in Breitenwang.
An 8-year-old fell into the Sill river in Innsbruck and was rescued by a fisherman and another man.
A car hit a pedestrian and her two children on a crosswalk in Vienna; all three were injured and taken to the hospital.
A man performing music behind a shop window attracted a crowd of 40-50 people, obstructing traffic in Vienna. Police were called, and the crowd dispersed except for one man who was reported.
Police conducted a control in a local venue in Vienna with 23 guests, where COVID-19 regulations were violated; one individual was arrested due to immigration law breaches.
A 17-year-old driver lost control in a curve on L349 near Lockenhaus, hitting a tree; his passenger was injured and had to be rescued by firefighters before being airlifted to a hospital.
A man broke into two self-service boxes in Villach, stolen a cash box in one incident, and was arrested by police after a pursuit.
A 66-year-old man died after being struck by a falling tree during logging work in his forest.
Car accident with injuries on A2 involving two vehicles; one person hospitalized.
A fire broke out at a wood chip storage facility in Suetschach, Feistritz/Rosental, requiring substantial firefighting resources, and the cause is under investigation.
A car-motorcycle collision occurred in Villach, injuring the motorcyclist who reportedly performed a wheelie before the crash, while the car driver remained uninjured.

Police stopped a car in Haid, St. Florian am Inn, discovering drugs, drug paraphernalia, and an illegal weapon during a search. The driver showed signs of drug influence and his license was confiscated.
A 24-year-old intoxicated driver caused a traffic accident, fled the scene, and was later apprehended. His car and license were confiscated.
An elderly woman was rescued from her car after a collision that sent both vehicles into a field; both drivers were injured.
A 53-year-old man from Grieskirchen district lost control of his car in Hartkirchen, crashed into a stone wall, and later fell down a steep slope resulting in fatal injuries.
A modified vehicle with excessive noise and smoke was stopped and inspected; the driver admitted to unauthorized modifications and will be reported.
A 17-year-old was assaulted and robbed of a Bluetooth speaker by two attackers in Salzburg-Nonntal; suspects were later arrested by police.
Three-car collision on Oberechinger Landesstraße caused by a driver failing to brake in time, resulting in minor injuries and all vehicles being towed.

Two men engaged in a physical altercation and a verbal dispute over social distancing in a store in Salzburg Itzling, resulting in minor injuries and a threatening statement made in front of police officers.
A car with three occupants veered off the road, hit a tree, and caught fire in Seiersberg. The vehicle burned out, but all passengers escaped uninjured.
Three Afghan refugees were found and detained in Dornbirn after fleeing from a Serbian truck.
A truck lost control and its trailer collided with a car in Bregenz, injuring the driver and causing significant damage.
A fatal workplace accident occurred on a construction site in Feldkirch where two workers fell from 8 meters while attaching a concrete platform; one died and the other sustained ankle injuries.
Unsecured vehicles in Vorarlberg were targeted for theft by unknown individuals checking locking mechanisms.
A 30-year-old male suspect was arrested after allegedly committing multiple car break-ins, with stolen registration documents and car keys found during a search.
Burglars broke into two firms in Bezirk Wolfsberg, stealing work clothes and causing property damage.
An elderly woman was found weak and lying on the floor of her house after her daughter alerted authorities. She was provided first aid by police and taken to the hospital by helicopter.
Police officers rescued abandoned dwarf rabbits in a park and handed them over to animal rescue.
A 60-year-old man from Absam went missing in the Halltal area after setting out for the Buchtaler Hütte; extensive searches have been conducted without success.
Police arrested three Serbian men on suspicion of drug trafficking, securing heroin, cocaine, cannabis, and money during the search.
A fire broke out in the roof area of a wood chip storage facility, allegedly caused by sparks from a chimney carried by the wind; no injuries resulted.
A cable fire behind wooden paneling in an apartment in Mutters caused smoke development and property damage, with no injuries reported.
A 21-year-old man in Villach was investigated for drug dealing, with heroin and cannabis found after a vehicle stop and house search, leading to his arrest.
Man lost control of car on snowy road, overturned down slope in Gotschuchen; sustained unspecified injuries and was taken to hospital.
A car accident occurred on the A1 ramp in Linz-Land, Austria, involving an intoxicated driver; one car went off-road, and the other sustained heavy damage, with minor injuries reported.
A 32-year-old man was arrested for setting fires at the property of a 69-year-old pensioner in Steiermark, causing damage valued at approximately 70,000 euros.
A 22-year-old woman and her 21-year-old passenger were lightly injured after their car overturned on Braunauer Landesstraße in Burgkirchen. The driver had a blood alcohol level of 1.22 promille.
A 34-year-old man crashed his car, which overturned, and was severely injured; he was rescued by firefighters and hospitalized.
Police searched for a suspect who ran from a garden after being disturbed by a resident in Stattegg. The suspect stole documents from an unlocked car.
An incendiary bomb from wartime was discovered on a tree stump in Viennas 17th district and safely removed by the militarys disposal service.
A 28-year-old man was arrested in Vienna after breaking a car window to reportedly seek a sleeping space.
A teenager was robbed of his mobile phone by a group of young men, leading to one arrest; the search for the remaining suspects continues.
A taxi driver was threatened with a knife by an unknown man demanding cash; the driver managed to fend off the attacker and forced him out of the taxi.
Car accident on icy road in Villach involving multiple vehicles, resulting in injuries to two women.
A car caught fire on the A2 Süd Autobahn near Leobersdorf in Austria, causing damage to infrastructure and leading to road closures; no injuries were reported.
Freight truck and regional train collide at unguarded railway crossing in Horn; one injured and property damage reported.
A man without a valid driving license and under drug influence was stopped after speeding and overtaking a plainclothes police car.
Three people injured in a head-on collision involving two cars on the B 148 in Braunau district, Austria.
Burglary in a construction company in Traun; items like cash, camera equipment, and ski passes stolen and later recovered after arrest of a suspect.
Hot ash caused a fire affecting a fence and a tree; no injuries reported.
A 44-year-old woman suffered severe head injuries during a horse riding accident in Ramsau, Austria, when her horse fell and kicked her.
Two individuals were injured in a collision between a car and a small truck at an intersection due to right-of-way violation.
A 55-year-old German skier went off the slope and hit a tree, suffering injuries; he was airlifted to an Innsbruck clinic.
A man attempted to break into an apartment but was noticed by a neighbor who called the police. The suspect was apprehended in the stairwell, and burglary tools were seized.
A man attacked another with a knife during an argument, injuring his hand; police arrested the attacker.
A 38-year-old Nigerian man was arrested in Vienna on suspicion of drug trafficking; heroin, cocaine, and a mobile phone were confiscated.
An Italian skier fell and sustained injuries while skiing off-piste from Stubeck; he was airlifted to the hospital.
Fatal car accident in Klagenfurt a.W. involving three men; two died, one injured.
A 64-year-old man was fatally injured when hit by a car as he lay on the road after being dropped off by another vehicle.
An intoxicated cyclist fell and was injured, later tested with 2.14 per mille of alcohol.
A drunk driver on B 145 in the Bezirk Gmunden endangered police by crossing into oncoming traffic, later caused a crash involving damage to roadside structures, and had a BAC of 1.24 per mille.
A 64-year-old man was fatally injured after being struck by a car while lying on a roadway in Andorf. The incident occurred during the night.
An intoxicated driver caused a rear-end collision on the B129 in Alkoven, injuring himself while the other driver and passenger remained unhurt.
A man cleaning a roof fell about 3.2 meters onto a carport roof and was hospitalized with injuries of unknown severity.
A 22-year-old woman injured her knee while skiing and was rescued by helicopter.
A cyclist in Graz was lightly injured after being hit by a car during an overtake on Schönaugürtel street.
A 54-year-old woman fell while skiing from Hochreichhart and was rescued by helicopter with a knee injury.
Traffic stop in Graz with driver testing positive for drugs and another individual arrested for possession of marijuana seeds and interfering with officers.
A 44-year-old skier fell while skiing downhill near Bodenalm in Prägraten, sustaining serious leg injuries and requiring rescue and hospitalization.
Police broke up a party with about 20 people in a hotel room in Igls, violating COVID regulations and causing noise disturbance.
Driver fled traffic control in Reutte, was in possession of cannabis, and caused injuries to a police officer who fell during an attempted escape.
A peaceful demonstration against Covid measures in Innsbruck was held with 180 participants; 29 administrative charges were issued.
A 32-year-old woman from Salzburg fell during a ski tour descent at Weerberg, sustaining a leg injury and was airlifted to a hospital.
A German paraglider crashed near Hippach in the Zillertal, sustaining severe injuries and being airlifted to Innsbruck Clinic.
A 54-year-old man was found dead in his outdoor swimming pool; preliminary investigation suggests he fell accidentally.
A truck experienced a brake failure in the Arlbergtunnel, causing it to stop and resulting in damage to the vehicle; the tunnel was temporarily closed for several hours.
Fire broke out at a recycling center in Niederndorf, cause unknown, with no injuries reported.
A 70-year-old woman was found dead in the Inn river in Münster; investigation and autopsy ordered to determine cause of death.
A heavily intoxicated man fell 5 meters at a construction site in Langen bei Bregenz, suffering fatal injuries.

Two young individuals were threatened with a perceived firearm during an argument in Stadtpark, Vienna. Two suspects were later arrested; the weapon, an Airsoft gun, was confiscated, and it was revealed both suspects were under the influence of alcohol during the incident.
A heavily intoxicated Slovenian driver was stopped at an entry control for lacking a valid license and car documents; his driving was prohibited and he faces charges.
Police interrupted an unauthorized gathering in Höchst where 30 participants disregarded Covid-19 regulations and showed uncooperative behavior during identity checks.

Multiple burglaries and acts of vandalism occurred at Blumengärten Hirschstetten involving damage to buildings, vehicles, thefts, and unauthorized use of vehicles; two teenagers were caught during a burglary attempt and admitted responsibility for 17 offenses.
A man in Villach attacked a police officer after demanding the return of his car keys, which were confiscated due to his drunk driving offense.
A 52-year-old man drove off the road and crashed into a tree, sustaining injuries and requiring rescue by firefighters.
Laundry cart caught fire in a staff building in Seefeld; one person hospitalized for smoke inhalation.
A truck was found to be significantly overloaded during a traffic control in Nauders, and the driver was prohibited from continuing.
Police interrupted a birthday party in St. Veit/Glan with 10 participants violating Covid-19 regulations, leading to 30 charges.
A man with nearly 2 promille alcohol level was caught driving in Pfarrwerfen; his license was confiscated and further driving prohibited.

An 18-year-old hosted a party where two 17-year-olds began fighting in the street. A 19-year-old intervened and ultimately punched one of the 17-year-olds, causing severe head injuries. The victim underwent emergency surgery but is no longer in critical condition. The assailant turned himself in and confessed.
An 87-year-old cyclist was injured in a collision with a car in Villach and taken to the hospital.

A car accident occurred in Wimpassing, Austria, involving three vehicles and causing injuries to a woman who was flown to the hospital. Significant damage was reported, and the road was closed for one hour.
Two cars collided at an intersection, resulting in injuries to three individuals; one driver required extrication by fire services.
A 19-year-old woman lost control of her car on a wet road after an overtaking maneuver, leading to a collision with another vehicle and ending with injuries and vehicle damage.
A Serbian truck driver was found illegally parked with an expired drivers certificate and residence permit, leading to his arrest in Ansfelden.
A 44-year-old Belgian tourist was injured when a large snowball triggered during slope preparation rolled down a ski slope and over him.
A 54-year-old driver collided with an 11-year-old girl in Obertauern while driving uphill on a snowy road; the girl was slightly injured.
Burglars broke into an apartment in Schladming and stole a black furniture safe containing over 60,000 euros.

A 40-year-old driver rear-ended a 59-year-old womans car near a roundabout in Weiz, resulting in total damage to both vehicles and injuries to two people. The 40-year-old refused an alcohol test and will be reported.
A 78-year-old woman in Floing, Austria, was seriously injured when her hand came into contact with a circular saw while cutting firewood.
An unknown perpetrator stole a waiter’s money pouch from his belt in an Apres Ski bar in Sölden and fled with the cash.
A waiter in Brixen im Thale quit his job and left with the daily earnings, but was intercepted by the police and the money was recovered.
A woman was injured in a hit-and-run accident while crossing the L55 in Koblach and was taken to the hospital.
A public demonstration in Eisenstadt addressed concerns about lockdown measures and coronavirus legislation, with minor administrative violations recorded.
A motorcycle with two young riders collided with a car in Niederdörfl; they were injured, and the car driver was lightly intoxicated.
A collision occurred between a 12-year-old cyclist and a 15-year-old moped rider in Straßburg, causing injuries to both and significant vehicle damage.
18-year-old rider injured in a fall after horse was startled, transported to hospital by helicopter.
A 39-year-old man assaulted his partner, causing severe injuries, leading to a restraining order against him.
A 53-year-old man fell 60 meters on hard snow while climbing the Schneeberg, sustaining a broken ankle. He was rescued by helicopter and taken to a hospital.
A 19-year-old man was injured in a car accident after veering off the road and was rescued from the vehicle by the fire department.
A burglar was apprehended in Linz after breaking into a basement storage unit. The suspect was caught with tools and stolen items.
Car collided with moped at intersection in Garsten causing injuries to moped driver and passenger.
A 42-year-old snowboarder collided with a young skier on the Schönalmbahn slope in Obertauern, suffering serious injuries, while the child appeared unharmed and left the scene with their family.
Two individuals threatened a 17-year-old with a weapon to obtain drugs and money in Leibnitz; both were later arrested by police.
A sauna room in a single-family house caught fire causing significant property damage, but no injuries were reported.
A 38-year-old man suffered a severe ankle fracture after slipping on icy ground during a descent near Niklasdorf. He was assisted by mountain rescue and transported to the hospital.
A 45-year-old woman was seriously injured during a sledding accident after colliding with a snow obstacle and being airlifted to a hospital.
A 51-year-old man from Graz slipped on ice while descending Schöckl and was severely injured. He was airlifted to a hospital.
A 20-year-old Austrian injured an 18-year-old Austrian during a dispute at a gas station in Innsbruck, also firing two shots with a blank gun. The victim was hospitalized.
A 70-year-old Austrian woman suffered severe head and facial injuries after falling on a ski slope in Obertilliach. She received first aid on-site and was airlifted to a hospital.
A head-on collision occurred on Brixentaler Straße in Westendorf between two vehicles, injuring all occupants of both cars who were transported to the hospital.
An intoxicated woman accidentally drove her car onto a train track at a station in Klaus, resulting in a disruption of train service for 50 minutes.
A 27-year-old man died in an avalanche while skiing on Große Göller in the St. Aegyd am Neuwalde area.
A 37-year-old man lost control of his car, causing damage and soil spillage, and left the scene, later refusing to disclose his location or undergo an alcohol test.
A heavily intoxicated man damaged a radiator in a Straßwalchen bar, causing extensive water leakage.
Unknown perpetrator broke into a club premises in Pflach, stole cash and a piggy bank.
A 35-year-old man was found dead in Klagenfurt due to drug consumption, with substances and drug paraphernalia found at the scene.
Unknown suspects intentionally scratched a parked car in Klagenfurt using a sharp object.
A techno party with 18 attendees violating COVID-19 regulations was dissolved by authorities in a bunker in Hörsching.

Around 200 people in Kapfenberg gathered in a religious setting, wearing masks but not maintaining required social distancing, leading to police intervention and identification for administrative review.
A 15-year-old was attacked and severely injured by a group of six youths near the Hauptbahnhof in Innsbruck, who robbed him of his watch; five were arrested immediately, and the sixth two days later.
A car caught fire in Deutschlandsberg due to a suspected technical defect, resulting in total loss but no injuries.
A 21-year-old probationary drivers license holder was caught speeding at 140 km/h and committing multiple traffic violations; his license was confiscated on the spot.
A 42-year-old driver, under the influence of alcohol, caused a collision while making a left turn in Vienna, injuring both drivers slightly.

A 29-year-old driver collided with a VW bus on the A12 near Stams, causing the bus to skid off the road and scatter contents across the highway. One person injured, vehicles heavily damaged, and the road temporarily closed.
A 43-year-old Slovak driver lost control, hit a traffic sign, and overturned on the A1 highway near Pucking, suffering severe injuries.
Two people injured in a collision between two vehicles in Grieskirchen region, Austria.
A car caught fire in the engine area at a roundabout on the B319 in Fürstenfeld; no injuries occurred.
A 19-year-old driver, under the influence of alcohol, caused an accident at an intersection, resulting in minor injuries to five passengers.
A man evaded police by jumping from a second-floor window but was caught after a 500-meter chase.
Two teenage males were caught breaking into newspaper vending machines with a hammer, stealing coins, and were arrested. Tools and money were secured.
A 41-year-old skier from Salzburg fell during his descent and was injured near Fraganter Hütte. He was airlifted to a hospital.
An avalanche struck during an alpine training in the Großglockner area, causing the death of a police officer who was partially buried and suffered severe injuries.

A collision occurred between a 52-year-old skier from the Czech Republic and a 9-year-old boy in the Mölltaler Glacier ski area. The boy sustained injuries and was airlifted to Villach hospital, while the skier planned to seek medical attention privately.
Two men collided during a motocross training ride, resulting in severe injuries.
A 57-year-old man died during forestry work in Gmunden when a birch tree dislodged and struck him on the head.
Five Czech climbers were killed in an avalanche on the Dachstein mountain after being completely buried under snow without avalanche transceivers.
A skiing collision in Austria resulted in a woman severely injured, and the male skier fled the scene.
Two skiers collided on a slope in Fanningberg, Lungau, resulting in injuries of undetermined severity. Both were wearing helmets.

A heavily intoxicated 20-year-old man attacked a taxi driver with a knife, threatened him, damaged the taxi, and threw a fire extinguisher at the vehicle. He was arrested after police forced entry into his apartment.
A 61-year-old man sustained a mild smoke inhalation injury while extinguishing a small fire caused by a gas burner in his apartment.
A police-led event in Feldbach aimed at enhancing womens sense of safety through safety tips and prevention measures.
Two teenagers were robbed by a group of four to five people near Bachlechnerstraße/Höttinger-Au in Innsbruck.
In Sölden, a thief stole a waiter’s money pouch containing a four-figure sum in euros and fled a crowded après-ski bar.
A 25-year-old worker was injured when wooden beams fell while he operated a ceiling crane in Jenbach, Austria.
A serious traffic accident occurred in the Stutztobeltunnel involving a car and a bus; the car driver was critically injured and had to be airlifted to the hospital.
Four suspected burglars were arrested in Vienna with assistance from police dogs and a helicopter after attempting to break into a garden house.
A drunk driver in Klagenfurt drove recklessly, displayed aggressive behavior towards police officers, and was subsequently arrested.
A woman from Klagenfurt was scammed into sending large sums of money to a man abroad she met through an online dating platform.
A traffic accident in Hohenwarth-Mühlbach involved three vehicles and road maintenance work. Two people were injured and hospitalized.
A 31-year-old driver in Gänserndorf, Austria lost control of his vehicle, which overturned. The man suffered serious injuries and was taken to the hospital.
A 30-year-old forestry worker accidentally cut his right forearm with a chainsaw while working in Königswiesen due to slipping on frozen ground; he called for help and was airlifted to the hospital.
A 40-year-old man fell seven meters through a roof during renovation work, sustaining injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.
A cyclist was hit by a car in Nonntal, Salzburg, suffering serious injuries. The driver fled but was later detained; a breathalyzer test was refused, and the driver lost their license.
Two cars collided in Graz, resulting in injuries to both drivers; one was severely intoxicated and driving recklessly.
Collision between a forklift and car on a company premises injured two people, one severely and one lightly.
A cement mixer detached from a truck and collided with a car, injuring a woman and her young child.
A worker was injured in a ski resort accident involving a snow grooming machine when an emergency stop caused him to be ejected from a work basket.
A 50-year-old man fell through the floor while working in an attic in Hall in Tirol, sustaining serious injuries.
A 16-year-old female moped rider collided with a car while both were entering Dornau road in Stans. She was injured and hospitalized, and both vehicles were heavily damaged.
Unknown perpetrators damaged gutters at an elementary school and set a bush on fire, which was extinguished by firefighters.
A bank advisor identified a fraudulent attempt using a hacked email account to transfer funds from a womans account, preventing any financial loss.
Couple broke into newspaper cash containers and stole money, identified by a witness and apprehended with stolen items and tools.
Three women stole cosmetics from a store in Eferding, were identified via surveillance footage, and confessed after being interrogated.
A 66-year-old man injured his leg with a chainsaw during forestry work in Heldenberg and was airlifted to a hospital.
Two individuals in Klagenfurt were arrested for selling heroin and cocaine, with investigations ongoing to identify buyers.
A man robbed a gas station in Linz, threatening an employee with a handgun and fleeing with cash.
Attempted break-in at a building in Scheffau; suspects tried to open a safe but failed, causing property damage.
Kitchen fire occurred in a single-family home in Mattsee; no injuries, but significant property damage.

A 79-year-old woman, lightly dressed, left her house in Kirchberg i.T. She was found safe near the emergency center following a search operation by police, fire brigade, mountain rescue, and a police dog handler.
A suspected shoplifter stole two perfumes and injured a passerby while fleeing, but was detained and arrested by a store detective in Vienna.
A man was attacked with a baseball bat and robbed of his mobile phone in a park; suspect is still at large.
A pedestrian was hit and seriously injured by a truck at a crossing in Vienna.
Two World War II hand grenades without fuses were discovered by walkers in Schachendorf and Klostermarienberg and safely disposed of by the bomb disposal service.
A 52-year-old forestry worker suffered severe head injuries after slipping while working at a forest site in Thörl-Maglern. He was treated on-site and airlifted to a hospital.
A 50-year-old man accidentally shot a 65 mm nail into his forearm while using a pneumatic nail gun at work in Radenthein, Austria. He was hospitalized with unspecified injuries.
Worker fell approximately 6 meters through an open roof onto a woodpile while dismantling roof panels, sustaining injuries.
A 65-year-old man lost control of a tractor with a trailer on slippery road, causing it to overturn; he sustained injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 46-year-old worker fell from a height of 7 meters while performing roof repairs and sustained severe injuries.
Ten drivers under the influence of drugs were stopped during a traffic control in Upper Austria, declared unfit to drive, and had their licenses confiscated.

A 24-year-old man was injured in a forestry accident when his chainsaw hit his head, causing cuts. He called his father, drove two kilometers on a tractor, and awaited rescue before being hospitalized.
A man loading logs onto a trailer was fatally injured when two logs fell on him in Ried in der Riedmark, Upper Austria.
A 46-year-old truck driver lost his life after his vehicle veered off a wet road and crashed into a rock face, causing the cab to detach. Milk from the tanker spilled into the Enns river.
A car driver collided with an 86-year-old e-bike rider in Andorf, resulting in injuries to the cyclist.
Two vehicles collided at an intersection in Salzburg Süd. A 74-year-old driver and her 84-year-old passenger were injured, while the other driver remained unharmed.
A dishwasher caught fire in the basement of a market building due to a technical defect; no injuries reported, but the dining area had to be closed due to smoke.
Police conducted initial checks in the newly established protective zone in Grazs Stadtpark, issuing 26 bans and identifying individuals under judicial investigation.
A 13-year-old was robbed by an unknown male who stole his schoolbag and fled on foot.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a car dealership in Innsbruck, smashed a car window, and stole the steering wheel, causing significant damages.
A noxious substance was released in a school center in Wörgl causing respiratory issues for students, with 39 hospitalized for examination.
A 27-year-old driver under the influence of drugs attempted to flee a police stop in Vienna, endangering others, and was arrested along with the cars owner who also had an outstanding warrant.
Driver caught speeding at 131 km/h in a 70 km/h zone in Pinkafeld, facing penalties.
An intoxicated woman was stopped driving a damaged car on its rim; her license was confiscated.
A fire broke out in the attic of a residential building; no injuries reported, and the fire was contained by firefighters.
A car accident occurred in Grieskirchen involving a 68-year-old woman and a 34-year-old man; the man was later found to be intoxicated with 1.4‰ alcohol by an off-duty police officer.
An intoxicated driver in Linz forced an ambulance to abruptly brake, was found with a blood alcohol level of 1.12‰, and will face charges.
Two trucks collided on the A25 near Wels, Austria; both drivers were injured and the road was temporarily closed.
A heavily intoxicated driver veered off the road near a bus stop on the B159 in Hallein, requiring fire department intervention; no injuries reported.
A 24-year-old Afghan man bypassed a Covid checkpoint in Hochfilzen and was later arrested in Leogang for being unlawfully present in Austria.
A cyclist in Salzburg was hit by a car on a crosswalk, causing minor injuries, and the driver fled the scene.

Two 19-year-old men, armed with a metal rod, robbed a tobacco shop in Leoben, stealing cash and cigarettes, with the support of an 18-year-old accomplice. All were apprehended and linked to prior burglary and other offenses.
A 54-year-old pedestrian was seriously injured in a traffic accident on Conrad-von-Hötzendorf-Straße in Graz after being hit by a car.
A Hungarian man loading wood on a forklift in Stams suffered a head injury from falling wood and was treated at Innsbruck Clinic.
A man in Matrei in Osttirol fell from a 2-meter high snow pile and broke his thigh while removing ice from a roof.
A man vandalized several houses and objects with graffiti in Brixlegg.
A 59-year-old man fell 3.5 meters at a construction site in Rum, sustaining a severe thigh fracture; he was taken to Innsbruck clinic.
Unknown perpetrators damaged building facades and nearby vehicles in Innsbruck by throwing paint-filled containers.
An unknown suspect sprayed graffiti with the tag KRONOS! on the back of a truck parked in Hohenems.

A man and his girlfriend purchased a used car, illegally attached stolen license plates, and drove recklessly. The man, who was drunk and without a drivers license, was stopped twice by police after unsafe driving and unauthorized use of the vehicle.
Oil spill observed on the Danube near the Aschach power plant, containment measures initiated.
Sixteen individuals, including children, were apprehended near Spielfeld, Leibnitz, while illegally entering Austria by crossing rail tracks; they were returned to Slovenia.
A 57-year-old woman went missing in Vomp after taking a taxi to Schwaz and has not been seen since.
A car collision occurred at an intersection in Vöcklabruck district, involving a Croatian driver and another vehicle; one person was injured while another remained unhurt.
A 77-year-old man received a fraudulent call from someone pretending to be a police officer and another person seeking money under false pretenses.
A 40-year-old man committed an armed robbery on a gas station in Linz using a softgun to obtain cash for drugs.
A 29-year-old was caught at the Spielfeld border with drugs, including Speed and Ecstasy; further investigations revealed long-term drug dealing in Graz and Maribor.
A worker was severely injured during maintenance work on a heavy electric motor in Arnoldstein.
A 16-year-old pedestrian was struck by a car while crossing a protected walkway and sustained unspecified injuries in St. Veit an der Glan.
A 53-year-old woman struck a pedestrian on a crosswalk in Fügen, causing minor injuries to the 16-year-old boy who was taken to the hospital.
A 56-year-old man wanted by Hungary for a 2011 major theft involving €30,000 was located and arrested in Bad Vöslau.
Police arrested a 47-year-old Nigerian man for selling cocaine and found additional drugs and cash; a 33-year-old Austrian buyer was reported.
Police recorded multiple speeding violations on Klosterneuburger Straße, with one motorcyclist reaching 176 km/h in a 70 km/h zone.
A heavily intoxicated truck driver with a blood alcohol level of 2.28 promille was stopped and fined, and his driving license was confiscated.
A 12-year-old German skier lost control and hit a rock, suffering severe injuries, and was airlifted for emergency surgery.
A car and a truck collided at a construction site intersection in Hollabrunn, resulting in serious injuries to the car driver.
A 12-year-old girl collided with an unknown woman during a school skiing trip, leading to physical complaints and requiring medical attention.
A car collided with a cyclist in Traun, injuring the cyclist who was taken to the hospital.
A driver showed a softgun during a traffic altercation on the A1; the weapon was confiscated and charges were filed.
Two cars collided head-on in Falkenstein; both drivers sustained injuries and were transported to the hospital.
A Polish man and a Czech woman were caught stealing clothes in a store in Traun; both were later apprehended and identified by a store employee.
An 80-year-old pedestrian in Salzburg was struck by a car in a hit-and-run accident while crossing a street; she sustained unspecified head injuries and was treated by emergency services.
A two-car accident occurred in Nußdorf am Haunsberg; one driver was intoxicated and both were injured.
A car collided with a train at an unguarded railroad crossing in Straßwalchen/Haidach, leaving two women seriously injured.
A small truck was stolen in Graz; the suspect fled after being chased by police.
A laser cutting machine caught fire in a metal processing company, causing significant property damage; no one was injured.
An 82-year-old woman was targeted in an attempted robbery near the Leibnitz train station; a 20-year-old suspect was arrested following a police search.
A technical defect in a heating control caused significant smoke development in a residential house; no injuries were reported.
Two cars collided on L 301 in Hitzendorf; a 26-year-old driver, who tested positive for alcohol, crossed into oncoming traffic and hit a 23-year-old driver, causing severe injuries to the latter.

A 19-year-old driver lost control of his car due to weather and road conditions in Kirchdorf i. T., resulting in the vehicle skidding off the road, overturning, and landing in a stream. The driver sustained minor injuries, and the car was totaled.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a café in Dölsach, forced open a safe, stole cash, cigarettes, and a tablet.
A collision occurred between a snowboarder and an unidentified skier on a ski slope; the skier left the scene without providing information.

A 65-year-old Italian man driving a street sweeping vehicle on the Brenner Autobahn tipped the machine on its side after hitting a concrete barrier, sustaining injuries. The incident caused hours-long traffic disruptions.
Police discovered a marijuana plantation in Innsbruck during a routine inspection, resulting in the seizure of cannabis plants and equipment.
A 7-year-old boy was slightly injured after colliding with a car while crossing Trillergasse in Vienna; the child received medical attention and was released to his parents.
Military pyrotechnic device, identified as a smoke bomb, was found and safely removed in Vienna.

A 60-year-old man refusing to leave a friends apartment and behaving aggressively led to his arrest. The 28-year-old friend tried to intervene, attacking a police officer and causing minor injuries. Both were arrested and held in custody.
A 56-year-old Serbian woman convicted of drug trafficking in Serbia was arrested by the Vienna Criminal Investigation Department and taken to a correctional facility.
A truck hit a pedestrian crossing the road, resulting in the pedestrian being injured and taken to the hospital.
A fire broke out in an apartment in Klagenfurt, St. Peter district; two people were hospitalized for suspected smoke inhalation and the fire was extinguished without further injuries.
Two young women were injured in a car collision with a turning truck in Feldkirchen, causing total or severe vehicle damage.
A 14-year-old boy was injured after sledding off a run at Dreiländereck, Arnoldstein, and was rescued by emergency services.
A traffic accident occurred on the A10 in Spittal an der Drau, where a car collided with a stationary truck, causing severe injuries to the cars driver who was airlifted to a hospital.
A farmer fell through a rotten barn floor while replacing roof tiles and was injured in Sachsenburg.
A 22-year-old Serbian man threatened and attacked a policewoman in Krenglbach; he was arrested and detained.
An elderly woman in poor health was rescued from her apartment after falling, following concerns raised by relatives. She was taken to Braunau am Inn hospital.
An 82-year-old man collided with a parked semi-truck on a motorway exit and was injured, requiring rescue by firefighters.
A 30-year-old driver in Leonding was found without a license and showed signs of drug influence during a vehicle check but refused a clinical examination.

A truck with a trailer carrying 20 tons of wood chips skidded on a snowy road, with the trailer tipping over and blocking Bundesstraße 20. No injuries were reported, and the road was closed for several hours for vehicle recovery.
Police discovered counterfeit license plates and several hundred grams of marijuana during a search of a suspects apartment in Graz.
An 81-year-old woman accidentally drove her car through a drugstores window in Deutschlandsberg while parking, causing significant property damage but no injuries.
A traffic accident occurred involving a 74-year-old man and a 49-year-old woman, leading to the womans car overturning and her being injured.
A car caught fire while driving, but the driver and her daughter were able to escape safely and no one was injured. A bystander helped extinguish the fire before the fire department arrived.
A 25-year-old woman lost control of her car on a snowy road, colliding with another vehicle and injuring herself slightly. The other driver and her two children were unharmed.
A 43-year-old chimney sweeper in Gerlos fell from a roof while performing cleaning work, sustaining serious upper body injuries and was airlifted to a clinic.
A 33-year-old Slovakian caregiver allegedly stole cash and jewelry from a 91-year-old woman in Mariazell. She was arrested aboard a train at Wiener Neustadt, with the stolen items largely recovered.
A man threatened a shop employee with a knife in Vienna-Alsergrund, stole cash and goods, and was arrested the following day after being identified via security footage and a failed payment attempt.
Near-collision between a bus and an e-scooter in Feldkirch resulted in minor injury to a passenger when the bus driver performed a hard stop; the e-scooter rider fled the scene.
A man severely injured his finger and required partial amputation after an accident during refueling a vehicles equipment.
Attempted burglary at a vending stand in Gmünd; perpetrator caused damage but fled without loot.
Extension and enforcement of a protection zone in Grazs city park due to drug and public disturbance incidents.
A 19-year-old male driver collided head-on with a 40-year-old female driver on the Klagenfurter Schnellstraße near Maria Saal, resulting in the mans death and the womans severe injuries.
Burglars broke into a jewelry store in Feldkirch, smashing the entrance and shop window and stealing an unknown quantity of jewelry before fleeing.
A truck slid 15 meters down a steep slope in a forest, hitting a tree and preventing further descent; the driver was seriously injured and hospitalized.
Fatal apartment fire in Vienna; two elderly residents died despite rescue efforts.
A car collided with a motorcycle in St. Andrä, causing the motorcyclist to fall and sustain severe injuries.
An unknown suspect broke into a ground-floor apartment in Klagenfurt a.W. through the terrace door and stole several hundred euros in cash.
Workers foot was trapped between a package and a rail at a production facility in Lavanttal, causing severe injuries.
A 43-year-old man died after his car veered off the road and hit a tree, causing the vehicle to catch fire and burn completely.
A fatal traffic accident occurred in Zwettl where a car collided head-on with a truck, resulting in one death and one minor injury.
Two cars collided at an intersection in Karlstein an der Thaya after a driver failed to yield the right of way, resulting in serious injuries to one driver.

A 19-year-old woman driving under the influence had an accident in Piberbach, injuring a 16-year-old passenger on a trailer. Alcohol tests showed she and a 20-year-old man also involved were intoxicated, leading to license revocations.
A house in Salzburg-Parsch was broken into via a terrace door, with cufflinks stolen from a drawer.
Multiple injured in a traffic accident involving a car and motorcycle in Salzburg.
Collision between two cars in Maishofen, Salzburg resulted in injuries and significant damage.
A 46-year-old driver caused a rear-end collision in Henndorf am Wallersee, injuring the occupants and damaging both cars.
An 85-year-old woman who went missing was found unharmed but hypothermic after a search operation in Graz.
A car caught fire in Graz, causing injuries to a 74-year-old driver and minor damage to nearby property, firefighters extinguished the fire.
A wooden pillar in a basement at Graz Main Square began smoldering, causing smoke and odor due to heat from dehumidification work. No injuries reported.
A man was stopped in Innsbruck for a vehicle check, and cannabis was detected. Police searched his home and found larger amounts of cannabis, amphetamines, and cocaine residues.
A collision occurred between two skiers in Sölden, resulting in severe injuries to a woman, who was transported to the hospital by helicopter.
A skier was caught and buried by an avalanche in Sölden but was safely rescued by another guide and emergency services.
A 38-year-old Austrian fell approximately 9 meters while working on the roof of a single-family house in Waidring, sustaining severe injuries and requiring airlift to Salzburg hospital.
A 56-year-old man was arrested for attempting to steal items from a store using a modified backpack.
An apartment fire in Vienna resulted in the death of an 81-year-old tenant despite rescue attempts; investigations into the cause are ongoing.
A 23-year-old woman attacked random pedestrians, injuring six people, with one suffering severe injuries. She was heavily intoxicated and arrested.

A 32-year-old man in Klagenfurt was found lifeless by his partner; suspicion of drug consumption, heroin and cannabis cultivation found, along with several weapon-like items including a functional hand grenade.
A 40-year-old woman stole goods from a supermarket in Klagenfurt am Wörthersee by ordering items from the deli department and not paying for them at the checkout.
Two vehicles collided head-on while one attempted to overtake another; one driver sustained severe injuries and the other minor injuries.
A man in Lenzing was caught driving without a license and had been involved in multiple incidents including accidents and substance impairment.

A fire broke out in an uninhabited agricultural property in Unterweißenbach and quickly grew into a large blaze. The fire department managed to control the fire, and an investigation found no evidence of foul play.
A car accident occurred in Maishofen, injuring an 18-year-old driver and two passengers; the driver veered off the road and collided with a noise protection wall.
A cyclist fell and injured his hand while trying to avoid a car that abruptly braked and swerved due to an oncoming vehicle.
An 18-year-old woman was caught stealing branded perfumes worth over 300 Euros in Salzburg and was arrested after being stopped near the store by security personnel.
Fire broke out in a wood chip facility at a house in Unternberg, promptly managed without injuries.
A driver on the A9 in Austria was caught speeding at over 200 km/h and was found to be mildly intoxicated; his license was confiscated and he faces charges.
Fire broke out in a two-family houses basement, likely caused by a technical defect, with no injuries and damage of unknown value.
A wooden garden shed caught fire due to a technical defect in an electrical device, causing thousands of euros in damage but no injuries.
A car caught fire while driving in Haus im Ennstal; a police officer extinguished the fire preventing further damage.
Smoke and flames were discovered during a moving operation in Absam; firefighters controlled the fire that originated from a heat buildup in a light spot.
Unknown perpetrator released hydraulic oil valve at a public parking lot, spilling 400 liters and causing environmental damage in Pettneu am Arlberg.
Two cyclists collided during an overtaking maneuver in Innsbruck, resulting in injuries for both riders.
A man injured his finger while using a circular saw on a construction site in Nußdorf-Debant.
A car was broken into in a parking garage in Rum, and a wallet with cash was stolen.
Collision between a moped and a car at a traffic-controlled intersection in Höchst, Austria; the moped rider was injured and the car driver tested positive for alcohol.
A 58-year-old locksmith fell from a height of six meters on a construction site in Bezau, suffering severe back and ankle injuries, and was airlifted to a hospital.
Apartment fire caused by forgotten pot on stove; four injuries including burns and smoke inhalation, significant property damage.
Tools and machines were stolen from a construction site in Seiersberg-Pirka after a toolbox was broken into.
Three Austrian citizens stole headphones, a power bank, and beer crates in Reutte, causing a low four-digit euro loss.
A 31-year-old man died in a car accident after crashing into a bridge pillar in Wiener Neustadt.
Authorities resolved multiple thefts involving stolen license plates, trailers, bicycles, and party tents; suspects include two Czech nationals, one in custody in Prague.
A man in Salzburg was found asleep in his car with the motor running, measuring 1.82 promille alcohol; his license was confiscated and he faces charges.
A parked car started rolling and trapped a pedestrian between vehicles, causing injuries.
A 20-year-old woman was injured after her car overturned in Thannhausen, Bezirk Weiz, due to a maneuver to avoid a rabbit.
Fraudulent scheme in Tirol where sellers on online platforms were tricked into buying and sharing voucher codes for a fake transportation insurance.
