A man sank into loose soil in a gravel pit and was rescued by firefighters without injury.
A 23-year-old Moldovan man was arrested at the Suben border crossing with high-value watches suspected of being stolen.
A 63-year-old skier died in a skiing accident after colliding with trees and sliding down a slope at Großeck/Speiereck ski area in Salzburg.
A forest and meadow fire occurred in Bruck an der Mur; no injuries were reported, firefighting involved helicopters and multiple fire brigades.

Three individuals, two identified as 17-year-olds, broke into a gas station in Lienz, stole alcohol and cigarettes, and fled after triggering the alarm; two suspects have been identified and confessed.
A 27-year-old man broke into a construction container, vandalized a coffee machine, and stole coins and cigarettes before being apprehended by police.
A carpenter fell 6.60 meters from a roof structure under construction, sustaining injuries and was airlifted to the hospital.
A 59-year-old skier in Alpbach, Austria, attempted a jump, fell, and sustained a tibial plateau fracture, requiring helicopter transport and surgery.
A Dutch woman stole orange juice from a mall in Innsbruck, resisted apprehension with physical violence, and attempted to flee but was ultimately arrested.
A black compact car rear-ended a stationary vehicle in a tunnel, and the driver fled without providing information.
Head-on collision between a car and a light truck on L88 in Raggal causing injuries to car occupants and total vehicle damage.
Multiple scam calls by fake police officers occurred in Feldkirch area, deceiving victims about burglaries and inquiring about valuables.
A 40-year-old woman became violent towards police officers after a domestic dispute in St. Veit/Glan, leading to her temporary arrest.
Attempted car break-ins and damage to vehicles using stones and bottles; the perpetrator was apprehended.
Man jumped from second floor after seeing armed men at his door in Imst.
Two men were caught stealing clothes and tools; both were apprehended and confessed.
A collision between a 59-year-old female skier and a 78-year-old male skier occurred on a ski slope in Warth, resulting in severe injuries to the woman.
Car accident in Villach caused property damage; no injuries reported.
A 38-year-old worker was severely injured by a falling log in a sawmill in Hohenberg.
Shots were fired from a moving car in Wolfurt with a blank firing gun, no injuries reported.
COVID-19 cluster in Leiblachtal leads to strict exit controls, requiring a valid negative test, causing traffic disruptions.
Police arrested a Serbian man for selling cocaine in Vienna and seized drugs and cash during a related house search.
Altercation in tram where a man assaulted a woman reportedly out of jealousy; both were intoxicated and appeared to be under drug influence.
A man threatened another with a pipe wrench in a park demanding a phone but was apprehended by police after the victim escaped unharmed.
A worker fell from a ladder while cleaning windows, sustaining injuries.
Fire occurred in a metal laser cutting machine in Völkermarkt, with firefighters extinguishing the flames after workers failed attempts.
A farmer was injured while trying to milk a cow, which pushed him against a wall.
82-year-old man fell unconscious in bathroom, suffered burns from hot water, and was airlifted to hospital.
A 73-year-old man was fatally injured while removing a winch in a garage in Bezirk Steyr-Land, found by his daughter; resuscitation failed.
A 65-year-old man from Innsbruck Land district fell victim to online fraud involving financial promises, resulting in significant monetary losses.
A truck transporting food overturned on the L 197 highway near Lech, causing significant damage but no injuries.
A collision occurred between two vehicles on Faschinastraße resulting in injuries to one driver and significant property damage.
A 16-year-old attacked ÖBB staff at Hauptbahnhof during a ticket check and was apprehended after fleeing; no injuries were reported.
A 66-year-old man reportedly snatched a handbag from an 86-year-old woman in Vienna-Favoriten. Witnesses intervened, stopping the suspect until police arrived and arrested him.
Unexploded German grenade discovered in a field during agricultural work, safely removed by bomb disposal unit.
Fire broke out in a weekend house likely due to a technical defect; the owner extinguished it before the fire brigade arrived.
A forest fire broke out in steep terrain in Sachsenburg, requiring air and ground firefighting efforts.
A car accident in Bogenfeld resulted in two men being seriously injured, requiring emergency services to free the driver trapped in the vehicle.
Motorcycle and car collision occurred at an intersection in Ternitz, causing injuries to two people on the motorcycle.

A 77-year-old man without a valid driving license collided with a 47-year-old woman and her 2-year-old daughter on a crosswalk in Mistelbach; the mother was severely injured while her daughter sustained minor injuries.
A car driven by a 59-year-old woman collided head-on with another car driven by a 47-year-old woman, resulting in serious injuries to both drivers and a temporary road closure.
Two drivers without a license were stopped in Bezirk Gmunden, both showing signs of drug use and refusing further drug tests; one was caught again later with a small amount of cannabis.
A 48-year-old Bosnian citizen was arrested at the Suben border crossing on an international warrant for suspected insurance fraud.

A 26-year-old Slovak driver exhibited dangerous driving and pointed a realistic-looking gas pistol at another driver on the A1 highway, leading to his arrest in Leonding. A machete and the pistol were found in his car.
A 27-year-old male fell over 500 meters from the summit of Großer Priel during a training course and was subsequently carried further by an avalanche; he was later found deceased.
Traffic checks were conducted in Ilztal, Bezirk Weiz, involving inspections of heavy vehicles and speed measurements, leading to fines, license plate impoundments, and driving restrictions.
Police officer injured by a moped driver during a traffic control on Wechsel Straße B54; the driver fled the scene.
Garage fire in Graz caused unknown damage but left no injuries.
Avalanche occurred at Gamskogel in the Seckauer Alps, no injuries reported.
An Austrian skier triggered an avalanche in Silz/Kühtai but remained uninjured. He was partially buried but managed to free himself and was airlifted to the valley after losing a ski.
A 12-year-old boy was hit by a black car while riding his scooter in Tirol; the driver fled the scene.
A car caught fire on the Brenner Autobahn near Schönberg i.St.; firefighters extinguished it without injuries reported but caused traffic delays.
The police in Innsbruck announced the reissuance of protective zones at two locations to ensure the safety of children and youth.
Police stopped a vehicle in Rankweil and secured a blank gun; two men aged 21 and 24 are being questioned.
Several liters of disinfectant were stolen from a private garage in Klagenfurt district, causing financial loss to a local company.
A 52-year-old Austrian was targeted by a phishing email and unknowingly provided banking details, resulting in a four-figure sum being debited from his account.
A 36-year-old driver suspected of human trafficking was arrested during a routine vehicle check in Viennas Inner City; his three passengers lacked proper identification.
An elderly man fell in his bathroom, suffered severe burns from hot water, and later died in hospital.
Two suspected drug dealers were arrested in Vienna; drugs, cash, and falsified documents were seized.
Hazardous goods truck with safety violations was stopped on A2 in Laxenburg; 23 administrative offences were identified.
Two men were arrested in Grieskirchen for operating a cannabis production and distribution operation.
A truck driver went off the road in Linz, causing damage to the vehicle and environmental contamination from leaking diesel fuel.
Fire broke out in a residential house; residents were evacuated, and emergency services responded.
Police found people consuming cannabis and seized weapons and drugs during a party in Wörgl.
Unknown individuals broke into two newspaper vending machines and attempted to break into another in Innsbruck, stealing money and causing damage.
Fire broke out in a multi-family house in Niederndorf, no fatalities, one minor injury, extensive firefighting efforts.
Military supports police in COVID-19 deployment at border crossing in Vorarlberg.
Fire in a company building in Kühnsdorf involving insulation material and strong smoke development; likely caused by previous cutting torch work.
A man threatened his partner with a rifle and was arrested without resistance; no injuries occurred.

Marine diesel oil leaked during ship refueling on the Danube near Brigittenauer Bridge causing a 3 km oil film; the fire department contained it, and two individuals were charged for environmental negligence.
A man was caught attempting to break into two parked cars, smashing their windows and searching the interior. No items were stolen, and the suspect was arrested.
Unknown perpetrators vandalized a religious facility by painting its exterior facade with paint.
A 71-year-old man from Wolfsberg was scammed out of several hundred euros by an unknown person posing as a Ghanaian female online.
A 19-year-old was hospitalized after a drug overdose during a party; five individuals face drug-related charges.
Fire broke out in the first floor of a residential agricultural outbuilding; a woman attempted to extinguish it but failed, leading to a full deployment by ten fire departments.
A cow escaped from a meat processing plant in Vorchdorf, damaged several garden fences, and was later shot by a hunter at a stream.
In Koppl, Salzburg, a workshop fire caused by a model airplane battery explosion destroyed the workshop and damaged the facade; no injuries were reported.
A 24-year-old German driver lost control of his truck on a snowy road, causing it to slide and overturn down an embankment; the driver suffered unspecified injuries.
A fire broke out in a multi-family house in Niederndorf, likely caused by an electrical defect; one person sustained minor injuries during initial firefighting efforts.
A 57-year-old man fell 4 meters from a ladder in Kössen, sustaining severe head, arm, and rib injuries.
Fire broke out in a multi-family house in Niederndorf; one person sustained minor injuries during initial firefighting efforts, and damage assessment is ongoing.
A 71-year-old man attempted unauthorized entry at the Lustenau-Au border and injured an officer with his vehicle when refusing to comply with instructions.
A woman spat on police officers claiming she had HIV and Hepatitis-C; her companion attacked an officer during the arrest, both were detained.
Police investigated illegal gambling in Viennas city center and seized cash and poker equipment during a raid.
Police intervened at a prayer house in Vienna-Fünfhaus due to COVID-19 regulation violations; attendees displayed aggressive behavior and lacked safety measures like masks.
Man on e-scooter carrying cannabis and cash resisted arrest, assaulted police, and injured an officer in Vienna.
Police conducted vehicle inspections in Neusiedl am See targeting illegal modifications; multiple violations were detected and several vehicles were flagged for further checks.

A 21-year-old man under the influence of drugs attempted to break into a restaurant near the Justizanstalt in Klagenfurt. A Justizwache officer heard the noise, detained the man with another officer, and handed him over to the police. The man injured his hand during the attempt.
A wildfire in Rennweg am Katschberg caused damage to vegetation and structures, requiring extensive firefighting efforts including helicopters.
Police investigated two individuals for alleged Bitcoin investment fraud causing financial losses to clients in Austria.
A 58-year-old man lost his life in a motorcycle accident in Kaumberg, Lower Austria, after crashing into a concrete base due to excessive speed.
A traffic enforcement operation in Lower Austria led to numerous alcohol and drug-related offenses as well as other traffic violations.
Collision between a small truck and a car in Wiener Neudorf due to a medical incident; both drivers injured and hospitalized.
A car accident occurred involving a hit-and-run driver; three people sustained minor injuries.
Police conducted traffic checks in Haid, Oberösterreich, finding nine drivers under influence of drugs or alcohol, prohibiting them from driving.
Two unknown suspects fired a softgun from a vehicle at a group of teenagers in Linz, injuring a 14-year-old girl.
A female jogger was struck by a cars rearview mirror and injured; the driver fled the scene.
Two drivers were caught under the influence of alcohol in Neu-Anif and Eugendorf; licenses were confiscated.
Several male youths attacked four others in Mirabellgarten, Salzburg, causing minor injuries; one was hospitalized.
Three men died in a single-car accident on Lamprechtshausener Bundesstraße B 156 in Acharting.
A heavily intoxicated driver was stopped on the B 163 (Wagrainer Straße) in Flachau, showing a blood alcohol level of 1.76 ‰ and had their license confiscated.
A 30-year-old man was severely injured in a workplace accident involving a circular saw.
A 64-year-old man was seriously injured when a 1.5-ton road roller tipped over on his property, trapping his foot under the safety frame.
69-year-old man fell and sustained serious head injuries during a hike; was airlifted to hospital.
Fire broke out in an apartment building; one person hospitalized; fire controlled by several fire departments.
Teenagers caused significant damage to a snack vending machine at Bananensee in Schwoich, Austria.
Police responded to an alcohol-fueled altercation in Leutasch and discovered a CO2 revolver and ammunition, violating a gun ban.
A 16-year-old motorcyclist was hit and injured in a hit-and-run accident by a speeding driver in a dark VW Sharan on B 171 in Wörgl.
A garden shed fire spread to a nearby house in Schwaz; a family and their dog escaped unharmed but significant property damage occurred.
A 22-year-old drunk driver caused a traffic accident in Rum leading to four vehicles being damaged and one person injured.
Electric car caught fire repeatedly in a garage in Lustenau, requiring extensive firefighter operations and eventual submersion in water.
A fire started on a balcony in Göfis due to a candle in a flowerpot, causing significant damage to the balcony and house facade but no injuries.
Fire in an apartment above a farming building likely caused by an electric stove, leading to significant damage and injury to a female resident.
A man illegally disposed of waste at a riverbank and threatened a woman with potential coronavirus infection when confronted.
A jogger was hit by the side mirror of a car which fled the scene; the driver later reported to the police stating he thought he hit an animal.
A 36-year-old man attacked a driver with knives, causing injuries and later fled, injuring a pedestrian; he was eventually apprehended after resisting arrest.
A 79-year-old woman in Stattegg was scammed by fake police officers who stole cash and jewelry worth tens of thousands of euros.
Unknown perpetrators damaged a parked Mazda CX5 by bending its windshield wipers in Untertilliach, Austria.
Police conducted Covid regulation checks in two establishments in Koblach; violations included guests without valid tests and one falsified test document.
Excessive speeding on the A2 highway in Baden District, vehicle recorded at 232 km/h, 41 out of 1074 vehicles exceeded speed limits.
Unknown perpetrators broke into newspaper vending machines in Innsbruck stealing money and causing damage.
A suspect was arrested after breaking into a jewelry store, stealing 48 rings, and carrying a toy gun.
A small truck collided with a train at a railroad crossing in Herzogsdorf, resulting in injuries to the truck driver and train conductor.
A pool house in Hartl burned down completely despite fire department efforts; no injuries reported, but significant property damage occurred.
A garden hut caught fire in Voitsberg, threatening a nearby family home, but firefighters extinguished it without injuries.
Two men were arrested after damaging parked cars and behaving aggressively towards police.
A man attacked a police officer with multiple punches to the head and face; the officer sustained minor injuries thanks to a helmet. The attacker was arrested after applying physical force.
Two men suspected of attempting to break into a phone shop in Vienna by smashing its glass were arrested nearby after being disturbed during the act.
A seemingly intoxicated man threatened police officers during an open street operation and was arrested, no weapon was found.

A truck rolled downhill uncontrolled after the driver removed snow chains, came to rest on its side in a ditch after passing through a steep meadow and trees, causing total vehicle damage with no injuries.
An intoxicated man attacked police officers at a gas station in Sollenau, escalating the situation with aggressive behavior, damaging a police vehicle, and causing injuries to three officers.
A 20-year-old man fled from a police check in Linz, was found with marijuana, and injured an elderly man during his escape.
A 20-year-old unlicensed and intoxicated driver lost control of his car, striking a tree and ending up in a ditch.
A partial ceiling collapse in Molln injured five people as six individuals fell from the first floor while searching for an item on an old wooden barns attic due to the high load and weak structure.

A fire broke out in the attic of a residential building in Freinberg, causing significant damage to the attic and attic apartment. Firefighters quickly intervened to prevent harm to people and nearby properties.
A drunk driver with a blood alcohol content of 1.92 promille was stopped and had their license revoked on the A10 highway near Golling.
A 25-year-old man stole perfumes in a store, fled briefly, and was arrested. Authorities later discovered he was wanted for aggravated assault.

An 18-year-old provisional driving license holder lost control of his vehicle, resulting in a crash with injuries and property damage. The driver was under the influence of alcohol and a small amount of cannabis was found in the car.
A 66-year-old driver collided with a 27-year-old driver on Glocknerstraße; the older man was injured and taken to a hospital.
A fire broke out in a garden shed in Salzburg Elisabeth-Vorstadt, resulting in the discovery of a lifeless man whose identity is unknown; no evidence of foul play is suspected.
A supermarket security guard was slightly injured while detaining a shoplifter; a passerby intervened, allowing the shoplifter to escape.
Police intervened in a birthday party held despite COVID-19 restrictions, with attendees not maintaining social distance and consuming alcohol.

A balcony fire in Hall in Tirol spread into an apartment, leading to evacuation and firefighting efforts. There were no injuries, but one apartment was destroyed and two others were affected by smoke contamination.
A 27-year-old Austrian suffered a severe hand injury while working with firewood in Längenfeld and was airlifted to a hospital.
Fire broke out in a wood chip mill in Imst but was quickly extinguished by the fire department; no injuries reported.
Police in Tirol warn about fraudulent online shops selling health products against prepayment and advise caution in spotting fake websites.
Fire caused by a technical defect in a dryer in Hohenems; no injuries reported.
A grass fire on a roadside in Feldkirch was extinguished by the fire department; a cigarette butt might have caused it.
Police responded to a party in a private apartment and at a supermarket storage room in Vienna where Covid regulations were violated, resulting in multiple fines and one arrest for illegal stay.
Police patrolled the Donaukanal in Vienna to enforce Covid regulations, with one person reported for illegal alcohol sales.
A man broke a bike lock and fled with the stolen bike; he was pursued and arrested by the police and found in possession of drugs.
Police inspection in a bar led to multiple charges including breaches of the Covid regulations and problems with business licenses; illegal gambling and prostitution were not confirmed.

A police operation in Burgenland focused on alcohol, drug offenses, and traffic violations. Multiple drivers were found impaired by alcohol or drugs, and 8 kg of cannabis was seized from a vehicle in Neusiedl. Numerous penalties were issued.
An 81-year-old woman ran a red light in Villach, causing a collision that overturned another car, injuring two young women.
A 13-year-old girl on a bicycle was hit by a car in St. Stefan, and the driver fled the scene. The girl sustained injuries and was taken to the hospital.
An unidentified man pretending to be a fare inspector assaulted a bus driver in Klagenfurt and fled. The bus driver was injured.
A 20-year-old German womans car collided with an oncoming car while overtaking a tractor in Braunau, injuring both drivers and causing the tractor operator to flee the scene.
A dog in Linz ate a poisoned bait while walking, received timely veterinary care, and survived; remaining poison baits were secured.
Police dissolved two birthday parties violating Covid-19 measures in Sankt Peter am Wimberg and Niederwaldkirchen with 14 and 11 participants respectively.
A 14-year-old girl fell into the Danube River and was rescued by a 32-year-old man near Puchenau, suffering minor hypothermia.
Two skiers lost orientation in bad weather during a tour in Tennengebirge; rescued uninjured by emergency services.
A 25-year-old man threw a vodka bottle at a security guards head during an altercation at a gas station in Graz, causing a head injury.
Police stopped a vehicle with three men, discovering the driver lacked a license and the car was not registered. Cannabis and a weapon were also found.
A car driver lost control on a curve, the car overturned and caught fire; the injured driver was rescued by two first responders.
Motorcyclist and passenger seriously injured in collision with tractor while attempting to overtake in Graz-Umgebung.
Two hikers got stranded in rugged terrain near the Rote Wand and were rescued uninjured by a police helicopter and rescuers.
Police discovered a gathering of 11 people in a barn/garage in Radfeld violating COVID-19 regulations.
A 57-year-old in Tirol was defrauded of 1,300 euros on the sales platform willhaben.at when no delivery of silver coins occurred after advance payment.
A tenant assaulted his landlady with hand strikes and threatened her with a small kitchen knife over an electricity bill.
A farm building in St. Johann im Saggautal caught fire due to welding sparks, injuring three people with smoke inhalation and causing minor property damage.
An intoxicated driver collided with a concrete barrier at a toll station in St. Michael after consuming alcohol in Graz and driving without a valid license.
14-year-old drove a car without a license, taking the keys from his father for a joyride with friends; parents and authorities were involved.
Two men impersonating police officers conducted fake traffic and fever measurement checks in Außerfragant, raising suspicion.

A 49-year-old man was physically assaulted on a bike path in Traun after a verbal dispute over the use of the path, resulting in serious injuries. The perpetrator, a 23-year-old man, was later identified and admitted to the act.
A fire broke out in a garden hut in Salzburg, resulting in the death of a 50-year-old Ukrainian man due to smoke inhalation. No foul play is suspected.
A shed in Spittal an der Drau caught fire and was completely destroyed, but no people were harmed.
A man in Gmünd, Kärnten caused significant smoke in his apartment while cooking under the influence of alcohol; no injuries or damages occurred.
A 19-year-old drunk driver in Wolfsberg crashed a non-roadworthy car into a tree, injuring himself and four passengers and causing total vehicle damage.
A 17-year-old driver in Salzburg fled police, endangered pedestrians, collided with a police car, and was found with cannabis and no driving license.
A teenager reported being robbed of his mobile phone by two minors; the suspects were identified and the stolen phone was recovered.
Two men were caught breaking into newspaper cash boxes and arrested; small amount of money recovered.
An agricultural accident occurred when a trailer with calves detached and rolled into a house, causing significant damage and leading to the death of five calves.
A 61-year-old man allegedly shot his 50-year-old wife during a dispute in Maria Taferl, severely injuring her. The man reported the incident and was arrested without resistance.
A 33-year-old German woman operating a log splitter in Brandberg severed her right middle finger; she was airlifted to a clinic.
A tractor lost 8 liters of engine oil during a test drive in Lauterach, causing road contamination.
A dispute occurred where a man dropped suspected drugs and fled, followed by a shot fired from a gas pistol; drugs and a cartridge case were found at the scene.
A 41-year-old man in St. Andrä/L injured his hand with a table saw, nearly severing three fingers, and was flown to a hospital after receiving initial medical care.
A motorcyclist veered off the road in a curve and was injured, requiring airlift evacuation to the hospital.
A 34-year-old man fell off a mountain bike and broke his right leg, requiring airlift to a hospital.
Police responded to a suspected break-in which turned out to be a young man entering his girlfriends room through the window to avoid detection by her father.
Fire at a church in Linz involving a burning book and table, extinguished by firefighters and first responders; investigation ongoing.
An intoxicated motorcyclist without a proper license collided with a car, injuring a passenger.
Unauthorized gathering in Steyr violated COVID-19 regulations, with participants blocking roads and receiving police citations.
A linden tree was set on fire by an unknown perpetrator, requiring firefighters to extinguish and remove the tree.
A paraglider pilot crashed into a house facade and was injured after avoiding a power line during a flight.
Siblings stranded during snowy hike on Schneealpe, rescued by police helicopter.
Police discovered a cannabis cultivation setup with nine plants and cannabis material in a 21-year-old Austrians room in Lienz after he called for assistance.
Fire at Pestkapelle in Imst caused by burning plastic and wax, extinguished by firefighters with minor damage to the chapel wall.
A skier triggered an avalanche in Neustift im Stubaital, was completely buried, and later rescued and treated for injuries.
A 39-year-old Austrian cyclist fell and sustained injuries after hitting a water trench on a gravel path near Zirl, requiring helicopter transport to a clinic.
Motorcyclist injured in a collision with a car on B171 in Imst, Austria.
A fire alarm was triggered at a business park in Götzis due to smoke caused by the detonation of a pyrotechnic device.
Car collided with a cyclist at an intersection in Rankweil; cyclist injured, driver found to have high alcohol level.
A man shot his wife with a rifle in their home in Maria Taferl following an argument, causing serious injuries.
An intoxicated man threatened and attacked police officers in Schlosspark, Enns, leading to his arrest.

Police discovered 271 grams of cannabis and an indoor cultivation system following a domestic dispute. A suspect fled after assaulting an officer but was later apprehended. Additional drugs were found at another property.
A 12-year-old boy sledding in Damüls skidded off the track, falling down a slope and sustaining injuries; he was airlifted to the hospital.

A 15-year-old skier from Bregenz had an accident in the Mellau ski area, jumping from an unmarked area onto a piste and crashing into a building wall. He was airlifted to a hospital with unspecified injuries.

A 63-year-old man allegedly spat in the face of a cleaning woman at Wels train station after being asked to leave the elevator for not maintaining social distancing. Police detained him and ordered a COVID-19 test.
A group of skiers triggered an avalanche in Neustift im Stubaital that buried a 31-year-old man. Despite rescue efforts, the individual succumbed to injuries on April 6, 2021.
The Interior Ministry and Austrian Economic Chamber issued safety tips for seniors on secure money handling amid COVID-19 risks, emphasizing contactless methods and avoiding crowds.
A daughter-in-law noticed and extinguished a minor fire caused by a candle in her mother-in-laws house in Kronstorf.
Two Romanian individuals presented falsified documents during border controls in Suben.
A driver in Wörgl fled from police after refusing to stop his car, broke several traffic rules, and violated COVID-19 regulations.
A truck driver was severely injured on the head while opening the loading area of his truck in Klagenfurt.
Two Romanian men were arrested for stealing pallets from a construction site in Favoriten district.
23-year-old man allegedly hit and threatened to kill a 47-year-old woman in Vienna; he was arrested.
A 28-year-old Croatian man attacked police officers during an operation, was found with small amounts of suspected heroin, and threatened officers while in custody.
A Czech man was arrested in Vienna for allegedly tampering with newspaper vending machines and carrying stolen cash containers and tools.
A wooden forest hut burned down completely near Marzer Kogel in Pöttelsdorf, causing damage to nearby trees; firefighters extinguished the blaze by 03:30, with no injuries reported.
Man wanted under EU arrest warrant was detained, and another was found with a fake drivers license during a vehicle check on the A2 in Arnoldstein, Austria.
A heavily intoxicated driver in Klagenfurt resisted police stop, almost hit an officer, and was detained after refusing a breathalyzer test.

A head-on collision occurred on B 20 in Traisen involving two cars, causing injuries to both drivers; one driver was found to be driving an unregistered vehicle with stolen plates without a valid license.
A 38-year-old cyclist suffered fatal injuries in a bike accident on a steep downhill road in Stattegg, with a collision involving a tree despite wearing a helmet.
A tractor caught fire possibly due to a short circuit, completely destroying the vehicle. Firefighters prevented the flames from spreading to a nearby building.
A man acted aggressively towards police at a Lustenau gas station; pepper spray was used during his arrest for resisting authorities and other offenses.
A 250-year-old wooden building in Lesachtal burned down completely; no injuries were reported; fire cause under investigation.
A tree fell onto a power line during logging, causing a grass fire; no injuries reported.
A 19-year-old man fell into the cold Draufluss river but managed to climb back into his boat uninjured; emergency services were mobilized but stood down after confirming his safety.
A 73-year-old man accidentally caused a wildfire after using a lighter to modify a garden hose, burning 1.5 hectares of grassland before firefighters extinguished it.
A 76-year-old man injured his right hand with a circular saw while working on a farm in Feldkirchen and was taken to a hospital after initial medical care.
A 45-year-old worker was severely injured in a construction site accident on the A 4 near Schwechat when hit by a van in reverse.
A traffic accident occurred on the A1 in Loosdorf involving a truck and a small van; the driver of the van was injured and had to be rescued by the fire department.
A motorcyclist collided with a car while overtaking in Linz, sustaining severe injuries and requiring hospitalization.
A man fled police over train tracks in Wels, was caught, and found in possession of a CO2 pistol, heroin, and cannabis.
A forestry worker was injured when struck by a larch tree during logging operations in Ebensee, Gmunden district. He received medical assistance and was flown to the hospital.
A 56-year-old worker fell five meters from scaffolding during exterior plastering work in Münzkirchen, Schärding district, sustaining serious injuries.
A 21-year-old woman violated a restraining order in Zell am See, leading to her temporary arrest by the police.
A traffic accident involving two trucks and a van occurred on the A10 Tauernautobahn in Werfen, Salzburg, resulting in one injury.
A 14-year-old male threatened two females with a folding knife near the St. Johann im Pongau train station but was later apprehended by police.
An unknown perpetrator robbed a gas station in Salzburg using intimidation to obtain cash.
Two cars collided on B20 near Gußwerk, Bruck-Mürzzuschlag, causing serious injuries to both drivers.
A 35-year-old worker fell several meters from a girder on a construction site and sustained serious injuries.
Hazardous material spill of sodium chlorate at Kufstein train station controlled and safely contained without risk to public health.
Two skiers collided in Brunnalm, resulting in one being airlifted to a hospital with a suspected leg fracture while the other remained unharmed.
Police detected cannabis odor in an apartment, discovered an indoor plantation and drugs, arrested a 46-year-old Austrian man, and secured the substances.

A concrete mixer truck caught fire on the A12 near Zams due to a hydraulic system leak, causing oil to spray onto the hot engine, but the driver extinguished the fire. An oil spill was also caused along a 180-meter stretch.
A 54-year-old man was seriously injured while unloading iron parts using a truck-mounted crane in Lienz. He was struck by the crane and fell onto a gravel surface.

A fire broke out in a ventilation system in a company in Fulpmes during renovation work, possibly caused by sparks from a grinder. The fire was extinguished by local fire departments, and no one was injured.
A 6-year-old boy on roller skates was hit and severely injured by a delivery van in a pedestrian zone in Götzis.
Apartment fire in Dornbirn; children attempted firefighting before evacuating; no injuries reported.
A male driver tried to flee from a police vehicle check in Vienna, crashed into a house wall, abandoned the car, and was later caught. Drugs, a knuckle duster, and a dog were found in the car.

A car driver caused a series of incidents on the A 10 Tauernautobahn, including two accidents and driving on the wrong side of the road. The driver was later found deceased after a collision with a truck.
Cables of several barriers on the A12 Inntalautobahn were deliberately cut, causing damage worth several thousand euros.
A nurse in a nursing home in Kufstein was found working despite being tested positive for COVID-19. She initially resisted quarantine but later complied.
Two children, aged 5 and 7, collided while skiing in Hochötz; 5-year-old sustained a broken collarbone.
Two women were arrested in Vienna-Ottakring for suspected drug dealing, and police seized methamphetamine and cocaine during a house search.

Three fires were deliberately set in Kufstein, involving a paper container, a garbage container, and a portable toilet. Minimal damage occurred as the fires were quickly extinguished. Three suspects have been identified but deny involvement.
An unknown perpetrator stole a wallet with documents and a bank card from an office in Wr. Neudorf and tried to withdraw money with the card.

Two Romanian men were caught in a forest with 20 deer antlers and reported to the prosecutors office.
Car accident involving a man losing control, hitting trees, overturning, and being hospitalized with back injuries.
A skier collided with another skier, causing injuries, and left the scene in Thierbach ski area without providing details.
A 19-year-old woman fell from a rooftop in Innsbruck while attempting to smoke a cigarette, sustaining head and spinal injuries.
A collision occurred between two vehicles on L202 in Bregenz resulting in injuries to three individuals.
A fire broke out in an apartment in Lustenaus Vorachstraße; residents evacuated safely, and firefighters extinguished the flames.
A 56-year-old cyclist fell off a 15-meter slope in Göfis while riding an e-bike and was rescued by emergency services.
Collision between a car and a moped in Lauterach resulted in minor injuries to the driver and serious injuries to the passenger of the moped.
A car accident occurred on A5 in Wolkersdorf where a vehicle hit barriers, injuring the passenger and hospitalizing the driver.
A drunken argument among three Ukrainian truck drivers in Mondsee led to one man being severely injured after being struck with a hammer.
A Serbian man was caught with stolen goods, including straps and plates, on a parking lot; he admitted stealing them from his employer.

An intoxicated man without a drivers license took a relatives car without permission, drove recklessly at high speed, and crashed into a stone wall, resulting in minor injuries and total vehicle damage.
Teenagers took a car for an unauthorized drive, leading to a short police chase and their subsequent apprehension.
Two teenagers used a CO2 gun to damage property and injure a woman near Graz, Austria. Authorities identified and seized illegal weapons from the suspects.
A car crashed into a guardrail and plunged down a steep slope, resulting in serious injuries to the driver and moderate injuries to the passenger.
Fire broke out in a covered wood drying structure; six fire brigades controlled the blaze, preventing further damage.
An 88-year-old woman died following a fire in a residential building in Kufstein; 14 other residents were unharmed, and significant property damage occurred.
A resident in Innsbruck confronted an intruder in his building and later found that a neighboring apartment had been burgled.
A 25-year-old man from Steyr, driving under the influence with 1.36 per mille alcohol, veered off the road, collided with fences in Harmannsdorf, and caused minor injuries to his girlfriend.
A drunk driver crashed into a house wall in Herbstheim, Höhnhart, and was reported to the police.
Police discovered an illegal gambling operation in Vienna; multiple suspects were apprehended, illegal drugs were found, and fines were issued for Covid-19 regulation violations.
Passersby discovered what seemed to be human skull remains in a forest, but it turned out to be a realistic plastic skull model.
A 53-year-old man and his son accidentally set fire to a hedge during garden work with sparks from a tool. The fire destroyed an 18-meter hedge before being extinguished by the local fire department.
A 50-year-old man injured a 42-year-old man with a baseball bat during an altercation and damaged his car; the attacker also attempted to hit the victim with his car but was later arrested.
A man in Radenthein severely injured his thumb while using an axe-like tool to clean tree branches.
Seven speed cameras were vandalized along the B 34 with glass smashed using an unidentified object, causing significant damage.
A fire broke out in a companys woodchip heating system, causing major damage to the silo; intervention by fire brigades prevented the spread to the workshop.
A 16-year-old moped rider fell in Geinberg due to alcohol impairment and was injured, later taken to the hospital.

A 44-year-old man was involved in a single-vehicle accident in Pongau while driving under the influence with 1.68‰ blood alcohol content, and was injured but could leave the car, later transported to a hospital.
A 75-year-old driver caused a rear-end collision in Graz, severely injuring himself and lightly injuring two others.
A 61-year-old woman was injured in a room fire caused by lit candles that ignited a mattress in Graz. The fire was quickly extinguished by the fire department.
A ski mountaineer fell and injured his shoulder while descending during a tour, and was rescued by helicopter.

A fire broke out in the backyard bushes of an apartment building in Innsbruck, caused by a residents cigarette disposal. The fire was extinguished after about 30 minutes, and the resident will face charges for causing the fire.
A cyclist was injured in a collision with a car in Innsbruck. The car driver initially fled but was later stopped by the police.
Fire destroyed a multi-apartment building in Brixen im Thale, with no injuries reported.
72-year-old woman was injured in a bicycle collision; the other cyclist fled the scene without helping.
A highly intoxicated British driver led police on a high-speed chase in Vienna, endangering the public and colliding with a police vehicle before being arrested.
25-year-old driver without a valid license attempted to evade a traffic stop, driving towards an officer who avoided injury; later surrendered and was arrested.
A 21-year-old Syrian attempted to stab a 24-year-old Syrian during an altercation in Vienna, followed by the victim being assaulted later by the suspects family.
An 11-year-old boy from Vienna collided with a car while riding an e-scooter in Villach, ignoring right of way, and suffered serious injuries.
Fire broke out in an agricultural building in Eberstein; livestock was saved, a 14-year-old was hospitalized for smoke inhalation, and the fire was controlled by firefighters.
A 16-year-old skier from Vienna was injured in a fall at the Nassfeld ski area and was airlifted to a hospital.
A truck accident caused injuries and damaged other vehicles on the A1 West Highway in St. Valentin, Austria.
A car accident occurred involving a vehicle veering off the road, flipping over and injuring the cars driver and passenger.
A 60-year-old concrete balcony collapsed in Bezirk Vöcklabruck, causing a 3.5-meter fall; a woman died from injuries and others were heavily injured.
A 61-year-old man died in a car accident on the A 25 near Marchtrenk when his car skidded, overturned, and landed upside down. Despite first aid attempts, he was pronounced dead.
Driver on the A10 motorway showed signs of impairment; tests confirmed THC and cocaine. Driver refused medical examination and will be reported.
A 25-year-old man without a valid driving license was stopped by police in Werfen after a short pursuit during a traffic check.
A 20-year-old man in Graz resisted a ticket inspection, acted aggressively, injured an inspector, and was arrested by police.
Multiple break-ins occurred in garden sheds in Eisenerz and Vordernberg where tools, aluminum rims, and car tires were stolen.
An unknown offender broke into a tobacco shop in Seiersberg using power tools, caused a short circuit, and stole several cartons of cigarettes.
An intoxicated truck driver was stopped and found to have multiple administrative violations; his license was confiscated and further driving prohibited.
A fire in a fire bowl and fallen trees due to strong winds prompted firefighting efforts in Hopfgarten im Brixental.
Strong winds blew off a garden house metal roof in Jenbach causing no injuries but unknown property damage.
A snowmobile caught fire and was completely destroyed while traveling uphill on a ski slope. No injuries or danger to others were reported.
A 17-year-old rider fell from her horse and down steep terrain in Fendels, Austria, prompting a search operation. She was found and airlifted to a hospital with injuries of undetermined severity.

A pedestrian was struck by a motorcycle in Neumarkt an der Ybbs after standing in the road to confront the reckless rider. The pedestrian sustained serious injuries while the motorcyclist sustained minor injuries and initially left the scene but later returned.
A birthday celebration involving Romanian families in Bezirk Braunau escalated into a physical fight after a noise complaint was made, resulting in five people getting injured and hospitalized.
A forest fire affected approximately one hectare and was likely caused by a discarded cigarette.
A fire broke out on the balcony of a multi-family house in Brixen im Thale, completely damaging the building. No injuries reported.
Unknown individuals damaged a wooden bench and a painted sign at a tourist site by throwing the bench into the water and severely damaging the sign.
Multiple thefts, fraud cases, and extortion incidents occurred, leading to the identification and detention of three individuals in Carinthia.
A car driver turning left collided with an oncoming motorcyclist, causing injuries to the motorcyclist.
A man was injured in a workplace accident involving a forklift and a trailer in Vorchdorf, Austria.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a gas station in Sipbachzell, triggering the alarm. The property owner arrived with a gun, fired at a fleeing vehicle, but the suspects escaped.
Multiple car break-ins occurred in Innsbruck, targeting vehicles in underground garages and public parking areas, with valuables stolen.

Police responded to a noise complaint, encountered an intoxicated man and a group causing disturbance. A man fell out of a window, was injured, and hospitalized. Four individuals obstructed police, leading to a pepper spray-assisted arrest.
Two young women attempted a burglary in Favoriten, Vienna, resisted arrest, and tried to disarm an officer but were detained.
A man threatened his partner with a knife during an argument and fled but was later apprehended.
A man impersonating a police officer was caught trying to gain access to apartments, displayed aggressive behavior, and was arrested.
An intoxicated man with head injuries refused assistance, fled to the woods, resisted help, and caused disturbances at a hospital after a car driver found him on a road in Lasberg.
A fire broke out in the attic of a single-family house in Münzkirchen, heavily damaging the roof structure. Twelve fire brigades were deployed, no people or nearby objects were at risk.
A 29-year-old man in Traun was caught driving under the influence of drugs, carrying drug paraphernalia, stolen license plates, and a loaded CO2 gun, leading to a temporary weapons ban and charges.
A 23-year-old man was severely injured while working alone in his forest when a tree trunk moved and struck his right ankle.
A 15-year-old was assaulted and robbed of €50 at a tram stop in Innsbruck; a 13-year-old suspect was identified and detained.
Group of four teenagers broke into and stole cash from newspaper boxes in Innsbruck using a hammer; three were arrested shortly after.
Two Austrian teenagers were caught setting a disinfectant dispenser on fire at the Jenbach train stations mens restroom.
A 56-year-old cyclist collided with a car door opened by a 34-year-old man, resulting in serious hand injuries to the cyclist and minor damage to the car.
A 49-year-old German man fell about 5 meters while installing a safety railing in Walchsee, sustaining injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.
Multiple cellar break-ins occurred in residential buildings in Vorarlberg, with minor thefts of alcohol and bicycles reported.
An 88-year-old woman was critically injured in a collision with a car while crossing a street in Vienna, and the 45-year-old driver was unharmed.
Two men were arrested at U-Bahnstation Ottakring in Vienna for selling drugs.
Two men were arrested on suspicion of breaking into a basement compartment and possessing burglary tools and stolen goods.
An uprooted tree caused by strong winds fell onto a car on Drehtalbrücke; the driver was uninjured, but the car and guardrail were severely damaged.
Two 21-year-old men were injured in a car collision in Wolfsberg when another vehicle turned left into their path.
Truck made contact with railway power line in Feldkirchen causing a voltage surge and train service disruptions, no injuries.
A man handling what appeared to be firearms led to a police operation, but the weapons turned out to be soft air guns.
Gas leak in Linz due to construction work led to building evacuation; no injuries reported but high risk for residents and traffic.
Police in Upper Austria recovered a rented car that had been unlawfully withheld and planned to return it to its rightful owner.
Collision at an intersection in Neumarkt between a car and a moped left the moped driver injured and caused significant damage to both vehicles.
A 62-year-old man in Bad Gleichenberg was arrested by a special task force for making threats with a weapon on Facebook. Weapons, drugs, and prohibited images were seized during a house search.
Fire broke out in the basement of an empty local building; no injuries were reported.
Fake documents and an illegal weapon were discovered during a vehicle check in Premstätten, Austria; the driver was reported to the prosecutor.
A 39-year-old woman lost control of her car on the L-343 road near Hirschegg, hitting traffic signs before coming to a stop in a ditch and sustaining injuries of unspecified severity.
A sudden maneuver by a black VW Passat caused a multi-car collision, injuring a 19-year-old woman in Mötz, Tirol.
A 23-year-old man suffered a severe hand injury during drilling work in steep terrain and was hospitalized.
A 46-year-old Austrian man sustained severe arm injuries while cleaning a machine in Fügen after accidentally activating it; he was airlifted to a hospital.
Two young men attempted to break into a cafe in Wolfsberg, triggered an alarm, and were arrested with stolen items and drugs.
A 60-year-old man caused a forest fire by burning leaves, and he is reported to the authorities.
A grass fire affected 1500 m² due to an unknown cause, and the fire was extinguished.
A forest fire was likely caused by a cigarette and was put out by firefighters.
A 22-year-old driver hit a 16-year-old girl on a pedestrian crossing while momentarily distracted by changing glasses, causing injuries.
A man engaged in a distraction scheme at a pharmacy, stealing 100 euros during a transaction and subsequent return of a purchased item.
A cyclist was hit and injured by a car in Graz, and the driver fled the scene.

A fire broke out in the heating room of a farm in Metnitz due to hot ash but was extinguished by the farmers 72-year-old mother using a garden hose. No injuries were reported, but the damage is estimated at several thousand euros.
Two agricultural outbuildings caught fire in Wartberg/Krems, causing significant damage but no injuries. Firefighters prevented the fire from spreading to the main property.
A man attempted to stab another during an altercation and was later apprehended by police after fleeing the scene.
Driver caught speeding at 130 km/h in a 50 km/h zone during traffic enforcement in Vienna.
A 56-year-old man threatened supermarket employees with a screwdriver after refusing to wear a mask and was arrested shortly after fleeing.
A man injured his left thigh with a chainsaw while cutting a tree in a steep forest area near his home, requiring hospitalization.
A car accident occurred in Schwechat involving two vehicles, resulting in one person being injured and taken to the hospital.
Grass reignited after being extinguished by a property owner, causing a barn fire.
A cigarette caused a couch fire on a balcony, which was extinguished without injuries.
A construction vehicle caught fire due to a technical issue and caused damage.
A large forest fire involving helicopters occurred and required extensive firefighting.
A workshop fire caused by a tools spark resulted in a minor injury and substantial damage.
Police caught an 18-year-old driver and his passenger in Traun under the influence of cannabis after residents reported a disturbance; cannabis and drug paraphernalia were confiscated.
A 72-year-old mans use of a flame device to remove weeds caused a hedge fire that spread to a neighbors garage facade in Wels. The fire was quickly extinguished, and no one was injured.
A fire broke out in a pigsty in Traunleiten, killing animals but causing no human injuries.
A drunk driver hit a female cyclist, injuring her, fled the scene, and later admitted to the accident.
A 35-year-old farmer in Krottendorf bei Ligist, Austria, was injured in a tractor accident while working on steep terrain, resulting in head injuries.
A 25-year-old man sustained injuries while operating machinery on a steep meadow in Erlsberg, later transported to the hospital by helicopter.
A 50-year-old construction worker in Schladming fell 13 meters while removing masonry on a site, sustaining serious injuries.
Two 14-year-old suspects stole a womans handbag in Dornbirn, Austria, and later returned the stolen items to the police.
A collision occurred between a truck and a cyclist in Lauterach, resulting in the cyclist suffering minor leg injuries and her bicycle being destroyed.
Two youths attempted car theft and caused property damage in Mäder, including vandalizing vehicles and a window.
A 26-year-old man attacked a security staff member with a glass bottle and later resisted police, injuring an officer and making threats.
Police officers in Klagenfurt saved the life of a 59-year-old man by performing CPR until medical professionals arrived.
A conflict in Spittal/Drau escalated between a couple and four teenagers over social distancing, leading to physical altercations and property damage.
A fire broke out in the attic area of a house in Villach-Warmbad; no injuries were reported, and firefighters extinguished it.
An explosion and fire damaged a sandblasting machine at a business in Ferlach, causing significant material damage but no injuries.
A 41-year-old man was fatally injured while working on a production machine in Traiskirchen - Möllersdorf when he got stuck between a heavy metal container and the machine.
A 19-year-old Iraqi was arrested for allegedly injuring a 22-year-old Syrian with a knife during a brawl at Bahnhofsplatz in Wels.

A school bus with 16 students skidded off the road due to icy conditions and tipped into a ditch, injuring seven students lightly. The injured and the bus driver were taken to the hospital, and the bus was recovered with the help of cranes.
A 48-year-old worker fell into a cable shaft near a railway system in Bezirk Wels-Land while working on repairing concrete covers, suffering unspecified injuries.
A 56-year-old driver swerved to avoid an animal and crashed into a tree in Ligist, suffering serious leg injuries.
A car slid off the road and fell 40 meters down a slope; the driver was unharmed.
A car hit a 71-year-old woman in Imst, Austria causing severe injuries; she was taken to the hospital.
An armed robbery occurred at a tobacco shop in Salzburg where a 21-year-old threatened the shop owner with a knife, stole cash, and fled with an accomplice before being apprehended by the police.
A man under house arrest with an electronic monitoring device took unauthorized car trips, was pursued by police, and was eventually caught and admitted offenses.
Police officers broke a car window to rescue an unconscious man and performed life-saving measures until medics arrived.
Police arrested three individuals in Klagenfurt after a cigarette machine burglary, a car chase, and targeted shooting at a fleeing vehicles engine block. No injuries were reported.
A 65-year-old cyclist fell off his mountain bike after being overtaken by a truck and suffered a head injury due to not wearing a helmet.
A wooden hut in Pinsdorf caught fire, resulting in a full blaze, with no injuries reported; cause remains unknown.

In Vorarlberg, increased incidents of break-ins and thefts in cellar compartments of residential buildings have been reported since March 2020. Police urge vigilance and precautions like locking main doors and garage accesses.
Cloth soaked in oil caught fire inside a company vehicle, spreading to a toolbox and sawdust, but was extinguished by the fire department.
Smoke development in a school basement due to a pellet stove defect, leading to evacuation and no damages or injuries.
Two vehicles collided head-on in Poysdorf, Austria; one driver suffered severe injuries and had to be extracted from the vehicle.
A man broke into a store in Bad Ischl, stealing cash and cigarettes, and was arrested shortly afterward, leaving footprints in the snow. He was under the influence of alcohol.
A 50-year-old truck driver was injured during unloading work when the vehicle tipped over on a construction site.
Police arrested a 30-year-old man in Arthaberpark, finding 30 portions of cocaine, cannabis, cash, two mobile phones, and a firearm. The suspect is in custody.
A 58-year-old man died after losing control of his motorcycle, hitting a guardrail, and sustaining fatal injuries on the B14 road in Vienna.
A severe collision occurred on the A6 involving multiple trucks due to a traffic jam caused by border controls. One driver was seriously injured and airlifted to the hospital.
Car collided with a cyclist in Klagenfurt, injuring the cyclist severely.
A man lost control of his car on the Tauernautobahn, it flipped and slid on its roof; he was injured but managed to free himself.
A 45-year-old driver lost control in a curve, leaving the road and stopping in a field; he later died at the hospital.
A hedge fire in Trumau damaged a carport, garage, tractor, car, and various garden tools; fire extinguished by local fire departments.
A 27-year-old driver under the influence of alcohol lost control of his car and hit a guardrail on Leonfeldener Straße, suffering minor injuries.
Fire broke out in a waste disposal facility in Linz involving 60 tons of commercial waste; no injuries reported.
A cyclist was injured in a collision with a car at an intersection on a downhill road.
An 18-year-old driver fled from police in a high-speed chase, endangering others, before being stopped and arrested.
A kitchen fire caused by overheated oil was extinguished by firefighters; a 65-year-old woman was hospitalized for suspected smoke inhalation.
Collision between two cars in Sankt Andrä-Höch resulted in injuries to both drivers and significant vehicle damage; minor alcohol involvement noted.
A wildfire in Absams Halltal area spread rapidly due to dry conditions and wind, involving large vegetation areas; firefighters contained it by 01:00.

A fire broke out in an assisted living facility in Lienz. All residents were evacuated unharmed, and the fire was fully extinguished by the local fire department. Significant property damage occurred, and investigations into the cause are ongoing.
Police provide guidance on domestic violence awareness and encourage reporting during periods of quarantine and isolation.
A 35-year-old Bosnian man allegedly threatened an employee in a tobacconist shop and stole cash before being arrested with an accomplice nearby.
A man was caught attempting to break into lockers in a hotels employee changing room in Vienna; he was arrested by the police.
Three individuals were arrested during a traffic control in Vienna-Landstraße for suspected burglary and violation of a residence ban.
A 31-year-old man caused a car accident in Pörtschach under alcohol influence and without a valid license, resulting in total vehicle damage and two minor injuries.
A tractor and a car collided on a road in Feldkirchen, causing injury to the tractor driver and disruption to traffic.
A 19-year-old without a valid drivers license tried to escape police, lost control of his vehicle, and crashed into a field; he was apprehended along with his passenger.
A car collision occurred involving an 18-year-old and a 64-year-old in Ostermiething, causing injuries to the older driver and total damage to both vehicles.
A car driver collided with a vehicle and then with an oncoming truck in Edt bei Lambach, causing severe injuries to himself and injuries of unknown severity to his passenger.
A rear-end collision occurred on B168 in Piesendorf, causing minor injuries to two women and unspecified injuries to a young driver. Vehicles were towed and the road was cleaned by firefighters.
Workers hand crushed between roof structure and beam during construction in Lend.
A 52-year-old construction worker fell from a scaffold and sustained injuries to his head and arm in Graz.
A 68-year-old motorcyclist fell and was seriously injured after a risky overtaking maneuver by a moped driver, who fled the scene.

A 20-year-old man in Graz threatened police officers with a kitchen knife after being confronted about loud noise. The man, who was moderately intoxicated, surrendered immediately and was taken into custody.
A driver in Wörgl fled a police stop, injuring two officers as he drove off. His car was later found abandoned.

A 26-year-old woman under the influence of drugs, carrying her three children aged 6, 4, and 2 in the car, was stopped by police for unsafe driving; she admitted consuming drugs and was charged multiple times.
A 40-year-old cyclist was lightly injured in a hit-and-run accident when a car struck his arm and fled the scene.
An unidentified man attempted arson by throwing burning newspapers through a church window in Graz causing no injuries or fire.
Police found 41 violations regarding COVID-19 restrictions at an unauthorized event and issued reports for attendees who lacked proper face masks in vehicles.
Three suspects were identified in Vienna for graffiti vandalism on buildings, public transport, and private vehicles, causing extensive damage.
A drunk driver caused a wrong-way accident on the A2 highway in Guntramsdorf; no injuries but severe vehicle damage occurred.
A physical altercation occurred between a truck driver and a bus driver over parking issues in Hartkirchen.

A greenhouse caught fire in Laakirchen, likely caused by a frost protection candle. Firefighters quickly extinguished the fire, with total damage to the greenhouse and minor damage to nearby property.
A car and truck collided on A 1 highway; no injuries reported.
A family of ducks was rescued from a residential area in Vienna and safely relocated to their natural habitat at Wienerberg Pond.
A fire broke out in a residential building in St. Kanzian am Klopeinersee, severely damaging the upper parts of the building. No injuries were reported as all residents evacuated safely.

Two slope fires occurred near the Lienz-Spittal/Drau railway line and Kleblach/Lind station, affecting 150m² and 2000m² areas respectively, causing temporary rail traffic interruptions; both were extinguished by fire brigades.
A 15-year-old without a driving license lost control of a moped during a test ride on a field path in Kirchbach and collided with a railway underpass wall, suffering injuries.
A 32-year-old man damaged a wayside shrine in Klagenfurt-Viktring and behaved aggressively towards police when confronted.
A driver was caught speeding at 156 km/h in a 100 km/h zone on the B 2 in Horn, Austria, and was reported to the local authorities.
A 41-year-old truck driver was fatally injured while attempting to prepare a trailer on a sloped gravel path, becoming trapped between the truck and trailer.
A 65-year-old man collided with an oncoming car while attempting to overtake on Eferdinger Straße, causing injuries to both drivers.
A woman was injured on her lower leg by a chainsaw while helping her partner fell trees in a forest.
A dispute between a truck driver and a bus driver in Hartkirchen escalated into a physical altercation, with reports of spitting and one person being hit in the face.
A domestic dispute in Salzburg-Maxglan escalated, involving a man assaulting his girlfriend and the woman breaking a glass door panel. Police issued a restraining order.
A paper waste bin burned in Salzburg, suspected arson, but was extinguished quickly without major damage.
Prepared Easter fire illegally ignited in Birkfeld; firefighters extinguished it and assessed damage.
A forest fire burned 500 m² in steep alpine terrain at 1,370 meters elevation, involving about 100 firefighters and two police helicopters; no injuries reported.
Three people injured in a collision between a moped rider and a cyclist; a second moped rider also crashed while avoiding the accident.
A 35-year-old Czech woman fell on a hiking trail in Mayrhofen and slid approximately 5 meters over rough terrain. She was rescued by mountain rescue and suffered a left ankle injury.
A German driver collided with a Slovak truck driver on the Inntalautobahn near Terfens, resulting in injuries for both.

A 7-year-old cyclist collided with an elderly cyclist on Achweg in Bregenz, causing the child to suffer serious hand injuries, while the other cyclist left the scene without providing contact details.
A 78-year-old man suffered a fatal heart attack while swimming in the Alter Rhein in Lustenau.
Police responded to loud party noise in Vienna-Favoriten, finding six men, illegal gambling machines, and suspected cocaine.
Man resisted police during routine check, attempted to attack an officer but was arrested without injuries.
A 16-year-old girl armed with a knife caused a disturbance in a residential home in Vienna; police subdued her using a taser, and she was taken to a hospital for further treatment.
A man overturned his car after colliding with a concrete barrier on Kärntner Straße in Villach; he was moderately intoxicated.
A fire in Arriach destroyed a residential house and caused damages exceeding 500,000 Euros; no injuries reported.
A motorcyclist attempting to overtake another vehicle collided head-on with an oncoming car, sustaining severe injuries. The car driver was unharmed and the overtaken vehicle left the scene.
A 61-year-old skier fell and injured her knee during a descent near the Falkert summit and was airlifted to a hospital.
Man was caught driving at 168 km/h in a 70 km/h zone; his drivers license was temporarily revoked.
A 57-year-old driver in Steyr-Land was harassed by two cars on the road, followed home, and confronted verbally; police later identified the involved individuals.
A 15-year-old moped rider in Mattighofen fled the police and crashed into a ditch after attempting to escape through a meadow. He had no valid license and faced charges for various violations.
A 77-year-old man was injured during a ski tour in Gosau and required rescue by helicopter after a fall.
A garbage bin fire near a bus stop in Salzburg was extinguished by the fire department; investigations are ongoing.
Speeding violations and alcohol-related driving incidents were recorded in Salzburg and Pongau, including drivers surpassing speed limits and driving under the influence.
A 26-year-old driver lost control of his car due to excessive speed, causing it to overturn and land on its roof. He sustained injuries and was airlifted to hospital.
A motorcyclist was seriously injured after falling due to a car overtaking in Obdach, with the car driver remaining unidentified.
Two vehicles collided head-on in Eggersdorf causing injuries to both drivers.
A 40-year-old Austrian dangerously drove a car without a license plate at high speed through Kufstein, ignoring police attempts to stop him.
Unknown perpetrators vandalized a kiosk in a swimming pool area in Haiming, breaking windows, glass doors, and damaging equipment.
A German man was injured during paragliding practice in Aschau after being caught by a gust of wind and hitting a fence post, sustaining serious leg injuries.
Missing 25-year-old man with health issues found safe but exhausted after a large search operation in Ranggen.
A cigarette butt caused a balcony fire in Obsteig, damaging the wooden railing and roof; no injuries occurred.
A fire broke out in the heating room of a residential building in Thüringen; no injuries were reported, and the suspected cause is a technical defect.
A wildfire in steep terrain in Frantschach - St. Gertraud was extinguished by firefighters; the cause is still unknown.
A 22-year-old Sudanese man was arrested in Vienna for suspected drug dealing; heroin and two phones were seized.

Two suspects, a 19-year-old man and woman, set fire to a plexiglass panel in a waiting area at the Bad Vöslau train station causing significant damage. No injuries were reported. They admitted to committing the arson out of boredom.
A man suspected of robbing a woman in January was arrested after being stopped for vehicle damage, thanks to police investigations and a warrant.
Police provided safety and hygiene guidelines for visiting Easter markets during the pandemic.
Two trucks collided on B 320 in Radstadt, injuring three people and significantly damaging the vehicles.
A 46-year-old man in Salzburg was reported for attaching fake license plates to a vehicle.
A 34-year-old man was caught attempting a break-in and found with a softgun and a wooden baton; he was arrested in Linz.
A 32-year-old man fell five meters while preparing roof work on a construction site in Mittersill.
In Salzburg, a man pushed his girlfriend after an argument, slightly injuring her, and threatened the police with a knife leading to his arrest.
An 85-year-old driver in Birkfeld lost control of his car, crashed into a house, causing injuries and significant property damage.
Roof fire in a multi-family house in Laimach, Austria; no injuries reported, investigation ongoing.

A 24-year-old man allegedly pushed an elderly woman in a residential area in Vienna, stole her handbag, and was later apprehended after fleeing and hiding. The victim was hospitalized with suspected bruises and abrasions.
An intoxicated man spat on a grocery store employee after being asked to wear a mask, claiming to be COVID-19 positive. He was temporarily arrested nearby.
Car was caught speeding at 109 km/h in a 30 km/h zone in Vienna-Meidling; driver faces license suspension.
An offering box in a church in Eisenstadt was broken into between 14:00 and 15:00, and a small amount of money was stolen.
A reed roof caught fire in Weiden am See, suspected due to sparks, with no immediate danger to people or animals.
Two drivers were caught excessively speeding on the A21 and A2 highways, one with a blood alcohol level of 2.26‰. Licenses were revoked and both were reported.
A 19-year-old driver under suspected drug influence was stopped by police, refused drug testing, had his license and keys confiscated, and faced charges along with passengers.
A tractor accident occurred in Rodatal, Steinbach an der Steyr, leaving a 51-year-old man seriously injured and a 14-year-old with minor injuries. The driver had a blood alcohol content of 1.34‰.
A Bulgarian truck driver was caught with fake Belgian license plates and no valid driving license at the Suben border crossing in Austria.
A 24-year-old driver attempted an illegal overtake on the Wiener Bundesstraße, resulting in a head-on collision with another car, causing two fatalities and one severe injury.
A significant rockfall occurred in an alpine area near Michaelerberg-Pruggern; no injuries were reported, and the area was closed off.
A fire broke out in a Graz apartment due to newspapers on a lit stove; one person was injured and transported to the hospital.
Fire broke out in a forest near Schlossberg in Graz, extinguished without injuries.
A fire broke out in the staircase of an apartment building but no injuries were reported.
Multiple fires broke out along a railway embankment in Fieberbrunn, possibly due to sparks from a freight train, causing property damage but no injuries.
A fire broke out during welding work on the wooden substructure of a solar system in a single-family house in Wattens, but it was extinguished by multiple fire brigades.
A 56-year-old pedestrian was seriously injured in a collision with a truck driver at a crosswalk in Innsbruck.
A young child was seriously injured in a collision with an unidentified cyclist who did not stop to help in Lochau.
Police arrested a 19-year-old suspect after an attempted bicycle theft in Vienna where three individuals fled; pepper sprays were found on the suspect.
A man threatened three teenagers with a knife at a gas station in Vienna; was apprehended with knives, drugs, and high alcohol levels.
A driver was arrested in Vienna for drug impairment, possessing stolen driving licenses, illegal weapons, and driving a car with misappropriated license plates.
A 23-year-old man was injured while working with a chainsaw in a forest in Eberndorf, transported to Klagenfurt hospital by rescue helicopter.

Hit-and-run accident on Völkermarkter Straße, Klagenfurt; a speeding white car caused a collision with a 20-year-old womans car, leading it to crash with an oncoming van. Both vehicles sustained significant damage, and two people were injured.
A man operating a mini-excavator on his private property tipped into a trench and was injured; he was rescued and airlifted to a hospital.
A 47-year-old man was injured while using a chainsaw on a spruce trunk in a forest in Ludmannsdorf, Klagenfurt district.
Three hikers were rescued from an alpine emergency in the Rax mountains after becoming trapped in a steep snowy ravine; a police helicopter located and airlifted them, and they were unharmed.
A 59-year-old motorcyclist collided with a small truck on the LB 4 in Pernegg, resulting in severe injuries. The road was closed temporarily.
A 45-year-old man fell 150 meters during a ski tour in Puchberg am Schneeberg, sustaining severe injuries and was rescued by mountain rescue and air ambulance.
A 62-year-old man fell about 3 meters while cleaning a winter garden and was airlifted to a hospital with injuries.
A 31-year-old Polish truck driver was arrested for aggressive behavior and high blood alcohol level during a police control in Linz-Land. He was later released.
A man stole an 18-year-old womans phone in Linz after borrowing it under the pretense of making a call and fled the scene.
A trailer tipped over while turning and collided with an oncoming car, injuring the car driver.
A cyclist in Linz was punched in the head by an unknown man during a confrontation; three suspects were detained but denied involvement.
A 36-year-old man in Riedenburg, Salzburg threatened another man with a knife but no one was injured.
A 15-year-old moped rider and his passenger were injured in an accident involving a tractor; the moped collided with the tractors trailer.
A motorcycle collided with a car when the car turned left; the motorcyclist was injured and hospitalized.
A 53-year-old man suspected of threatening family members and escaping from a Graz institution was arrested in Steyr after being recognized by a passerby.
Two Romanian women were arrested in Graz for stealing from an 82-year-old man after being invited into his apartment.

A 78-year-old woman fell and suffered serious shoulder injuries during a parking incident involving a 21-year-old driver in Graz. No alcohol was involved, and the incident details are under investigation.
A man broke into a house in Innsbruck, fled after being approached by police, but was caught and arrested. Both the suspect and two officers sustained injuries.
Police conducted controls at a house party in Leutasch where 25-30 people ignored Covid-19 measures and drugs were seized.
A 49-year-old intoxicated driver hit a police officer who was conducting vehicle checks, fled the scene, and was later arrested after a pursuit.
A 74-year-old man was critically injured by a falling tree while working in Hopfgarten im BrT, requiring emergency medical evacuation.
A hay load on a trailer caught fire in the Landecker Tunnel, causing minor injuries to the driver during firefighting efforts.
A 27-year-old skier fell 300 meters on a snow-covered ice slope at the Juppenspitze in Schröcken and was airlifted to the hospital with injuries.

A car collision occurred in Klagenfurt where a white car caused a 20-year-olds vehicle to swerve into oncoming traffic, resulting in another collision. The driver of the white car fled the scene but was later identified.
A car was caught speeding at 224 km/h on A2 highway near Wr. Neustadt, exceeding the limit of 130 km/h. Driver will be reported to authorities.
A paraglider crashed after one side of the canopy folded, leaving him stuck unharmed in a tree and later rescued by mountain rescue personnel nearby.
A collision between a motorcycle and a small truck resulted in severe injuries to the motorcyclist, who later died in the hospital.
A driver on the A10-Tauernautobahn near Reittunnel was stopped for erratic driving and found to have a blood alcohol level of 1.12%. The drivers license was confiscated and they will face charges.

A 59-year-old Austrian man driving west on the Inntal Autobahn near Wörgl veered off the road and crashed into an overpass portal, suffering minor facial injuries; his car sustained significant damage.
Unidentified individuals vandalized buildings and noise barriers at Volders-Baumkirchen station with graffiti, causing damage worth a mid-four-figure euro amount.
A head-on collision occurred in Salzburg on the B1 when a car driver attempted an illegal overtaking of a truck, resulting in the deaths of the car driver and a passenger in the oncoming minivan.
An unknown perpetrator broke into an educational institution in Lienz, forced open several doors, and stole a moderate three-digit euro amount.
A conflict between neighbors escalated into a physical altercation involving eight people, resulting in injuries and threats.
A stork was killed in a traffic accident involving a van in Bad Leonfelden, causing damage to the vehicles front.
Two youths set fire to paper bins in Linz-Urfahr, causing significant damage to a building facade and interior due to smoke; they were arrested by police.
A fire broke out in a wood processing company hall in Preding, causing property damage but no injuries. Firefighters intervened and investigations are ongoing.
A wooden hut near a forest in Stadl-Predlitz burned down completely; no one was injured. Firefighters prevented the flames from spreading to the forest. The cause is under investigation.
A Serbian man in Innsbruck was arrested for using forged documents to commit fraud.
Police disrupted an apartment party violating Covid regulations, issuing numerous fines, with some partygoers attempting to flee via the roof.
A 19-year-old man lost control of his vehicle on the B 100 in Gemeinde Irschen, causing it to overturn; he tested positive for alcohol and lacked a valid driving license.
A 38-year-old Slovenian man caused a hit-and-run collision in Ferlach, later crashing into various objects, including a rock wall, until he was apprehended by police.

A 51-year-old man fell during a hike on Höllenberg, resulting in a branch piercing his arm. He managed to partially remove it and walk home before alerting rescue services. He was transported to the hospital by helicopter.
A 51-year-old man injured his left hand while cutting tree branches with a chainsaw in his garden in Velden/WS, severing two fingers. He was airlifted to a hospital.
A fire destroyed a farm outbuilding in Neuhofen/Ybbs, suspected to be caused by an electrical short circuit. No injuries were reported.
A 23-year-old man intentionally crashed his car into four parked vehicles at a company parking lot in Bezirk Linz-Land due to unrequited love.
17-year-old driver caught using license plates from another vehicle; plates removed and reported.
Multiple fire spots discovered in a forest near Bürmooser See; origin suspected to be discarded cigarettes or small campfires.
An intoxicated 43-year-old man was temporarily arrested in Thal for exhibiting aggressive behavior and attacking police officers.
A 52-year-old man from Graz fell off his bike without external influence on Rinneggerstraße and was seriously injured; he was airlifted to a hospital.
