A 33-year-old man fell to his death while descending Hochtausing mountain after slipping and tumbling approximately 100 meters, despite being properly equipped and experienced.
Fire broke out in a hobby room in a multi-apartment building, possibly caused by an e-bike battery; no injuries reported.
A 71-year-old man caused a traffic accident on a roadway in Holzgau, Tirol by gesturing with a shovel in protest, leading to two motorcyclists crashing and sustaining minor injuries.
A 51-year-old Austrian accidentally caused a fire during flame works on a house extension, resulting in damage to a nearby meadow and a wooden garden fence.

A 42-year-old man allegedly shot at a house in Hohenems, damaging its roof. Police found firearms and ammunition at his residence, enforced a weapons ban, and hospitalized him for psychological evaluation.
A couple allegedly damaged a car and threatened the owner with a knife; they were later identified and reported to the authorities.
Driver evaded police, caused an accident, and falsely reported a stolen vehicle before admitting responsibility.
A driver was caught speeding at 138 km/h in a 70 km/h zone on the B10 near Parndorf and was informed of legal action.

A registered demonstration in Eisenstadt involving around 40 participants protested against lockdown measures and COVID-19 legislation; no incidents occurred, but three administrative charges were filed for non-compliance with safety measures.
A fire alarm was caused by a pot on a stove in an unoccupied house; no injuries occurred.
A man fell 50 meters down a slope in Linz and was rescued by emergency services after his cries for help were heard by construction workers.
A 24-year-old woman swerved to avoid a deer and rolled her car twice in Mining, sustaining minor injuries.
A 17-year-old cyclist collided with a car on a curve in Langfeldstraße, causing injuries and requiring hospitalization.
A collision occurred between a car and a motorcycle in Bezirk Ried, leading to injuries for the motorcycle rider and his passenger.
Police broke up a techno party in Goldwörth finding drug use and violations of Covid regulations with 12 people involved.
A 16-year-old moped rider lost balance, hit a curb, and collided with a house wall, requiring hospitalization.
A paper container was completely destroyed by fire in Salzburg; no one was injured.
A motor trike accident occurred in Adnet, Salzburg, injuring the driver and passenger.
A fire destroyed a carport, vehicles, and parts of a house and garden structures in Deutschlandsberg; no injuries reported.
A 63-year-old motorcyclist in Feldbach suffered life-threatening injuries after being pushed by a gust of wind into a guardrail and falling off his motorcycle.
A 45-year-old man fell off his e-bike due to road damage, sustaining head and hand injuries.
A Ukrainian man caused a hit-and-run traffic accident under the influence of alcohol, crashing into a wall and getting stopped by a neighbor who prevented further danger.
A 71-year-old Austrian man suffered severe leg injuries after a self-driving work vehicle moved independently and ran over his left foot. He was airlifted to a hospital after emergency assistance.
Collision occurred in the Ambergtunnel involving three cars due to a misunderstanding of a traffic regulation, causing injuries to two drivers.
A smoldering fire occurred in a pool area in Dornbirn, likely caused by a technical defect, resulting in significant property damage but no injuries.
A car and a residential property in Roitham am Traunfall were set on fire, with no injuries reported; arson is suspected.
A 24-year-old man stabbed a 27-year-old woman in a random encounter in Hard, while slightly intoxicated and under the influence of drugs, citing frustration as his motive.
A man broke into a supermarket in Drasenhofen, stealing alcohol and juice, and was arrested intoxicated after police investigations and a tip from the public.
Two juveniles broke into construction containers in Maishofen, stole money, and caused damage.
Unknown perpetrators vandalized sculptures with paint in a sculpture park, causing significant financial damage.
A cat was wounded by gunfire, presumably by a shotgun, in Lieserbrücke, Seeboden. The shooter remains unidentified.
Unknown suspects broke into a food truck and a restaurant in Groß-Enzersdorf, damaged property, and caused a total damage of about 7,000 euros.
Police uncovered a series of ATM thefts and arson incidents conducted by a professional criminal group involving stolen vehicles and other criminal activities.
An 18-year-old driver caused a traffic accident in Utzenaich after hitting a streetlight and a decorative stone due to drunk driving; his car flipped over and was totaled.
A fire broke out early morning in a building in Lieboch causing significant property damage but no injuries.
An intoxicated man resisted arrest in Graz, injuring an officer and damaging equipment before being detained with additional police support.
A forest fire occurred in Bregenz, allegedly caused by a discarded cigarette, affecting 100 square meters of forest; it was extinguished by fire services.
A 29-year-old man evading a police check was apprehended and arrested due to an active warrant for intentional grievous bodily harm.
A man in Villach rescued his neighbor from a smoky apartment caused by a fire in the kitchen and extinguished it with a fire extinguisher.
A 17-year-old driver swerved to avoid a rabbit, causing their car to crash into a forest; both occupants were injured and hospitalized.
A man robbed a gas station in Salzburg, threatening an employee and fleeing on foot with an unknown amount of money.
A car collided with a cyclist on Kaufmannstraße in Innsbruck, causing severe facial injuries to the cyclist who was hospitalized. The driver was uninjured.
A 32-year-old Austrian man crashed his car into a stone wall in Stans, sustaining fatal injuries.
A 32-year-old Austrian lost control of his car on the Unterinntal Landesstraße in Stans, hitting a stone wall and sustaining severe injuries.
A cyclist disobeyed a red light, was hit by a car, and sustained minor injuries.
A house fire likely caused by a cigarette resulted in the death of an 87-year-old man.

A motorcyclist in Vienna evaded a traffic stop, running multiple red lights and speeding before being apprehended at a gas station. The individual had no valid license, and the motorcycle had stolen plates.
A six-year-old child accidentally caused a fire in a garden hut in St. Veit/Glan, which was extinguished by firefighters without injuries.
A tractor caught fire due to a technical defect in Friesach, with no injuries reported and the fire extinguished by local fire brigades.
A 63-year-old woman fell from her bike on the Krappfeld Straße in St. Donat, suffered severe head injuries, and was airlifted to the hospital.
Two hikers from Vienna became stranded on Rax near Brandschneid due to fatigue and inadequate equipment. They were rescued by the police helicopter after issuing an alpine distress call.
An 84-year-old woman and a 58-year-old man were involved in a collision on LB 30 near Raabs an der Thaya; the man was under the influence of alcohol, and both drivers sustained minor injuries.
A 52-year-old man was assaulted by his 37-year-old neighbor with punches and kicks, leading to the suspects arrest in Bezirk Wels-Land.
A drunk woman with a child caused a car accident, hitting a wall, a fence, and landing in a ditch; no injuries reported.
A 22-year-old motorcyclist lost control on a curve, crashed in a field, and later succumbed to injuries.
A 69-year-old cyclist was fatally injured after a collision with a car at an intersection in Sattledt, Austria.
A 32-year-old woman injured her ankle during a hike on the Bleckwand mountain descent in Strobl and was rescued by mountain rescue and police.
Two cyclists collided on Austraße in St. Michael causing injuries, both were taken to the hospital after receiving medical attention.
Two men broke into a pharmacy in Frohnleiten, stole medication, and were arrested at the train station after a witness reported the crime.
A 22-year-old Russian fired a blank shot to end a dispute between a Romanian woman and a Somali man over allegedly stolen mobile phones in Graz.
Two women on a small motorcycle had an accident; one was severely injured and the rider was slightly intoxicated.
A man discovered a World War II grenade near a forest road; it was secured and disposed of by bomb disposal experts.
Unknown perpetrators set a compost pile on fire in a garden, causing damage to a fence and nearby trees.

A 19-year-old caused a car accident in Reutte, damaging a car and a streetlight. While under examination for substance influence, the car owner drove the vehicle, causing two additional accidents, including crashing into a wall. No injuries but significant property damage occurred.
A 57-year-old man in Volders suffered severe head injuries after losing control of his unregistered motorcycle, falling, and sliding into a field without protective gear.
A tractor and trailer overturned on a steep field in Vals, injuring a 51-year-old Austrian man who was flown to the hospital for treatment.
A German cyclist was severely injured in Innsbruck after colliding with a concrete barrier during an attempt to ride over a hill.
An 81-year-old cyclist fell on the Neubaustraße, causing a severe head injury and was airlifted to the hospital.
A woman identified a suspect in connection to a robbery where she was physically attacked and robbed in her apartment; two individuals were arrested.
An armed man robbed a store in Vienna-Floridsdorf using a black revolver and fled with cash; police call for witnesses.

Two Polish men reportedly conducted shooting exercises with a CO2 gas pistol in a public area and were intoxicated. Police intervened, seized the weapon, and imposed multiple charges and a temporary weapon ban.
Two 17-year-olds were apprehended in Vienna after attempting to flee police; one resisted with physical aggression, while drugs and a weapon were seized.
A wind turbine caught fire in Gols, Neusiedl am See district, possibly due to a generator issue, and the fire department let it burn under control.
An unknown perpetrator broke into a parked company car in Landskron by smashing a side window and stole a wallet containing cash and a bank card.
A fire broke out at a company property in Klagenfurt am Wörthersee, damaging pallets, a plastic waste bin, and a building facade; no injuries were reported.
Heating oil leaked into the Tiebel river during renovation work, prompting firefighting efforts and the installation of oil barriers.
A 15-year-old boy walking with his mother was injured by falling tree branches caused by wind and was treated in a hospital for minor injuries.
A 73-year-old woman was injured in a traffic accident involving a hit-and-run truck in Gänserndorf.
75-year-old woman reported missing from a senior home in Vöcklabruck but found unharmed in a locked room after an extensive search operation.
A woman was threatened with a pocket knife and robbed of money and her mobile phone at Hauptplatz in Haid.
A driverless car in Linz rolled backward across a road, hit a curb, and eventually stopped against a tree causing minor damage.
A 65-year-old man fell into an unsecured stairwell during wall construction work and later succumbed to his injuries in the hospital.
A car veered off the road to avoid an oncoming vehicle and hit a tree, injuring two passengers; the other vehicle drove away.
A fire broke out in a ceiling lamp with a rail system in a house, causing damage to the living and dining room, but no one was injured.
A car veered off the road and hit a tree; the driver was unharmed, and the passenger sustained unspecified injuries.
An 11-year-old boy in Hall was hit by a car while crossing the street, sustained injuries, and was taken to the hospital.
Physical altercation between two men in Lustenau escalated, involving a third person; one man sustained a facial injury.
A red spreading device was stolen from under a shed in Bezirk Wolfsberg, causing an estimated damage of €1500.
Multiple individuals involved in physical altercations in Graz; a man was severely injured, and others sustained minor injuries. Police arrested four suspects.
Two cyclists collided in Erl due to darkness and lack of lighting, resulting in injuries to one cyclist.
A 35-year-old man died in a single-car accident in Nüziders after his vehicle hit a tree, likely due to speeding.
A man attacked a woman on the street and later became aggressive towards police, leading to his arrest. The man was under the influence of alcohol and had a restraining order against the woman.
A man was re-arrested after being released from detention for aggressive behavior, where he damaged a door and resisted arrest violently at Familienplatz in Vienna.
A man damaged rental e-scooters and attacked a police officer who intervened.

A tractor with a slurry tank tipped over due to an axle break, spilling 3 m³ of slurry on a municipal road in Prebl. Firefighters rectified the tank and cleaned the road; no environmental or drinking water hazard occurred.
A fire broke out at a multi-party house in Vöcklamarkt, severely damaging the building. All residents safely evacuated, and over 150 firefighters were involved in extinguishing the fire.
A 66-year-old mans disposal of grill ashes caused a fire that damaged neighboring property; the fire was controlled by firefighters.
A 45-year-old man was injured in a cycling accident in Vöcklabruck district and taken to the hospital.
Three Romanian men attempted a robbery in Salzburg, injuring a woman and fleeing on bicycles, but were later apprehended by police.
A fire broke out in a waste storage hall in Uttendorf, spreading rapidly and causing the closure of a nearby road and evacuation advisories.
Fire broke out in the heating cellar of a family home in Unternberg, likely due to a technical defect in the power line.
Cigarette embers likely caused a fire on the roof of an annex building; no injuries or casualties reported.
Forest fire in Gallmannsegg burned one hectare of mixed coniferous forest; no injuries reported.
A fire caused by cigarette butts on a balcony in Paldau injured three people due to smoke inhalation and caused significant property damage.
A forest fire likely caused by a cigarette burned 10,000 to 20,000 square meters of young forest near Schweighardtweg in Hafendorf, requiring significant firefighting efforts.
A fire broke out in the roof of a farm building, causing minor injuries from smoke inhalation to a resident while fire brigades extinguished the blaze.
Motorcycle collided with a car on Ellbögener Landesstraße; the motorcyclist was seriously injured, and two car passengers sustained unspecified injuries.
Cyclist and child on scooter collided on Hans-Flöckinger-Promenade in Innsbruck; the child was injured and taken to the hospital.
A 42-year-old Serbian man was arrested in Vienna for falsifying a vehicles mileage and inspection report in 2015.

A 27-year-old man was apprehended at the Hauptbahnhof with ecstasy tablets, cannabis, and other drugs, suspected of drug dealing. He was detained but later released pending charges and remains in immigration custody.
A 43-year-old allegedly threatened a 44-year-old with a knife during a dispute in Vienna; the suspect was temporarily arrested and reported at large.
A woman attacked a man in a supermarket and later assaulted a responding police officer, leading to her arrest and hospitalization.
A 30-year-old driver was caught speeding at approximately 125 km/h in Klagenfurt and was pursued and stopped by police.
An 84-year-old man lost control of his car near Landskron, causing multiple collisions and property damage but no major injuries.
A Romanian man triggered an avalanche while skiing in Mallnitz; he was killed while his companion remained unharmed.
A car collided with a truck on the B 60 in Weigelsdorf; an 18-year-old driver and his passenger were seriously injured.
A 31-year-old worker fell from scaffolding in Schärding, suffering injuries, and was taken to the hospital.
A 23-year-old man lost control of his car during a hailstorm, veered off the road, and collided with a tree, sustaining injuries.
A 67-year-old man in Salzburg fell victim to an investment fraud scheme involving fake online trading, phone pressure, and unauthorized transactions.

A 26-year-old man in Leibnitz refused to wear an FFP2 mask, caused a disturbance in a bar, and resisted police efforts at the station, resulting in his arrest. One officer and the man sustained minor injuries.
Cannabis plants and cultivation equipment found in a residential building during a drug-related investigation.
A man confined his ex-girlfriend against her will in a friends apartment in Innsbruck but left before police arrived.
A tire and drive shaft from an excavator were stolen from a construction site in Rattenberg, Austria.
A substantial five-figure sum of money was stolen at a deposit ATM in a bank branch in Innsbruck.
A car collided with a stationary truck on the A12 highway near Wörgl, resulting in the death of the driver of the car.
Hydraulic oil leaked from a poorly secured laboratory press on a semi-truck, prompting chemical analysis and cleanup efforts at a rest stop in Hörbranz.
Fire broke out in a multi-family house, cause yet to be determined, investigation ongoing.
Driver caught speeding at 207 km/h in a 130 km/h zone on S 5 highway near Königsbrunn in rainy conditions.
22-year-old Afghan drug dealer arrested for trafficking cannabis, cocaine, and Ecstasy after a traffic check in Mehrnbach.
Heavily intoxicated driver caught after driving erratically, license confiscated and reported.
Police conducted heavy vehicle checks on A2 motorway in Bad Vöslau; two overweight trucks were stopped with safety violations, and legal actions were initiated against responsible parties.

A 27-year-old Iranian man was attacked with iron rods by three youths in Innsbruck after refusing to give them a cigarette. The victim sustained minor injuries, and the suspects, a 16-year-old Cameroonian and two Austrians aged 16 and 15, were later arrested.
Fire caused by heating a wood stove in a garden house resulted in severe damage; two fire brigades controlled the blaze.
An intoxicated man without a driving license crashed into a concrete garden fence, sustained injuries, and will be reported to authorities.
A 50-year-old worker in Trofaiach fell from a ladder while handling a crane element and was injured when the equipment fell on him.
A 41-year-old man was caught purchasing drugs outside a closed premises in Vienna, leading to the arrest of a 49-year-old operator and the confiscation of drugs and cash.

A fire broke out on the wooden shingle-covered roof of a house in Großkirchheim. No injuries were reported, and fire departments managed to control the blaze. Investigations into the cause are ongoing.
A 35-year-old woman was briefly distracted by her children while driving downhill and collided with an oncoming car, causing minor injuries to the other driver and significant vehicle damage.
A 23-year-old male driver lost control of his car and collided with a concrete wall, resulting in his death at the scene.
A fire occurred in Kremsmünster caused by self-ignition of a foam block due to chemical reaction; one firefighter was slightly injured.
A 25-year-old driver without a valid license, under the influence of drugs, crashed his car on the Pyhrnpaß-Bundesstraße in Wartberg/Krems and overturned it, but was uninjured.
A 17-year-old was found guilty of trafficking drugs like marijuana, hashish, and amphetamines, selling them to 25 individuals; items including cash and drugs were seized during a house search.
Fire in a livestock facility in Offenhausen killed around 150 pigs; the cause remains unknown and damages are substantial.
A snack bar in Gunskirchen caught fire; the fire caused significant damage to the kitchen and roof before being extinguished.
A hut caught fire in St. Anna am Aigen; no injuries were reported, and firefighters extinguished the blaze. The fire was likely caused by heat radiation from a stove pipe.
Collision between a cyclist and a pedestrian in Graz resulted in serious injury to the pedestrian.
A 20-year-old woman lost control of her car due to excessive speed and veered off the road, coming to a stop in a field. She was injured and transported to the hospital.
A 54-year-old woman fell while cycling on the Ötztaler Radweg in Längenfeld, sustaining serious head injuries.
A chimney fire occurred in a house in Ludesch due to the lighting of a wood stove; no damages or injuries were reported.
A car struck a pedestrian crossing the road in Schwarzach, resulting in injuries.
Six Afghan men were discovered in a truck at A23 in Vienna and arrested under immigration law.
A shoplifter in Vienna-Donaustadt, who was heavily intoxicated, attacked a police officer by punching him in the stomach, leading to the mans arrest. One officer sustained injuries during the arrest.
Bicyclist crashed and was injured due to abrupt braking as a car turned in front of him; the car driver fled the scene.
A worker in Villach fell from a container while attempting to secure a safety net and suffered severe injuries, requiring hospitalization.
A 24-year-old worker accidentally fell and hit his head on an iron beam at a construction site in St. Jakob/R, suffering unspecified injuries and requiring airlift to a hospital.
A 76-year-old man fell through a roof panel at a warehouse in Ernstbrunn and tragically died from the fall.
A 19-year-old driver lost control of his car, leading to a fatal accident on L 5010 in Einöd; the passenger was injured and hospitalized.
A 58-year-old man fell approximately 3.5 meters from a ladder while working in Berndorf, sustaining severe injuries and was airlifted to a hospital in Vienna.

Three drivers under the influence of drugs were stopped, two drivers were caught driving under the influence of alcohol, and one speeding driver was detected in a special traffic control operation in Wels-Land.
A car with French plates broke through a border control on the A10, damaging barriers, and the driver fled; no arrests yet.

An elderly cyclist in Salzburg was severely injured in a collision with a truck at an intersection. The truck driver, found to be under the influence of alcohol, was prohibited from continuing his journey. The cyclist suffered life-threatening injuries.
An 18-year-old driver caught speeding at 103 km/h in Ramingstein; provisional driving license confiscated.
Police stopped a Croatian truck on the A9 due to a dangerously tilted trailer and discovered multiple severe technical deficiencies during inspection.
A car collided with a truck on the A2 highway near Sinabelkirchen, causing the car driver to sustain minor injuries and requiring hospitalization.
Fire broke out in the living room of a house in Kolsass; one person hospitalized for suspected smoke inhalation and three others unharmed.
Collision occurred when a trailer tipped over in a curve; one person was injured and transported to the hospital.
A van collided unbraked into a stationary truck on a highway in Wörgl, causing severe injuries to the van driver and injuries of undetermined severity to the truck driver.
A 22-year-old man driving at high speed caused a multi-vehicle collision in Dornbirn, injuring himself and damaging several vehicles.
A 17-year-old man assaulted and robbed a 15-year-old in a drug deal in Innsbruck; the suspect was later arrested.
Fatal car accident in Einöd; an 18-year-old driver lost control of the vehicle, resulting in his death, while the passenger was injured.
A cyclist was fatally injured in a collision with a truck in Salzburg at an intersection. The truck driver, found with an alcohol level of 0.59 mg/l, was prohibited from further driving.
Two vehicles were caught speeding at 148 km/h and 141 km/h in a construction zone on the A23 near St. Marx.
An 80-year-old man suffered a medical emergency while driving and was rescued and stabilized by first responders and emergency services in St. Andrä vor dem Hagenthale.
Fire started in a flower trough on a terrace in Dornbirn due to smoldering coal from a water pipe, causing significant property damage but no injuries.
Two men were involved in a physical altercation, both were aggressive upon police arrival, leading to their arrest; pepper spray was used on one of them.
A hit-and-run traffic accident in Vienna involving two cars and a motorcycle resulted in serious injuries to the motorcyclist and their passenger. Police are looking for suspects.
A man stole fuel from a gas station twice, using a stolen vehicle and license plates, and evaded payment.
Two teenagers attempted to rob iPhones from two victims in Linz and Leonding and physically assaulted one victim before being apprehended by police.
Moldavian man caught entering Austria with a forged drivers license.
A 74-year-old woman with dementia went missing in Wels-Land and was found unharmed near Gunskirchen after a search.
Cash was stolen from an office in Salzburg-Liefering after entry using a stolen key, with the thief escaping undetected.
An intoxicated man shouting Nazi slogans and threatening police was arrested after resisting officers.
A 40-year-old worker fell 2.8 meters from scaffolding, sustaining serious injuries, and was hospitalized.
A 26-year-old man was seriously injured while working with a nail gun, accidentally shooting a nail into his leg.
A 42-year-old woman fell 2.5 meters from a ladder while retrieving gardening tools and suffered severe spinal injuries.
A forest fire was reported in Neustift im Stubaital, affecting an area of 500-600 m2; no injuries were reported.
A car collision in Zirl injured one person and caused property damage to both vehicles.
A 74-year-old Italian driver crashed into a tree on Reschenstraße B 180 near Pfunds after veering off the road; he was injured and airlifted to a hospital.
Fire erupted in a paper press wagon in Dornbirn; extinguished by the fire department with road closure for cleanup.
A pedestrian discovered a suspected World War II incendiary bomb near a forest path in Vienna, which was safely removed by the bomb disposal unit.

Police conducted a traffic checkpoint in Viennas Meidling and Hietzing districts, resulting in multiple charges including drug-related offenses, traffic violations, possession of a weapon, and the seizure of substances, documents, and a weapon.
A truck driver with over 2.26 promille alcohol was stopped in Neudorf after damaging traffic facilities on the highway.
An unknown car driver caused a traffic accident in Villach, collided with a 17-year-old e-scooter rider who was crossing the street and fled the scene; the rider sustained minor injuries.
A fire in Neunkirchen claimed the life of a 45-year-old man; investigation ongoing with no initial signs of foul play.
Three students set a wood pile on fire under a bridge in Schlatt, leading to damage of electrical lines, sewer pipes, and significant infrastructure.
A 76-year-old woman with dementia left her care home in Vöcklabruck District at night. After an extensive search involving multiple agencies, she was found cold but responsive and hospitalized.
An 18-year-old probationary license holder was caught driving at 95 km/h in a city area and will be reported.
A 19-year-old Romanian man from Linz was stopped on the A7 Mühlkreisautobahn driving a car he had taken without permission and without ever having a valid drivers license.
A 16-year-old stole headphones from a drugstore in Salzburg and was caught with a small amount of cannabis after being apprehended.
Drunk moped driver fled police, drove erratically, fell, and was temporarily arrested.
Worker seriously injured after a 24kg tile carton fell from a high shelf in a hardware store, causing severe head injuries.
A 57-year-old man was severely injured in a workplace accident involving a forklift transporting a rail beam in a factory.

A wood-burning stove overheated in a farmhouse in Fieberbrunn, leading to a fire. The owner and his son attempted to extinguish it but required assistance from the fire department. Both suffered suspected smoke inhalation and were treated at a local hospital.
An old World War II hand grenade was found during excavation work in a garden in Wörgl, deemed harmless and removed by the militarys bomb disposal unit.
Two cars collided in Kitzbühel causing injuries to both drivers; one had to be extricated by the fire brigade, and both were taken to the hospital.
Police officer rescued a deer that entered a residential apartment in Krems an der Donau and released it into the wild unharmed.
An unknown perpetrator stole a package containing an iPad Air from in front of a residential apartment in Rum, Austria.
A burglar broke into a phone shop in Eisenstadt by creating holes in drywall, stealing phones, and causing significant damage.
Two individuals impersonating police officers stopped a man, conducted a fake vehicle inspection, and extorted 30 euros from him.
Facades of four buildings in Göfis were defaced with graffiti by unknown perpetrators.

A series of burglaries were solved in Lower Austria, involving a suspect who committed break-ins and physical assault during incidents in Groß Gerungs, Felixdorf, and Katzelsdorf, with an arrest made in Purkersdorf.
An unknown suspect broke into a mobile phone shop in Eisenstadt, stealing phones and accessories worth a five-digit euro amount.
A witness observed a man breaking the lock of a parked bicycle and stealing it; the suspect was apprehended nearby.
A man from Vienna was found with marijuana hidden in a bottle during a train inspection near Wels and intended to distribute it at a party.
Man caught driving under drug influence in Linz, admitted to recent drug use and refused medical examination.
A 50-year-old worker fell several meters from a ladder during roofing work and was seriously injured.
Two motorcycles were stolen from an accessible carport in Graz in the night of April 16, 2021.
A 21-year-old man was arrested for aggressive behavior toward police officers, including spitting and attempting to hit them, during an identity check.

A 16-year-old reported being threatened with a firearm during a dispute on Ottakringer Straße; a vehicle search led to the discovery of a firearm, ammunition, drugs, and documents. Two suspects were identified.
49-year-old Kosovar caught and arrested for a series of burglaries in Vienna with damages in the five-figure range.
A 32-year-old Austrian man committed a theft in a grocery store, threatened staff with a knife during pursuit, and was later arrested by WEGA police with the weapon secured.
A 22-year-old locksmith suffered severe hand injuries while adjusting a powered pressure roller in a factory.
An E-bike rider was injured in a collision with a car in Weißenstein; the driver remained unharmed.
A truck driver lost consciousness and crashed into a train station building in Brückl, causing property damage and sustaining injuries.
A wildfire occurred in steep terrain in Lunz am See; firefighters extinguished the blaze with support from a police helicopter. No injuries were reported.
A residential house fire in Schiltern resulted in two women being rescued and hospitalized with unspecified injuries. The house was heavily damaged and rendered uninhabitable.
A 15-year-old cyclist collided with a car while attempting to cross a road, resulting in serious injuries. The cyclist was airlifted to a hospital.
A 64-year-old man fell from scaffolding and was injured while working on a house roof in Wels, Austria.
A motorcycle rider collided with a car that abruptly braked due to pheasants crossing the road, resulting in minor injuries and transport to the hospital.
A 57-year-old motorcyclist died following a collision with a car in Waldkirchen am Wesen on April 16, 2020.
A 23-year-old male motorcyclist from Vienna crashed without external involvement on a road curve in Fraham, sustaining injuries to his right foot.
Police stopped a Dutch man driving with falsified vehicle documents and without a valid license.
A 20-month-old child fell into a 3.4-meter deep shaft in the garden while the father was conducting repairs, sustaining injuries and being airlifted to a hospital.

A 20-year-old driver in Anthering lost control of her car on the B156 road, resulting in the vehicle overturning before coming to rest in a field. She sustained injuries and was transported to a hospital. The road was briefly closed for recovery efforts.
Collision occurred in Salzburg between a truck and an e-bike rider, injuring the cyclist.
Cargo of a semi-trailer caught fire while driving, causing total damage to the trailer and temporary road closures; no injuries reported.
Two people were killed and one injured when a bus and a car collided, with the bus losing control due to a medical emergency.
A 46-year-old cyclist in Graz was seriously injured after colliding with a loading ramp placed on a pedestrian and cycle path by a delivery driver.
A wheel loader caught fire due to a suspected technical defect during operation and was completely destroyed; no injuries reported.

A 15-year-old girl, along with an accomplice, robbed an 18-year-old womans phone in Innsbruck after attempting to snatch her handbag and purse. The juvenile perpetrator was arrested during the manhunt.
A collision occurred at an intersection in Vienna between a tram and a car, resulting in a 40-year-old woman being injured and taken to a hospital.
A 46-year-old man fell 5 meters while dismantling a hay crane in Greifenburg, suffering severe injuries requiring emergency airlift to a hospital.
A reed thicket caught fire in Ferlach and spread to neighboring hedges; neighbors controlled the fire before firefighters arrived.
Motorcyclist collided with a parked car, sustaining serious injuries and being transported to the hospital.
Armed man robbed a bank in St. Pantaleon, threatened employee with a knife, and fled with cash; perpetrator remains at large.
A car accident in Asten involving two vehicles resulted in five people, including two children, being injured and hospitalized.
A 15-year-old was injured after braking suddenly to avoid a grey VW Golf and fell off his moped near a riding stable in Hellmonsödt, Austria. The driver of the VW Golf is being sought.
Three people injured in a rear-end collision involving three cars on Naarnerstraße in Perg, Austria.
A paper bin was set on fire by an unknown perpetrator and extinguished by a resident using water.
Driver consuming a joint stopped on A1 highway, found with marijuana, a gas pistol, and a prohibited weapon.
A 77-year-old woman was robbed at gunpoint in her car in a parking garage by an unknown man who fled the scene on an electric scooter.
A 17-year-old threatened a 23-year-old with a knife in Graz City Park over a failed drug deal; no injuries reported.
A 57-year-old cyclist collided with a car in a roundabout, resulting in severe facial injuries and requiring hospitalization.
A 19-year-old man fell 100 meters in rugged terrain near Hochwacht, Kufstein, and was rescued with injuries of unspecified severity.
Smoke was reported from a locked apartment in Innsbruck Wilten; a witness rescued a dog inside, and the fire department determined the cause to be burnt food.
A 39-year-old worker fell 7.5 meters from a roof during demolition work in Oberau, suffering fatal injuries.
A Romanian truck driver noticed smoke from his trailers tire near the Lermooser Tunnel, detached it, and firefighters extinguished overheated brakes; no injuries reported.
Two men in Lustenau exhibited aggressive behavior towards police during an alcohol-related control and resisted arrest, requiring the use of handcuffs and foot restraints.
A 43-year-old woman fell off her bicycle in Dornbirn, sustaining significant facial injuries, and the police are seeking witnesses.
Three teenagers were apprehended in connection with multiple motorcycle thefts, with two initially fleeing but later being caught and linked to four thefts causing significant damage.
7-year-old girl fell from a window trying to follow her parents and sustained injuries; parents were reported.
Police conducted a traffic operation uncovering multiple offenses, including drug driving, alcohol-related incidents, and traffic violations.
640 liters of diesel stolen from four construction vehicles at a highway construction site in Dornbirn.
A 14-year-old confessed to starting six fires in Steinbach, causing damages of approximately 100,000 Euros.
An armed robbery occurred in a bank in St. Pantaleon with the perpetrator fleeing with stolen money. The suspect, a 39-year-old Bosnian, was later arrested and part of the stolen cash was recovered.
An unknown perpetrator attempted a fraudulent bank transfer in Ischgl, but the forgery was identified and no funds were transferred.
A 45-year-old worker was injured in Mödling when a construction debris container swayed due to wind and pinned him against a wall.
Cannabis cultivation operation was uncovered by police in Vienna-Donaustadt, with arrests and seizure of cannabis plants, packaged drugs, and cash.
Fire caused by a cigarette stub in a PVC flower box spread to a gas grill, garden furniture, and Styrofoam facade at a house in Deutschkreuz. No injuries were reported.
A man lost control of his car and drove into a stream in Maria Saal; he was rescued with minor injuries and was found to be moderately intoxicated.
A motorcycle parked near an apartment building in Klagenfurt am Wörthersee caught fire and was extinguished by police and firefighters, with no indication of self-ignition.
Two cars collided in Dornbirn, with one driver fleeing the scene and the other sustaining injuries.
Car collided with a truck on A2 motorway in Austria, causing one fatality and two injuries.
A 73-year-old dementia patient went missing but was found safe, though undercooled, near a railway underpass and returned to the hospital.
A motorcycle secured with a chain was stolen from a carport in Graz overnight.
A newspaper delivery woman was run over by her own car, suffering a severe leg injury due to the car not being properly secured.
A 24-year-old intoxicated driver caused a car accident in Leoben, damaging four parked vehicles, two of which were totaled. No one was injured.
A 49-year-old Dutch national was arrested in Vienna following an investigation and a warrant issued by the prosecution.
A 42-year-old man caused multiple hit-and-run accidents in Vienna, potentially under the influence of substances, before being arrested after hiding in a flat.

A 29-year-old asylum seeker from Somalia threatened a caregiver with death in an asylum accommodation, damaged a police car door, and acted aggressively towards officers. He was arrested and later detained.

A man attempted to start his motorhome in Feldkirchen which resulted in a fire on the roof-mounted air conditioner. The fire was extinguished, preventing further damage, but the man suffered burns to his hands.
A wooden garden hut filled with firewood was totally damaged by fire in Metnitz; the cause is unknown.
A fire occurred in the cellar of a residential property in Wolfsberg, caused by a child potentially activating stove burners, burning stored materials and causing smoke damage.
A highly intoxicated man caused a traffic accident with property damage and fled, was later found by police playing loud music in his car, and displayed aggressive behavior during the arrest in Linz.
Two motorcyclists collided head-on in Unterviehbach, resulting in their deaths and vehicle fires.
An 18-year-old cyclist in Salzburg hit a lamppost, fell, and was injured while under the influence of alcohol at 1.34 promille.
A cyclist was stopped by police while riding on the A10 Tauernautobahn; he was removed from the highway safely and reported to the authorities.
A 40-year-old motorcyclist collided head-on with a car while overtaking another vehicle in Dorfgastein, sustaining severe injuries and being transported to the hospital.
A 34-year-old man was severely injured after losing control of his motorcycle and crashing into a forested area in Winzendorf.
Fatal car collision occurred on Ebersdorferstraße L412, resulting in the death of a 54-year-old man and injuries to a 47-year-old driver.
A 53-year-old worker was critically injured after a wall fell on him during construction work in Werndorf.
Two people, a mother and her toddler, were seriously injured after a wooden piece fell from a terrace during assembly in Hartberg.
A 49-year-old Austrian was seriously injured in Hall in Tirol after a lifts drive chain broke and caused a fall from 5.5 meters.
A 47-year-old Hungarian man fell from a height of approximately 3 meters at a construction site in Fulpmes, sustaining serious injuries.
A man in Wörgl threatened three people and a bakery customer with a firearm, resisted arrest, and was found in possession of weapons despite a ban.

Two experienced climbers on the Hochfeiler mountain were involved in a crevasse fall. A 28-year-old broke through the snow, but his partner managed to stabilize the situation. The injured climber was rescued and taken to safety by the mountain rescue team.
A cyclist assaulted a 68-year-old driver in Matrei am Brenner after a driving incident, then fled the scene.
An unidentified person attempted to break into a house in Oberlienz using a spade, but fled when a neighbor confronted him after hearing the noise.
A 9-year-old boy collided with a car after being frightened by a barking dog, leading to his hospitalization.
A bomb threat was made to a bank in Feldkirch-Altenstadt, prompting an evacuation, building search, and subsequent arrest of a suspect in Styria.
Scammers exploited fears during the COVID-19 crisis with fake online shops, fraudulent job and credit offers, phishing emails, and phone scams targeting vulnerable individuals.
A 22-year-old driver attempted to evade police, leading to a high-speed chase through several streets in Wien before crashing into parked cars, injuring himself and a passenger.
Motorcyclist collided while attempting to avoid a car and succumbed to injuries at the scene.
Fire broke out in a residential building in Pinkafeld; three people were hospitalized, two for suspected smoke inhalation and one was rescued directly from the fire.
A man fell 4.5 meters from the roof of his garage, sustaining severe injuries, and was airlifted to the hospital.
A 30-year-old driver, not having a license and under the influence of alcohol, lost control of a car, which overturned multiple times and hit a garden stone wall; both occupants were injured.
A car caught fire in a parking garage in Pasching. Two brothers managed to control the flames until firefighters arrived. The incident caused significant damage to the building but no injuries.
A 33-year-old driver attempted an unannounced U-turn, leading to a collision with another vehicle, resulting in one person severely injured and one lightly injured.
A driver under the influence of alcohol caused a traffic accident, fled the scene twice, and was later found by police, leading to the revocation of his license.
Kenyan siblings aged 16 and 17 were caught shoplifting clothing worth a low three-digit euro amount in Salzburg and confessed to the crime.
A 37-year-old driver was caught under the influence of cocaine during a routine vehicle check in Salzburg-Schallmoos; his license was confiscated.
Two elderly women were injured when their car swerved to avoid a cat and crashed into a rock on the roadside, overturning near Zell am See.
A 37-year-old man driving on the L 214 in Wagrain was stopped for speeding and found to have a blood alcohol level of 0.94‰. His license was confiscated, and he was reported.
Small fire in a pellet stove caused by a suspected technical defect, extinguished by the fire department, with minimal damage and no injuries.
Two young men robbed a 20-year-olds apartment using a hammer and fled with cash, but were later arrested following a large-scale police search.

An old acacia tree in Innsbruck caught fire, allegedly caused by four unknown individuals who discarded a cigarette into the tree. Firefighters extinguished the fire and felled the tree for safety reasons.
Discovery of a German WWII-era hand grenade, secured by police and handed over to the bomb disposal unit.
A 45-year-old woman on a ski tour in Schmirn fell into a brook bed while crossing a narrow bridge, resulting in severe injuries requiring hospital transport.
Two Austrian mountaineers were caught in a snow slab while skiing, resulting in one fatality and severe injuries to another in steep terrain near the Großer Zunig in Matrei in Osttirol.
A multi-vehicle traffic accident occurred in Alberschwende involving four cars; one person was injured and significant damage was reported.
Police intervened in a gathering violating Covid-19 regulations in Linz; 23 individuals fined.
Teenagers in Graz damaged traffic signs and stole license plates, later confessing to the acts.

Unknown perpetrators broke into a locked container on a construction site in Feldkirchen bei Graz and stole various tools and equipment from brands like HILTI and STIHL, causing damage worth several thousand euros.
A 35-year-old man vandalized vehicles, a glass shelter, and a billboard while under the influence of alcohol and drugs. He was arrested and taken to a hospital.

A 17-year-old male threatened three individuals with a blank pistol at Lehener Park in Salzburg for self-defense, following a chase initiated by the victims. He later confessed and was charged with a weapons ban.
14-year-old Austrian skier was injured and briefly lost consciousness after misjudging a jump off-piste in Kühtai; he was airlifted to a clinic with leg fractures.

Two motorbikes, including a Poketbike and a 125cc lightweight motorcycle, were stolen from an unlocked carport in Angath. Both suspects were identified and confessed, with one vehicle later recovered in a nearby forest and the other found with one of the suspects.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a container on a construction site in Axams and stole several machines between April 17, 2020, at 3:30 PM and April 20, 2020, at 7:00 AM.

A fire broke out in a residential building in Tulln an der Donau, causing significant damage estimated at 50,000 euros. A 26-year-old man was identified as a suspect and arrested, though he denied involvement.
A 38-year-old man from Gmunden was involved in numerous thefts and burglaries in electronics stores, selling stolen consoles and games online to fund his living.
A driver was caught driving at 157 km/h in a 60 km/h zone during a traffic control in Vienna.
A smoldering fire occurred in a biomass boiler at a heating plant in Ferlach, likely due to a technical defect, causing minor damage.
A drunk driver crashed into a telephone pole causing damage and minor injury.
Fire broke out on a house terrace in Waizenkirchen and spread to the interior. Four people suffered minor smoke inhalation and were hospitalized.

A 23-year-old woman drove under the influence of alcohol, lost control of her car, hit objects in a roundabout, continued driving despite severe vehicle damage, and was eventually stopped. She tested at 1.42 per mille alcohol level.
An 18-year-old driver in Pongau crashed his car into a tree after losing control under the influence of alcohol; he sustained injuries, and his passenger remained unharmed.
Police rescued an intoxicated woman clinging to a rock in the Mur river in Graz, Austria.
Two male suspects were apprehended following a break-in at a fashion store in Vienna; tools used for the break-in were seized.

Police in Linz were called to investigate a hit-and-run; two 21-year-old males resisted officers during questioning, with one attacking police and both being arrested. A driver tested for alcohol with 0.96 promille.
Four teenagers were caught in possession of stolen items including a traffic sign, a bicycle, and a wooden stork in Innsbruck.
A security guard at a grocery store had a physical altercation with a suspected shoplifter who allegedly threatened to harm the guard with a key before being apprehended by police in a nearby park.
Man attempted to snatch a womans handbag on the street but was caught by plainclothes officers; no injuries reported.
A 16-year-old attacked and injured a police officer during an intervention following a family dispute, leading to his arrest using physical force.
Two cyclists collided during an overtaking maneuver on the bicycle path B10 near Rust, causing one to fall and be treated by medical services.
A 24-year-old man lost control of his car on a wet road, overturned, and slid downhill; he sustained minor injuries and was slightly intoxicated.
A car accident occurred in Klagenfurt involving two drivers resulting in minor injuries to a woman. The other driver failed a breathalyzer test and was found to already have his license revoked.
A man called for rescue as his partner was unable to continue a mountain hike due to exhaustion and fear, leading to a helicopter-assisted operation.

A 18-year-old driver in Purgstall an der Erlauf caused an accident with a streetlight and fled the scene. Stolen license plates were found in the vehicle. Later, he turned himself in, where he was found to be under the influence of substances and unfit to drive.
Two intoxicated drivers crashed into a garden house, causing significant damage and a power outage; no injuries were reported.
A two-year-old child was accidentally run over by a Hoftrac operated by her mother; the child sustained injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.
A car collided with a traffic sign, the vehicle became inoperable, and the passenger, who was intoxicated, became aggressive towards police during the accident response.
A man caused a traffic accident in Saalfelden, fled the scene, and was later found by police with a blood alcohol level of 2.22‰.
A 18-year-old man got lost and injured his knee during a hike in Kapfenberg and was rescued by mountain rescue teams.

An 87-year-old man was seriously injured while working with a wood splitter in Pischelsdorf am Kulm. He slipped and his hand became caught in the machine. His son-in-law provided first aid, and he was transported to the hospital.
An eight-year-old girl was bitten in the head by a dog while playing in a garden; the dogs owner tested positive for alcohol.
A man in Graz falsely reported emergencies to authorities, prompting unnecessary response efforts; drugs were also found in his possession.
A 64-year-old motorcyclist and his 58-year-old wife fell on a road in Klöch due to gravel, resulting in minor injuries.
An 18-year-old hiker in Aurach bei Kitzbühel got lost during an evening hike and was rescued from steep terrain by authorities.
An unknown perpetrator attempted arson by trying to ignite a tree in a forest near Stans, which was extinguished by the fire department without injuries or major damage.
Motorcyclist lost control and crashed on Langenerstraße in Bregenz, sustaining severe injuries and causing property damage.
A minor bluish-white water discoloration was observed in Minderach, Schwarzach, likely originating from the Mühleweggraben canal; origin remains unidentified after investigations.
In Vienna-Favoriten, a 36-year-old Algerian man was arrested for drug dealing after attempting to flee and resisting police. Marijuana and cash were confiscated.
A vehicle was caught driving 133km/h in a 50km/h zone during a speed monitoring operation in Vienna; the driver may face license suspension.
Pizza delivery man in Klagenfurt was threatened with a knife and robbed by three individuals; wallet partially recovered later.
A woman in Villach was defrauded by someone posing as a U.S. Army member asking for money to leave Afghanistan.
Two drivers exceeded the speed limit significantly in Klagenfurt; their licenses were confiscated.
A fire broke out in an apartment in Hürm, forcing a 64-year-old tenant to jump from a window; he was injured and hospitalized. The fire was extinguished by multiple fire brigades.
A drunk driver swerved to avoid a deer, lost control, and crashed into a wooded area, causing significant vehicle damage but no injuries.
A 17-year-old driver lost control of his car and hit a concrete garden fence column, injuring himself and two passengers.
A 26-year-old under the influence of alcohol and THC caused a traffic accident in Traun, resulting in minor injuries to a 40-year-old woman.

A wooden house in Bad Hall caught fire; the blaze, noted by a neighbor, caused significant damage despite firefighting efforts. No one was injured, and the origin is suspected to be near the stove in the kitchen. Investigation is ongoing.
A 37-year-old Slovak climber became disoriented in snowy conditions on the Hochblaser and was rescued by the mountain rescue team after his wife raised the alarm.
A 25-year-old man confessed to committing over 200 graffiti-related acts of vandalism across Austria, mainly in Graz and Vienna, causing significant damage.
Motorcyclist injured in a collision with a car on B171 in Roppen, no alcohol involved.
An unknown offender shot a housecat with an air rifle, causing serious injuries.
A pizza delivery driver was robbed in Klagenfurt by three individuals, with the intention of using the money for drug procurement.
60-year-old man in Brunn am Gebirge threatened police with a knife after endangering his wife and damaging the kitchen. He was arrested after resisting and threatening officers.
A 57-year-old cyclist suffered severe head injuries after falling from his e-bike on a path in Salzburg.
Two brothers discovered an old WWII hand grenade in a cave near Viktorsberg, leading to its removal and the sealing of the cave for safety.
Fatal traffic accident in Adlwang, two people died and one was severely injured after a car lost control, slid off the road, and hit a tree.
A fire in Steinbach am Ziehberg destroyed a barn and equipment, possibly caused by a lightning strike during a thunderstorm; no severe injuries reported.
Multiple garbage fires were set in Feldkirchen/Donau, with one spreading to a tree; the fires were extinguished by firefighters and arson is suspected.
A missing 78-year-old woman was found hypothermic but otherwise unharmed by the mountain rescue team, firefighters, and police in Prägraten.
Unknown perpetrators attempted a scam involving counterfeit checks at a guesthouse in Völkermarkt, but the fraud was detected in time to prevent significant financial loss.

A 68-year-old man in Klagenfurt was defrauded of several tens of thousands of euros in a cryptocurrency investment scam, involving multiple supposed traders contacting him and requesting bank transfers.
A man was arrested in Vienna for severely damaging a parked car, including smashing all windows and deforming the body.
27-year-old driver severely injured after his car crashed off the road and hit tree logs on Böhmerwald Straße.
Two men in Ried im Innkreis got into a conflict involving alcohol, leading one to threaten the other with a knife, causing a police intervention and damage to property.
A 15-year-old caused multiple traffic incidents, including stealing license plates, using unregistered vehicles, and crashing into a tree, injuring passengers.
A 20-year-old man without a drivers license lost control of an unregistered car and collided with trees and a fiber optic cabinet, resulting in injuries and severe damage.
Stolen car from Belgium and forged registration document seized at border control.
A forest fire caused by a lightning strike was detected in Bruck an der Mur; no injuries were reported.
Kitchen fire broke out at the home of a 71-year-old woman, likely caused by overheated cooking oil; no injuries were reported.

A traffic accident occurred in Absam where a motorcyclist struck a pedestrian on a crosswalk, resulting in the pedestrian being injured and transported to the hospital, with minor damage to a car involved in the incident.
A car with four occupants plunged 6 meters off a forest path and into a stream bed, injuring two individuals, including one who was airlifted to a hospital.
A 58-year-old woman crashed her light motorcycle in Stanzach on the L21 road and sustained serious injuries; she was flown to a hospital by helicopter.
A man discharged a CO2 weapon near a skater park, leading to a police operation. He was later apprehended near a stadium with the weapon in his possession.
A man attempted to unfasten a steel cable on a docked passenger ship, risking significant damage; he was detained by police and released after interrogation.
Two suspects were arrested in Vienna for drug trafficking; over 500 grams of heroin and other materials were seized during a personal and house search.
A train conductor was pushed and injured by a passenger without a ticket during a ticket check on a train to Krumpendorf; the suspect remains unidentified and fled the scene.
A truck veered off the road and overturned in a field in Markgrafneusiedl, the driver was injured and required rescue services.
An 18-year-old woman fell 2.75 meters during roofing and plumbing work, receiving unquantified injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.
A burning gasoline canister was found and extinguished near a kindergarten in Pucking; no injuries occurred, and a witness reported hearing someone fleeing.
An 88-year-old wrong-way driver on the A7 was stopped with the help of other drivers, avoiding any accidents.
Head-on collision between two cars left two injured, requiring one victim to be freed by firefighters and hospitalized while the other refused medical treatment.
Three men were apprehended after attempting to flee from a police check in Wels and subsequently applied for asylum.
Police and firefighters extinguished a car fire in Linz, ensuring no injuries occurred.
A farm building in Schäffern caught fire at night; no one was injured. Firefighters managed to control the blaze and prevent it from spreading to a nearby residential house.
A car driven by an 18-year-old Austrian overturned on the Fernpass road near Bichlbach, causing minor injuries to the driver; the vehicle was totaled.
Unknown perpetrators stole motors and accessories for roller doors from a construction site in Vomperbach, causing significant financial damage.
A construction worker suffered an eye injury from a broken screwdriver during excavation work in Au, Bregenzerwald.
A phone scam targeting elderly individuals in Wiener Neustadt involved impostors pretending to be police officers to obtain money or valuables; all cases were attempted frauds.
A 28-year-old man stole a car key and wallet from a house in Desselbrunn, attempted to take the car but was caught nearby by police.
Unknown perpetrators damaged graves and religious items at a cemetery in Klaus, Austria.
An apartment fire in Graz was caused by a defective cable, leading to property damage but no injuries. Nearby residents were evacuated, and the fire was extinguished promptly.
Police responded to a domestic incident in Schwendau, discovered drugs in the apartment, and four individuals were reported for drug law violations.

A 61-year-old woman fell while attempting to mount her e-bike after an unknown car driver abruptly moved, causing her to brake abruptly. The driver fled the scene despite the woman sustaining a severe hand injury.
A bronze sculpture of a flamingo by a Japanese artist was stolen from a property in Krumpendorf.
A car accident in Adlwang left two dead and one injured after the vehicle veered off the road and crashed into a tree; the driver was found to have been under the influence of alcohol.
An 18-year-old Austrian woman fell asleep with a burning cigarette, leading to a fire in her bedroom; she was found unconscious and taken to the hospital.
Three men attempted to steal a car in Vienna, threatening the owner with a knife, and were arrested after a brief chase; weapons and drugs were found in their possession.
A 29-year-old man was seriously injured by a falling tree during logging work in Maria Rain.
A 53-year-old driver collided with a garbage truck, injuring a 41-year-old workers leg in Untertullnerbach, Bezirk St. Pölten-Land.
Police conducted moped inspections in Wals, focusing on technical modifications, resulting in several charges including excessive speed.
A 71-year-old homeless man died after being accidentally compacted in a recycling truck in Wals.
A multi-party residential building caught fire early in the morning, likely originating from the heating system; no injuries reported.
A taxi driver lost control of her vehicle in Innsbruck, hitting a traffic island and a lamppost, injuring herself and her two passengers.

A 17-year-old woman without a valid driving license caused a car accident on Waidischer Landesstraße in Bezirk Klagenfurt while driving under the influence. The accident resulted in injuries to her and one 18-year-old passenger, with the car severely damaged.
A 40-year-old man attacked and injured a 35-year-old man with a pocket knife in Voitsberg; police arrested the suspect.
A police officer was slightly injured by a dog bite after entering an apartment for an investigation in Vienna.
A worker was seriously injured during demolition work at a spa in Bad Eisenkappel when a metal pipe unexpectedly struck him.
A 17-year-old driver fell asleep at the wheel, causing a car crash that resulted in injuries and significant vehicle damage in Feldkirchen.
An 84-year-old man and his car collided with a freight train at an unguarded railway crossing in St. Andrä/Lav., causing his death and injuring his wife.
A hunting lodge in Furth an der Triesting was completely destroyed by fire; no injuries were reported.
A confrontation occurred in Wels between a 24-year-old and a 47-year-old in a fast-food restaurant parking lot, where the younger man struck the other on the head, causing him to fall.
A 27-year-old mountain biker fell off a steep path in Niederkappel, sustaining injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 20-year-old roofer fell from a roof and sustained injuries, requiring airlift to a hospital.
A 15-year-old girl admitted to multiple arson incidents, with one person attempting to set a plant pot on fire. The perpetrators were caught and tested positive for THC.
A fire broke out on the terrace of a house in Straßwalchen, damaging furniture and the facade, with no injuries reported. Firefighters extinguished the fire after around one hour.
Protesters blocked a municipal road in Koppl using slow driving and fake breakdowns, causing traffic disruption until police intervention.
A drunk man in Graz was arrested after resisting police, attacking an officer, and being found with knives and marijuana.
A 46-year-old man was seriously injured fixing a truck crane in Raaba-Grambach, sustaining severe chest and abdominal injuries.
A carport with vehicles caught fire in Eibiswald, causing damage of around 100,000 euros. No injuries were reported.
Phone scammers in Kitzbühel, Tyrol impersonate police officers to extract money and valuables from victims.
A heavily intoxicated cyclist fell into a creek in Schwarzach and was rescued by bystanders; taken to hospital with injuries.
A firearm accidentally discharged in Vorarlberg, injuring a 57-year-old man who was shot in the abdomen during a gathering.
Three young men caused severe property damage at Nenzing train station by breaking glass, damaging a ticket machine, and stealing snacks and drinks from a vending machine.
A collision occurred between a car driver and a cyclist on Gutheil-Schoder-Gasse, resulting in injuries to the cyclist who was hospitalized.
A parking enforcement officer was slightly injured by a cars side mirror as the driver drove away without stopping, after being approached for illegal parking.
A man physically assaulted and threatened his partner, was arrested by the police, and a protective order was issued. The victim was taken to the hospital.
A 36-year-old man was observed selling drugs, later arrested, with drugs and cash found in his apartment.
Several people were found gathering in a company location without adhering to Covid-19 safety regulations including masks and distancing; they were reported and dispersed.
A 31-year-old man crashed his car into a tree near Klagenfurt after losing control, was injured, and tested positive for alcohol. The car was totaled.
A 31-year-old man collided unbraked with a truck on the A2 Südautobahn, resulting in injury and substantial vehicle damage.
Numerous violations were found during heavy vehicle inspections, including technical faults, overloaded vehicles, and safety issues, resulting in fines and travel bans.
Two women were injured in a traffic accident involving a bus and two cars in Gloggnitz.
A car and motorcycle collided at the intersection of Herzogbergstraße and Tirolerhofallee in Perchtoldsdorf, resulting in injuries to the motorcyclist.
Police officers saved a 60-year-old woman from a suicide attempt after tracking her location using social media and phone data.
A woman involved in a parking lot accident in Schwanenstadt was found to have a blood alcohol level of 2.62 promille after contacting police; her license was confiscated.
A Slovenian forestry worker was injured in Scheffau by a rolling tree rootstock; rescue teams transported him to the hospital.
Hydraulic oil leaked into a water canal and a stream in Leoben; firefighters installed oil barriers to contain and remove the spill.
An 83-year-old man died after his tractor overturned while spreading slurry on a steep field.

A German citizen allegedly committed online fraud by offering Labrador puppies for sale. A 59-year-old man from Graz-Umgebung was misled into paying several thousand euros for supposed transport fees.
An aggressive driver followed another car, leading to a physical assault by a passenger who injured the victims face and neck.
A man bit a driving school owner in Innsbruck during a police incident that revealed the mans wife was using hidden devices to cheat on a driving test.

A collision occurred on the A 12 in Langkampfen when a van driver failed to stop and crashed into a stationary truck, leaving the van driver severely injured and requiring rescue by the fire department.

A 23-year-old man, after being informed about a vehicle violation, attempted to flee dangerously, endangering police officers, and was later found to be under drug influence and involved in theft and fuel fraud.
Three burglaries occurred in Sillian, Heinfels, and Strassen, with cash stolen in one instance and property damage in others.
A secretary in Zirl was tricked into transferring money via a fake email pretending to address an outstanding invoice.
A 36-year-old woman followed a 77-year-old from an ATM to a parking garage, attacked her by choking, and stole her wallet. The suspect was later apprehended and linked to another theft.
Police arrested a 29-year-old man in Vienna-Favoriten after discovering weapons, drugs, and dangerous items in his apartment.
A man driving with his girlfriend was assaulted by a passenger from another car following a road rage incident near Hall in Tirol.
Multiple arrests and charges following police-related fraud incidents targeting elderly victims in Lower Austria.
Police organized controls for mandatory COVID-19 tests for individuals traveling out of the Bregenzerwald region.
A 30-year-old intoxicated driver crashed into a parked car, causing considerable damage, and a pedestrian was slightly injured while evading the accident.
A roof fire occurred in Weiden am See. All residents were safely evacuated, and the fire was contained without injuries. A part of the roof was heavily damaged and had to be dismantled.
A 15-year-old boy riding a moped lost control, went off the road, and fell into a field, sustaining injuries.
A car attempting to overtake a truck collided with an oncoming vehicle and the truck, causing injuries to one driver and significant damage to vehicles and roadside infrastructure.
A fire broke out in a residential construction area in Lendorf, suspected to have been caused by a battery for a construction site radio.
Six vehicles in Villach Landskron were damaged by unknown perpetrators, with side mirrors broken and windshield wipers bent.
Police broke up a noisy apartment party in Linz involving a drunk resident and ten others.
A drug-impaired moped driver with stolen license plates was apprehended on the A23 motorway in Vienna.
A man damaged a neighbors window and threatened him and his partner after a dispute during a gathering involving alcohol consumption.
An 18-year-old motorcyclist was caught speeding at 112 km/h in a 50 km/h zone, attempted to evade police, and was eventually stopped; his license was revoked and vehicle defects noted.
A Romanian citizen was caught at the Suben border checkpoint with a forged French registration document; the vehicle registration and plates were confiscated.
Police officers rescued a dehydrated and weakened elderly woman from her home in Bezirk Gmunden, providing first aid until the arrival of the emergency doctor.
An 81-year-old man lost control of his vehicle, resulting in a crash into a brook bed, causing damage to road signs and himself sustaining unspecified injuries.
A car collided with a cyclist in Salzburg, causing minor injuries to the cyclist.
A traffic dispute near Salzburg Hauptbahnhof escalated into a dangerous threat involving a 22-year-old man defending his girlfriend.
A 34-year-old motorcyclist was injured in a collision with a car entering the B113 road in Gaishorn am See.
A 59-year-old fell from a roof while installing a roof window blind, sustaining indeterminate injuries, and was airlifted to a hospital in Graz.
A man impersonated an officer and conducted a fake traffic stop in Lienz; he fled when questioned.
Burning of cleared branches on a clearing in Rankweil; fire quickly extinguished, no injuries or spread to trees.
A 67-year-old man fell 55 meters from a rock plateau near a chapel into the Bregenzerach riverbed and sustained severe injuries before being rescued by helicopter.
Police arrested a man suspected of motorcycle theft and resisting arrest; he attempted to punch an officer and injured two others with kicks.
Two Romanian men were arrested by police in Vienna for shoplifting items worth approximately €3,300, including perfume and cosmetics, after being observed by a store detective.
Kitchen fire caused by an electrical defect destroyed kitchen furnishings and damaged other rooms; no injuries reported.
A tractor caught fire on a farm in Unteramlach, Kärnten and was extinguished by firefighters.
A truck trailer caught fire at a gas station in Grafenwörth, leading to an explosion that injured the driver.
A woman in Linz thwarted an attempted car theft by confronting and hitting one of the thieves, causing them to flee.
A railway worker in Wels, Austria was seriously injured when he stumbled and had his foot run over by a moving railcar during coupling operations.
A 17-year-old provisional license holder was stopped by a motorcycle patrol in Edt bei Lambach and tested positive for drug influence, leading to the temporary surrender of his license.
A 16-year-old male attempted to assault officers during a control in Linz, and others tried to interfere with the arrest, requiring police reinforcements to de-escalate the situation.
Driver in Mittersill was caught without a valid license and a small amount of drugs was found in the vehicle.
A man threatened another with a knife after an argument at Salzburg main station and was subsequently arrested by police.
A 15-year-old moped driver collided with a car after an emergency stop caused by a risky overtaking move by an oncoming truck.
A 15-year-old moped rider collided with a 70-year-old cyclist, causing injuries to both. The moped rider suffered serious injuries and was taken to the hospital.
A car collided with a train in St. Johann in der Haide, injuring the 51-year-old train driver and the 52-year-old car driver slightly, while train passengers remained uninjured.
An oil spill occurred when a transformer fell during loading operations, releasing transformer oil into nearby waterways. Firefighters erected oil barriers, and no damages have been reported so far.
A 72-year-old cyclist collided head-on with a car on a local road in Fritzens and was injured, while the car driver remained unharmed.
An open shed used as a garbage house burned down completely in Wildschönau/Roggenboden. The fire did not spread to a nearby farm. The cause of the fire is under investigation.
A car and two cyclists collided in Pettnau, causing minor injuries and damage to one bicycle.
A 25-year-old truck driver was injured during loading work in Ötz involving aluminum beams and wooden planks.
A 56-year-old driver lost control of his vehicle on Walgaustraße, causing it to overturn multiple times. He was injured and tested positive for alcohol. The car was totaled.
A 62-year-old man unintentionally started a fire while clearing brush, which spread as a smoldering fire in a nearby forest. Firefighters extinguished the fire, preventing significant damage.
A motorcycle was stolen from a parking lot in Innsbruck between April 21 and April 22, with only some parts left behind.
Two teenagers were arrested in Laßnitzhöhe for aggressive behavior and possession of drugs after causing a disturbance on a train.
Unknown perpetrators stole insulation panels and sealing sheets from a construction site in Vomperbach causing damage in the three-digit euro range.
A man sneaked into a house in Dornbirn and was caught stealing a drill after alerting residents when it fell; he was detained by a resident until police arrived.
A Turkish man was arrested in Vienna for suspected drug dealing with marijuana and cash seized during a house search.
A 2-year-old girl fell out of a first-floor window while playing in Vienna-Penzing and suffered severe head injuries.

Two men were arrested in Leibnitz for producing and selling approximately 24 kg of marijuana, valued at 240,000 euros. They financed their lifestyle through drug dealing, including rent, luxury vacations, and personal drug use. Police uncovered their activities after discovering indoor plantations. Both men are in custody, one confessed, the other refused to testify.
A trailer containing lithium-ion batteries, lawnmowers, and other equipment caught fire near a roundabout in Telfs; no injuries reported.
Police warn about a scam in which victims are tricked into paying a fake insurance fee for a fabricated prize.
Aggressive and intoxicated party guests in Bezirk Perg led to police being called, with additional units needed due to escalating aggression and Covid-19 violations.
A container caught fire in Straßwalchen, and police used a fire extinguisher to control the flames until the fire brigade arrived.
A 69-year-old man lost control of his vineyard tractor, overturning down a 50-meter slope and sustaining injuries before being airlifted to the hospital.
Two teenagers were apprehended for stealing bicycles, including one identified by its owner.
A driver was found under the influence of drugs during a vehicle inspection, leading to a search that uncovered cash, cannabis, and cocaine, suggesting suspected drug dealing.
Two men were temporarily arrested after a theft in newspaper vending machines and two machines were found in their possession.
A worker sustained head injuries when a loader sled slipped downhill and struck his excavator during hillside stabilization work.
A cyclist in St. Margareten was hit by a car, resulting in injuries and requiring airlift evacuation.
A motorcycle collided with a car in Bergland, causing injuries to the motorcyclist.
An 18-year-old and his companion were assaulted and threatened with an air gun in Wiener Neustadt over an old dispute. Four suspects were detained, and several air guns were confiscated.
A motorcyclist collided with a deer in Kirchschlag in der Buckligen Welt and was injured.

Driver was stopped at a border check in Suben and found without a valid driving license. His passenger presented a counterfeit Turkish driving license and attempted to continue the trip to Vienna. Both individuals were reported to authorities.
A paraglider crashed after a short flight, falling about 20 meters and being injured.
A Czech national convicted of two robberies was located and arrested in Marchtrenk, Austria.
18-year-old woman crashed her car into a bridge foundation and was injured; her vehicle was totaled.
A car collision involving multiple vehicles resulted in injuries to three individuals in the Rohrbach district.
A 42-year-old snowboarder in Weißbach bei Lofer fell into a sinkhole during his descent and was later found dead by rescue teams.
A 16-year-old on a learners driving permit was caught speeding at 137 km/h in an 80 km/h zone with his mother as the accompanying driver, resulting in legal action.

A 27-year-old man was caught attempting to break into a vending machine at a train station in Frohnleiten, using a stone to smash the glass. He was arrested, and a suspicious substance was found in his possession.
A 33-year-old driver hit a pedestrian on a crosswalk in Graz, causing severe injuries to the womans hand.
Nine Egyptian men were apprehended in Feldkirchen; they sought asylum and were taken to the detention center in Graz.
Motorcycle accident on the Brennerstraße in Mutters; motorcyclist seriously injured after collision with a car.

A 27-year-old Austrian fell victim to unauthorized withdrawals from his bank account after engaging with a fraudulent link and sharing codes. Most transactions were reversed, leaving a loss in the low four-digit euro range.
A 50-year-old man fell from a flat roof while working on a construction site in Bregenz and sustained severe injuries.
A car driven by a 39-year-old man collided head-on with another car on L 48 in Schwarzenberg, causing injuries to three individuals, while the cyclist involved was uninjured.
Police warn about phishing scams targeting online banking users with fraudulent push notifications to steal account access.
A man threatened to kill and assaulted his partner. He was arrested with a small quantity of drugs, and the victim was slightly injured.
Authorities conducted heavy traffic and hazardous materials inspections in Vienna, leading to multiple violations and penalties.
A 44-year-old gardener fell from a height of six meters during tree trimming in Spittal/Drau and was injured, requiring airlift to a hospital.
A 92-year-old woman in Klagenfurt lost control of her car, left the road, hit two trees, and was hospitalized with unspecified injuries.
Oil spill on a road and nearby lake in Ebensee required extensive cleanup and traffic redirection.
A 17-year-old driver overturned her car after leaving the road in Schiedlberg, sustaining injuries and being hospitalized.
A fire broke out in a building in Bezirk Grieskirchen; extinguishing efforts were difficult due to flammable materials and caused water pollution in a nearby stream.

A 66-year-old woman lost control of her car due to poor visibility and hail, flipping the vehicle into a lake. Passersby rescued her from the partially submerged car using a Stanley knife to cut her seatbelt. The woman was unharmed, and the car was later recovered by firefighters.
Lightning struck workers during snow clearing on Schafbergspitze, injuring five.
An apartment in Salzburg was broken into via a tilted window, and a small amount of money was stolen.
Two separate fires broke out at garbage collection sites in Graz, Bezirk Gries; one was extinguished by passersby and the other by the fire brigade, with no injuries reported.
