An apartment in Neumarkt in Steiermark caught fire in the early morning. No injuries were reported. Firefighters extinguished the fire, and investigation into the cause began.
A man threatened a passerby with a firearm at Südtiroler Platz in Innsbruck.
A 19-year-old driver lost control of his car on a wet road in Kramsach, causing it to hit a rock and overturn. The driver was uninjured, but the car was heavily damaged.
A moped collided with a car on Pontenstraße in Lustenau, resulting in minor injuries to the moped rider.
A 24-year-old man sustained serious head injuries during logging work in Eichenberg when part of a tree trunk broke off and struck him, requiring airlift to the hospital.
A 41-year-old man in Bruck an der Leitha displayed aggressive behavior, assaulted a police officer, damaged property at the police station, and made threats. He showed signs of alcohol use.
A 30-year-old man was arrested in Graz under an international warrant for committing armed robbery in Bosnia and Herzegovina in 2015 and submitting a forged document in Austria for marriage purposes.
A 41-year-old man in Hall i.T. became aggressive after falling, threatening paramedics, damaging an ambulance, and confronting police.
A 40-year-old man entered a residential building in Dornbirn, wandered in an apartment without searching it, took two watches, and was arrested by police after being locked inside by the residents.
Two men in Lochau were found in possession of a softgun and various drugs; weapon prohibition issued and charges filed under narcotics law.
A man in Innsbruck threatened a pedestrian with a gun, later identified as a toy gun, claiming it was meant as a joke.
A man threatened a passerby with a gun at Südtiroler Platz in Innsbruck, later claiming the weapon was a toy.
Unidentified individuals attempted to break into a parking ticket machine in Haiming but failed to access the money, causing significant damage to the machine.
Unknown perpetrators broke into newspaper stand cash boxes in Feldkirch-Gisingen, stealing small amounts of money.
A 25-year-old man admitted to starting fires in Wopfing, causing multiple woodpiles to burn, but the fires were controlled quickly.
An 18-year-old intoxicated driver collided with parked cars, causing minor injuries to a 17-year-old passenger.
A fire broke out in a barn of a farm complex in Nötsch; the building was destroyed, and firefighters prevented further spread in the residential area.
A 27-year-old woman from Vienna died after her car crashed into a tree on the LB 36 road in the Zwettl district.
Fire broke out in a refrigerated truck carrying dairy products, likely due to a technical defect, and was extinguished by the fire department; no injuries reported.
A small truck slid off the road, crashed into a guardrail, and avoided falling at Zirlerberg, Zirl; driver unharmed but vehicle totaled.
A 4-year-old girl fell from the window of a 6th-floor apartment in Siebenhirten, Vienna, and despite immediate medical assistance, her life could not be saved.
A forest fire in Stegersbach damaged 1500 m2 of woodland and a hunting structure; cause unknown, no injuries reported.
Fire broke out on a raspberry plantation due to the burning of old canes that spread to plastic containers and irrigation hoses; no injuries reported.
A 54-year-old motorcyclist was injured in a traffic accident in Eisenstadt when a 19-year-old car driver failed to notice them during a turn, leading to a collision.
An unknown assailant held a knife to a 21-year-olds neck and demanded his belongings in Klagenfurt; the attacker fled after being interrupted by a passerby throwing a drink can.
A driver in Klagenfurt threatened pedestrians with a knife during a dispute about his parking behavior before fleeing the scene.
A 250 kg US aerial bomb was found during excavation in Villach. Residents were evacuated and the bomb was defused and removed.
A dead deer with a gunshot wound was found in a forest area, suspected to be a case of poaching. This is the third similar incident in a month.
A 19-year-old without a driving license struck a 74-year-old cyclist with her car in Eggendorf, causing serious injuries.
A collision occurred between two vehicles in Ferschnitz, resulting in injuries to both drivers.
A 61-year-old man drove off the road, overturned, and hit trees in Bezirk Neunkirchen; he was found to be intoxicated with 1.48 per mill and sustained minor injuries.
A 55-year-old man fell from his e-bike and sustained serious injuries, resulting in hospitalization.

Three drunk drivers were apprehended in Vöcklabruck and Linz, Austria, two in St. Georgen im Attergau on April 23, 2020, and one in Linz on April 24, 2020. Their blood alcohol levels ranged from 1.26 to 1.96 promille.
An 84-year-old driver failed to yield and collided with a motorcycle in Hinzenbach, causing injuries to the 54-year-old motorcyclist and significant damage to both vehicles.
An 85-year-old woman driving a light quadricycle mistakenly entered a highway and drove against traffic direction before being safely stopped.
A fire ignited in a dry meadow in Mariazell due to sparks from maintenance work; no injuries reported.
A passerby spotted a forest fire and alerted firefighters, who quickly controlled the fire; no injuries reported.
A 45-year-old man in Sellrain injured his hand on a lawn tractors blade while performing cleaning work.
An 8-year-old girl riding an e-scooter collided with a car and was injured while navigating a municipal road.

A rear-end collision occurred in Wattens on Innsbrucker Straße, involving an 18-year-old driver and a 79-year-old driver. Both drivers and a 1-year-old child were injured, and the vehicles sustained significant damage.

A 67-year-old Austrian man died from severe head injuries during tree-felling work in Erpfendorf when the tree fell on him; a friend alerted authorities after significant delays due to lack of cellphone reception.
A man attempted to extinguish burning oil with water, causing a grease explosion that damaged his apartment and injured him.
A fire broke out in the engine area of an excavator on Hahntennjochstraße, Imst. The driver moved the vehicle to a safe area and firefighters extinguished the blaze.
A 79-year-old cyclist was injured in a collision with a van on Höchsterstraße in Dornbirn.

A motorcyclist attempted to overtake vehicles on the Balderschwangerstraße L5 in Hittisau, but lost control while braking to avoid a turning truck, resulting in a severe crash with a post. The rider sustained serious injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.

Two men resisted police during a COVID-19 regulation check in Hohenems. They acted aggressively, refused compliance, and threatened officers, leading to their arrest. Both men were later released and will face charges.
An oil spill from a truck caused pollution on a road in Höchst, resulting in a cleanup by the fire department and road authority.
A man wanted for allegedly threatening a justice officer in October 2020 was apprehended by police at the Hauptbahnhof station in Vienna.
An intoxicated man without a required mask acted aggressively in a supermarket and attacked police officers, injuring one and damaging equipment.
A fire in a Vienna apartment led to the death of a 55-year-old man and smoke inhalation injuries to two police officers.
A collision occurred between a truck and a cyclist in Vienna, resulting in severe injuries for the cyclist.
A 24-year-old motorcyclist lost control on the B56 Geschriebensteinstraße and sustained injuries after crashing into a roadside ditch.
A 27-year-old car driver collided with a 67-year-old motorcyclist at a junction in Brückl, causing the motorcyclist to fall and sustain injuries of an unspecified severity.
A 37-year-old Romanian man was arrested in Ried im Innkreis for serving a prison sentence after being wanted for misappropriation in Romania in 2016.
A drunk driver collided with a police officers vehicle, attempted to flee, but was later apprehended and found to have a blood alcohol level of 3.04‰.
A 23-year-old Syrian man displayed aggressive behavior towards police, resisted arrest, and caused injuries during a disturbance in Leibnitz; he was later detained with additional police support.
A man was seriously injured by a falling branch during forestry work in Sankt Ruprecht an der Raab.

A man floating in the Mur River was rescued by emergency services after being noticed by passersby; a second man who tried to assist was also saved. Both individuals survived, with one heavily undercooled.
During a football match in Innsbruck, pyrotechnics ignited by a group caused fires on the stadium roof and nearby hedges, leading to a game interruption and fire department intervention.
A construction worker in Baumkirchen was injured by a falling concrete ceiling during renovation work.
A 23-year-old man was injured when trying to secure falling steel plates on a company premises in Ebbs.
A 53-year-old Italian woman attempted to transport three Yemeni men without valid visas towards Germany; men requested asylum.
A house in Gaissau caught fire with concerns that a 61-year-old woman might still be inside the property which was completely destroyed along with nearby vehicles and properties being damaged.
Two cars collided on L 87 in Bludesch, Austria, causing minor injuries to both drivers and two passengers; no alcohol was involved.
Apartment fire in Lustenau caused by a cigarette; no injuries, only property damage.
A 50-kg Rottweiler named Donna fell into a pool and couldnt get out. Police used a ladder and a catch pole to rescue her and handed her over to animal rescue due to unreachable owners.
A 36-year-old man threatened his 76-year-old landlord with a knife over missing cash, was heavily intoxicated, and was subdued and arrested by police.
A Somali man assaulted an Austrian woman during a dispute, causing injuries to her face and nose in Innsbruck. The man fled but was later apprehended and received a restraining order.
Violation of COVID-19 regulations in a bar in Klagenfurt a.W.; 10 guests found without masks consuming drinks.
Drunk driver in St. Pölten district ignored police stop, sped at least 50 km/h over the limit, and was arrested after a chase; breath test showed 1.7 promille.
A 22-year-old driver turning towards a parking area on L 109 in Bergern collided with an oncoming cyclist due to the low sun. The cyclist suffered severe injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.
An elderly woman walking her dogs was physically assaulted by another woman who kicked and punched her after a confrontation involving loose dogs.
A planned gathering at Albertinaplatz, Vienna, was prohibited due to concerns over non-compliance with COVID-19 safety measures and potential overcrowding.
A 24-year-old male driver died after his car veered off the road, went down a steep embankment, and hit a tree in Raach/Hochgebirge, Bezirk Neunkirchen.

A 25-year-old man lost control of his vehicle and collided with a traffic light in Leoben after reportedly consuming alcohol; he was uninjured, but the car was totaled and his license was provisionally revoked.
A forest fire in Kennelbach/Bregenz affected 3000 sqm due to suspected discarded cigarette during a dry period; no injuries reported.
A 15-year-old fell from a two-meter-high scaffold during roof work and was hospitalized with injuries.
A 17-year-old moped rider severely injured after crashing on Waxenberg Straße in Bezirk Urfahr-Umgebung.
Unidentified individuals broke into a clothing store in Innsbruck during the night but fled without loot upon being noticed by a witness.
Two individuals attacked a roommate and one tried to hit a policeman during an intervention at a shared apartment; one suspect was arrested and another reported.
A fire incident occurred in an apartment in Völkermarkt where a 77-year-old wheelchair-bound man was rescued after a smoke and smoldering fire in a metal bucket was detected.
A 40-year-old man in Liebenfels was injured while handling a firework in a metal barrel that caused an explosion, sending the barrel against his arm resulting in injuries.
A 53-year-old man injured his leg with a chainsaw while performing forestry work in Krumbach.
A 13-year-old boy fell six meters near a castle in Waidhofen an der Ybbs and was injured.
A 19-year-old motorcyclist fell and was injured while driving through Altenmarkt/Triesting; he was airlifted to a hospital.
A 23-year-old driver was lightly injured in a car crash caused by a 33-year-old man with a BAC of 0.86‰; the latter had his license revoked.
A Wallaby was found near a road in Unterach am Attersee and was captured and cared for by a gamekeeper after being reported to the police.
A 20-year-old Nigerian man attempted to evade arrest in Linz by fleeing during a police operation, injuring an officer, before being captured after a chase involving multiple units.
An intoxicated driver lost control of his vehicle near a bridge, damaging a railing and the car, and fled to a parking lot before being caught by police.
A small fire caused by discarded cigarette stubs was extinguished near the Moosgrabenbrücke in Unternberg.
A hedge fire in Salzburg-Maxglan destroyed a thuja hedge and spread to a garden shed; no foreign culpability suspected.
A forest fire in Heimschuh, Leibnitz District, burned 200 square meters due to a technical defect in an electrical distributor; no one was injured.
A 31-year-old motorcyclist was seriously injured after crashing off the road and hitting a slope in Stadl-Predlitz, Murau district.
A three-year-old boy injured his hand while playing with a brick on a construction site and was airlifted to a hospital.
Motorcyclist collided with a car and fell, sustaining injuries.
A construction crane collapsed in Tristach, damaging the construction site, a nearby house, and a truck, but no serious injuries were reported.
Fire in a chimney at a guesthouse in Angerberg controlled by local firefighters and a chimney sweep, with no significant damage reported.
A truck carrying 30,000 liters of diesel fuel experienced a tire blowout in the Pfändertunnel, causing damage to a passing car and requiring a two-hour highway closure for fuel transfer operations.
A hiker got lost in steep terrain near Thüringerberg/Thälispitze and was rescued unharmed by a police helicopter.
A man attempted to abduct a 3-year-old child from a mother in Vienna, assaulted her, but was later apprehended.
A woman in Vienna-Brigittenau injured her partner with a knife; she was intoxicated and arrested, while the victim was hospitalized.
Police identified a gathering of vehicles from the GTI scene in a supermarket parking lot; participants were fined for violating Covid-19 curfew restrictions.
A womans e-bike battery caused a fire in the utility room of her house; the battery was removed and extinguished by firefighters, with no injuries reported.
A 19-year-old driver caused a car accident on Drautalstraße, injuring himself, his passenger, and another driver; both cars were heavily damaged.
A 64-year-old man fell from an aluminum ladder while working on his driveway, hitting a parked car and then the asphalt, leading to severe injuries requiring airlift to the hospital.
Motorcycle collision during overtaking maneuver involving a tractor in Himberg results in injuries. A woman was airlifted to the hospital.
Two vehicles collided on the B 127 after one braked abruptly due to an animal, causing injuries to two individuals; one driver had a blood alcohol level of 0.58 per mille.
An intoxicated driver in Austria drove onto train tracks, causing disruption until rescued by emergency services.
Two Afghan nationals were found walking on the A8 motorway near Wels without travel documents, later detained and applied for asylum.
Four women assaulted and robbed a 26-year-old Bulgarian woman and a 21-year-old Somali man in Linz, stealing various items and causing physical injuries.
A 67-year-old motorcyclist died in a crash on B 120 near Pettenbach after losing control and leaving the road.
A drunk driver in Salzburg caused a rear-end collision and was found to have a blood alcohol level of 2.08‰; his driving license was confiscated.
Multiple drivers in Salzburg found under drug influence during traffic checks; licenses confiscated and driving banned.
Intoxicated driver in Salzburg stopped with a defective vehicle; charged and vehicle impounded.
A 74-year-old homeowner was severely injured in a residential house fire in Krispl, Hallein district, and transported to the hospital via helicopter.
Lithuanian minibus caught fire on highway A1 near Salzburg, no injuries reported.
A police officer in Leibnitz was lightly injured after being grazed by a fleeing motorcycle during a traffic stop attempt.
A 45-year-old man sustained serious injuries after slipping and falling on a large stone near his fishing hut.

A seven-year-old girl was injured of unspecified severity after falling downhill approximately 95 meters while riding a bike and jumping over a two-meter-high wall. She was airlifted to a hospital for treatment.
A 56-year-old German glider pilot made an emergency landing in Pusterwald, Austria due to a suspected engine failure. The landing caused minor damage to the aircraft, but the pilot was unharmed.
A 39-year-old man fell from a ladder at a house in Passail while working on a network installation, sustaining unspecified injuries.

A 58-year-old motorcyclist suffered severe injuries in a collision with a car driven by a 58-year-old woman in Gnas. The helicopter transported the motorcyclist to a hospital, and the car driver, in shock, was hospitalized as well.
A 300 sqm forest slope fire occurred near Klausbach in Pfaffenhofen, involving a steep cliff and requiring substantial resources including firefighters and helicopters.
Police disbanded an unauthorized outdoor party in Ampass with 150-200 participants, many of whom fled; alcohol consumption and violations of Covid regulations were noted.
A dryer caught fire in a multi-family house, causing smoke damage and injuring a 19-year-old who was treated for smoke inhalation.

A high-speed police chase in Dornbirn ended with a collision. A 16-year-old driver without a license and his accomplice evaded police, broke through roadblocks, and collided with a police car. They admitted to previously stealing license plates.
A motorcycle collided with three other motorcycles and a car in Sulz, injuring the rider.
Motorcyclist crashed on Faschinastraße, collided with a curb and stone wall, sustained severe injuries, and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 42-year-old man was apprehended by police and a service dog at a company site in Neudörfl where he attempted theft using an unauthorized key.
A 19-year-old drove recklessly on the B18 in Hirtenberg, ignoring traffic rules and police signals before being stopped by police.
Unknown offenders broke car windows in an underground garage in Traun and stole items including watches, cigarettes, and a pocket knife.
A 60-year-old hiker fell at Steineck mountain in St. Konrad, getting seriously injured; rescue teams and a helicopter transported him to the hospital.
Police in Vorderweißenbach discovered over 100 kilograms of smuggled meat worth €1,500 in a Moldovan transporter during a border inspection and handed it over to customs authorities.
Four women committed multiple robberies and assaults in Linz involving threats, beatings, and theft of personal belongings, targeting several victims; they were arrested afterwards.
A 16-year-old moped driver collided with a car, resulting in serious injuries; she was airlifted to a hospital.

A kitchen fire occurred in Neusiedl am See, possibly caused by a stove left on accidentally, leading to smoke inhalation injuries for the resident and a neighbor, with the fire extinguished before firefighters arrived.

A 30-year-old Austrian male and a 35-year-old Moroccan male committed multiple thefts and break-ins in Innsbruck and Wattens using a stolen car, leading to a police chase and their arrest in Brixlegg.
A 75-year-old man fell from a ladder in his barn and was airlifted to a hospital after sustaining injuries.
A 20-year-old Afghan man assaulted a 25-year-old Afghan man in Klagenfurt, causing facial injuries. The victim was hospitalized, and the suspect was arrested after attempting to flee.
17-year-old driver without a license and under the influence of alcohol veered off the road and crashed into a tree, resulting in the death of a 15-year-old passenger and injury to the driver.
A 58-year-old man had a severe motorcycle accident on a curve in Voitsberg and was hospitalized.
Three individuals damaged side mirrors of seven vehicles in Innsbruck and fled the scene.
Multiple drivers caught for drastic speeding in Vienna during a traffic inspection.
A couple was rescued after getting stuck in steep terrain during a hike on Radsberg in Ebenthal i.K.

Police responded to a domestic violence incident in Villach where both parties were injured and under the influence of alcohol. A restraining order was issued against the man after allegations of assault were made by both individuals.
A 35-year-old man and a 35-year-old woman were involved in a dispute. The man acted aggressively towards police and tried to punch an officer but was arrested.
An Austrian citizen discovered a World War II-era mortar grenade during garden work. Authorities secured the area, and the explosive device was safely removed by experts.

Two Azerbaijani nationals allegedly insulted, attacked a market vendor, damaged his stand, and assaulted a relative who tried to help. Police arrested them, and one suspect resisted by attempting to headbutt an officer.
A 41-year-old woman fell during a hike in a remote forest area in Wolfsberg and injured her leg on a branch, requiring rescue and hospital treatment.
A 59-year-old woman from Wolfsberg crashed into the right guardrail on the A2 highway near the Jerolitschbrücke after a sudden health issue and was transported to Klagenfurt hospital by air rescue.
A 48-year-old cyclist fell into oncoming traffic on a road in Wolfsberg and collided with a car, sustaining injuries.
A 25-year-old man without a valid driver’s license or helmet crashed a non-registered motorbike in Arbesthal, sustaining serious injuries.
A man was caught and arrested after attempting to break into a recycling center in Krems an der Donau.
A 52-year-old man died after being buried by collapsing earth during construction work in Scheibbs.
A 19-year-old motorcyclist in Melk District, Austria, crashed off the road, suffering injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.
A fire likely caused by a tractors technical defect severely damaged a barn and stable, with 8 bulls perishing.
A 50-year-old man committed a store theft in Gmunden, fled when the alarm sounded, physically resisted pursuers, but was eventually detained and handed over to the police.
A car driver failed to notice a motorcyclist resulting in a collision, causing injuries to the motorcyclists foot.
Three men attempted to smuggle six grams of cannabis into a prison in Asten, Linz-Land, but were caught by police after being seen by a guard and fleeing.
A 53-year-old man was severely injured when his minibus veered off the road, hitting a sewer shaft and crashing into a tree.
A 22-year-old man reported being attacked and robbed by an unknown individual in the city center of Liezen on a Saturday night.
Two hikers were stranded in alpine winter conditions and rescued by emergency services without injuries.
Two motorcyclists collided head-on in a curve on the B24, both were injured and airlifted to hospitals.
A fire occurred on the balcony of a house in Kainach bei Voitsberg, Austria; no injuries were reported and the cause is unknown.
Collision between a car and a motorcycle resulted in injuries to the motorcycle rider and his passenger.
Two Austrian teenagers attacked police officers during a drug-related investigation in Sillian, injuring two officers; drugs were found in the apartment.
A man was seriously injured in Karres when a horse kicked him while being hitched to a carriage.
A fire broke out in a garden compost bin in Innsbruck Arzl, likely due to self-ignition, spreading to a wooden shed but was controlled and extinguished.
A fire destroyed a paper container and caused damage to a building in Rankweil; firefighters extinguished it.
A 37-year-old woman drove off the road in Amundsenstraße, colliding with a tree stump. Both she and her 3-year-old son sustained minor injuries. An alcohol test revealed 2.08 per mille.
A man without medical training offered illegal aesthetic treatments in Vienna, injuring at least one person. He was apprehended and funds were seized.
Lost hiker on Gerlitzen triggered search operation but returned home uninjured without notifying rescuers.
A fire broke out in the wooden extension of an unoccupied residential house in Micheldorf; it was quickly controlled by firefighters, limiting damage to a small area.
A 19-year-old man lost control of his light motorcycle on Teuchen Straße and collided with a guardrail, causing a minor injury.
A 29-year-old woman in Klagenfurt am Wörthersee lost balance while riding her bike uphill on Opferholzstraße and suffered a serious leg injury.
A motorcyclist in Heiligenblut lost control on gravel, fell, suffered minor injuries, and continued to Lienz after first aid.
A 23-year-old man crashed a non-registered quad into a tree in Bischofstetten, severely injuring himself and slightly injuring a 22-year-old passenger.
Two vehicles collided on the A1 highway in Bezirk PL, Austria, causing two fatalities and multiple injuries.
A car overturned after a collision involving two vehicles on the Oberinnviertler Straße L503 in Mettmach, injuring three people.
A 17-year-old driver lost control of the car on a curve, crashing into a tree and injuring two passengers in Bad Ischl.
Two teenagers were injured in a moped collision in Mortantsch, Bezirk Weiz.
A motorcycle accident occurred in Gralla due to a vehicle collision, injuring the motorcyclist.
18-year-old moped rider fled from police in a high-speed chase endangering pedestrians, eventually stopped and reported.
A 26-year-old Iranian broke into a grocery store in Silz, consumed stolen goods, and was arrested by police.
An 18-year-old Croatian driver collided with a motorcycle in Flaurling, Austria, causing serious injury to the biker and significant vehicle damage.
A collision occurred between a man on an e-scooter and an elderly woman on a bicycle in Innsbrucks Rapoldipark, causing injuries to both individuals.
A 69-year-old man resisted police during a COVID-19 check at Losenpass, Vorarlberg, becoming aggressive and physically attacking officers, leading to his arrest.
A boy was injured in Lustenau when a car collided with his bicycle; the driver fled the scene without providing information.
A man was critically injured in a hit-and-run traffic accident in the Großgöttfritz area. The suspected driver reported himself to the police the following day.
A 44-year-old man fell to his death from a rocky ledge during a hike and was found the next morning after a search operation.
24-year-old man injured another man with a glass bottle and shard in Innsbruck after a dispute.
A 22-year-old falsely reported being robbed due to heavy intoxication; he confessed and will be charged with pretending a punishable offense.
A 33-year-old man was injured and robbed of his mobile phone during an altercation involving three suspects in Innsbruck, while another man was attacked but not harmed.
A Swiss woman attempted to bypass a border control in Höchst, driving her vehicle at a police officer and refusing to cooperate. She was pursued and arrested after a chase.
A fatal wrong-way car collision occurred on the A1 highway in Niederösterreich, resulting in two deaths at the scene and multiple injured victims; one injured person passed away later in a hospital.
A fire broke out at the roof ridge of a house in Bezirk Braunau, likely caused by moss igniting near the chimney. The blaze was quickly extinguished by firefighters, and no injuries were reported.
A vending machine caught fire in a break room at a company premises in Sulz causing significant damage and heavy smoke. No foul play was suspected.
A 52-year-old Hungarian man was arrested at the central train station in Vienna due to an outstanding warrant for suspected coercion.
A 23-year-old woman was injured and airlifted to a hospital after falling from her horse during a show jumping event.
Two cars collided at an intersection in Hohenau an der March after a driver ignored a traffic sign; one passenger sustained injuries.
A 15-year-old cyclist was injured after being towed by a moped and falling for unknown reasons in Diersbach, Upper Austria.
A 29-year-old driver in Traun was found to be under the influence of drugs while driving to a car wash; his license and keys were confiscated.
A 38-year-old woman and her 4-year-old daughter fell during a descent from a climbing path in Strobl, resulting in injuries. Rescue services transported them to a hospital.
22-year-old man caused a drunk driving accident in Göming; his car flipped and ended on its roof, he sustained minor injuries.
A car collided with a tractors slurry tank trailer; the car driver was injured and found to be over the alcohol limit.
Twelve individuals were arrested in Graz for illegal immigration into Austria, allegedly transported by smugglers.
Two cyclists collided on a bike path in Graz; one suffered severe injuries while the other had minor injuries.
A 15-year-old moped rider lost control on gravel, fell, and collided with an oncoming motorcyclist, resulting in injuries to the moped rider.
A physical altercation in Innsbruck escalated, leading to injuries for two individuals and resistance during arrest.
A 50-year-old man was injured after colliding with his sons bike near Kramsach, Tirol.
Motorcyclist in Vomp suffered severe injuries after losing control and hitting a streetlight.
A 60-year-old man stumbled during a paragliding launch in Hart im Zillertal and injured his face, then sought hospital treatment on his own.
A motorcyclist in Austria fell and sustained moderate injuries after losing control in a curve while overtaking a cyclist.
Search operation conducted at Bregenzer Ach in Wolfurt after witnesses reported a black car entering the water; no vehicle or persons were found.
A fire broke out in a pizza oven duct in a pizzeria in Ludesch, spreading to the buildings roof. No injuries were reported, substantial damage occurred, and investigations are ongoing.
A woman fell 15 meters down a slope while hiking and was injured; she was rescued by helicopter and taken to the hospital.
A cyclist fell on a forest path in Frastanz, suffered injuries, and was transported to a hospital by helicopter.
A motorcyclist fell due to strong use of the front brake and was injured; transported by helicopter to a hospital.
A 30-year-old driver in Vienna was stopped and found using a fake Serbian drivers license while impaired by drugs, refusing further examination; he was prohibited from continuing and charged.
A man was reported for handling a softgun in a public park; police identified and questioned a 19-year-old suspect, confiscating the softgun.
Unidentified perpetrators broke into a basement compartment in a residential building in Klagenfurt and stole fishing equipment worth several hundred euros.
A 59-year-old man in Bezirk Völkermarkt was found in possession of numerous illegal firearms and war materials during a court-ordered house search.
A 32-year-old driver was caught speeding at 194 km/h in a 100 km/h zone in Poysbrunn.
A 55-year-old man fell about 8 meters while climbing without safety gear and was rescued by a helicopter and taken to a hospital with undetermined injuries.
A truck accident occurred on the A1 near Neulengbach, resulting in injuries to two Romanian individuals and causing significant damage to the guardrail and road closure.
A fire destroyed a storage hall in Weinburg due to accumulated hot ash, causing six-figure euro damages.
Two cars collided head-on in Tulln, leaving both drivers injured and requiring hospital treatment. The road was temporarily closed for rescue and cleanup efforts.
A toddler was found sitting on an open window ledge, risking a fall. Police intervened to prevent an accident while the father, intoxicated, was asleep.
A 74-year-old man on a motorcycle collided with a barrier in Altheim and sustained serious injuries.
A car collision on Wögerhof Gemeindestraße in Bezirk Rohrbach resulted in the death of a 42-year-old driver and injuries to a 64-year-old driver.
A car collided with a truck on B147 in Munderfing, causing the death of the car driver.
Car caught fire near a gas station in Leoben due to a suspected technical defect; fire was extinguished without injuries or damage to the gas station.
A cyclist in Graz was seriously injured after being struck by a cars side mirror, with conflicting accounts from those involved prompting a police call for witnesses.
A wooden shed near a residential house caught fire due to improperly disposed ash; the shed was destroyed and nearby buildings were damaged, but no injuries were reported.
A rear-end collision in Kundl involving three vehicles resulted in one person being injured and significant damage to two cars.
A car collided with two cyclists in Grinzens, resulting in one cyclists death, one injured cyclist, and the injured driver.
A 22-year-old Austrian woman was stopped for a vehicle and driver check, where officers discovered counterfeit license plates on her car.
A car accident occurred in Imst involving two drivers, both sustaining injuries and significant vehicle damage.
Two young drivers were caught participating in an illegal street race, leading to the confiscation of their provisional licenses.
Two men suspected of drug dealing were arrested in a Vienna-Brigittenau apartment; heroin, cocaine, and cash were seized.
A series of incidents involving drug theft, assault, and robbery in Krems resulted in the arrests of an 18-year-old and a 26-year-old suspect.
Several garbage bins caught fire in a residential area of Klagenfurt, likely due to improperly discarded ash. Firefighters quickly extinguished the blaze.
A fire occurred at a single-family house in Leogang involving a wooden grill shelter and nearby structures. No injuries were reported.
Apartment fire in Kalsdorf bei Graz caused significant damage and led to the hospitalization of a 23-year-old man due to suspected smoke inhalation.
Fire broke out in a waste disposal facility, possibly caused by improperly disposed batteries or accumulators. No injuries were reported.
Two escaped prisoners were apprehended in an apartment after a large-scale police search in Vienna.
Police arrested a 33-year-old driver in Viennas Martinstraße after discovering cannabis odor, secured 500 grams of marijuana and drug paraphernalia, and confiscated the suspects drivers license.
During a traffic stop in Vienna, a 38-year-old man under suspected drug influence attacked police officers with punches and kicks before being arrested.

A driver in Leopoldstadt fled from police after committing several administrative violations, endangering pedestrians and colliding with a police car. Drugs and prescription medication were found, leading to his arrest.
A stolen SUV connected to a burglary was found by parking enforcement in Vienna and returned to its owner.

Two cars collided on Zollfeld Landesstraße in St. Donat, Kärnten, causing injuries to both drivers. A 56-year-old man was hospitalized, and a 59-year-old man suffered minor injuries. The road was closed during the vehicle recovery.
A construction worker in Velden found an unexploded grenade at a construction site, which was secured by authorities.
A 25-year-old man was caught driving at 117 km/h in a 60 km/h zone and had his license confiscated.

A fire broke out in a newly rented apartment in Ried im Innkreis, suspected to have started from the electric stove and ignited moving boxes. No injuries occurred, and the fire department responded effectively.
A cyclist hit a pedestrian in Traun and fled the scene, leaving the man injured.
A 56-year-old man swerved to avoid a hare, causing his car to overturn; he suffered injuries and tested positive for alcohol.
Two individuals were injured in a traffic accident in Innsbruck after a black Mercedes collided with their car and fled the scene.

A Bosnian woman was investigated for drug trafficking in Innsbruck, importing and selling significant amounts of cocaine and heroin. She was arrested on December 30, 2019, with drugs found hidden in a stuffed animal.
Two men broke into a van in Lochau, later forcefully entered a gas station shop in Hörbranz, and were arrested after fleeing and being found with a knife and stolen items.

A fire broke out at a company in Hörbranz, Austria. Employees attempted to extinguish it before emergency services arrived. Fire spread to silos and conveyor belt; it was extinguished by the fire brigade. No injuries reported, significant property damage caused.
A Serbian man wanted for property crimes was arrested during a control operation in Vienna.
A group of young men fired shots into the air using a CO2 blank-firing gun, causing a police operation; a 19-year-old intoxicated male was found with the weapon and issued a temporary gun ban.
Police recorded 26 drivers exceeding the speed limit of 100 km/h, with two notable instances of 176 km/h and 173 km/h, facing license revocation.
A car collided head-on with another vehicle on the B 100 Drautalbundesstraße, leading to injuries and multiple people being transported to hospitals via ambulance and rescue helicopters.
A car accident involving injuries occurred on the B83 near Riegersdorf, causing three people to be hospitalized and significant vehicle damage.
A 79-year-old man lost control of his car on the A2 Griffen exit, hitting a sign and overturning his vehicle. He sustained minor injuries and was treated on site.
A 27-year-old man fell off his e-bike while crossing a pedestrian path and was injured in Linz.
A 53-year-old cyclist fell from his mountain bike in Putzleinsdorf and was injured, requiring hospital treatment.
A 22-year-old driver lost control of his car on Aicher Straße L1036, was ejected from the vehicle, and died at the scene despite first aid and resuscitation attempts.
A 27-year-old woman collided with another vehicle, causing her 2-year-old daughter to hit the windshield and suffer injuries. Both children involved were hospitalized.
Police dismantled a drug ring in Bezirk Steyr-Land, involving 30 people and various drugs over three months.
A 38-year-old cyclist collided with a tram in Graz, sustaining serious injuries after falling and getting trapped under the tram. Emergency services freed him, and he was hospitalized.

A collision involving three cars on L 602 near Jöß resulted in two severe injuries, one minor injury, and one shock victim. Firefighters rescued the trapped individuals, and the injured were hospitalized. The road was closed until 10:20 AM.
Two Austrian men were threatened with a knife in Vomp by an unknown attacker, followed by a physical altercation; the suspect fled and remains at large despite a police search.
Fire broke out after a field chopper hit a hidden metal rod, igniting both the machine and surrounding vegetation; firefighters quickly controlled the blaze.
A tractor with a trailer overturned due to a sudden braking maneuver after being closely overtaken by another vehicle, spilling wood chips into a nearby brook; no injuries were reported.
Fire broke out at Inn-Kraftwerk in Ebbs due to an electrical distribution defect; three individuals hospitalized for suspected smoke inhalation.
A head-on collision occurred in Ambergtunnel due to a vehicle entering the wrong lane; two women were injured and taken to the hospital, and three cars were severely damaged.
A woman accidentally injured her leg with a chainsaw while working in her garden.
A man in Maxglan, Salzburg slipped in his bathroom, sustained a head injury, and received professional first aid from a police paramedic before being transported to the hospital.
Two Georgian nationals arrested during a traffic control in Puchenau for possessing stolen goods linked to thefts in Rohrbach and Linz-Land districts.
A 19-year-old woman in Klagenfurt overdosed on drugs and later died in the hospital after being found unresponsive in her home.
A man assaulted his ex-wife and unlawfully entered her apartment in Linz before being arrested by police.
An intoxicated 22-year-old driver crashed into a building corner in Bad Goisern; vehicle heavily damaged, no injuries reported.
A 37-year-old man was injured after his car veered off the A2 near Wolfsberg Nord exit, hitting a crash cushion and landing on the grass verge; the car was heavily damaged.
A 27-year-old man in Traun was attacked by multiple individuals who punched and kicked him before stealing his bag.
A 17-year-old male fell near a bus rear axle and was run over, injuring his arm.
A man was arrested for allegedly setting a fire in the basement of a single-family home after a dispute, causing damage and requiring rescue efforts.
Two men broke into an apartment in Vienna via scaffolding, tied up the occupants, stole valuables, and fled through a window. The victims were unharmed and police are investigating.
A 33-year-old man was arrested near Ballhausplatz in Vienna after behaving oddly and carrying a machete; no one was harmed.
An 18-year-old driver lost control of his car in Thörl-Maglern, slid off the road, hit a power pole, and caused injuries to himself and two other passengers.
A power pole bent due to strong winds, causing a grass fire from a short circuit. Firefighters prevented the fire from spreading.

A car crashed into a guardrail, collided with an oncoming truck, and was thrown back into the guardrail on Drautal Bundesstraße. Two individuals in the car were injured, and the road was temporarily closed.
A man was severely injured when a snapped cable struck his head while attempting to pull a felled tree with a tractor in a forest area.
A 68-year-old quad driver collided with a car, veered off the road and sustained serious injuries in Albrechtsberg.
Car detected driving at 199 km/h in a 100 km/h zone, drivers license temporarily seized, and no alcohol detected.
Bus and truck collided at an intersection in St. Pölten; multiple injuries reported.
A Bosnian man with a ban from Austria was found in possession of drugs and using a fraudulent identity to bypass the ban.
A Dumper vehicle caught fire at a farm property in Neukirchen; firefighters prevented the fire from spreading to the stable building. No injuries occurred.

A fire broke out in a restaurant in Munderfing when a döner grill caught fire, causing flames to spread to the ventilation system. The owner and his wife controlled the fire with an extinguisher, but the owner suffered minor burns.
68-year-old man sustained serious injuries after crashing his motorcycle into a concrete water conduit near Attendorf.
A burglary in Kitzbühel involved an unknown suspect stealing and attempting to escape with costume jewelry, but the homeowner intercepted and recovered the items; the suspect remains at large.
An error in the reported age of a woman was corrected from 44 to 86 years old.
A 12-year-old boy fell off his bike in Mayrhofen and collided with a truck, resulting in injuries to his left arm.

A 44-year-old woman drove off the road with her mobility vehicle in Silz and was found injured in a slope area near the Inn by her daughter-in-law. She was rescued and flown to a hospital. Authorities are seeking witnesses.
Fire in a grocery store in Bludesch caused significant damage; extinguished by flooding the basement with foam due to dangerous conditions.
A farmers discarded cigarette caused a 0.5-hectare grassland fire, quickly controlled by firefighters and equipment.
A 50-year-old driver opened a car door, causing a 37-year-old cyclist with a cargo bike to collide and fall, resulting in minor injuries to the cyclist while a 4-year-old passenger remained unharmed.

A 44-year-old American man allegedly stole a glass bottle and threatened a 40-year-old man during an argument in a grocery store in Vienna. The victim fled, and the suspect pursued him, further threatening him with the broken bottle. Police detained the suspect in a tram.
A man transported WWII ammunition to a Vienna police station, prompting a street closure and involvement from the Austrian militarys bomb disposal unit.
A 24-year-old man stole a bag from a car, was identified by the victim, and apprehended with the help of bystanders before being arrested.
Two incidents of domestic violence occurred in Vienna where women attacked their partners, resulting in serious injuries; both suspects were arrested.
A 42-year-old man fell off his e-bike in a roundabout, suffered serious injuries, and was allegedly intoxicated.
Police searched for a man near a bus stop in Krumpendorf suspected of carrying a rifle, who was later identified as an exhausted military participant in an orientation run.
A fire broke out at a firm premises in St. Veit/Glan due to flame works, damaging pallets and roof structures before being tackled by firefighters.
A fire destroyed a tool shed at a pensioners residence in Ruden. No people or animals were harmed, and no other objects were endangered.
Police discovered suspected illegal prostitution involving Romanian women in Baden.
A woman suffered severe injuries after being struck by a tractor attachment while cycling; the tractor driver, found to be intoxicated, initially fled the scene.
A 58-year-old driver under the influence of alcohol collided with a 64-year-old cyclist in Gutenstein, causing severe injuries to the cyclist.
Moped and car collided at an intersection in Obergrafendorf, resulting in injuries to the 15-year-old driver and an 18-year-old passenger.
A 19-year-old car driver collided with a 68-year-old cyclist on the L 92 in Gresten, causing the cyclist to fall and suffer injuries. She was airlifted to the hospital.
A high-speed collision in Linz between a speeding motorcyclist and an e-scooter rider at an intersection resulted in both individuals dying at the scene.
A 20-year-old man attacked a 23-year-old with a knife in Linz due to jealousy disputes; both were hospitalized, and the weapon was secured.
A motorcyclist lost control in a curve, hit a guardrail, and was injured in Gschwandt.
Truck collided with a car on the A8 in Krenglbach; car driver unharmed, truck driver injured.
Driver stopped in Salzburg for using phone while driving, found to lack a valid license and attempted to bribe officers.

A car and a moped collided at an intersection in Eugendorf, causing injuries to the moped driver who was hospitalized. The car driver had a slight alcohol level, while the moped driver tested negative for alcohol.
Two cars collided at a crossroads in Salzburg-Gnigl, resulting in four people injured and both vehicles being totaled.
A car caught fire and was completely burned out in a garage in Salzburg-Liefering; no injuries were reported.
An abandoned suitcase near a police station in Graz triggered suspicion, leading to street closures and a bomb squad inspection that found harmless items inside.
A man using a forged Hungarian ID document was apprehended in St. Johann i.T. after attempting to evade authorities during a financial police inspection.
Police discovered cannabis and prohibited weapons in a car after attempting to check individuals and vehicles on a parking lot in Innsbruck.
A 37-year-old Austrian woman died after her car veered off the road and struck a tree on Harter Landesstraße in Fügen.
A fire broke out in Großvolderberg affecting numerous trees and shrubs on a steep slope; firefighting efforts involved local fire brigades and a police helicopter.
Collision between a truck and an e-bike in Hard resulted in serious injury to the cyclist.
A man threatened a parking enforcement officer by coughing and spitting, claiming to be COVID-19 positive; he was later tested negative and reported.
A 40-year-old man was arrested for committing six armed bank robberies in Austria between 2012 and 2017.
Five Austrian youths broke into a venue in Innsbruck and stole a cash register; they were caught in the act.
Police officers provided first aid and successfully resuscitated a 72-year-old cyclist who had fallen and sustained head injuries.
69-year-old man found dead after a fire in his apartment in Vienna-Meidling; cause of the fire under investigation.
106 police recruits in Vienna completed their training and are ready to join the citys police force starting May 1, 2021.
A pizza delivery worker in Linz was robbed at an address by a masked and armed individual who stole cash and personal documents.

A pile of wood was set on fire in Niederuntersberg, Sankt Veit. Firefighters extinguished the fire in about an hour, with a low four-figure damage reported. The cause of the fire is under investigation.
A 42-year-old truck driver and a 17-year-old motorcyclist collided during an attempted overtake in Schwaz, Austria, resulting in severe leg injuries for the motorcyclist.
Four men were arrested in Vienna on suspicion of preparing a burglary attempt after being found with stolen license plates and burglary tools.
A man driving a small truck lost control on a wet road, causing the vehicle to overturn and fall onto industrial premises. He was injured and rescued by firefighters.
A 22-year-old farmer in Verditz accidentally severed the tips of two fingers during woodworking and was taken to the hospital; no third-party involvement was detected.
Fatal traffic accident involving a motorcyclist without a valid license who collided with a car after sliding on the road in Pressbaum.

A heavily intoxicated 51-year-old man was arrested in Steyr by the Cobra unit after discharging a firearm outside his home. A loaded shotgun was seized, and the man was issued a temporary weapons ban.
A fire caused by an incompletely burned scented candle broke out in a childs room of a house; no injuries reported but significant property damage occurred.
A cyclist was hit by a white Mitsubishi SUV at Locherer Weg 6, Kufstein, and the driver fled the scene. The injured cyclist reported the incident and was hospitalized with arm injuries.
A car driven by a man without a valid license overturned and came to rest in a playground in Sellrain, causing material damage but no injuries.
A driver lost control of his car on a wet road, causing it to crash and overturn. He fled the scene but later reported himself to the police; a breath test was positive for alcohol.
A head-on collision occurred between a truck and a car on the B171 in Pians, causing injuries to the car driver and significant damage to both vehicles.
Police responded to a vague threat sent via email, searched municipal premises in Lauterach, found no danger, and cleared the scene an hour later.
A 19-year-old man fled from police during a control, attacked officers during apprehension, and was found with cannabis and a prohibited weapon.
A 10-year-old girl was hit by a car while crossing a pedestrian crosswalk and was injured.

Driver stopped for unsafe transportation of materials on top of vehicle.

Truck driver slightly injured after collision between truck and train at a railway crossing.

Internet investment fraud involves scammers enticing victims with promises of high returns, then leveraging call centers to collect money, which is rerouted to foreign accounts.
