An 89-year-old woman in Bezirk Perg was rescued after falling in her home. A neighbor alerted emergency services after a phone call. Firefighters broke a window to access her, and she was taken to a hospital for further care.
Approximately 100 rainbow trout and a sturgeon were found dead in a fish pond, with investigations underway to determine the cause.
A 53-year-old hiker in Austria fell and sustained serious injuries, requiring rescue by alpine emergency teams and airlift to a hospital.
A 50-year-old cyclist died in a collision with a car in Bad Blumau, Austria.
A man died from fatal injuries after falling down a staircase in his home; incident involved emergency services and is under investigation.
A 33-year-old German man fell from his e-bike in Igls, injuring himself after losing balance and hitting train tracks. He tested positive for alcohol.
A 26-year-old woman crashed her mountain bike in Tannheim, hitting a stone wall, and was flown to a clinic with unspecified injuries.
A 70-year-old woman on an e-bike fell after colliding with a barrier and was injured.
Attempted robbery occurred in Innsbruck where a 17-year-old was forced to withdraw money at an ATM and assaulted by an unknown person.

Police pursued a driver under the influence of drugs who fled, driving recklessly at high speeds. The car eventually crashed, and the driver and passenger were apprehended on foot. Stolen license plates, a knuckle-duster, and drugs were found in the vehicle.

Two domestic violence incidents occurred in Vienna; one involved a man threatening his ex-wife and her son in Meidling, and another involved a woman attacking her ex-partner with a knife in Favoriten.
A man attacked police officers with pepper spray during a drug-related identity check and was apprehended after a chase.
A man threatened a local employee with a knife and attacked a police officer during arrest on Jägerstraße in Vienna.
A woman driving a small truck on the Innerkremser Landesstraße swerved to avoid an animal, fell down a 100m slope, and sustained injuries. She reached a nearby hut to get help.
Smoke developed from a chimney in a house in Klagenfurt due to overheating; no injuries were reported.
Motorbike group accident in Schärding district; three riders fell, one seriously injured.
A 19-year-old female driver veered off the road, slid 100 meters across a meadow, and collided with a tree, sustaining injuries.
A car driven by a 28-year-old woman with her one-year-old daughter overturned on the L501 near Hörndl, Tarsdorf. Both sustained minor injuries and were flown to a hospital in Salzburg.
A security guard assaulted a man during a dispute over a Covid certificate at a golf course.
Car accident occurred during a turning maneuver in Maxglan, Salzburg, resulting in a minor injury to a 62-year-old, with both cars needing to be towed.
A cyclist was injured in a hit-and-run accident involving a silver Mercedes Coupe, with the driver failing to stop in Salzburg.
A pedestrian was injured in a car accident in Hallwang after the driver, under the influence of alcohol, lost control trying to avoid a cat on the road.
A 64-year-old man collapsed and died of natural causes at a Covid testing site in Mürzzuschlag, Austria, despite immediate resuscitation efforts.
Parts of a deer were found on a sandbank in Schlitters, Zillerbrücke, suspected to be related to an illegal hunting or fishing incident.
A 41-year-old Italian driver had a car accident on Eiberg Straße in Söll, with the car overturning and ending up in a field; the driver sustained minor injuries and tested positive for alcohol.
A 19-year-old man fell on a garden gate in Mutters, causing a metal bar to pierce his thigh; emergency services assisted in removing the bar, and he was taken to a hospital.
Two cars collided in Innsbruck at an intersection, resulting in injuries to two elderly passengers and significant vehicle damage.
A 56-year-old German woman had a serious head injury after falling from her e-bike in Gerlos, Tirol.
A hand grenade was found in a forest in Unterwart and later secured by the bomb disposal service.

A 23-year-old Afghan man was suspected of ordering and obtaining illegal drugs over a period using a phone registered to a priest. He was later found driving without a valid license in Hermagor, where a small amount of cannabis was discovered in his car.
Two schoolchildren set fire to waste containers in Arbing, causing damage exceeding 5,000 Euros.
A trash island caught fire in St. Michael in Obersteiermark, possibly due to arson.
Smoke development due to suspected technical defect in a pizza oven led to evacuation of 500 students; no injuries or damages reported.

Police in the Bezirk Ried investigated a 32-year-old man who admitted to selling 11.5kg of cannabis between March 2019 and February 2021. Small amounts of cannabis and drug-related items were seized during a house search.
An 18-year-old driver in Steyr crashed into a noise barrier after falling asleep, causing structural damage and minor property damage, and was injured.
A car was caught speeding at 119 km/h in a 50 km/h zone; driver not yet identified.
Ten traffic accidents occurred in Vorarlberg during the 2021 Pentecost weekend, resulting in 10 injuries. Speeding violations, drunk driving incidents, and reduced traffic volume were noted.
A 30-year-old man was attacked by four masked individuals on Donauinsel, demanding money and hitting him, but fled when interrupted by a passerby.
Car collision on Lerchenfelder Gürtel resulted in minor injuries and significant vehicle damage.
Stolen car found abandoned and damaged during a joint police and parking enforcement operation.
A car accident occurred involving an 18-year-old driver who went off the wet road into a ditch; no injuries were reported, but the driver was in shock.
A 58-year-old woman lost control of her motorcycle on a curve and veered off the Friesacher Straße in Gasteige, sustaining injuries and being taken to the hospital.
A motorcyclist was caught speeding at 170 km/h in an 80 km/h zone and will face charges.

A car collided with a trailer on the S 33 in Grafenegg, causing the loaded vehicle to be thrown onto the road. The intoxicated driver without a valid license fled and suffered severe injuries after climbing a noise barrier.
Two cars collided at an intersection in Groß Schweinbarth when a driver ignored a stop sign; both drivers were injured and one car caught fire but was extinguished by the fire brigade.
An intoxicated man attacked paramedics and police officers in Linz, injuring a paramedic and a police officer slightly before being arrested.
A farmer was trapped under collapsing masonry during demolition work at his residence and sustained injuries.
Fire at an abandoned building in Baumgartenberg; cause undetermined, six fire brigades responded.
A 15-year-old in Linz was caught fleeing from police on a stolen moped without a valid license.

A heavily intoxicated driver caused a single-vehicle accident in Oberndorf and fled the scene; he was later found injured by the police and faces charges for hit-and-run and refusal of a breath alcohol test.
A car with a trailer collided with a local train in St. Georgen near Salzburg after ignoring a red light at a railway crossing; no injuries occurred.
A 38-year-old Georgian man was arrested for stealing perfumes worth several hundred euros from two stores at a shopping center in Graz on May 23 and May 25, 2020.
A collision occurred between a car and a car trailer on a wet road, causing minor injuries to a 34-year-old woman.
A 54-year-old motorcyclist was seriously injured in a collision with a car at Anger, Bezirk Weiz.
A 28-year-old motorcyclist slid off a wet road, hit a concrete block, and was severely injured.
A fire broke out in a wooden structure in Innsbruck Hötting, likely due to flame work conducted earlier in the day. The fire was quickly contained by police and firefighters.
A van slowed down on the B 198, leading to a rear-end collision with a car; two people were injured and vehicles were heavily damaged.
A 33-year-old woman in Rankweil threatened a 56-year-old man with a softgun, shouting at and insulting him, but he was unharmed.
A man attempted to flee during a police check, was caught, found with cannabis, and arrested due to an existing warrant.
A cyclist resisted police, attempted to flee, and attacked officers with elbow strikes, leading to his arrest.
A 58-year-old man was arrested in Vienna-Penzing for threatening two teenagers with a knife following a confrontation about mask-wearing.
A man threatened a tobacco shop employee in Vienna with a knife, demanded cash, and fled the scene. Police searches are ongoing.
A 45-year-old man was found dead in Wolfsberg due to a suspected drug overdose confirmed by autopsy; further investigations are ongoing.
A Polish truck driver lost control and overturned on a steep embankment; the driver was uninjured and the truck was recovered with heavy equipment.
A 19-year-old driver lost control of his car and it overturned due to being cut off by an unidentified driver who then fled the scene in Gänserndorf.
A car collision on L 3109 in Hagenbrunn resulted in one fatality and severe injuries for two others when a 17-year-old attempted to overtake another vehicle.
A van with five passengers collided with a tractor, resulting in the death of one passenger and severe injury to another.
A four-year-old child fell out of a first-floor window onto the asphalt while playing and was hospitalized after being briefly unconscious.
A Polish truck driver was found with a disguised stun gun during a border check in Austria and is now facing charges.
Motorcycle collided head-on with a small truck resulting in injuries to the motorcyclist, who was airlifted to the hospital.
A father saved his unconscious daughter from a burning 450-year-old farmhouse in Hüttau, evacuating six other family members first. The daughter was hospitalized with unspecified injuries.
A cement mixer truck overturned on the road in Hüttau, injuring the driver who was airlifted to the hospital.

A 43-year-old man lost control of a crane truck on the B70, leading to it overturning into a grassy area. No one was injured, but a challenging recovery operation caused a full road closure until the next morning.
A truck driver in Nauders was found to have driven without a driver card 95 times in 92 days, leading to over 200 violations and suspicion of evidence falsification.
A driver was caught speeding at 166 km/h in an 80 km/h zone in Kössen.
A collision occurred between a car driven by a 64-year-old man and a motorcycle operated by a 27-year-old man in Kramsach. The motorcyclist was severely injured and the motorcycle was totaled.
A car collided with a motorcycle in Innsbruck, causing severe injuries to the motorcyclist and serious damage to both vehicles.
A 30-year-old man was heavily injured after losing control of his car in Lingenau, rolling several times and coming to rest in a field; he tested at 1.18 promille alcohol level.
Two cars collided during an overtaking maneuver in Kennelbach; one vehicle overturned causing injuries and significant damage.
A family, including a 5-year-old child, was injured in a car accident involving a collision with a truck while attempting to turn onto the S2 in Breitenleer Straße.
A 16-year-old motorcyclist collided with a car at an intersection in Graz, suffering fatal injuries; the car driver sustained minor injuries.

A brawl among several men in St. Georgen an der Gusen resulted in multiple injuries and vehicle damage; the conflict escalated the next day in Perg, leading to another fight with additional injuries, including serious ones.
Intoxicated woman refused to leave her ex-boyfriends apartment, became aggressive towards police, attacked a female officer, and was arrested; officer suffered minor injuries.
A 19-year-old forestry worker was injured by a falling tree rootstock and airlifted to a hospital in Klagenfurt.
A car caught fire due to a technical defect in Ossiach; no injuries reported, and firefighters extinguished the fire.
A man with a firearm robbed a tobacco shop in Linz, demanding money after initially pretending to make a purchase. The perpetrator escaped on foot, and the employee was unharmed but in shock.
An unknown perpetrator robbed a tobacconist in Linz, threatened the victim with a firearm, and escaped with cash. The victim was left in shock.
A hut in Brandenberg, Austria, caught fire and burned down. No individuals or animals were harmed, and the cause of the fire is still under investigation.
A remote alpine hut called Häuslalm in Brandenberg was completely burned down; no injuries reported and the cause is under investigation.

Police provided prevention tips for outdoor activities in alpine areas, noting low accident rates due to cautious behavior during COVID-19 but increasing incidents with hiking and mountain biking due to lack of experience.
A 44-year-old Slovenian man was caught at the Lavamünd border crossing with falsified COVID-19 test confirmations.
A heavily intoxicated Romanian truck driver was stopped and prohibited from continuing his journey on the Tauernautobahn in Seeboden; his license was confiscated and he was fined.
Police dismantled an illegal drug lab in Mistelbach, seizing large amounts of synthetic drug precursors and arresting two suspects, while the main suspect remains at large.
A car with a Czech license plate was caught speeding at 200 km/h in a 130 km/h zone on the A5 highway near Gaweinstal, Mistelbach district.
Three people injured in a three-car collision involving vehicles being thrown onto the opposite lane and into a field.
ATM was blown up by three perpetrators causing damage and fleeing with the loot in a small car.
A man broke into a tobacco shop and was later arrested; admitted to other crimes and investigations are ongoing.
Police officers in Salzburg extinguished a fire in an apartment building, rescuing a trapped family while the cause of the fire remains under investigation.
Phone scammers impersonating police officers attempt to deceive individuals into giving money or valuables under the pretense of protecting them from theft.
A barn in Gattendorf caught fire due to a lightning strike on a nearby tree; the fire was extinguished by the fire brigade with no harm to people or animals.
A 20-year-old man in Klagenfurt exhibited aggressive behavior, obstructed police officers, and was found moderately intoxicated before being temporarily arrested.
A collision between a moped ridden by a 16-year-old and a truck occurred at an intersection in Klagenfurt, resulting in injuries to the moped rider, who was taken to the hospital.
A 15-year-old girl was injured when her horse reacted and kicked her in the abdomen during a halt beside Mettersdorfer See.
A 17-year-old man injured his arm with a chainsaw during private logging work in Techendorf and received medical treatment.
A suspicious metal disc was found during excavation in Villach, prompting police and bomb disposal services to secure the area; later identified as a brake caliper.
A car and a moped collided at an intersection in Zillingdorf, injuring the moped rider and passenger.
A man robbed a tobacco shop in Linz using a realistic-looking soft gun and fled with cash; he was later arrested and confessed to the crime.
A 35-year-old Romanian man was arrested at the Suben border checkpoint as he was found to be subject to a European arrest warrant for facilitating prostitution in Italy in 2018.
A 46-year-old electrician fell approximately 1 meter from a work scaffold in Maishofen and injured his hand, suspected wrist fracture.
A car driver and a cyclist collided on a bike crossing in Wals-Himmelreich, leaving the cyclist injured and transported to a hospital.
An attempted burglary occurred in Seekirchen where an unidentified man broke into an apartment but stole nothing; police are still searching for the suspect.
An 18-year-old woman attempted to steal a horse from a riding stable in Kirchbichl but was stopped by the owner and fled on a bicycle.

A 30-year-old driver under the influence of alcohol lost control of a car on Gemeindestraße Rheinauen in Hohenems, causing significant damage to the car and colliding with a hedge, a traffic sign, and a city guidepost. No one was injured.
A fire broke out in the attic of an apartment building in Lustenau, injuring one resident and requiring the evacuation of 15 individuals, with two being rescued by the fire department.
An elderly woman in Vienna was deceived by a fraudster posing as a doctor, resulting in her losing €30,000.
Two men were arrested in Vienna after fleeing when stopped by police; stolen goods linked to burglaries were found in their backpacks.
A 17-year-old threatened a man with a knife during a dispute in a bar, and his brother damaged a cars side mirror; one was arrested for dangerous threats.
Cyclists in St. Andrä/Lav., Austria, were hit by cars after a chain reaction accident involving three cars; two cyclists were injured and transported to the hospital.
An E-bike rider was moderately injured in a collision with a truck in St. Veit an der Glan.
A motorcycle collided with a car during an overtaking attempt in Oberpreitenegg, causing injuries to the motorcyclist.
Fire destroyed an agricultural outbuilding in Innerteuchen, Villach-Land, causing significant damage but no harm to animals.
A house fire in Maria Lanzendorf caused by a cigarette led to severe injuries for a 78-year-old man, who later died, and his 82-year-old partner.
A 21-year-old woman riding an e-scooter was hit by a small white car at a crossing in Herzogenburg, causing minor injuries, and the driver fled.
A car accident occurred in Jaidhof, Austria, when an 88-year-old man turned left and collided head-on with another vehicle, injuring both drivers.
A woman was severely injured when her car collided with a tractor while attempting to overtake it in Großweikersdorf, Bezirk Tulln.
A house fire in Maria Lanzendorf left two elderly residents with severe burn injuries; initial investigation suggests a cigarette may have caused the fire.
Two people injured in a rear-end collision involving three cars in Rohrbach; road was temporarily closed.
A 27-year-old male driver under the influence of alcohol caused a head-on collision with another car, injuring a 28-year-old man who was hospitalized.
A drunk driver on a highway in Ansfelden was intercepted after dangerous driving behavior; she tested positive for 3.14‰ alcohol and was found unfit to drive.
A car driver and a cyclist collided in Salzburg, with the cyclist sustaining minor injuries.
A 28-year-old car driver collided with a 15-year-old moped driver in 5111 Bürmoos, causing the moped driver and his 14-year-old passenger to be injured and transported to the hospital.
Motorcyclist and car collided near Kommunalfriedhof in Salzburg, resulting in shoulder injury to the motorcyclist; both vehicles were not drivable.
Fraudulent callers impersonated police officers in Salzburg, attempting to scam victims by claiming emergencies or threats; no successful scams were reported.
Two cyclists collided and sustained minor injuries in Graz. Police are seeking witnesses.
A 25-year-old woman had a serious fall while mountain biking on a downhill track in Schladming.
Three individuals received minor injuries in a head-on collision between two cars in Birkfeld, caused by a drivers coughing fit.
A car driven by a 51-year-old Austrian crashed into a curb, crossed the road, went through a hedge, and stopped in a garden; the driver was injured and refused an alcohol test.
Three masked individuals broke into a flat in Innsbruck, assaulted two residents, and injured them. One suspect was apprehended, but the others remain at large.
A 66-year-old man collided with a 19-year-old moped rider in Hall i.T., causing injuries to the woman.
Two men attempted to rob a womans backpack and phone in Klagenfurt, but fled when interrupted by a cyclist.
A 25-year-old man driving under the influence and at high speeds was stopped by police after multiple offenses, including speeding and ignoring stop signals.
An unknown perpetrator conducted online fraud by pretending a payout on a broker platform, causing a 64-year-old Austrian to make a significant advance payment.
Prototype cargo bike stolen from university campus in Graz; theft occurred overnight and damage is estimated in thousands of euros.
Police conducted checks in public areas in Graz at night due to noise and disturbances, leading to administrative offenses and some investigations into criminal offenses.
A 33-year-old Austrian driver crashed into a curb and bridge railing on Tiroler Straße in Kundl, causing injuries to two passengers and significant damage. A conducted alcohol test was positive.
Three masked individuals forcibly entered an apartment in Innsbruck, assaulted two residents, and later were identified as attempting robbery and drug theft.
Cyclist injured in a traffic accident after being struck by a car at an intersection; driver cited sun glare as the cause.

A 17-year-old driver under the influence of alcohol was injured in a car accident after losing control and hitting a ditch in the Forstau area. The driver freed himself and was later found and helped by another motorist.
A drunk 28-year-old driver crashed his car in Anif, Austria, causing significant damage but no injuries.
A residential house in Vordernberg caught fire, severely damaging the roof; no one was injured.
A roof fire occurred at a single-family house in Thurn with significant property damage. Residents escaped uninjured.
Police in Tirol implemented increased traffic monitoring for the Pentecost weekend to manage expected higher traffic volumes, focusing particularly on motorcycle safety.
A 20-year-old man attacked police officers with punches, injuring four before being arrested.
A three-person injury traffic accident occurred on B50 in Oberpullendorf due to a rear-end collision.
Investigation in Braunau district uncovered drug rings dealing synthetic drugs via Darknet; multiple arrests and seizures made.
Two individuals were injured in a collision involving a truck and car on the A25 highway near Sattledt and Linz.
A Romanian driver collided with a truck on the A1 Westautobahn, causing two fatalities and injuring four others.
A drunk and possibly drug-influenced driver attacked and injured a police officer during a traffic stop and attempted to resist arrest.
A man was seen publicly handling a rifle replica and allegedly aiming it at passersby; he was detained and faces charges of dangerous threat.
A car and a motorcycle collided in Kärnten causing serious injury to the motorcyclist and major vehicle damage.
A car collided with a moped in Leibsdorf, causing injuries to two riders who were taken to the hospital.
An unknown perpetrator broke a car window in Villach and stole a handbag from inside the vehicle.
A 35-year-old Hungarian man suffered severe arm injuries while working in a meat processing plant in Villach, Austria.
A 72-year-old motorcyclist lost control on a curve, collided with a tree, and was declared dead at the scene.
A 58-year-old man was severely injured during forestry work when he was trapped by a falling log and airlifted to a hospital.
Three hikers got stranded in steep terrain near Hinterer Langbathsee, Ebensee, and were rescued uninjured by a 13-person mountain rescue team.
A 20-year-old motorcycle rider with a probationary license drove under the influence of drugs and was caught speeding at 175 km/h in a 100 km/h zone.
A 67-year-old rider from Linz lost control of his light motorcycle on a curve, crashed, and was severely injured; he was airlifted to a hospital.
A 20-year-old climber was rescued by helicopter from challenging terrain on Traunstein after following incorrect paths shown by a mobile app.
A paraglider pilot crashed during landing in Guggenthal, sustaining injuries.
A 77-year-old cyclist fell during an e-mountainbike tour due to changing light conditions, sustaining facial injuries and requiring rescue and hospital transport.
A multi-apartment house caught fire in Gratkorn, causing significant property damage and injuring two firefighters during extinguishing efforts.
An 80-year-old woman fell while cleaning a window in her home and suffered a fractured thigh, requiring an airlift to the hospital.
A car and motorcycle collided in Innsbruck, causing injuries to both drivers.
A car veered onto the opposite lane on B170, causing a head-on collision and a subsequent crash involving a motorcycle; all three drivers were injured.
A paraglider in Fulpmes crashed during landing due to strong wind; the 50-year-old man suffered injuries and was taken to a hospital.
A 54-year-old woman slipped on snow while climbing Almerhorn and fell down a steep slope, sustaining serious but non-life-threatening injuries.
A 52-year-old woman died after being struck by a car driven by a 25-year-old man who momentarily looked at his GPS device in Viennas 12th district.
A man was observed damaging a police car in Vienna and was later found to be intoxicated; he was reported to authorities.
Two suspects were arrested in Vienna for alleged drug selling, with a small amount of marijuana and cash seized.
A man threatened three individuals with a fake gun during a street argument over unpaid rent and later fled but was arrested.
A suspected grenade found during playground renovations in Vienna turned out to be a historic cannonball; safely removed by the Austrian Armed Forces.
A truck carrying fuel left the road, overturned, and the driver was fatally injured near Lendorf.
Flooding occurred on the Granitztal Landesstraße due to heavy rainfall, requiring intervention by fire brigade forces.
Head-on collision between two vehicles on B 122 in Weistrach due to distraction; a 58-year-old woman was injured, the 22-year-old driver was found to be over the alcohol limit.
Two mopeds collided in Schwertberg, causing one rider to be injured and hospitalized.
A 22-year-old was caught speeding at 136 km/h in a 70 km/h zone and displayed no remorse, claiming he had been overtaking another car.
Attempted robbery at a bakery in Laakirchen; suspect fled after failing to open the cash register.
A 22-year-old man was attacked by three unknown assailants at the Bahnhofplatz tram stop in Linz. They attempted to steal his phone, but the victim resisted and later required medical treatment.
Two unknown men attempted a burglary in Hartl, were caught in the act but escaped; later, they are presumed to have burgled another house in Feistritztal, stealing jewelry.
A 23-year-old cyclist and a 71-year-old car driver collided at an intersection in Graz resulting in the cyclist sustaining severe injuries.
A 41-year-old Italian man reported his wallet stolen in Innsbruck; two Romanian suspects were caught with stolen items and admitted to the theft.
A child on a bicycle collided with a car after jumping over a sand mound, resulting in injuries.
A car-bicycle collision on a sidewalk in Innsbruck caused severe injuries to the e-scooter driver and significant vehicle damage.
A 27-year-old woman slipped and fell 17 meters over a waterfall during a canyoning tour in Hirschegg, sustaining back injuries, and was airlifted to a hospital.
Tenant interrupted a burglar in his apartment and pursued him. The suspect, previously deported for similar crimes, was arrested nearby by Vienna police.
Unknown perpetrators heavily damaged a granite bench at a rest area in Liebenfels.
An e-bike was stolen from a 49-year-old man while it was briefly left unattended near a fruit stand in Enns.
Unknown perpetrators damaged religious symbols at a Way of the Cross in Imst.
A 23-year-old man in Klagenfurt a.W. was caught receiving 10 kilograms of cannabis from a Slovenian man, leading to arrests and confiscation of cash.
A car was caught speeding at 177 km/h in an 80-km/h zone on an Austrian highway, leading to potential license revocation.
Two men were injured in a car accident near Winden am See; the driver was found to be under the influence of alcohol.
Two unknown male suspects attacked and threatened a 15-year-old in Salzburg Elisabeth Vorstadt, stealing a phone and wallet.
Unknown perpetrators attempted to extort a man by threatening to release explicit images unless he paid 5000 Euros.
A 15-year-old was assaulted and robbed of their phone and wallet by two unidentified males in Salzburg.
A 43-year-old worker in a wood processing company in Unternberg was injured when his leg got caught in machinery while resolving a blockage.
An 18-year-old intoxicated driver was slightly injured in a car accident after losing control and overturning the vehicle.
A German woman cyclist fell due to a riding error and sustained serious facial injuries in Innsbruck.
A man insulted and attacked police officers during a routine check; he was arrested and resisted, injuring an officer.
A plainclothes police officer was strangled from behind by a man during a drug-related operation but managed to free himself; the attacker was detained.
Two Austrian men were arrested in Vienna-Floridsdorf following a house search, and approximately half a kilo of cannabis and cash were seized.

A shoplifter assaulted a store employee when confronted, attempted to flee, but was apprehended by bystanders and later arrested by police. The stolen goods were valued at €95.42, and the employee suffered minor injuries.
A heavy panel injured a 21-year-old workers leg during construction work in St. Jakob im Rosental.
Heavy traffic inspections in Mistelbach district resulted in 198 reports, including a Bulgarian vehicle carrying improperly managed hazardous materials.
A head-on collision occurred between two cars on a road, resulting in one driver being seriously injured and requiring rescue by firefighters.

A furniture joinery warehouse in Eschenau caught fire, causing significant damage. Quick action by firefighters prevented the fire from spreading to adjacent buildings. The owner was slightly injured during initial extinguishing efforts.
A 44-year-old Slovak man assaulted a policewoman during an altercation on Südtiroler Platz in Salzburg and was arrested.

Two women in Salzburg received phishing SMS messages claiming they needed to pay extra postage for their packages to avoid being held in Vienna, but no money or information was disclosed and no harm occurred.
22-year-old motorcyclist crashed on B 69 road in Kranach, suffering undetermined injuries and was airlifted to hospital.
A cable fire caused by an overloaded power line occurred in the basement of a house in Breitenbach, with no injuries and limited damage.
A truck lost control due to brake failure, crashing into a guardrail and falling seven meters down an embankment, injuring two individuals.
A dog ran onto the A12 highway in Telfs and was hit by a car, resulting in minor injuries to the cars occupants and significant vehicle damage.
A 19-year-old driver lost control of her car, struck a tree, and the vehicle spun and landed back on the road; she sustained minor injuries.
Fraudulent SMS impersonating logistics companies aim to deceive recipients into providing credit card details, leading to subscription traps.
A 26-year-old man acted aggressively, damaged a mans phone, resisted arrest, and injured a police officer.
A COVID-positive woman and her accomplice were caught attempting to steal food from a supermarket in Vienna; they attacked staff and police used force during her arrest.
A 22-year-old man was arrested in Vienna for robbing six tobacco shops and two gas stations, threatening staff with a knife, and stealing cash due to financial problems.
A man hit his wife on the back of the head during a dispute in Spittal an der Drau, leading to pain and fear. Police issued a restraining order and arrested the aggressive and intoxicated man.
A car overturned off the road in Jaunfeldstraße, Völkermarkt; no injuries reported, total vehicle damage.
Smoke buildup occurred in a house due to a closed flue damper from a heated tiled stove; no fire or injuries reported.
Two individuals stole headphones from a store in Villach and, after being confronted, one suspect assaulted a security guard before escaping in a vehicle.
Two unidentified intruders broke into a house in Braunau District, stealing valuables and escaping into the woods after being confronted by the homeowner.

A rear-end collision occurred in Mureck when a 31-year-old driver, under the influence of alcohol and without a license, hit the car of a stopped 21-year-old driver; both sustained unspecified injuries.
A car collided with a tractor while exiting a parking lot, requiring the driver to be freed with hydraulic rescue tools and transported to the hospital with unspecified injuries.
A fire broke out in the basement of a multi-family house in Kapfenberg; no one was injured and the fire was extinguished by a resident before firefighters arrived.
Burglary in an uninhabited house and garden hut; musical instruments stolen.

A metal trash can in a kitchen caught fire due to smoldering ash from an ashtray, causing damage to nearby objects and heavy soot on walls and the ceiling. The fire was detected by passersby and extinguished by the fire department. No injuries were reported.
Motorcyclist collided with a tractor while attempting to overtake; sustained injuries and motorcycle was heavily damaged.
A 34-year-old motorcyclist fell due to a driving error on L337 in Telfes im Stubaital, sustained injuries and damaged a traffic sign.
A traffic accident occurred in Kirchberg where a 15-year-old on a moped collided with a 41-year-old pedestrian, causing both injuries and requiring medical attention.
Police broke up an unauthorized party with 200-250 youths and a DJ in Schruns; no incidents occurred during the intervention.
Teenagers allegedly obstructed ambulance access and interfered with emergency services in Vienna; one was arrested due to an existing warrant.

A 21-year-old driver lost control of their vehicle on the A14 near Satteins due to aquaplaning and collided with a canal cover and sign. Both the driver and a 15-year-old passenger sustained minor injuries.
Traffic checkpoint in Vienna-Favoriten revealed multiple violations, seized stolen license plates, a suspected stolen e-card, and noted technical vehicle defects.
99-year-old woman drowned in a swimming pool after wandering outside during the night; no foul play detected.
A 45-year-old man with Huntingtons disease went missing from a care home in Wels; last seen in Bauordenstraße, concerns of an accident.
11-year-old cyclist and car collided; cyclist injured, driver provided first aid, cyclist taken to hospital.
83-year-old cyclist hit by car; cyclist severely injured, taken to hospital by helicopter, and driver tested positive for alcohol.
A car accident occurred in Droß, resulting in severe injuries to three men and minor injuries to a woman.
A traffic accident occurred in Pfaffenschlag bei Waidhofen an der Thaya involving two cars, resulting in one driver heavily intoxicated and three people injured, including one seriously.
A 34-year-old motorcyclist died after crashing into a roadside barrier in Pressbaum despite rescue efforts.
A speeding car driver in Wels and four highly intoxicated cyclists in Marchtrenk were stopped by police for serious traffic offenses.
Two free-running dogs attacked a man and his dog in Gänserndorf; the man and his partner were injured while the attacking dogs owner is being reported to authorities.
Three unknown individuals assaulted a 20-year-old man in Groß St. Florian, stealing cash and cigarettes after rendering him unconscious.
Chemical spill during loading operations caused fish deaths in a firefighting pond.
Car stuck on railway tracks hit by a freight train; no injuries reported, but both the car and the locomotive sustained damages.
Stolen vehicle found near the airport in Innsbruck.
A woman unknowingly participated in a money laundering scheme by transferring funds from her bank account to a cryptocurrency account, leading to a scam involving fake phone sales online.

A 32-year-old man in Frastanz lost control of his car, collided with a glass container, and was injured. He was trapped in the vehicle and had to be freed by firefighters before being taken to the hospital.
A paper container caught fire in Hard, destroying the container and damaging a nearby garden fence; the fire was quickly extinguished by the local fire department.

Police responded to a curfew violation at a venue in Wien-Favoriten where they found ten heavily intoxicated individuals, cleared the premises, and issued multiple COVID-related fines to the operator and guests.
Fire in an apartment in Klagenfurt; two women hospitalized and property damage reported; cause unknown.
A man acted aggressively towards police officers in Klagenfurts Schillerpark and was arrested after attempting to flee. He tested positive for alcohol.
A 19-year-old crashed into a streetlight and fence while driving under the influence and was found with a falsified drivers license.
Two cars collided head-on near a business area in Rohrbach district; three individuals were injured and hospitalized.
A man was injured in the face with a knife while trying to intervene in a fight involving three unknown attackers in Linz.
Police apprehended a driver in Vienna who possessed multiple bags of cannabis and showed signs of intoxication but refused testing.
A 32-year-old Georgian man suspected of multiple burglary thefts was arrested in Viennas 10th district after attempting to flee; a warning shot stopped the escape.

In Vienna-Hernals, a group of youths allegedly robbed a man of a mid-three-digit sum of money after he displayed it openly; one suspect was arrested nearby, another turned himself in, and two more are sought. In Vienna-Alsergrund, two men were arrested for robbing another man of his wallet using violence.
An elderly man was robbed on the street after withdrawing cash from a bank in Vienna.
Two teenagers took a car without permission, drove recklessly on the streets of St. Veit an der Glan, caused damage to the car, and were stopped by police.
A fire broke out in a farmhouse in Lurnfeld, causing two residents to be rescued and hospitalized due to smoke inhalation. The cause and damage are unknown.
Motorcyclist collided with a car and was severely injured after being thrown into a roadside ditch in Paternion.
A 50-year-old man from Klagenfurt crashed his mountain bike on a steep forest road in Magdalensberg, suffered severe injuries, and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 62-year-old truck driver hit a 57-year-old pedestrian at a crosswalk in Schwechat, causing severe injuries to the pedestrian and health issues for the driver.
A 22-year-old motorcyclist lost control and crashed into a guardrail on a wet road, sustaining serious injuries.
A motor glider crashed on Weißegg in the Tamsweg district, resulting in the pilots death.
Head-on collision between two cars on Seekirchner Landesstraße in Salzburg resulting in injuries to both drivers.
Unknown perpetrators blew up an ATM in Leogang, causing destruction, and fled unnoticed.
A car hit a moped rider during a turning maneuver in Graz and fled the scene, leaving the 17-year-old female rider seriously injured.
An 87-year-old woman was seriously injured after being hit by a car reversing out of a parking spot in Graz. The driver provided immediate first aid and was not under the influence of alcohol.
Attempted theft of a mobile phone from a woman in Knittelfeld; the victim was slightly injured during a struggle.
A 55-year-old man was injured by a recoiling tree trunk during forestry work at 1700 meters altitude in Sillian and transported to a hospital by helicopter.
A fire broke out at a house in Niederau, affecting the facade and attic-level construction; firefighters quickly controlled and extinguished it.
A 17-year-old worker sustained a serious knee injury while moving an electrical distribution box on a construction site in Mayrhofen.
A collision occurred between a car and a cyclist in Lustenau, resulting in the cyclist being injured and hospitalized.
A 24-year-old man was arrested for assaulting two store detectives after being caught stealing a bottle of vodka in Vienna.
A 19-year-old man in Villach assaulted two girls during a domestic dispute, threatened them with a blank pistol, and was later arrested by police.

Two maypoles were illegally cut down using chainsaws in Bezirk Spittal/Drau, one near the Napplach fire station and another at the church square in Pusarnitz. Damage was caused to vehicles and property.
Police and medical services responded to a drug intoxication in a Klagenfurt apartment, discovering drugs, a weapon, and an individual violating a weapon prohibition.
A 74-year-old German cyclist lost control of his e-bike after braking abruptly, resulting in a serious injury and requiring airlift to a hospital.
A 34-year-old Czech man was arrested in Linz after breaking car windows and stealing a navigation device.
A 37-year-old man lost control of his car while driving under the influence, flipping the vehicle on its roof. He emerged uninjured but was taken to the hospital. He had no drivers license.
A 16-year-old Russian male attacked a police officer with a punch to the face during an incident in Linz and was arrested after resisting.
Teenagers were caught after a burglary in Traun; stolen goods, a softgun, a stun gun, and a brass knuckle were recovered.
A 39-year-old man was severely injured in a motorcycle accident in Schönau im Mühlkreis, losing control and hitting an obstacle; he was found by a friend and had to be airlifted to the hospital.
An 18-year-old man assaulted a 17-year-old during an argument in Kaprun, followed by the 17-year-olds father threatening bystanders with a wooden plank; both individuals will face charges.
A heavily intoxicated man fell off an e-scooter while trying to navigate a curb, sustaining injuries. He tested positive for 2.26 per mille alcohol.
14-year-old cyclist collided with car; both drivers injured, treated at hospitals.
Fire broke out at a metal processing factory in Bruck an der Mur; no injuries, property damage occurred, and investigations are ongoing.
A cyclist was critically injured in a collision with a car driven by an intoxicated driver without a license.
A fire broke out on a balcony of a multi-party house, causing damage to the facade and roof structure, likely due to an improperly extinguished cigarette. No injuries were reported.
A 16-year-old motorcyclist lost control, collided with a retaining wall, and suffered severe head injuries due to an unsecured helmet.
A 32-year-old Croatian worker suffered burns after a water jet blew back through a furnace grid during slag removal in Vils.
A 35-year-old Hungarian motorcyclist fell after skidding during an emergency brake maneuver in Heiterwang, suffering a broken leg.
A 23-year-old man suffered a foot injury from a chainsaw while working on a terrace construction at his parents house in Brixen im Thale and was airlifted to the hospital.
A missing 49-year-old woman in Nassereith was found safe after a search operation.
A man was found growing 32 cannabis plants and possessing cannabis in his apartment near a police station after officers detected the smell of cannabis.
Police and city actions focused on public disturbances and drug offenses on the Donauinsel and Groß Enzersdorfer Straße in Vienna, including multiple legal violations and preventive measures.
A missing surfer was rescued near Bregenzer Bucht after drifting due to strong winds and experiencing equipment failure.
Traffic inspections on A4 in Nickelsdorf revealed numerous violations, including a dangerous truck with defective brakes and an illegal transportation of nine dogs in unsuitable conditions.
A motorcyclist and his 12-year-old son were involved in a collision with a car; the child was airlifted to a hospital with injuries.
Burglars broke into a single-family home in Graz, stealing a watch collection, luxury handbags, and more, causing a loss of tens of thousands of euros.
Police conducted traffic inspections targeting a tuning car meet; multiple violations, including radar offenses, vehicle infractions, alcohol, and drug-related charges were reported.
A 51-year-old motorcyclist died after a crash in Scheibbs district during the Pentecost weekend.
Hazardous goods transport stopped; vehicle overloaded, unsafe cargo, and leaking substances detected.
An elderly motorcyclist was hit by a car from behind in Gnadenwald, causing him to fall. Initially reporting no injuries, he later experienced severe pain and required medical attention.
A probationary driver caused a major traffic accident in Esternberg and fled the scene before being identified through vehicle parts left behind.
Unknown individual administered drugs to a 19-year-old in a bar in Unterweitersdorf, causing severe health issues.
A 64-year-old man in Muntlix was found unconscious and resuscitated by police until emergency services arrived.
A car collided with a deer in Weißenbach, resulting in the car overturning and injuring the driver.
A car and a truck collided head-on in Imst, Austria, causing severe injury to the car driver who was trapped and needed rescue, while the truck driver sustained minor injuries.
The police initiative GEMEINSAM.SICHER was relaunched in Vienna to enhance community collaboration, address issues like vandalism and noise, and improve public safety.
A 18-year-old driver lost control of his car while turning, hitting a tree; one passenger was slightly injured, and the driver was found to be underage and intoxicated.
A 17-year-old intoxicated driver without a valid license crashed into four parked cars in Mittelberg, causing significant damage and injuring himself.
Multiple cars were caught speeding significantly over the limit in Viennas Floridsdorf district, with speeds of up to 198 km/h recorded.
A 46-year-old man threatened a gas station employee with a knife in Vienna, leading to his arrest and detection of alcohol consumption.
A sauna building in a hotel in Bad Tatzmannsdorf burned down completely due to a fire initiated by an electric sauna heater, with no injuries and no intent suspected.
A motorized hang glider had engine problems and made an emergency landing, causing minor injuries to the pilot and heavy damage to the glider.
A residential house caught fire in Seewalchen am Attersee; the fire originated in the living room and was quickly extinguished by the fire department.
A 17-year-old driver lost control of his car during an overtaking maneuver and crashed, resulting in four minor injuries.
A fire broke out in a barn in Mattsee, caused by sparks from a grinding machine; no injuries reported.
A 31-year-old man fell from a tree while performing forestry work and sustained severe injuries.
Fire destroyed an unused agricultural building, no injuries reported, cause under investigation.
An unknown perpetrator pretended to be a company employee and tricked a grocery store employee into providing Bitcoin top-up codes, causing financial damage.
At least ten cars were vandalized in a parking garage in Schwaz with scratches and damaged license plates.
A person posing as a Tobaccoland employee scammed a tobacco shop employee into providing Bitcoin recharge codes, causing financial loss.
A 37-year-old Austrian man fell approximately 4 meters from a roof during renovation work in Kundl, suffering serious injuries to his left foot.
A 35-year-old man fell three meters while descending in alpine terrain, resulting in a shoulder dislocation, and was rescued by helicopter after reaching mobile reception.
Two Syrian men threatened and attacked a taxi driver, then assaulted police officers during their arrest; both tested positive for alcohol.
In Vienna, a 15-year-old girl was found during a disturbance investigation, was intoxicated, and later assaulted officers by throwing objects and threatening them. She was temporarily detained.
A 23-year-old woman driving a car hit a 29-year-old intoxicated pedestrian at a crosswalk; the man was seriously injured.
Motorcyclist exceeded speed limits significantly, reaching 225 km/h in a 100 km/h zone, with illegal modifications to exhaust system detected, license seized.
Large boulder fell into a river near Heiligenblut, leading to the closure of B 107 for safety reasons.
A man became too exhausted to continue a climbing tour in Breitwand and was rescued by mountain rescue services.
A drunk driver caused a car accident on Römerstraße, injuring himself and his passenger, who was airlifted to the hospital.
A 36-year-old man experienced health issues after a dive in Attersee and was transported to a hospital for treatment.
A glider pilot made an emergency landing in a field due to poor thermals; no injuries or damage reported.
A car overturned in Micheldorf after hitting a bridge railing; the driver was injured and taken to a hospital.
An unidentified youth attempted to rob two 11-year-old boys in Grazs Annenstraße and assaulted them; no injuries reported.
Cyclist injured in Graz after a risk-taking maneuver by a white van caused an accident; police seeking witnesses.
An 18-year-old cyclist fell 20 meters down a steep slope in Faggen and was rescued and airlifted to a hospital.
A woman suffered severe head injuries after a collision with another cyclist in a descending mountain bike group in Greiter Graben, Alpbach.
A cyclist in Mieming was injured after being allegedly forced off the road by a passing truck; the truck driver did not stop.
A 34-year-old Austrian man in Kufstein allegedly threatened a 20-year-old Serbian man with a weapon; suspect was arrested and the weapon secured.
Motorcycle rider and passenger injured in a collision with a car at an intersection; passenger airlifted to hospital.
A man was arrested for having over €45,000 in unpaid administrative fines, mostly for traffic violations, after being stopped for using a mobile phone while driving.
A bicycle rider collided with a pedestrian in Schattendorf, leaving both injured and requiring hospitalization.
A 65-year-old driver collided with a railing while avoiding another vehicle, tested positive for alcohol, and was injured.
Two 15-year-olds in Innsbruck were threatened with a knife and robbed by five female youths who were later arrested.
Three Italian men were robbed and assaulted in a garage in Innsbruck by four unidentified attackers. The victims were threatened with further violence if they informed the police.
A ship in St. Pantaleon tilted due to water ingress, causing fuel to leak into the Enns Canal and Danube. The owner is being charged for environmental negligence.
A fire broke out in an agricultural building likely due to a technical defect; no other ignition sources identified.
A 51-year-old man fled the scene after causing a car accident in Feldkirchen, injuring a 48-year-old woman and her daughter. He later admitted fear of losing his license after drinking beer.
A farmer fell approximately 3.5 meters while working in his barn in Völkermarkt, sustaining injuries.
A group assault in Pestalozzigasse, Weiz, left two men injured, and the perpetrators fled towards Schillerpark.
A 17-year-old driver lost control and crashed into a tunnel portal in Sölden while intoxicated, resulting in injury and total car damage.
A 15-year-old moped rider fell after braking suddenly on Kärtner Bundesstraße B 83 in Villach and was taken to the hospital with minor injuries. Another driver involved left the scene.
27-year-old driver crashed his light vehicle in Villach, overturning and requiring rescue and hospitalization.
A car collision occurred involving a Romanian mans vehicle, a truck, and an Austrian womans car, injuring three people.
A 24-year-old driver lost control of his car and hit a streetlight; he was injured and hospitalized, and the car sustained severe damage.

In Vienna, a 14-year-old without a license used a stolen car, resisted officers, and appeared drug-impaired; a different case involved a 26-year-old driving at high speed and violating multiple traffic laws.
A 45-year-old man was arrested at the Nickelsdorf border crossing for burglary theft following a warrant issued by a Vienna court.
Two men attacked police officers verbally and physically after an intervention for noise complaints in Linz.
A 54-year-old woman was seriously injured in a fall with her e-bike while handling her mobile phone in Innerschwand am Mondsee, and was airlifted to UKH Salzburg for medical treatment.
A 29-year-old intoxicated driver caused a traffic accident in Linz, crashing into a parked van and causing severe property damage.
A car was stolen from the driveway of a 22-year-old woman on Sunday evening by an unknown suspect.
A 50-year-old man was injured when his car went off the road and overturned on the L353 near Anger, resulting in total vehicle damage.
Small fire in the basement of a house; no injuries reported, caused by a technical defect in a charging station.
A 53-year-old man had an accident while descending on an e-bike in Rum, Austria and was rescued by mountain rescue services.
A woman fell from her mountain bike in Iselsberg and sustained serious injuries; she was later found and transported to the hospital by emergency helicopter.
Collision between two cyclists in Lorüns on a bike path; one woman was seriously injured, and the responsible cyclist fled without providing information.
Police conducted a house search in Bregenz linked to theft; the son resisted entry but was subdued, and weapons were found. The father faces charges for theft and weapon possession.
A man attacked a police officer by shoving him from behind and punching him multiple times, causing injuries and property damage during the arrest.

An individual was stopped for unsafe driving in Vienna and was found without a valid license, under suspected drug influence, and in possession of cannabis. Further investigation revealed additional drugs at his residence.
A traffic accident occurred in Vienna where a 70-year-old woman was injured and her car overturned after being hit by an intoxicated driver with no valid license.
A stray dog named Lilly was rescued by police in Vienna, safely captured after roaming through various districts without harm to her or the public.
A 50-year-old man threatened his wife and son with a kitchen knife during a family argument in Vienna-Liesing. He was arrested, and a restraining order was issued. No injuries were reported.
A 15-year-old moped driver and her friend were injured after falling in a traffic circle in Feldkirchen.
A car skidded on a wet road in Klausen-Leopoldsdorf, tumbled over an embankment, and landed upside down; the driver was injured and airlifted to a hospital.
A 33-year-old motorcyclist fell after attempting to avoid a collision with a car at an intersection in Pischelsdorf, suffering injuries and being taken to the hospital.
A truck driver was injured during the unloading of a garage door and airlifted to a hospital.
A 57-year-old German motorcyclist and his 56-year-old passenger were injured after their motorcycle veered off the road and collided with a guardrail.
A 52-year-old German man was arrested in St. Pantaleon, Austria, under an EU warrant for unlawfully claiming long-term unemployment benefits while employed.
A woman in Linz was stopped for reckless driving, refused drug and alcohol tests, displayed aggressive behavior toward police, and was briefly detained.
A motorcyclist was caught speeding at 186km/h in a 100km/h zone and faces penalties.
A heavily intoxicated woman resisted arrest, attacked a police officer, and damaged a police vehicle at a local venue.
A dog consumed poisoned bait in a park and required emergency treatment; investigations are ongoing.
A work accident occurred in Serfaus where a falling machine injured a worker in the head and shoulder area.
A 53-year-old employee was injured during loading of a truck in Brixlegg when a metal bolt rolled and pinned his ankle.
A mortar injection pump worth a mid-four-digit euro amount was stolen from a construction companys parking area in Thal/Assling between May 28, 2021, and May 31, 2021.
A Dutch cyclist lost control and crashed into a concrete base while descending a restricted road, sustaining injuries requiring hospital treatment.
A man was caught collecting fallen wildlife parts in a hunting area in Vorarlberg and was reported to the authorities.
A balcony fire occurred in an apartment in Hohenems, causing significant damage but no injuries. The fire was extinguished by firefighters, and the apartment remains habitable.
A 41-year-old man, wanted for fraud, was arrested in Linz for committing multiple order frauds involving electronics and a burglary in Straßwalchen.
A crowd of 50-70 intoxicated individuals caused a disturbance during a festive event, leading to police involvement and multiple legal actions.
A car was stolen from a driveway in St. Georgen bei Neumarkt on May 31, 2020, and later found undamaged in a nearby field with the keys inside.
A 23-year-old suspect was arrested for two vehicle thefts in Vienna Favoriten after being identified by a witness and attempting to flee.
Two men threatened a victim with a 20cm dagger in his garage in Mattersburg, stole cash, and fled towards the city center. Police are investigating.
Two German climbers got stranded on a 40-meter-high cliff during descent and were rescued by police helicopter using a rope.
A woman refused to comply with an Austrian border control, attempted to bypass the checkpoint, and endangered a soldier by driving towards him.
Police officers conducting an immigration check were attacked by two men with punches and kicks, resulting in injuries and requiring hospital treatment.
A fire broke out in a heating systems wood chip supply area, causing damage to the supply and electrical installation before being extinguished.
Drunk driver caused a traffic accident, fled the scene, and was found with illegal substances while not having a valid license.
Car overturned and driver fled the scene; injuries and search efforts reported.
Two 17-year-old intoxicated teens in Schwaz set off a firecracker in a newspaper stand and were apprehended by police.
A 31-year-old man died after his car crashed into a tree on LB 3 in Bezirk Gänserndorf, Austria.
A car without a valid driver license caused significant damage to 13 parked vehicles and disrupted traffic controls; police intervened.
A 4-year-old girl was lightly injured after being hit by a car when running onto the street.
A 58-year-old Hungarian man was arrested at the Vienna main station for fraud and criminal association under an EU arrest warrant.
A man attacked a police officer with a knife during an intervention at a metro station after assaulting his ex-girlfriend.
A motorcyclist was severely injured after running off the road and crashing into a ditch on B15 near Eisenstadt.
A 53-year-old hiker got stuck in rocky terrain near the summit of Mittagskogel and was rescued by a police helicopter.
A 3-year-old child was bitten or scratched in the face by a dog while visiting a farm.
A police dog bit a 15-year-old girl in Hermagor after the dog removed its muzzle during a walk, causing injuries to her arm.
A 24-year-old man from Linz was arrested during a vehicle check in Bad Großpertholz for driving without a valid license and having outstanding fines of approximately 5,800 euros.

A car chase occurred after police attempted to stop a vehicle in poor condition. The driver, a 22-year-old without a valid license, fled at high speeds, ran red lights, and was eventually stopped. Methamphetamine and cannabis were found in his possession, and drug influence was confirmed.
A 26-year-old motorcyclist veered off the road in Kefermarkt, Freistadt district, and flipped multiple times, landing in a field; he was hospitalized with injuries of unspecified severity.
Woman critically injured as boat collapses during cleaning at a storage facility.
A 17-year-old provisional driver was caught speeding at 173 km/h in a 100 km/h zone on the A 10 near the Hiefler Tunnel and claimed she was in a hurry.
Fire broke out in the kitchen of a single-family house; no injuries, but significant property damage.
A 32-year-old woman injured her foot during a descent from Schöckl mountain and was hospitalized.
A 50-year-old tractor driver collided with a 54-year-old cyclist, causing the cyclist to sustain injuries and be transported to the hospital.
Motorcycle and e-bike collision in Breitenbach am Inn, resulting in head injuries for both drivers.
A Slovak driver crashed her car into objects and trees due to losing control on a street in Mieders, Tirol; she sustained injuries and tested positive for alcohol.

License plates were stolen from four cars in multiple locations in Tirol. A police chase ensued in Innsbruck, resulting in a property damage accident. Four youths were detained, and stolen license plates were found in the trunk. No injuries occurred.
A 48-year-old paraglider crashed into a forest near Ötz due to thermal turbulence and was severely injured; rescue operations involved a helicopter and mountain rescue team.
A 50-year-old woman on an e-bike made an emergency stop and fell, suffering severe head injuries, after a car attempted to enter the road in Scheffau.
A motorcycle collided with a mountain bike on the L73 road in Rankweil, resulting in minor injuries to all three individuals involved and damage to both vehicles.
A 62-year-old woman fell on a hiking trail and was rescued by the mountain rescue team before being taken to Feldkirch State Hospital with injuries.
A 52-year-old Polish national was arrested in Vienna-Floridsdorf under a European arrest warrant for multiple violent and property crimes.
An intoxicated driver lost control of his car, struck a light pole, causing the car to catch fire; driver and passenger injured.
A 46-year-old cleaning staff member was arrested in Vienna for allegedly stealing a five-figure sum from her employer.
A 78-year-old driver lost control of her vehicle on the B50 road between Kittsee and Berg, crashed into a tree, and was airlifted to the hospital after sustaining injuries.
A 34-year-old woman fell off her bike in Reigersdorf, avoiding a cat, and was hospitalized with serious injuries.
A heavily intoxicated 53-year-old man in Villach assaulted his 31-year-old son, causing unspecified injuries. The man was charged with assault and received a restraining order for their shared home.
A 31-year-old driver swerved to avoid a deer on the road, went off the road in Pertitschach, and crashed down an embankment, sustaining injuries and damaging his car.
Paper container fire in Klagenfurt extinguished, no injuries, investigation ongoing.
A car collided with a motorcycle at an intersection in Klagenfurt, causing serious injury to the motorcyclist.
Motorcyclist collided with a car on Loiblpaß Straße B 91, suffered injuries, and was airlifted to hospital.
A 22-year-old man died after his car veered off the road and collided with a tree in the district of Gänserndorf.
A 17-year-old moped driver collided head-on with a car and was seriously injured in Waidhofen an der Thaya area.
Two vehicles collided head-on in Goggendorf, injuring both drivers; one driver tested positive for alcohol.

A 59-year-old Austrian man suffered a medical emergency while driving on the A-21 in Heiligenkreuz, causing a collision with a passing truck and damage to vehicles and a guardrail; no injuries reported, but substantial traffic delays occurred.
Motorcycle collided with a car during an overtaking maneuver in Puchenau, causing injuries to the motorcyclist.

A traffic accident involving four vehicles occurred on the A2 Südautobahn in Gleisdorf with one person slightly injured; two drivers were found to be heavily intoxicated.
An 87-year-old cyclist collided with a tractor fork and sustained serious injuries in Admont, Austria.

A car collided with a tractor in Brixen im Thale, Austria, due to the car crossing into the opposite lane, resulting in damage and the car drivers temporary license suspension due to alcohol impairment.

A neighborhood dispute in Innsbruck led to a Nigerian man threatening a Greek man with an axe; both sustained minor injuries. The Nigerian, found to be staying illegally, was detained and given a weapons ban.
A small child was bitten in the leg by a dog on a playground in Krumbach; police seek the dog owner.
A paraglider pilot crashed during landing after losing control and sustained injuries, requiring airlift to the hospital.
A car driver collided head-on with a truck after attempting to avoid a traffic jam and suffered injuries in Alberschwende; her car sustained total damage.
36 truck tires with rims stolen from a firm premises in Parndorf.
A heavily intoxicated woman in Telfs was apprehended by police after aggressive behavior; during the arrest and subsequent detention, she physically attacked officers, leading to injuries.
A 51-year-old ski tourer fell during a descent from Reißeck mountain, suffered injuries, but managed to descend and seek medical help.

A 54-year-old German mountaineer went missing during a hike in the Ahrnspitze area in Scharnitz, and a search operation involving helicopters and rescue teams from Austria and Germany has been initiated.
A heavy hydraulic hammer of approximately 250 kg was stolen from a storage site in See, likely using a crane-like device.
Restrictions were imposed on heavy truck traffic in Tirol due to Italian holiday regulations.

A 21-year-old driver crashed into a roundabout on the B50 near Eisenstadt, damaging its structures. He was trapped in the vehicle and later rescued by a witness. The driver sustained minor injuries and was found to have been under the influence of alcohol.
A freight train struck two cows on the tracks in Ferndorf; one died and the other was injured.
A car collision occurred in Klagenfurt on Waidmannsdorfer Straße due to one driver ignoring a stop sign, resulting in another driver being injured and significant vehicle damage.
A car driver failed to yield and collided with an oncoming motorcycle, severely injuring the motorcyclist.

A 58-year-old motorcyclist in Albrechtsberg lost control due to over-acceleration and fell, sustaining unspecified injuries.
Report on bicycle-related incidents in Steiermark, including traffic accidents and thefts, highlighting the increase in e-bike accidents and the role of the Graz bicycle police.
Telephone scammers impersonating police officers attempt to obtain cash and valuables through deceit.
A burned male body was discovered, and investigations into the fires cause are being carried out.
A fire broke out in an apartment building in Bregenz, causing one death and multiple injuries due to smoke inhalation, with evacuation and extensive emergency response.
An armed robbery occurred at a tobacco shop in Wien-Brigittenau. The suspect fled with cash, and no injuries were reported.

Gas detected in Klagenfurt; area was cordoned and investigated, with no hazardous gas leak found.
Two trucks collided on the A2 highway; no injuries but significant damage occurred.
A gas bottle caught fire in a restaurant kitchen in Nötsch, Villach. The fire was extinguished, guests evacuated, and the area was secured. No injuries or damage occurred.
A fawn was rescued at Rathausplatz in Gänserndorf and handed over to local police and a hunter for care.
A 51-year-old warehouse worker was fatally injured while operating a mobile overhead crane, becoming trapped between heavy cable drums.

A 49-year-old cyclist fell and sustained severe injuries while riding on a path near the Danube in Tulln an der Donau. He was not wearing a helmet and was airlifted to a hospital in Vienna.

Dispute between a cyclist and a car driver in Ranshofen led to police involvement after the cyclist exhibited signs of drug influence and refused a clinical driving fitness test.
An 84-year-old cyclist collided with an ambulance in Neuhofen im Innkreis and suffered fatal injuries.

A 16-year-old moped driver was forced off the road and injured during an overtaking incident involving a truck, with the driver initially leaving the scene but later being called back thanks to witnesses.
A missing 45-year-old man with Huntingtons disease was found deceased in Wels; no foul play is suspected.
Fire caused by a probable short circuit in photovoltaic system batteries, extinguished by firefighters with no injuries reported.
Worker injured by falling steel part at a construction site.
A 79-year-old man fell off his e-bike after hitting a rock on the road, sustaining unspecified injuries.
