Two men were injured while trying to remove the driveshaft of a car in a garage when the car fell on one of them.
A head-on collision occurred between two cars on Herzogsdorfer Landesstraße, resulting in injuries to both drivers.

A drug ring was dismantled in Grieskirchen, involving multiple dealers who sold drugs over six months. Two key suspects were arrested and are accused of threatening a man with a machete to collect drug debts.
A 37-year-old man led police on a car chase through Graz and surrounding areas, endangering others and resisting arrest before being apprehended; no alcohol was involved.
Oil left on an electric stove caused a kitchen fire in Köflach; the fire was extinguished by firefighters, and one person was hospitalized for possible smoke inhalation.
A 42-year-old Slovenian man is suspected of committing at least 20 acts of fraud, causing over 82,000 Euros in damages by falsifying or removing pallet documents and selling the pallets for profit.
Two Germans discovered a bazooka while magnet fishing in Thiersee; the area was secured, and the explosive device was neutralized by the bomb disposal team.
A 3-year-old boy fell from a balcony in Feldkirch while trying to retrieve a toy but remained uninjured.
A 56-year-old man suffered severe hand injuries, including partial thumb amputation, while working with a table saw in his workshop in Dalaas.
A wrong-way driver was stopped on the A5 near Wolkersdorf Nord without causing any accidents; the driver was sober, and their license was confiscated.
A Hungarian woman damaged her car and a traffic barrier in a hit-and-run accident on the B 178 road near Unken.
A 63-year-old woman fell off her e-bike in Arbesbach, suffering injuries and was airlifted to Linz hospital.
A 52-year-old motorcyclist died after a collision with a small truck at an intersection in Vösendorf.
A motorcyclist lost control and crashed into a ditch; he was airlifted to the hospital with injuries.
A van slid down a steep slope in Götzis, Meschach, after a driver failed to stop it during a maneuver; no injuries were reported.

A 27-year-old man threatened and attempted to injure a 49-year-old during a dispute, then fled via a roof hatch and fell several meters while being pursued by police. He was injured and later charged.
A man in Carinthia was defrauded via an online cryptocurrency trading scheme, losing several thousand euros after being convinced to invest through a fraudulent investment platform.
A 22-year-old man in Salzburg was caught twice in 24 hours driving without a license after a previous ban. He will be reported to the local authorities.
A car driven by a 44-year-old Austrian plunged down an embankment in Telfs, causing injuries to the driver and significant vehicle damage.
A coffee machine caused a fire due to a short circuit in a house in Oberperfuss; no injuries reported.
Wanted man from Czech Republic arrested in Vienna related to an 8-month sentence for theft.
Police warn of phone spoofing scams where callers impersonate officers to steal valuables.
Two vehicles collided in Bleiburg due to speeding, causing injuries and significant vehicle damage; both drivers tested positive for alcohol consumption.
A 73-year-old man in Villach-Land fell and got injured while trying to return escaped horses to their pasture.
Two cars collided head-on after a driver attempted to overtake another vehicle, causing one driver to be seriously injured and requiring helicopter transport.
Two truck drivers were injured when one truck tipped over onto another while unloading gravel on a commercial site.
A drunk driver caused a traffic accident in Pfaffstätt, where a 24-year-old pregnant woman was injured and hospitalized; the drivers license was revoked after a 1.2 promille alcohol test.
A 15-year-old motorcycle learner from Ried district lost control on a wet road in Steinedt during a training ride and fell; he was taken to the hospital with unspecified injuries.
A rear-end collision occurred in Straßwalchen, resulting in injuries to two individuals and significant vehicle damage.
An intoxicated man in Obermieming resisted arrest and attacked police officers, resulting in minor injuries to the man and two officers.
A 38-year-old man accidentally caused a kitchen fire in Tarrenz while warming food on an electric stove and falling asleep. The fire was extinguished by the fire department.
A 43-year-old woman was caught spraying graffiti on a gas station wall in Innsbruck, intending to cover an existing FPÖ sign. She will be reported to the public prosecutor.
An unknown suspect entered a hair salon in Innsbruck and stole a cash register with money.
A car driver caused a cyclist to brake abruptly at an intersection, leading to her falling and sustaining minor injuries. The driver fled the scene after a brief conversation.
Two men were arrested in Vienna while caught in the act of a burglary in an apartment, with tools and stolen goods seized.
A 27-year-old man was arrested in St. Pölten for extensive property damage, including damaging vehicles, shop windows, and other items using stones.
A car collided with a cyclist during a turn, injuring the cyclist and causing a shock to the car driver.
A man with a CO2 airsoft gun accidentally fired a shot outside a supermarket in Wr. Neustadt, leading to a police operation. He was later identified and arrested.
Authorities found 60 guests in a venue in Vienna-Simmering violating curfew regulations and issued multiple administrative charges. A woman displaying aggressive behavior was temporarily detained.
Unidentified perpetrators attempted to steal a valuable horse from a farm by disabling the electric fence and entering the paddock but were likely interrupted and fled the scene.
A 25-year-old lost control of his car on Lamprechtshausener Bundesstraße, resulting in one passenger being injured. The driver had over 1.2 per mille alcohol and lost his license.
A 29-year-old Austrian man crashed his car into a tree on the B 171 in Kundl, possibly due to microsleep, resulting in injuries and significant vehicle damage.
Two individuals broke into an electronics store, stole items, and one resisted arrest violently; weapons were found on one suspect.
Intoxicated woman fell from a rented motorboat and became disoriented; police and water rescue intervened, and legal actions are being pursued.
Three men were offered drugs, declined, and were then attacked. The suspects tried to snatch a bag, stole a jacket and a small amount of cash, and were arrested during a search operation.
A fire broke out on the roof of a multi-apartment building in Kemeten, believed to have been caused by material fatigue and a heat buildup in the solar panel wiring.
A 15-year-old boy and his 14-year-old friend were injured in a moped accident caused by loose gravel on a road; the 15-year-old was hospitalized.

A 15-year-old male lost control of his moped due to excessive speed, veered off the road, and crashed in a nearby forest in Wolfsberg District, sustaining injuries and causing significant damage to the vehicle.
A father accidentally caused injuries to himself and his daughter by pouring flammable liquid on an already burning fire, leading to a flash flame near a grill area in Villach.
A man was caught speeding at 181 km/h on a road with a limit of 100 km/h and will be reported to the authorities.
A 35-year-old motorcyclist from Graz crashed on the Klippitztörl Landesstraße, sustaining injuries and causing significant damage to his motorcycle.

Two motorcyclists were stopped after being detected driving at 222 km/h, significantly over the speed limit, on the A5 in Hohenleiten. Their licenses were confiscated and they were reported to the district authority.
A car driver collided with a cyclist after failing to yield while turning left; the cyclist sustained unspecified injuries and was flown to a hospital.
A 55-year-old woman from Vienna fell about 20 meters while climbing in Dürnstein and was rescued by helicopter with serious injuries.
Multiple vehicles were involved in a collision on the A2 near Kottingbrunn. Several passengers were injured, including one child with severe injuries who was airlifted to a hospital.
A motorcyclist was caught speeding at 225 km/h on A 5 and was stopped by authorities.

An intoxicated driver assaulted his girlfriend during a car ride, lost control of the vehicle, and crashed into a tunnel wall; he was aggressive towards police, tried to flee, and was arrested with a high blood alcohol level.
A 22-year-old man in Salzburg was aggressive and threatened violence on a train, resisted police arrest, and attempted to harm officers.
A collision occurred between a Vespa and a bicycle in Salzburg on Berchtesgadener Straße, resulting in injuries and requiring the cyclist to be hospitalized.
A 57-year-old motorcyclist was seriously injured in a collision during an overtaking maneuver near Salzburg.
Paragliding pilot from Czech Republic injured during landing approach due to adverse wind conditions.
A cyclist was severely injured in a traffic accident when a car driver failed to notice him while turning into a parking lot.

A car accident in Gratwein-Straßengel resulted in a 69-year-old man being critically injured and his wife seriously injured; their vehicle veered off the road, rolled down a slope, and landed in a stream bed.
A 75-year-old Austrian man had a car accident on the Inntalautobahn A12 in Langkampfen due to microsleep, resulting in injuries and total car damage.
A 28-year-old Austrian man fell 80 meters during a solo mountain tour and was airlifted to a hospital with injuries.
Two individuals on e-bikes collided at a crossroads in Fieberbrunn, leaving both injured.

A collision occurred on Wildbichler Straße in Ebbs when an 80-year-old motorcyclist attempted to overtake a 15-year-old moped driver who was turning; three individuals were injured and both vehicles were damaged.
Austrian driver fell asleep and caused a head-on collision on Loferer Straße; four people injured and both vehicles totaled.

Two boys were trapped in a water current at Dornbirner Ache; one was stuck on a sandbank and another in a water whirl. A 21-year-old passerby and additional helpers coordinated a rescue using a rope, ladder, and emergency services. All were safely rescued and hospitalized.

A pedestrian in Lustenau was struck by a car after stepping onto the road and gesturing at the driver. The driver fled the scene but later turned himself in. The pedestrian was injured and hospitalized.
A 56-year-old man attacked a 57-year-old with a broomstick, causing facial injuries. The attacker was intoxicated and arrested by police.

A 37-year-old woman threatened her husband with a knife during a family dispute; both accused each other of threats and past physical attacks on their children, leading to the children being placed in crisis intervention.
Police conducted a traffic enforcement operation in Vienna Favoriten, issuing fines, removing license plates, and arresting individuals for suspected drug possession.
A 20-year-old man threatened his family members and punched a police officer in the face, leading to his arrest.
A man attempted to break into a car with a pocket knife and was temporarily arrested by the police.
Two authorized gatherings about rights and participation occurred calmly in Eisenstadt, with no legal or safety violations.
A 21-year-old truck driver caused a traffic accident on Rosengasse, Oberpullendorf, involving four damaged vehicles and a telephone pole. The driver was injured and found to be intoxicated.
A 47-year-old man and his 51-year-old sister were involved in a moped accident caused by an unknown drivers collision, resulting in serious injuries to the sister.
A 52-year-old man died after being struck on the head by a falling wooden beam during demolition work in Velden am Wörthersee.
A Slovenian womans car collided with another vehicle on the L128 road; the elderly driver was injured and taken to the hospital, while significant damage occurred to both vehicles.
An 83-year-old cyclist was injured after colliding with a car on the B 25 road in Grafenmühl.
Two Macedonian nationals were caught shoplifting electronic devices and other stolen goods in Bezirk Linz-Land and were arrested.
Two teenagers were physically assaulted by unknown individuals at Tummelplatz in Linz, with one sustaining facial injuries and requiring hospitalization.
A man fell into the Danube in Linz and sank; a search operation was initiated but has been unsuccessful so far.
A traffic accident in Salzburg involved a 23-year-old cyclist who was injured and the alleged offender fled the scene.
A car caught fire in Graz due to a suspected technical defect; no injuries were reported.
A 20-year-old man was seriously injured after his car veered off the road for unknown reasons; local residents alerted emergency services.
A traffic accident occurred in Graz involving a car and a moped, leaving the moped driver seriously injured.
A 59-year-old worker sustained a head injury after slipping and falling on a rock during maintenance work in mountainous terrain.
Two diesel generators caught fire near Schloss Ambras in Innsbruck during camping activities; the fire was quickly controlled, and no danger to people or the environment occurred.
A 17-year-old from Kundl crashed her motorcycle in a sharp curve on the L37 near Thiersee without external influence and was taken to a hospital with unspecified injuries.
A man accidentally caused a fire while working on a car in a garage, extinguished it with a fire extinguisher, but sustained burns to his arm.
A traffic controller was struck and severely injured by a reversing cleaning truck during roadworks in Matrei in Osttirol.
Two men attempted to steal electric tools and a toothbrush from a store in Wattens, fleeing the scene. Later, they were apprehended with suspected stolen items worth €1,000.
Two cattle escaped a farm in Fußach, crossing roads and causing minor property damage before being tranquilized and safely relocated without injuries.
A car bumper was stolen from a BMW in Bürs; the thief later confessed after police found the stolen part.
Two young cattle escaped from a farm in Fußach, crossed roadways, and caused property damage to fences, hedges, and a parked car before being tranquilized and captured.
A 50-year-old man was seriously injured at a cafe in Klagenfurt after being punched in the face and head multiple times by a 44-year-old man during an altercation.
A 23-year-old woman lost control of her car, which overturned and landed on its roof; she sustained injuries and was hospitalized.
A man fell from a roof while working on a farm, sustaining severe injuries.
Cheese truck overturned on the Westautobahn, causing a highway closure; no injuries reported.
Five escaped horses caused a traffic accident on a highway in Schlüßlberg, leading to the death of one horse that had to be euthanized due to severe injuries.
An 18-year-old with a provisional drivers license drove under the influence, collided with a bridge railing in Altheim, and caused injuries to himself and his passenger.
Missing 13-year-old girl from Tyrol was located near Bahnhof Golling after a large search operation and safely returned to her parents.
Three intoxicated individuals engaged in a physical altercation involving punches and kicks, resulting in injuries to two men who were hospitalized.
A woman was injured after falling from an e-scooter in Klagenfurts Goethepark due to alcohol-related riding. Both individuals were moderately intoxicated.
Unknown perpetrators damaged two streetlights in Erkergasse, Klagenfurt am Wörthersee, using an unidentified object.
Two teenagers were attacked by a group of 7-8 youths in Linz, sustaining injuries; perpetrators remain unidentified.

A 24-year-old driver in Bergheim was found with his car stuck in a field at 01:00 after driving off the road. A breathalyzer test showed 1.78 per mille alcohol. His license was seized, and he was reported to authorities.
Group of youths attacked four victims sitting by the Salzach river in Salzburg, injuring three through punches and kicks.
A masked man threatened an employee with a knife, stole cash from a store in Vienna-Erdberg, and fled. Nobody was injured.
Two men committed bicycle thefts in Vienna; one suspect was arrested while intoxicated and the other managed to escape initially.
A suspected drug dealer was arrested by undercover police in Wien Mitte after selling cocaine; drugs and cash were confiscated.
A cyclist was slightly injured at Hietzinger Kai in Vienna after being hit by a car while crossing the road.
A 45-year-old cyclist fell in a steep forest section in Feldkirchen, seriously injuring himself, and was airlifted to a hospital.
A Slovenian paraglider faced technical issues and performed an emergency landing, getting stuck in a tree in steep terrain before being safely rescued without injuries.
A man injured his hand while working with a milling machine at home and was taken to the hospital after receiving first aid from his wife.
Motorcycle and car collision in Villach resulted in severe injuries for the motorcyclist with slight alcohol involvement by the car driver.
An 80-year-old man suffered severe head injuries after falling off his bicycle on the Drauradweg in Villach.
An 84-year-old woman lost control of her car, crashed into a garage door, and sustained severe injuries. Neighbors rescued her, and she was hospitalized.
A 77-year-old driver lost control of his car in Breitenstein, causing it to veer off the road, roll down an embankment, and overturn, injuring all four occupants.
A truck collided with a bus at an intersection in Schwechat, injuring the truck driver, the bus driver, and a passenger, while causing significant vehicle damage.
A 19-year-old man sitting on the hood of a car driven by a 20-year-old woman fell off and sustained serious injuries after the car was driven at high speed in a parking area.
A car swerved to avoid a deer, left the road, and collided with a parked vehicle, causing significant damage and slight injuries to the car occupants.

A car accident caused by a 24-year-old driver under the influence of alcohol resulted in the vehicle overturning; the driver and a 21-year-old passerby, also intoxicated, had their licenses temporarily revoked.
At Mühlviertler-Alm Straße in Liebenau, a tractor with hay forks collided with a car during overtaking, injuring a passenger who was hospitalized.
A moped collided with a car during a turning maneuver, causing minor injuries to the moped driver and passenger.
An intoxicated driver led a police pursuit, committing multiple violations before being apprehended on the Südautobahn and testing heavily under the influence of alcohol.
A 37-year-old motorcyclist crashed in a curve and sustained unspecified injuries.
Kitchen fire in Graz caused by overheated cookware; several individuals hospitalized due to suspected smoke inhalation.
A car collided with a concrete barrier on the A2 in Hart bei Graz, injuring the driver and passenger. The accident caused road closures and significant traffic delays.
A 26-year-old Austrian paragliding pilot activated his emergency chute after encountering turbulence and was rescued from a tree by mountain rescue in Walchsee.
A 34-year-old driver crashed into a tractor, causing it to overturn and injuring the 17-year-old operator; a positive alcohol test was reported.
A 64-year-old man stole a waitresss cash bag containing a four-digit amount of money from a bar in Innsbruck and was apprehended with the stolen bag in the train station hall during a police search.
A motorcycle collision in Sellrain resulted in injuries to a 57-year-old rider and a 42-year-old passenger, with the latter airlifted to a hospital.

A 62-year-old Austrian man was severely injured while trying to attach a hay turner to a hydraulic machine in Gerlos. The machine started moving, trapping his foot under the twin wheels. He was flown to a hospital in Schwaz by rescue helicopter.

A 17-year-old tractor driver attempted to turn left when he was overtaken by a 52-year-old motorcyclist, resulting in a collision. The motorcyclist was thrown onto the road and tragically suffered fatal injuries, and the motorcycle caught fire.
A 22-year-old woman rear-ended a vehicle at 80km/h on Lustenauerstraße in Hard, causing significant damage and injuring both drivers.

Traffic operation in Vienna resulted in 498 speeding violations, 61 alcohol tests, and multiple other traffic offenses. One driver with 1.78 promille alcohol level and drug influence had their license temporarily revoked.
A 17-year-old broke into a bakery, stole cash, and was later identified and confessed to the crime.
A collision occurred between a small truck reversing out of a parking space and a motorcycle, injuring the 61-year-old motorcyclist.
A man attempted to steal a mobile phone from a vending machine with a wire; drugs were found on him during a search and he was arrested.
Motorcycle collided with a mountain biker in a curve, causing injuries to the biker and the bikers companion in Durnthal, Austria.
A 16-year-old motorcyclist collided head-on with a car on the Nockalmstraße, resulting in injuries and significant damage to both vehicles.
A German paraglider crashed shortly after takeoff, became stuck in a tree 20m high, and was rescued and hospitalized.
A 44-year-old runner was severely injured in a mountain trail incident involving protective mother cows during a race.
A woman was injured during a tandem skydive landing due to wind impact on the parachute at Flugplatz Gneixendorf.
Police intervened in a loud party of several hundred people at Donaulände, Linz. After protests, music equipment was turned off and removed, with verbal abuse directed at officers.

A Czech couple and their aggressive dog were rescued by alpine police and a rescue team after getting lost in steep terrain near Hallstatt; the dog required special handling by police helicopter due to its aggressiveness.
A teenager in Linz was found handling a blank pistol, attempted to fire it, and fled when approached by police. He was later identified and admitted to possessing the weapon.
Collision between two cars at a crossroads in Kaufing resulted in multiple injuries, with one car overturning and landing in a garden.

A 20-year-old man in Mariapfarr lost control of his car due to excessive speed and alcohol intoxication (1.6‰), crashing into a decorative boulder and overturning. He sustained minor injuries and had his license revoked.
An 87-year-old driver collided with a 63-year-old cyclist on Aigner Straße in Salzburg Aigen, causing injuries to the cyclist.
Two young males were robbed and one assaulted by two unidentified offenders in a supermarket parking lot in Graz, threats involving a possible weapon were made.
A 20-year-old cyclist fell off his mountain bike due to rocky terrain and sustained unspecified injuries.
An 81-year-old man fell off his e-bike and sustained unspecified injuries after overtaking another cyclist. The other cyclist continued their journey.
A traffic accident occurred on B 69 in Mureck involving two cars, resulting in several injuries, including children and adults.
Two separate inflatable boat accidents occurred on the Mur River in Murau, leading to a search operation; a 16-year-old was injured and one man was rescued from a sandbank.
A 50-year-old German paraglider crashed from a height of 10 meters in Panzendorf, sustaining injuries and being transported to the hospital.
Two front tires of a car parked in Tannheim were punctured with a sharp object by an unknown perpetrator.
A 35-year-old man in Hall in Tirol threatened multiple people with an axe and damaged a cars hood while intoxicated; he was apprehended.
A man was forced to stop his car on Kaltenbacher Landesstraße by two masked individuals who demanded money and a bank card, then fled after taking a small amount of cash.
A 49-year-old man was injured when his loader fell onto a field path in Roppen, trapping his leg and causing unspecified injuries; he was transported to a hospital.
A 54-year-old woman from the Netherlands slipped on a snowfield while hiking, injuring her knee, and was airlifted to a hospital.

A kitchen fire occurred in Hohenems after a resident left hot oil and frozen fries on the stove, causing a fire which was unsuccessfully doused with water but later extinguished with fire extinguishers. Two residents were taken to the hospital as a precaution.
Collision between car and bus in Alberschwende followed by a hit-and-run; driver identified and tested positive for alcohol.
A 12-year-old cyclist was injured after being cut off by an unknown driver in a black Audi, causing the cyclist to fall.
An intoxicated man attacked a police officer to prevent an official action related to noise disturbance, injuring her slightly before he was subdued and arrested.
A robbery occurred at a snack bar in Innsbruck where cash, phones were stolen, and property was damaged.
A 34-year-old driver, under the influence of alcohol, lost control of his car, hitting infrastructure and entering a property, resulting in injuries.
A drunk car driver collided with a lawnmower tractor; the tractor driver was severely injured.
A 55-year-old cyclist fell and was severely injured while attempting to avoid a collision with a young pedestrian in Bludenz.
A 50-year-old man died after falling from a barn roof in Stroheim during renovation work, despite immediate resuscitation efforts and medical intervention.
A newborns body was discovered in a public fishing pond in Freistadt, Austria by a passerby, and police are appealing for information regarding the mother.
A collision between a cyclist and a car in Vöcklabruck resulted in severe injuries to the cyclist; both parties were found to be under the influence of alcohol.
A 35-year-old man was arrested for multiple assaults, and authorities are seeking two young witnesses who attempted to intervene before being threatened by the suspect.
A 21-year-old man falsely claimed to have been robbed on Kaltenbacher Landesstraße; he later admitted the story was fabricated.
A 23-year-old driver lost control of his vehicle, hit a streetlight and a garden wall, fled a hospital during examination, and was later apprehended; he was tested positive for alcohol.
An intoxicated driver crashed into an electricity box, overturning his car, with no injuries reported.
Fire damaged five garbage containers and the roof of a waste station; firefighters prevented the flames from spreading to nearby parked cars.
A 21-year-old man drove off the Gerlitzenstraße, hit a tree, and rolled over multiple times. He suffered injuries and was under the influence of alcohol.
Two agricultural buildings burned down due to flammable work by a 59-year-old resident with a gas burner in Mettmach, causing significant damage.
Two separate fires broke out in farm buildings in Oberösterreich, causing property damage but no injuries.

Multiple alcohol-related incidents occurred in Mittersill, including a 19-year-old driver with over 2.00 per mille alcohol level, a 55-year-old driver also found intoxicated, and a bicycle accident in Uttendorf due to suspected alcohol use.
A 39-year-old man in Hofstätten an der Raab attacked a police officer responding to a noise complaint, causing injuries. The man was reportedly intoxicated and later locked himself in his apartment.
A German woman fell from a rock wall during a party in Sillschlucht, requiring hospitalization. Party guests caused disruptions, including vandalizing police vehicles and stealing license plates.
A 1-year-old child was severely injured after being hit by a small truck in a courtyard as the driver attempted to remove construction debris. The child was hospitalized.
A 32-year-old man was physically attacked by an unknown assailant who stole his phone and fled.
Violent altercation between two groups of men on Salztorbrücke in Vienna, resulting in injuries to nine individuals and a police officer.
A 37-year-old car driver caused a collision on the B83 road near Pörtschach while turning left to a parking lot, resulting in a 62-year-old motorcyclist crashing into the car and suffering injuries.
A carriage with ponies overturned in Hüttenberg, causing injuries to two men while a woman remained unhurt, and the ponies were unharmed.
A 71-year-old man crashed his motorcycle due to self-inflicted reasons on Nockalmstraße, sustaining injuries and was taken to the hospital.
A 15-year-old moped rider was injured in a collision with an unregistered car driven by a 17-year-old without a license.
A 27-year-old man in Linz was robbed of his phone at knifepoint. The suspect, a 37-year-old Romanian, was apprehended shortly after near the crime scene and arrested.

A drunk driver with 2.22 promille blood alcohol level caused two traffic accidents in Micheldorf. He first grazed a parked car and fled the scene, then lost control near a gas station, damaging property and injuring a gas station employee.

A head-on collision involving two vehicles resulted in four injuries on the B123 near Bad Mühllacken. A 19-year-old turning left collided with a 45-year-old driver coming from the opposite direction. The accident blocked traffic for more than an hour, and emergency services responded.
A garden owner in Lambach found a non-venomous corn snake in his garden, and police handed it over to animal rescue services.
A car collided with a median barrier on A2 highway, overturning and injuring the 39-year-old driver.
A 23-year-old man resisted arrest after causing property damage and throwing a concrete flowerpot at officers, resulting in injuries to both the man and an officer.
A driver was stopped on the A9 motorway for speeding up to 227 km/h; no injuries were reported.
A 47-year-old paraglider pilot crashed shortly after takeoff due to unfavorable wind conditions, sustaining serious injuries.
A 60-year-old man was seriously injured in a motorcycle accident on the B77 road in Maria Lankowitz after hitting a guardrail and falling. He was airlifted to a hospital.
A 45-year-old Polish worker was severely injured after falling with a tree stump in steep terrain during forestry work.
Two cars collided head-on at a gas station entrance in Brixlegg, resulting in injuries to two passengers and damage to both vehicles.
A 15-year-old Austrian crashed his moped into a stream in Kramsach, sustaining injuries and causing significant damage to the vehicle.
A 78-year-old cyclist collided with a car in Gschnitz while entering Gschnitztalstraße and sustained injuries after falling.
Motorcycle and car collision in Görtschach; motorcycle driver injured, no drivers license for car driver.
A 36-year-old woman fell off her e-bike during a braking maneuver in Buch and sustained unspecified injuries.
A 51-year-old suspect resisted a police check, attacked officers, injuring two. He was arrested with stolen electronics likely linked to a burglary.
A man in Vienna-Döbling was drugged and robbed in his apartment by a suspected escort, losing a five-figure cash sum.
Two suspects attacked and robbed four women, then were apprehended after a short chase.
A man was arrested in Vienna-Donaustadt for threatening and assaulting his partner, who sustained minor injuries. A restraining and contact ban was issued.
Fire broke out in two basement compartments of a multi-apartment building; no injuries, but investigations into the cause continue.
A woman in Wolfsberg was scammed while attempting to buy a dog online, losing money through repeated payment requests.
A car and motorcycle collided at an intersection in Kottes-Purk, causing injuries to the motorcyclist who was transported to a hospital.
A motorcycle rider fell and was injured while attempting to avoid a car making a U-turn on LB 27 in Hirschwang an der Rax.
Two teenagers were injured after losing control of a moped and crashing in Neustadtl an der Donau.
A 36-year-old man fell from a height of 4 meters while climbing in Wieselburg-Land and was injured. He was airlifted to a hospital.
A 15-year-old boy had a motocross accident on private property in Lunz am See, sustaining injuries and was transported to a hospital via helicopter.
A couple found an injured moped rider who had crashed due to the low sun in Ulrichsberg, was treated locally and taken to the hospital.
A brawl broke out on a parking lot involving several individuals, with two people injured but no serious knife wounds were reported.
A fire broke out in a garage during motorcycle repair work, causing significant property damage but no injuries.
A motorcycle collided with a tractor during an overtaking maneuver, injuring the rider.
A 58-year-old motorcyclist collided with a car and suffered serious injuries in Albersdorf-Prebuch; she was flown to a hospital for treatment.
A 58-year-old motorcyclist was seriously injured after skidding off the road and colliding with rocks in a curve.
A gas grill hose caught fire but was extinguished by the user before firefighters arrived, causing minimal damage.
A 27-year-old driver collided with a 9-year-old boy on a scooter in Zirl, causing injuries to the boy despite emergency braking. The boy was taken to the hospital.
Rafting accident on the Isel River in Huben; one person injured, three rescued, and one person missing despite ongoing search efforts.
A cyclist collided with a farming vehicle in Fritzens, resulting in injuries; both parties tested negative for alcohol.
A 38-year-old driver lost control of his car on the A14 highway in Koblach, collided with barriers, and caused a severe accident. He was seriously injured and his car was heavily damaged.
A fire broke out in a kitchen in Götzis when hot frying oil ignited; the fire was extinguished by firefighters and no injuries were reported.
A man lost consciousness while swimming in the Frutz river and was rescued by family members, emergency services, and a helicopter crew before being taken to a hospital.
A motorcycle collided with a car at an intersection, leaving the motorcyclist seriously injured.
A hit-and-run driver struck parked cars and a pedestrian, injuring her lightly; the driver was later identified.
An overtaking maneuver caused a motorcycle collision; the rider was injured and airlifted to a hospital.
A truck accident injured two passengers and damaged nearby vehicles due to flying debris.
A collision between a motorcycle and a car caused severe injuries to the motorcyclist.
A motorcyclist lost control and fell after hitting a signpost; he was injured.
A man operated a motorboat recklessly on Attersee, creating dangerous waves that disrupted a sailing school and damaged property before being identified by police.
Collision between a motorboat and a motorized barge on the Danube injured two individuals and caused total damage to the barge.
Rival football fans clashed in Wildon, causing disturbances and minor property damage, but no injuries.
Hay on a tractor caught fire in Pfunds, the driver and bystanders started extinguishing it, and the fire department controlled the blaze.
A German motorcyclist crashed due to a driving error, injuring his left leg after colliding with an oncoming car in Oetz.

Driver caught speeding at 188 km/h in an 80 km/h zone, found without a valid license and under the influence of alcohol.

A 64-year-old cyclist collided with a dog on a pedestrian and cycle path in Jenbach, leading to injuries for both the cyclist and the dog.
Agricultural building in Virgen, Austria, completely destroyed by fire; no injuries reported, animals rescued.

Collision between a small truck and a car occurred; three people sustained minor injuries, and the truck driver was found heavily intoxicated.

A 61-year-old woman was run over by a golf cart at a golf course in Bad Gleichenberg, sustaining severe injuries.
A motorcyclist collided with a tractor during an overtaking maneuver and was severely injured.
Teenagers on a moped collided with a construction barrier and fell, resulting in injuries.
