A traffic accident in Viennas 14th district involved a police vehicle and a car, causing injuries to multiple individuals including a passerby and vehicle occupants.
Three individuals were arrested for selling marijuana on the Donauinsel, with approximately 12 grams of the drug seized.
A dog was rescued from a car parked in direct sunlight in Vienna. Authorities found the dog exhausted and wearing an illegal spiked collar. The owner was located and charged with animal cruelty.

Police conducted a statewide traffic operation in Burgenland on June 18, 2021, focusing on alcohol, drug violations, and speeding, leading to multiple penalties, including driving under alcohol and drug influence.
A motorcycle collided with a car turning left; the rider sustained injuries and both vehicles were significantly damaged.
Three unknown assailants robbed a young man of minor items in a poorly lit area after threatening him with violence in Villach.
A 31-year-old woman was hit by a car while crossing the street in Klagenfurt, resulting in injuries.
Fire broke out in agricultural equipment and straw due to sparks from grinding work; no injuries reported, only property damage.
A car and a motorcycle collided on Neunkirchner Straße in Wiener Neustadt, causing severe injuries to the motorcyclist after possibly ignoring a stop sign.
A mudslide caused by a storm led to the closure of the L247 Thumersbacher Landstraße for cleanup operations; no injuries or damage reported.
An ambulance vehicle was damaged and the driver responsible fled the scene in Bürmoos.
A motorcycle and a car collided in Graz, resulting in serious injuries to the 23-year-old motorcyclist.
Two people were slightly injured in a traffic accident on the A2 motorway involving a truck and a car.
A 66-year-old female driver collided with a train at a railway crossing and succumbed to her injuries on site.
A 4-year-old girl suffered life-threatening injuries after falling from a third-story window while playing with her siblings.
62-year-old moped rider collided with a tractor and sustained serious injuries.

A car driven by a young Bosnian crashed on the Fernpass Bundesstraße due to excessive speed, flipping over and causing severe damage but only minor injuries to the occupants. Police investigated a possible street race.
A mudslide caused by a storm blocked a 50-meter section of Sellrainer Straße near the recycling center, leading to a temporary road closure for cleanup and excavation.
A tractor with an attached stone crusher rolled uncontrollably down steep terrain due to a burst air hose causing brake failure. No injuries were reported.
A cyclist was fatally struck by a truck on a pedestrian crossing in Rankweil after the driver failed to notice the victim.
Two vehicles collided at an intersection in Drasenhofen, resulting in severe injuries to a 37-year-old woman.
Three assailants committed a home invasion in Dornbirn, threatening and restraining two individuals, attempting unsuccessfully to open a safe, and fleeing without stealing any valuables.

A violent robbery occurred at a parking lot in Gaißau where a businessman was attacked and robbed of €3,000; the case was solved years later through DNA evidence leading to the arrest of the perpetrator.
A 23-year-old man was arrested in Vienna after threatening police officers and assaulting his partner.
A man impersonated a police officer in Vienna, conducted fake traffic stops, removed license plates, and engaged in a physical altercation before being apprehended by authorities.
A man drove under the influence of alcohol onto train tracks in Tauchendorf, damaging his vehicle, and was discovered hours later by a cyclist.
A 1.5-year-old girl fell from a second-story window onto a concrete surface but miraculously remained uninjured.
A car ran a red light and was dragged 13 meters by a train in Linz; the driver sustained minor injuries, and significant damage occurred to the car and train.
A driver crashed into a forest area in Roitham and left the scene, prompting a search operation that was later called off without finding the individual.
Collision between two cars at an intersection caused by a driver running a red light under the influence of alcohol, resulting in one injured person and significant vehicle damage.
A 23-year-old man was caught driving under the influence in Kaprun, resulting in a license suspension and being reported to the authorities.
18-year-old Russian resisted police by attempting to flee and struggled during arrest, leading to minor injury of an officer.
A group of unidentified youths attacked a 25-year-old German man with kicks and punches in Innsbrucks Altstadt before fleeing the scene.
A man set objects on fire near his ex-girlfriends apartment door but the fire was quickly extinguished by the police.
A 33-year-old Austrian man was attacked and injured with a glass bottle by three Somali men during a physical altercation; suspects were arrested near the scene, and the victim was hospitalized.

A driver in Vienna evaded police during a high-speed pursuit, endangering others, damaging parked cars, and discarding marijuana from the vehicle. The driver, found with ammunition and no license, was arrested and faced multiple charges.
Nine individuals were arrested at Maria-Theresien-Platz in Vienna for suspected robbery and severe physical assault; multiple victims were attacked and robbed by a group of youths.
A man in Wien-Simmering was arrested for assaulting and threatening his wife; over 200 grams of marijuana were found in his possession, suspected of being intended for sale.
A 52-year-old man in Winklern fell from a mountain bike on a forest road, lost consciousness, and was revived by passing cyclists before being transported by helicopter to a hospital.
An intoxicated guest assaulted a local owner and his wife at a venue in Velden am Wörthersee.

A 58-year-old man caused a traffic accident in Völkermarkt, Kärnten by ignoring a stop sign and colliding with another car, resulting in minor injuries to an 18-year-old passenger and significant vehicle damage; the driver was found to have a low blood alcohol level.
A cyclist was hit by a car at an intersection, resulting in injuries, and the driver was found to be heavily intoxicated.
A cyclist collided with a car door in Ternitz, sustaining serious injuries.
A 54-year-old man lost control of his e-mountain bike and fell 25 meters down a slope, resulting in injuries of unspecified severity.
A 33-year-old motorcyclist crashed into a rock wall while attempting to avoid a stone on the road and sustained injuries in Schwarzau/Gebirge.
A 15-year-old cyclist from Vienna fell after hitting a post with her pedal in St Aegyd am Neuwalde and sustained unspecified injuries.
A hiker suffered a cardiac arrest during a trek and was successfully resuscitated by a mountain rescue team and later stabilized by helicopter transport to hospital.
A woman driving under the influence was stopped after a high-speed chase in Freistadt, leading to her license being confiscated and further legal action.
A 2-year-old child wandered alone on a road until passersby alerted the police; the child was later safely reunited with the mother.
A young couple in Kaprun was involved in a loud altercation leading to police intervention, during which a man was arrested for aggressive behavior and a small amount of drugs was seized.
A 25-year-old motorcyclist died in a head-on collision with a car; the car driver was heavily intoxicated but uninjured.
Police conducted traffic controls due to planned car gatherings, found traffic violations, dangerous vehicles, and cases of alcohol consumption.
An ambulance caught fire on the B 72 in Mitterdorf an der Raab; no injuries were reported.
A fire broke out at a waste processing company in St. Michael, with significant smoke but no injuries or financial damage.
A 57-year-old motorcyclist was seriously injured in a traffic accident on the B 23 near Mürzzuschlag after losing control during an overtake and crashing onto the roadway.
Motorcyclist severely injured in an accident involving a car at a roundabout in Graz, no collision occurred.
A 51-year-old German cyclist fell on a downhill gravel path in Nassereith, dislocating his shoulder and requiring rescue and transport to a hospital.
An intoxicated German cyclist lost control on a curve in Sölden, crashing into an open barn and sustaining injuries.
A 16-year-old in St. Johann in Tirol suffered severe burns after accidentally getting too close to a fire during a traditional celebration.
A car parked near a barn in Kirchbichl caught fire due to an electrical defect, causing total damage to the vehicle but no injuries.
A car driven by a 31-year-old German woman overturned on a steep field in Zellberg, injuring her and her husband.
A violent fight involving nine men occurred on Ottakringer Straße in Vienna, leaving one man severely injured after being attacked with a brass knuckle. The suspect, a 17-year-old male, was arrested.
A motorcyclist collided with a deer on a road in Greifenburg, resulting in the riders injuries and the deers euthanization.
Unknown perpetrators forced entry into a bar in Mondsee, causing significant damage to the door after being denied entrance.
A 20-year-old man was attacked and injured on a parking lot in Unterweitersdorf after confronting a stranger who harassed his friend.
A 39-year-old man was severely beaten by two or three individuals outside a pub in Freistadt, sustaining serious injuries.
A wooden agricultural building in Dienten am Hochkönig burned down completely, with no persons or animals inside. The fire was contained, preventing it from spreading.
A woman sustained severe burns after falling into glowing embers during a solstice celebration in Westendorf.
Three men attacked two others with a metal rod and steel baton, injuring them. The suspects later surrendered to police and handed over the weapons.
A man was arrested in Vienna after breaking a car window, stealing valuables, and fleeing. Items and tools were found in his possession.
An Italian driver lost control of his car in the Katschbergtunnel, causing collisions with the tunnel walls; no injuries but significant vehicle damage.
Motorcycle collision in Trebesing caused injuries to three people and totaled two motorcycles.
A 56-year-old woman from Villach suffered serious injuries after a bicycle accident on a gravel road in Ossiacher Tauern, Bezirk Feldkirchen.
Motorcyclist collided with a turning car in Maria Saal resulting in the riders death after being hospitalized.
A car driver collided with a cyclist during an overtaking maneuver, causing the cyclist to sustain injuries and be hospitalized.
A 32-year-old woman suffered cardiac arrest in a private swimming pool and was resuscitated by a neighbor and a police officer before being airlifted to a hospital.
A 76-year-old car driver and a 50-year-old motorcyclist collided at an intersection in Bärnkopf, causing the motorcyclist to fall and sustain injuries.
A driver evaded police and was reported for driving at 170 km/h in a restricted zone.
A 58-year-old man died in a car accident on the A7 in Linz after his vehicle hit guardrails multiple times and collided with a concrete base and steel pillar.
A solstice fire caused a forest fire in Bad Ischl with no reported injuries; fire under control but not yet fully extinguished.
A 26-year-old male driver tested positive for drugs during a traffic stop.
A 50-year-old female driver was stopped for erratic driving; tested with 2.5 promille alcohol level.
Two 18-year-old women were slightly injured when their car veered off the road, colliding with a parked car and a traffic sign, due to distraction caused by an unrestrained dog on the passengers lap.

A 26-year-old man died after a cliff-jumping accident at Falkensteinwand in St. Gilgen am Wolfgangsee. He jumped from 40 meters, landed on his back, and failed to resurface. A large-scale search operation eventually located his body using sonar and professional divers.

A multi-vehicle collision occurred on the A1 highway in Eugendorf involving a minibus and several cars, resulting in 12 injuries, with one person seriously injured and transported by helicopter to the hospital.
A 45-year-old man was seriously injured after falling during a hike in the Hohe Veitsch area and was rescued by a mountain rescue team.
A 69-year-old man fell while mountain biking on the Hochscheibenalmrunde trail and sustained minor injuries.
An Austrian woman, riding a motorcycle without a helmet and under the influence of alcohol, crashed into a street barrier, causing injuries to herself and her passenger near Tannheim.
A car parked at a hotel in Fendels was broken into, and items including a wallet, mobile phone, and sunglasses were stolen.
An awning in Hall in Tirol threatened to fall from a building and was safely removed by the fire department without causing injuries or damage.
A 60-year-old Austrian man, heavily intoxicated, lost control of his light motor vehicle and crashed into a traffic sign, causing the vehicle to overturn and injuring himself.
A 50-year-old Austrian woman was severely injured after crashing her motorcycle on the B197 road in the Maienwasen-Galerie in St. Anton am Arlberg.
A 74-year-old man caused a multi-vehicle collision due to falling asleep while driving, resulting in injuries and substantial damage near Häselgehr, Austria.
Unknown individuals broke into a vending machine in FC Mäder and stole snacks and drinks using a wheelbarrow, leaving litter and evidence at the scene.
A Swiss car driver turned left against a red light at an intersection, causing a collision with a 16-year-old moped rider who sustained serious injuries.
Motorcyclist and passenger injured after falling in a curve; motorcycle collided with oncoming car, injuring the driver.
An elderly woman was found injured and unable to stand after falling in her home; rescue services assisted and transported her to the hospital.
An 80-year-old driver and a 51-year-old driver collided on L 5055 in Grünz, causing injuries to the elderly driver who was transported to the hospital.
A 19-year-old male crashed his car into a tree on Lanzendorferstraße in Achau, sustaining severe injuries.

Multiple drivers in Upper Austria were caught under alcohol and drug influence while speeding, racing, or driving without licenses; several were declared unfit to drive, and legal actions were taken against them.
A 21-year-old male driver was stopped for speeding; tested with 1.78 promille alcohol level.
A 46-year-old woman lost control of her car, veered off the road, and collided with a tree, sustaining injuries of indeterminate severity.
Attempted break-ins at two stores in Gmunden; offender identified as a Hungarian citizen currently serving a prison sentence.

A Romanian gang broke into a vehicle company in Urfahr-Umgebung district, stealing seven sports vehicles. The vehicles were recovered, and multiple members of the gang were later identified and arrested across Europe.

A chimney fire occurred in a residential building in Arnoldstein, Villach District, noticed by the 53-year-old homeowner; the fire extinguished itself before the fire brigade arrived, causing only light smoke development.
Multiple thefts and burglaries in kindergartens and businesses were resolved, with five suspects in custody and substantial damages reported.

A 24-year-old German hiker got lost while descending from Almkogel mountain and called for alpine rescue after failing to find the marked trail. Rescuers found her uninjured and brought her safely back to St. Lorenz.
Four individuals were arrested in Vienna for selling drugs; significant quantities of heroin, cocaine, and cash were confiscated.
Three suspects involved in two physical altercations in Schärding on July 4, 2020, at a self-service snack stand were identified and reported to the public prosecutor. Two individuals were injured.
An unattended e-bike with a dog basket was found in Telfs; a woman who left it with a dog and a backpack went missing, and her whereabouts remain unknown.
An e-bike with a dog basket and bags was found abandoned near a grocery store in Telfs; the situation raised concern but ultimately no crime or accident was determined after further investigation.
Two Russian nationals were arrested in Styria for their involvement in an organized vehicle fraud and theft operation spanning several countries; a stolen BMW was seized.
Five suspects set fire to twelve roll containers with merchandise near a supermarket branch in Vienna and subsequently turned themselves in to the police.
A Serbian national was caught selling drugs in Vienna and arrested. Searches led to a seizure of heroin, cash, and marijuana plants, with another individual arrested in connection.
A series of thefts involving motorbikes, cars, trucks, license plates, and fuel occurred in Lower Austria. A 43-year-old Czech man was identified as the main suspect.
Two masked men broke into a house in St. Pölten, one assaulted the resident, and both fled when noticed.
A masked man broke into a womans house in Gänserndorf, stole valuables, and fled. He was later arrested.

A 70-year-old man suffered a cardiac arrest during dental treatment at Kagraner Platz in Vienna. He was successfully resuscitated by collaborative efforts of police, emergency services, and the dentist.
A German intern stole an oven from an Innsbruck warehouse, discovered months later through a social media photo.
Police and emergency services in Vienna resuscitated a 54-year-old man after cardiac arrest.
A car was set on fire in Leobersdorf in an attempt to commit insurance fraud; suspects and accomplices were identified and confessed.
Two locked youth mountain bikes were stolen from a locked bike cellar in Klagenfurt, St. Peter.
A driver fled from a police traffic check in Bludenz, injuring an officer who had to jump aside; the driver was later identified and will face charges.
Four drug dealers and multiple drug users were identified and arrested in Salzburg following investigations; seized substances included cannabis, cocaine, and other drugs.
Social benefit fraud involving fake residential registrations leading to a financial loss of €61,528.52; seven suspects involved including one who admitted the offense.
A 49-year-old man drove off the road on the L221 near Wiesen, ending in a ditch; he was injured and found to be under the influence of alcohol.
A 26-year-old man accidentally drove through a café garden in Greifenburg, damaging furniture and umbrellas, and fled the scene in shock.
A 17-year-old in Klagenfurt was robbed at knifepoint after withdrawing cash from an ATM, with the perpetrators fleeing the scene.
Improper transport of hazardous and explosive materials in a Polish truck; 1040 kg of high-explosive goods seized.
A 21-year-old man unlawfully used a car and trailer, mounted stolen plates, crashed into a supermarket in Obergrafendorf, stole goods, and was later arrested while impaired by drugs.
Two trucks collided on the B 38 in Franzen, Zwettl district; one driver sustained minor injuries and the road was closed for several hours.
A collision occurred between two vehicles in Schwarzau im Gebirge, resulting in injuries to a 70-year-old woman who was taken to the hospital.
Unidentified individuals vandalized multiple locations in Silbertal with graffiti, including an info board, asphalt, and a bus stop.
Unknown individuals vandalized a restroom at Rastplatz Radin in Bludenz with graffiti.
Attempted armed robbery on a train where a man was threatened with a firearm.
A truck loaded with wood products was completely destroyed by fire due to a technical defect, causing damage worth several thousand euros.
Two unknown suspects used an illicitly obtained or forged key to enter a café in Seewalchen, opened a safe with a hidden key, and stole the daily takings and cash from a register.
31-year-old driver under the influence of drugs and without a license was stopped on the S31 in Hirm.
A small truck in poor condition with numerous defects, including damaged lights and a fuel tank secured with straps, was stopped and taken off the road in Vorarlberg, Austria.
An 18-year-old man fired a gas pistol during a fight at a gas station in Bregenz, lightly injuring two individuals. The suspects fled the scene but the shooter is known to the police.
A woman rear-ended a car on the A22 Nordbrücke in Vienna, causing an injury to a passenger, while she was under the influence of drugs.
Several individuals caused property damage and disturbance in a residential building, leading to injuries during an attempted escape and arrests for property damage and document forgery.
A 30-year-old man crashed into an impact attenuator on the A22 Nordbrücke in Vienna while driving under the influence of alcohol with a BAC of 2.86 per mille. His license was confiscated on-site.
63-year-old Turkish man arrested in Vienna for drug possession conviction in Turkey.
A 38-year-old Hungarian truck driver died in a workplace accident in Ennsdorf while trying to prevent his rolling truck from moving forward.
A car drove onto a non-traffic lane in a construction zone, fell into a trench, and injured the driver and passenger.
An intoxicated woman got her car stuck and, after causing a disturbance, attempted to assault a police officer before being arrested.
Multiple mountain rescue operations, including assisting a climber on Predistuhl, rescuing two hikers on Gosaugletscher, and aiding a stranded hiker on Grenzeck-Steig.
Copper cables were stolen from a company premises in Perg, causing significant financial damage.
Rafting accident on the Salzach river in Lend, Salzburg; two participants injured and multiple rescued after boats capsized during high water levels.
A 13-year-old caused a kitchen fire in Graz while attempting to cook fries, resulting in minor property damage. No injuries were reported.
A 7-year-old girl was injured in a riding accident after falling from a pony in a riding hall and was transported to a childrens hospital.
A 63-year-old woman fell and severely injured her ankle while mushroom picking, requiring rescue and medical assistance.
A 25-year-old man was seriously injured while working with an angle grinder in Gössendorf, Austria. He suffered a neck injury and was airlifted to the hospital; his life is not in danger.
Eight Belgian nationals, including two toddlers, got lost during a hike and were rescued unharmed by mountain rescue teams in Prägraten, Austria.

A canyoning guide slipped while abseiling in the Alpenrosenklamm, injuring a participant who suffered a head wound and circulatory collapse. The injured person was airlifted to the hospital, and the rest of the group was safely guided out of the gorge.
A car was struck by a train at an unguarded railway crossing in Fügen, causing significant damage and injuries to the car driver, who was rescued and hospitalized after being trapped in the vehicle.

A 55-year-old Dutch man was seriously injured during a guided canyoning tour in Zemmschlucht, Finkenberg, after slipping on a wet rock. He was rescued by helicopter and taken to a hospital for treatment.
A 77-year-old German motorcyclist crashed into a curb and hit a streetlamp, sustaining severe injuries.
Unknown perpetrators damaged boats and cars in Höchst harbor during the night.
A man set fire to a barn to gain attention from his ex-girlfriend, causing significant damage and leading to his confession and arrest.

A German man engaged in a series of crimes in Austria, including stealing license plates, breaking into car dealerships, and leading police on dangerous car chases, ultimately injuring officers before being apprehended.
A 19-year-old woman walking her dog was hit by an unknown driver on Appenzellerstraße in Götzis near a roundabout, causing minor back injuries. The driver fled the scene.
A car collided with a motorcycle in Villach, causing injuries to the motorcyclist who fell off to avoid a direct collision.
Fire in a residential building in Linz; one person rescued from the roof and treated for smoke inhalation.
Attempted armed robbery on a betting shop in Steyr; suspect fled without loot after confrontation with employees.
A 19-year-old man fell from a roof while attempting to climb to a balcony, sustaining serious injuries.
A farm building in Gnas caught fire, causing significant property damage but no injuries.
Three female suspects were arrested after a burglary at an electronics store in Vienna; stolen goods were recovered.
A motorcyclist collided with a car, suffering severe injuries, as the car driver reportedly ran a red light.
Two drug dealers in Vienna resisted arrest violently, injuring four officers slightly. One suspect ingested drug pellets and is under medical supervision.
A 52-year-old Serbian man wanted in Germany for seriously injuring two people in 2016 was arrested in Vienna and taken into custody for extradition.
Two drivers were injured in a car accident on the Rennsteiner Bridge in Villach.
A car collision on the A2 highway caused one vehicle to overturn, injuring the driver and passenger.
A suspicious pink handbag near a bank in Klagenfurt led to a temporary area lockdown, later resolved as young men claimed ownership, explaining it contained bottles.
A 15-year-old motorcyclist in Wolfsberg fell, colliding with an oncoming car and sustained injuries.
A 78-year-old cyclist in Kilb collided with a car while attempting to turn left, resulting in injuries and requiring airlift to a hospital.
A 77-year-old resident of a senior center in Gmunden went missing and was found unharmed in a car by a local citizen after a search with police, dogs, and a helicopter.

A 44-year-old man in Linz-Land was stopped while driving an unregistered car with license plates from his mothers car under her permission, without a valid driving license, and recorded a blood alcohol level of 1.02‰.
A 55-year-old cyclist in Braunau am Inn suffered serious injuries after falling on a bike path for unknown reasons and was hospitalized.
Camping bus rolled into a pond; no injuries occurred.
A truck collided with a central barrier and a car, caught fire, and caused injuries and road closure on the A9 Pyhrnautobahn.
Firefighters responded to a smoke alarm caused by burnt food on a stove in an apartment, no injuries occurred.
A drunk driver without a valid license fled from police, causing a traffic accident. No one was injured.
A confrontation occurred between two drivers on L226 in Natters, involving pepper spray and damage to a car radiator grill.
A man operating a mower tractor in Hopfgarten lost control of the vehicle due to a suspected fainting spell and was ejected upon collision, sustaining severe injuries.

An 86-year-old driver in Umhausen lost vehicle control due to health problems, hitting a pedestrian with the cars mirror, causing the pedestrian injuries and resulting in hospitalization for the driver.
A 66-year-old motorcyclist collided with a car attempting a turn, resulting in injuries and significant vehicle damage.
A motorcyclist under the influence collided with a pedestrian in Schwaz, injuring both.
A motorcycle with two riders collided with a car in a traffic jam on the A14, resulting in severe injuries to the riders.
An infant was accidentally scalded with hot coffee spilled by its mother in a hotel in Lech, requiring medical evacuation.
A 26-year-old man was seriously injured during repair work on a machine when a damaged belt broke, causing a part to fall on his left hand.
Increased police and city operations at Wiener Donaukanal to address public disturbances and drug-related street crimes.
An intoxicated man was removed from a bar for aggressive behavior, injured two security staff, resisted arrest, and faced multiple charges including bodily harm and dangerous threats.
A man in St. Veit/Glan accidentally caused smoke in his apartment after falling asleep with food on the stove, resulting in a smoke alarm and minor injury.
Garage roof caught fire due to roofing work, prompting a fire department response; no injuries reported.
Two vehicles collided head-on on Engelbachstraße due to one driver being distracted by his GPS; one driver was injured and trapped in his car, requiring rescue.
Scammers impersonating police officers called Salzburg residents to demand money as bail, but a bank staff prevented a victim from handing over €30,000.
A facade fire broke out at a school in Kappl, extinguished by around 150 firefighters with no injuries reported.
Collision between a truck and a street sweeper in Ludesch caused significant damages, including a total loss of the sweeper and fuel leakage from the truck. No injuries occurred.

A 6-year-old girl was slightly injured in a hit-and-run traffic accident on Baumgartner Höhe in Vienna. The driver, who briefly spoke to the childs mother, fled the scene but has been identified and will face multiple charges.
Argument over noise escalates; a man threatened another with a stun gun disguised as a flashlight, leading to police involvement and multiple charges.
A 3.7 cm tank shell was unearthed during construction work and safely removed by the militarys demining service after assessment by a bomb expert.
A 16-year-old motorcyclist was injured in a collision with a car driven by a 41-year-old at an intersection in Hornstein.
A 71-year-old driver collided with an oncoming car on Gailtalstraße B 111, causing minor injuries to three people, while two children were unharmed. Both cars were heavily damaged.
A 38-year-old tourist suffered a fatal allergic reaction after being stung by a wasp at a campsite in St. Kanzian, Austria.
A man suffered a hand injury while working with an iron saw in Arnoldstein, and was taken to a hospital.
A man lost control of his car due to a deer crossing the road, causing the vehicle to overturn and end up in a ditch; no injuries were reported.
Cyclist injured in a collision with a car on the B92 in Magdalensberg, transported to hospital.
A motorcycle and a car collided at an intersection in Bad Fischau-Brunn, causing severe injuries to the motorcyclist.
A 22-year-old motorcyclist crashed his bike in St. Aegyd am Neuwalde, causing serious injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.
Two men pretending to be telecom employees stole money from a 93-year-old womans house in Wr. Neudorf.
68-year-old motorcyclist crashed on a curve and was airlifted to a hospital with serious injuries.
A 46-year-old man reversed a small truck in Spannberg, potentially hitting a pedestrian, a 73-year-old woman, who suffered a suspected severe injury. The driver was in shock.
An intoxicated motorcyclist crashed and was injured on the B129 road near Prambachkirchen, testing positive for 1.54 per mille alcohol.
A 22-year-old motorcyclist lost control in a sharp curve, fell into a forest and hit a tree, sustaining serious injuries.
A 52-year-old farmers tractor rolled over while mowing on steep terrain, seriously injuring him.
A motorcyclist collided head-on with a car at an intersection in Vöcklabruck district, resulting in injuries.
A cyclist hit an 84-year-old pedestrian on Pioniersteg in Salzburg and fled the scene; the pedestrian was injured and taken to the hospital.
A van collided with a motorcycle while turning, causing the motorcyclist to fall and sustain serious injuries.
A fatal traffic accident between a car and a bus occurred, resulting in the death of a 78-year-old man, with another passenger injured and the bus driver unharmed.
A motorcyclist was seriously injured in a collision with an SUV on Bundesstraße 317 near Scheifling.
A carport caught fire likely due to hot ash from a campfire being discarded in a trash can, causing significant property damage but no injuries.
Two 13-year-old girls attacked, robbed, and intentionally injured another 13-year-old girl in Innsbruck, stealing items and inflicting burns with cigarettes.
A 58-year-old German man capsized during a kayak trip on the Drau River in Assling and was found in critical condition.
A German man fell from a height of 6-7 meters in a high ropes course in Kramsach, sustaining serious injuries.
Attempted burglary at a company in Walchsee; unknown offenders disabled motion detectors, searched office spaces, and left the scene.
A head-on collision occurred on Hohenemserstraße in Lustenau, involving multiple vehicles and leaving four injured, including a pregnant woman.

A 63-year-old man suffered a heart attack while driving on Gwiggen (L1) in Hohenweiler. His son managed to stop the car, and passersby initiated resuscitation efforts. A defibrillator was used by a doctor, and the man was later transported to a hospital by helicopter.
A 13-year-old boy broke into 11 unlocked cars in Feldkirch, stealing cash and valuables, with stolen bikes found at his residence.
A 21-year-old man threatened two others with a knife, fled the scene, damaged a car, and resisted arrest violently in Vienna.
A falling stone struck a taxis windshield in Steyr, causing the driver to lose control and collide with a traffic mirror. The driver was lightly injured, and the car was totaled.
Group of youths were attacked and robbed by six to ten individuals on Rosner Weg in Innsbruck; two were injured and taken to the hospital.
A 26-year-old woman was threatened with a knife by a man in a park; the suspect was arrested and the knife secured without any injuries reported.
A farmer in Bad St. Leonhard was seriously injured after being struck by a bull while trying to tie it up in the barn.
An intoxicated man assaulted his girlfriend and her sister outside a venue in Techelsberg; no injuries were reported.
Two Portuguese men engaged in a physical altercation in Wolfsberg, where one attacked the other with a broken glass, causing injuries to both.
A 52-year-old Czech man fell during a climbing tour on the Gustav Jahn Steig and was found dead; his daughter was rescued by helicopter.
A 60-year-old motorcyclist collided with a car while overtaking and suffered severe injuries; both vehicles were totaled.
A 16-year-old moped driver under the influence of alcohol collided with a car at an intersection, sustaining injuries.
Thieves broke into a bicycle shop through the roof in Bezirk Vöcklabruck and stole high-value e-bikes and other items.
A collision between a cyclist and a motorcyclist on the L271 caused injuries to both, requiring hospitalization and resulting in vehicle damage.
An intoxicated 65-year-old cyclist in Salzburg fell and was injured; he was found with 1.76 per mille alcohol and was reported under traffic law.
A 10-year-old boy fell into hot coals and sustained burns while playing, leading to charges of negligent bodily harm against the adults present.
A 44-year-old woman fell about 2.5 meters during a hike in Deutschlandsberg and sustained injuries of undetermined severity.
A gas bottle on a grill caught fire, causing minor injury to a 44-year-old man attempting to extinguish it.
A 49-year-old man was seriously injured in a motorcycle accident on the B138 near Liezen; he lost control and crashed into a slope.
A motorcycle caught fire in Deutschfeistritz causing significant damage but no injuries.
A pellet plant caught fire at a wood processing company in Leoben, likely due to a technical defect. No injuries were reported, and the fire was quickly controlled by firefighters.
An 18-year-old driver lost control of his car during a high-speed drift maneuver in Innsbruck, colliding with three parked cars; no injuries were reported.
A 20-year-old German man kicked a 20-year-old Austrian in the face, causing a nasal fracture, and another 21-year-old Austrian sustained facial injuries during a fight outside a venue in Innsbruck.
A farmer was severely injured after his tractor lost control, rolled backwards, and crashed during mowing on a slope in Erlerberg, Tirol.
A Slovak driver caused a multi-vehicle accident in Kufstein due to distraction and heavy alcohol intoxication, resulting in injuries and significant property damage.
An 18-year-old man was accidentally shot and injured in Götzis by a 25-year-old handling an air rifle; the group falsely reported the incident due to existing weapon bans and appeared intoxicated.
The body of a 51-year-old man was found floating in the Dornbirner Ache; water rescue recovered the deceased, and the cause of death is under investigation.
Police conducted speed checks resulting in 16 violations, including one driver speeding at 107 km/h within city limits.
A 39-year-old German woman lost control of an E-Motocross bike in a motocross hall in Ötztal-Bahnhof, colliding with barriers and sustaining severe back injuries.

Police conducted a gambling law check in Hohenems, detecting three operating gambling devices which were temporarily disabled before being restored to verify functionality. The establishment was subsequently shut down and operators reported.
64-year-old man lost control of his motorcycle in Höchst, sustaining leg injuries in an alcohol-related accident.

Two groups of men engaged in a violent brawl outside a venue, with several injured. A man was later intentionally hit by a car and attacked with a golf club. Suspects were arrested and the vehicle used was secured.
A drunk driver caused an accident, injuring two individuals and damaging property at a parking lot in Vienna.
A 34-year-old Czech motorcyclist fell on the Südsteirische Grenzstraße due to unknown reasons, sliding off a steep slope and was injured, requiring hospital transport.
Police intervened in verbal and physical altercations on Rudolfskai in Salzburg; two officers were lightly injured during arrests of aggressive individuals.
A 20-year-old Pakistani man was injured with a broken bottle in a dispute in Parsch, Salzburg. The attacker fled but has been identified.

A fight involving three individuals occurred outside a venue in Innsbruck, where a 20-year-old Austrian man injured a 23-year-old Turkish man by smashing a glass bottle on his head; two others were also injured.
A 14-year-old boy crashed his moped into a guardrail at high speed, causing the 17-year-old passenger to suffer fatal injuries after falling into a stream. The driver sustained severe injuries.
Two teenagers assaulted police officers during a drug-related check, injuring one officer, and were later detained and drugs were confiscated.

A 21-year-old Slovenian man noticed smoke and flames emerging from his car while driving downhill. He escaped safely, and an unidentified driver extinguished the fire. Firefighters secured the area and prevented fluid leaks. The car was a total loss.
A motorcyclist collided with an oncoming car and slid into another car, injuring a 36-year-old passenger.
A 71-year-old motorcyclist went off the road on a curve and was injured, requiring hospital treatment.
A car driven by a 17-year-old woman collided with a motorcycle ridden by a 61-year-old man during a left turn, causing minor injuries to the motorcyclist.
A two-car collision occurred in Bergland, Bezirk Melk, resulting in a car rolling over and minor injuries to one driver. Alcohol and possible phone use contributed to the crash.
A 33-year-old paraglider experienced a canopy collapse shortly after takeoff near Ötschergipfel, resulting in serious injuries.
A 27-year-old man veered off the road to avoid a collision with a car turning left, crashing into a marker and embankment, sustaining injuries.
A battery explosion in a hall in Ottensheim caused a fire and significant smoke, requiring firefighting and investigation.
Two motorcyclists were involved in a collision with a tractor in Bad Goisern, resulting in serious injuries for both riders.
A 46-year-old woman sustained severe injuries after falling off her bicycle on a steep road in Desselbrunn.
Motorcyclist and passenger injured in an accident on Wolfgangseestraße B158 near Koppl, Austria.
A German woman slipped and fell during a hike near Tappenkarsee, sustaining injuries. She was rescued by helicopter and taken to a hospital.
A fight involving seven men occurred near Makartsteg in the city of Salzburg, leaving five known participants injured.
A fire broke out in the basement of a family house in Bad Schwanberg, no injuries reported. Cause is under investigation.
A 64-year-old woman got lost during a hike and was safely rescued by the mountain rescue team.
A 24-year-old man caused a traffic accident in Graz while intoxicated and fled the scene. He later resisted arrest, drew a replica handgun, and was found with drugs and a knife.
Smoke developed in the basement of a house due to overheating a stove, no injuries reported.
A 40-year-old man was injured during a paragliding take-off accident in Gröbming, falling from a height of 3-5 meters.
A 47-year-old motorcyclist lost control and crashed while turning onto Landesstraße 407, suffering severe injuries.
Approximately 300 liters of diesel fuel were stolen from an unlocked fuel tank of a construction companys truck in Sautens.

A man reportedly jumped into and swam in the Inn river near Universitätsbrücke in Innsbruck but later exited on his own and left with another man. Emergency services conducted a search but found no one.
A 21-year-old driver and a 54-year-old cyclist collided head-on, causing severe injuries to the cyclist and significant damage to both vehicles.
A 21-year-old German man suffered an electric shock from a damaged cord while working at a hotel buffet in Lermoos, sustaining undetermined injuries and was hospitalized.
A car collided with a train at a railway crossing in Scharnitz/Oberndorf, causing damages but no injuries.
Family involved in a summer tobogganing accident in Laterns; three members injured, with an 8-year-old girl airlifted to hospital.
A landslide of approximately 1,000m³ of debris blocked the Gamperdonastraße near a tunnel in Nenzing; no injuries or additional damage occurred.
Multiple burglary thefts in Mühldorf, Vienna, and Graz resulted in significant property damage and led to the arrest of two suspects.
An intoxicated man threatened noisy individuals with a soft gun, pointing it at an 18-year-old, and was arrested.
A truck reversing on Panoramaweg in Annenheim injured a cyclist and caused severe damage to his bike.
A man from Klagenfurt caused a traffic accident on the A2 due to microsleep, resulting in injuries and a temporary road closure.
Coordinated traffic control operation in Vienna led to 116 reports, including violations for alcohol-impaired driving, driving without a license, poor child safety, and vehicle defects.
A car collided with two 14-year-old pedestrians in Friesach and fled the scene, causing minor injuries to one child.
A 17-year-old man lost control of a tractor during hay-turning work in Bleiburg, resulting in a crash and injuries.
A 56-year-old man fell from his e-mountain bike due to a braking error and was injured, requiring helicopter transport to a hospital.
A collision occurred on the Ossiacher Straße involving a motorhome and two cars, causing injuries to a driver and passenger, and property damage.
A motorcyclist collided with a truck in St. Aegyd am Neuwalde and was seriously injured.
A pedestrian was slightly injured when assisting a driver in parking; a search for the driver and vehicle remains ongoing.
A tractor collided with a parked car due to obstructed visibility from loaded hay bales, injuring the car driver.
A 22-year-old man without a driving license was stopped in Traun and tested positive for THC during a drug test; his driving was deemed unfit.
A 15-year-old was lightly injured during an altercation with a 14-year-old at a swimming pool in Linz.
Multi-car collision on B145 in Langwies; one vehicle caught fire and two individuals sustained minor injuries.
A cyclist collided with a car while attempting a turn, resulting in injuries and hospitalization.

A 17-year-old male mountain biker lost control on a gravel path, falling around seven meters into a ravine in the Wildentalschlucht, Salzburg. Rescue teams utilized a rope to extract him, and he was airlifted to a hospital with injuries.
An overloaded vehicle with improperly secured cargo was stopped on the A10-Tauernautobahn; driver was cited and further travel prohibited.
Fatal traffic accident involving a cyclist and motorcyclist on B164 Hochkönig Straße; cyclist died, motorcyclist severely injured.
A man threatened a woman on a parking lot in Mittersill, damaged her car, and was arrested by police.
A 16-year-old moped rider and her passenger crashed in Salzburg at a roundabout, sustaining minor knee injuries; no alcohol or external fault involved.
A trash container in Salzburg-Itzling caught fire and was extinguished by the fire department; no injuries reported and only minor damage occurred.
A 24-year-old motorcyclist was seriously injured in a crash after losing control and hitting a wall in Floing. She was airlifted to the hospital with suspected severe head trauma.
A cyclist collided head-on with an unknown teenage cyclist in Graz, resulting in minor injuries for the woman. The teenage cyclist fled the scene.
Two cars collided on L712 in Liezen, Austria; one overturned while another crashed into a slope, injuring both drivers.
A man reported that his wallet was stolen at the bus terminal in Innsbruck. A suspect was arrested shortly after and the stolen cash was recovered.
A balcony fire in Innsbruck caused property damage but no injuries; a cat was rescued. The fire seemed to be started by a cigarette.
A 59-year-old Czech man fell into a glacier crevasse during a descent from Großglockner and was rescued with minor injuries.
A car rolled out of control in Weer, injuring a 57-year-old severely as it pinned him against a house wall.

Two teenagers on lightweight motorcycles were injured in Schönberg im Stubaital when one lost control and collided with a car, and the other collided with the first motorcycle. Both were hospitalized, and the vehicles were severely damaged.
A woman attempted to steal a sweater in a clothing store, assaulted two employees, and threatened to kill one, but was caught and arrested.
A 26-year-old climber slipped on loose gravel while descending in Tschagguns, falling 40-50 meters and sustaining multiple injuries. He was rescued by helicopter and transported to the hospital.

A 75-year-old woman lost control of her car on L 200 in Reuthe, colliding with another car causing both vehicles to crash, resulting in minor injuries to three individuals and significant damage to both vehicles and surrounding property.
Police rescued an infant locked inside a car in Bludenz during high temperatures by breaking a window to free the child, who was unharmed.
A 34-year-old Slovakian man drowned in the Binnenbecken in Hard; no foul play suspected.
Four vehicles were involved in an accident in Rankweil, with one passenger injured and multiple cars damaged.
A woman fell from her bicycle and sustained injuries; she was taken to the hospital.

A 23-year-old man in Liezen was slightly injured and robbed by unknown perpetrators near the train station. His wallet, phone, and a watch were stolen by individuals in an Audi who asked him for a cigarette before attacking him.
A wooden barn in Leutasch caught fire, destroying the barn and machinery, with no injuries reported.
A cyclist collided with a car while riding behind it and was seriously injured when the car stopped unexpectedly.
Police conducted a traffic operation in Vienna, focusing on bicycles and e-scooters, resulting in various penalties and fines for violations.
Police arrested a drug dealer and associates for heroin dealing and consumption during a targeted operation in Vienna. Resistance was encountered during further arrests.
Several drug-impaired e-scooter riders stopped; one arrested for suspected drug dealing and another caught with cannabis.
A woman discovered an old Russian hand grenade in a wardrobe while clearing out an apartment; authorities were notified and safely removed it.
A car with two occupants collided with a train at a railway crossing in Steinbrunn, resulting in their deaths.
Unknown individual broke into multiple businesses at a business park, causing damage and stealing a camera.
An unknown perpetrator broke into a fuel pump ATM at a gas station in Grafenstein without stealing any cash.
A gas station in Grafenstein was broken into and cash from a betting machine along with cigarettes were stolen.

A 66-year-old man in Spittal/Drau was found with a loaded hunting rifle during a vehicle check following a positive blood alcohol test. Authorities seized the weapon, issued a temporary weapons ban, and later confiscated more firearms and ammunition, some unregistered, from his home. The man will face charges.
A slightly intoxicated 22-year-old man crashed his car on a straight road section, hitting a parked car, flipping over, and causing significant damage to both vehicles.
A 55-year-old man was seriously injured on his hand while unloading grain in Tragwein and was airlifted to a hospital.
A collision occurred when a 55-year-old man driving a van failed to see a 29-year-old womans car stopped for oncoming traffic, causing an accident in which the woman was injured.
A 28-year-old motorcyclist crashed on a wet road, was injured, and transported to a hospital.
Police conducted moped and speed checks in Salzburg, identifying significant violations including altered mopeds and excessive speeding; multiple offenders were reported to authorities.
Two separate fires occurred at a waste management facility in Salzburg-Itzling, suspected to be caused by chemical reactions in the waste. No injuries were reported.
A 32-year-old woman fell from her apartment balcony and was injured after hanging from the railing and calling for help.
A car collided with a motorcycle in Scheffau; the motorcyclist was injured and airlifted to the hospital.
A 15-year-old Austrian cyclist fell off his e-bike on a bike path in Längenfeld, sustaining severe facial injuries.

A 71-year-old Austrian man lost control of his car during a maneuver on a forest road in St Leonhard, causing the vehicle to roll down a slope and come to rest on its roof against a tree. The driver suffered minor injuries and was transported to a medical facility.
A 52-year-old Austrian paraglider crashed from around 10 meters and was seriously injured after a wind shift caused his glider to collapse during takeoff at Grubigstein in Lermoos.
A 15-year-old motorbike rider crashed in Arzl im Pitztal due to a car pulling out without yielding, sustaining minor injuries; the car fled the scene.
A 2-year-old child was left in a parked car under hot temperatures in Innsbruck; the child was rescued without injuries, and the father was reported to the authorities.
During fuel refilling in Koblach, a moped caught fire, completely destroying it and damaging another one nearby.
A 72-year-old motorcyclist collided head-on with a car and was subsequently run over by a bus, succumbing to injuries on the scene in Vorarlberg, Austria.
A 75-year-old e-bike rider collided with a car driven by a 56-year-old in Frastanz, resulting in minor injuries for the cyclist.
Police rescued two injured baby squirrels from crows in Vienna; one died due to severe head injuries.
Two Hungarian perpetrators stole a watch and cash from a house in Langeck and assaulted the homeowner while fleeing; they were arrested at the border.
The Saggau river near Eibiswald was polluted due to unknown causes during drilling work under the river. No fish died as a result.
A farm building caught fire and sustained severe damages, with no injuries reported. Firefighters controlled the blaze by early morning.
A 49-year-old Romanian man was arrested in Wr. Neustadt for suspicion of stealing from church collection boxes in multiple locations including Wr. Neustadt and two districts in Vienna.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a house in Innsbruck and stole a mountain bike from a basement storage unit.
A 48-year-old Austrian fell while descending the Habicht mountain and was severely injured. He was rescued and flown to a hospital in Innsbruck.
Three suspects in Friesach unlawfully operated a car, towed it, and caused damage by pushing it down a hill. One suspect also stole a starter box and attempted to use it for further car theft.
A 2-year-old girl was seriously injured after running onto tram tracks and colliding with a moving tram on Simmeringer Hauptstraße in Vienna.
Two cousins engaged in a physical altercation in a shared courtyard, were aggressive to police, and were temporarily arrested.
A suspected shoplifter attacked a store detective with attempted blows and kicks after being caught trying to steal perfume.

A 16-year-old German tourist attempted to steal alcoholic beverages from a bar in St.Kanzian am Klopeiner See, fled after being caught, damaged a car, and was apprehended by witnesses before being handed over to the police.
A woman reported that her daughter found an unexploded hand grenade in Wörthersee; the area was secured, and the device was removed by specialists.
A 61-year-old German tourist got lost while hiking in the Mittagskogel area in Kärnten and was found safe by the police.
A house in Glödnitz was broken into; a cash box containing thousands of Euros was stolen.
A pile of brushwood caught fire in Millstatt am See but was extinguished quickly without damage or danger to property.
A man drove to a police station under the influence of drugs, was found unfit to drive, and had his license revoked.
A mother and her two children were hit by a car while crossing a gas station exit in Wels, resulting in minor injuries.
An 83-year-old man was run over by his tractor after it moved on a slope; he was injured and hospitalized.
A 37-year-old woman injured her knee while climbing Drachenwand and was rescued by a helicopter.
A moped collided with a car in Strobl, injuring two teenagers, while the car driver remained unharmed; no alcohol was involved.
Tandem paragliding accident in Rauris; passenger injured after glider suddenly descended before landing.
Two armed men robbed a bank in Salzburg-Liefering with a revolver, forcing employees to hand over cash before fleeing. No injuries or gunfire occurred.
A cyclist with a blood alcohol level of 2.38‰ hit a taxi mirror and fell, sustaining head injuries.
A Slovakian driver crashed a truck into a guardrail in Salzburg-Süd, causing an oil and fuel spill.
Unidentified burglar broke into a house, got surprised by residents, and fled with cash, jewelry, and a laptop.
A 24-year-old caused a three-vehicle collision while turning, resulting in one person being injured and road closure for investigation.
A man left his dog in a hot vehicle; police rescued the dog and are investigating animal cruelty.
A 20-year-old driver collided with a 12-year-old cyclist on a street in Ellmau, resulting in the girl being injured and taken to the hospital by helicopter.
Heavy thunderstorms caused a mudslide in Virgen, Tirol, blocking a road and damaging property without causing injuries.
Car collided with a motorcycle during a turn; motorcyclist was seriously injured.
A 63-year-old German man fell off his e-bike on a local road in Nesselwängle, sustaining unspecified injuries and was flown to a hospital.
A 10-ton steel container fell off a truck on the Brennerautobahn, spilling waste, causing damage to the road and vehicle but no injuries.
Motorcyclist collided with a camper on a road near Pfafflar, resulting in injuries and considerable vehicle damage.
A 4-year-old boy fell from a slide at a swimming pool in Schwarzenberg, sustaining serious injuries and was airlifted to the hospital.
Police arrested a drug dealer in possession of heroin and cash; four drug buyers were also stopped, one possessing prohibited weapons.

Two unemployed men were caught committing cellar break-ins and bicycle thefts in Mauthausen; one suspect was arrested with a stolen bicycle and tools, while the other initially fled but was later apprehended.
A 13-year-old girl was found dead in an apartment in Telfs; possible drug intoxication suspected.
A tractor with a hay-loaded trailer overturned and rolled down a slope in Bizau, seriously injuring the driver, who was airlifted to the hospital.

A 35-year-old Polish man broke into a vacation apartment in St. Gallenkirch, damaged property, threatened police with violence, and attempted to steal from vehicles. He was arrested and charged with multiple offenses.
A 27-year-old man was arrested in Berg, Austria, for attempting to smuggle six Syrian individuals, including a child, to Germany.

Three smugglers were arrested for transporting at least 50 illegal immigrants from Hungary and Serbia through Slovakia to Austria between 2019 and 2020. They were part of an organized human trafficking group.
An unknown man attacked and attempted to assault a 16-year-old girl in Linz; neighbors intervened, causing the assailant to flee.
A 17-year-old driver was caught speeding at 160 km/h on the B 127 in the Rohrbach district, exceeding the 100 km/h limit.
Unknown perpetrator broke a jewelry store window in Bludenz and stole a watch worth €350 before fleeing.
A 27-year-old man caused a car accident while driving under the influence of alcohol, colliding with an ambulance on the Mariahilfer Gürtel and injuring its driver.
A 22-year-old man driving without a license was arrested for suspected drug dealing after 70 Ecstasy tablets and cash were found.
A lightning strike caused a fire at a residential building in Olbendorf, affecting a roof window. Firefighters extinguished the fire without injuries.
A rear-end collision involving three vehicles occurred on the B57 in Ollersdorf, injuring three people and causing significant vehicle damage.
A 61-year-old motorcyclist was injured in a collision with a 60-year-old car driver in Pamhagen.
An intoxicated driver in Klagenfurt caused a traffic accident after losing control of his vehicle while on the phone, damaging both his car and a traffic light before fleeing the scene on foot.

A 31-year-old woman drove off the road in Ludmannsdorf, Klagenfurt District, causing her car to overturn and leaving her trapped inside; she was rescued and hospitalized, and her alcohol test was positive.
A woman drove off the road due to drowsiness and hit a tree, sustaining injuries and totaling her car.
A motorcyclist lost control on a curve, collided with a guardrail, and suffered fatal injuries in Albeck, Feldkirchen district.
A 47-year-old German man fell off a stand-up paddleboard into a lake in Langau, Austria, and was later found dead after an extensive search operation.
A 27-year-old woman lost control of her car on L 11 in Gänserndorf, resulting in a rollover accident and severe injuries.
Oil contamination found in a seepage pit; cleanup and investigation initiated.
A truck driver under the influence of alcohol lost control on a wet road, causing the vehicle to overturn and resulting in injuries.

A 23-year-old electrician fell four meters through a collapsed ceiling at a store in Vöcklabruck district, sustaining injuries of unknown severity. First aid was provided by a doctor and paramedic present.
A 54-year-old German rider on a three-wheeled vehicle veered off the road and crashed near a gasthaus, sustaining injuries and being airlifted to a hospital.
An 80-year-old womans car rolled into Wallersee lake after losing control on a sloped road; she was rescued by bystanders, and the vehicle was later recovered by firefighters. No injuries occurred.
A 32-year-old woman resisted police intervention during a dispute, attempted to flee, and was slightly injured after falling and hitting her head on a lamppost.
Fire broke out in the roof of a multi-family house, suspected to be caused by lightning. No injuries reported.
A 43-year-old driver lost control of his vehicle, crashed through a fence, and hit trees, resulting in minor injuries and a fuel spill.
36-year-old injured in a workplace accident involving a collision of transport vehicles in Kalsdorf bei Graz.
A small fire occurred on a restaurant roof; no injuries were reported, and the cause is under investigation.
A 4-year-old boy was fatally struck by a car that moved independently on a sloped driveway in Ötz/Ebene.
Motorcyclist lost control on a curve and fell 10 meters into a forest in St. Jakob/Def., sustaining injuries.
A 73-year-old man fell from his e-bike due to a braking error and was seriously injured in Innsbruck.
A man in Fritzens was injured in a tractor accident during fieldwork and airlifted to the hospital.
A head-on collision occurred between a small truck and a motorcycle on L205 in Lingenau, causing severe injuries to the motorcyclist.
Car collided with a shop window in Lustenau, causing injuries to the driver and property damage.
A 56-year-old man injured two fingers in a printing machine during maintenance work in Rankweil.
A collision between a truck and a car on L 537 resulted in severe injuries for a 76-year-old woman and minor injuries for a 70-year-old man.
An 81-year-old Ukrainian man was found injured on the A25 in Austria after leaving a Czech minibus during a stop; investigation into the incident is ongoing.
A quad was stolen from a company site in Judenburg; the suspect was arrested in Romania and extradited to Austria.
Two teenagers attempted to saw through a bike lock, fled upon police arrival, and were apprehended.
An 82-year-old driver struck a cyclist during an overtaking maneuver, causing the cyclist to fall and sustain injuries.
A drunk driver overtook an unmarked police car at excessive speed, was stopped, found at 1.34‰ BAC, and had their license revoked.
A worker was injured by nitric acid during unloading in a metallurgical plant.
A cyclist in Dornbirn fell and was injured while trying to avoid a collision with a car that failed to yield at an intersection; the driver left the scene.
A man discovered suspected war material, a tank grenade, during excavation work in Vienna. It was safely removed by the bomb disposal unit without posing a threat to people or property.
E-scooter rider collided with a car at an intersection, resulting in injuries and hospital transportation.
A 56-year-old man was caught attempting a break-in; he was using a hammer on a door lock but was apprehended without resistance.
An intoxicated man refused a breathalyzer test, threatened officers, and had his license and keys confiscated in Vienna.
Severe storms with heavy rain caused multiple mudslides and road closures in various areas including Gurktal Bundesstraße and Kleblacher Straße in the districts of Feldkirchen and Spittal/Drau.
A fire broke out at an agricultural building in Diex, causing extensive damage to the roof, stored straw, and harvest goods, with no injuries reported.
A Bosnian man was detained at the Karawankentunnel border for using counterfeit identification documents.
Two cars collided on the Turracher Bundesstraße in Moosburg, resulting in injuries to the drivers and a passenger as well as total damage to both vehicles.
Indoor cannabis cultivation and possession of cannabis were discovered in a mans apartment in Klagenfurt.
A 19-year-old driver with a probationary license drove off the road near Burgkirchen, collided with a tree, sustained injuries, and tested for a blood alcohol level of 1.62‰.
An 11-year-old boy suffered severe injuries after falling several meters during an activity at a leisure park in Bezirk Wels-Land. He was airlifted to a hospital.
Two German mountaineers were struck by lightning while climbing in Dachsteingebirge; both survived and were rescued by helicopter.
Car collision occurred in St. Johann im Pongau on B311; one person injured after a vehicle overturned.
A moped collided with a car on Europastraße in Salzburgs Taxham district, injuring two individuals who were hospitalized.
A 35-year-old Hungarian man was attacked and robbed by several men after leaving a gambling salon.
A moped rider and her passenger were injured in a rear-end collision with a car in Gleisdorf, Austria.
A 15-year-old motorcyclist was seriously injured in a collision with a car at an intersection in Schladming.
A tram driver in Graz was attacked by a man after she requested him to wear a face mask. The man became aggressive, insulted her, physically assaulted her, and then fled the scene.
A 17-year-old was injured when he was accidentally run over by a car while filming a TikTok video on a driveway.
Collision between two heavy vehicles in Tobadill injured two drivers, one severely.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a restaurant in Innsbruck and stole three waiter cash bags and a mixing console worth a four-digit amount in euros.
A car caught fire on the Venter Landesstraße in Sölden; the driver and her granddaughter evacuated safely, and the fire was extinguished by another motorist using a fire extinguisher.
A 92-year-old driver caused a head-on collision with another car, resulting in injuries to both drivers on B171 in Kirchbichl.
A 20-year-old man in Sulzberg lost control of a tractor while spreading manure on a steep field, resulting in an accident and causing undetermined injuries.
Smoke was detected from an apartment in a high-rise building in Bregenz; cause identified as a forgotten pot on a stove, no injuries reported.
Burglary and attempted break-in at office building in Telfs, causing significant financial damage.
Three young men were apprehended for stealing tools worth €5000 from a construction site in Bregenz, and the stolen items were recovered.
A man gained unauthorized access to a house in Feldkirch under the guise of inspecting light bulbs, stole valuables, and demanded payment.
Two French nationals arrested for multiple residential burglaries in Lower Austria, stolen items recovered.
A wallet was stolen from a Czech citizen in a restaurant in Völlerndorf, and the stolen credit cards were used for six transactions before being blocked.
Two men in Klagenfurt damaged a parked car by throwing beer bottles at it and breaking parts of it.
A 54-year-old man under the influence of alcohol collided with another vehicle in Gudrunstraße, injuring two passengers.
A 37-year-old woman injured a 43-year-old man with a screwdriver during an argument in an apartment; the suspect was arrested, and the victim was hospitalized.
A man discovered remnants of an incendiary bomb on a construction site; the bomb disposal unit removed the fragments without causing evacuations or traffic disruptions.
Two men were arrested in Vienna for separate offenses including theft and death threats following warrants issued by the prosecutors office.

A 16-year-old driving a moped with his 13-year-old sister as a passenger crashed after braking suddenly to avoid an animal in Wolfsberg, resulting in injuries to the sister who was taken to a hospital.
An ambulance had to abruptly brake to avoid a collision with a BMW SUV, leading to an injury of a paramedic inside the vehicle. The BMW driver fled the scene.
A 16-year-old moped rider was seriously injured after braking too hard and colliding with a tractors front axle in Zwettl.
A 20-year-old driver in Wels was caught speeding at 105 km/h in a 50 km/h zone; no alcohol detected.
Boats were in distress due to a storm on Mondsee; water rescue teams and police helped ensure safety without injuries.
A 70-year-old man was injured while hiking in Hohentauern and received medical assistance after slipping off a wooden footbridge.
A fire broke out in a room of a multi-unit house in Kramsach, causing significant damage and requiring medical checks for two residents.
Two moped riders collided at an intersection in Kirchbichl, resulting in one suffering unspecified injuries.
A fire broke out on the balcony of an apartment in Röthis; the cause is suspected to be a cigarette improperly extinguished, causing significant damage to the apartment.
A man suffered burns from a flashover while lighting a grill fire with spirit in the Großes Walsertal.
A 35-year-old man threatened two 18-year-olds with knives in Feldkirch after demanding drugs, before being arrested near Sparkassenplatz.
A 34-year-old man was attacked by a group of eight people using glass bottles and strikes, resulting in two injuries and damage to a parked car in Vienna.
Two 18-year-old Slovak nationals were caught attempting a burglary in a residential buildings basement; stolen items were recovered.
Police stopped a fleeing driver under drug influence who damaged two patrol cars and violated multiple traffic laws.
Traffic checks with noise measurements conducted; fines issued and licenses revoked due to drug influence in Tiefgraben, Mondsee.
Two German hikers were rescued by a police helicopter after getting stranded on steep terrain at Untersberg in Salzburg.
A 24-year-old man was run over by his brothers car during a grill party, resulting in serious injuries.
A train attendant was physically attacked by a teenager after addressing disruptive behavior in St. Valentin.
Motorcyclist and e-biker collided in Imst, both injured.
Unknown individual broke into a bicycle shop in Moosburg and stole about 40 high-end bicycles.
A British woman crashed her e-bike on a trail in Ischgl, suffering a leg fracture and was airlifted to a hospital.
An 18-year-old driver endangered others while fleeing from police, damaging two police vehicles and ignoring traffic safety in multiple locations.
Train conductor in St. Valentin was attacked by a teenager who fled after the incident; the suspect was later identified.
A 16-year-old aimed a softair rifle at people at a bus station, and the incident was shared on social media.
A 40-year-old man attacked two street cleaning workers with a glass bottle, injuring them, before fleeing and being apprehended.
A car accident occurred on the A10 near Paternion causing injuries to the driver and two passengers.

A man attempting to intervene in a couples dispute outside a nightclub in Villach was punched in the face and injured.
Multiple people were injured in a car accident involving a 17-year-old driver, two passengers, an 80-year-old driver, and a third car. One passenger was airlifted to a hospital.
A car overturned after the driver, under the influence of alcohol, lost control on a foggy road, with minor injuries reported.
Two men were injured in a brawl in Wels, and the suspect fled the scene.
Car tires were slashed and spray-painted, and license plates were stolen in Salzburg Lehen.
A man was arrested for animal cruelty in Vienna after being caught abusing a horse; he attempted to flee but was stopped by police.
A 69-year-old motorcyclist was injured in a collision with a car turning left into a field path.
A possibly intoxicated 47-year-old man fired a blank gun during an altercation, injuring four teenagers lightly, then fled the scene.
A driver swerved to avoid a deer, causing his car to veer off the road, crash through a hedge, hit a beehive, and overturn, resulting in injuries to the driver and a passenger.
Two women fell while riding mountain bikes on the Flow-Trail in Bad Kleinkirchheim, both were injured and airlifted to a hospital.
An 80-year-old driver collided with a moped, injuring a 15-year-old girl in Feldkirchen.
A 27-year-old man lost control of an unregistered motorcycle and fatally collided with trees in a private area in Bernegg, Austria.
A car driven by a 52-year-old woman was hit by a train in Vorchdorf after she failed to stop at a Halt sign, causing the car to be thrown against a garden fence. No injuries were reported.
A 47-year-old man driving under the influence caused a collision on Imolkamer Landesstraße L1091, damaging parked cars and sustaining injuries.
A moped collided with a car at an intersection near Bezirk Vöcklabruck, seriously injuring the moped driver, who was airlifted to a hospital.

A 17-year-old motorcyclist died in a collision with a car on Kärntner Straße in Seiersberg on the night of August 16, 2020. Despite resuscitation efforts, the teenager was pronounced dead at the scene. The car driver tested negative for alcohol and is receiving psychological support.
A 45-year-old Romanian cyclist crashed into a curb while switching to a pedestrian and bike path, suffering a nasal fracture and facial abrasions. He was under the influence of alcohol.
MotoGP racing event in Spielberg concluded safely with authorities and teams ensuring a smooth and secure execution despite being closed to the public due to COVID-19 measures.
A 34-year-old woman crashed her e-bike and suffered injuries including a fractured collarbone and ribs in Wörgl, requiring helicopter rescue.
A paraglider crashed from a height of 30 meters due to tangled control lines at Virgen, suffering pelvic and hand injuries.
Mudslides covered parts of the Gschnitztal Landesstraße in Tirol; no injuries were reported and cleanup operations commenced.
A 71-year-old woman fell and was seriously injured while hiking in Kundl. She was rescued by helicopter and taken to the hospital.
A 55-year-old Austrian man fatally fell from his bicycle in Oberndorf, despite resuscitation efforts.
Mudslides and flooding caused by heavy rainfall disrupted roads in Riezlern, involving emergency services and private companies in cleanup efforts; no injuries were reported.
A 51-year-old Serbian suspect was caught using a bolt cutter to steal a bicycle, loading it into a van and attempting to flee before being apprehended by police near the scene.
A Slovakian suspect was arrested in Gattendorf for bicycle theft, and connections to thefts in Parndorf and Vienna were uncovered.
A fox entered a hotel room through an open balcony door and bit a sleeping three-year-old girl twice on the foot.
Collision between a motorcycle and an electric car in Wolkersdorf resulted in two injuries.
A collision between a moped and a car resulted in the severe injury of a 48-year-old moped rider, who later succumbed to his injuries.

A balcony caught fire in Salzburg-Itzling, prompting neighbors to alert a resident who safely evacuated. The fire was extinguished before firefighters arrived, but they had to check for hidden embers. The incident caused property damage, and the cause remains unknown.
Kitchen fire in Market Hartmannsdorf caused by unknown reasons; family safely evacuated, two hospitalized as precautions.
A moped rider collided with a pedestrian on a crosswalk, injuring both individuals and causing damage to the moped in Schwarzach.
Two suspects broke into a construction site in Vienna and stole fuel from an excavator before being apprehended by police.
A 68-year-old woman collided with a speeding 24-year-old driver at an intersection, causing injuries to the man and damage to the womans vehicle.
A 43-year-old motorcyclist was injured in a collision with a car while attempting to overtake on the B50. He fell into a vineyard and was taken to the hospital. Traffic was briefly interrupted.
Unknown perpetrator broke into a workshop in Glanegg between August 17 and 18, stealing chainsaws and tools, causing significant financial damage.
90 grams of heroin were seized during a border control at the Loibltunnel crossing.
Heavy rainfall caused localized flooding and damage in Straßburg; no injuries reported.
A 63-year-old man died after falling 15 meters while replacing a solar panel on a rock wall in Winklern, assisted by his 15-year-old apprentice.
Heavy rainfall caused the Metnitz-Bach to overflow, flooding a road and leading to its temporary closure.
Motorcycle collision with a car in Traiskirchen resulting in severe injuries to the motorcyclist.
A 15-year-old moped rider collided with a car, was injured, and hospitalized; both vehicles suffered heavy damage.
A 15-year-old moped rider and a 63-year-old motorcyclist collided at an intersection in Siegertshaft due to limited visibility from a maize field. Both were severely injured and flown to hospitals.
Fatal car crash in Gunskirchen, where a 59-year-old man collided with a truck and suffered fatal injuries.
A car driver evaded police near Salzburg Hauptbahnhof, caused multiple traffic violations, and collided with a police vehicle before being captured and arrested.
A drunk driver with two children in the car was stopped and tested with a high alcohol level; he faced charges and the children were handed over to relatives.
A chimney fire occurred in a hotel restaurant in Liezen; no injuries were reported, and the fire was quickly extinguished by the local fire department.

A 55-year-old man from Germany was injured during a hike on the Gößeck mountain near Trofaiach after falling 15 meters on steep terrain due to losing his footing. He was rescued by helicopter and taken to the hospital.
A heavily intoxicated man fired a gas pistol inside an apartment in Reutte; police found multiple weapons and small amounts of cannabis in the apartment.
A German woman was injured during a guided canyoning tour in the Auer Klamm in Oetz and was airlifted to the hospital.
A 17-year-old Austrian fell with his e-bike on a gravel path in Iselsberg, breaking his collarbone.
Two drivers in Kleinwalsertal were caught speeding excessively, with one driving at 98 km/h and another at 120 km/h in a 50 km/h zone; both will be reported to authorities.
Straw bales used as decoration at a garden house caught fire and were quickly extinguished by firefighters, cause under investigation.
A heavy safe and high-value beverages were stolen from a restaurant in Innsbruck, with no signs of forced entry.
Four burglaries occurred in Axams town center; cash, cigarettes, beverages, and other items were stolen from various premises.
Unidentified perpetrators broke into the VIVO Middle School in Höchst, caused damage, vandalized property, and started a fire that triggered the alarm, which was extinguished by the fire department.
Human smuggler arrested and 21 illegal migrants identified in Bruck an der Leitha, including a child, with 13 detained and 8 still at large.
Multiple burglaries occurred in Axams, where various items including cash, cigarettes, alcohol, and sweets were stolen from cafes, business premises, and local clubs over two consecutive nights.
Police officers in Vienna saved the life of a 68-year-old unconscious woman by performing first aid and reanimation until emergency medical services arrived.
A suspect took a wallet lost on a tram and used its bank card for illegal transactions; the suspect was identified after a public appeal.
Armed robbery at a bank in Graz by two suspects; later connected to a series of seven robberies in multiple Austrian cities by four men who were eventually arrested.
A man armed with a knife jumped into an unmarked police car, was subdued by officers, and was identified as having stabbed another man. The incident arose over a dispute about a drug-related threat.
