A criminal group in Vienna impersonated police officers to deceive elderly victims via telephone scams, stealing money and valuables. Several arrests and house searches took place, recovering significant assets.
A verbal dispute escalated into physical violence and property damage in Villach, involving three women over a parked car. One woman injured another, and a phone was damaged during the incident.
Collision between a car and a moped in Klagenfurt resulting in injuries and vehicle damage.
A 50-year-old man was arrested in Köttmansdorf for large-scale fraud involving prepaid contracts for modular homes, causing damage of €200,000.
A woman and a man attempted a U-turn on a road, leading a moped driver to crash into their car. The teenager suffered minor injuries, and significant vehicle damage occurred.

A 20-year-old Afghan man from Vienna stabbed a 21-year-old Afghan man and injured another while attempting to mediate during a street argument in Viendorf. The suspect was arrested, and a knife was seized.
A German man assaulted multiple people with a knife, causing injuries, in Laa an der Thaya; he was arrested by police.
An intoxicated man in Linz initiated a physical altercation in a bar, injuring another patron before being restrained and arrested.
A physical altercation occurred between two Kosovar men at a farm in Eferding, leading to injuries from a knife and police involvement.
A 15-year-old lost control of his moped due to a manure trail, causing a crash that resulted in serious injuries to the driver while the passenger remained unharmed.
A car and tractor collided in Fürth, Piesendorf; two were injured, one flown to a hospital, the other sought treatment independently.
A 50-year-old taxi driver was injured in a head-on collision with a truck in Urscha, Gleisdorf.
An aircraft made an emergency landing near Graz due to a missing nose wheel, causing no injuries but some damage to the airplane.
Armed robbery at a bank in Graz; two masked men threatened staff with a handgun and fled with cash, escaping in a car, no injuries reported.

A truck driven by a Ukrainian driver went off the road on a prohibited route in Brandenberg, nearly falling off. The vehicle was stabilized by the fire department and later recovered. Minimal damage occurred.

Two individuals, a 26-year-old man and his 54-year-old mother, were arrested in Lustenau for resisting state authority and assaulting police officers during an attempt to execute an arrest warrant. Both face charges of resistance to state authority and grievous bodily harm.
Unidentified individuals spray-painted graffiti on ÖBB train wagons at the Spielfeld station during the night.

A heavily intoxicated truck driver was stopped at a rest area, arrested after aggressive behavior, and his vehicles windscreen damage was resolved before the journey continued with a replacement driver.
Fire in a basement of a multi-unit building in Bischofshofen; no injuries, material damage caused.
A 40-year-old intoxicated man was injured after being hit by a car while crossing a road at a red pedestrian light in Neubaugürtel, Vienna.
Three young men were caught and admitted to vandalizing properties with graffiti in Vienna.

A 28-year-old woman attacked her husband with a knife during a domestic dispute, causing serious but non-life-threatening injuries. She was temporarily detained, and a restraining and weapons ban was issued against her.
A 21-year-old driver caused multiple traffic accidents under the influence of cannabis, attacked other drivers and police officers, and injured a woman before being arrested.
A fire broke out on a rooftop terrace of a residential building in Neudörfl, with significant facade damage. Neighbors extinguished the fire, and no people or animals were endangered.
Car accident at a highway exit left three people injured, with two vehicles severely damaged.
An 80-year-old man turning left collided with a 15-year-old moped rider and his 14-year-old passenger in Spittal/Drau, injuring the rider.
An unknown truck caused a 25 km oil spill on the Drautalstraße B 100, requiring extensive cleanup efforts.
A 59-year-old man lost control of his hang glider during landing on Emberger Alm and crashed into a wooden structure, sustaining injuries.
A pet King Python escaped its terrarium and was found unhurt in a house gap; the owner was reported for not registering the reptile.
Motorcycle accident in Frankenfels due to slippery road conditions; both the rider and passenger sustained injuries.
A 24-year-old driver under the influence caused a collision in Reichraming, resulting in two people being injured.
An 80-year-old man lost control of his tractor on a slope, leading it to overturn and collide with a power pole. He was rescued and taken to the hospital with injuries.
Two 15-year-old schoolgirls on mopeds fell on a gravel-strewn road in Kurzenkirchen, Bezirk Schärding, and sustained injuries of an undetermined degree.
Altercation in Eferding involving a family and a local man over COVID-19 mask rules, resulting in physical confrontation and minor vehicle damage.
Two teenage girls on a moped fell due to sudden braking, resulting in minor injuries, and were taken to LKH Weiz for treatment.
53-year-old man severely injured after falling off an e-bike on a gravel road, transported to hospital by helicopter.
A 71-year-old Belgian man fell to his death while searching for his camera on a mountain trail near Gschnitz.
Car caught fire on A2 Südautobahn; no injuries reported, cause unknown.
An 18-year-old male sustained severe leg injuries while mowing in Neustift iSt and was airlifted to a clinic in Innsbruck.
A Belgian man fell 45 meters while hiking on the Berliner Höhenweg and was seriously injured.
Car-motorcycle collision in Umhausen; both drivers injured, motorcycle rider airlifted to hospital.
A truck driver veered off the road into a wooded area, was injured, and transported to a hospital in Vienna. The ramp to the highway was temporarily closed.
A 24-year-old Serbian man was arrested in Vienna for suspected drug dealing, with 500 grams of drugs and €315 seized after a short chase.
Two unidentified men threatened a 35-year-old with a knife in Linzs Schillerpark and stole two packs of cigarettes.
Man jumped onto railway tracks near Golling station, causing a freight train to initiate emergency braking; he fled and remains unidentified.
An intoxicated driver was found sleeping in a heavily damaged car in Salzburg-Itzling; his license was confiscated after testing 1.5 per mille alcohol.
A drunk 18-year-old driver lost control of his car due to speeding, crashing into a wall, trying to evade a police check in Zell am See. No injuries were reported, but significant damage occurred.
Two individuals attempted to steal bicycles and e-scooters in Vienna. One suspect was arrested, and eleven bicycles and two e-scooters were recovered.
Man threatened two guests with a multifunction knife in a restaurant; suspect was arrested.
A 37-year-old man attacked a 30-year-old victim with a knife and pursued him, causing life-threatening injuries before being arrested.

A collision occurred on the B50 in Kittsee between a 70-year-old driver and another vehicle containing a 72-year-old driver and his 76-year-old passenger, resulting in one serious and two minor injuries.
An 8-year-old Greek child was severely injured in a go-kart collision at a leisure center in Austria.
A 58-year-old woman lost control of her motorcycle in a curve and fell into Halbach, sustaining injuries of indeterminate severity.
A 73-year-old man fell 10 meters while hiking and sustained back injuries, requiring helicopter transport to a hospital.
A car collided with a moped in Saalfelden. The 15-year-old moped driver was injured, while all car occupants remained unharmed. Alcohol tests were negative for both parties.
A moped rider in Graz was lightly injured in a hit-and-run traffic accident involving a car that fled the scene, likely a white or silver BMW.
A 29-year-old motorcyclist suffered severe injuries in a collision with a 30-year-old car driver at a junction in Heimschuh.
Unknown perpetrators broke into multiple stores in Fürstenfeld and stole cash.
A 65-year-old motorcyclist was injured after sliding on a bitumen strip and colliding with an oncoming car on the B114 road in Hohentauern.
A Belgian kayaker capsized in the Ötztaler Ache in Sölden, was swept away, and later died in a hospital despite rescue efforts.
A cyclist was injured when a car turning onto the Bundesstraße 175 in Ebbs collided with him. He was treated and transported to a hospital.
A man was seriously injured during asphalt cutting work when a reversing truck hit him in Kundl.
Three vehicles were involved in a rear-end collision in Mils bei Hall, leaving all drivers with injuries of unknown severity.
A 36-year-old German hiker was found dead by a police helicopter crew near Grünsteinscharte. It is presumed he fell, and an autopsy was ordered to determine the exact cause of death.
A heavily intoxicated man resisted arrest in Hohenems, injuring two police officers during a domestic altercation with his girlfriend.
A transformer station caught fire in a company in Fußach; the fire was quickly extinguished, no injuries reported.
A 63-year-old man was fatally injured after being trapped under a tractor-like vehicle while attempting to load a generator in Dornbirn Hatlerdorf.
A car collided with a truck at a crossroads in Nüziders, causing severe property damage. No injuries were reported.
A drug deal dispute in Schruns escalated when three individuals attacked a potential buyer who refused to pay, resulting in a physical altercation involving a baseball bat.
A truck driven by a 28-year-old man collided with a train at a railway crossing in Gumpoldskirchen; no injuries were reported.

Car collided with a motorcycle in Raab, injuring the motorcyclist who was airlifted to a hospital.
A 29-year-old man was assaulted by three coworkers during a dispute over a company car, which was subsequently stolen. The perpetrators were quickly arrested and the vehicle recovered.

A 27-year-old driver in Gaißau lost control of his car on Hauptstraße and collided with trees in a nearby forest. Three passengers suffered minor to undetermined injuries, while the driver was uninjured. The car was totaled.
A 28-year-old Syrian man was caught attempting to sell drugs in Vienna. Police found cannabis packets and cash on him, leading to his arrest.
A 22-year-old suspect was arrested for attempted burglary after entering an apartment through an unlocked balcony door. Police found valuables in her possession.
Attempted burglary into a single-family house in Viennas Donaustadt district; suspects arrested while trying to forcibly open a window.
A 53-year-old man threatened a subway driver with scissors and attacked another passenger; he was detained by witnesses until police arrival.
A womans car caught fire after driving over a small haystack, and the fire was extinguished by a resident using a fire extinguisher.
A farmer in Bezirk Feldkirchen, Austria, had a tractor accident while transporting hay bales, resulting in severe injury and requiring rescue efforts.
A 23-year-old man was injured after diving into shallow water at Faaker See and was taken to the hospital.
A motorcyclist lost control on a dirt road in Kirchbach and crashed, sustaining injuries.
A Serbian truck driver was stopped on the A25 in Wels for massive driving time violations, attempting to hide them with a foreign drivers card.
A 65-year-old motorcyclist was injured after a fall following a full brake to avoid collision in Grieskirchen district.
Serious collision between a car and a motorcycle on the B137 near Neumarkt am Hausruck, resulting in severe injuries to the motorcyclist.
A 16-year-old boy was severely injured in a moped accident in Pramet after colliding with his friends moped while attempting to stop.

A traffic accident occurred in Salzburg involving a drunk driver, resulting in two minor injuries and vehicle damage. The driver had a blood alcohol level of 2.44 promille and was stripped of his license on the spot.
Car collision in Anif; a driver was slightly injured and her license was revoked due to 0.84‰ alcohol level.

A 29-year-old Austrian punched a 16-year-old Slovak in a supermarket at Salzburg main station over non-compliance with mask-wearing rules, causing a bleeding nose. The attacker, intoxicated with 2.3 per mille alcohol, was detained and reported.
A Bulgarian truck displayed severe fuel and oil leaks along with a damaged air spring, leading to the vehicles license plates being confiscated and the drivers journey halted.
Unidentified perpetrator threw concrete pieces at Graz synagogue windows, causing damage.
Several mountain bikes were stolen from garages and carports in Bischoffeld without the use of force.
A 53-year-old man was injured in a traffic accident on B 72 in Birkfeld when a van crossed into the opposite lane and collided with his car.
A 75-year-old man crashed his car into trees and a parked vehicle on B 67, injuring himself lightly and his wife severely. Both were rescued from the wreck by firefighters.
A 29-year-old German woman was struck by a falling rock while climbing in the Anna via ferrata route on Dachstein and sustained unspecified injuries.
A 15-year-old moped rider and his passenger collided head-on with a cyclist after entering a roundabout in the wrong direction in Kufstein, causing severe injury to the cyclist.
A 42-year-old Austrian woman lost control of her car in Gurgl, crashing into a bridge railing and sustaining injuries. Her car was totaled.
A multi-vehicle collision occurred in Innsbruck involving a car, motorcycle, and a small truck, resulting in serious injuries for the motorcyclist.
A barn in Lustenau was completely engulfed in flames; the cause remains unknown, no injuries were reported, and nearby homes were evacuated as a precaution.
A car hit a 79-year-old woman on Hauptstraße in Bad Schönau; she was injured and airlifted to a hospital.
A 62-year-old man fell approximately 60 meters on a steep mountainside after attempting a nighttime descent and was found dead the following morning.
Motorcyclist injured after slipping on liquid spilled from an unidentified vehicle, leading to a crash in Längenfeld.
Police arrested a drug dealer with 1 kg of marijuana and smaller amounts of cocaine, money was also seized.
Unknown perpetrator sprayed graffiti on twelve garage doors in Puchenau.
A construction container in Sölden/Zwieselstein was broken into, and a chainsaw and an angle grinder were stolen.
A German driver collided with a Vienna-based motorcyclist during a turning maneuver in Krainegg, causing injuries to the motorcyclist and damage to both vehicles.
A cyclist collided at full speed with a car near a pedestrian crossing, resulting in injuries and hospitalization.
A man in Linz was assaulted and robbed near a cinema by an unknown assailant after drinking together earlier that evening.
A 37-year-old German driver crashed his car and was severely injured; alcohol influence was confirmed.
A forest fire broke out in the Runach forest area in Matrei i.O., covering approximately 20 square meters; no foul play is suspected.
Vandalism in a hotel involving water damage and a triggered fire alarm, causing 167 guests to evacuate; investigation ongoing.
A fire in Gallizien caused damage to a building and injured a firefighter; exact cause unknown.
A 33-year-old motorcyclist and a 40-year-old car driver collided in a roundabout, causing injuries to the motorcyclist and damage to both vehicles.
A 59-year-old paraglider crashed during landing in Annenheim, sustaining serious injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.
Motorcyclist crashed into guardrail in a curve and sustained serious injuries in Unterpreitenegg.
A 74-year-old cyclist collided with a pedestrian on the Donauradweg, causing injuries to both individuals.
A motorcycle collided head-on with another after a risky overtaking maneuver in Eschenau-Rotheau; both riders were severely injured.
A motorcycle collision occurred in Türnitz, Austria, where a 37-year-old man was severely injured and transported to the hospital.
Driver caused a collision at a traffic light with 1.66‰ alcohol level and refused further testing.
A 25-year-old driver in Austria lost control of his car and overturned while driving under the influence, resulting in injuries and license suspension.
A motorcyclist in Austria collided with another motorcyclist after being distracted by an overtaking bike, resulting in injuries.
A 59-year-old man and his daughter were rescued by a police helicopter after he fell during a mountain climb, experienced shock, and could not proceed.
Heavy rain, hail, and storms caused multiple mudslides, leading to road closures and the evacuation of trapped individuals without injuries in Pongau, Austria.
A traffic accident in the Liefering roundabout involved two cars; one driver was injured and transported to the hospital.
A house roof in Laßnitzhöhe caught fire, likely due to a lightning strike; no injuries occurred.
A hail-defense single-engine aircraft crashed in Hochgößnitz, leaving two pilots injured, and the wreckage was secured for further investigation.
A 61-year-old German woman experienced severe health issues during a mountain ascent in Jerzens, requiring a complex rescue involving a mountain rescue team and a helicopter.
Mudslide caused by heavy rainfall blocked a road in Neustift i.St.; no injuries but traffic was disrupted and people were rescued.
Mudslide caused by heavy thunderstorm blocked Kaunertaler Gletscherstraße, requiring cleanup to free trapped vehicles and people.
Mudslide in Sölden caused damage to two bridges and led to road closures.
Landslides occurred in two areas, injuring a motorcyclist and trapping vehicles and people, but no fatalities were reported.
Mudslide in Aschbach caused by heavy rain and thunderstorms, leading to temporary road closure; no injuries reported.
Police conducted drug and alcohol traffic controls in Bregenz and Dornbirn, resulting in multiple sanctions including license confiscations and legal charges.
A 16-year-old moped driver in Dornbirn had an accident while carrying two passengers, leading to minor injuries and damage to the moped.

30-year-old man in Krems an der Donau fled police during a traffic stop, driving recklessly through multiple streets; he was caught in a forest, found without a valid license, and suspected of being under the influence of drugs.
Police in Kufstein discovered drugs including cannabis and cocaine in a hotel room occupied by a 20-year-old Austrian and also confiscated cash associated with drug trade.
Unidentified persons broke into a locked construction container in Mieming, stealing various tools and equipment.

A collision occurred in Klagenfurt between two cars when a 22-year-old turned left, hitting an oncoming vehicle operated by an 82-year-old man. The passenger in the 82-year-olds car was injured and taken to the hospital.
A pedestrian was struck and seriously injured by a car in Wölfnitz, Austria.

An 18-year-old driver fell asleep at the wheel, causing a crash where the car veered off the road and rolled several times in Brandhof, Austria. The driver was seriously injured but managed to exit the car independently.
A bus driver was threatened with murder by a passenger after being reminded to wear a face mask; suspect was later arrested and drugs were found.
A man attempted to steal a moped, fled the scene, and resisted arrest by kicking and punching officers.

A 21-year-old man robbed a car key using a knife and fled with the stolen car, causing multiple traffic accidents according to witnesses. The car was found abandoned in Lower Austria, and the suspect was later arrested after turning himself in.
A 15-year-old allegedly attacked a 21-year-old with a knife during an altercation, and both sustained injuries requiring medical attention.
Fire broke out in the bedroom of a row house in Kemeten due to an electrical defect; no injuries reported.
Car accident involving two vehicles on B 50, resulting in three individuals being slightly injured and a two-hour road closure.
A Jaguar driver caused two hit-and-runs in Villach, first rear-ending another car and then crashing into a concrete post before fleeing on foot.
Motorcyclist collided with car while overtaking, resulting in injuries and vehicle damage.
An e-bike worth several thousand euros was stolen from a public beach in Klagenfurt, Austria, between 12:00 and 13:00 hours. The victim is a 51-year-old Czech tourist.
A 16-year-old girl had a Quad accident on a gravel crossbuggy track, tipping her quad onto herself, and was airlifted to a hospital with suspected spinal injuries.
14-year-old boy caught riding a stolen bicycle after breaking its lock.
An unknown perpetrator entered a guesthouse, searched rooms, and fled after showing an ID to the victim in Freistadt district.
A farmer was severely injured by a flash fire caused by a silicone spray can igniting during welding work.
A 56-year-old drunk driver collided with a 54-year-old motorcyclist in Weibern; the motorcyclist was injured and hospitalized.
A 15-year-old moped rider collided with a car on the B3 road, resulting in injuries to the rider who was taken to a childrens hospital.

A 79-year-old driver caused a collision while attempting to make a U-turn on a busy highway; both drivers sustained minor injuries.
A 26-year-old man, heavily intoxicated, lost control of his moped on Riedgasse in Innsbruck, hitting a curb, causing injuries and significant property damage.

A head-on collision on B100 – Drautalstraße resulted in the death of a 50-year-old woman and severe injuries to a man, his wife, and their six-month-old daughter.

Police conducted speed controls in Flachgau; a 25-year-old was caught driving at 151 km/h in an 80 km/h zone and will face legal consequences.
A 56-year-old man fell five meters from scaffolding during construction work and sustained life-threatening injuries.

A German truck driver experienced an accident while operating a crane in Kirchberg in Tirol, causing the truck to slide down a hill and damaging surrounding properties.
A 29-year-old man operating a construction vehicle injured a German woman in Innsbrucks old town; the vehicle partially ran over her.

A 29-year-old man caused a head-on collision on the B 100 Drautalstraße, leading to the death of a 50-year-old woman at the scene and the subsequent death of a 6-month-old child due to severe injuries.
Cyclist fell after abruptly braking to avoid children on the street, sustaining injuries.

Firefighters rescued a heavily intoxicated man from a smoke-filled apartment caused by a pot left on the stove, preventing a potential fire.
A collision occurred in Ebensee when a 53-year-old man failed to yield and hit another car, injuring three people and causing significant damage to both vehicles.
Collision on A10 near Werfen involving three vehicles, resulting in two injuries and significant damage. Road was closed temporarily.

A 15-year-old moped driver was injured in a rear-end collision with a car on the B50 in Stoob.
A car with two occupants left the road while avoiding cyclists, overturned, and came to rest near a tree line; one person was injured.
11-year-old girl suffered from severe headaches while hiking in Heiligenblut and was airlifted to hospital.

Truck driver lost control after a bee sting, causing a crash and structural damage; driver injured, extensive property damage.
Collision at an intersection between a van and a light vehicle; one person was injured and airlifted to a hospital.
A 39-year-old worker in Linz was injured after being caught and dragged by a conveyor belt. He alerted colleagues via radio, and emergency services transported him to the hospital.
A motorcycle accident involving a car occurred in Leonding, resulting in injuries to the motorcyclist.
A motorcycle collided with a car on the Hochkönig Bundesstraße B 164, causing serious injuries to the motorcyclist.
A teenager on an unregistered moped collided head-on with an elderly cyclist, seriously injuring the cyclist.
A 23-year-old Czech woman fatally fell 150 meters from a hiking trail while taking a photo, suffering fatal injuries.

Despite efforts to avoid the debris, one driver collided with another vehicle, pushing it off the lane and then hitting a third car. No injuries were reported, but the vehicles required towing, and lanes were temporarily closed for accident management.
A 45-year-old Georgian man was arrested for smuggling an Iraqi/Kurdish family of five into Austria illegally; they sought asylum.
Unknown individuals sprayed blue graffiti on objects at a playground in Breitenwang, causing damages.
A worker fell 3.5 meters during roof construction in Großweißenbach, suffered severe injuries, and later died in the hospital.
E-scooter rider fled traffic stop, evaded arrest briefly, and was found under the influence of alcohol and drugs.
A fire broke out in a staff room in St. Kanzian am Klopeinersee; a woman extinguished it before the fire brigade arrived, one person was injured.
A 50-year-old man died in a traffic accident after his small truck veered off the road and hit a tree.

A car accident occurred in Mistelbach district where a vehicle skidded off a gravel road, hit a tree, flipped over a slope, and landed upside down in a pond. A 22-year-old male driver succumbed to his injuries despite rescue efforts.

A 15-year-old Iranian was caught with cocaine and ecstasy on a train between Vienna and Bregenz near Enns.
A 25-year-old Austrian woman collided head-on with a truck on the Loferer Straße in Going am Wilden Kaiser, resulting in injuries and vehicle damage due to driving under the influence.
A man was arrested in Vienna for dealing heroin; approximately 45 grams were found in his possession.
Two men were arrested after breaking into a residence in Vienna, stealing valuables, and attempting to flee.
Attempted burglary into a multi-apartment building causing damages worth several hundred euros.

Motorcyclist and passenger injured in a collision with a car while turning onto a highway ramp.
Diesel spilled from a truck caused three motorcycle accidents on a road in Linz, Austria, injuring one rider.
A 16-year-old moped rider collided with a car in Sierning, resulting in injuries.

A German tourist misjudged a hiking route in Obertauern, spending the night on the mountain and was rescued uninjured via helicopter the following morning.
A cyclist fell and was slightly injured after trying to avoid a car that ignored a right-of-way, leading to a hit-and-run incident.
A 66-year-old motorcyclist was severely injured after losing control on a curve and colliding with a halted concrete mixer truck.
A cyclist lost control and fell while trying to avoid colliding with two children on bikes; he sustained minor injuries in Innsbruck.

An inflatable structure was damaged and parts stolen in Zell am Ziller; a suspect has been identified.

A pedestrian was fatally struck by a car on the Hausruckstraße, B143, in Weierfing, with the driver fleeing the scene.
Head-on collision of two cars led to two drivers being injured and the road being temporarily closed.

Police intervened at Helmut Zilk Park in Vienna due to noise disturbance by a group of around 30 people; a 23-year-old man was briefly detained after refusing to cooperate and later identified before being charged.
Two men were arrested after breaking into a food stand in Vienna and stealing food, cash, and tools.
A 65-year-old man fell off his e-bike in Dolling, Kötschach-Mauthen, and sustained serious injuries.
A 55-year-old motorcyclist lost control on a curve, crashed off the road, and sustained injuries requiring airlift to a hospital.

Car accident in Anras where a vehicle rolled over into a steep ditch; driver seriously injured and son mildly injured.
A moped collided with a stationary car in Lustenau, injuring the moped rider and causing significant damage to both vehicles.

A 43-year-old man fell while climbing at the Känzele Klettersteig in Bregenz, but his safety gear prevented a fatal fall. He was rescued by fellow climbers and the mountain rescue team after being unable to climb back up due to exhaustion.
An 87-year-old woman was fatally struck by a tractor driven by her son in Düns while reversing into a field.
Two E-bike riders collided in Bregenz, with one rider severely injured; alcohol was involved.

A 44-year-old man attacked a police officer, causing injury, after being confronted about noisy behavior.

A cyclist was injured in a traffic accident involving a hit-and-run. The driver briefly stopped but then fled the scene. Police investigations are ongoing, and the injured cyclist received medical attention.
A 55-year-old man from Styria suffered injuries after falling off his mountain bike on the Country Flow Trail during a descent on the Petzen.
A 59-year-old man from Wolfsberg fell off his e-bike on an unlit road and was injured.
A man was seriously injured by falling straw bales during a stacking operation on a farm in Gurk.
A Slovenian motorcyclist was seriously injured after losing control and crashing on Lavamünder Bundesstraße.

35 grenades were discovered during roadworks in Waldhausen, Bezirk Zwettl, and were safely removed by the military disposal team.

Unidentified perpetrators broke into an apartment in Innsbruck via the balcony door and stole cash, a watch, and a mobile phone.
A woman in Villach threatened her mother and sister with murder, causing fear and distress; the incident led to her arrest.
Traffic controls and exit restrictions implemented on the Tauernautobahn (A10) due to expected heavy holiday traffic.

A man attempted to break into a car, threatened a witness, assaulted a police officer, resisted arrest violently, and was found with illegal drugs.

A 23-year-old man lost control of his car, hit private property structures, and overturned, sustaining injuries.
Kitchen fire caused by overheated cooking oil in Wolfsberg, extinguished by a caregiver and the fire department, no injuries reported.
A man suffered head injuries after falling from a mountain cart on a downhill trail in Mönichkirchen.
A 27-year-old man lost control of his motorcycle on a curve in Hohenberg, sustaining injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.

A car accident occurred in Traismauer involving multiple vehicles; a 43-year-old driver lost control and collided with oncoming traffic and a police station wall, resulting in serious injuries and requiring airlift to the hospital.
A 26-year-old man was caught driving at 235 km/h on the Westautobahn, overtaking on the right, endangering others, and had his license confiscated.
A Nigerian man was caught attempting to sell cannabis in Linz and was arrested after fleeing from the police.

A 31-year-old man from Klagenfurt threatened his 21-year-old partner and her 20-year-old friend out of jealousy, causing fear and distress.
Two men in Klagenfurt were involved in a physical altercation outside a bar, exchanging punches and sustaining significant injuries.
A car crashed after veering off the road, flipping multiple times, and hitting several objects; the driver had a blood alcohol level over 1.4 promille.

A taxi driver lost control on a wet road, hit a bridge railing, and ended up in a streambed, requiring emergency rescue.

A house fire caused by a stereo system defect led to a 33-year-old man suffering smoke inhalation while attempting to extinguish it.
A man threatened his ex-girlfriends life and set her apartment door on fire before fleeing; he was later arrested.

A 15-year-old moped rider collided with a car reversing out of a driveway, resulting in the moped rider being injured and transported to a hospital.

Two women were bitten and injured by an American Staffordshire Terrier after it jumped through a window and attacked their leashed dogs during a walk. They received treatment at a hospital and were released the same evening.

Traffic controls in Linz revealed a driver speeding at 113 km/h in a 50 km/h zone and another with 1.58 permille alcohol, along with various other traffic violations.
A driver lost control of his car while overtaking, leading to a rollover and injuries; alcohol was involved.
A 20-year-old man in Linz was caught driving under the influence of multiple drugs and without a license. Marijuana was also seized from his vehicle.
A car driven by an 18-year-old with two passengers veered off the road and landed in a field, causing injuries and a diesel spill.

Unknown perpetrators broke into two club premises in Nußdorf-Debant, causing damage and stealing a small amount of cash.

Driver collided with a building foundation in Haigermoos and fled the scene, later identified via social media and admitted to causing the accident due to microsleep.
A car collided with a likely underage pedestrian who fled the scene in Vienna.

A car accident occurred in Klagenfurt with injuries to the driver and passenger due to wet road conditions and driver alcohol influence.
Tractor and trailer accident with heavy property damage in Wolfsberg; no injuries reported.

A 77-year-old man fell from a ladder while cleaning his gutter, sustaining undetermined injuries and was transported to the hospital.
Three cars were involved in a traffic accident in Wieting due to mispedal confusion; one passenger sustained injuries and was hospitalized.
A 70-year-old man got lost in a forest near Steinbach am Attersee and was rescued by police and firefighters after being trapped in thorny terrain.
A 38-year-old was caught driving without a license and under the influence of alcohol; tested with 1.02 per mille.
A 50-year-old farmer was fatally struck by a tree during forestry work in Bezirk Urfahr-Umgebung.
A truck collided with a car parked on the shoulder of the A9 highway; both drivers sustained minor injuries and the truck overturned into a ditch.
A 27-year-old was robbed and slightly injured by four unknown perpetrators in Graz, losing his wallet and contents.
Car collision in Liezen involving two vehicles, resulting in minor injuries to one person.
Two German climbers, aged 35 and 26, were rescued after being unable to descend the Großglockner due to bad weather and icy conditions; they were exhausted but unharmed.

Police introduced a new service dog named Siegfried who is undergoing training for police service in Vorarlberg, Austria.

Police in Linz apprehended two suspects after a car and license plates theft, including a 23-year-old driver who attempted to flee and endangered an officer during a traffic stop.
A 14-year-old attacked a 16-year-old at and near a shopping center in Bezirk Linz-Land, involving physical assaults and injuries.

A German woman in Innsbruck was defrauded on a dating platform, leading to financial losses of low five-figure Euros and involvement in further transfers to conceal funds.

An 81-year-old cyclist collided with a dog leash and its owner on Marktgasse in Klein-Pöchlarn, causing her to fall and sustain serious injuries.
A fire occurred in a single-family house in Stockerau, spreading through the upper floor; no injuries were reported, but the house is now uninhabitable.
A 70-year-old man was injured in a tractor accident on his sons property in Steyr-Land District, requiring an airlift to the hospital.
Motorcyclist injured and hospitalized after collision with car at intersection in Neuhofen im Innkreis; driver of car suffered shock.
Bus and car collided head-on on Antiesenhofener Straße, leaving the car driver injured.
A driver was stopped in Elsbethen for using a phone while driving and was found to have a blood alcohol level of 0.72 promille; he was prohibited from continuing to drive and reported to authorities.
A man was found with cannabis and a butterfly knife during a vehicle inspection; he violated drug possession and weapon prohibition laws.
A 60-year-old German motorcyclist crashed on Katschberg Bundesstraße, suffered injuries and was airlifted to hospital; road was closed for 20 minutes.
A woman was injured during a guided canyoning tour in Strubklamm, Salzburg, and rescued using a rope pulley system.

A laptop was stolen from a man on a train between Vienna and Salzburg. The suspect, a Polish man, physically attacked the victim before fleeing. He was apprehended at Salzburg Hauptbahnhof and the laptop was recovered.
A 77-year-old man was found dead on a hiking trail near the Rote Wand in the Grazer Bergland. Rescuers determined he died of natural causes.
An elderly woman in Graz was scammed by a man pretending to be a city employee, stealing 500 euros.
A heavily intoxicated pedestrian collided with a tram in Graz Inner City, sustaining serious injuries to the upper body and head.
Headlights were stolen from several SUVs, causing damage worth tens of thousands of euros.
Two Slovenian workers accidentally set a roof structure on fire while conducting flame work; no injuries reported.
Fire broke out at a recycling center in Kindberg suspected to have been caused by disposed batteries; no injuries reported.
Two electric bikes were stolen from a hotels bike shelter in Pertisau; the bikes were secured by a lock that was cut.
A moped collided with a pedestrian in Tumpen causing injuries to both individuals.
A heavily intoxicated Polish driver was stopped after driving the wrong way on the A12 near Telfs, posed safety risk, and had his license temporarily revoked.
A tractor fell off a steep path, severely injuring the 56-year-old driver who was airlifted to a hospital. The vehicle was secured by firefighters to prevent further accidents.
A 70-year-old German cyclist without a helmet fatally injured in an accident in Mieders on the Stubaitalstraße due to a collision with another rider.
25-year-old man lost control of his car on the A14, resulting in a crash and total damage to the vehicle; minor injuries reported.
An 11-year-old girl was hit by a car while cycling in Lustenau and the driver left the scene without providing information.
Multiple men were involved in a conflict; one man assaulted police officers during the intervention, causing minor injuries to two officers before being arrested.
A 19-year-old intoxicated woman attacked a taxi driver over unpaid fare and assaulted police and witnesses during her arrest in Vienna.

A car and an overpowered e-scooter collided when the scooter driver disregarded priority rules, resulting in minor injuries to the scooter driver and legal consequences for operating an unregistered vehicle.
Three car drivers were caught racing at 180 km/h on a highway with an 80 km/h limit; they were fined and may face license suspension.
A 56-year-old man fell approximately 3 meters while trimming a hedge on a ladder, sustaining serious injuries.
Emergency services were deployed after a man was mistakenly believed to have drowned in the Faaker See; the man was later found safe on an island.

A 19-year-old woman from Munich lost control of her car on a municipal road in Unterwietingberg, Klein St. Paul. The car hit an embankment, overturned, and she sustained injuries of an undetermined degree. She was transported to Friesach Hospital.
A 23-year-old driver collided with a 68-year-old motorcyclist while overtaking illegally, causing serious injuries to the motorcyclist.
A 79-year-old man died after falling into a silo in Traismauer while working on a farm.
A man was injured when he was pinned between a car and a trailer after the car rolled due to the parking brake not being engaged.
A motorcyclist collided with a combine harvester and sustained severe injuries in Kirchbach-Zerlach, South Styria.
Collison between a motorcycle and a bicycle left three people injured in Frohnleiten.
A house caught fire after cooking oil overheated; no injuries reported.
A 27-year-old Czech woman injured herself to an undetermined degree after colliding with a tree while biking on a downhill trail; she was airlifted to a hospital.
A 55-year-old man fell about five meters while climbing in the Hochschwab massif and sustained undetermined leg injuries.
A 59-year-old Austrian man drove his car under the influence of alcohol and fell approximately 50 meters off the road near Rifflseehütte. He was rescued and hospitalized.
A 20-year-old German motorcyclist lost control on a curve, fell into a 60-70m deep gorge in Namlos, and was airlifted to a clinic with injuries.
A motorcycle collided with a turning car in Unterpinswang, leaving the rider and passenger with injuries.

A collision occurred on the B 179 in Musau when a car driver turned around due to traffic congestion and a motorcyclist attempting to overtake collided with the car, resulting in serious injuries for the motorcyclist and their passenger.
A 26-year-old German motorcyclist crashed in a curve at Kanzertaltunnel, Bschlabs, and was injured.
Motorcycle accident in Söll involving two alcohol-intoxicated individuals, the rider and his passenger, who suffered injuries of unknown severity.
Unknown perpetrator damaged safety glass at a bus stop in Feldkirch using a sharp object.
Two young men in an unregistered car lost control on a dirt road, causing the vehicle to overturn multiple times; both sustained minor injuries.
A cyclist was injured after a collision with a car in Bezirk Braunau, Austria.
Unidentified perpetrators stole three flagpoles from a sports field in Rückersdorf, causing damage worth several thousand euros.
Two brothers were arrested in Linz after attacking a 21-year-old and resisting police intervention, damaging property in the process.
Drunk driver caused a traffic accident in Neunkirchen, leaving three people injured.
Two cars collided on Höchsterstraße in Dornbirn, resulting in severe injuries to one driver and other passengers sustaining varying degrees of injuries.
A cyclist under the influence of alcohol collided with a car after running a red pedestrian light, resulting in minor injuries to the cyclist and damage to the car.
A motorcycle collided with a car in Floridsdorf, Vienna, resulting in injuries to the motorcycle rider and damage to both vehicles.
A cyclist was injured after being forced off the road by a car in Klagenfurt am Wörthersee. The car fled the scene without stopping.
A KTM 690 motorcycle without license plates was stolen in St. Niklas, Villach, causing financial loss to a 23-year-old man from Salzburg.
59-year-old motorcyclist crashed on a curve, collided with a car, and suffered serious leg injuries in Patergassen. The road was temporarily closed.
A man fell from a tree while picking apples, sustaining severe injuries, and was transported to the hospital.
A 20-year-old woman fell approximately 50 meters while hiking on Schneeberg; rescued by helicopter and hospitalized with injuries.
An 84-year-old driver collided with an ambulance in Enzenreith at an intersection. Both drivers, passengers, and the ambulance crew were injured, while both vehicles were totaled.
A motorcycle collided with a car near Glaubendorf, causing the deaths of the motorcyclist and his passenger. The car driver tested positive for alcohol but was unharmed.
A 50-year-old man fell approximately 40 meters to his death near the Hohe Wand in Stollhof, Bezirk Wiener Neustadt.
A 67-year-old man was found dead in a pond after presumably falling down a steep slope in Waldburg.
A 16-year-old motorcyclist collided with a car at a red light in Traun, suffering severe injuries and being transported to the hospital.
A man robbed a 25-year-old at knifepoint, stole cash, and was apprehended shortly after in Linz.
A 69-year-old man had a severe E-Bike accident in Bad Goisern and sustained serious injuries.
A 60-year-old man lost control of his e-bike, fell into a meadow, got caught in an electric fence, and was rescued by the fire department. A breathalyzer test showed 1.0‰ alcohol.
A 38-year-old hiker fell on steep terrain while descending from Hohe Arche and sustained injuries; he was rescued by helicopter and taken to the hospital.
A Swiss woman was attacked by a young bull while hiking near Filzmoos, Salzburg, sustaining injuries to her left knee.
Two teenagers on a moped were injured in a collision with a car while attempting to overtake a cyclist in Leogang.

A 28-year-old Bosnian man was caught stealing a bicycle by breaking its lock in a restaurant parking lot in Salzburg Liefering. The stolen bicycle was recovered during a house search and returned to the owner.
Two vehicles collided on the L104 road in Austria due to one driver being heavily intoxicated, resulting in minor injuries for both parties.
Two cars collided in Wittmannsdorf, resulting in injuries to a 19-year-old who was transported to the hospital. The collision occurred at an intersection where a stop sign was allegedly ignored.
Two individuals, a cyclist and a motorcyclist, were injured in a still unclear accident in St. Lorenzen near Knittelfeld.
An unknown man entered a multi-family home through an unlocked door and fled without stealing anything after being confronted.
A 57-year-old German man was injured in a bicycle accident in Fügen, Austria. The cause of the accident is unclear, and witnesses are being sought.
A 77-year-old cyclist fell on B 172 Walchsee Straße, sustaining severe injuries, and was airlifted to the hospital.
A motorcycle accident occurred on B198 road in Tirol when a German drivers sudden braking caused by another car led to a crash. The suspect in a white Skoda Octavia fled the scene.
A car caught fire after being previously involved in an accident and abandoned on a gravel road; no injuries were reported.
A 43-year-old cyclist in Bregenz lost control of his bike in a curve, hit a wall, and fell approximately 8 meters into a ravine, suffering injuries of undetermined severity.
Motorcycle accident in Damüls caused injuries to the rider and passenger, requiring medical attention and road closure.
Two individuals and a dog were rescued separately by helicopter at the Rauer Kamm in Lackenhof am Ötscher after encountering difficulties during their hike due to fear and physical exhaustion.

Two Afghan asylum seekers had an altercation in their accommodation in Bad Hall, leading to one being injured by a punch. The perpetrator, found to be intoxicated, was temporarily arrested and charged.
A car and a truck collided on the L104 due to the truck driver crossing into the opposite lane; the truck driver was heavily intoxicated and both drivers sustained minor injuries.
A traffic accident occurred in Wittmannsdorf involving two cars; a 19-year-old driver was injured.
A 16-year-old pedestrian in Dornbirn was hit by a white Mercedes without lights at night, suffering minor injuries requiring medical attention.
Two male suspects robbed a 21-year-olds watch in the U-Bahn station Krieau, later identified and arrested on a separate burglary on October 24, 2020.
A car and motorcycle collision in Feldkirchen, Austria, resulted in injuries and property damage.
Two vehicles collided in Langkampfen. A 32-year-old womans car overturned after a side collision with a 21-year-old mans car. Both drivers were injured.
Police arrested a 21-year-old Nigerian man in Vienna after he resisted during a pursuit; he is suspected of being involved in drug dealing.
A man threw an e-scooter onto subway tracks, causing an emergency stop; he was apprehended by police after being spotted by a witness.
An 86-year-old driver ran a red light, hitting a 53-year-old pedestrian at a crosswalk. The pedestrian sustained severe injuries including suspected bone fractures and a concussion.
A 53-year-old driver hit a 35-year-old intoxicated pedestrian who crossed the road against the red light and sustained minor injuries.
A tractor caught fire due to an electrical short circuit, with no injuries or immediate danger to people or animals.
Three people injured in a collision involving a car, a truck, and another car on a road leading to the A4 highway; roadway closed for two hours.
A 52-year-old forestry worker was injured while cutting a fallen tree; emergency services rescued and airlifted him to a hospital.
A 23-year-old man from Graz fell off his mountain bike on a downhill ride, suffering injuries after tumbling 10 meters down a steep slope.
A driver aimed a gas pistol at another after a road rage incident on a motorway, leading to his arrest.
A 15-year-old cyclist was hit by a white van and slightly injured in a hit-and-run incident.
A car collided with a train at a railway crossing in Walding; no injuries reported, but significant damage to both vehicles.
A driver swerved to avoid a white Ford station wagon exiting a driveway, causing his car to overturn and land on its roof, resulting in minor injuries.
A 25-year-old worker in Gerlos experienced an electrical discharge injury while performing maintenance on a grounded 380KV line from a helicopter. He was transported to a hospital for observation.
A 50-year-old mountain biker suffered a medical emergency and died despite resuscitation attempts.
A car collided head-on with a tractor, injuring the car driver severely while the tractor driver remained uninjured.
An 84-year-old man who went missing from a care home in Hall was found dead; no indication of foul play, autopsy ordered.
Unknown perpetrators placed fist-sized stones on railway tracks in Krumpendorf am Wörthersee, endangering train operations; no damage occurred.
A 25-year-old man fell from a roof during cleaning work in Kremsmünster, sustaining severe injuries.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a company in Waidring and stole cash and a new laptop.
A 13-year-old cyclist in Dornbirn was injured after being forced to brake suddenly when overtaken by a car, causing him to fall and be hospitalized.
Two youths placed large stones on railway tracks in Krumpendorf, risking train derailment.
Two masked individuals robbed a jewelry store in Vienna-Favoriten and fled on foot; no injuries reported.
A man in Klagenfurt vandalized multiple windows and a car, resisted police, and attacked officers, causing minor injuries.
A cyclist in Salzburg was hit by a car and sustained a head injury; the driver fled the scene, and the cyclist was found to be under the influence of alcohol.
A 24-year-old Bosnian drove a van and collided with a truck on the A12 near Zirl; he was injured and hospitalized, while the truck driver was unharmed.
A collision occurred between a car and a motorcycle at the intersection of Geblergasse and Wattgasse, seriously injuring the motorcyclist who was taken to the hospital for emergency care.
A 27-year-old intoxicated man resisted arrest, insulted police, and injured an officer in Vienna.
Four men were arrested in Vienna for a pickpocketing operation targeting elderly individuals, with stolen items recovered.
A couple was threatened with a knife by a man who believed they were talking about him. The suspect was arrested but later released on charges.
A car accident occurred on the B65 in Heiligenkreuz, injuring three people as two vehicles collided during an attempted overtaking maneuver.
Two vehicles collided on the Ossiacher Tauernstraße in Glanhofen, with serious injuries to both drivers; one driver tested positive for alcohol.
Unknown individuals set fire to a plastic seating furniture near a retention basin building in Maria Saal; damage contained by firefighters.
Two suspects stole cash from a shop in Pernitz, had a physical altercation with the shop owner, and fled but were later apprehended by police.
A motorcyclist was injured in a collision with a truck at an intersection, causing significant property damage.

A vehicle was stopped by police at an autobahn exit due to a faulty light, leading to the arrest of the driver and passenger on suspicion of human smuggling and the detention of four individuals with no identification for illegal stay.
Head-on collision between two cars during an overtaking maneuver; one driver injured.
A truck loaded with 20 tons of wood collided with a tunnel wall, injuring the driver and causing significant damage.
A tractor slid into the opposite lane and caused a collision with a car, resulting in injuries to five people including two children.
Car collided with a cyclist in Salzburg, both women injured and car overturned into a stream.
Two German hikers were rescued after being caught in the dark during a mountain hike without light sources.
Diesel spill caused road closure and traffic accidents on B115 in Trofaiach; a suspected truck lost fuel and road cleanup involved significant emergency response.
41-year-old severely injured after falling asleep at the wheel, crashing through a fence, and hitting a tree on Übelsteiner Straße.
A forestry worker in Trofaiach was severely injured when struck by a falling tree trunk and had to be rescued by helicopter.
Motorcycle collision in Innsbruck/Wilten results in severe injuries for the rider and passenger, and minor injuries for the car driver.

Unidentified individuals broke into an apartment in Erpfendorf and stole valuable items, including silver coins, a coin collection, and a silver watch chain with pendants. Police search for suspects was unsuccessful.
A father and son capsized their canoe on the Lech river near Martinau; both were unharmed except for mild hypothermia in the child.
An 89-year-old woman was bitten by a French bulldog during her evening walk, causing unspecified injuries. She was provided first aid and taken to the hospital.
An elderly woman was killed in a collision between her car and a train at a secured railway crossing in Eisenstadt. Her husband was seriously injured, and no one else involved was harmed.
A 45-year-old man driving in Villach reversed his car, hitting an 81-year-old woman crossing the road. She was injured and taken to a hospital.
A car accident occurred on Silberseestraße in Villach where a driver and passenger sustained serious injuries after crashing into a granite monument.
Police officers rescued a severely injured person from a burning hotel room in Linz, using a battering ram to break in and extinguishing flames to ensure safe evacuation.
A 22-year-old woman admitted to stealing small amounts of money from colleagues tip jars in a business in Großarl since February, and was caught using a trap.
Police provide prevention tips against burglaries targeting bicycles, cash, and jewelry in multi-tenant buildings.
Unknown individuals broke a bus stop glass panel in Wolfurt using a wine bottle.
Police warn public in Vorarlberg about investment fraud involving fake trading platforms and manipulation tactics.
A motorcycle rider attempted to overtake traffic on the wrong lane and collided with a turning car, resulting in moderate injuries.
A 53-year-old man was assaulted and robbed by five unknown men in Stadtpark, Vienna. Personal belongings like a wallet and mobile phone were stolen.
A traffic accident occurred between a small truck and a pedestrian in Fichtnergasse, 13th district, Vienna, resulting in minor injuries to the pedestrian.
A man suspected of dealing heroin was arrested in Vienna after being observed selling drugs; he resisted arrest violently and drugs and cash were found in his possession and home.
A collision occurred in Marz involving two cars; a 27-year-old driver was found intoxicated and suffered injuries. Vehicles were heavily damaged.
A fire burned approximately 250 straw round bales on a property in Krensdorf with no immediate danger to people or animals.
Four unidentified men broke into a house in Bezirk Spittal/Drau, threatened a caregiver and homeowner with knives, and stole cash and jewelry before fleeing.
A man injured his leg with a chainsaw while working on a roof and was airlifted to a hospital.
A man fell 4 meters from scaffolding due to a defect, sustaining severe injuries and being airlifted to a hospital.
A truck collided with a car on the A 22 in Leobendorf, causing the car to overturn and resulting in injuries to the car driver.
A 25-year-old driver without a license was stopped in Neuhofen an der Krems after fleeing police and was found to be driving under the influence of alcohol.
Two vehicles collided at an intersection in Haid, injuring a woman who was hospitalized.
An unknown man entered a house in Neumarkt, startled by the resident, and fled without stealing anything.
A 44-year-old woman threatened her neighbor and the police during an aggressive outburst in her apartment while being heavily intoxicated.
E-bike rider collided with a car, resulting in life-threatening injuries.
Four suspects aged 16 to 19 were caught red-handed during a burglary at a company site and admitted to at least 20 similar crimes in Austria.
A vehicular fire caused by a technical defect was extinguished by the fire brigade in Schwaz, Austria; no injuries reported.
Four men were caught at Pfänderstraße in Lochau with a CO2-pistol and some cannabis; one had an active weapons ban, and one was in open custody with an electronic ankle bracelet.
A car fire occurred on the A14 near Altach in Vorarlberg. The fire, which started in the rear motor area, was extinguished by bystanders before the authorities arrived. No injuries were reported.
A car parked outside a house in Villach-Lind was scratched deeply from the rear to the front door by an unknown perpetrator.
A man was pushed off a park bench and robbed of his mobile phone and house keys, sustaining minor injuries in Linz.
Truck and car collision on A1 highway near Ansfelden, resulting in injuries to the car driver.
A German citizen was attacked and robbed by three unknown suspects in Linz; one suspect was arrested with stolen property.
Two unknown individuals attempted a burglary at a warehouse in Saalfelden, entering through an office window and later trying to open a residents apartment door. They fled when confronted.
Driver crashes his car, colliding with poles and a rock, causing the vehicle to overturn; he sustained injuries and tested positive for alcohol.
A 42-year-old man was arrested in Vienna after threatening a 63-year-old with a disguised electric shocker while intoxicated and breaking a glass pane, injuring himself.
Two separate incidents during traffic stops in Vienna; both involved drivers fleeing and attempting to injure officers, one intoxicated and the other without a valid driving license.
Police conducted a traffic operation focusing on impaired driving; 16 drivers suspected of drug use were stopped, 15 licenses were confiscated, and over 100 grams of cannabis seized.
A truck driver was injured after falling off a trailer while securing waste materials at a company site in Völkermarkt, Austria.
Two cars collided in Villach, Austria; both drivers injured and vehicles totaled.
A collision occurred between two cars on Landesstraße 1259, causing severe injuries to both drivers who were transported to hospitals.
A woman was robbed on a train; two men stole her backpack, took the cash, and fled across the tracks.
A woman and her dog were injured by an unleashed dog during a walk in Linz. The owner of the other dog left the scene quickly.
Two German climbers lost their way during a mountain descent on Großvenediger and were located and rescued by a police helicopter and mountain rescue teams. They were exhausted but uninjured.

A 22-year-old reported being threatened with a gesture by a 51-year-old man in Oberndorf near Salzburg. The aggressor, found under alcohol influence, confirmed threats during questioning and was detained.
Traffic accident in Neumarkt involving a car and a motorcycle resulted in one injured person, the motorcyclist, who was airlifted to a hospital.
Car-bike collision in Salzburg resulted in injuries to a cyclist.
A car driver veered off the road, crashed over an embankment, and hit a tree, resulting in serious injuries.
A car driver lost control in a curve, flipped the vehicle, and was injured, requiring airlift to a hospital.
A worker in Leoben fell from a terrace roof while installing glass plates, sustaining injuries of unspecified severity.
A 21-year-old woman driving a car collided with a truck in Kundl, resulting in severe injuries and significant vehicle damage.
Collision involving two small trucks; one driver injured and vehicles severely damaged.
Collision between a car and a cyclist at a crossroads in Lochau, resulting in injuries to the cyclist.
A fire broke out in the roof of a duplex house in Hohenems, damaging it and an adjacent apartment building; no injuries were reported but the house is uninhabitable.
A 7-year-old was completely buried in maize while unloading on a farm in Kapelln and was rescued by a family member before being airlifted to a hospital with unspecified injuries.
Two cars collided on a rainy Tauernautobahn near Paternion. A 61-year-old passenger sustained injuries and was taken to the hospital while the drivers remained uninjured.
A 17-year-old woman lost control of her car on a wet road in Reichenfels, causing it to overturn and land on another road below. She sustained injuries and was taken to the hospital.
A car collided with a train at a railway crossing in Grünau, resulting in the car being dragged 50 meters and the driver sustaining minor injuries.
A car collided with a moped in Schwertberg, injuring the 16-year-old rider who was taken to the hospital.
A printer caught fire in a residential building in Götzis; residents evacuated and three people treated for smoke inhalation.
A 24-year-old was arrested in Vienna for attempting to transport drugs; cocaine, heroin, and cash were confiscated.
A 56-year-old driver, with a blood alcohol level of 1.9 promille, hit a 76-year-old pedestrian at a crosswalk; the pedestrian was injured and hospitalized.
Two cars collided in a traffic accident in Viennas Hohe Warte area; one driver with a 0.70 promille alcohol level caused the crash, resulting in injuries and severe vehicle damage.
A car accident occurred on the A 2 near Wolfsberg due to possible aquaplaning, involving severe injuries to the car driver and significant vehicle damage.
A 56-year-old man disrupted public order in front of the Villach train station, verbally abusing passersby and security staff before being arrested after resisting police.
A head-on collision between a car and a van in Bezirk Gänserndorf resulted in the deaths of two individuals and severe injuries to two others.
Traffic checks in Linz and Linz-Land focused on speed and vehicle tuning; multiple violations and citations issued.
An 80-year-old man drove the wrong way on the A8 highway, causing traffic disturbance but no injuries.
A 15-year-old pedestrian was struck by a tram in Linz-Land, suffering injuries and being taken to the hospital.
Car overturned after losing control on wet road during a driving training, causing injuries to three occupants.
A head-on car collision involving a 23-year-old and a 64-year-old driver in Sankt Peter am Hart caused three serious injuries, requiring hospitalization and road closure for cleanup.
A cement mixer truck overturned in Plainfeld, causing a four-hour road closure and environmental cleanup due to oil and fluid spills.
A man violently resisted police intervention during a domestic disturbance, injuring a police officer, and was arrested in Graz.
An 88-year-old man was found with hypothermia and leg pain during a large search operation after he went missing while looking for tools on his property.
A 69-year-old man threatened and insulted officials of the district authority in a letter as a reaction to a received notice; he is being reported to the Graz Prosecutors Office.
A German tourist lost orientation during a hiking tour due to poor weather conditions and was rescued after seven hours by the Neustift mountain rescue team.
Two individuals in Innsbruck collapsed suddenly and were hospitalized in critical condition; the cause remains unknown.
A truck on the A12 near Volders caught fire, with the flames spreading to its cargo of pellets, requiring firefighters and a crane for unloading.
A fire occurred in a conservatory in Innsbruck caused by spontaneous combustion of cleaning cloths; no injuries reported.
A 40-year-old Austrian man fell 3.5 meters from a wet roof while doing repair work in Gnadenwald and sustained severe chest injuries.
A 10-year-old child was struck by a car while crossing the road near a bus stop in Schnifis and was injured.
Two individuals collapsed and lost consciousness outside a cafe in Innsbruck under unknown circumstances and were hospitalized in critical condition.
A 37-year-old woman caused a car accident in Dölsach after swerving to avoid another vehicle, overturning her car. She and her son were lightly injured, and alcohol was detected in her system.

Ten Syrian nationals were intercepted by police in Haslau-Maria Ellend, Austria, suspected of being victims of human trafficking; a 63-year-old Turkish truck driver was arrested under suspicion of conducting the smuggling operation.
A masked and armed woman robbed a bank in Alberndorf im Pulkautal, threatened an employee, and fled with cash; the perpetrator later confessed and all stolen money was recovered.
A 12-year-old boy was hit by a car while crossing on a pedestrian crosswalk and sustained minor injuries.
An intoxicated man attacked a police officer during a bar closing inspection without causing injury.
Industrial vacuum cleaner secured with a chain was stolen from a construction site in Villach between September 9 and 26, 2020.
Heavy rainfall caused the Metnitzbach river to overflow due to a technical defect at a small hydroelectric plants weir, leading to water damage at a nearby property.
A 21-year-old driver collided with a bridge rail while avoiding a deer and was found to be over the alcohol limit.
Fire broke out in the attic of a house in Golling, Salzburg. The fire was extinguished by the fire department, and no one was injured.

An 18-year-old man and a 27-year-old woman were attacked with punches and kicks by unknown offenders in a parking lot outside a disco, sustaining unspecified injuries.
A man fell from a height during construction work in Gallizien, resulting in fatal injuries.
Road closure in Ebenthal due to storm damage causing water backup and structural damage; cleanup and repairs conducted.
A 15-year-old moped rider in Ebenthal slipped on gravel and fell, resulting in injuries to her right leg; she received medical attention and was taken to a hospital.
An 18-year-old driver lost control of her car, collided with a tree, and was seriously injured in Heidenreichstein, requiring rescue and airlift to the hospital.
A car collided with a train at an unsecured railway crossing in Niederfladnitz, resulting in injuries to the car driver.
A driver in Ansfelden, Linz-Land district, threatened another driver with death over alleged dangerous driving.

A 23-year-old intoxicated driver crashed into a concrete wall on Dorfstraße, causing the vehicle to overturn. The driver escaped without assistance, tested positive for alcohol at 1.54 per mille, and had his license confiscated.
An 18-year-old was apprehended for stealing a motorcycle in Linz after being spotted by police following a tip-off.
A car accident occurred in Leonding when a vehicle lost control, colliding with two others, resulting in injuries to three individuals.
A drunk driver caused a collision at an intersection in Salzburg, resulting in injuries and total damage to the vehicles.
An unregistered and unlocked car was taken without permission in Acharting and later found with open windows in Bergheim.
Fire broke out at a loading ramp of a company building; no injuries reported, but property damage occurred.
A 33-year-old man fell from an eight-meter height during insulation work and sustained life-threatening injuries.
A semi-truck overturned on a highway ramp due to high speed; no injuries reported.
A truck driver caused a collision with a tractor, leading to the tractor overturning and its driver being slightly injured in Kundl, Austria.
An e-bike was stolen from a carport, despite being secured with a U-lock and a chain.
A 16-year-old boy was robbed at knifepoint in Dornbirn by a 19-year-old who was later apprehended nearby.
A man threatened a petrol station clerk with a syringe, stole cash, and fled on a bicycle in Vienna.
A 33-year-old man in Bleiburg, under the influence of alcohol, crashed his moped and sustained injuries.
21-year-old driver attempted to evade police vehicle stop in Vienna; his car had invalid license plates. Driver and others involved faced penalties, and vehicle plates were confiscated.
A young driver lost control of his vehicle, causing it to crash into a parked car, which was pushed into a storefront window, resulting in property damage but no injuries.

A car accident occurred in Hermagor where a vehicle lost control, rolled down a steep terrain, and the occupants were seriously injured and rescued with a complex operation involving multiple emergency services.
A 12-year-old cyclist lost control while jumping over a ramp and collided with another boy, resulting in the former being injured and hospitalized.
An explosion occurred in a wood-burning stove in a single-family house, causing minor injuries to two individuals.
20 construction fence panels with stone bases were stolen from a construction site in Moosburg, causing financial damage to a 34-year-old entrepreneur.
A 25-year-old man was injured after his motorcycle went off the road and hit a tree in Lassee.
An unidentified individual threw a firecracker at a skate park in Linz, injuring an 18-year-old and causing damage to property before fleeing the scene in a car.
A man threatened, strangled, and hit his wife during a family dispute while intoxicated.

A collision occurred between two cyclists, a 26-year-old and a 14-year-old, on Hofstallgasse, Salzburg. The adult was injured and taken to the hospital. Neither wore a helmet, and alcohol tests were negative.
Fire in a heating system due to a technical defect caused gas buildup, resolved by firefighters.
Police stopped a suspected abduction vehicle in Graz after a misunderstanding involving a father misinterpreting his daughters getaway with her boyfriend.
A 43-year-old intoxicated driver fled the scene of a car accident, resisted police attempts to stop him, endangered others, and was eventually arrested after being stopped following a pursuit.

A 33-year-old Czech man stole fuel and high-end tools from a construction site in Pians, escaped in a car but was later arrested along with his 26-year-old partner. Additional thefts and drug possession were revealed.
A car hit a deer on Ehenbichler Landesstraße in Weißenbach, injuring the driver and killing the deer.
A 63-year-old Swiss driver lost consciousness due to health issues, causing a car accident on the A13 in Natters; his 17-year-old daughter was uninjured.
A 15-year-old on a moped caused an accident in Lans, injuring her 17-year-old passenger.
A 22-year-old woman lost control of her car, hitting a fire hydrant and two parked cars, then fled the scene in Villach.
A business owner in Bezirk Wels-Land reported thefts from his storage and cooling rooms; video evidence led to the arrest of a 20-year-old suspect linked to three burglaries and a weapons offense.
Police responded to a reported abduction in Graz which was revealed to be a misunderstanding involving a father mistaking another person for his daughter.

A 73-year-old Italian man repeatedly hit a 25-year-old Austrian woman in the face during an altercation in a local establishment, and the woman retaliated by kicking a 72-year-old Italian woman; both sustained injuries but refused medical assistance.
Three paper waste containers at a school in Ludesch were set on fire by a 14-year-old student using a lighter, causing significant damage to the containers and school facade.

A youth gang attempted a robbery involving physical violence and threats in Herzogenburg; they damaged a bicycle and threatened others.
A car collided with a moped at an intersection, injuring the 16-year-old moped driver.
Two vehicles collided on the B38 in Oberrauchenödt, Austria, resulting in injuries, vehicles landing in a stream, and oil leakage into nearby water bodies.
A German driver lost control on a wet road on the A8 near Wels, collided with two vehicles, injuring two people.
A drunk driver veered off the road, fell down an embankment, and landed in a creek; he was lightly injured and tested with a blood alcohol level of 2.3 permille.
Drugs and illegal weapons were seized, including cannabis plants, cocaine, and prohibited weapons, during a police-assisted eviction in Vienna.

A 20-year-old man parked his car illegally in a police no-parking zone in front of the Leopoldsgasse police station. The car had multiple violations, including being unregistered, lacking a technical inspection plate, and having plates from another car. It was also discovered the mans driver’s license had been revoked, though he had not surrendered it. His license was seized, and he was reported multiple times.
A car lost control and collided with a lorry, injuring the driver severely and damaging additional vehicles in Vienna.
A truck accident occurred in Eberndorf, causing injuries to the driver and significant property damage. Debris blocked the road temporarily.
A 64-year-old man fell in an oil tank room beneath a garden hut, suffering fatal head injuries after a ladder slipped.
A 52-year-old woman caused a traffic accident in Klagenfurt, injuring herself and a 60-year-old man. Two cars were heavily damaged.
A 17-year-old lost control of a car on a wet road in Traiskirchen, Austria, crashing into a tree and sustaining injuries. He was airlifted to a hospital.
Two cars collided head-on on a wet road in Handenberg, with both drivers injured and requiring extraction by emergency services.
A car driven by an 18-year-old skidded off the road in slippery conditions and crashed into an embankment, injuring her and her 16-year-old passenger.
A head-on collision occurred between a car and a truck in Braunau district; four car occupants were injured, the truck driver was unhurt, and environmental contamination resulted from spilled fuel.
16-year-old collided head-on with another car while turning left at a green light.
A 21-year-old man in Linz-Land was caught driving without a license under the influence of drugs and fatigue. He refused a urine test, and a clinical examination confirmed his impairment.
19-year-old was stopped for riding a modified e-bike at 41 km/h without proper brakes, license, helmet, or registration, which is required for such high-powered e-bikes.
A 20-year-old driver was stopped for erratic driving and found to be under the influence of drugs in Salzburg.
A truck carrying scrap metal tipped over in a curve on the B156 in Bergheim due to an unsecured container, blocking both lanes for about two hours. No injuries occurred.
Five men engaged in a physical altercation at Graz Main Station; one threatened another with a gas pistol. Police intervened, and injuries were treated at hospitals.
A cyclist in Graz was injured after avoiding a collision with a car; police are searching for the driver who fled the scene.
A collision on A2 near Lieboch involving two cars and a truck resulted in three individuals sustaining injuries.
A truck with significant technical defects was stopped and inspected, resulting in a travel prohibition and its registration plates being confiscated.
A 15-year-old moped rider was injured in a collision with a car at an intersection in Telfs.
A cyclist suddenly crossed a buss path in Innsbruck-Amras, causing the driver to brake abruptly. A passenger was injured due to the sudden stop.
Two men were arrested in Klagenfurt-Land for drug-related offenses, including heroin smuggling and cannabis cultivation.
A 32-year-old man in Linz was arrested for stealing a bicycle near Südbahnhofmarkt, possessing drugs, and carrying forged prescriptions.
A pedestrian was struck by a car and seriously injured in Graz; police are seeking witnesses to the accident.
A 35-year-old man fell approximately 2 meters while working on an awning in Höflein, suffering spinal injuries and requiring helicopter transport to a hospital.
Clearing of a tent camp at Michaelerplatz, Vienna, with several identities recorded and three individuals temporarily detained.
A fire broke out in an agricultural building, likely caused by a discarded cigarette, and was extinguished by the fire department.
Unidentified perpetrator broke into a public building in Landeck, triggered an alarm, and fled without loot despite a police search.
A cyclist collided with a car door that was opened unexpectedly, causing injuries and property damage.
Multiple drug-related offenses in Vienna resulted in arrests and the seizure of cocaine and cannabis.
A man was caught and arrested by police while breaking into and rummaging through a car after witnesses reported the incident.
A man was arrested in Vienna after making two bomb threats from phone booths; no dangerous items were found, and he initially denied the accusations.

A wooden barn in Großmutschen, used as a workshop, was completely destroyed by fire. No one was injured, but the barn and its contents, including a vehicle, were lost. The cause of the fire is under investigation.

A 19-year-old man lost control of his car while briefly looking at his food, leading to a crash involving multiple flips and a totalled vehicle; he sustained unspecified injuries but was responsive and taken to the hospital.
A German pensioner lost control of his motorcycle on a curve, hit a curb, and fell unconscious from his vehicle in Millstatt am See.
An 82-year-old man fell on a staircase in his second residence, suffering severe arm injuries, and was airlifted to a hospital.
Kitchen fire caused by a technical defect in a range hood caused significant property damage in St. Veit/Glan.
A head-on collision occurred between two cars in Gallbrunn, leaving one driver seriously injured.
Worker fell six meters into a shaft while working on a railing and was hospitalized with unspecified injuries.
A man was bitten by a rattlesnake he kept illegally in the basement of his house, requiring medical attention.

A planned explosion in a quarry in Bezirk Kirchdorf caused unexpected rock projections, injuring a man who was later airlifted to a hospital, and damaging a high-voltage power line.
