A rear-end collision in the Niklasdorftunnel on the Semmering Schnellstraße S 6 injured two individuals, who were taken to a hospital for treatment.
Thieves broke into a water sports shop in Graz, stealing items worth around 100,000 euros.
Thieves stole a moped from an underground garage in Graz between September 26-28, 2020. Police identified the culprits and recovered the vehicle on September 29, arresting three 16-year-olds.
A 79-year-old man reported missing was found uninjured in Deutschlandsberg after a search operation.
Two men in Götzens were caught with stolen license plates and driving without a license under the influence of drugs.
A cyclist collided with a turning VW bus at an intersection, resulting in injuries.
A man physically assaulted a taxi driver in Innsbruck and stole money before being apprehended the next day.
Two women suspected of pickpocketing were arrested after attempting to steal from an elderly womans backpack at a tram stop in Vienna.
A suspected burglar was caught climbing down a building facade after being surprised by the resident. He was rescued by emergency services and arrested.
A man was robbed of his cash by two suspects threatening him with a knife. Both suspects were arrested, and the stolen money and knife were recovered.
A parking enforcement officer was grabbed by a man in Vienna-Simmering over a parking dispute; the man later threatened the officer with a wooden stick.
A woman was caught stealing in a bookshop in Vienna-Mariahilf and threatened harm to her baby before being calmed and arrested.

A fire broke out in an unoccupied apartment in Wolfsberg, caused by items left on an electric stove that was accidentally turned on, leading to significant damage.
A van driver swerved to avoid a car overtaking in oncoming traffic, leading to an accident where the van ended up in a field and the driver was injured.
A 45-year-old woman was slightly injured when a bus hit her car from behind after she braked abruptly due to a crossing deer. The bus driver had an alcohol level of 0.54 per mille.
A man attempted to lure a six-year-old girl into his car using sweets in Pinzgau on her way home from school.
During a driving safety training session, a 41-year-old instructor was injured after a trainee accidentally collided with him on a slippery training surface.
An 84-year-old driver collided with a train at a railway crossing, resulting in his death and serious injuries to his wife.
Car and motorcycle collided; motorcycle rider injured, taken to the hospital.

Attempted break-in into a shop in Wolfsberg using a tool to force a window, causing material damages.

A shoplifter in Vienna resisted arrest, threw a beer can at police, attempted to hit them, and behaved aggressively throughout the encounter.
A 20-year-old Slovak woman was arrested after stealing pants from a clothing rack and was found with additional stolen items in her backpack.

A barn containing firewood and a circular saw was destroyed by fire in Kroatisch Geresdorf; no injuries to people or animals, and the fire did not spread to nearby buildings.
A 39-year-old woman lost control of her vehicle on the B50, causing it to veer off the road, overturn, and land on its roof. She sustained injuries and was taken to the hospital.
A 56-year-old man in an intoxicated state threatened staff and others at a social institution in Klagenfurt, resisted arrest, and injured a police officer.

A 61-year-old man lost control of his car on the Gailtal Bundesstraße B111 near Emmersdorf, causing it to veer off the road. He was injured and transported to a hospital. The car was totaled, and the road was partially closed for recovery efforts.

An 87-year-old driver on the A2 near Klagenfurt drove in the wrong direction, causing another car to swerve and crash into a barrier. No injuries were reported. The driver was stopped and transported to the hospital due to health concerns.

A car driven by a 51-year-old Korean man veered into the opposite lane and collided head-on with another car, severely injuring an 86-year-old man and leaving his 84-year-old passenger critically injured in Schwechat.
A car accident occurred on Blätterstraße L 137, involving a truck, a car, and a runaway horse, resulting in injuries to drivers and the death of the horse.
A 78-year-old man fired a shotgun into the air for bird deterrence, unintentionally hitting a woman with falling pellets in Prottes, no injuries reported.
A car collided with a motorcycle in Plöcking, St. Martin im Mühlkreis, resulting in the motorcyclists death from injuries sustained during the accident.
A 31-year-old Ukrainian driver was arrested in Redlham for suspected human smuggling after transporting four Kurdish individuals without travel documents.
A car collided with a motorcycle at an intersection in Plöcking, injuring the motorcyclist who was airlifted to the hospital.
An accident occurred when a bus driver rear-ended a car, causing it to be pushed to the opposite lane. The car driver complained of neck and shoulder pain.
Unknown perpetrator set a trash can on fire in a restroom in Salzburg, causing damage to surrounding walls.
Two workers were injured by an electric shock when a hedge trimmer came into contact with a power line; one was severely injured and airlifted to a hospital.
A 41-year-old female hiker was rescued unharmed near Wildsee in the Seetaler Alps after losing her way in the dark and calling for help.
A 51-year-old man suffered a severe leg injury during a paragliding landing in Gaal, Austria, and was airlifted to the hospital.
Two individuals were injured during facade work when a worker fell from scaffolding onto a colleague.
An 82-year-old Swiss woman was found dead near Ehrwalder-Alm-Bahn after a suspected fall; she had been reported missing on September 30.
A 27-year-old motorcyclist crashed on the B189 in Nassereith, injuring himself and causing significant damage to his motorcycle.
Motorcyclist in Düns crashed and was injured while avoiding an oncoming car.
A 15-year-old girl on a moped swerved into a field to avoid a collision with a black car in Hard, sustaining injuries; the car fled the scene.
A 7-year-old boy was seriously injured after being hit by a car while crossing the street in Villach.
Cash and jewelry were stolen from a Swiss womans travel bag in a night train compartment from Zurich to Austria.
A collision occurred between two cars at an intersection; one person was injured and hospitalized.
An 81-year-old man from Steyr-Land was defrauded in a Bitcoin investment scam involving remote access and six-figure monetary transfers.
Three unknown perpetrators accessed a grocery store through the back entrance using a wrench, threatened two employees, and stole an unspecified amount of cash.
Football fans ignited pyrotechnics and displayed a banner; two men identified themselves as responsible and were charged under pyrotechnics law.
Driver evaded police stop, nearly hit an officer, was later apprehended without a valid driving license.
A construction worker discovered suspected war material during excavations, prompting police to secure the area and call in a bomb disposal team.
Fatal traffic accident involving a car colliding with a stationary truck, resulting in the death of the car driver despite immediate first aid efforts.
A 58-year-old man exhibited aggressive behavior and insulted people at a gas station in Spittal an der Drau, leading to his arrest after also causing a disturbance earlier at a hospital.
A drunken man in Klagenfurt became aggressive towards police after a dispute, resisted giving identification, and was arrested.
A stolen moped was discovered during a traffic check in Klagenfurt, Austria. The driver partially confessed, and the moped will be returned to its rightful owner.
A large fire broke out in the upper floor of a single-family house in Pöggstall, causing significant damage but no injuries.
A 19-year-old motorcyclist collided head-on with a car in Hofstetten-Grünau, resulting in her death and the car drivers hospitalization.
A 49-year-old man was injured in a construction site accident in Heiligenberg while dismantling a wall panel, which fell and pinned him underneath.
A man suffered severe leg injuries after getting caught in a rotating power take-off shaft on a farm in Munderfing.
A car and a train collided at an unguarded railroad crossing in Obertraun, causing severe injuries to the cars driver.

A car with four occupants went off the road on the B311 near Saalfelden, injuring one person with shoulder injuries while others remained unharmed. The driver, a probationary license holder, tested negative for alcohol.
A two-year-old boy died after a car rolled into a stream in Spital am Semmering; he was swept away by the current.
Two men were injured in a car accident involving an electric vehicle and a 15-meter fall into an unsecured construction site pit after consuming alcohol.
A fire broke out in a 55-year-old mans apartment in Bärnbach, Voitsberg; no injuries reported and technical defect suspected as cause.
A 20-year-old man in Matrei in Osttirol lost control of his car, veered off the road, and slid down a slope, sustaining injuries. An alcohol test revealed a significant level.
A tree fell on a 12-year-old girl due to strong winds; she was hospitalized with unspecified injuries.
A car accident occurred in Matrei in Osttirol where a 27-year-olds vehicle was hit by a 20-year-olds car, leading to injuries and a positive alcohol test for the male driver.
Glider made an emergency landing in a field due to weather and lack of thermals, no injuries.
A glider made an emergency landing in a field in Tirol due to strong winds; no injuries reported.
A heavily intoxicated 22-year-old driver caused a car accident on L82 in Bürserberg, resulting in injuries to a 20-year-old woman and significant vehicle damage.
Electric scooter rider hit by unidentified car in Lustenau, driver fled the scene.
An unknown person used a car without permission, causing extensive damage to the front and tires, and then returned it to its original location.
Burglars broke into a grocery store in Längenfeld, smashing a window, stealing cash from a safe, and attempting to disable the alarm system.
A 15-year-old moped rider was injured in a hit-and-run accident involving a dark SUV in Feldkirch, Austria.

Four suspects were arrested in Wr. Neustadt for suspected shoplifting; stolen clothing worth a mid-five-figure euro value was recovered.
Unknown individuals damaged a house and cars in Trebesing by pouring paint and wood stain on the property.
A 20-year-old driver crashed his truck while intoxicated, fled on foot, and was later apprehended near the scene.
A 25-year-old driver, under the influence of alcohol, lost control of his car, went off the road, and overturned in a field in Piberbach. The passenger sustained injuries and was taken to a hospital.
A 38-year-old Bosnian man was assaulted by two to three unknown perpetrators outside a bar in Attnang-Puchheim, sustaining unspecified injuries.
A van with nine Romanian occupants collided with a heavy vehicle near Haid junction, resulting in the van overturning and three passengers sustaining injuries.
A drunk driver caused a traffic accident in Bruck an der Glocknerstraße, damaging a street lamp and a bus stop.

A 58-year-old man fell from a ladder while painting inside a construction site and was injured; he was airlifted to the hospital.
A 72-year-old woman and her grandchildren were hit by a falling tree during a hike, resulting in the death of a 4-year-old girl and injuries to others.
A confrontation escalated involving threats with a knife, property damage, and an attempted break-in. Police found illegal weapons and arrested a 15-year-old after a vehicle search.

A 27-year-old woman driving under the influence lost control of her car, resulting in an accident where the vehicle overturned; the driver was mildly injured, and her brother sustained unspecified injuries requiring hospital treatment.

Head-on collision occurred on B154 near Mondsee involving multiple vehicles, resulting in critical and severe injuries to several individuals. Emergency services airlifted the injured to nearby hospitals.

A man deliberately hit another with his car in Salzburg Schallmoos, followed by a group assault and property damage involving a broken car window. All involved were arrested and charged.
A 57-year-old man lost control of his car on a wet road and sustained injuries; a breath alcohol test showed a positive result.
Police station temporarily closed in Graz after an officer tested positive for Covid-19.
A 39-year-old intoxicated driver collided with another car in Mitterndorf an der Raab, causing injuries to several individuals, who were transported to the hospital.
A 36-year-old woman lost control of her car on a wet road, causing it to veer off and overturn, resulting in serious injuries for her and minor injuries for her daughter.
A minor traffic collision occurred in Lienz involving a local womans car and an unidentified second vehicle whose driver did not stop after the incident.
A 54-year-old man fell off his e-scooter on uneven road in Innsbruck, suffering a serious shoulder injury.

Car collision involving multiple vehicles in Hard, injuries reported, all alcohol tests negative.
A 24-year-old driver lost control of his car due to excessive speed and crashed into a rock wall near the City-Tunnel entrance in Bregenz, Austria, resulting in injuries and a temporary road closure.
Two human smugglers arrested near the border for aiding illegal entry into Austria.
A 27-year-old man was found in his apartment in Villach with 505 grams of cannabis and several illegal weapons, including a stun gun and machete; he was charged under drug and weapons laws.

Excessive speeding by five drivers on the A2 in Baden district, with speeds up to 215 km/h in a 130 km/h zone, detected by traffic enforcement.

Family hospitalized with poisoning symptoms after exposure to fumes from an unknown cleaning substance used by a man offering facade cleaning services.

Collision between a car and a small truck led to the truck crashing into a tree, injuring the driver.
A worker fell while unloading a container and was flown to the hospital with injuries.
A German hiker was rescued by a police helicopter after being stranded due to snowfall and wind on the Großer Donnerkogel.
A 55-year-old cyclist collided with an open gate protruding onto a sidewalk, resulting in a left leg injury.

A 56-year-old car driver collided with a truck in Gralla, resulting in his death, and the truck driver remained uninjured.

A car skidded on a wet road in Jochberg, resulting in injuries to both the driver and passenger after the vehicle overturned.

Three-vehicle collision occurred in Nüziders involving a motorhome and two cars; one person injured and significant property damage reported.

Driver without license stopped for speeding while intoxicated on B153; vehicle and trailer seized due to multiple offenses.
Two excavator buckets were stolen from a construction site, with one having to be dismantled before being taken.
A driver under the influence of drugs was stopped after speeding at 209 km/h and committing multiple traffic violations on the S31 near Eisenstadt.
Three men robbed two vocational students in Hartberg, Austria; one victim suffered a concussion, and money was stolen.

A 68-year-old pedestrian was struck by a car while crossing a pedestrian path in Villach, resulting in injuries. The driver had right of way but failed to see the pedestrian. The incident occurred during heavy rain and poor visibility. The police are seeking witnesses.
A 25-year-old man attacked a 22-year-old man with a stone during a dispute in Leoben, causing severe head injuries.
A man in Kitzbühel was trapped by a falling glass plate in a rooftop apartment and had to be rescued by firefighters. He sustained serious leg injuries and was flown to a clinic.
A truck driver was briefly distracted and veered into a construction area on the S 1 in Schwechat, hitting a worker who sustained injuries and was transported to a hospital.
A motorcycle collided with a stationary tractor on B50 near Bernstein, injuring the rider who was airlifted to a hospital.
Police discovered a cannabis production operation and arrested two suspects in St. Veit an der Glan.
A 79-year-old pedestrian was hit and seriously injured by a reversing truck in Dellach im Gailtal. The truck driver was in shock, but an alcohol test was negative.
Car fire caused by a cable malfunction in an underground garage; no major damage reported.
A 93-year-old man from Spittal an der Drau was found drowned after a large-scale search operation involving multiple agencies; no foul play detected.
A collision occurred between a motorcycle and a car on the LB 9 in Wolfsthal; the motorcyclist was airlifted to the hospital with injuries.
Two truck drivers engaged in a physical and verbal altercation over right-of-way, resulting in one man threatening the other with a knife before being arrested.
A German citizen was found with 2250 grams of marijuana, indoor cultivation equipment, and was conducting online sales of CBD and seedlings, leading to a house search and legal charges.
Two men posing as police officers stopped a car in Marchtrenk and stole thousands of euros from a pair of brothers.
A 68-year-old man used pepper spray on a 28-year-old driver after a verbal altercation caused by honking. Police later found weapons on the suspect and issued a preliminary weapons ban.
A collision occurred between a car and a small truck on the A1-Tauernautobahn near Hüttau, with the car driver fleeing the scene and later found with a BAC of 1.72 promille.
A cyclist collided with a car at an intersection in Salzburg, resulting in serious injuries to the cyclist.
A cyclist was seriously injured in Graz after being rear-ended by a car.
A Slovene driver exceeded the speed limit by 94 km/h on the A2 highway and was stopped, had his license confiscated, and was fined.
A cyclist sustained severe injuries after being struck by a trucks side mirror and falling, requiring emergency airlift to LKH Graz.
A pedestrian was hit by a truck while crossing the street in Graz, resulting in severe injuries requiring surgery.
Unknown perpetrators broke into two childrens clothing stores in Seefeld, stealing clothing worth a mid-six-figure euro amount.
A car driven by a 21-year-old collided with an e-scooter ridden by a 48-year-old woman at an intersection in Innsbruck, resulting in the scooter rider being seriously injured.
Unknown suspect sprayed graffiti on various surfaces in Rum, causing minor damage.
Multi-vehicle accident on Lofererstraße involving a truck and a car, resulting in minor injury to a car driver and light vehicle damage.
Fire broke out in an abandoned buildings apartment; no injuries were reported.
Drunk driver with suspended license caught transporting a child without a safety restraint; vehicle had false plates and was not registered.
A car and an e-bike collided in Waidhofen an der Ybbs, causing the e-bike rider to sustain serious injuries.
Two 13-year-olds were identified for setting trash bins and a plant on fire and stealing bicycles in Klosterneuburg – Maria Gugging.
Two individuals suspected of stealing a blazer and a handbag worth €26,500 from stores in Vienna using distraction techniques.
A 64-year-old driver hit a 15-year-old pedestrian crossing at a crosswalk due to poor visibility in the rain. The pedestrian was injured and hospitalized, and the car sustained significant damage.
A 21-year-old man lost control of his car on the A2 near Wernberg, resulting in a rollover accident; he was injured, and the car was totaled.
A car veered off the road during an overtaking maneuver, resulting in an injury to the driver and vehicle damage.
A 61-year-old man drowned in a pond in Haslach an der Stiefing; his body was found by divers at night after a search by emergency services.

A 57-year-old Romanian woman was arrested in Vienna for her involvement in fraudulent activities and belonging to a criminal organization. She was sought on a European arrest warrant to serve a nine-year sentence in Romania.
Two teenagers caught damaging a car window to steal a built-in device; they also confessed to a bicycle theft and carried a questionable mobile phone.
A man was stabbed during an altercation at a birthday party; the suspect was arrested, and the victim is recovering.
A 64-year-old driver in Krensdorf lost control of his car, crashing into a fence and a wooden pole, resulting in injuries and the detection of alcohol consumption.
An elderly woman in Bad Ischl was targeted in a phone scam where a caller impersonated her niece and attempted to collect money, but no money was handed over as the woman became suspicious.
Two vehicles collided at an intersection on the Donau-Bundesstraße in Steyregg, causing significant damage and injuring both drivers.
A 17-year-old moped rider crashed in a curve, colliding with two cars, and was severely injured.
A 59-year-old man attacked a 48-year-old man with a knife during a heated argument in Leibnitz, with the suspect later arrested.
A 31-year-old man damaged his family homes entrance door and later the inventory of a police cell after being arrested.
A man threatened his ex-girlfriend, damaged her car, and resisted police arrest, injuring three officers.
A car caught fire on Kalser Landesstraße due to a technical defect; no injuries were reported.
A 62-year-old driver collided with an 81-year-old pedestrian at a crosswalk in Innsbruck, causing unspecified injuries to the pedestrian.
A 16-year-old girl fell on stairs at Innsbruck station and sustained injuries of unknown severity.
A 69-year-old man fell from a terrace roof while doing insulation work and sustained severe injuries.
An 18-year-old cyclist collided with a car and was injured in Aschau im Zillertal.
A 16-year-old girl in Hard fell and got injured when braking her moped to avoid a surprising stop by a blue car towing a trailer with gravel, which then left the scene without helping.

Frontal car collision involving a 20-year-old female driver with passengers and a 33-year-old male driver under the influence of alcohol on the Langeneggerstraße in Langenegg; three women injured, man uninjured. Vehicles heavily damaged.
A drug courier was arrested in Felberstraße, Vienna, with large quantities of narcotics including marijuana, cocaine, and ecstasy found in his possession.
A 68-year-old woman was tricked by a scammer into donating money, who then stole several hundred euros from her at a parking lot near a store.
A 41-year-old man in Klagenfurt was arrested for selling heroin in large quantities between July 2019 and July 2020, with drugs and related items seized during a house search.
A 38-year-old man was seriously injured in a head-on collision involving a van and a truck.
A 30-year-old man under the influence of alcohol crashed his car into a tree on Güterweg Fürling in Rohrbach-Berg and was injured.
Police responded to a burglary alarm in a shop in Vienna and apprehended a 20-year-old woman in possession of burglary tools and drugs.
A drunk driver caused a rear-end collision on Biberhaufenweg in Vienna, fled the scene, and was later apprehended at his residence. The other driver was injured and received medical care.
A 48-year-old driver lost control of his car, leading to the vehicle flipping over and landing upside down. The driver was injured and taken to the hospital.
Two women were lightly injured in a rear-end collision involving a truck and two cars on the B50 in Oberpullendorf.
A truck driver swerved to avoid an oncoming car, causing his vehicle to tip over an embankment. He sustained injuries of unspecified severity and sought medical treatment.
A man lost control of a tractor in alpine terrain, causing it to overturn down a slope, leaving him severely injured.
A 37-year-old Romanian man was arrested for six shoplifting incidents, including four in Herzogenburg and two in Krems, stealing items worth approximately 1,000 euros.
A 49-year-old motorcyclist from the Gänserndorf district fell on the road under unknown circumstances in Spannberg, sustaining severe injuries and was airlifted to the Meidling accident hospital.
A 58-year-old woman reported missing from a care facility in Gmunden was found unharmed by a passerby after an extensive search operation.
A woman and her grandchild in a stroller were hit by a van in Thalheim bei Wels, leaving both injured.
A 20-year-old woman caused a collision at a crossroads in Ansfelden, injuring a 63-year-old passenger who was taken to the hospital.
Five Afghan juveniles were discovered in a truck trailer in Sattledt and later applied for asylum.
A 64-year-old motorcyclist was severely injured in a collision with a van exiting a driveway onto the L503 road in Oberkriebach. He was airlifted to a hospital in Salzburg.
A motorcyclist swerved to avoid a car, hit a guardrail, and was slightly injured; the car fled the scene.
A woman from Germany was injured and two cars were damaged in a rear-end collision caused by stop-and-go traffic due to construction work in St. Johann.
A 29-year-old man sent an email threatening police officers in Graz with harm; he was identified, confronted, and is not confessing to the crime.

A man in Deutschlandsberg, known for prior offenses, was arrested following dangerous threats and resistance against law enforcement. He threatened guests with a knife in a bar, fled, and was later apprehended by police.
A car collided with a minibus in Sankt Ruprecht an der Raab, causing minor injuries to an 88-year-old driver.

A 7-year-old boy was hit by a car while running out of a waiting house on the Sankt Martiner Landesstraße, sustaining a serious leg injury. He was airlifted to Graz for treatment. The driver, a 19-year-old woman, tested negative for alcohol.
Counterfeit documents were seized from a 21-year-old Albanian man during a person check on an international train.
Two men defrauded a cashier in a betting shop in Innsbruck out of several hundred euros by confusing her during a currency exchange.
A 62-year-old German man stumbled near Trainsjoch peak in Thiersee, sustaining a serious shoulder injury and was airlifted to a hospital after calling for help.
A car driven by a 19-year-old collided with a motorcycle ridden by a 36-year-old in Innsbruck, causing injuries to the motorcyclist and significant vehicle damage.
A cyclist in Innsbruck collided with a stationary car, sustaining severe facial and hand injuries.
A 60-year-old driver lost control of his car on the L90 road near Buchboden, causing the vehicle to crash and sustain heavy damage. No injuries were reported, and the driver was located later.
A 76-year-old cyclist fell off the road into a ditch and suffered fatal head injuries.
A collision occurred between a moped driver and an e-bike rider at a junction in Nüziders, resulting in severe injuries to the e-bike rider and damage to both vehicles.

Two cleaning company employees in Vienna were apprehended for theft after being captured on surveillance cameras committing multiple crimes, using access keys provided by the companies they worked for.

A 24-year-old operating a self-driving sugar beet harvester in Mannsdorf/Donau accidentally struck a power line, received an electric shock, and was rescued by farmers before being airlifted to a hospital.
A 50-year-old car driver fatally collided with a pedestrian in Reithtal, Bezirk Liezen, resulting in the pedestrians death despite resuscitation efforts.
Two individuals were arrested in Donaustadt for shoplifting various items, including clothing, wallets, and spirits, from multiple stores within a shopping center.
A 63-year-old man attacked a 55-year-old man with a knife in a residential area, causing injuries; the suspect was arrested and the weapon secured.

Two Lithuanian nationals were apprehended for suspected theft in Viennas Liesing district as they loaded high-end bicycles into a vehicle. A prohibited weapon shaped like a credit card was also seized.
A hazardous materials transport vehicle with explosive cargo was found to have severe technical deficiencies and taken out of operation.
A 49-year-old man drove a truck under heavy alcohol influence, collided with a tree, and fell down a slope in Albeck. He sustained injuries and was hospitalized.
A car accident occurred in Klagenfurt when an 18-year-old driver collided with the rear of a 54-year-olds vehicle, causing injuries and significant damage to both cars.
A 77-year-old man caused a multi-vehicle accident on the A2 Südautobahn near Vienna due to brake failure, injuring seven people and resulting in a total road closure.

A 21-year-old and an unidentified attacker assaulted a 23-year-old in a bar in the Linzer Altstadt, stole his phone, lured him outside, attacked him again near Tummelplatz, and fled with the phone towards the city center.
A 14-year-old boy was threatened and assaulted by several youths at Linz train station; he was later robbed by another member of the group days before.
A 45-year-old woman fell off her e-bike in a curve and was injured, requiring transportation to the hospital by helicopter.
A motorcycle accident in Wintersdorf left a 65-year-old passenger seriously injured after the driver lost control while turning.
A 15-year-old was injured in a fight involving multiple teenagers in Zell am See; two 16-year-olds attacked and threatened him before fleeing on a moped.
Two men shot at beer cans with a CO2 pistol in a bus stop area; one was found with drugs and had a weapons ban, and the other received a provisional weapons ban.
A garden hut caught fire in Tauplitz; no injuries reported, significant property damage caused by a probable electrical fault.
A 7-year-old girl was injured in a collision between a small truck and a car on B 78 in Weißkirchen in Steiermark.
A 66-year-old man was injured in a vineyard accident in Klöch while operating a tractor.
A 26-year-old Iraqi man was punched in the face by an unknown assailant at Südtirolerplatz in Innsbruck, who then fled the scene.
Motorcyclist injured in a road accident after an evasive maneuver to prevent collision with a car in Obsteig.
An Italian motorcyclist lost control, hit a guardrail, and fell off the road, sustaining injuries.
A 22-year-old driver collided with a car on the L204 in Lustenau, causing vehicle damage and an oil spill. No injuries were reported.
A 72-year-old woman slipped on a wet playground area in Brand, sustaining injuries and was airlifted to a hospital.
A 20-year-old Syrian man was arrested for suspected human smuggling after being found driving a car with seven migrants, one hidden in the trunk, in Vienna.
A 63-year-old man on an electric wheelchair fell off the road in Kramsach and sustained serious injuries before being rescued and hospitalized.
A 16-year-old girl went missing from a youth shelter in Bregenz, Austria.
A locked basement compartment in Kundl was broken into and a mountain bike with a bike computer was stolen.
A 16-year-old girl went missing from a SOS Childrens Village in Bregenz.
A 14-year-old was assaulted and threatened by several youths at Linz Hauptbahnhof, involving physical attacks and a robbery over new shoes.
An 81-year-old man collapsed during a walk in Vienna, and he was saved by quick actions from two bystanders and police officers who administered CPR and used a defibrillator.
A driver fled from a traffic stop in Wolfsberg, resulting in a high-speed chase; the driver was intoxicated and unlicensed.
A 39-year-old man assaulted a 61-year-old man due to a dispute over a local ban; another individual joined the attack, causing injuries and issuing threats.
A car caught fire completely in Helfenberg, but the driver and her daughter escaped unharmed.
Traffic inspections in Salzburg led to multiple violations, including overloaded vehicles, removed catalytic converters, and unlicensed driving.
A 55-year-old man threatened another man with a knife during a parking dispute in Kudlichgasse, Vienna, leading to his arrest.
Police intervened in a brawl in Klagenfurt am Wörthersee, apprehending two young suspects who were found with weapons and drugs after a short pursuit.
A tractor and a car collided on Lippitzbacher Landesstraße 80a, causing the car to overturn and resulting in injuries to four people.
A 21-year-old man and a 23-year-old woman collided in Villach, resulting in minor injuries for the woman.
A 34-year-old man in Villach injured himself in a traffic accident while driving under the influence of alcohol; his license was temporarily revoked.
Car accident occurred on Landesstraße 1012; three people were injured and the vehicle suffered significant damage.
A 28-year-old motorcyclist died after losing control and crashing on a curve in Bad Vöslau, Austria.
A cyclist in Scheiblingkirchen lost control during a downhill ride and hit a tree, sustaining serious injuries and requiring helicopter transport to a hospital.
A heavily intoxicated man broke a cars rear window and stole an item in Linz before being apprehended by police.
A drunk wrong-way driver on a highway was stopped by police near Enns without causing any collisions and was found with a blood alcohol level of 1.52‰.
Multiple drivers in Linz-Land were stopped and found unfit to drive due to drug influence, alcohol intoxication, reckless driving, and overfatigue; licenses were confiscated.
Car accident in Hofing, Grieskirchen district; driver lost control, hit a tree, and both occupants were trapped and injured.
A pickup truck with a trailer crashed on a hillside in Hüttschlag, injuring the driver and passenger; the driver was found to be intoxicated.
A fire on a camping site destroyed two caravans, seriously injuring an 80-year-old man who was rescued just in time by a bystander.
A 19-year-old man was assaulted outside a bar in Radstadt by a 17-year-old suspect, who fled but was later identified and apprehended along with an accomplice.
A car got stuck on railway tracks at Tischlerhäusl crossing in Zell am See; the driver had a blood alcohol level of 2.3 ppm and lacked a valid driving license.
A 43-year-old man was seriously injured by a falling branch during forestry work and was airlifted to a hospital.
A heavily intoxicated man resisted police enforcement and injured an officer in Gratkorn after being asked to wear his mask properly.
A 15-year-old moped rider was seriously injured in a head-on collision with a forage harvester in Wettmannstätten, Austria, and airlifted to a hospital.
A 28-year-old motorcyclist was severely injured in Gamlitz after losing control and crashing due to excessive speed during an overtaking maneuver.
A 57-year-old Austrian man went missing during a ski tour to the Großvenediger summit, prompting a search operation that has not yet been successful.
Car with five occupants overturned and fell 80 meters down a steep slope in Fügenberg. Two were seriously injured, others sustained unspecified injuries. Driver tested positive for alcohol.
A car with 11 passengers rolled off a forest road in Niederau, causing one serious and several other injuries.

A 60-year-old Austrian man fell into a combine harvester while working and was injured, requiring helicopter transport to a hospital.
A tractor with an agricultural trailer caused a head-on collision with a car on a downhill curve in Egg, Austria, causing injuries to two car occupants and significant vehicle damage.
A 59-year-old man went missing from Klinikum Klagenfurt and has not returned to his room; a search is ongoing.
Unidentified perpetrators broke into a restaurant in Wattens, stealing cash, electronic devices, and alcoholic beverages.
Unknown individuals broke into three basement compartments of an apartment building in Maishofen and stole a bicycle.
A vibratory plate worth several thousand euros was stolen from a construction site in Neumarkt, Köstendorferstraße, possibly using a red-and-white Hoftrac loader.
A 64-year-old cyclist involved in a hit-and-run accident causing personal injury in Bezirk Neunkirchen was identified and will be prosecuted.
A locked bicycle was stolen from Felixdorf train station by three individuals.
Austrian police arrested a 39-year-old man for resisting police and causing serious injury to officers in a physical altercation at Rabensteig, Vienna.
A traffic accident occurred where a collision between two cars caused a trash can to strike and injure a pedestrian.

A 53-year-old Ukrainian driver was driving the wrong way on A 23 in 10th district, Vienna. He was stopped by police and found to have a blood alcohol level of 2.16 promille, creating a life-threatening situation for other road users.
A fight broke out at an asylum facility involving intoxicated residents; no knives were involved but two men were injured by broken glass.
A drunk driver in Schärding drove over a construction trench, injuring his passenger and losing his license.
A car was damaged by an unknown perpetrator who slashed tires and scratched the paint.
Collision between two cars on the Seeberg B82 road caused injuries and significant vehicle damage; alcohol tests for drivers were negative.
A 63-year-old man from Hungary was injured after losing control of his car, hitting a tree, and overturning on the A 21 in Heiligenkreuz, Lower Austria.

Two separate alcohol-related car accidents occurred in Otterthal, Bezirk Neunkirchen, involving a 28-year-old woman and a 34-year-old man; both drivers were under influence and were reported to authorities.
A highly intoxicated driver caused a traffic accident by hitting a traffic sign, continued driving, and was later found by police at his home with his damaged vehicle.
A 10-year-old cyclist collided with a car while crossing the road and was injured, requiring transport to a hospital.
A rear-end collision involving two vehicles occurred on a rainy road in Salzburg, causing injuries to two passengers and significant vehicle damage.
Two individuals in Graz resisted police intervention, assaulted officers, were arrested, and found with drugs, cultivation equipment, and a prohibited weapon.
Police station in Graz temporarily closed due to a positive Covid-19 test of a policewoman, with safety measures and disinfection in place.

An Austrian man accidentally caused a fire at his bar in Axams due to malfunctioning heaters under a canopy. The fire was quickly controlled by firefighters, resulting in material damage but no injuries.

A 38-year-old moped rider threatened a 27-year-old car driver with a firearm during a traffic altercation in Vienna. Police later arrested him at his residence and seized various weapons.
A man was caught and arrested after breaking a stores display window with kicks in Vienna.
A car caught fire on the S 36 highway in Sankt Stefan ob Leoben; firefighters extinguished the fire, and no one was injured.
A delivery driver struck a pedestrian with his truck, injuring her, while entering a supermarket parking lot.
A car caught fire in Kufstein, and police and firefighters managed to extinguish it without any injuries or damage to the house.
A 23-year-old man was caught shoplifting in a store and is suspected of committing multiple thefts within a short period. He was detained but later released pending further investigation.
A man and a woman attempted a shoplifting in a grocery store in Vienna. They assaulted an employee who tried to stop them before fleeing. Both suspects were later apprehended by the police.
A 76-year-old driver collided head-on with a truck on the B 100 road in Neu-Feffernitz, resulting in injuries and severe vehicle damage.
A 56-year-old woman from Vienna lost control of her car on the S37, veered off the road, and was injured. Emergency services cleared the area.
A heavily intoxicated 26-year-old man damaged four police vehicles by smashing windshields and breaking side mirrors at the Sicherheitsakademie in Ybbs an der Donau.
A head-on collision occurred on L 68 in Zwettl between a 21-year-old and a 51-year-old driver, resulting in the 21-year-olds death and severe injuries to the 51-year-old.
A car collided with a small truck after losing control, injuring the driver and causing minor injuries to the truck driver.
25-year-old driver was caught speeding excessively in Frankenburg and surrounding areas, facing multiple traffic violations.
A 41-year-old man in Ansfelden crashed his car after allegedly avoiding a hare, resulting in multiple rollovers. He was injured, found to be intoxicated with 1.34‰, and had a revoked drivers license.
A 55-year-old driver swerved to avoid a hare, lost control of his car, and crashed into a tree, sustaining injuries.
A 25-year-old woman lost control of her car on a wet road in Vöcklabruck, went off the road, overturned, and hit a tree. She sustained injuries and was taken to a hospital.
A 22-year-old man was injured in a collision involving a car and a truck on the A1 near Eggendorf, requiring helicopter transport to the hospital.
A 16-year-old and her 23-year-old brother reported being threatened over the phone by their 53-year-old father in Hallein.
A car collision occurred in Saalfelden, involving a stationary car hit by another car; one person injured, both cars totaled.
A man accidentally caused a fire in his homes sauna after leaving a bucket on the heater, leading to significant damage.
A 36-year-old man was injured when a grapple attachment slipped and trapped his foot during excavation work in Hüttau.
A car collision occurred at an intersection in Salzburg; one passenger sustained a minor knee injury.
Two male thieves entered an unlocked house in Pöls, stole cash, and fled in a car with foreign license plates.
A 27-year-old Slovenian man allegedly injured and threatened his 21-year-old wife with a knife during a domestic dispute in Graz. Police arrested the man.
A fire broke out in the attic of a single-family home during kitchen renovation work; no injuries were reported.
A 19-year-old man stole the handbag of a 16-year-old girl in Graz and was hit by a car during his escape attempt; he was caught by bystanders and handed over to the police.
A fire broke out at the facade of a single-family house in Telfs; no injuries reported, cause under investigation.
A 28-year-old driver collided with a vehicle on the Inntalautobahn in Pettnau, causing injuries to both drivers. The driver was found to be heavily intoxicated.
Police stopped a 23-year-old driver for excessive speeding at 155 km/h in a 50 km/h zone and discovered he had evaded previous officers.
A car driven by an 18-year-old collided with a guardrail and a bridge railing in Jenbach, injuring the driver and a 16-year-old passenger.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a basement compartment in Wörgl and stole two e-bikes.
Car accident during an alleged illegal car race on the A14 motorway in Vorarlberg, leaving two injured and causing total damage to one vehicle.
A truck collided with a herd of cattle in Wolfurt, resulting in damage to the vehicle and the loss of three animals.
Two Romanian nationals were caught shoplifting in Gleisdorf. Further investigations connected them to additional thefts and burglaries in another store. They confessed and were detained.
Three unknown male suspects stole 18 mobile phones from an unlocked glass cabinet in a shopping park in Innsbruck.
A cow escaped a butcher shop, injured a worker, ran into a car causing damage, and was later euthanized.
A 22-year-old man was robbed in Graz by an unknown assailant who threatened him with a knife, took cash, and snatched a bag containing medications and toilet paper, slightly injuring the victim.
Two young men stole a car, drove extensively without paying for fuel, caused a fire hazard, attempted other thefts, and committed drug-related offenses.
A man broke a car window to search for valuables and was apprehended by police while still in the vehicle.
A truck loaded with gravel fell 30 meters down a slope in Reichraming after the driver reversed too far; the driver sustained injuries but managed to seek help.
A fire broke out in a single-family house in Götzens; the residents escaped safely, but a dog died and significant damage occurred.

Police conducted a traffic and crime safety patrol in Vienna, issuing 30 charges and 25 fines. They intercepted an intoxicated driver without a license and five drug-impaired drivers, leading to license revocations and citations.
A 53-year-old intoxicated man was arrested in Leopoldstadt, Vienna after threatening to burn down a restaurant and injuring the owners wife during an altercation involving a steak knife.
Intoxicated driver drove onto train tracks, halting train traffic; no injuries reported.
A man in Baden, Austria became aggressive with a doctor and threatened a police officer with a knife, leading to his arrest by special forces without injuries.
A man in a park in Traun was attacked and robbed by two individuals who hit him with his umbrella and stole cash from his wallet.

Multiple garbage bins and containers were set on fire in Linz; suspects, believed to be three young males, were seen fleeing the scene. Firefighters extinguished the fires, which caused some property damage.
A 53-year-old woman overturned her car in an alcohol-related accident, suffering minor injuries.

A 57-year-old man involved in a traffic accident in Ansfelden became aggressive towards police and others after being found to have a blood alcohol level of 1.72 per mille. He was temporarily detained after repeated attempts to calm him failed.
A fire broke out in an outbuilding of a gardening shop in Straßwalchen, causing light smoke inhalation injuries to two employees.
A 48-year-old man was injured during forestry work on Ochsenberg when a tree trunk swung and hit him.
Rockfall in Reith im Alpbachtal caused damage to a house and evacuation of nearby homes; no injuries reported.
Electronic, mechanical, and hydraulic parts from five tractors were stolen from a business premises in Bezirk Neusiedl am See.
Unknown individuals threw paint bags at the facade of a police station under construction in Dornbirn, causing damage.
A 39-year-old man admitted to setting fire to an apartment in Innsbruck, which was extinguished without injuries but caused property damage.
A 10-year-old boy in Hermagor had a self-caused bike accident resulting in head injuries after a bag hanging on the handlebar got stuck in the front wheel.
A 17-year-old moped rider collided with a car when the latter attempted a left turn; both individuals were taken to the hospital.
A 50-year-old Liberian man was caught and arrested by police while selling drugs on the street. Numerous drug pellets and €1,285 in cash were seized.
A long-time fugitive suspected of embezzling nine million Euros was arrested by law enforcement in Vienna.
Two individuals were injured in a rear-end collision on the B57 in Ollersdorf; both were hospitalized with unspecified injuries and the road was temporarily difficult to pass.
A 29-year-old woman from Klagenfurt died after her car collided with a crash attenuator on the A2 highway near Pörtschach Ost, becoming trapped in the vehicle.
A 56-year-old man caused a multi-car collision on Ossiacher Straße; one person was injured and three vehicles were significantly damaged.
A car accident occurred involving two vehicles; multiple people were injured and taken to the hospital, and both vehicles were totaled.
A car accident occurred in Amstetten, involving two vehicles. Three people, including a 19-month-old child, sustained severe injuries due to a hydraulic oil spill on the road.
Two drivers were caught speeding at 114 km/h and 112 km/h in a 50 km/h zone during traffic checks in Wels.
A car accident occurred involving a collision between three vehicles, leaving several individuals with undetermined injuries and requiring one person to be rescued from their car by firefighters.
A car hit a pedestrian who unexpectedly entered the road; the pedestrian was injured and admitted to the hospital.
A car collision occurred when a driver turned left, injuring one person who was hospitalized.
Worker injured by a circular saw during container reconstruction; coworker operating the saw was under influence of alcohol.
A 53-year-old driver collided with a 75-year-old pedestrian, causing serious leg injuries to the pedestrian in Hartberg, Austria.
A truck transporting sand tipped over on the L657 road due to unstable ground while reversing; no injuries were reported.
A 17-year-old Austrian woman lost control of her car on a curve, went off the road, and fell down an embankment, sustaining injuries and causing total damage to the vehicle.
A 45-year-old Austrian man crashed his car into a tree near Mötz, sustaining serious injuries.
An 80-year-old driver hit a 51-year-old pedestrian at a crosswalk in Innsbruck, causing injuries of undetermined degree.
A 31-year-old worker fell 2.5 to 3 meters from a roof in Seefeld in Tirol, sustaining severe injuries. He was airlifted to a hospital in Innsbruck.
A pedestrian was hit and severely injured by a car at Neubaugürtel in Vienna, requiring emergency medical treatment.
An elderly couple in Ebensee was distracted with gardening when a woman entered their home and stole cash from a wallet.

Three unidentified suspects robbed two men, displaying a pistol and stealing Air Pods, cash, and cigarettes.

A 26-year-old woman and her 36-year-old boyfriend from Klagenfurt are suspected of selling heroin and cannabis to at least 20 buyers between 2018 and 2020 to support their substance addiction and livelihood.
A man was followed by three youths after leaving a gas station in Linz. He was assaulted and robbed of his wallet and phone.
An 82-year-old driving the wrong way on the A9 highway caused a collision involving several vehicles; no injuries were reported, but significant vehicle damage occurred.
A man was robbed on the Grenobler Bridge in Innsbruck, with the suspect stealing his wallet and phone before fleeing.
A 16-year-old girl named Barbara Bösch, previously reported missing, returned to her SOS Childrens Village residence independently.
Police arrested three Algerian men suspected of attempting to break into an apartment in Vienna, one of whom was armed with a knife.
A 19-year-old woman swerved her car to avoid wildlife, causing it to overturn; she and her two passengers sustained minor injuries.
A car collision on a wet road in Grafenstein injured three people, causing significant damage to both vehicles.
A man was assaulted and robbed by three teenagers in Linz after a brief interaction at a gas station.
A 6-year-old boy was injured after being hit by a van while crossing the road in Natternbach. He was airlifted to the hospital with unspecified injuries.
A smoldering fire caused by an overheated chimney pipe in a residential house; no injuries reported.
A 68-year-old man was severely injured in a workplace accident while assisting with carpentry work on a roof.
Two cars collided at an intersection, injuring a 23-year-old woman lightly and a 64-year-old man seriously.
A 61-year-old man fell 3.5 meters into a basement shaft during construction work in Erl, Tirol, sustaining back injuries and was rescued and hospitalized.
A car lost control due to brake failure, crashed into a barrier, hit another car, and a streetlight, causing injuries and vehicle damage.
A Nigerian man was arrested for illegal entry into Austria and resisted police violently, injuring two officers.
A Turkish truck with serious technical defects was stopped and removed from traffic in Vorarlberg, Austria. The driver also violated driving and rest period regulations.
Burglars broke into two construction containers in Graz and stole tools and cash worth several thousand euros.
A 25-year-old man from Linz injured another man by repeatedly kicking his leg after an argument; was later arrested with a small amount of cannabis.

Police arrested a 15-year-old suspect on suspicion of bicycle theft after a witness reported seeing three individuals breaking a bicycle lock and fleeing. One suspect was caught after a pursuit; another escaped.
Two Slovak nationals, aged 22 and 32, were caught in the act of breaking into a building in Linz and were arrested with the help of a police dog.
A man attempting a U-turn collided with a womans car, causing her vehicle to go off the road and into a slope; she was injured and hospitalized.
A car collided with a bus in Bichlbach-Au, causing injuries to the car driver and one bus passenger. The bus driver was uninjured, and the vehicles sustained significant damage.
Police arrested a 33-year-old Polish man under an EU arrest warrant for several financial crimes, including tax fraud, during routine checks at a highway rest area.
Significant speeding offenses were recorded on the A22 motorway in Vienna; a car was measured at 157 km/h in an 80 km/h zone.
Police conducted a traffic enforcement operation targeting alcohol, drug impairment, and speeding, resulting in multiple violations and licenses being confiscated.
Police in Villach conducted a house search and found various drugs and equipment for drug production, leading to the arrest of a 26-year-old suspect.
A 21-year-old without a license attempted to flee police on the B3 near Mauthausen, resulting in a dangerous car chase; he was later stopped and tested positive for drugs.
Car overturned on A8 highway in Upper Austria, injuring a couple who were transported to hospital.
A mother and her two children were injured in a car accident at the Güterweg Hasibeder in Eggerding.
A 54-year-old man was caught driving at 151 km/h in a 100 km/h zone on the B96 road near Tamsweg, overtaking a police car during a no-overtaking stretch.
A Slovak man wanted for property crimes was arrested during a routine traffic check in Zell am See.

A truck driver was stopped in Mühldorf bei Feldbach for violating rest and driving times, and found to have a blood alcohol level of around one promille. His driving license was provisionally revoked, and further driving was prohibited.
A parked car caught fire in Liezen, Austria; no injuries were reported, and the fire was extinguished by firefighters.
A car collided with a tractor in Inzing, causing the tractor to overturn; the driver of the tractor was injured while the car driver, found to be under the influence of alcohol, remained unharmed.
36-year-old driver hit a 15-year-old pedestrian crossing the street in Innsbruck, causing injury; the pedestrian fled but later sought medical treatment.
A German man caused a disturbance in a Kufstein bank, threatening a robbery after being denied the opening of an account and was later detained and hospitalized under mental health regulations.
Hydraulic fluid leaked from a sweeper, causing road contamination over several kilometers. Local fire departments cleaned the affected roads.
A driver committed several traffic violations, including speeding and overtaking illegally, before being stopped by police due to traffic congestion.
A 70-year-old man disposed of stove ash near a building wall, which ignited and caused a smoldering fire that damaged a garage facade and window. Fire was extinguished without injuries.
A 19-year-old driver evaded a police traffic check in Lendorf, lost control of the vehicle, crashed, and tested positive for alcohol.
A Romanian truck lost control, hitting a concrete barrier on the A1 highway near Enns, spilling cargo and causing significant vehicle damage, but no injuries.
A 17-year-old seasonal worker was seriously injured while using a wood splitter, injuring his right index finger. No third-party fault is suspected.
A powder mill caught fire in a company building in Bludenz; no injuries were reported as the fire was extinguished by the companys firefighting team.
Two pedestrians were hit by a car on a crosswalk and sustained minor injuries.
Car driver was heavily injured after speeding and losing control, crashing into objects, and flipping the vehicle. Alcohol was involved.
A man attacked his ex-partner with a knife in a car, causing severe injuries. He later surrendered to the police and was arrested.
A high-value mountain bike was stolen from a bike rack in Klagenfurt.
A 27-year-old man lost control of his car on the Packer Bundesstraße in Bad St. Leonhard, overturned, hit a guardrail, and ended up on the roof; he suffered unspecified injuries and was hospitalized.

A three-car collision on LH 5 near Leopoldsorf/Marchfeld caused severe injuries to a 28-year-old male driver, with others sustaining minor injuries.
A man without a license and heavily intoxicated drove another persons car causing damage before being stopped by police.
A truck driver in Traun with a blood alcohol level of 1.52‰ was stopped by police after admitting to an accident and showing signs of intoxication.
A 23-year-old driver under the influence of alcohol lost control of his car in Ebensee, crashing into road structures, overturning, and colliding with a tree.
37-year-old driver in Linz-Land displayed signs of intoxication with 1.92 promille BAC; was stopped by police, and his driving privileges were already revoked.
A 58-year-old man was fatally injured after being pinned under a truck while changing its tire in Redlham.
A 15-year-old attempted to enter a closed restaurant in Salzburg, leading to a physical altercation with a 47-year-old who used pepper spray in self-defense; minor injuries reported.
A driver with a blood alcohol content of 1.94 promille was stopped by police in Lofer, had his license confiscated, and will be reported to the authorities.
A 19-year-old man was found in possession of cannabis intended for sale, along with money from drug sales.
Police began monitoring the Covid-19 quarantine zone in Kuchl at midnight on October 17, controlling access points and ensuring compliance with regulations.
A 30-year-old Hungarian suspect stole a locked bicycle from outside an inn in Bad Loipersdorf; the bike, lock, and suspect were identified and recovered after a police operation.
A 28-year-old woman crashed her car into a tree while avoiding an oncoming vehicle allegedly speeding; she sustained severe injuries, while her child was unharmed.
Collision between two cars in Poellau, causing injuries and total damage to vehicles.
A 22-year-old woman collided with a truck on the B66 road in Straden, sustaining injuries of undetermined severity. The truck driver was unharmed, and the car was totaled.
A German driver caused a side collision with an Austrian vehicle on a sharp curve; two people were injured and taken to the hospital, while others remained unharmed.
A car was set on fire at a dealership in Telfs, causing significant damage and affecting another vehicle.
A 64-year-old Austrian man drove off the road in Schwendt and crashed down a slope; he was rescued and hospitalized with injuries.
A car accident occurred in Alberschwende when a driver veered off the road, hitting a wall and parked car before rolling down an embankment and landing in a field. The driver was seriously injured.

A 23-year-old man caused a kitchen fire in his apartment while intoxicated, leading to the evacuation of seven residents; no major injuries occurred.

Gas explosion at a temporary school in Dornbirn resulted in injuries, significant property damage, and evacuation of nearby buildings; fire and emergency services responded promptly.
Police dissolved a gathering of about 70 people in a restaurant cellar in Vienna due to violations of COVID-19 regulations.
Two men attempted to break into the apartment of ones ex-girlfriend but were detained by police.
A 13-year-old boy from Germany suffered a severe leg injury during a motocross training session in Fresach, Austria, when he lost control of his bike while attempting a jump.
A truck driver crashed into a pigsty building in Mettmach, causing structural damage and sustaining injuries; no animals were harmed.

A heavily intoxicated Czech truck driver was reported to the police after exhibiting unsteady behavior; he refused an alcohol test and had his vehicle keys and license temporarily confiscated.

A man was caught speeding at 143 km/h in a 70 km/h zone and will be reported.

A 15-year-old pedestrian was slightly injured in a collision with a car in Seekirchen am Wallersee.
Car rollover caused by a 23-year-old driver with 1.3 per mille alcohol, suffering minor injuries; the driver lacked a valid license and will be reported.
Kitchen fire in Graz caused by overheated oil; two people injured.

A 64-year-old cyclist crashed on a rural road, resulting in serious leg injuries.
Car accident in Telfs, Austria: Driver under drug influence lost control, but escaped with injuries.

Avalanche triggered by skier in Stubaier Alpen; no one was buried or injured; search operation was conducted and concluded with no missing persons.

A man broke into two cars in Innsbruck and threatened a car owner; he was later arrested by the police.
Public toilet in Hard vandalized with broken glass, graffiti, and toilet paper damage.

Three Plexiglas lighting elements at the Nenzing roundabout were damaged by unknown perpetrators.
A house fire in Rabensburg caused by overheating or technical failure of a hairdryer resulted in significant property damage, but no injuries.

A group of five youths initiated arson at a construction site at the Fachhochschule in St. Pölten, causing severe damage to the facade and affecting two companies with losses amounting to 920,000 euros.
Worker injured hand during maintenance at a cable car in Bad Kleinkirchheim and was transported to hospital by helicopter.
Altercation between multiple residents in a care facility in Villach due to a misunderstanding involving a woman, resulting in minor injuries.
A bank robbery occurred in Vienna-Floridsdorf where two suspects threatened a bank employee with a gun and stole cash. Later, four suspects were arrested by police.

A 20-year-old man in Vienna threatened a passerby with a gas pistol in an aggressive manner; he was arrested after attempting to dispose of the weapon. The suspect was intoxicated with a 1.6 promille alcohol level.
A fatal car accident occurred in Moosbrunn, involving a head-on collision; one person died, and two others were injured.
Search initiated for a missing man in Braunau, involving police, a helicopter, and firefighters.
A 55-year-old man got his foot trapped under a truck while inspecting a brake issue; he was seriously injured.
A man was bitten by a Staffordshire Terrier during an altercation, resulting in injuries to his head and arm before the dogs owner fled.
A car collided with a passenger train at a railway crossing in Sattledt, causing injuries to four car occupants while train passengers remained unharmed.
A 23-year-old woman caused a rear-end collision with a 60-year-old woman, who was injured and taken to the hospital in Steyr.

Car collided with a cyclist in Bürmoos, causing injuries to the cyclists hip.

An elderly man was tricked into a conversation and robbed in front of a doctors office by a woman pretending to collect donations.

A collision occurred in Weißenbach when a truck and a car collided during a turning maneuver, resulting in the car overturning and the driver sustaining injuries.

Unknown individuals damaged the glass entrance door of the Bezirkshauptmannschaft Südoststeiermark in Feldbach by throwing pebbles at it.
Unknown perpetrators set fire to wooden pallets and cardboard at a construction site of a public building in St. Pölten, causing significant damage.
Police attempted to stop a known offender, who fled in his car, injuring an officer and endangering pedestrians; the suspect remains at large.
A worker in Bleiburg reversed his car, hitting a colleague and causing her a leg fracture.
A 28-year-old woman lost control of her car on Friesacher Straße and collided with a guardrail, causing her car to be totaled and resulting in injuries that required hospital treatment.

Two 14-year-old students in Linz were hit by a car and severely injured while crossing the street behind a bus; the collision also involved a second parked car.
A cyclist collided with the windshield of a car after making a wide turn onto the wrong lane, resulting in injuries.
A 58-year-old man was injured while using a circular saw, accidentally contacting the blade; he was airlifted to the hospital.
Kitchen caught fire during cooking; no injuries.
Collision between a car and a motor scooter in Graz resulted in both drivers being injured.
An acetylene gas cylinder began smoking at a construction site in Hohenems and was shot by authorities to prevent further danger before being extinguished by firefighters.
A car collided with a stationary waste collection truck, injuring one worker who was trapped between the vehicles.
A man attempted to steal clothing in Graz, was caught by store detectives, and injured one of them during his attempt to escape.
Turkish bus drivers violated driving and rest time regulations during a trip from Istanbul to Dortmund; continued travel was prohibited.
German van caught speeding at 159 km/h in a 70 km/h zone, potential license revocation.

A 54-year-old man allegedly threatened an ÖBB security staff member with a knife after being asked to leave a train station platform. Police arrested the suspect and secured the knife with no injuries reported.
A 48-year-old motorcyclist fatally crashed into a tree after veering off the road on L 148 in Wr. Neustadt-Land.
Concrete spilled from a truck onto a road, causing damages to numerous vehicles and disrupting traffic.

An intoxicated driver was stopped on the A9 highway driving in the wrong direction with a light vehicle; no injuries reported. The driver was found to have a blood alcohol level of around two promille.
A bus driver in Graz performed an emergency brake to avoid a cyclist, causing a passenger to be lightly injured. The cyclist fled the scene.
A 67-year-old man in Graz was arrested after committing fraud, assaulting a waitress, and resisting police while intoxicated.
A traffic accident occurred on the Inntalautobahn near Pettnau when a woman collided with her partners vehicle, causing her car to overturn and resulting in injuries.
A cyclist collided with a tractor trailer in Telfs, suffering serious shoulder and head injuries.

An 18-year-old man was critically injured by a stabbing during a walk in Wimpassing, Austria, by an unknown attacker who then fled the scene.
A 17-year-old drove the wrong way on the A 5 in Mistelbach district, had an accident, and was found to be under the influence of drugs.
A 24-year-old woman was harassed and inappropriately touched in Graz; police are seeking witnesses.
A 16-year-old moped rider collided with a left-turning car on Arlbergstraße in Bregenz, sustaining leg injuries.
A 44-year-old Slovak man was arrested at Südtiroler Platz, 10th district in Vienna, due to an international arrest warrant for property crimes.
A car accident occurred in Klagenfurt when a vehicle stopped at a red light was rear-ended by another car, causing injuries to the driver of the stopped vehicle.
A deer that had escaped its enclosure was located and captured by police and its owner in Salzburg.
Police warn about increased risk of twilight burglaries during autumn and winter and provide prevention tips.
Two men stole a backpack from a womans car; one was arrested after fleeing on foot, and the other was rescued from a roof and also arrested.

A 28-year-old man, wanted for threatening behavior, injured a policeman by ramming him with a car while trying to evade arrest. He was later apprehended in a third-floor apartment after attempting to escape through the window.
A 56-year-old man was injured in the upper body with a knife during a dispute; the suspect is on the run and investigations are ongoing.
A 75-year-old driver collided with a parked vehicle in Stegersbach, causing her car to overturn and crash into an oncoming vehicle. She was injured and transported to the hospital.
A 19-year-old woman lost control of her car on Poggerdorfer Landesstraße, causing injuries and was hospitalized.
A 76-year-old man hit a 79-year-old woman on a crosswalk in Seeboden, resulting in injuries.
A 32-year-old man lost control of an unregistered vehicle, crashed into a ditch, and hit a tree, sustaining severe injuries.

Driver stopped without a valid license and prohibited from continuing.

Two individuals were arrested in Vienna; one for suspected drug trafficking in multiple countries and the other for failing to serve a prison sentence for drug-related crimes.
A 72-year-old driver caused a traffic accident on the B 37 in Jaidhof, crashing into a van and subsequently injuring himself seriously while being under the influence of alcohol.

Police found 316 grams of cannabis during a vehicle check involving three people in Dornbirn.

A car caught fire in Klagenfurt/WS due to a technical defect in the engine; no injuries were reported.
A farmer in Krems, Austria was injured while trying to separate fighting cows and was taken to the hospital.
Attempted robbery at a gas station in Klagenfurt; suspect fled after no cash was taken.
A man was caught with cannabis during a police check at Villach train station.
A car collided with a motorcycle on the B122, resulting in the motorcyclist being thrown into a nearby field and hospitalized with injuries.

A 40-year-old male driver was arrested in Vienna due to an outstanding warrant from his home country and possession of cannabis, heroin, and marijuana hidden in his vehicle and clothing.
Traffic police conducted an operation in the 12th district of Vienna, resulting in various traffic-related violations and arrests, including drug-driving and driving without a license.
Police conducted a criminal enforcement operation in Vienna focusing on theft, human trafficking, and illegal migration, making several arrests and identifications.
A truck driver turning right ran over a pedestrian at a crosswalk, causing severe injuries; the victim was taken to the hospital.

Fraudulent phone calls by scammers impersonating police officers in Vorarlberg aim to extort money from victims, particularly the elderly.
A woman was arrested after aggressively resisting police during an anti-racist protest, leading to injuries to two officers.
A tractor accident occurred in Greifenburg, Austria, where a 31-year-old driver suffered head injuries after his vehicle veered off-road and hit a tree. A passenger was uninjured.

Two vehicles collided on a road in Auersthal, one driver showed signs of alcohol impairment with 1.8 per mille, both parties hospitalized with injuries.
Police stopped a highly intoxicated driver operating a van in Bisamberg with a blood alcohol level of 3.38‰; his license was confiscated and he was reported.
A 45-year-old intoxicated man threw two art objects into the Danube in Linz, one of which was recovered with significant damage.
An 18-year-old moped rider was injured when she had to evade a car cutting a turn on a road in Vöcklabruck, and the driver fled the scene.
A car accident occurred in 5020 Salzburg involving a 35-year-old man, who was drunk, and a 48-year-old woman. She sustained a suspected arm fracture, and the man was reported to authorities.

Police searched a 27-year-olds apartment in Oberndorf, Salzburg and found drug-related items along with white supremacist content on his phone, which was confiscated.
A 58-year-old man was injured during repair work on a flail mower in a vineyard garage, becoming trapped between the machine and a forklift.
Two paragliders collided mid-air and landed in a lake, sustaining minor injuries.
Police trainees completed their basic training in Graz and will start serving in the Styria region from November 1, 2020.
A 16-year-old in Innsbruck, under suspected drug intoxication, threatened police with a knife, fled, and injured an officer before being apprehended.

An elderly woman in Innsbruck was deceived by a fraudster impersonating a police officer and handed over cash and jewelry.

A 16-year-old moped driver collided with a car, resulting in minor injuries in Villach.

Two separate incidents: A traffic accident involving a car and a motorcycle, where the motorcyclist lacked a license, and a case of speeding by two cars at 124 km/h in a 50 km/h zone.
A man was observed via security camera trespassing on a company premise and caught with stolen tools; he was arrested by police.
