A traffic accident involving multiple vehicles occurred on L5 in Groß-Enzersdorf, resulting in severe injuries for several individuals. Emergency services assisted and road closures were in place.

A man stole a moped outside a bar in Haid, consumed alcohol inside, and later returned with a transporter to take the moped. He was caught in an intoxicated state, and the mopeds location remains unknown.

Two stolen truck mixers from Germany were detected during a police check on the A8 Innkreisautobahn in Austria; documents and data had been falsified, and two Turkish drivers attempted to transport them.
Three people injured in a rear-end collision involving multiple cars on the B3 near Steyregg.
Fire started inside a parked car, damaging the console and roof lining. No foul play suspected.
An 80-year-old driver was killed, and his 76-year-old passenger was seriously injured after their car veered off the road and into the Sattentalbach stream in Pruggern.
A rear-end collision involving two cars occurred on the S6 near Leoben-Ost, leaving both drivers with minor injuries.
A 62-year-old cyclist suffered life-threatening head injuries in a downhill accident on Sorgerweg in Graz after abrupt braking in a construction area.
A smoldering fire broke out in a farmhouse in Kirchdorf, quickly extinguished by firefighters; no injuries reported.
A family in Graz accidentally caused a fire in their basement during craft activities, resulting in minor injuries to a 17-year-old and minimal property damage.
Unknown perpetrator broke into a construction site in Vomp and stole tools and machinery from an installation companys storage room.
Unknown individuals damaged 27 snow poles on the Silvretta Hochalpenstraße, causing approximately 2,600 euros in damage.
Two trench compactors were stolen from a construction site in Wolfurt, Austria.
School building, a nearby wooden hut, and a traffic radar device were heavily vandalized, with graffiti sprayed and damage caused to multiple structures in Gnesau, Austria.

Groups of youths caused disturbances in Vienna-Favoriten, including shouting religious slogans, using pyrotechnics, and vandalizing a church. Police detained several individuals, with no major damages or injuries reported.
A woman had her wallet stolen from her handbag in Perchtoldsdorf, and the thief used her ATM card to withdraw money in Mödling.
An intoxicated woman lost control of her car and collided with another vehicle, causing minor injuries to both drivers.
A 57-year-old pedestrian was hit by a truck in St.Veit/Glan and severely injured; the truck driver remained unharmed.

A 43-year-old driver in Bischofshofen evaded police, drove at excessive speeds, and caused multiple accidents, including collisions with parked cars and a fence. He refused an alcohol test and faces charges of endangering public safety.
Police issued a warning in Tirol about the risks of winter driving conditions and urged drivers to use appropriate equipment and adjust their driving behavior.
A compost heap in Weer caught fire, possibly due to self-ignition, and was extinguished by the fire department after extensive efforts to remove smoldering remnants.
Two small trucks caught fire outside a workshop in Hall; fire was extinguished by local fire departments, with no injuries reported.

A car and a motorcycle collided on the A-23 in Vienna; the motorcyclist and a car passenger were injured. The motorcyclist, who had over 2.3‰ alcohol level and no driving license, caused significant damage to the vehicles.

A 36-year-old driver on the A-23 in Vienna, showing signs of impaired driving, ignored police signals to stop and was later caught. He failed an initial alcohol test showing over 1.6 promille and refused subsequent tests, leading to a temporary license suspension and a security deposit.
A 45-year-old man crashed into a transformer station in Diex, Völkermarkt district, after swerving to avoid wildlife, sustaining serious injuries.
A car and a bicycle collided in a roundabout in Völkermarkt, causing injuries to the cyclist.
A head-on collision between a car and a truck occurred on B60, injuring the car driver severely and causing minor injuries to two truck drivers.
Teenagers attempted to rob a taxi driver in Linz using pepper spray, injuring the driver slightly. The main suspect, a 16-year-old girl, was arrested and identified along with an accomplice.
Fatal traffic accident where a motorcyclist collided with a truck during an overtaking maneuver and sustained fatal injuries.
A 27-year-old student from Brazil fell from a cherry picker while securing a tree with a rope, resulting in injuries of unknown severity and hospitalization.
A 31-year-old woman from Vienna lost control of her quad, falling about 5 meters down a slope and was airlifted to the hospital after first aid was provided by witnesses.
A woman with 1.52 promille alcohol in her blood caused a traffic accident in Salzburg and her car was immobilized due to lack of a driving license.
Two injured in head-on collision between a car and a small truck in a construction area on B 317 in Unzmarkt-Frauenburg.
25-year-old attempted to steal a car with the engine running but failed due to unfamiliarity with an automatic transmission and was restrained by the owners son and father until police arrived.
A 51-year-old woman was severely injured while performing maintenance and cleaning on a machine in Feldbach.
Forgotten oil on a stove caused a fire in Graz, resulting in significant property damage but no injuries.
A German man threatened staff at a parcel service call center in Hall in Tirol over a missed delivery.
A 76-year-old pedestrian was hit and injured by an unknown driver who fled the scene in Innsbruck.
A 53-year-old woman drove her car off the road in Imst, breaking through a wooden fence and landing on a wall. She was injured and taken to the hospital.
A drunk driver without a valid license crashed into a traffic island in Lustenau, causing property damage but no injuries.

A 34-year-old man without a valid driving license and using an unregistered car with swapped license plates caused an accident on a highway ramp in Bregenz-Weidach. He fled the scene but was later apprehended by the police in Dornbirn-Süd. An alcohol test was negative, but he refused a drug test.
Bus driver reversed and collided with a car in Mäder, injuring the cars passenger.
Police in Vienna discussed handling large gatherings during the pandemic, emphasizing health risks and legal considerations.
A man in Pörtschach am Wörthersee was found to have a laser blocker in his car during a speed control, leading to its confiscation and an investigation.
Collision between a car and a cyclist in Klagenfurt; cyclist injured and car driver found slightly intoxicated.
A 23-year-old man and his father were performing forestry work in Frantschach-St. Gertraud when a falling tree caused a branch to injure the father on the back, leading to serious injuries.
Two vehicles collided on the A 21, causing injuries to both drivers and significant damage to the cars.
A 52-year-old man in Linz was caught speeding at 126 km/h in a 70 km/h zone, driving without a valid license and under the influence with a BAC of 0.94‰. Charges were filed.
Intoxicated driver attempted to flee from police in Pasching; stopped after chase, found with 2.88 per mille alcohol level.
Police arrested a Hungarian man in Obernberg am Inn for possessing stolen high-value bicycles, tools, and forged purchase contracts connected to thefts in Germany since April 2020.

Four individuals were involved in an altercation outside a Linz bar, with a 47-year-old man assaulting another person and later attacking a policewoman; alcohol and drug tests for the suspect were positive, leading to his arrest.
A fire occurred in a multi-story residential building in Salzburgs Old Town; no injuries were reported, and the fire brigade extinguished the blaze.
A car driver in a silver Audi A5 evaded police during a high-speed chase through Graz, ignoring traffic signals and endangering pedestrians and other drivers.
A 20-year-old driver collided head-on with an oncoming car, resulting in his death at the scene and severe injuries to another driver.
Four police officers in Styria, Austria were appointed to new roles by the regional police director, starting November 1, 2020.
A 53-year-old Romanian caregiver allegedly stole a low five-figure amount of cash from a 61-year-old woman in Pfunds; the stolen money was found in his backpack after a search.
A car collision in Oberdrum left two people injured, including the driver under the influence of alcohol.

A physical altercation occurred in Lauterach involving several individuals, during which a 29-year-old man used a knife to injure an 18-year-old. The attacker was arrested, and the others involved sought medical treatment for their injuries.
A man reportedly carrying a long weapon and firing shots was seen in Mäder, prompting a police search, but he was not located.
A fire occurred in an apartment in Bregenz, initiating a quick response by neighbors and the fire department to control the situation and evacuate residents.
Two individuals were arrested in their residence in Vienna for drug dealing; over 570 grams of cocaine and 750 euros were seized.

Two 15-year-olds collided with parked vehicles in a stolen car, attempted to flee, but were detained. Subsequent investigation revealed the car was stolen in Graz, and the suspects were involved in multiple thefts and fraud.

Two men suspected of multiple burglaries were arrested in a forest hideout near Leibnitz, Austria. They were found with stolen cash, tools, and items linked to at least 16 burglaries, and one had an outstanding arrest warrant for theft.
A 27-year-old man fled after a traffic stop in Wien-Floridsdorf, attacked an officer, resisted arrest, and slightly injured two policemen.
A mattress fire caused by a tea light led to the arrest of a Turkish woman who was found with a forged ID and tied to multiple fraud offenses.
Unknown perpetrators damaged a football field in Höchst by drifting over it with a vehicle multiple times.
Driver was caught speeding at 167 km/h in an 80 km/h zone, risking a high fine and loss of driving license.
A 72-year-old cyclist fell and was severely injured near a supermarket in Leoben as a car exited a parking lot. Police are searching for the involved driver.
A 49-year-old pedestrian was hit by a 74-year-old driver in Linz and later died from his injuries.

A 36-year-old man in Saalfelden was twice stopped by police for driving under the influence, first on the B311 with a blood alcohol level of 2.64, and later driving another car without license plates.
A 57-year-old man fell three meters from a ladder while pruning a tree and was injured, requiring air transport to a hospital.
A 22-year-old drunk driver crashed into a garden, damaging property, and fled the scene on foot before being apprehended with a blood alcohol level of 1.28 promille.
A safe containing several thousand euros in cash was stolen from a company in Graz by unknown offenders who entered through an unlocked back door.

A group of suspected drug dealers was arrested after extensive investigations. Police confiscated marijuana, amphetamines, and cocaine worth over 160,000 euros. Further house searches revealed additional drugs and involved parties, with one suspects partner attempting to dispose of drugs in the toilet, which was later recovered by a cleaning service.
A driver in Feldkirch crashed into a bollard, fled the scene, ended up on railway tracks, and was later suspected of fabricating a car theft while under the influence of alcohol.
A 27-year-old drug supplier was arrested in his apartment in Viennas 16th district with 209 grams of cocaine and cash discovered.
A 17-year-old male was arrested at an event in Vienna after acting aggressively, refusing to leave the premises, and kicking an officer during an altercation.
A man injured his wife during a dispute in an apartment by slamming a door, leading to her being hospitalized and him receiving a restraining order.
Burglary in a house in Maria Rain, jewelry stolen, suspects escaped into nearby woods.
A 74-year-old man fell while hiking on an unmarked trail in steep terrain and had to be rescued and taken to a hospital due to injuries.
A 19-year-old driver in Villach reversed into a 56-year-old man, causing serious injuries, while the latter was filling air into his car tires at a gas station.
A house facade was damaged using pyrotechnics by unknown individuals.

A 38-year-old man was caught stealing alcohol and socks from a store in St. Georgen im Attergau, and later apprehended for stealing gloves from another store. He had prior theft incidents in Tyrol and was sent to prison.
A 36-year-old man stole cash from a practice in Timelkam, was pursued by the owner, returned the cash, fled again, and was later apprehended with the help of the local community.
A man in Linz engaged in a police chase after ignoring a stop signal; he possessed an illegal weapon and a softgun and was caught after a 10-minute pursuit.
Two teenagers broke into a youth center in Bürmoos and stole a cash box, attempting to open it nearby before being identified.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a car in Salzburg by smashing a side window and stole a mobile phone.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a family house in Salzburg by smashing a window and searched all rooms.
Four-vehicle collision on A1 highway near Salzburg injured one man, alcohol tests were negative.
A drunk Hungarian truck driver damaged a parked car, fled the scene, and was later stopped by police who confirmed alcohol intoxication and driving violations.
Car collision in Schwoich involving two vehicles and five individuals, causing significant injuries and total damage to the cars, with ongoing investigations to identify the driver.

A 19-year-old Austrian driver lost control of his car during an overtaking maneuver on a curve, causing it to crash into an embankment and overturn multiple times. The driver was injured and transported to a hospital.
Two paper containers were set on fire in Bregenzs Achsiedlung; passersby extinguished the fire and later sought medical help due to smoke inhalation.
An intoxicated man allegedly smashed 12 glass panes at Lochau train station.
A fire caused by a knocked-over Halloween candle in a residential buildings entrance led to significant smoke but no injuries. Fire extinguished quickly.

A fisherman discovered a grenade-like object in the Donaukanal during magnet fishing. Authorities secured the area and the bomb disposal service determined it to be a World War II tank grenade without a detonation system, which was safely removed.
A group of men attacked two individuals in Vienna, causing injuries. Three suspects were detained, and 10 additional suspects are being sought.
Vienna police conducted patrols on Halloween night, managing various incidents including an assault, a vandal caught spraying graffiti, and a man showing a Nazi salute.

A man noticed heavy smoke from a neighbors apartment which activated the smoke detector; emergency services rescued an uninjured man who fell asleep after cooking sausages, causing smoke but no property damage.
A 20-year-old man set three trash bins on fire in St. Peter, Klagenfurt; the fires were quickly extinguished, and he was identified after boasting about the arson.
Police caught three youths with graffiti materials and illegal pyrotechnics near Underpass Walls, Underweitersdorf.

A group of young men threw bottles and cans at police during a Covid-19 compliance check; additional alcohol-related incidents occurred in Asten and Hörsching involving aggressive and non-compliant individuals.
Two masked men robbed a taxi driver in Linz, threatening him with a weapon and stealing his wallet before fleeing on foot.
A fire broke out in a multi-section garage in Tarsdorf; a man was injured attempting to extinguish it, resulting in total damage to the garage and several items.
An 18-year-old was found with a blank-firing gun in Linz after displaying it during a group scuffle; a temporary weapon ban was issued.
Two 17-year-old slightly intoxicated girls vandalized properties by removing and smashing decorations on the street in Straßwalchen.
A 71-year-old e-bike rider in Eugendorf suffered a heart attack, fell, and passed away despite immediate resuscitation attempts.
A fire broke out in a bedroom in a house. No injuries occurred, and residents extinguished the fire with a handheld extinguisher. Fire services conducted follow-up checks.
A car accident with non-injurious damage occurred in Omes, where the driver used stolen license plates and tested positive for cocaine and THC after the accident.
An 82-year-old man was injured while using a wood splitter at home in Tannheim, leading to hospitalization after his fingers were caught.
An unidentified perpetrator forcibly opened the door of an apartment in Innsbruck without stealing anything but causing damage to the lock.
Unknown perpetrators broke into 7 basement compartments in apartment buildings in Lienz and stole items of low value and food.
Arson at a middle school in Rankweil caused significant property damage, but no injuries were reported.
Car lost control in Ambergtunnel due to tire failure, causing collisions with tunnel structures; no injuries reported, but total vehicle damage and positive alcohol test for driver.
A missing minor, Alicia Feigl, was found safe in Lower Austria after police investigations and a public tip. She was picked up by relatives and returned to Vorarlberg.
A pedestrian in Dornbirn was hit by a car while crossing at a pedestrian crosswalk. Both the driver and the injured pedestrian were taken to the hospital.
A 32-year-old Romanian from Vienna caused an accident on the A1 while driving a stolen vehicle under the influence of alcohol.
Unidentified perpetrators stole three e-bikes from a locked bike garage and a nearby location in Ellmau; total damage valued in the upper four-digit range.

Police conducted alcohol traffic checks in Bezirk Dornbirn, identifying 9 drivers under the influence of alcohol, 4 above 0.8‰ and 5 between 0.5-0.79‰; licenses were confiscated and violations were reported.
Three Czech men were arrested for stealing multiple bicycles in Hohenau an der March and Rabensburg, with a total of nine thefts between October 26 and October 31, 2020.
A 29-year-old man suffered a severe leg injury during forestry work in Ramsau, Lilienfeld, after a tree collapsed unexpectedly. He was rescued by firefighters and airlifted to a hospital.
A taxi driver in Linz was robbed at gunpoint by two masked men who stole his wallet and car keys before fleeing on foot.
An elderly nun was struck by an unknown man who fled the scene; no injuries or damage occurred.
A 32-year-old man admitted to breaking into a flower shop in Grazs Inner City, stealing cash and electronic storage devices; the stolen items were recovered, and he was reported at large.
Police in Tirol monitored Halloween activities, reporting 13 violations and 20 warnings; one venue in Innsbruck Land violated hygiene and distancing rules.
A 76-year-old nun was attacked by a 19-year-old man on a bus in Graz; the suspect was later identified, confessed, and has been admitted to a medical facility.
Unidentified individuals broke into a basement compartment in Niedernsill and stole an e-bike.
A 23-year-old man was attacked and injured by an unidentified male, with additional assault by two other men, in Wiener Neustadt.
A 44-year-old man was attacked and knocked to the ground in Gleisdorf after being forced to stop his vehicle by a white pickup and confronted by another driver who assaulted him.
Two unidentified perpetrators attacked and injured two men in Wels, breaking one victims arm; the incident was filmed and uploaded online.
Two unidentified attackers injured two 31-year-olds at Stadtplatz in Wels; one victim suffered a broken arm.
Two unknown male offenders attacked and injured two 31-year-old men in Wels, breaking one victims right forearm; the incident was filmed and posted online.
A woman kicked a man in the face during an argument at a gas station in Klagenfurt causing him to fall, and he was taken to the hospital with injuries.
A 24-year-old man was lightly injured at a Halloween party by unknown individuals.
A 45-year-old man fell asleep while smoking, causing a fire that engulfed his apartment and required evacuation of the building.
Two men in Salzburg were assaulted and robbed; a wallet and a mobile phone were stolen.

A 33-year-old driver collided with a guardrail on the A1 in Salzburg while intoxicated, with a recorded blood alcohol level of 1.54‰. The vehicle was heavily damaged and required towing, and the drivers license was confiscated.
Two men were injured during a brawl in a Graz bar; an unknown man struck another with a glass ashtray and then both fell, injuring a bystander.
Two young men were attacked and injured by two unidentified individuals at Heiligengeistplatz, Klagenfurt.
Fire broke out at a 32-year-olds agricultural property in Bezirk Grieskirchen, extinguished by the owner using fire extinguishers. Significant property damage occurred, but no injuries.
A 57-year-old Serbian driver was stopped for a breathalyzer test in Salzburg-Itzling, showing over two promille; his license was confiscated and he will be reported.
A group of youths overturned a car and spray-painted four others in Graz; police are seeking witnesses.
A man broke into a company on Ödenburger Straße and was caught by police and a police dog after attempting to search the premises and fleeing.
A 24-year-old man aggressively resisted police, injuring three officers during an attempted arrest at a locale in Hauptallee, Vienna.
A 16-year-old Russian student was caught breaking into newspaper boxes, and a stolen mobile phone was linked to the suspect.
A car and a tractor collided on the Packer Bundesstraße in Völkermarkt, resulting in multiple injuries; the car driver was found to be under the influence of alcohol.
A fire broke out on a balcony in Klagenfurt/WS due to a candle, causing minor smoke injuries to two individuals and damage to nearby property.
Driver with laser blockers on license plates stopped and device confiscated on A2 near Villach.
A Slovenian man lost control of his car under the influence of drugs, causing an accident that injured him and his passenger, and drugs were found in the vehicle.
An abandoned farmhouse in Klein-Schollach, Melk district, caught fire, causing significant damage over €300,000 but no injuries.
A 78-year-old woman collided with another car at a crossroad, her vehicle tipped onto its side, and she was extracted and airlifted to a hospital with injuries.
Driver without a license and under the influence of drugs attempted to evade police, leading to a high-speed chase in Salzburg; drugs and paraphernalia were found in the vehicle.
A nine-year-old boy fell about ten meters from a construction scaffold in Graz, sustaining serious injuries including a skull fracture and pelvic fracture.

A chimney fire occurred in a residential agricultural house in Iselsberg-Stronach, caused by a deflagration or chimney resin buildup. The fire was controlled and extinguished by local fire brigades without any injuries.
Physical altercations occurred during a Halloween party in Seefeld, with a 20-year-old man injuring two people and another individual being attacked by an unknown offender.
Car collision in Wildermieming resulting in injuries and significant vehicle damage.
Two men in Innsbruck attacked police officers, causing injuries, after being stopped for riding a bicycle improperly and refusing an alcohol test.
A BMW with stolen plates caused a traffic accident after a burnout at a gas station in Schwarzach, then all occupants fled the scene.
20-year-old car driver collided with a bus after skidding on Badidastraße in Göfis; minor injuries for the driver, no injuries for others, and a positive alcohol test for the driver.
Two men were caught attempting a burglary in Vienna after a woman reported suspicious noises and actions outside her apartment.
A 34-year-old man from Klagenfurt slipped and fell about 40 meters while hiking on Predigerstuhl, was rescued by helicopter and taken to the hospital with unspecified injuries.
A green-black Merida e-bike worth several thousand euros was stolen near the central cemetery in Klagenfurt-Annabichl.
A fatal traffic accident occurred in Rosegg involving a head-on collision caused by a driver under the influence of alcohol, resulting in one death and several injuries.
A car collided with a minibus on LB 2 in Vitis, causing life-threatening and severe injuries and multiple other minor injuries.
A 65-year-old man fatally crashed his light motor vehicle into a tree in Braunau am Inn district, Austria.
A 70-year-old experienced hang glider crashed from a height of about ten meters during a landing attempt, suffering serious injuries.
A fire broke out at a 32-year-olds property in Grieskirchen; the owner, a firefighter, extinguished it before fire services arrived.
A worker in Stubach suffered hand injuries when a steel part detached while he was hammering rods and struck his hand. He was taken to the hospital.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a company reception area in Salzburg Nord, pried open the entrance door and stole two fixed safes.
Unknown offenders broke into a construction site in Seiersberg-Pirka and stole electrical equipment, including a compactor, grinder, and painting device, valued at several thousand euros.
Fire broke out in an outbuilding with no injuries but property damage; firefighters extinguished it.
Two people were slightly injured in a rear-end collision on the B54 near Pischelsdorf am Kulm; both drivers tested negative for alcohol.
An 82-year-old driver lost control of his car on a municipal road in Straden, went off the road, and fell 25 meters down a steep slope, sustaining injuries of unknown severity.

A tractor in Zellberg caught fire on a farm property without known cause, leading to a total loss of the vehicle. Firefighters prevented the fire from spreading, and no persons or animals were harmed.
A cyclist in Innsbruck collided with a bus and suffered fatal injuries after being run over.
A 52-year-old German woman fell approximately 60-80 meters while descending a climbing route on Köllenspitze in Nesselwängle, resulting in fatal injuries.
Two German climbers got lost on the Totenköpfl during a climbing trip, bivouacked overnight without proper shelter, and were guided to safety by rescuers using a helicopter.
Burglars broke into a guesthouse, stole cash and meat, and caused significant property damage in Pöls an der Wieserbahn.
A 33-year-old man went missing during a mountain tour near Kirchdorf, and search efforts involving police, dogs, and local rescue teams are underway.
A 24-year-old woman was assaulted by three men after intervening when they harassed another woman for a cigarette.
A former farmhouse in Klein-Schollach, Bezirk Melk, was deliberately set on fire using an open flame. A 49-year-old suspect was identified and taken into custody.
A driver in Wals was stopped during a routine check and found to have a breath alcohol level of 0.73mg/l; his license was confiscated and he will face charges.
An intoxicated moped rider lost control on a curve and crashed; was assisted by bystanders and found to be under the influence of alcohol.
Police found a man sleeping drunk in an unlocked car; he had no driving license due to a prior offense.
Wrong-way driver on A1 highway collided with a minibus trailer; no injuries reported but significant vehicle damage occurred.
Two Austrians were arrested after a drug deal involving cannabis was observed by police in Vienna.
Police stopped a truck with loose wheel nuts on the trailer during a hazardous goods check; the driver claimed unawareness.
An intoxicated man damaged a car in Villach and later vandalized items at home. He was arrested after refusing to stop and will be interrogated the following day.
A man was caught stealing diesel from construction machinery at a site in St. Paul im Lavanttal and was found with additional fuel of unverified origin at his residence.

A 53-year-old man in Feldkirchen evaded police during a speed check, hid his car in a carport, and attempted to flee on foot. He was aggressive, refused an alcohol test, and was eventually calmed by police.
A 52-year-old man tragically died after a tractor accident on a slippery forest path in Poppichl, with the vehicle tipping over and pinning him beneath it.
A man threatened and strangled his girlfriend during an argument in Villach, and was issued a restraining order.
A 10-year-old boy lost control of an unregistered moped and collided with a tree, injuring himself and his 8-year-old brother in Moosburg, Austria.
An elderly woman forgot a pot on an electric stove, causing smoke and alerting the fire department; no injuries or fire occurred.
A fire broke out on a farm in Regau, Austria, causing significant damage to a building and forcing the evacuation of livestock, with four cattle euthanized due to injuries.
A man fell from a height of six meters while working on a roof and sustained severe injuries.
A 67-year-old woman fell off her moped for unknown reasons, sustained injuries, and was airlifted to the hospital after receiving first aid.

A 27-year-old Romanian injured a 31-year-old man in the face in Salzburg near the main train station after a dispute over a wrongly parked car. The father and brother of the injured man got involved, leading to threats from the father towards the Romanian. Both the 27-year-old and the 53-year-old father were reported to the prosecutor.
Two men were attacked and injured after an altercation near Salzburgs main train station.
A skateboarder holding onto a car lost control and suffered life-threatening head injuries after falling at high speed.
A 76-year-old cyclist died following a collision with a car on the L 734 road in Bleiberg, Bezirk Liezen.
Unknown individuals stole cash from a church sacristy by accessing through an unlocked back door and hiding in until they could steal two cash boxes containing thousands of euros.

A 31-year-old male driver hit a 61-year-old female pedestrian on Amraser Straße, resulting in life-threatening injuries for the woman. Another pedestrian avoided the crash, and the car sustained significant damage.
A 15-year-old moped rider in Zirl collided with a car after his mopeds light failed, resulting in injuries and significant vehicle damage.
An 18-year-old Austrian fired a blank-firing pistol during a wedding convoy in Kufstein, was stopped by police, and the weapon was seized.
A 15-year-old girl on a moped crashed on a curve in Hart im Zillertal, sustaining injuries and was hospitalized.
A fire broke out in a sawmill in Kennelbach, leading to evacuations and significant property damage, with no injuries reported.
Two men attempted a break-in at a house in Klagenfurt; one suspect assaulted a police officer during the arrest.
A 33-year-old climber was found deceased under the Kremsmauer ridge after a search operation; the man likely fell during a crossing.
A mother and her daughter were injured in a car accident on B137 in Wallern an der Trattnach after a collision with a truck.
A 29-year-old woman was injured in a rear-end collision near a roundabout in Enns, Upper Austria.
Collision between an 11-year-old scooter rider and a 58-year-old cyclist in Graz left the cyclist seriously injured.
Small truck overturned in Graz after collision with a car; driver sustained minor injuries.
A 10-year-old boy from Graz fell off his mountain bike during a jump at a training ground and sustained injuries of an unspecified degree. He was airlifted to a hospital.
A 32-year-old Austrian man was severely injured in a car accident on the Zillertalbundesstraße in Fügen, losing control and hitting a guardrail.
A collision occurred between a car and an unregistered motorcycle in Niederau, leaving the motorcyclist seriously injured and hospitalized.
A car accident occurred in Thal/Aue where a Ukrainian drivers vehicle was rear-ended by an Italian driver, resulting in injuries to the Ukrainians wife and damage to both cars.

A 61-year-old Hungarian in Oberhofen backed up a truck to a loading ramp, resulting in a 24-year-old Syrian man being trapped and seriously injured. The injured person was taken to a hospital in Innsbruck after initial treatment.
Two men were seriously injured after their car lost traction on snow, rolled multiple times, and came to a stop; they were airlifted to a hospital.
A 69-year-old Austrian set old wooden planks on fire in Leisach, causing the fire to spread to his wood shed; the fire was extinguished by the local fire brigade with no injuries or damage reported.
A 3-year-old girl was bitten by a stray dog in the arm while walking with her mother in Kapelln; the child was injured and taken to the hospital.
Five young individuals attacked and injured two pedestrians in Linz; three were arrested immediately, two were later identified.
A fire broke out in a farm building in Regau, causing significant damage and leading to the death of four cattle due to burn injuries.
Burglary at a hardware store in Frohnleiten, cash stolen between November 2nd and 3rd, 2019.
A 51-year-old German hunter fell 10-15 meters while descending a rocky area and was rescued injured by a search team in Silbertal.
A 69-year-old man suffered a fatal heart attack after a verbal altercation with two boys aged 12 and 13, reportedly involving a toy gun and wooden sticks, at a football field in Rankweil, Austria.
Verbal dispute involving two boys and an elderly man led to a heart attack and death of the man in Rankweil.
A terrorist attack occurred in the inner city of Vienna, killing four people and injuring 22; the suspect was neutralized by police.
Police officers performed CPR on a 51-year-old man near Stadtpark in Vienna, restoring his vital functions, and the man is recovering in the hospital.
Terror attack in Viennas city center with Burgenland police units providing assistance.
Police canine units were deployed alongside other forces during a terror attack in Vienna, assisting in evacuation, securing areas, and supporting operations.
A 3-year-old girl was bitten by a dog on her arm while walking with her mother in Kapelln, St. Pölten; the child was injured and taken to the hospital.

Two Austrian brothers attacked a bouncer outside a local in Vienna after being asked to leave for violating a no-smoking policy, demonstrated aggressive behavior towards police, and were arrested after resisting and threatening officers.
A 19-year-old Austrian lost control of his moped on a municipal road in Inzing and was injured; a positive alcohol test was reported.
A collision occurred in Klagenfurt between a truck and a cyclist at an intersection, resulting in injuries to the cyclist and total damage to the bicycle.
A grain storage in Frauenstein caught fire for unknown reasons and was completely burned down.

Unknown perpetrators broke into two construction containers in Pfaffenhofen and stole several chainsaws and motor cutters.
Three individuals damaged grave accessories in a cemetery in Klagenfurt after stealing beverages and consuming alcohol; one admitted guilt.
A traffic accident involving two cars occurred at an intersection in Wels, resulting in injuries to three people.

Unidentified perpetrators broke into safe deposit boxes in three banks in Klosterneuburg, Mödling, and Vienna using manipulated access controls and secret cameras to steal jewels, gold, watches, and cash, resulting in damages in the double-digit million range.
A 29-year-old Moldovan man was arrested at the Loibl Pass due to an existing warrant for a financial crime in Moldova.
Two men were injured and trapped in a car after a rollover accident in Micheldorf, St. Veit/Glan, due to the drivers positive alcohol test.
A 23-year-old man injured a 28-year-old Somalian man during a dispute in Linz, stabbing him in the back and cutting his thumb. The suspect was detained, and the victim was hospitalized.
Two men overcharged an elderly man over 900 euros for locksmith services after he locked himself out of his apartment in Hallein.
A car collided with a guardrail in Salzburg due to excessive speed and icy road conditions; driver was under the influence of alcohol and lacked a valid license.
A 50-year-old man was injured in his right hand during a workplace accident in Liezen while trying to hang a metal workpiece into a lifting device.
A 35-year-old man was severely injured after his small truck collided with a tree on L 223 road near Fehring, resulting in total vehicle damage.

A garbage bin caught fire near a residential building in Leoben with no injuries reported. Firefighters quickly controlled the blaze, preventing further damage, with an estimated loss of several hundred euros.
Police arrested four young men after a backpack robbery and two blank gunshots were fired; the stolen items were returned to the victim, and no one was injured.
Police officers were attacked while attempting to resolve a dispute; one officer was bitten in the thigh, and three individuals were arrested.
A deer caused a traffic accident involving two vehicles, resulting in one driver sustaining severe injuries.
A driver lost control of his car, crashed into planters and streetlights, flipped the vehicle, fled the scene, and was later found under suspicion of drug influence.

A fire broke out in the kitchen of a 43-year-old resident’s apartment in Linz caused by an active electric stove. The fire department extinguished the fire without any injuries. The apartment is temporarily uninhabitable.

A 79-year-old man illegally burned various waste items in a forest clearing in Attersee, Bezirk Vöcklabruck. The fire was extinguished by the fire department after being noticed by police; no injuries occurred.
A 28-year-old was injured with a knife during a dispute in Linz; the attacker was arrested, and the victim received medical treatment.

A 35-year-old Austrian woman lost control of her car due to a health issue, hitting the median barrier multiple times. A German man stopped her vehicle to prevent a severe accident. She was hospitalized, and her vehicle was removed, causing traffic disruptions.
A gas heater in a workshop caught fire, and the fire was controlled by firefighters without any injuries reported.
Intoxicated driver in Graz led police on high-speed chase, violated traffic rules, damaged a police car, and was arrested.
A bus in Graz made an emergency stop to avoid a car crossing its path, resulting in one person being moderately injured and three others sustaining minor injuries.
Two unknown individuals broke into a 26-year-olds apartment in Liezen and stole cash and gold jewelry worth several thousand euros.
An attempted break-in at a hotel garage in Pfunds aimed at stealing e-bikes caused damage to the garage door and access door.
A car crash occurred in Navis when a woman turned left and collided with an oncoming vehicle, injuring the driver and his passenger.
A 22-year-old driver was caught with stolen license plates and driving without a license during a control in Tirol.

A 27-year-old inmate escaped custody in St. Pölten after violently pulling away from guards at a hospital and fleeing. Police apprehended three suspected accomplices but the escaped prisoner remains at large.
A 52-year-old farmer died in a forestry accident when a log rolled over him while transporting it.
Two women feeding camels at a circus in Ried were injured after a camel aggressively grabbed food and caused injuries to their arms.
A 42-year-old man died during a planned dive in Steinbach am Attersee after ascending in distress.

A 23-year-old man fell 5.6 meters from a roof while helping with roofing work in Laakirchen. He was responsive after the fall and sustained injuries of unspecified severity, requiring helicopter transport to a hospital.
A 21-year-old driver caused a head-on collision on B145 near Sulzbach, resulting in one severely injured person who was airlifted to a hospital and two others with undetermined injuries.
A 17-year-old Serbian male allegedly assaulted his 18-year-old sister with kicks to her body and threatened her in Salzburg Lehen.
An 18-year-old moped rider in Salzburg hit an 88-year-old woman on a road, causing her life-threatening head injuries.
An 11-year-old girl was hit by a car on a pedestrian crossing in Zieglau; the driver was intoxicated with 2.32 per mille alcohol level and had their license seized.
A car caught fire in Feldkirchen bei Graz, likely due to a technical defect. The fire was extinguished, and no one was injured.
A 20-year-old German driver collided with a 15-year-old Austrian moped rider in Kufstein, causing injuries to the latter.
A father and son were performing forestry work in Pill when a tractor slipped downhill, causing a tree top to strike and injure the fathers leg. He was airlifted to a hospital.
A head-on collision occurred in Hainburg/Donau on the B 49 involving two cars, resulting in severe injuries for three men.
A 43-year-old man stole a water bottle without paying, injured a 21-year-old security guard during an altercation, vandalized property, and made threats before being arrested in Graz.
A 26-year-old man was arrested for stealing a taxi drivers phone, assaulting police officers, and possessing stolen documents.
Two armed men robbed a gas station, threatening the attendant with guns and stealing cash and cigarettes before fleeing.

A 35-year-old man was rescued from a smoke-filled apartment in Linz after strong smoke and flames were reported. The smoke was caused by burnt food, and the man was hospitalized with unspecified injuries.
A camel at a stranded circus in Ried bit two women, causing severe injury to one and minor injury to the other, during an attempt to feed them.
Road closure due to fallen trees and risk of further incidents; military helicopter assisted in clearing efforts.
An 88-year-old woman was critically injured in a collision with a moped in Salzburg and later succumbed to her injuries.
A drunk driver collided with a bus on Montfortstraße in Götzis, causing injuries to two people and significant damage to the vehicles.
Three masked and armed men robbed a shop in Braunau am Inn, threatening and assaulting the owner before fleeing with cash.
A 25-year-old Italian man went missing after leaving a friends apartment in Wattens, wearing only one shoe.

A car accident occurred on B 35 in Maissau when a 32-year-old driver collided with a deer. The deer was thrown into the windshield of an oncoming car, severely injuring its 46-year-old driver who later succumbed to her injuries.
An intoxicated woman caused multiple traffic accidents in Vienna, including a rear-end collision and vehicle damage while parking.
Fire broke out in an apartment building in Spittal/Drau; 12 residents were evacuated, and 4 people were hospitalized due to suspected smoke inhalation.
A 27-year-old man in Salzburg Itzling assaulted and strangled his girlfriend, leading to his arrest and the issuance of a restraining order.
A greenhouse in Kössen burned down completely, likely caused by a candle in a glass that broke due to heat.
Fire broke out in a building in Oberdrauburg, quickly extinguished by firefighters, causing property damage of 10,000€ but no injuries.
A man in Seefeld reported being scammed through a fake online shop but managed to cancel the payment successfully.
Three unidentified individuals attempted to break into an apartment in Innsbruck by kicking the door but fled when the residents alerted the police.
A car with two 18-year-old Germans went off the road on a frosty bridge in Achenkirch, flipped over, and both occupants were injured and taken to hospitals.
Collision between a car and a cyclist in Vienna resulting in the cyclist being injured.
Three young men threatened a 19-year-old with a knife and a soft gun, stealing his wireless headphones before being apprehended.
Police conducted a traffic safety operation in Burgenland, targeting alcohol, drugs, speed, and distance compliance. Multiple offenses were recorded, including two alcohol-related incidents.
A wet snow avalanche in Kirchbach caused damage to a property, tractor, bicycle, and various items, with water entering the house; no injuries reported.
A wet snow avalanche caused significant property damage to a garage, a car, and a flooded house in Rüben, Hermagor District following heavy rain and snow.
A mudslide caused by heavy rain blocked the Kleinkirchheimer Bundesstraße in Radenthein, resulting in road closure and cleanup operations.
A 19-year-old man lost control of his car on a slippery road, causing it to overturn and land in a creek; he suffered injuries and was hospitalized.
Burglary in Villach-Landskron where jewelry was stolen from a house causing damage worth several thousand euros.
A 22-year-old woman lost control of her car on the B11, collided with a tree, and died at the scene in a traffic accident.
A drunk driver with 1.88 per mille rear-ended another car, causing injuries to both parties and leading to a temporary road closure.
A regional train in Weyer, Austria had to perform an emergency stop after a tree fell on the overhead line, causing damage. No injuries were reported.
Two young motocross riders hit a police officer on Breitwiesenstraße in Asten, causing injuries; one was arrested and both were reported.
A car collided with a moped causing the moped rider to be injured and taken to the hospital.
A 35-year-old car driver suffered fatal injuries after crashing into a garage in Timelkam, Vöcklabruck district.
Three cars were involved in a traffic accident on the Tauernautobahn near the Tauerntunnel due to snow-covered roads; one person was injured, and two vehicles were towed.
Cash was stolen from a locked locker in a fitness studio in Salzburg on the morning of November 15.
Multiple vehicles were vandalized with scratches on the hoods in Graz.
A 15-year-old moped rider and his 14-year-old passenger were injured after losing control on a downhill road, causing the moped to slide under a stationary car.
A 38-year-old woman died after two separate collisions and a rollover on A2 Südautobahn, involving multiple vehicles.
A drunk driver caused a traffic accident in Innsbruck by illegally turning left, resulting in a collision with injuries and significant vehicle damage.
A collision between a car and a timber-laden truck on B 171 in Kundl left the car driver injured and trapped, and the truck driver with a hand fracture.
A 41-year-old man in Innsbruck admitted to eight arson attacks using firelighters, causing damage to vehicles, waste containers, and transformer stations between November 13 and 15, 2019.
Multiple phone thefts occurred in Innsbrucks city center, and a suspect was detained with stolen items and prescription medication without a prescription.
A 19-year-old man collided head-on with another vehicle on the S16 highway, causing serious injuries to both drivers; the road was closed temporarily.
Two men attempted to break into a building in Vienna, one was arrested, and the other was seriously injured after falling during an escape attempt.
A 70-year-old experienced mountaineer fell 150 meters to his death during a hike in the Gailtaler Alps.
A man robbed a 20-year-old woman by snatching her handbag and fled in St. Stefan im Lavanttal without causing physical injuries.
A 22-year-old driver caused a multi-car collision on B 100 near Rasdorf in Austria, resulting in one injury and significant vehicle damage.
Fire broke out in a building near a chimney; quickly extinguished by the owner and firefighters. No injuries, property damage of around 10,000€.
A 23-year-old man in Linz was caught driving without a license, using his fathers car without permission, and initially providing false identification to the police.
Police intervened in Linz after reports of a man with a gun, which turned out to be a plastic prop used during the filming of a music video.
A woman driving without a valid license was stopped after failing to react to police signals near Salzburg Hauptbahnhof.
A minor rear-end collision occurred in Salzburgs Sterneckstraße, causing slight damage to vehicles and minor injuries to four passengers.

A car accident occurred in Vasoldsberg where an 18-year-old driver lost control and hit a tree. A 17-year-old passenger died at the scene, while the driver and a 16-year-old passenger sustained injuries.

A rear-end collision occurred on Bundesstraße 116 in Niklasdorf. A 66-year-old man driving a car veered off the road after the collision, hitting a tree and returning to the road. He sustained serious injuries and was airlifted to the hospital. Another passenger in the second car suffered minor injuries.
A 59-year-old man fell from scaffolding and suffered serious injuries during work on his farm.
Four Romanian nationals broke into a clothing collection container in Innsbruck and stole clothes. They were apprehended shortly after and the stolen items were returned to the owner.
Driver caught speeding at 207 km/h in a 100 km/h zone on A12 in Münster, Austria.
A car accident occurred in Matrei i.O. when a vehicle driven by a 20-year-old man went off the road, falling 20 meters into a forest. Three passengers were injured, one seriously.
A 52-year-old German man fell 20-25 meters while crossing an icy waterfall in Tux, sustaining serious injuries; he was assisted by hikers and airlifted to a clinic.
A 33-year-old man was stabbed in the abdomen on a path in Frastanz by an unknown individual, who later fled. The suspect, a 29-year-old known to authorities, was apprehended nearby.
A fire caused by a technical defect in a dryer occurred in the basement of a residential house in Sulz; no injuries reported.
A Harley-Davidson motorcycle was stolen from a parking area in Gössendorf, with the theft occurring between November 15, 17:00 and November 16, 09:30.

A head-on collision occurred between two cars on B 11 in Heiligenkreuz, involving a 25-year-old driver with an alcohol level of 1.6‰. No injuries were reported. The 25-year-olds drivers license was revoked and he was reported to authorities.
A 24-year-old caused a traffic accident by damaging public property with a car, fled the scene, and was later found with an alcohol level of around one promille.
A 63-year-old man was injured after an altercation with three mountain bikers on a prohibited trail; he fell six meters down a slope during the incident.
Four Romanian men broke into a house in Klaus and were caught and arrested by police with the help of a police dog.
A 75-year-old woman was hit by a car while crossing the street in Linz; the driver fled, and the woman later discovered severe injuries.
A 54-year-old driver caused a traffic accident in Linz, attempted to conceal it by illegally disposing of his car, and later turned himself in to the police.
A man was robbed at gunpoint by two individuals on the street, losing cash. Suspects were later identified and arrested using DNA evidence.
A homeowner in Burgkirchen extinguished a fire in his house using two fire extinguishers before emergency services arrived; the fire occurred in the heating room and caused a power outage.
An 18-year-old woman in Salzburg Itzling was caught with no valid driving license, using a falsified ID, and had a blood alcohol level of 1.1‰.
A 52-year-old man was arrested for violent offenses against his ex-partners, including threats and ongoing abuse.
A 42-year-old Serbian national broke into an apartment and fled when surprised by the tenants, but was arrested by police and is in custody.
Several suspected drug dealers were caught in action, small amounts of marijuana and cash were confiscated, and four individuals were temporarily arrested.

A 63-year-old man lost control of his car while driving under the influence on the B95 road in Himmelberg, crashed into a wall, and was injured. A passenger was uninjured; the driver failed an alcohol test and his license was temporarily revoked.
Landslide in Millstätter Berg area led to evacuation of residents due to safety risks and upcoming rainfall.
A road in Weißenstein was flooded and closed to traffic; fire department efforts are ongoing but hampered by water from surrounding fields.
A 29-year-old man in Linz fled a police stop while driving under the influence of drugs without a valid drivers license; he later confessed and provided a counterfeit drivers license.
A birthday party in Reichenau escalated with loud music complaints, drug abuse signs, a car driver under the influence, physical aggression towards an organizer, and official event dissolution.
A car caught fire on a road in Bezirk Braunau am Inn, fully burning out due to a suspected technical defect. The driver managed to exit safely and the fire was extinguished by the fire department.
A 27-year-old driver caused a chain collision by rear-ending a stationary vehicle on the B139 in Haid, injuring multiple people, including children.
A 70-year-old cyclist was severely injured in a collision with a car in Graz. The accident occurred at the intersection of Gaswerkstraße and Wetzelsdorfer Straße.
An 86-year-old woman was seriously injured in a collision with a car driven by her 51-year-old son, as he reversed his company vehicle in their driveway.
A 33-year-old man fell from a scaffold while working on a building facade and was seriously injured.
An unknown perpetrator broke into a locker at a gym in Innsbruck and stole valuable jewelry.
Unidentified suspects broke into ski storage rooms of accommodations in Neustift iSt and stole multiple pairs of alpine skis and a snowboard.
A car accident involving alcohol occurred on the A14 near Lauterach, injuring two women and causing total damage to two vehicles.

A 13-year-old student threatened a 14-year-old classmate with a spring knife outside their school in Vienna-Simmering, demanding money. The victim handed over a small amount of cash before reporting the incident to the police.
A man without a valid drivers license fled from police in a high-speed chase through highways and city streets, endangering multiple people, and escaped on foot after abandoning the vehicle.
A car crash occurred due to the driver losing control and hitting a tree, causing injuries to both occupants and leading to the closure of L321 for an hour.
A woman attempted to extinguish a ceiling fire caused by her wood stove, with firefighters ultimately putting it out; no injuries occurred.
A man from Klagenfurt paid €1,000 in advance for car brake parts on an online platform, but the items were never delivered.
SUV ignored traffic light, causing a man to swerve and crash into a traffic light pole; the driver of the SUV fled the scene.
A man under the influence of drugs and alcohol wielding two CO2 guns was arrested near a gas station in Freistadt; two officers were injured during the arrest.
A 23-year-old driver, under the influence of alcohol, drove off the road and into a ditch, sustaining injuries.
A 19-year-old driver lost control of his car, which overturned and landed on its roof in a field; he was injured and taken to Linz hospital.
A 62-year-old man was injured during forestry work after being struck by a falling beech tree and dragged down a steep slope in St. Leonhard bei Freistadt.
A driver was caught speeding at 225 km/h in a 130 km/h zone on the A2 Südautobahn near Bad Fischau and had his drivers license temporarily revoked.
Unknown offenders damaged vehicles, walls, and signs with spray paint in Weiz.
Multiple thefts resolved, two Polish suspects arrested and found with stolen items and small amounts of drugs.
A 59-year-old injured during forestry work when a tree split and hit his head, receiving medical aid and being flown to a hospital.
A car accident occurred on the Wiener Bundesstraße with the driver fleeing the scene; later, the car owner claimed theft, but was found to be intoxicated with 1.0 per mille alcohol level.
Physical altercation at an event in Oberperfuss involving multiple people, leaving some injured.
A 74-year-old woman in Graz was deceived by individuals impersonating police officers over the phone and lost valuable items amounting to thousands of euros.
A 27-year-old man was attacked and injured by three to four unidentified men at Stadtplatz, Mattighofen.

A group of young adults caused 13 severe damages to infrastructure in Mistelbach district using illegal fireworks, acquiring them abroad from 2016 to 2019 and filming their actions, resulting in legal consequences.
Landslide occurred near Krems in Carinthia above the Katschberg Bundesstraße, causing road block until further inspection.
A driver veered off the road and crashed into a tree; a severely injured person was found and transported to a hospital.
A man threatened a taxi driver with a knife after refusing to pay the fare in Bruck an der Glocknerstraße and fled on foot.
A 59-year-old woman in Graz attacked two policewomen during an official action, injuring them lightly with her high heels, after being detained for a public order disturbance.
A 17-year-old was arrested for breaking into vehicles and attempting to steal in Vienna.
Two men were caught after trying to flee from police, one resisted arrest and two warning shots were fired. Items stolen from a broken van were recovered.
Two women were injured in a car collision at a crossroads in Bezirk Perg and taken to a hospital.
Two women were injured in a car collision in Ainet; both were transported to the hospital with significant damage to their vehicles.

A 22-year-old man was arrested in Vienna after being recognized by a security guard as the perpetrator of a break-in at a shopping centers information stand. Items including keys, IDs, and money were recovered from the suspect.
A 31-year-old Tunisian man was arrested in Vienna after presenting a forged Colombian passport and being found to have a European arrest warrant from Germany.

Around 20 intoxicated individuals caused disturbances outside a venue; two men were arrested for refusing to comply and endangering traffic, leading to a locale inspection with 389 violations reported.
A 21-year-old man struck and injured a 73-year-old woman walking by the roadside in Sachsenburg due to darkness and heavy rain.
A small truck parked outside a house in Würmlach caught fire for unknown reasons, requiring the fire department to extinguish it.
Landslides and flooding caused road closure, house evacuations, and structural damage in Oberdrauburg and Dellach/Drautal.
A mudslide in Obervellach caused a woman to fall 8 meters from a barn and injured cattle; she was rescued and taken to the hospital as residents were evacuated.
A 72-year-old bus driver hit a 36-year-old woman on a crosswalk in Wieselburg, causing severe injuries.
A head-on collision occurred between two vehicles on B127 in Linz, resulting in two injuries and total damage to both vehicles.
A 28-year-old Bosnian man was seriously injured in a stabbing incident outside a Linz bar; a 31-year-old suspect was arrested.
A man attempted to break into a tobacco shop and a supermarket by smashing windows but failed to enter; he was arrested.
Driver under drug influence stopped on highway for driving without lights in fog, license confiscated.
A caregiver is suspected of accidentally scalding a patient with overly hot bathwater in Eggersdorf, causing injuries that required hospitalization.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a tool shop and stole chainsaws, accessories, tools, clothing, and cash.

A 49-year-old woman was seriously injured after being bitten by her own Rottweiler during a walk near her home in Feldkirchen bei Graz. The incident occurred when the dog pulled strongly on its leash, causing her to fall and then attack her. She managed to return home and was hospitalized.
An avalanche hit a car with six occupants on a private road near the Stubaier Gletscherbahnen, two passengers were injured.
A 55-year-old man crashed his car in Neustift, fled the scene, and was later found intoxicated but uninjured after a search.
German driver lost control on icy road, car overturned into forest in Tarrenz; occupants injured and vehicle totaled.
A snow slab hit a car near Stams, Austria, causing minor vehicle damage but no injuries.
A car driven by an 18-year-old German woman hit a 29-year-old Austrian pedestrian on Binderholzstraße in Fügen, causing serious injuries to the pedestrian.
Head-on collision occurred on Pitztaler Landesstraße in Wenns, causing significant damage and injuries.
Unidentified suspects set fire to a paper container in a school courtyard in Hard, causing damage to the building facade and a car.
Two cars collided during a turning maneuver in Lochau; both drivers were injured and their vehicles suffered significant damage.
A 38-year-old man was physically attacked by four young Syrian nationals in Vienna; the suspects fled but were apprehended by police shortly after.
A 100 kg aerial bomb, presumed to be of Soviet origin, was discovered during construction work in Vienna. The area was secured, and the bomb was removed by the military disposal team.
A worker fell through a roof hatch from a height of about 10 meters and suffered fatal injuries while working on a firms rooftop insulation.
A 64-year-old man fell into a three-meter-deep creek bed near his home in Kötschach/Mauthen, sustaining injuries and requiring rescue services.
Cyclist under the influence of alcohol collided with a car at an intersection in Tribuswinkel, sustaining injuries.
An intoxicated driver caused a head-on collision with another vehicle, injuring the other driver in Oeynhausen.
A 23-year-old driver under the influence of alcohol lost control of a company car, resulting in a rollover and minor injuries to the passenger.
An 18-year-old worker suffered facial burns due to a gas explosion during sealing work on a balcony in Losenstein.
A 14-year-old attempted to rob headphones from a 13-year-old by grabbing his neck and fled when the victim screamed.
A truck driver was injured in a traffic accident after his vehicle veered off the road and hit a traffic sign and woodpile.
A 52-year-old driver accidentally hit a 93-year-old pedestrian while reversing her car in Altheim, injuring the pedestrian.
Two paper containers were deliberately set on fire in Salzburg, requiring the fire department to extinguish them and prevent further damage.
A 46-year-old woman and her 21-year-old daughter reported being threatened and attacked by the womans 38-year-old partner, who was later arrested and partially admitted to the offenses.
A fire broke out in a house in Weißkirchen in Steiermark, caused by a technical defect in a phone charger; no injuries were reported.
A car accident occurred on Hochkönigstraße in Fieberbrunn involving two vehicles, with no injuries reported and significant damage to one car.
A womans box of sawdust caught fire on a stove in Hinterthiersee; attempts to extinguish the flames involved neighbors and firefighters. No injuries but property damage occurred.
Fire broke out in a chimney in Telfs; no injuries reported and fire was quickly extinguished.

Two cars collided in Völs at a crossing when one driver failed to notice the other had stopped. Both drivers reported minor injuries, with one being hospitalized. The cars were not operational and had to be towed.
A 35-year-old farmer in Doren got entangled in a cable during forestry work, fell around 6 meters, and sustained injuries of unknown severity. He was transported to a hospital by helicopter.
A part of a double residential house in Ludesch caught fire; all residents evacuated safely, and a firefighter was injured during extinguishing efforts.
A man caused a fire in his home by falling asleep while smoking, which led to the discovery of a cannabis plantation.
Unidentified driver caused a hit-and-run traffic accident in Mattighofen, damaging a car and fleeing the scene.
A 31-year-old Hungarian man was caught stealing perfume in Baden and admitted to multiple thefts, including alcohol, over several days.
A pedestrian in Linz was fatally struck by a truck despite the drivers emergency braking.
Elderly women in Vienna were victims of fraud involving fake police demands for bail money following a fabricated car accident claim.
Defibrillators purchased for police vehicles in southeastern Styria are handed over as part of a pilot project funded by the state of Styria.
A 41-year-old man fell 2 meters from a ladder during work on a hall cladding in Feldkirchen, sustaining unspecified injuries and was taken to Klagenfurt Clinic.
A 33-year-old worker fell 4 meters from a ladder onto a concrete floor at a heating plant in Klagenfurt, sustaining injuries of uncertain severity.

A collision occurred between a small truck and a train at an unguarded railroad crossing in Prottes, Gänserndorf. The truck driver sustained serious injuries and was airlifted to a hospital in Vienna.
A fire in St. Margarethen an der Sierning caused damages to a storage hall and minor injuries to a farmer attempting to extinguish it.
A 33-year-old man fell from scaffolding while removing formwork elements at a construction site in Ostermiething, suffering injuries of undetermined severity.
Attempted break-in at an ATM in Linz with possible intent to use explosives; damage was discovered by a bank employee.
A car and a bicycle collided at an intersection in Salzburg, injuring the cyclist.
A man was caught stealing a bicycle using bolt cutters; he was apprehended by the police and the bicycle was recovered.
Driver caught speeding at 206 km/h in a 130 km/h zone on the A2 in Neunkirchen district.
A fire broke out in a single-family house in Bezirk Vöcklabruck, likely in the pantry, and was controlled by the fire department after evacuation and initial extinguishing attempts.
A suspected drug dealer in Vienna-Ottakring was arrested after resisting police with physical aggression, leading to minor injuries for both parties.
Internationally wanted man arrested in Vienna for multiple burglary convictions.
A 78-year-old woman crossing the road was hit by a car exiting a parking lot, causing fractures and requiring hospitalization.
A 36-year-old man crossing the road was hit by a tram after stepping in its path, causing severe injuries and requiring medical attention.
Police conducted traffic inspections and removed defective trucks from service due to major technical issues.
An 80-year-old man was buried and killed by a landslide near his house in Bad Kleinkirchheim.
A worker was injured during cleanup after a storm when a tree struck him on the chest.
Multiple vehicle collision on S 33 resulting in one person severely injured and two others lightly injured.
A 57-year-old Romanian man was seriously injured after falling from the step of a reversing truck in Göttlesbrunn-Arbesthal and being struck by its wheel.
A 49-year-old Polish worker was fatally crushed by moving construction parts on a sloped surface near Hollabrunn, Austria.
Three Syrian nationals without travel documents were apprehended on a bus at a parking lot in Ried im Innkreis, intending to travel via Germany to seek asylum in Holland.
A 19-year-old man drove off the road and hit a tree, resulting in injuries.
A kitchen fire caused by oil in a pan injured two women and resulted in property damage in Knittelfeld.
Evacuation of houses in Gaimberg due to landslide risks caused by unstable slope after excavation works.
A steep, waterlogged slope in Natters collapsed, threatening a house; residents were evacuated and animals relocated.
Two men fired a shotgun at a wooden board on their property in the area of Hohenems, Schwefel, causing no danger to others. Police were notified and responded.
Two unidentified male suspects entered a bank through a skylight, held two female employees in the restroom area, stole cash from the vault, and fled without injuring anyone.
A suspected drug dealer was arrested in Viennas Ottakringer Straße with heroin, cocaine, and cash seized.
A 39-year-old man evaded police in a car, endangered pedestrians, fled on foot, and was arrested with fake IDs, altered plates, and suspected heroin.
A man was found injured and unconscious on the street in Vienna-Meidling; despite first aid, he succumbed to his injuries, and criminal involvement is being investigated.
Collision on L210 in St. Margarethen where a car hit an invalid vehicle after swerving due to a deer on the road, injuring the driver of the invalid vehicle.
A cyclist was injured after a collision with a car at the intersection of Hauptstraße and Sportplatzgasse in Parndorf.
A 19-year-old man fell 7.5 meters during photovoltaic installation in Spittal/Drau, sustaining serious injuries.
Three individuals were caught in a forest in Herzogenburg carrying softguns, using cannabis, and violating multiple laws, including traffic and drug regulations.
Motorcycle and car collided at an intersection; motorcyclist suffered severe injuries and was airlifted to the hospital.
A truck collided with a cyclist in Traiskirchen, resulting in injuries to the cyclist.

A 28-year-old woman caused a fire while cooking in Bad Vöslau. She was unable to extinguish it, leading to the evacuation of a multi-apartment building. She sustained minor burns and was hospitalized; no other injuries occurred.
Car fire caused by a technical defect at a lookout point, no injuries reported.
A man attempted to combat a rat infestation using an air rifle, leading to ricocheting bullets that slightly injured a truck driver.
A 64-year-old cyclist suffered health issues, veered off the road, and was airlifted to a hospital in Wels.
Two injured in a car collision at an intersection; one car collided with a tree.
A fire broke out in a single-family home potentially originating from a pantry. The family was safely evacuated, and the fire was controlled by firefighters. No technical malfunction was identified.
A 57-year-old man from Murtal district died after being struck by a falling tree crown during logging work when it got dislodged and hit him on the head.
A parked car in Telfs was set on fire using an accelerant, causing total damage to the vehicle but no injuries.
An 86-year-old man in Lechaschau struck a 73-year-old woman on a bicycle with his car, leading to injuries and hospitalization.
A 62-year-old woman fell on a forest path in Navis while trying to avoid a branch, suffering injuries and needing airlift rescue.
A 64-year-old Austrian woman was scammed into transferring 2500 euros to a supposed US soldier she met online.
A 77-year-old hunter in Feldkirch fired shots at cormorants near a lake, endangering nearby fishermen. Police seized his weapons and identified illegal firearm possession.
A roof truss fire occurred in a multi-family house in Klaus, Austria, caused by an electrical defect; no injuries reported.
Two workers inspecting weld seams at a power plant in Wald am Arlberg were injured by a falling rock.
A driver in Markgrafneusiedl was stopped after multiple traffic violations, including speeding and endangering others, with unsecured children in the car.
A 35-year-old driver collided with another vehicle at an intersection causing significant damage; a fake drivers license was later discovered.
A 59-year-old motorcyclist collided with a car at an intersection, sustained severe injuries, and later passed away in the hospital.
Unknown perpetrators damaged three parked cars in Innsbruck by puncturing tires on the roadside.
A locksmith attempted to charge an exorbitant fee for a door opening in Tarrenz but failed to open the door, causing significant damage and prompting a fire brigade intervention.
Two unidentified men reportedly threatened a 17-year-old with violence and stole money in Vienna.
A highly intoxicated man caused a disturbance at an employment office and was arrested for refusing to leave.
Phone scam attempts in Salzburg where callers posed as police officers and demanded cash payments; no damage caused.

A car driven by a 29-year-old woman collided with a 16-year-old moped rider on Alte Bundesstraße in Kuchl. The moped rider was injured and taken to a hospital, while the car driver was in shock and also received medical attention.
A 65-year-old man from Pongau transferred hundreds of thousands of euros to a UK-based trading firm over a year, losing money in what is suspected as fraud.
Fire broke out at a nursery, damaging property but causing no injuries; investigation into the cause is ongoing.
