Traffic analysis and incidents involving motorcycles and mopeds in Tyrol during 2019 were reported, including accidents, fatalities, violations, and enforcement measures.
A landslide in Dölsach damaged houses, a street, and a wooden hut; residents were evacuated with no injuries.
A head-on collision between two trucks resulted in one fatality and three injuries, involving additional crashes with two cars.
Two masked perpetrators robbed a store in Frömmlgasse, Vienna, injuring a 48-year-old employee with a knife and fleeing with cash.

Two 12-year-old children set a paper recycling container on fire in Sonnenallee, causing a full fire that damaged a nearby car and resulted in total losses. The offenders were identified and confessed, but are not legally accountable due to their age.

A 30-year-old man threatened a 22-year-old with a knife during a German course in Vienna and attempted to flee. He was pursued and arrested after throwing away a knife-integrated brass knuckle and being stopped by a warning shot.
A 26-year-old car driver hit a 74-year-old cyclist on a rainy road in St.Veit/Glan, causing injuries to the cyclist who was taken to a hospital.
A smoldering cigarette ash caused a couch fire in Gallizien, extinguished by the homeowner before fire services arrived.
Collision between a car and a motorcycle in Horn; motorcyclist severely injured and hospitalized.
A 16-year-old moped rider and an 80-year-old driver collided head-on, causing serious injuries to the moped rider and unspecified injuries to the driver.
A car collision occurred in Sierning involving a 55-year-old man and a 27-year-old woman, resulting in the woman being trapped in her vehicle and injured.
A man was caught driving without a license or vehicle registration, with a mismatched license plate and under the influence of drugs in Linz.
A cyclist was hit and injured by a vehicle turning into a driveway, resulting in facial injuries.
Multi-vehicle collision on B311 in St. Martin bei Lofer resulted in two injuries.
A 71-year-old man lost control of his vehicle, crashed through a wildlife fence, and was injured after ending up in a forest area.
Two Romanian men were caught at night stealing electronic devices and scrap metal from a recycling yard in Hart bei Graz.
Apartment in Graz was broken into; jewelry, cash, and a safe containing high-value items were stolen.
79-year-old farmer trapped in tractor accident in a forest; rescued and hospitalized.
A truck tipped over while unloading at Brenner Base Tunnel construction site, injuring the 51-year-old driver.
Cable fire at a power mast caused a power outage in Neustift im Stubaital affecting approximately 1600 households, with suspected material defect as the cause.
An industrial oven caught fire in Telfs, Austria; no injuries were reported, and firefighters extinguished the blaze.
A cyclist collided with a pedestrian on the bike lane in Innsbruck, causing facial injuries to the woman who later reported the incident; the cyclist left the scene after briefly stopping.
A woman in Lauterach was targeted by service scammers posing as emergency plumbers and was overcharged for a dubious repair; police were alerted and investigated the incident.
A 24-year-old man attempted to steal items from a store but was caught and detained by employees before being handed over to the police.
Two men posing as police officers were arrested during a staged handover after scamming a 70-year-old woman into withdrawing money.
87-year-old driver lost control of car in Weitensfeld, causing it to slide off the road, overturn, and injure both occupants.
An unidentified individual stole several hundred euros from the cash register of a bakery in Wolfsberg.
A car driven by a 77-year-old man was struck by a train at a level crossing, resulting in injuries to the driver and temporary rail closure.
A teenager in Bezirk Linz-Land made threatening comments with a possible Islamist tone on an online platform, targeting a 43-year-old man. Police investigations led to his identification and arrest.
An 82-year-old driver collided with a truck while attempting a U-turn, resulting in injuries and hospitalization.
A collision occurred between a car and a moped in Salzburg, leaving the 25-year-old moped driver injured.
A head-on collision involving two trucks and multiple vehicles occurred on B 68 in St. Margarethen an der Raab, resulting in one fatality and significant vehicle damage.
A 78-year-old man was rescued and hospitalized after experiencing a medical emergency during a hike on the Seetaler Alpe.
A 30-year-old man was seriously injured during forestry work in Frohnleiten, Graz-Umgebung when a falling tree caused a large branch to hit him.

A 76-year-old Austrian woman was scammed in Wörgl, with her data being stolen through a fake Amazon investment advertisement. She was persuaded to transfer money and install a program allowing remote access to her PC, resulting in significant financial losses.
A car caught fire in Lienz after smoke was noticed; no injuries reported but significant damage occurred.
A 42-year-old man in Sölden was seriously injured after dropping a heavy box on his foot while working in a grocery store. He required medical attention and was taken to a hospital in Innsbruck.
A man fell 3.5 meters from a ladder at a construction site, sustaining severe ankle injuries, and was airlifted to the hospital.
A 37-year-old woman and her 19-year-old daughter were caught shoplifting in Innsbruck; the daughter admitted to committing 15 similar thefts within a year.
A fire broke out in a garage in Wörgl due to an electrical malfunction, resulting in property damage but no injuries.
A male pretending to be an electricity meter reader entered a 90-year-old womans home in Hard, stole jewelry, and left quickly.
Drunk driver in Graz fled police and was stopped, leading to arrests for disruption and drug possession.
A 47-year-old Czech man was arrested after stealing a winter jacket in Pasching; additional stolen items were found in his vehicle, and two accomplices were later apprehended.
Police orchestra in Vienna performs a concert featuring The Lord of the Rings music.
A person broke the glass of a store entrance in Villach during the night, opened multiple drawers, but stole nothing.
During a check on a night train near Villach, Austria, a 27-year-old man from Côte d’Ivoire resisted arrest and attempted to escape but was detained.
A shop in Villach had its entrance door glass broken and was searched by an unknown offender; no theft reported.
Five arrests made in Eisenstadt for street-level cannabis trafficking involving 50 buyers and sales worth €16,000.

A 25-year-old driver collided head-on with a 32-year-old drivers car at a junction in Altschwendt, with both cars being thrown into a field, and one hitting a tree. Both drivers and an 18-year-old passenger were injured.
A car accident occurred on Hochkönigstraße (B 164) in Saalfelden when a driver turned onto the road and collided with another vehicle, causing injuries and rendering both vehicles inoperable.
A confrontation between two construction workers in Vienna escalated, leading to one man injuring another with a utility knife. The victim sustained facial cuts and was hospitalized.
Fire occurred at a recycling company in Müllendorf, likely caused by self-ignition of stored e-waste; managed by firefighters.
A 63-year-old man was seriously injured in a traffic accident when his car crashed into a guardrail and overturned on the Klippitztörl road in Kärnten during heavy rain.

Two police officers in Salzburg were injured while trying to subdue an aggressive man during a reported brawl.
77-year-old driver collided with a 19-year-old pedestrian at an intersection, causing injuries to the pedestrian.

A Slovenian dangerous goods truck was found with major technical defects during a traffic inspection and prohibited from continuing its journey.
A pedestrian in Graz was hit by a car, sustaining severe injuries due to poor visibility conditions.

A 38-year-old driver of a small truck caused a collision with a truck after failing to stop at a stop sign in Strass im Zillertal. The small truck was thrown off-road, and the truck collided with a car. Both the small truck driver and the car driver were injured and taken to the hospital.
A 59-year-old Austrian driver fatally injured in a car accident on the Inntalautobahn near Zirl.
A fraudulent individual posing as a transport company employee stole a truckload of chocolate in Bludenz; the goods were intended for Belgium but never reached their destination.
A 30-year-old Austrian man was seriously injured after falling from a truck while unloading steel plates in Kramsach.

A 79-year-old cyclist was injured when an unknown pedestrian ran onto the road, causing her to fall. The pedestrian fled by boarding a bus.
A car collided with another vehicle on a highway in Wolfurt, causing one car to overturn and trapping the driver, who was later rescued with back injury suspicions.
Two men were caught by police in an apartment with burglary tools and items such as counterfeit money, pepper spray, and drug paraphernalia.
A head-on collision occurred between two cars on the Gailtal Bundesstraße in Nötsch, causing injuries to four individuals and resulting in total damage to both vehicles.
A car caught fire due to a technical defect on Bundesstraße in Eberndorf, was completely destroyed, and the passenger suffered a shock but no physical injuries.
A 9-year-old child sank into mud near the Forstsee and was rescued by a woman and other bystanders before emergency services arrived.
69-year-old driver caused a collision with a 57-year-old woman on a municipal road in Lurnbichl, resulting in injuries to the woman, who was taken to the hospital.
Two teenagers vandalized multiple cars in Linz; one suspect was detained while the other fled.
Car overturned on a road in St. Florian, leaving the driver and passenger injured.

A 48-year-old German man fell from a height of 4-5 meters onto a concrete foundation during construction work in Untermieming and was airlifted to the hospital with unspecified injuries.
A fire occurred in a single-family house in Ebbs; the blaze was controlled by firefighters, causing property damage and leading to a 61-year-old woman being hospitalized for observation.

A 38-year-old driver lost control of his car on Walgaustraße in Satteins due to high speed, crashed into a boundary stone, and overturned into a ditch. Firefighters rescued him, and he was hospitalized with unspecified injuries.

A 10-year-old boy on a scooter was struck by a car while crossing Rheinstraße in Bregenz; the driver attempted to brake and swerve but was unable to avoid the collision. The boy was hospitalized with injuries.
A collision occurred between a company van and a car at the intersection of L190 and L193. The cars driver, a 67-year-old woman, was slightly injured and taken to the hospital.
A Serbian national was arrested for allegedly misappropriating a luxury rental car in Vienna and attempting to smuggle it across the border for resale.
A paper container and a nearby dumpster were set on fire in Hohenems; firefighters extinguished the fire.
Unknown perpetrator sprayed green paint on a parked car and a house in Seeboden.
Police conducted a traffic operation in Favoriten and Simmering, resulting in multiple citations including impaired driving due to drugs and alcohol, and technical vehicle issues.
A 54-year-old man attempted to coerce a bank employee in Wels by threatening to retrieve a weapon. He fled but was arrested upon returning to the bank.
An 18-year-old attempted two robberies in Traun, assaulting victims when they resisted, and was later apprehended by police.
An unknown suspect stole a wallet and used the stolen bank card for cash withdrawals and luxury purchases in Bad Ischl.
Unknown suspect stole a card and used it to withdraw money and make purchases.
Police in Vienna stopped a 16-year-old driver without a license, found drugs and cash, arrested him after a chase, and discovered he sold drugs to his 21-year-old passenger.
A 47-year-old man accidentally injured his leg with a grinder while cutting iron rods at a construction site in St. Kanzian am Klopeinersee.
A 22-year-old worker was injured on his left hand while operating a forklift in St. Veit an der Glan.
A car driven by an 18-year-old collided with a 77-year-old pedestrian on B 20 in Rotheau, resulting in the pedestrians death.

A 56-year-old man died in a traffic accident on the S4 near Neudörfl after his car skidded on an icy road and collided with another vehicle.

A taskforce in Lower Austria uncovered extensive social benefits fraud with damages near four million Euros, involving false claims and deception to receive unemployment benefits, pensions, and other social aid.
A 52-year-old driver lost control on an icy road, hitting a tree and dying at the accident scene.
A hit-and-run traffic accident occurred in Ehrwald, with the driver damaging a traffic sign. Following a trail, police found the vehicle and seized cannabis from the drivers home.
Two men were arrested after stealing a bicycle and loading it into a car in Vienna. The stolen bicycle and burglary tools were seized.
Two teenagers attempted to break into a pizzeria by forcing a window but fled without entering. They were arrested nearby and confessed.
An 81-year-old woman driving a car struck a 52-year-old pedestrian at a crosswalk in Klagenfurt, causing injuries of unknown severity.
A 28-year-old man in Spittal/Drau caused a traffic accident while driving under the influence. His car was heavily damaged, but he remained uninjured. His drivers license was confiscated.
A drunk driver attempted to evade a police checkpoint but was intercepted and tested for a blood alcohol concentration of 1.64 promille.
A Romanian couple was caught stealing coins from a church donation box in Neuhofen an der Krems and arrested by police after being observed by a local resident.
A 49-year-old man in Linz was stopped for a traffic check, found with drugs, presented a fake license, and exhibited signs of drug impairment.
Collision between two cyclists on a bike path in Salzburg, resulting in injuries to one cyclist.

A heavily intoxicated local man was caught driving his car on the B163 in Flachau after being observed by a witness; his license was revoked and charges were filed.
Two vehicles collided on the B72 Weizer Straße, causing five injuries and significant vehicle damage.
A 75-year-old pedestrian was hit and seriously injured by a 25-year-old car driver while crossing the street in Graz.
A one-year-old child suffered an electric shock after inserting a plug into an unsecured socket but appeared unharmed; taken to the hospital for precautionary observation.
An 89-year-old woman was rescued by police, firefighters, and paramedics after being found dehydrated and on the floor of her home in Feldkirchen bei Graz, following a fall two to three days earlier.
Two cars collided at an intersection in Hopfgarten causing one person to be injured and significant vehicle damage.
A 28-year-old German driver hit a 79-year-old Austrian woman on a pedestrian crossing in Ehrwald; the woman was injured and taken to the hospital.
A man in Weer conducted shooting exercises with a legally owned rifle, leading to a police operation including EKO Cobra and a helicopter due to concerns about gunfire.

A 25-year-old Hungarian man was caught breaking into multiple basement compartments; arrested with stolen goods and burglary tools in his possession.
A man threatened his girlfriend with a knife in their apartment; she escaped and called the police. He was arrested without resistance, and his alcohol level was measured at 2.3 per mille.
An armed man threatened staff and stole cash from a supermarket office in Vienna, then fled; no injuries were reported.
A man drove at 99 km/h, ran a red light, and was arrested due to unpaid fines in Vienna.
Hydraulic oil leak from a forestry machine in Magdalensberg; fire brigade contained the spill.
A car collision occurred in Mörtschach, causing injuries to three individuals and total damage to both vehicles.
A 43-year-old woman injured her thumb while operating a cable clamping machine in Feldkirchen, Austria, and was taken to the hospital.
A 70-year-old woman was injured while hiking on the Hohen Gallin in Techelsberg. She tripped over a root, injuring her ankle, and was rescued by the mountain rescue team.

A 19-year-old driver on a probationary license was caught driving at 223 km/h on the A1 and committed multiple traffic violations before being stopped by police. His license and car keys were confiscated, and he faces charges.
A Georgian man was stopped in Linz, found to be unlicensed and under the influence of drugs with marijuana in his possession; he refused a drug test and was declared unfit to drive.
Two unidentified individuals, apparently intoxicated, vandalized property, assaulted a man, and fled after a confrontation in Uttendorf.
A driver in Thalgau with excessive speed and no license led a car chase, fled on foot, and was found to be intoxicated.

Unknown perpetrators broke into an apartment in Bischofshofen, stealing several items. Investigations are ongoing.
A 41-year-old woman sustained severe injuries after slipping on snow during a descent in alpine terrain, requiring rescue and hospitalization.
A 55-year-old man was seriously injured while using a freight elevator in Schwarzautal when his arm got caught between the masonry and the lift.
A car accident occurred in St. Kathrein am Offenegg when a vehicle slid off the snowy road, rolled down a slope, and came to rest on its wheels. Two occupants were injured and brought to a hospital.
A 21-year-old man was injured during woodwork in a forest in Umhausen, requiring helicopter rescue after a tree rolled onto his left leg.
A fire broke out in a 19-year-old womans attic room in Kramsach due to a self-igniting laptop battery, causing damage to the room and roof; no one was injured.

Fire in a multi-apartment building in Baumkirchen, likely caused by an electrical defect; five people hospitalized for suspected smoke inhalation.

A paraglider lost altitude shortly after takeoff, collided with a tree, and fell while attempting to climb down, suffering minor injuries.
A 22-year-old man and his 19-year-old accomplice were arrested for multiple thefts, including breaking into a coffee machine, with evidence found during a police vehicle check.
A handbag was stolen from an unlocked car parked at a store in Rum, causing a low four-digit financial loss. The victim was a 21-year-old Hungarian woman.

A physical altercation occurred in Nenzing involving a 46-year-old man disapproving of his daughters relationship with a 25-year-old man; multiple family members later disrupted police proceedings and clashed further.
A 19-year-old Serbian national was arrested for suspected drug dealing after selling heroin to four individuals, with additional heroin and cash found during a search.
A fire damaged a barn and a thatched-roof residential building in Grieselstein; no injuries or danger to people or animals reported.
Car accident on B 121 near Amstetten resulted in two people being injured and trapped inside the vehicle, requiring rescue by the fire department.
Two drivers engaged in a street race in Wels, reaching speeds of 120 km/h in a 50 km/h zone before being stopped by police; one driver showed reckless behavior with children and a partner in the car.
A woodpile caught fire in Baumkirchen; the fire was swiftly controlled by the local fire brigade.
A German couple got lost in deep snow and steep terrain during a hike in Achenkirch and were rescued uninjured by a police helicopter.
A 63-year-old female hunter slipped on a concealed branch, fell, and injured her ankle; she was rescued and transported to the hospital.
Two male teenagers caused damage to a sliding glass door in a parking garage in Imst using a stone; both were later identified, detained, and confessed.
Police officers performed first aid, including CPR and defibrillation, to save a collapsed mans life at a subway station in Vienna.
A 53-year-old man was attacked and injured with a scooter in Wr. Neustadt by two individuals, a 19-year-old woman and a 32-year-old man, who were later arrested and confessed involvement.
A 39-year-old Serbian man went missing from a ship in Linz; potential accident suspected.

A man in Uttendorf was assaulted and lightly injured by two unknown, allegedly intoxicated individuals who vandalized his garden, threw a can at his car, and pushed him to the ground. One suspect was later identified and admitted to being intoxicated during the incident.
Two teenagers recorded and shared a private phone call with a policeman on social media, suspected of misuse of recording equipment.
A pedestrian was hit by a vehicle that fled the scene in Bad Bleiberg, causing injuries.
An unidentified man broke into a bakery in Klagenfurt a.W. through a ground-floor window and escaped by climbing a drainpipe onto a roof before disappearing from view.
A car collision occurred in Feldkirchen, Austria, resulting in injuries to one woman and total damage to both vehicles.
An altercation involving physical assault and threats occurred in Henndorf between a 40-year-old man, a 30-year-old man, and his wife, with all parties being intoxicated.
Several individuals were caught cheating during a theoretical driving test using hidden devices and impersonation.
Unknown perpetrators set fire to wood in a barn and a woodpile near a single-family home in Going am Wilden Kaiser; fires were extinguished without injuries or major damage.
A garden shed caught fire in Klagenfurt am Wörthersee; suspected cause is improperly disposed ash.
An 85-year-old man dressed inadequately for the cold temperatures wandered off, prompting a search operation; he was later found unharmed and returned to his family.
Unknown perpetrators set two garbage containers on fire near an apartment building in Salzburg, causing damage to the building but no injuries.
High-value car reported as stolen in Germany was seized by police in Vienna during routine patrol; driver was a 30-year-old Croatian national.
Three drug dealers were arrested in Vienna following house searches that uncovered drugs and cash.
A 22-year-old man smashed a car window with an axe, injuring the other driver slightly. He resisted arrest and injured two police officers.
A car accident occurred on Loiblpassstraße in Ferlach, where a woman and her husband were injured after their vehicle went off the road and into a brook.
A 41-year-old man was seriously injured after crashing his vehicle into a tree and falling into a stream. He was rescued and resuscitated by emergency services.
A truck carrying sodium hydroxide solution veered off the road in Klein St. Veit, but no hazardous material leaked, and the load was safely transferred.

A 20-year-old man and his 19-year-old girlfriend were caught for drug offenses, including selling heroin, cocaine, MDMA, and XTC tablets in various locations in Austria. Police also seized drugs and a CO2 gun.

A 28-year-old man without a drivers license attempted to flee from the police in Haid, driving at excessive speeds and committing traffic violations. The suspect showed signs of drug influence but refused a medical examination and behaved aggressively during the incident.
A 47-year-old woman fell asleep while driving, causing a collision with a parked car and a garden fence; she and her daughter sustained minor injuries.
A car veered into the opposite lane on the Donaubundesstraße, causing a collision and resulting in injuries to one person.
A former farmhouse turned apartment building in Steinhaus caught fire and suffered an explosion; no injuries reported, cause under investigation.
A head-on collision occurred due to evasive maneuver, injuring four people in Kirchberg an der Raab, Austria.
A 27-year-old drove into the rear of a light vehicle, severely injuring the 59-year-old driver, with the accident involving an unregistered car and a positive alcohol test for the 27-year-old.
A 30-year-old woman in Weiz attempted to rob two girls aged 12 and 13 by threatening them with a knife. The girls escaped, and the suspect was arrested.
An 88-year-old pedestrian was severely injured after being hit by a car while crossing the street in Leoben.
A 21-year-old man damaged 12 parked vehicles in Innsbruck and was apprehended near the scene.
A 14-year-old Bulgarian assaulted a 14-year-old Austrian during a leisure event in Innsbruck, causing facial injuries.
A 28-year-old man and two others fell from approximately two meters on a construction site in Dölsach during a concreting operation, causing him shoulder injuries.

A 19-year-old driver collided with a 54-year-old driver near the Achraintunnel in Dornbirn. The 54-year-olds car ended up in a ditch, and she was hospitalized with unspecified injuries. All three cars involved sustained significant damage.
Two vehicles collided at a right angle on Rudener Straße in Völkermarkt, injuring a 32-year-old man.

A 36-year-old woman fell from three to four meters while climbing at Prossetwände in Winzendorf and was airlifted to the hospital with injuries of unspecified severity.

A 31-year-old man suffered mild smoke inhalation while attempting to extinguish a fire in an unoccupied house in Mittergoggitsch. The fire was believed to have started due to an electrical short circuit, and firefighters successfully extinguished it.

A hiker slipped on a stone and suffered a severe arm injury while walking on a trail below the Grasjochbahn at Hochjoch. She was airlifted to a hospital after first aid.
Avalanche covered part of a road in Wipptal; no injuries or damage reported.
A 52-year-old Serbian citizen stole diesel from a gas station and led police on a high-speed chase on the A1 highway, later found with 1.18% alcohol in his system.
A man was arrested in Vienna after selling cocaine, leading to house searches where large sums of cash, weapons, and cocaine were seized.

A fire occurred in a single-family house in Raach am Hochgebirge; an 86-year-old female resident was hospitalized for suspected smoke inhalation. The fire was likely caused by a faulty heating blanket.
A car slid off a corporate site in Krumbach and rolled down a slope, injuring the passenger.
A 19-year-old driver lost control of her car and struck a tree, resulting in injuries and a positive alcohol test.
A tractor caught fire in a riding hall, igniting stored hay and destroying the roof structure. No people or animals were injured.
Unidentified perpetrators broke into a construction site in Graz, Bezirk Gries, stealing building materials and damaging freshly laid screed.
Two men impersonating police officers stole cash and jewelry from an 84-year-old mans apartment in Graz.
A woman confessed to throwing an activists doll into the Inn river in Innsbruck, stating the act was not politically motivated.
Police announced video and audio recordings to prevent dangerous attacks around a football match in Innsbruck.
A 17-year-old driver lost control of his car on a wet road in Thannhausen, hitting a tree stump and injuring himself and three passengers, all taken to a hospital.
A Polish man aged 30 drove his car off the road on the Inntalautobahn near Stams, causing the vehicle to overturn and land on its roof, resulting in injuries and significant damage to the car.
A 37-year-old Austrian man was arrested on suspicion of shoplifting two razors from a drugstore. The items were recovered, and the man is suspected of habitual theft.
An intoxicated man attempted to break into an apartment in Vienna-Leopoldstadt using a metallic object, but fled after the tenant defended himself with a hammer. The suspect was arrested nearby.
A man found a likely functional World War II mortar shell using a metal detector; it was safely removed by the Austrian army bomb disposal team.
Police discovered a small marijuana plantation and jars of dried cannabis in a mans apartment; he claimed it was for personal use and was reported at large.
Collapse of a stable roof due to heavy snow load in Heiligenblut caused no injuries; animals inside were unhurt.

A driver under the influence of THC and cocaine was stopped by police in St. Martin, Linz-Land. The man had no license, the car was unregistered, and false plates were used. He was found unfit to drive.
During a birthday party, a man was injured in both eyes due to a prank involving a fire extinguisher.
A 45-year-old man in Linz confessed to making a bomb threat due to anger toward nightclub bouncers; he was apprehended and reported to the authorities.
A farm building in Fehring caught fire on Saturday evening, with explosions accelerating the blaze and the structure burning down completely. No injuries were reported.
A car collided with a bicyclist in Graz, seriously injuring the cyclist.
Two cars collided at an intersection, causing three injuries and total damage to both vehicles.
A 25-year-old woman was sexually assaulted by an unknown man in the stairwell of her residence in Graz while waiting for the elevator.
A sauna hut in St. Margarethen an der Raab caught fire due to heat radiation, causing significant damage but no injuries.
A roof fire occurred in Altaussee caused by heating material during roofing work, with no injuries but significant property damage.
Unknown perpetrator broke into a store in Neu Arzl, Innsbruck, but stole nothing; police investigation ongoing.
A woman in Innsbruck was assaulted and robbed of a water bottle she was holding, with the perpetrator fleeing the scene.
A 26-year-old skier fell off a slope in Scheffau and was injured, requiring helicopter transport to a hospital.
A collision occurred at an intersection in Rankweil involving two vehicles, resulting in injuries to three individuals and significant vehicle damage.
Police officers in Vienna successfully rescued a weakened and disoriented parrot near the central station.
A traffic collision occurred at an intersection involving two vehicles, causing one car to flip and injure three people who required emergency medical care.
Three suspects were arrested after breaking into a shop, smashing the glass door, and stealing cigarettes; a knuckle-duster was discovered during the search.
A woman entered a house in Maria Rain but left immediately upon being noticed, leading to her identification as a suspect in a prior theft.
A traffic collision in Ruden resulted in minor injuries to three people and total loss of both vehicles.

Two men were accused of shooting at wooden boxes and boards on a company property in Traiskirchen. Several weapons, including hunting rifles and ammunition, as well as substances like cocaine, were seized. A temporary weapon ban was issued, and the investigation is ongoing.
A car driven by a 69-year-old man collided with a tractors trailer in Ziersdorf due to a suspected medical condition, leading to injuries and hospitalization.

A 64-year-old man was injured while performing forestry work in Trattenbach after being struck on the thigh by a moving tree. He sustained serious injuries but managed to seek help and was hospitalized.
A 54-year-old man fell 2.6 meters from a concrete wall onto a floor while working on a construction site in Wiener Neudorf, sustaining serious injuries. He was airlifted to the hospital.
A drunk driver with 2.86 per mille crashed into a roadside post and got stuck on an embankment in Ried district.
An intoxicated driver collided with a train, causing no injuries but resulting in a temporary railway closure.
A Romanian driver under the influence of drugs collided with a police car in Ried im Innkreis and was found unfit to drive.
Two unidentified individuals attempted to break into construction containers in Grödig but fled when spotted.

A 16-year-old driver was caught speeding at 135 km/h on a 70 km/h road in Salzburg and attempted to evade police. The car was later found, and investigations revealed both the driver and a passenger lacked valid licenses.
A bus driver was robbed in Kuchl, Salzburg, threatened with a suspected weapon and hit on the head before the attacker fled with the drivers money pouch.
A security staff member in Graz was spat on by a man after requesting him to wear a mask in the train station; the man was detained and reported for multiple violations including Covid regulations.
An 87-year-old driver accidentally drove off the road, crashing and injuring himself. The vehicle fell 12 meters and hit a house. He was airlifted to a hospital.
Fire broke out in an office kitchenette causing property damage but no injuries.
A truck tipped onto its side at a highway entrance in Vogau, lightly injuring the 33-year-old driver.
Pedestrian was injured in a hit-and-run collision with a cyclist in Innsbruck.
A fire broke out in the outdoor area of a house under renovation in Dornbirn-Rohrbach due to self-ignition of oil-soaked cloths; no one was injured.
A bakery delivery driver was attacked by two assailants, hit with a weapon, and robbed of a significant amount of cash in Bregenz.
An 88-year-old pedestrian and a 33-year-old motorcyclist collided on a wet road in Reichhub, resulting in serious injuries for the pedestrian.
A police vehicle was involved in a collision with another car during an emergency ride in Ried im Innkreis, resulting in injuries to both drivers and the police passenger.
Two hunting dogs attacked a horse and its rider in Gutau, causing the rider to fall and suffer injuries, with the dogs attempting to bite both the horse and rider before being stopped by the owner.

A 28-year-old man in Hohenems resisted police intervention following a reported brawl. He attempted to hit and kick officers but was eventually arrested, having a blood alcohol level of 1.5 per mille.
A heavily intoxicated Slovenian man attacked police officers in a residential building in Liezen and was arrested.
Unknown perpetrator sprayed graffiti on the rear wall of a gas station in Hopfgarten im Brixental.
A bakery delivery driver in Bregenz was robbed of a large sum of money stored in an aluminum briefcase during a delivery.
A 20-year-old accidentally shot a 29-year-old with a shotgun during a hunting event, causing injuries of unknown severity.
Three Romanian men broke into a garden house in Feldkirch and attempted another break-in but were caught by a police dog team. They were arrested with stolen car tires in their possession.
A brutal robbery occurred on a bakery delivery person in Bregenz, where the victim was attacked with violence, robbed, and hospitalized with severe injuries.

A man harassed and inappropriately touched three women in different staircases in Graz. The incidents occurred in November 2019, and the police are seeking information about the suspect while providing safety tips.
A woman had her wallet and bank card stolen, and the card was used at an ATM to withdraw a three-digit sum.
Car collision involving a 19-year-old and an 18-year-old on L 188 caused injury to one driver and significant vehicle damage.
A truck driver veered off the road to avoid a deer, slightly injuring himself and damaging his vehicle.

A 25-year-old man unauthorizedly operated a car in Hermagor, crashed it into a guardrail, and fled the scene. Later, he was found nearby by taxi passengers, denied driving, but tested positive for alcohol.
A 23-year-old moped rider crashed and fled the scene in Pichlern; later found and tested positive for alcohol.

Two cars collided head-on on L 1162 in St. Roman, Austria, after an intoxicated driver veered into the oncoming lane, causing both vehicles to be thrown into a nearby field, resulting in injuries to both drivers.

A Belgian driver and his passenger were involved in a car crash on the Tauernautobahn near the Katschbergtunnel. Their car overturned and was struck by another vehicle. Both Belgians sustained injuries and were taken to the hospital.
Two drivers in Bischofshofen were caught under the influence of alcohol; one tried to evade police and both had their licenses revoked.
A waiter and a man got into a physical altercation in a bar in Salzburg after the man harassed several women. Both were reported for respective offenses.
A taxi driver was assaulted by a passenger who kicked him in the face during a dispute over payment; the suspects fled the scene.
A man was attacked in Mentlgasse, Innsbruck, robbed of his wallet and assaulted by two offenders who fled afterwards.
Chimney fire in a company building with residential units in Dornbirn; evacuation of 17 residents due to smoke, no injuries reported.
Hit-and-run accident at an intersection, with a driver running a red light and injuring another driver.
A man under the influence of drugs attacked officers during a traffic stop and attempted to flee, later disposing of drugs before being arrested.
A man broke into a car at a park-and-ride area in Parndorf using a stone and was later identified and arrested with stolen items.
A 54-year-old man caused a car accident after swerving to avoid wildlife and left the scene; later found by police under the influence of alcohol and his license was confiscated.

A 62-year-old man was pinned between a car and a wall near a garage driveway and was rescued by firefighters before being taken to the hospital.
A 28-year-old man nearly plunged into Hallstättersee after losing control of his car, which was stopped by trees. No injuries occurred, and the car was recovered with minor damages.
Two vehicles collided head-on on B154 in Mondsee, causing injuries to both drivers and total damage to the cars.
A verbal argument between two employees in a Salzburg pizzeria escalated, resulting in one injuring the other with a headbutt to the nose.
A 20-year-old was found with a small amount of cannabis and admitted to driving after consuming it; license temporarily revoked.
A female driver caused a traffic accident by driving against the prescribed direction, leading to a collision and property damage but no injuries.
An E-Bike rider collided with a car and sustained injuries in Ludersdorf-Wilfersdorf, Bezirk Weiz.
A 17-year-old driver in Mureck, Austria lost control of his car, hit a tree, and was severely injured.
A 49-year-old man was arrested in Graz for committing multiple thefts between November 16 and November 23, including burglaries in restaurants and medical offices, and was found with stolen items.
Fire in a woodworking shops basement in Ried im Oberinntal caused by a wall-mounted fan and heating pipe insulation igniting; significant property damage but no injuries.
Fire in an apartment in Telfs caused by a candle, extinguished by a neighbor and the fire department. A 71-year-old resident suffered suspected smoke inhalation.
Two teenagers were threatened by a man with a CO2 pistol while parked in Wörgl, Austria; the man denied threatening them and had his weapons confiscated.
A 17-year-old girl was attacked and injured by three unknown individuals in Hofgarten, Innsbruck.
A food delivery man was arrested in Vienna for using a fake Portuguese drivers license, driving without a valid vehicle registration, and being unlawfully present in the country.
Two loose Beagle dogs were found by police on Höhenstraße, taken to the station, identified through their chips, and returned to their owner.
A Polish shoplifter attempted robbery using pepper spray to attack a store detective, causing injuries to three employees before being restrained and arrested.
A man drove under the influence of drugs, evaded police while disobeying traffic rules, and was caught with a small amount of cannabis.
An unidentified thief stole two bottles of whiskey in a supermarket in Klagenfurt and hit a female store detective during an altercation before escaping.
A 78-year-old man in Klagenfurt was struck by a reversing truck and sustained unclassified injuries.
A heater caught fire in the cellar of a house, with no injuries reported and the fire quickly extinguished by firefighters.
A 28-year-old man was injured during tree felling work in steep forest terrain in Alt-Ossiach, requiring a rescue operation.
A traffic accident involving a truck and a van occurred on the B4 near Heldenberg, leaving one person injured and requiring rescue by the fire department.

A 77-year-old woman attempted to overtake a truck in foggy conditions on the B 17 in Teesdorf, resulting in a collision with multiple vehicles. She was killed at the scene, and an 83-year-old man and his 81-year-old wife sustained serious injuries.
A 19-year-old man was seriously injured when a pallet of paving stones fell from a forklift at a warehouse in Bruck an der Leitha.
A 22-year-old Romanian man wanted on an arrest warrant and banned from Austria was detained during a bus inspection on the A8 in Suben.
An 18-year-old driver under the influence of alcohol caused a head-on collision on Treubacher Landesstraße, Altheim, injuring a 22-year-old.
A 67-year-old man died during a hike on the Soleleitungsweg in Hallstatt, prompting rescue efforts.
An 18-year-old driver lost control of his car on the B136 in St. Roman, crashing into a tree and causing injuries to himself and a 16-year-old passenger.
A pedestrian was hit by a car while crossing a protected path on the B138 in Sattledt, resulting in serious injuries.
Three Bulgarian suspects were arrested for trafficking and distributing large amounts of cocaine and methamphetamine in Upper Austria.
A 20-year-old Turkish driver was caught using a fake Polish drivers license during a routine police check.
An apartment in Bischofshofen was broken into, cash and watches were stolen.

Collision between two cars in Weinitzen, Austria. Both drivers injured; 76-year-old man was heavily intoxicated and hospitalized, while 59-year-old woman suffered minor injuries. Significant vehicle damage reported.
A candle caused a small fire in an apartment in Liezen; no injuries occurred.
Apartment fire caused by an electronic defect leading to significant damage.
A cellar compartment in a residential building in Innsbruck was broken into and items including fishing gear and a cuckoo clock were stolen.

A paper container was set on fire near a school entrance in Hard, Austria; suspected arson with no major damages due to quick response by a passerby and firefighters.
A Romanian man wanted by the Linz prosecutor for property crimes was arrested during a traffic control in Katzenberg.
A store in Innsbruck was broken into, with various electronics and cash stolen.
A Latvian man was arrested in Kemeten, Austria, for human trafficking after being caught transporting five undocumented Syrian nationals.
Unknown suspects broke into a store in Rohrbach-Berg and stole 14 mobile phones, leaving other expensive devices behind.
A 20-year-old driver committed multiple speeding violations and reckless driving in Salzburg and Upper Austria, resulting in license confiscation.
A 51-year-old man was injured after colliding with a car door and falling while crossing the road in Innsbruck.
A 67-year-old man caused a disturbance at the Mondsee Advent market, became aggressive towards police, attempted to strike an officer, and issued a threat before being arrested.
Three intoxicated youths attacked a taxi driver, one kicking him in the face, during a fare dispute in Telfs. They fled the scene but were later identified and confessed.
A tractor was stolen in Liebing, Austria and later found in Hungary. The perpetrator remains unidentified.

A Hungarian fraud group was arrested in Austria for posting fake ads and using counterfeit payment confirmations to deceive sellers. The investigation revealed the use of false identities and numerous fraudulent transactions.
Driver caught speeding at 134 km/h in a 50 km/h zone in Austria and reported to authorities.
Collision on the Westautobahn near Salzburg between a truck and a car; one person injured and transported to a hospital.
Seven individuals were arrested in Leibnitz and Südoststeiermark for drug trafficking, involving large quantities of substances sold over three years.
An unregistered truck caught fire early in the morning in Graz and was extinguished by firefighters. No one was injured.
Warning issued about phone scam targeting elderly victims with false claims to extract money.
A 45-year-old man lost control of his car due to icy roads on the B 80a near Völkermarkt, causing the car to overturn. He was injured and hospitalized.
A car accident occurred involving two vehicles when one driver failed to yield while making a left turn, resulting in injuries to the other driver.
A 34-year-old man in Graz was scammed after investing thousands of euros in cryptocurrency through a possibly fake trading platform.
Two cars collided at an intersection in Vienna, leaving three of the five occupants with minor injuries.
Three men attacked and robbed a 59-year-old man in an apartment building in Vienna-Döbling, injuring him before police arrested the suspects nearby.
A shoplifter attacked and injured a police officer during an altercation in Vienna.
Explosion and fire occurred in a distillery during the filling process of a boiler, causing injuries and significant property damage.

A 21-year-old driver was caught speeding at 230 km/h in a 100 km/h zone; drivers license was revoked on the spot.
An intoxicated driver caused an accident in Perg, fled on foot, but was caught by paramedics.
A cyclist collided with a bus during an overtaking maneuver in Schärding, resulting in injuries to the cyclist.
A collision occurred between a car and a cyclist in Graz, leaving the cyclist with severe leg injuries.
An 89-year-old woman fell off her bicycle on a sidewalk in Innsbruck, suffering a head injury.
Skier collision in Hochgurgl involving a Dutch and German skier; the German skier was injured and airlifted to a hospital.
A 29-year-old worker fell 4 meters while performing roof work in Lienz and was injured.
Fire broke out involving a horse carriage in Söll, spreading to an outbuilding but was prevented from reaching the residential building by firefighters.
Two Syrian nationals were arrested in Lockenhaus for smuggling 19 undocumented individuals into Austria; one was caught using a drone and a police dog.
A 74-year-old mans truck collided with a road barrier on the Tauernautobahn due to suspected microsleep, injuring him and his 37-year-old passenger.
A knife-wielding man robbed a gas station and was later identified and arrested by police in Wolfsberg.
A car accident occurred in Ebenthal in Kärnten due to icy roads, resulting in injuries to two individuals.

A driver without a license caused a high-speed pursuit involving dangerous traffic violations and collisions with police vehicles on the A 2 highway in Lower Austria and Styria. The chase ended in Schäffern, where the vehicle was immobilized.
A 16-year-old was caught hiding stolen beer and wine, threatened and assaulted a police officer, and was arrested.
A 49-year-old cyclist was hit by a cars side mirror and injured after the driver was partially blinded by oncoming headlights and under the influence of alcohol.
A tractor with a trailer showing severe defects was stopped in Salzburg. The unbraked trailer was later found again improperly used despite warnings. The driver faces multiple charges.
Cyclist collided with an e-bike rider on a bike path in Salzburg and fled the scene; the woman sustained a hand injury.
A 71-year-old pedestrian was hit by a small truck, driven by a 35-year-old, while crossing the road in St. Johann. She was seriously injured and taken to the hospital.
Fire broke out in the heating room of a single-family home; firefighters extinguished it, causing heavy damage but no injuries.
Apartment fire in Graz caused by a cigarette; no injuries reported.

An 18-year-old under the influence of alcohol caused a single-vehicle accident in Langkampfen, hitting a traffic sign and driving into shallow water. He sustained injuries and required rescue and medical attention.
A 17-year-old drove her car through a red light in Innsbruck, colliding with another car driven by a 34-year-old woman. Both cars were heavily damaged, and two individuals sustained minor injuries.
An unknown perpetrator broke a car window and stole a handbag containing a wallet and five passports in Innsbruck.
A 63-year-old hiker got lost in rugged terrain near Neustift im Stubaital, was rescued by helicopter, and taken to a clinic with potential heart attack symptoms.
Worker in Sonntag fell from a scaffolding during solar panel installation, suffering severe head injuries.
A Serbian group, including a former member of the Dalton gang, was caught in the act of a burglary in Vienna; tools and stolen items were confiscated, over 30,000 euros in damage reported.
Unidentified perpetrators damaged a truck by cutting 14 cables and wiring systems, causing thousands of euros in damage.
Unidentified individuals broke into a clubroom in the Klagenfurt district, stealing cash and causing significant damage to the entrance door.
A 20-year-old from Steyr set ablaze a car after removing its license plates in order to destroy evidence of traffic accidents he caused.
Intoxicated 62-year-old man attacked police officers in Altaussee, injuring an officer.
Two Nigerian nationals were arrested in Vienna for suspicion of drug dealing after being found with cocaine and cash, while an Italian buyer was also reported.
A 23-year-old woman was sexually harassed in a grocery store in Graz by the shop owner. Separately, in Feldbach, a 44-year-old man was arrested for allegedly abusing his wife for years.
A 70-year-old woman caused a rear-end collision in Nenzing, injuring a 36-year-old man, while driving under the influence of alcohol.
Unknown perpetrators stole 1230 kilograms of copper cables prepared along a railway track, causing significant financial damage.
A fire was intentionally set in the basement of a multi-apartment building in Klagenfurt, resulting in the evacuation of residents and three individuals suffering from smoke inhalation.
A 14-year-old without a license drove a car without permission from Kitzbühel towards Oberösterreich and was stopped by police.
Unidentified individuals broke into a jewelry store in Graz, Bezirk Gries, and stole several rings of unknown value using a sledgehammer to smash the stores entrance. They escaped in a stolen car.
An 83-year-old man who went missing from a nursing home was found on the premises of a car dealership in St. Veit/Glan with minor hand injuries and taken back to the nursing home.
A homeless man was robbed and attacked by two unidentified men outside a snack bar in Graz.
A 35-year-old man died in a car accident on the old B-70 road between Krottendorf and Voitsberg, as his vehicle veered off the road and overturned multiple times.
A 22-year-old man was arrested in Vienna for selling heroin and cocaine; drugs and cash were seized.

A man was severely injured at a gas station in Neusiedl am See when his finger was caught between his car door and a truck. The truck driver fled the scene without exchanging details, and the search for the vehicle is ongoing.

A 58-year-old driver collided with two pedestrians on a sidewalk near LB 18 in Hainfeld, causing injuries; both were taken to a hospital.
An elderly man with a walker was fatally struck and dragged by a lorry, whose driver did not notice the incident and continued driving.
A 32-year-old driver in Austria lost control of his vehicle, which overturned, after consuming alcohol and attempting to avoid cyclists.
A fire broke out in a multi-family house in Vöcklamarkt. The owner alerted authorities, and the fire was quickly extinguished. No injuries were reported.
A 14-month-old boy fell from a window and sustained severe head injuries in Bezirk Vöcklabruck, Austria.
Fraudulent friendship requests on social networks are used to obtain mobile numbers and SMS codes to activate payment services, causing financial harm to victims.
Burglars entered a building in Maxglan via an unlocked door, stealing a safe, a bank card, and cash from a built-in safe, later withdrawing money from an ATM nearby.
Two masked and armed men robbed a tobacco store in Salzburg, threatening the employee and fleeing with cash.
A drunk driver in Obertauern crashed while driving on the B99, causing his vehicle to overturn. He was uninjured with a blood alcohol level of 2 promille.
An 80-year-old woman in Graz was rescued from her apartment after being found unable to stand following a fall.
A kitchen fire occurred in Graz due to unattended cooking oil; no injuries were reported.
A dryer caught fire in Lechaschau due to a suspected technical defect; the homeowner partially extinguished the fire, and fire services completed the task. No injuries were reported.
Car collided with a train at an unguarded level crossing in Musau, resulting in total car damage but no injuries.
Two Austrian skiers collided on a slope at Hintertux Glacier, resulting in injuries; one transported to the hospital and the other airlifted to a clinic.
A skiing collision occurred at Hintertux Glacier involving a 31-year-old German woman and a 61-year-old German man; the man suffered a knee injury and the woman sustained severe internal injuries.

A fire broke out in a powder coating machine at a production facility in Höchst, likely caused by a technical defect, and was extinguished by the fire department. No injuries were reported.
Two men were arrested at separate locations in Vienna, one on a European arrest warrant for property offenses and another for suspicion of making dangerous threats.
A man stole a bottle from a store and threatened a security guard with death to avoid being detained, leading to his arrest.
A man was threatened with a knife, insulted with antisemitic remarks, and had his kippa stolen by an unknown woman. The suspect fled and police were unable to locate her.
A paper waste container caught fire in Klagenfurt and was extinguished by the fire brigade, causing damage worth several hundred euros.
A collision occurred between a car driven by a 20-year-old man and a 72-year-old pedestrian in St. Andrä iL., resulting in the pedestrian being injured and taken to the hospital.
A collision occurred between two cars in Villach, Austria, resulting in injuries to a 63-year-old woman.
A smoldering fire started during roof repair work in Klagenfurt district and later broke out, but was quickly extinguished by firefighters.
A car and a truck collided on the B 7 in Drasenhofen, resulting in serious injury to the female car driver and significant vehicle damage.
A car lost control and collided with a truck on B 210 in Tribuswinkel, causing an additional rear-end collision; one person was seriously injured.
A collision occurred in Minichhofen between two cars; a 63-year-old woman sustained injuries and was taken to a hospital.
A woman in Linz fell and was found unresponsive in her home with smoke due to burnt food; she was taken to the hospital for possible smoke inhalation.
A 19-year-old driver in Linz was attacked with a glass bottle by another driver after being followed and harassed; the attacker fled the scene.

Worker accidentally shot a nail into his hand while using a nail gun and was taken to the hospital.

An 83-year-old man was injured in a tractor accident when his vehicle left the road and overturned on a steep slope in Fladnitz an der Teichalm.

A pedestrian in Innsbruck was injured after being hit by an unknown cyclist from behind, resulting in facial injuries.

A man driving a vehicle on the A2 near Ilz was caught with forged Czech identity documents and later claimed to be from Russia, requesting asylum.
Two suspects were caught stealing donation box money in Batschuns after being stopped by police.

Traffic safety campaign in Schwechat involved free light checks and bulb replacements by police and ÖAMTC for vehicles with lighting defects.

A car crashed unbraked into the side of a semi-truck in Wutschein, causing significant damage and requiring the injured driver, who was moderately intoxicated, to be extracted using hydraulic equipment.
