Car rear-ended a truck, injuring the car driver and causing significant damage to the car.
A car accident caused by inattention on the Mühlauer Bridge in Innsbruck resulted in a woman being injured and both vehicles being significantly damaged.
A wallet containing cash was stolen from an 80-year-old womans handbag in a supermarket in Imst.
Police conducted a traffic operation in Burgenland focusing on alcohol, drugs, and speeding; 670 drivers were checked, with one caught under the influence, and multiple violations reported.

Seven individuals, including five males and two females aged between 16 and 20, were found attempting to enter an uninhabited and dilapidated building in Wolfsberg and are facing charges for intrusion and COVID regulation violations.
A 50-year-old man in Sittersdorf drove an unregistered vehicle without a license, threatened officers with death, and attacked one, injuring him; he was then arrested.
A man stole traffic signs for a birthday party and was caught during a vehicle check.
A calf was rescued after falling into a manure pit and later a swimming pool in Bezirk Feldkirchen.
Three suspects were caught stealing road signs in Fucking, Tarsdorf, including using a cutting tool; additional thefts were reported in the vicinity.
A 61-year-old man driving on the L540 near Palmsdorf with 2.72 per mille was stopped by police and reported to the district authority.
A parked car rolled into a pond in Luftenberg; no occupants were inside, and the vehicle was retrieved without environmental damage.
A driver under drug influence caused a traffic incident where a cyclist fell and was injured.
A car collision at an intersection on Obertrumer Landesstraße in Kothgumprechting injured a 37-year-old woman; others were unharmed.
A 16-year-old Slovak unlawfully operated his aunts car without a license in Salzburg and violated Covid-19 restrictions with an 18-year-old Romanian companion.
A car and a truck collided in Graz; a passenger was lightly injured and significant damage was caused.
An 18-year-old man vandalized cars and obstructed police with barriers in Graz, Leonhardstraße. He was arrested, and a small amount of drugs was found on him.
A 75-year-old man died in a work accident involving a cone splitter during wood-splitting activities.
A 40-year-old female climber was seriously injured in a fall in alpine terrain and airlifted to a hospital for surgery.
Collision between two cars in Halbenrain resulted in one woman being injured and taken to the hospital; both vehicles sustained significant damage.
A forest fire occurred in Hopfgarten iD at the Lercher Liete area, affecting approximately 2500 square meters; it was controlled and extinguished by the local fire department.
A man was injured in a wood harvesting accident in Tösens after being overrun by a log.
A car collided with a bicyclist in Wattens, causing injuries to the cyclist due to low sun visibility.
An overloaded small truck was stopped and inspected by police on the A-1 highway near Pöchlarn, leading to the driver and vehicle owner being reported for exceeding weight limits.
Unidentified perpetrators broke into a greenhouse in the Schärding district and stole approximately 50 kilograms of hemp flowers.
An unknown offender broke into a company vehicle in Innsbruck, smashing a side window and stealing two laptops and diagnostic devices, causing a five-figure euro loss.
A 22-year-old woman fled a traffic check in Höfen, driving at high speed towards Weißenbach, damaging a marker post, and committing several violations.
A 73-year-old woman was deceived by phone scammers impersonating police officers, resulting in a six-figure monetary loss.

A 16-year-old male in Austria was arrested for threatening his girlfriends family and assaulting her, while under the influence of alcohol, after previously threatening and attacking a police officer during a shoplifting incident.
Police officers assisted in the birth of a baby on the Floridsdorferbrücke, ensuring the safety of the vehicle and helping the mother deliver her child before the ambulance arrived.
A red Canyon Spectral AL 6.0 mountain bike and a gray FOX helmet were stolen from a basement storage unit in Innsbruck.
Two men distracted a cashier and stole a donation box from a store in Landeck.
Burglary and theft incidents in Klosterneuburg resolved, three Czech nationals arrested, stolen goods and burglary tools recovered.

An Iraqi national was arrested on suspicion of human smuggling while transporting seven illegal Syrian migrants toward Germany; investigations revealed a structured smuggling cell operating between Vienna and Nuremberg.
A woman assaulted two police officers in a café in Vienna after a dispute, leading to her arrest.
A car and a goods train collided at a railway crossing in Ternitz, severely injuring the car driver.

A collision occurred between a truck and a car at an intersection in Mayrhofen. The car driver was injured and taken to a hospital, while others involved were uninjured. Both vehicles sustained significant damage.
Multiple traffic accidents occurred in Tirol where drivers were heavily intoxicated, prompting intensified police monitoring during the Advent season.
A masked perpetrator armed with a knife robbed a gas station in Hörbranz and fled on a bicycle, later being apprehended in Germany.
An unidentified man committed an armed robbery at a gas station in Vienna, threatening an employee with a firearm before fleeing on foot with stolen cash.
An 81-year-old woman was robbed after withdrawing money from a bank; three women were involved in the theft of the cash envelope from her handbag.
A man attacked a police officer following an altercation at a Christmas party; he resisted arrest and injured the officer slightly.
24 drivers were found under drug influence in targeted police checks in districts 12 and 23 of Vienna.

A 28-year-old driver from Croatia was caught driving at 225 km/h on the A 10 near Spittal/Drau, exceeding the speed limit by 95 km/h. His drivers license was revoked and a security deposit was imposed.
A man robbed a woman of cash and physically assaulted her when she tried to confront him in Klagenfurt.
A fire broke out in a house, and a 79-year-old was rescued by passersby and treated for suspected smoke inhalation.
A car collided with a moped on the B3 road in Perg; the moped driver sustained severe injuries and both individuals were hospitalized.
A car was struck by a train at a railway crossing in Schalchen, dragging the vehicle for 135 meters. The driver was injured and taken to the hospital.
Cyclist collided with a pedestrian while exiting a company premises in Niederalm, causing injuries to both; the woman was hospitalized, and the alcohol test on the cyclist was negative.
An armed robbery occurred in Thalgau where a masked male suspect, holding a pistol, attempted to steal money from a store but fled empty-handed after being confronted.
Two traffic accidents occurred in Eugendorf, Salzburg-Umgebung district, resulting in three minor injuries and significant vehicle damage.
A car driven by an 18-year-old crashed into two trees and overturned, injuring the driver.
Unknown individuals broke into an apartment through a terrace door and stole valuables including jewelry, watches, and cash.
A 62-year-old woman was severely injured in a car accident involving a Slovenian truck driver who disregarded the right of way in Graz.
A 78-year-old man was severely injured in a climbing accident at an indoor climbing gym when his son, who was climbing above, lost his grip and fell on him.
A 41-year-old worker fell from an unsecured concrete slab and was seriously injured while working on a construction site.
A woman in Innsbruck was slightly injured when an unknown female threw a folding knife at her without apparent reason, hitting her thigh.
Burglars broke into an unoccupied house in Zell am Ziller and stole an empty heavy safe.

A 20-year-old man lost control of his car on Arzler Landesstraße in Innsbruck, causing it to collide with another vehicle and plummet 40-50 meters down a slope, resulting in total damage to both cars and minor injuries to the driver.
A woman lost control of her car on the A12 highway near Telfs, causing it to crash and overturn due to heavy rain; she was injured and transported to a hospital.
Three unidentified individuals broke into an office in Kitzbühel and later a toy store, stealing a low four-digit euro amount from a cash register.
Gas leak in Götzis led to evacuation and required emergency services; no injuries reported, property damage occurred.
A man attacked a police officer after being reported for refusing to leave his ex-partners apartment, resisted arrest, and lightly injured an officer.
Police arrested several individuals for drug-related offenses, seizing various drugs and cash in Vienna.
Two cars caught fire in Klagenfurt, requiring firefighting efforts; one officer sustained smoke inhalation.
A man was seriously injured during logging work in a forest in St. Jakob/Ros. after being trapped under a falling tree and later rescued by acquaintances and emergency services.
A 38-year-old Iraqi man was arrested for smuggling seven illegal Syrian immigrants in Austria.
A hiker suffered a serious leg injury after getting caught on a tree root and was rescued and transported to a hospital.
Two unknown individuals broke into a gas station in Sipbachzell, stole 30 cigarette cartons, and fled in a car toward Kremsmünster. A female accomplice was identified via video.
A 31-year-old woman from Sankt Pölten fell to her death while climbing near the Großer Pyhrgas in Spital am Pyhrn.
Car collision caused by intoxicated driver, resulting in one person injured and a BAC of 1.58 promille for the offending driver.
A collision occurred between a small truck and a car on Ennstal Straße B 320; one driver had a blood alcohol level of 1.44 per mille.
A fire broke out in a two-family house in Adnet, likely caused by a spark from a wood stove, but no injuries occurred and the fire department quickly extinguished the flames.

An 83-year-old woman in Saalfelden was deceived and robbed by an armed man who falsely claimed via door intercom that there was a fire. After forcing his way into her apartment, the suspect demanded and received cash before fleeing.
A 45-year-old woman from Mödling died after slipping and falling off a cliff during a mountain descent in Trofaiach.
A 30-year-old man was seriously injured and an 84-year-old woman suffered minor injuries in a traffic accident involving a self-propelled machine and a car on L 518.
A woman fell and injured her knee while hiking on Zirbitzkogel, requiring helicopter transport to the hospital.
Fire broke out in a carport near a residential building in Lienz; controlled and extinguished by the fire department; no injuries reported.
A fire broke out at a residential house in Silz due to improper disposal of hot ashes, causing minor damage but no injuries as it was quickly controlled by a neighbor and the fire department.
A 35-year-old Italian woman fell approximately 25 meters on a hiking trail in Wilder Kaiser and was rescued with injuries.
Two German men engaged in a physical altercation in a bar in Ischgl, resulting in one man sustaining a nasal fracture and a concussion after being kicked in the head.
A 21-year-old lost control of his car while overtaking, leading to multiple rollovers; three individuals sustained injuries, with one in serious condition.
A 65-year-old man was seriously injured during forestry work when a tree trunk hit his leg; he sought help and was later hospitalized.

A Latvian man was caught stealing two travel trolleys from a supermarket in Vienna. After being pursued by a store employee and police officers at a health fair, he was apprehended and temporarily arrested.
A 28-year-old Austrian man assaulted two casino employees, stole casino chips and keys, and caused significant property damage while intoxicated, leading to his arrest.
A gas stove exploded in a hunting lodge, causing significant damage but no injuries.
Two teenagers admitted to causing vandalism damages in Allhaming out of boredom, including destruction at a sports club, playground, and football field.
Warehouse of construction company caught fire on Saturday evening; no injuries reported, explosions occurred, and investigation of the cause is ongoing.
Two demonstrations related to Fridays for Future caused traffic disruptions in Vienna due to street closures along specified routes.
A 62-year-old driver fatally hit a 42-year-old pedestrian while overtaking a truck on the Packer Bundesstraße in Klagenfurt.
A young driver attempted to overtake despite oncoming traffic, causing a multi-vehicle collision involving injuries and significant damage on the L506 road in Schärding district.
A 20-year-old woman collided with a stationary car due to inattention, causing injuries and hospital transportation.
Two children were hit by a car while crossing a pedestrian crossing in Stadl-Paura and sustained injuries.
A gas explosion occurred in a weekend house in Bad Bleiberg-Nötsch, causing serious injury to a 47-year-old man and completely destroying the wooden structure.
Driver crashed his car into a lamppost and a stone after veering off the road; tested 1.8 promile alcohol and license was confiscated.

A residential building in Leoben caught fire, possibly due to an electric blanket. A 77-year-old woman was rescued and suffered minor injuries. The fire was extinguished by over 70 firefighters after spreading to the roof.
A fire occurred in a multi-family house in Prutz near a tiled stove, causing two individuals to be hospitalized for suspected smoke inhalation.
Unidentified individuals damaged vehicles, trash containers, and traffic signs in Lienz over multiple streets.
Gas smell reported in a residential building in Hard; residents evacuated and investigated by emergency teams without finding any gas leak.
A heavily intoxicated man threatened staff in a supermarket, attempted to attack the store manager with a glass bottle, and was later apprehended by police.

A 76-year-old driver lost control of his car after reportedly suffering a heart attack, colliding with another vehicle. Bystanders provided first aid, and police and emergency services managed to resuscitate him. Two passengers were slightly injured.
Several arrests made during a drug crackdown operation by Viennas criminal police, including seizure of various narcotics.
A Romanian tour bus with severe technical flaws, leaking diesel and motor oil, was found in Töschling and addressed by authorities.
A package deliveryman in Klagenfurt is accused of stealing and fraudulently manipulating packages over several months, involving goods worth thousands of euros.
An 18-year-old driver lost control of his vehicle on a wet road, causing it to overturn; three passengers sustained varying degrees of injuries.
Fire destroyed a farm building and partially damaged a residential house; no injuries reported.
A house fire occurred in Rüstorf, causing two residents to evacuate; one was hospitalized, and the fire was quickly controlled.
A man was stopped for erratic driving and tested positive for multiple drugs; his license was revoked.
Two armed, masked individuals robbed a supermarket in Salzburgs Lehen district and escaped with an unknown amount of cash; no injuries reported.
A 21-year-old truck driver went off the road and tipped the truck on its side due to slippery terrain; no injuries were reported.
An infrared cabin in the basement of a house caught fire and was extinguished by firefighters; no injuries reported.
Three unidentified individuals attempted to blow up an ATM using explosives early in the morning but fled without taking any money, causing significant damage.
A car parked in a garden in Lienz caught fire and was heavily damaged, no injuries reported.
Three unknown perpetrators stole around 20 bottles of high-priced spirits from a store in Fieberbrunn.
A man in Simmering, Vienna injured himself during gun cleaning when a shot accidentally fired; several prohibited weapons and ammunition were later secured by police.
Police arrested two suspects after a series of cellar break-ins in a residential building; at least one bicycle was reported stolen.

A 27-year-old Austrian man attempted to steal a handbag from a 31-year-old Hungarian woman in Vienna, assaulted her, threatened police officers after being apprehended, and was charged with attempted robbery and resistance to state authority.
A 15-year-old girl in Klagenfurt was kicked by a horse on a ranch and was hospitalized with undetermined injuries.
Illicit sale of meat discovered in a garage in Klagenfurt; a couple was caught selling around 300 kg of meat and related tools.
A man was caught speeding at 117 km/h in a 50 km/h zone in Klagenfurt and will face charges, but his drivers license could not be confiscated as he did not have it with him.
Two men attempted to ignite an oven in a warehouse, leading to a flash fire that injured one of them and caused property damage; one was intoxicated.
A 16-year-old moped rider fled from a police control, was pursued, and eventually caught in a forest area. The moped had illegal modifications, and the rider is being charged with multiple offenses.
Two hikers lost their way during a snowy hike and were rescued by mountain rescue teams and a police helicopter.
In Allhaming, multiple acts of vandalism were reported over two days, including damage to playground equipment, a sports field, and other public property.
A wooden facade of a construction site caught fire in Tillmitsch, Bezirk Leibnitz; no injuries were reported, and the fire was extinguished by firefighters.
A 50-year-old man fell from a ladder while cleaning windows outside his house, resulting in injuries; he was airlifted to the hospital.
Three youths were identified as perpetrators of multiple burglaries and thefts in Lienz and Spital an der Drau districts, stealing cash and valuable items between September and November 2020.
A car driver lost control in a tunnel, avoided a bus collision, hit the tunnel wall twice, and then struck a bridge railing; the passenger and driver were injured and taken to the hospital.
A fire broke out at a farm outbuilding in Altlengbach, damaging the roof and spreading to a nearby house, with no injuries reported.
11 individuals were arrested for illegal residence and suspected employment fraud during a police inspection of an event location.

A fire broke out in the first floor of a family house in Rüstorf, caused by a defective electric reclining chair. Two residents escaped; an 83-year-old woman suffered smoke inhalation and was hospitalized.
Four vehicles were damaged on a parking lot in Obertauern with wipers and a side mirror broken.
Approximately 50 construction machines were stolen from containers at a construction site in Graz, Lend district.
A series of attempted and successful burglaries occurred in St. Pölten; a suspect slapped a cleaning staff member during one incident and escaped, with minimal monetary gain.
A man attempted multiple burglaries in St. Pölten, surprised and slapped a cleaning worker, and fled without stolen goods.
A 66-year-old visually impaired man was robbed in Graz, struck on the back of the head and had several hundred euros stolen.
A jogger kicked a dog attempting to bite him, leading to a physical altercation with the dogs owner who was later reported to display a knife.
Announcement of traffic safety emphasis checks in Burgenland including speed, distance, alcohol, and substance control for drivers.
A drunk man refused to pay for alcoholic drinks, threatened a waitress with a knife, and tried to attack police officers before being arrested.
Fire broke out in a storage hall containing chicken manure in St. Georgen, Wolfsberg.
Fire broke out in the center of Hallstatt, damaging five buildings and destroying two wooden huts and a car; a firefighter was seriously injured.
An intoxicated driver was stopped twice within two hours in Freistadt, refused a breathalyzer test the first time, and tested 1.24‰ BAC during the second stop.
A brawl took place during the Krampusfest in Wildermieming, involving multiple locals, leaving three injured.
Unidentified individuals broke into a carnival wagon in Igls and stole various beverages.
A 41-year-old man was injured during maintenance work in Fußach when an 800 kg injection molding tool fell on his leg, requiring rescue by colleagues and hospitalization.
A bull escaped during unloading, attacked people and police, and was ultimately euthanized to ensure safety.
Collision between a truck and a car in Pöchlarn caused severe damage to both vehicles and injuries to both drivers; one required helicopter transport to the hospital.
Police intervened in a physical altercation between two men in a local venue, using pepper spray to separate them; one man was arrested for aggressive behavior.
A 33-year-old man was attacked by an unknown couple; one of the assailants punched him in the face multiple times and stole his wallet.
A 25-year-old man drove off the road, hit a concrete post, and overturned his car, sustaining serious injuries. Alcohol and phone use may have contributed to the accident.

Police conducted a traffic safety operation in Burgenland, targeting alcohol and drug-related offenses. 16 drivers were found under the influence, with the highest alcohol level at 2.64 promille. Drug possession was also detected, and vehicle defects led to further actions.
A dishwasher caught fire in a restaurant in Wolfsberg district, causing property damage but no injuries.
A man scratched 10 cars with a sharp object in Klagenfurt, causing substantial damage. He was observed by witnesses and later detained by police but denies the allegations.
A 21-year-old man lost control of his car, was catapulted off the road, collided with a bridge railing, and fell into a stream, fatally injuring himself.
A 69-year-old pedestrian was hit by a car on the Hansberg Landesstraße in Feldsdorf, district Urfahr Umgebung, and was hospitalized after the incident.
A worker fell 15 meters into a well and suffered serious injuries but was rescued by a colleague using a winch.
A car collided with a cyclist at a crossing in Alkoven; the cyclist was injured and taken to the hospital.
Two men used a vehicle to break into a store, attempted to steal a cash register, fled, and were later arrested.
Police in Innsbruck seized drugs, a fake license, and a prohibited weapon in a car with stolen license plates.
Police found and seized nearly 587 grams of marijuana during a vehicle check in Breitenwang.
Green waste spontaneously ignited due to fermentation on a company premises in Reutte and the fire was extinguished by firefighters without injuries.
A chimney fire occurred in Brandenberg, extinguished by firefighters with no injuries or damage reported.
A heavily intoxicated man caused disturbances, damaged property with a knife, and injured himself in a shared house in Arzl im Pitztal.
A car collided with a truck at an intersection in Vienna; the car driver fled the scene but left behind an ID which allowed the police to identify him.
A 19-year-old male driver lost control of his car on Höhenstraße in Vienna, causing it to overturn. Both him and his passenger were injured, with the passenger sustaining severe injuries.
A woman from Villach lost control of her car on Töbringerstraße, collided with a stationary vehicle, a fence, and a tree, and sustained injuries.
Ransomware attack on a hotel in Bezirk Feldkirchen demanding Bitcoin payment, causing system blockage.
A 57-year-old farmer was injured in a forestry accident when a tree trunk struck him while using a tractor winch.
A 51-year-old man was severely injured during forestry work in Krumbach when a felled tree moved and dragged him into a ditch, requiring him to be airlifted to a hospital in Vienna.
A 51-year-old man was injured when a bull kicked the door of a livestock transporter, causing it to hit him on the head in Ramsau, Lilienfeld District.
Unknown arsonist set fire to PVC-paper containers and a wooden carport in Linz-Urfahr, causing damages of approximately 4,000 Euros.
A 19-year-old woman collided with a stationary bus in Gunskirchen, causing injuries to herself; no other individuals were harmed.
A 58-year-old man collided with construction equipment and a parked truck, became trapped in his vehicle, and was freed by the fire department before being hospitalized in Freistadt.
A 60-year-old woman lost control of her car on a local road, hitting a tree and suffering injuries.
A high-speed car crash in Salzburg caused severe injuries to a passenger and extensive damage to vehicles and property.

A ticket inspection in Salzburgs Rainerstraße escalated when a 21-year-old man pushed a ticket inspector off a bus, injuring him, and later claimed to have been assaulted during an altercation while being detained.
A pedestrian was injured in a parking lot in Salzburg when a reversing car hit her; the driver left without providing details.
A wooden pergola at a single-family house caught fire; neighbors evacuated two children and initiated initial firefighting efforts, with no injuries reported.
A 25-year-old driver lost control of his vehicle on a wet and cold road, crashed into a bridge railing, and sustained serious injuries, while two passengers were unharmed.
Fire in the upper floor of a residential house caused by improperly disposed cigarette remains; no injuries.
An 80-year-old man was injured after his car veered off the road, crashed into a guardrail and trees, and required rescue and hospitalization.
An oven explosion caused significant kitchen damage in Sölden during maintenance, but no injuries occurred.
Unknown perpetrators manipulated a gas station employee in Innsbruck to provide prepaid card codes, causing financial damage.
A 19-year-old male driver lost control of his car due to excessive speed near Ehrwald, resulting in the vehicle overturning multiple times; the driver was injured and the car was totaled.
A man in Innsbruck was caught with cannabis plants in a hidden grow operation; substances were confiscated and charges filed.
A 69-year-old German man fell about 150 meters while descending the Einstein in Tannheim, sustaining fatal injuries.
A 14-year-old boy was seriously injured when a trailer rolled back and collided with his leg in Virgen, Austria.
Three men got into an argument; two of them attacked the third, causing minor injuries. The attackers were arrested and the incident is believed to be related to jealousy.
An 18-year-old Croatian man was attacked with a knife on a playground in Jenbach, was punched in the face, but managed to escape. The assailant fled without taking any money.
Burglary occurred at the Bregenz town hall where cash and a small safe with documents were stolen.
An unknown suspect stole 7 bottles of whiskey from a supermarket in Westendorf, causing damage in the three-digit euro range.
A 24-year-old man was attacked by three locals with punches, choking, and kicking outside a venue in Bischofshofen.
A 42-year-old driver caused an accident at an intersection and fled, later returning to retrieve his license plate, but was stopped by police.
A 24-year-old guest injured a 27-year-old security staff member seriously during an altercation at a nightclub in Wolfsberg; victim was hospitalized.
A 19-year-old driver and two passengers were caught in Schwertberg with drugs during a vehicle control, and all tested positive for drug influence.
An unknown male robbed a bank in Krumpendorf using a firearm and fled with an unknown amount of money.
A 23-year-old man attacked police officers during a fight investigation, injuring two and damaging their equipment before being arrested.
A drunken man vandalized a door and attacked police officers, injuring two in Vienna.
Police arrested a 27-year-old Nigerian national on suspicion of distributing drugs, along with seizing cocaine, heroin, cutting agents, and cash from his residence.

A 16-year-old in Linz fled police in a high-speed chase, crashed the car into a barrier, and was apprehended after a foot pursuit; he used the car without his sister-in-laws permission and lacked a valid driving license.
Two masked individuals robbed a gas station in Salzburgs Maxglan district using a firearm, stealing cash and fleeing on foot; no injuries reported.
A man attempted to rob a food shop in Salzburg Maxglan, threatened the owner with a sharp object, and slightly injured him before fleeing empty-handed.
A traffic accident occurred in Salzburg involving a 22-year-old driver and a 39-year-old cyclist, leading to minor injuries for the cyclist.
Two kitchen appliances caught fire after being accidentally placed on an active stovetop; the fire was extinguished without injuries.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a store, stole chainsaws, a surveillance camera, and a car battery, causing damage worth several thousand euros.
Unidentified perpetrators broke into a house in Lienz through a garden door and a window, stealing jewelry, watches, and cash.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a house in Innsbruck, smashing a balcony door and stealing expensive designer handbags and jewelry.
Police arrested a 29-year-old Serbian man during a drug-related operation in Vienna, seizing 500 grams of heroin and €2,500 in cash.
A drunk driver lost control of a small truck on the B139 road in Weißenberg, hitting a street marker, breaking a fence, and damaging plants; no injuries occurred.
Two men in Linz engaged in a road rage altercation involving physical confrontation, pepper spray, and mutual car damage.
An 88-year-old cyclist was lightly injured and hospitalized after being struck by a car driven by a 29-year-old woman without a valid license in Bad Hall.
A car driven by an 18-year-old overturned in a curve, causing injuries and total damage to the vehicle.
Two trucks collided on the A10 motorway; one driver was slightly injured and significant vehicle damage occurred.
A 72-year-old cyclist was seriously injured after falling while trying to cross a bike overpass in Lieboch; a car involved in the incident may have failed to yield priority.
A car caught fire in Graz at Wielandgasse 22; no injuries reported and the fire was quickly extinguished.
A 42-year-old man accidentally ran over and severely injured a 61-year-old colleague with a company vehicle at a construction site in Kirchbichl.
During forestry work in Oberlienz, a man was seriously injured when a tree he climbed unexpectedly fell and trapped him.
Bus driver manipulated digital tachograph during a trip and failed to comply with rest periods, leading to legal actions against him and others involved.
A 38-year-old driver collided with a pedestrian on Feldkircherstraße in Altach; minor vehicle damage occurred, and the police are seeking the pedestrian for further investigations.
Two unidentified men committed an armed robbery in a gas station in Vienna using a handgun, stealing cash and cigarettes.
A 43-year-old female jogger had her mobile phone stolen by an unknown man in Vösendorf, Austria. The man approached her, spoke obscenely, and grabbed her phone. She was not injured.
An unknown suspect threw eggs at a house facade in Sittersdorf, causing significant staining and damage worth several hundred Euros.
A 23-year-old man in Kärnten crashed his car into a bridge pedestal after falling asleep while driving to work, sustaining unspecified injuries.
Fire broke out in a wood chip heating system storage area, spreading to the roof; firefighters prevented further damage.
Three cars collided on a snowy road, causing injuries to all three drivers.
An uninhabited wooden house burned down in Wolfsberg, cause unknown, no injuries reported.
A fire broke out in the ceiling of a residential house in St. Veit an der Glan due to an overheated chimney; no injuries were reported.
A 61-year-old man aggressively confronted others, injured a security employee, and was arrested for resisting authority and causing serious bodily harm.
Attempted armed robbery in a tobacco shop where a customer disarmed and restrained the suspect until police arrived.
A couple attempted theft at a flower shop; the man assaulted an employee and damaged property. Both were arrested nearby.
A car collision occurred in Klagenfurt am Wörthersee, leaving one driver injured and both vehicles heavily damaged. Visibility was obstructed by another vehicle, and alcohol tests were negative.
A truck with a trailer driven by a Slovene man overturned on the roadside in Völkermarkt, causing significant damage to the trailer and a temporary road closure.
An 86-year-old man crashed his car into a rock wall on St. Oswalder Straße in Bad Kleinkirchheim, likely due to health issues, and was hospitalized with unspecified injuries.
A car and a bus collided on the L 8078 road in Raabs an der Thaya, injuring the car driver.
A school bus tire burst on a steep road, causing it to crash into a guardrail. The driver and a child were injured, and the bus suffered severe damage.
A multi-vehicle traffic accident occurred in the Götschka Tunnel on the S10 highway, involving heavy trucks loaded with goods, resulting in severe property damage but no injuries.
A Georgian asylum seeker was caught shoplifting in Vöcklabruck, discovered to have an outstanding arrest warrant, and must serve a three-month sentence.
A man was arrested in connection with past robberies in Salzburg following coordinated police efforts; investigations are ongoing.
A car driven by a 58-year-old man in Salzburg struck a 28-year-old pedestrian who was crossing on a green light, causing her minor injuries.
A head-on collision occurred on Pinzgauer Straße, resulting in injuries to three people and total damage to two vehicles.
A collision occurred in Halbenrain between a truck and a car, resulting in minor injuries for a 37-year-old driver and her 9-year-old son.
A 62-year-old woman riding a moped was seriously injured in Graz, Bezirk Andritz, after possibly being touched by a car and trailer while being overtaken and falling off her vehicle.
Two cars collided, causing five injuries, with one person airlifted to a hospital for treatment of unspecified injuries.
A 44-year-old driver collided with a 48-year-old e-bike rider in Graz, causing a serious hand injury to the cyclist.
A 56-year-old man damaged four vehicles and attempted to damage four others in Innsbruck/Pradl.
A 27-year-old man dressed as a Krampus was injured after a car incident in Längenfeld; he leaned on and hit a car, then fell and sustained injuries.
A car collided with a moped on Grenobler Brücke in Innsbruck, causing the moped driver to fall and sustain injuries.
A 74-year-old woman struck a 69-year-old man on a pedestrian crossing in Kirchberg in Tirol, causing injuries.
An 85-year-old pedestrian was severely injured after being hit by a car on Gerlos Bundesstraße in Gerlos.

A 92-year-old driver lost control of his car in fog and light precipitation, causing the vehicle to overturn and fall into a drainage structure. He was injured and required rescue by the fire brigade.
A 28-year-old Somali man was arrested for possession of a stolen bank card and bicycle; he was also found to be under the influence of drugs.
A 58-year-old woman was arrested for shoplifting multiple perfume bottles twice in one day using a specially prepared bag.
A 42-year-old Slovak man was arrested in Vienna on national and international warrants for assault, theft, and coercion, as well as property offenses in the Czech Republic.

A 5-year-old boy was hit by a car while crossing a pedestrian walkway; the driver fled the scene.
A truck driver veered off the road, slid down a slope, and overturned on a field causing significant damage, but the driver was uninjured.
A 42-year-old man threatened to kill his family and harm police officers. He possessed multiple weapons, leading to his arrest by a SWAT team. A weapons ban was issued.
A 20-year-old driver with a 0.76‰ blood alcohol level crashed into a tree in Hohenzell, sustaining injuries and being hospitalized.
A man was injured by a falling branch during tree felling and was airlifted to a hospital in Germany for treatment.
A factory in Wörgl caught fire, with significant firefighting efforts preventing the spread to nearby buildings.
A German skier was severely injured after falling on a closed and unprepared ski slope in Höfen. He was assisted by two passersby and later airlifted to a hospital.
A 45-year-old woman collided with a detached truck tire in Kappl, leading to minor injuries and significant car damage.
A fire incident occurred when cooking oil overheated, causing a flash flame and smoke development. The fire was controlled without injuries.
Small fire in a school in Innsbruck caused by a smoldering fungus left on a wooden surface, extinguished by the caretaker, leading to minor damage and temporary evacuation.
A tree fell on a car at an intersection in Bregenz, causing significant damage to the vehicle, with no injuries reported.
Stolen items found after a vehicle stop; authorities searching for victims, possibly in Vorarlberg.
A 24-year-old Afghan man sexually harassed a 27-year-old woman in a bar in Klagenfurt, threatened her with death, and got injured after being pushed away while holding a beer bottle.
An 81-year-old woman caused a traffic accident by failing to yield, colliding with another car, which then collided with a third vehicle. She sustained serious injuries.
A German man fell off a 120m cliff while gathering wood for a campfire near Nesselwängle and died from his injuries.
An uninhabited apartment in Graz was damaged by unknown individuals, with walls being defaced and evidence suggesting an attempted squatting.
A collision between a truck and car on the B78 near Fohnsdorf injured three people, two seriously.
A man in Landeck found a plumbing company online to fix a clogged pipe and paid a high fee, only to discover the toilet was incorrectly reinstalled and the company became unreachable.
A 14-year-old was assaulted and robbed of his headphones by two youths in Vienna; suspects later confessed.

A man sprayed pepper spray into a car and directly at the 20-year-old driver in Landeck. Additionally, another case involved robbery with a stun gun and air pistol in Kauns, both incidents linked to the same suspects.
Skier triggered an avalanche in the Sonnenkopf ski area; no injuries reported and the skier managed to escape unharmed.
A man used pepper spray during a confrontation related to a drug deal in Landeck.
A professional Romanian theft group stole 4500 mobile phones worth millions from an Austrian telecom warehouse; they entered via the roof and transported the goods using rope systems.
Traffic disruptions expected due to a football match at Allianz Stadion in Vienna.

A 48-year-old driver lost control of his vehicle on B 127 in St. Martin im Mühlkreis, causing the car to slide off the road, overturn down a slope, and land in a field. The driver sustained injuries but managed to exit the vehicle without assistance.
Neighbors extinguished a fire in a residential building caused by candles, rescuing a victim who suffered leg injuries while trying to put out the fire.
A heavily intoxicated driver crashed into an underpass wall, causing significant vehicle damage but no injuries.
A kitchen fire occurred after food left on the stove caught fire, lightly injuring a 43-year-old man who was rescued by firefighters.

A 51-year-old Montenegrin assaulted a 39-year-old German in a local venue in Innsbruck, resulting in injuries to both individuals. The Montenegrin was restrained, arrested, and taken into custody after resisting police transport.
A 37-year-old man was attacked with a knife by a 29-year-old acquaintance and was injured in the upper body. Police provided first aid, and the man was taken to the hospital.

A 25-year-old man was stopped during a traffic check and found without proper vehicle registration; the vehicle and license plates were confiscated. Drug paraphernalia and a small quantity of cannabis were also discovered, and the driver tested positive for THC and cocaine. A passenger fell and required hospitalization, and further investigation into a possible car theft is underway.
A 25-year-old cyclist was lightly injured when hit by a turning car while crossing a pedestrian crossing with a green light.
An 83-year-old woman was hit by a reversing taxi and sustained head injuries.
Two pedestrians were hit and severely injured by a car when crossing the street at red traffic lights in Vienna.
Two women had a dispute, during which a 34-year-old threatened her 27-year-old neighbor with a kitchen knife. The police detained the suspect. No one was injured.
Hit-and-run incident involving a pedestrian hit by a car on a crosswalk, with the driver fleeing the scene, leaving the pedestrian seriously injured.

A 1,100-liter garbage container caught fire, likely due to disposal of hot ash, and a nearby plastic container also burned. Local firefighters prevented the fire from spreading to a carport with parked vehicles.
Two vehicles collided on St. Veiter Straße as a car tried to yield to an ambulance. The car driver was slightly injured, while others remained unhurt. Both vehicles were heavily damaged.
A highly intoxicated man caused a disturbance in a restaurant in Villach, behaved aggressively, and was arrested after failing to cease his aggressive conduct upon police warning.
Five suspects used a pyrotechnic device to damage a cigarette vending machine in Neunkirchen, stole cigarettes, and caused damages totaling €15,000.
A moped and a car collided in Purgstall an der Erlauf, injuring two teenagers.
A drunk driver with a blood alcohol content of 2.72 per mille was intercepted on the B148 road and had his license revoked.
A 20-year-old Afghan man was arrested in a refugee facility in Rohrbach district for selling cannabis for profit in Rohrbach and Linz.
Two individuals were stopped for driving offenses; one under the influence of alcohol and another showing signs of drug impairment.
Two assaults occurred in St. Martin/Mkr. and Unterweitersdorf, involving alcohol consumption; individuals were injured during altercations.
A 20-year-old Austrian was arrested in Salzburgs Old Town for involvement in a robbery in Maxglan and found in possession of drugs.
A 22-year-old German allegedly injured a 25-year-old Austrian with a glass bottle during an altercation in Wals.
A car crash occurred due to driver falling asleep; the driver, heavily injured, escaped the damaged vehicle and was hospitalized.

An 89-year-old woman and her husband were involved in a traffic accident in Salzburg-Itzling; another driver fled the scene after causing a collision that sent their car into a concrete post, leading to injuries and severe vehicle damage.
A 22-year-old man fell from a motorcycle without a license plate or valid driving license due to an icy road section, sustaining injuries and hitting a tree with his helmet.
An 83-year-olds kitchen in Kapfenberg caught fire, likely due to a candle on an Advent wreath; no injuries were reported.
A 67-year-old woman from Germany suffered serious injuries after skiing off a trail and falling 15 meters into a forest in Haus im Ennstal. She was rescued and taken to a hospital.
A 28-year-old Hungarian man fell and was seriously injured while riding an e-scooter under the influence of alcohol in Innsbruck.
Collision between two skiers in Sölden; one skier sustained a concussion and required medical attention.
A 64-year-old German skier was hit from behind on the Tiefenbachferner slope in Sölden, resulting in severe injuries. The other skier left to notify rescue services.
Two skiers collided on Piste 38 in Sölden, resulting in a 55-year-old German woman being seriously injured and airlifted to a hospital, while a 55-year-old Polish man sustained minor injuries.
A fire broke out in a vacation house in Steinberg am Rofan, causing significant damage but no injuries. The cause is still under investigation.
A 17-year-old moped rider lost control on Bödelestraße, crashed, and sustained injuries; alcohol test was positive.
Two individuals were arrested in Vienna-Favoriten and Vienna-Landstraße for selling drugs, involving transactions near the Belvedere and Stadtpark.
Stolen vehicle recovered and a man wanted under a European arrest warrant was apprehended during border checks in Nickelsdorf.
A 20-25 meter tall tree fell onto the L 73 road in Stallhofen, breaking a power line and causing a one-hour road closure.
A fallen tree forced the closure of the B83 road in Krumpendorf, with concerns of more trees collapsing under heavy snow.
A tree fell on a house in Spittal/Drau, causing property damage; other trees at risk of falling were addressed by the fire brigade.
A car collided with a fallen tree on the L 99 road in Trabesing but the driver was uninjured; the tree also damaged a noise barrier.
Road closures in Oberdrauburg and Zwickenberg due to heavy snowfall, fallen trees, avalanches, and landslides, no injuries reported.
A car driven by an 18-year-old man from Vienna swerved to avoid another car and collided with an oncoming vehicle, lightly injuring the other driver.
A 59-year-old woman lost control of her car due to icy conditions in St. Urban, Kärnten, and ended up in a creek; both the driver and her 74-year-old passenger were rescued and hospitalized.
Multiple trucks blocked both lanes on a snowy highway, causing a traffic jam and a subsequent vehicle accident with property damage.
A 49-year-old man accidentally shot himself while storing a rifle in his car after a hunting trip.
A man driving under the influence rear-ended a womans car in Perg district, causing minor injuries.

A severe traffic accident in Mörschwang resulted in three injuries after a collision at an intersection that caused both vehicles to be thrown into a field, leaving one passenger trapped in a car overturned on its roof.
Unknown individuals threw firecrackers near a retirement home in Bad Ischl, igniting about 150 square meters of land.
A semi-trailer with fake license plates was discovered during a vehicle inspection in Werfen. The driver, an Italian, is under investigation for falsifying documents and other violations.
Police secured 25g of cannabis and drug paraphernalia during a control at a train station, and charges were filed for drug-related offenses and violations of Covid-19 regulations.
A 59-year-old mountaineer injured his knee after a fall on an icy rock at Hochlantsch, requiring rescue and transport by mountain rescue and fire service.
A 34-year-old man with a history of violent offenses was arrested at his residence in Fohnsdorf by a special police unit after resisting arrest.
Two Bulgarian men resisted police during an identity check in Graz, leading to a physical altercation, injuries, and their arrest.
Suspected tachograph manipulation and data falsification on a truck; vehicle temporarily seized for detailed examination.
Terrace roof in Gaimberg collapsed under snow weight, no injuries reported.
An unknown man sprayed pepper spray into a car and directly at the driver in Landeck, then fled on foot.
A 3-year-old child injured his thumb using an electric drill accidentally while playing with it in Auffach, Austria.
A fire was deliberately set at Alamannen-Museum in Mäder, destroying wooden inventory and other items.
Police arrested a 27-year-old Nigerian man for dealing 170 grams of heroin following an observation operation in Vienna.
A 48-year-old woman was fatally stabbed in the Marktgemeinde Neudorf municipality, and a 53-year-old suspect has been arrested and confessed to the crime.
A 27-year-old man fell from a balcony in Kitzbühel, suffering severe injuries and requiring rescue by helicopter.
A man in Dornbirn was attacked and robbed, sustaining facial injuries as the perpetrator fled.
A fight involving around 20 youths occurred in Innsbruck where an 18-year-old was injured with a brass knuckle and a 17-year-old was unsuccessfully attacked with a knife; one suspect was detained.
Unknown perpetrators stole a parked PKW trailer with a car from a 69-year-old Slovenian man between December 8, 2020, at 14:00 and December 9, 2020, at 07:00 in Blasnitzen.
A 25-year-old driver lost control of his car on Murtal Bundesstraße, causing it to overturn multiple times; he was seriously injured and taken to a hospital.
Police officers in Vienna attacked during two separate incidents: one during an arrest operation and another involving a dispute with an intoxicated individual.
Two attempted burglaries occurred in Deutschkreuz; one involved an agricultural building and a vehicle trailer, and another targeted a business premises where alarms thwarted the intrusion.
A tree fell onto the L 40 road, damaging the roof of a house but causing no injuries; the tree remains in place due to safety concerns.
A truck driver lost control and crashed into a tunnel wall, resulting in injuries and complex rescue operations.
A fire broke out in a weekend house in Urfahr-Umgebung, Austria, destroying part of the property with no one inside.
A 31-year-old driver admitted to consuming cannabis and cocaine before driving; a drug test was positive, and the drivers license was provisionally confiscated.
A car collided with a 12-year-old pedestrian on a crosswalk in Graz, causing serious injuries to the pedestrian.
Police recovered a stolen fatbike and are seeking its rightful owner or persons who can provide information about it.
Police in Vorarlberg warn about online fraud during the holiday season, particularly via fake shops and dubious offers.
A collision occurred involving a small truck and another vehicle on Himberger Straße, resulting in one person being injured and transported to the hospital.
Fire broke out in the basement of a house near a pellet stove; two residents hospitalized for suspected mild smoke inhalation.
A car lost control on a slippery road during an overtaking maneuver, overturned, injuring a passenger.
Two Slovak men were arrested in Schwechat after a shoplifting incident revealed their involvement in thefts from construction site containers and possession of methamphetamine.
A collision occurred between a small truck and a motorbike on Kefermarkter Landesstraße in Neumarkt im Mühlkreis, leaving the motorcyclist seriously injured.
Car collision in Salzburg involving an intoxicated driver who ignored a red light, causing injuries.
A moped collided with a car on the Seekirchner Landesstraße, causing the moped driver to be injured and airlifted to the hospital.
A trailer loaded with workshop waste caught fire at a parking lot on the A 10 Tauernautobahn in St. Michael im Lungau; extensive emergency response ensued with no injuries reported.
A 55-year-old pedestrian was hit and injured by a car while crossing a zebra crossing.
A 51-year-old pedestrian was hit by a car while crossing a crosswalk in Graz, resulting in rib fractures and hospitalization.
A collision involving a van and a trailer on the A2 highway in Sinabelkirchen resulted in two serious injuries and significant traffic disruption.
Two passengers injured in a car accident due to snowy conditions in Stainach, Austria.
A 31-year-old Polish man was temporarily arrested after being identified as the perpetrator of approximately 20 shoplifting incidents in a Lienz grocery store over the past six weeks.
A 21-year-old Austrian woman lost control of her car on wintery roads in Hopfgarten, causing it to slide into a river, requiring her rescue and hospitalization.
A man suffered an open forearm fracture while working on a snow cannon in Hochötz and was flown to the hospital.
A 72-year-old man was injured during logging when a tree trunk moved unexpectedly, rolling over him and dragging him into a forest area.
A 57-year-old truck driver lost control on a snowy road, collided with a guardrail and a signpost column, causing significant damage. The driver was uninjured.
Three vehicle collision in Klaus resulted in four minor injuries and significant damage to all cars involved.
Gas leak in a multi-apartment building in Bregenz caused by an open gas cartridge; residents evacuated as a precaution but returned after ventilation.
A cyclist was lightly injured after being forced to evade an unknown car and fell against a snow pole in Wolfurt; the driver fled the scene.
A car hit two pedestrians at a crosswalk in Rankweil, leaving them severely injured.
A 34-year-old man under the influence of drugs or alcohol became aggressive, attacked officers and security staff, and was arrested in a shopping center in Vienna.
A woman was arrested for shoplifting using a modified coat to conceal items.
A fire broke out in the kitchen of a two-family house in Deutsch Griffen; residents and neighbors acted until firefighters controlled the situation, with significant property damage but no injuries.
Dangerous goods and heavy traffic inspections on A5 resulted in numerous violations, including an unmarked, overloaded and improperly equipped hazardous goods transporter.
A car collision occurred at an intersection involving two vehicles, injuring all four passengers including an 81-year-old woman and a 1-year-old child.
A man lost control of his agricultural vehicle and collided with a house wall, resulting in minor injuries and environmental contamination from oil leakage.
Cattle escaped onto the A1 motorway near Enns West, causing multiple collisions with vehicles. Three animals died, but no drivers were injured.
A Bulgarian man was arrested in Salzburg after being identified as wanted under an EU arrest warrant for multiple thefts.
The roof of a warehouse collapsed, causing damage to vehicles, but no injuries were reported.
An 85-year-old driver was seriously injured in a head-on collision between a car and a truck on a slippery road in Winzendorf, Austria.
A head-on collision occurred on the Fernpassstraße in Reutte, causing injuries to both drivers, with both vehicles heavily damaged and the road closed for 1.5 hours.
Partial roof collapse of a production hall in Assling caused by heavy snow; no injuries reported.
Worker injured during electrical repair on utility pole in Kartitsch.
A fire broke out in a locked cleaning chamber of a school in Altach, leading to an evacuation; no serious injuries were reported.
Two heavily intoxicated men caused a car accident and attempted to flee in Kennelbach; both were apprehended, neither had a drivers license.

Police pursued a car after the driver ran a red light in Vienna, leading to a chase where the vehicle hit the police car multiple times before being stopped. The intoxicated driver resisted arrest and attacked officers.

Police stopped a car on the B96 near St. Egidi and found various drugs, including marijuana, in the possession of four young men. One individual attempted self-harm during custody. The case remains under investigation.
A truck slid off a slippery road, overturned on its side, and ended up in a stream in Waidring; the driver was uninjured.
A structural defect in a chimney caused a house fire leading to damages over 100,000 euros in Deutsch-Griffen.
An unknown perpetrator committed a currency exchange fraud in a bank, causing financial damage.
A driver attempted to flee during a vehicle inspection, injuring an officer and damaging a police car before being arrested.
A 19-year-old woman lost control of her car on an icy road in Pollheim, overturned, and sustained minor injuries.

An 18-year-old drove a car in Zwettl without a license and under the influence of alcohol, causing a collision with another vehicle. Both the 18-year-old and his 28-year-old passenger, who was also under the influence, are facing charges. The 28-year-old was slightly injured, while the 51-year-old driver of the other car remained uninjured.
A woman and her 9-year-old son were in a car accident when their vehicle skidded off the road and overturned; both were injured and hospitalized.
A rear-end collision occurred in Thalheim, resulting in one person being injured and hospitalized.
A car accident in Prarath, Gleinstätten involved two vehicles due to icy roads; two people were injured and taken to the hospital.
A tree fell on a house in Wolfsberg due to heavy snowfall, causing damage to the facade, a window, and a garden fence. No one was injured.
A 16-year-old fell off his moped on a snowy road and was lightly injured; he and his father failed to notify the police about the accident.
A garden shed caught fire early in the morning; no injuries reported and cause under investigation.
An 11-year-old boy crossing a pedestrian path was hit by a car in Ludesch, resulting in injuries of an unspecified degree.
A 12-year-old boy on a scooter was lightly injured after being hit by a car at a pedestrian crossing.
A Serbian man was arrested for drug dealing in Vienna after selling heroin and being found with additional drugs and cash during a house search.
A chimney fire occurred at the home of a 77-year-old woman in Poggersdorf; no injuries or damage were reported.
A pedestrian was hit by a car at a roundabout in Villach, and the driver fled the scene; later found and tested positive for alcohol.
A 44-year-old Italian ski mountaineer crashed into a winching cable on a closed slope, resulting in serious injuries and hospitalization.
A man threatened a bailiff with death after she removed his cars license plates; he was arrested at work and taken into custody.
A car driver veered off the road and crashed into a tree, resulting in serious injuries.
A vehicle caught fire in Linz, likely due to equipment in the trunk; a man suffered smoke inhalation and another vehicle was damaged.
Unknown individuals set fire to a towel holder in a public restroom, causing significant soot damage.
Two men, aged 20 and 21, engaged in a physical altercation in front of a bar, resulting in minor injuries to both.

A man caused a rear-end collision at a Salzburg intersection, fled the scene, and was later identified. He had no license and was using a car without the owners consent. The victim sustained minor injuries.
Car collision in Salzburg resulted in injury to a female driver.
A car driven by a 25-year-old Croatian man lost control on a snowy road, collided with a snowplow, and overturned, resulting in injuries to the driver who was airlifted to the hospital.
A nine-year-old boy was severely injured after being bitten in the head by a dog in the basement of a house.
An SUV slid off a snowy forest road in Aichberg, Bezirk Liezen, and tumbled about 60 meters down a steep slope, causing injuries to the driver while the passenger escaped unhurt.
A car caught fire on a private parking lot due to unknown reasons; no injuries or additional damage were reported.
Five cars were involved in a rear-end collision on B64 road in Weiz, causing four minor injuries and significant property damage.
A roof structure in Oberperfuss caught fire for unknown reasons; fire departments quickly controlled the blaze.
Gas leaked from a trailer carrying gas cylinders in Rum, leading to a temporary road closure.
A 57-year-old worker fell 5-6 meters from a scaffold on a construction site, sustaining serious injuries.
Worker injured by excavator shovel, fell two meters and sustained leg and head injuries.
Two pedestrians, a woman and her son, were hit and injured by a car while crossing a pedestrian crossing in Bludenz.
Head-on collision between two vehicles in Rehmen, Vorarlberg; one driver tested positive for alcohol.
A 10-year-old girl was hit by a car while walking with a group on L 200; she sustained bruises and an arm fracture.
A worker was severely injured after getting trapped in the rotating snowblower mechanism during snow-clearing operations on L 193 in Vorarlberg.
Car collided with a pedestrian who then left the scene despite apparent injuries.
A woman found suspected war material during a walk, prompting police to secure the area and call in experts who identified it as a grenade, later removed by the military disposal service.
A man was found in possession of approximately 50 grams of cannabis after neighbors reported a noise complaint. The drugs were confiscated and the man was charged under Austrian drug laws.
A 33-year-old Slovakian man was caught with stolen perfumes from Parndorf while attempting to leave Austria by train in Kittsee.

A collision occurred between a truck with a trailer and a car on the B14 in Maria Gugging, resulting in serious injuries to the 79-year-old car driver who had to be airlifted to a Vienna hospital. The truck driver was uninjured.
An 88-year-old pedestrian was hit by a car while crossing a crosswalk. He was injured and taken to the Wels hospital.
A 57-year-old man swerved his car to avoid a sudden brake by an unknown driver, resulting in a crash into a fence in Redlham. He was injured and transported to the hospital.

A 16-year-old crashed his moped due to snowy conditions, left it at the scene, and failed to inform the police. His father took him to the hospital, and authorities found the moped after being tipped off by a passerby.
An unknown perpetrator robbed a gas station in Graz, threatening the employee with a handgun and fleeing with cash.
A 60-year-old woman got lost during a ski tour due to poor visibility and fog, prompting a large search operation where she was found unharmed.
A 23-year-old man lost control of his car, slid off the road, and ended up in a creek, sustaining unspecified injuries.
During the replacement of a glass pane, glass shattered, injuring a 55-year-old severely and a 16-year-old slightly.
Phone scammers posing as police attempt to obtain money and valuable information from residents.
An avalanche in Obertilliach buried part of a road, but no injuries or damages were reported.
A collision occurred between a truck and a car in Höchst, resulting in two injuries and significant damage to the car.
A Swiss man was arrested in Bregenz after aggressive behavior, threats, and property damage following traffic violations.
A woman in Leonding attempted to flee a traffic control, was found in possession of cannabis, and declared unfit to drive by a medical examination.
A man reported a robbery, leading to the discovery of a drug operation in his apartment in Linz. He was arrested after resisting a police search.
A cigarette vending machine in Viennas 21st district was blown up using pyrotechnics, with cash and cigarettes stolen.
A driver evaded police by speeding and entering a pedestrian zone, endangering three people; the driver and a passenger were arrested.
Two injured in a traffic accident involving multiple vehicles near Bezirk Freistadt, Austria.
A man died during woodwork after falling from a loading platform in Bezirk Wels-Land, despite resuscitation attempts by his partner.
Arrests made in Vienna following theft of motorcycles by a Belarusian group operating across Europe.
Police discovered cannabis plants, processed cannabis, drug paraphernalia, a machete, and a hunting knife in an apartment in Klagenfurt.
A 27-year-old in Linz fled from police during a traffic stop, driving recklessly without a license and under the influence of drugs. Narcotics and drug paraphernalia were found in his possession.
An 81-year-old man collided with another car while turning onto the B111 in Hermagor, causing injuries to the other driver and significant damage to both vehicles.
A 15-year-old apprentice suffered a severe hand injury while using a table saw in a workshop.
A road closure on B 111 in the Lesachtal area of Kötschach to Wiesen was lifted while the closure from Wiesen to the Tyrolean border remains in effect.
A 53-year-old man was injured when his foot was trapped between vehicles while attempting to tow a stuck truck in snowy conditions.
A burglar broke into a house in Frohnleiten and was scared off by the homeowner without causing injuries.
A 14-year-old boy was hit by a car in Vienna after crossing the street against a red pedestrian light; he sustained minor injuries and was taken to a hospital.
A 19-year-old suspected heroin dealer was arrested by police after being found with heroin packets and cash.
Two cars collided at an intersection due to an 18-year-old driver running a red light, causing minor injuries to the 28-year-old driver.
A pedestrian was hit and severely injured by a car, with the driver suffering from shock.
A 15-year-old boy was attacked and robbed of his mobile phone by four male juveniles who were later apprehended by police.
Three basement storage units in a residential building in Niederdorf were broken into, and items such as a bicycle, summer tires, and skis were stolen.
A man exposed himself and engaged in sexual acts in public near a school.
A 67-year-old man allegedly threatened his ex-girlfriend and her new partner with a knife in Spittal/Drau, but no weapon was found; a ban from the premises and a weapons ban were imposed.
An overheated chimney caused a fire in a 200-year-old farmhouse in Wels, Friesach, which was quickly extinguished; no injuries reported.
A 35-year-old Congolese man was arrested in Reichersberg for possession of falsified Angolan passport, Indian visa, and German Schengen visa.
Intoxicated driver fled police control, caused accidents and damage to property before being stopped.
Collision between two cars at an intersection in Linz; both drivers sustained injuries and traffic was temporarily paused.
Two cars collided in Unterstorcha, Paldau; one vehicle overturned causing minor injuries to the driver.
A 31-year-old woman was hit by a car while crossing a pedestrian crossing in Feldbach and suffered severe injuries.
A 58-year-old woman was seriously injured after tripping and falling while working with a wood processing machine at a company.
Unknown perpetrator broke into an apartment in Innsbruck and stole items including a blank gun.
An 82-year-old driver lost control of his car on the A 12 motorway near Pettnau, hitting a sign and overturning; the driver was slightly injured.
A woman committed fraud and theft by manipulating lottery payouts and stealing items, causing financial damage to a store.
A 14-year-old attempted a shoplifting in Innsbruck, resisted detention, attacked a security guard, and was later found with a small quantity of drugs.
A truck slid on a snowy road in Hirschegg, partially tipped over but did not fully overturn. The driver was uninjured and minor damage to the vehicle occurred.
A suspected drug dealer attacked a police officer during an arrest attempt but was apprehended; drugs and cash were seized.
A police officer noticed flames in the lower part of a vehicle on Hauptstraße in Gattendorf, prevented further damage by extinguishing the fire, and ensured safety for all involved.
A 44-year-old man drove under the influence, veered off the road, overturned his car, and sustained injuries; a search was initiated, later canceled after he returned to the scene.

A 21-year-old woman reported that her 19-year-old ex-boyfriend defrauded her of several thousand euros, assaulted her multiple times, and threatened her. Both consumed cannabis, and the man allegedly sold it. Police initiated a restraining order, and investigations are ongoing.
Two Russian nationals were caught stealing items from multiple unlocked vehicles in Wolfsberg, Kärnten.
A 22-year-old man in Reichenau severely injured his arm with a meat knife while working and was transported to the hospital for evaluation.
Two vehicles collided at an intersection in Waidhofen an der Thaya; a 75-year-old and a 53-year-old sustained injuries.
A 17-year-old drove a car without permission, leading to a high-speed police chase in Traiskirchen and surrounding areas, violating multiple traffic rules and ignoring police commands.

A 28-year-old Romanian man wanted under a European arrest warrant for involvement in a burglary in 2016 was arrested in Linz on December 11 and taken into custody.
A worker fell 3.5 meters while carrying a heavy window due to a broken floor panel, was severely injured and transported to a hospital.
A Hungarian woman was seriously injured while operating a food packaging machine in Hartl, Austria.
A German driver caused a collision on the Inntalautobahn in Langkampfen, resulting in injuries to himself and a Serbian driver, as well as significant damage to four trucks.

A 49-year-old Austrian slipped during logging work on steep terrain at Ötzerberg and sustained severe spinal injuries after colliding with a tree. He was rescued by mountain rescue and flown to a hospital.
A 78-year-old man was hit by a car while crossing Mieminger Bundesstraße in Obermieming, sustaining injuries and being taken to the hospital.
An 11-year-old girl was struck by a cars side mirror, causing her to fall and sustain injuries; the driver fled the scene.
A 15-year-old was seriously injured by an air pressure gun mishandled by two teenagers in a workshop.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a construction site container on Kaunertaler-Landestraße in Kauns and stole electrical tools worth several thousand euros.
A pedestrian was fatally struck by a small truck on a road in Gunskirchen, Bezirk Wels-Land.
Two unknown perpetrators stole various items from four unlocked vehicles in Kittsee, including clothing, tennis rackets, keys, and electronics.
Two acts of vandalism occurred in Imst where unknown perpetrators damaged house facades with a mini crossbow.
A man attempted to rob a taxi driver in Baden, using a knife to cause serious injuries; the suspect later turned himself in to the police.
A collision between a car and a pedestrian crossing occurred in Wieselburg, causing injuries to the pedestrian who was taken to a hospital.

Attempted theft of high-value perfumes in a store; suspect fled the scene.

Two 12-year-old girls were hit by a car on a pedestrian crossing in Altach, sustaining injuries of unspecified severity.

Unknown perpetrators broke into an office building and tampered with an ATM in Buch, stealing a low four-digit amount of cash.
Two vehicles collided head-on in Tobadill due to slippery road conditions, causing severe injuries to three people, including one passenger trapped in a vehicle.
A 31-year-old man caused multiple acts of vandalism in Kufstein, damaging signs, barriers, and trash bins before being apprehended by police.
Unknown suspect broke into an electronics store in Villach and stole mobile phones and tablets.
A man lost control of his car, slid off the road, and came to a stop in a creek bed; he was seriously injured and taken to the hospital.
Two men were rescued unharmed from an alpine emergency in the Eisenerzer Alps during a ski tour.
A man from Rohrbach district made 94 false emergency calls over the course of one night, refusing to stop despite police warnings.
Two vehicles collided head-on on a snowy road in Tobadill. Three people were injured, including two seriously, and were taken to the hospital.

Six youths arrested for allegedly robbing a young passerby of headphones and a small amount of cash under threat of violence.

A 90-year-old man was approached by a woman who stole an envelope containing cash from his shopping basket.

A 78-year-old pedestrian was hit by a car while crossing a crosswalk in Vöcklabruck, sustaining injuries and being taken to the hospital.

Cigarette vending machine in Vienna was exploded with a pyrotechnic, suspects fled with cigarettes and cash.

A 25-year-old man lost control of his car and overturned on Mölltaler Straße, resulting in minor injuries. He was heavily intoxicated, and a search found no other people involved. His car suffered total damage.
A fire broke out in a ground-floor apartment of a multi-family house in Volders, causing evacuation and leading to one person hospitalized for suspected smoke inhalation.
A 17-year-old driver caused a car accident on the B171 in Schwaz due to speeding and driving under the influence, resulting in two injured passengers and total damage to the car.
A fire broke out in an apartment on the ground floor of a multi-family house in Volders, leading to an evacuation of residents.

A 40-year-old woman was hit by a car while crossing a pedestrian lane and was injured in Vienna.
A 29-year-old man was attacked with a knife by a 25-year-old suspect during a dispute, leading to the arrest of three individuals and the victim sustaining non-life-threatening injuries.

Two separate incidents in Vienna involving assaults; one on a civilian and later resisting and attacking an officer during a police intervention, and another involving cannabis possession, resulting in resistance and an assault on an officer.

Burglary in a ground floor apartment in Innsbruck, cash stolen from a closet.
Collision between two cars in Landeck, one driver injured and taken to hospital.

A car collision in Gänserndorf District, Austria resulted in minor and severe injuries for the involved individuals.

Break-in at an apartment building in Navis, two storage units were broken into, and three e-bikes were stolen.

A 19-year-old woman lost control of her car on a road in Edenbach, causing the vehicle to roll over multiple times and sustain injuries of an unknown severity.

A 17-year-old unlicensed driver lost control of a car, leading to a crash involving injuries and a positive drug test.

Police discovered drugs and firearms during a house search in St. Veit/Glan after a noise complaint.
A garden house fire was noticed in Wolfsberg, quickly extinguished by local firefighters, preventing damage to nearby houses. No injuries were reported. The cause is under investigation.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a ground-floor apartment in Klagenfurt, stealing cash and jewelry.
Unknown offenders broke into an apartment in Klagenfurt by forcing a terrace door and searched for valuables.
A head-on collision occurred between a small truck and a car in Krumbach, injuring three men who were hospitalized.
A German driver struck a pedestrian with his car mirror, causing injuries and requiring hospitalization.
A 47-year-old Hungarian man was arrested in Eferding during a traffic control due to a European arrest warrant related to fraud and other property crimes.
A 59-year-old moped rider collided with a car after failing to yield at an intersection and was injured.
Three teenagers suspected of setting ornamental grasses on fire in Weiz, extinguished by witnesses.
A car caught fire due to a suspected technical defect, causing significant damage to the vehicle.
Burglars broke into a house and stole jewelry, a watch, and cash.
A garbage container caught fire at a construction site in Mayrhofen; firefighters extinguished the fire without injuries.
A 10-year-old student was injured in a collision with a school bus on Römerweg in Seefeld, Austria.
A balcony fire caused by embers in ash stored in a plastic bucket was extinguished in Schwaz, with no injuries reported.
A man fell from a wooden ladder while attempting to reach his attic and suffered severe neck injuries.
A man fell asleep while driving and crashed his car into a roadside ditch in Lauterach; no injuries reported.
A car with a trailer tipped over on the A 14 near Dornbirn Süd in Austria, causing significant traffic disruptions and a 6 km traffic jam; no injuries were reported.

Unknown individual sent 20 extortion letters in Kärnten demanding money; no payments have been made, and investigation is ongoing.
A head-on collision occurred on B 40 in Bezirk Mistelbach, resulting in the death of a car driver and injuries to two truck occupants.
A collision occurred between a tractor and a car in Felberach, resulting in injuries to the car driver and significant vehicle damage.
Police found a group of teenagers violating Covid-19 regulations in a smoke-filled café.
A drunk driver overturned his car on a road in Zwettl an der Rodl, suffering injuries and requiring rescue.
Four people were injured in a traffic accident involving two vehicles at a crossroads in Straßham, Austria.
A 26-year-old woman in Schärding district injured her hand while working with a saw and was hospitalized.
A woman in Bezirk Eferding suffered smoke inhalation from a smoldering fire caused by accident while handling ashes in her homes boiler room; firefighters extinguished the fire.
A 25-year-old driver was caught speeding at 170 km/h in a 100 km/h zone on the A 10 near Golling, facing charges and license revocation.
A truck accident caused a road sign collapse on B311, resulting in temporary road closure and traffic congestion.
A 38-year-old worker from Freilassing was seriously injured by an electric shock while working on a UPS device in Salzburg, suffering second-degree burns on his left hand.
A fire broke out in an agricultural building in Mooskirchen, causing no injuries. The cause is currently under investigation.
Three trash container fires occurred in Knittelfeld, suspected to be arson, with no injuries but property damage.
Two unknown males robbed a 15-year-old boy of his wireless headphones at a bus stop in Seiersberg, intimidating him to hand over the item.
A trucks semi-trailer detached and trapped a man between two vehicles, causing injuries.
A gliding snow avalanche occurred in Auerfeld, Osttirol, affecting four houses but causing no injuries.
Gas leak in a market due to accidental damage to a climate control line; no injuries reported.
Two Austrian women were victims of online fraud involving a GoPro camera and a PC controller; suspects remain unreachable.

A car accident occurred on the L66 in Göfis when a driver lost control on a slippery road, causing a collision and subsequent damage. One person was injured, and road cleanup and closure were necessary.
An 18-year-old moped rider was hit by a vehicle, lost consciousness after falling, and the driver fled the scene.
Remains of a poached roe deer were found in Wolfurt, indicating an act of poaching along with symbolic placement of leftovers.
A 6-year-old girl was bitten and injured by a leashed dog in Vienna; the owner is being investigated for negligent injury.
A 31-year-old man in Klagenfurt a.W. was arrested for drug offenses; significant quantities of drugs were seized, and additional suspects identified.
A fire broke out in a barn in Obermieger, destroying the structure and two tractors; no injuries were reported.
A violent altercation between two groups of people in Brixlegg resulted in at least six injuries, with two hospitalized.
18-year-old driver in Tarrenz caught speeding aggressively, reaching up to 135 km/h in a 60 km/h zone; license was confiscated.
A hit-and-run incident occurred where a car collided with a moped, causing the moped rider to crash and sustain injuries.
Police conducted a traffic operation in Vienna, finding drivers under the influence of alcohol and drugs, and issuing traffic violations.
A 52-year-old woman was arrested in Graz for stealing luxury clothes, with additional stolen goods found in her apartment.
Two 13-year-old girls were assaulted and robbed of their phones and some cash by a group of six youths, with five suspects later identified and denying the actions.

Social media scams involving fake sweepstakes and phishing for banking details reported by the police.

A forestry worker was seriously injured by a tree under tension during clearing operations in Innerfragant and was airlifted to a hospital.
A drunk driver caused a rear-end collision, injuring a woman and leading to his license being revoked.

A bull escaped in Regau and was contained by truck drivers before being safely euthanized; no injuries reported.

A 12-year-old German skier collided with a 23-year-old German skier at a practice lift in Kleinarl, resulting in injuries to the boy who was airlifted to the hospital.
