Burglars broke into a house in Thondorf and stole jewelry and savings books.
Unknown offender broke into an apartment in Innsbruck stealing cash and camera equipment.
A Hungarian couple collided while skiing in Sölden, resulting in severe injuries to the woman.
A car pulling a trailer lost control after a curve, causing a collision with another car and sending it down a slope; both drivers were injured.

A 62-year-old driver collided with an opened car door on Augartenstraße, resulting in his car hitting a 90-year-old man in a wheelchair. The driver is suspected of being under the influence of alcohol but refused an alcohol test.
A 21-year-old attempted to steal clothing worth 500 euros and resisted arrest, injuring two officers in Vienna.
A 37-year-old attacked a 39-year-old with a knife, stole money, and was later arrested with drugs and alcohol intoxication.

A 73-year-old man in Viennas Brigittenau district was arrested for threatening and injuring his 69-year-old wife during a domestic dispute; the victim escaped through a window, and the suspect was later detained by police.

Driver fled police on A25 near Wels, was stopped in Matthias-Schönerer-Straße; suspect showed signs of drug impairment, had no license, and carried a blank gun.
Cyclist fell, lost consciousness, and was assisted by an off-duty police officer before being taken to a hospital.
A 32-year-old driver caused a rear-end collision on the A 2 highway under heavy alcohol influence, resulting in one injury and vehicle damage.
Two cars collided on B 146 in Admont, causing minor injuries to both drivers and significant vehicle damage.

Traffic accident in St Jakob in Haus on L2 Pillerseestraße caused by an intoxicated driver, resulting in one person seriously injured.

Head-on collision between two cars in Dornbirn, two individuals injured and taken to the hospital.

Three individuals were arrested in Pöchlarn for shoplifting sweets worth nearly 2000 euros, with stolen goods found in their car.

An 89-year-old woman was struck by a car in Mödling and later succumbed to her injuries in the hospital.
An 18-year-old Austrian crashed an unregistered motorcycle in front of the Kramsach police station, sustaining serious shoulder injuries.
Motorcycle and car collision in Innsbruck, leaving the motorcyclist seriously injured.

Suspect caught shoplifting and in possession of weapons and drugs; arrested in Vienna.
Three men were caught shoplifting and one attempted to flee, attacking police officers before his arrest. Items worth over 100 euros were recovered.
A forester found wartime ordnance, identified as an incendiary stick bomb, in a forest, and the bomb disposal service removed it.

Nigerian man threw a sock containing cannabis under a car; police later arrested him and found additional cannabis at the scene.

A nine-year-old boy was hit and seriously injured by the side mirror of a van while crossing a street in Graz. The driver provided first aid.
A 20-year-old intoxicated man in Wörgl broke his acquaintances finger during an argument and later resisted police, behaving aggressively and injuring both himself and the officers lightly.
A burglary occurred in Ötztal-Bahnhof where an intruder accessed a house and stole items including cash and documents.

A dog, identified as a Stafford Terrier or Boxer, was killed in Bludenz.
A criminal group used fraudulent investment websites to scam individuals out of substantial amounts of money through fake trading platforms.
A 53-year-old woman was found severely injured on the sidewalk after a hit-and-run incident at a crosswalk in Vienna; witnesses sought.
A man displayed aggressive behavior in the street, spat at a police vehicle, insulted officers, and resisted arrest, injuring an officer in Vienna - Neubau.
Driver under the influence without a license fled from police but was arrested after resisting and injuring an officer.
Two women became lost and exhausted during a hike and were rescued by emergency services after a failed helicopter rescue due to fog.
A laptop ordered by a man in Moosburg was stolen from its package after it was delivered and left at his doorstep.
Three unknown offenders robbed a jewelry store in Wr. Neustadt, injuring and restraining the owner before fleeing on foot.
A drunk driver collided with another car and then a house, causing significant damage.

Police found small amounts of cannabis and paraphernalia during a vehicle inspection in Mittersill.
Two men in Salzburg were caught in connection with ordering and possessing illegal substances, including 1 kg of amphetamine and 4 kg of cannabis.
Two hikers were rescued from Eisenerzer Reichenstein after getting lost due to snow-covered trails and darkness.

A fire broke out in an agricultural building in Seckau, causing significant property damage, but no injuries. Emergency services managed to save 18 cattle and prevented the fire from spreading to nearby buildings.
An accident occurred in Reutte, Austria, when the driver of an electric scooter hit a dogs leash, causing a man to fall and sustain injuries.
Kitchen fire caused by an electrical appliance in Stumm im Zillertal; no injuries reported.
Car accident on Hochkönigstraße in Fieberbrunn involving two vehicles, five people injured, and significant damage.
A man fell from a roof while working in Lechaschau and sustained injuries of an unspecified severity.
Christmas lights on a bank facade in Lustenau caught fire due to a technical defect; no extinguishing was needed and damage was minimal.
A man driving under the influence of drugs was stopped, and drugs and related items were found in the vehicle.

A 29-year-old man attempted to steal a laptop from an electronics store in Wr. Neustadt. He resisted apprehension, drew a knife during the incident, and was disarmed by a bystander and detained until police arrived.
Unknown perpetrators vandalized four vehicles on a company premises, smashing headlights and causing significant monetary damage.

A man stole over 100,000 euros from an unlocked bank safe in Vienna and confessed to the crime citing financial difficulties.

A 23-year-old woman swerved her car to avoid an animal on the road, resulting in a collision with a guardrail and the car overturning multiple times in a field. She sustained injuries of unspecified severity.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a container in a parking lot near a grocery store and stole pyrotechnic items.
A fire broke out in a fishermans hut near Schrottenbacher Teich in Metnitz, destroying it completely.
A 31-year-old detainee escaped from a detention center in Vordernberg by breaking a window frame and using a bedsheet to climb over fences; the search is ongoing.
A 23-year-old driver under the influence collided with a 71-year-old driver, injuring both in Liezen district.

A motorcyclist fell and was mildly injured while braking to avoid a car that changed lanes; the car driver left the scene.
Two men robbed a jewelry store in Vienna using a gun, stealing cash and jewelry before fleeing the scene.
A car accident occurred where a 36-year-old driver was slightly injured, and the other involved driver fled the scene but was later found intoxicated and reported for hit-and-run.
A 31-year-old man was assaulted by a 21-year-old suspect in front of a bar in Klagenfurt, resulting in injuries and hospitalization.
Unknown perpetrators broke into a house in Wolfsberg, searched rooms, stole cash and a handgun causing significant damage.

A 79-year-old driver hit a 75-year-old pedestrian with his car on Mondscheingasse in Villach, causing injuries to the pedestrian who was taken to the hospital.
Fatal car accident on B37 in Krems an der Donau; one person died and another was seriously injured following a head-on collision caused by a lane change attempt.
Two drivers were lightly injured in a traffic accident caused by a drunk 20-year-old with 1.98‰ BAC. The collision occurred when the drunk driver entered the B143 road without headlights.
A car collided with an unlit tractor, causing severe damage and injuring three people, including the drivers of the car, tractor, and a bus; one driver was over the alcohol limit.
A drunk driver collided with another vehicle, causing injuries and road disruption.
A 77-year-old woman was injured in a traffic collision when she failed to yield at a crossing on the L590 and L589 roads.
A man in Salzburg evaded a taxi fare, acted aggressively during a police stop, punched an officer, and was found to be under the influence of alcohol.
A 51-year-old man was injured while attempting to unload a 5.5-ton excavator from a trailer, leading to a fall and hospital transportation.
A fatal car accident occurred on the B108 in Ainet where a 47-year-old womans car veered into oncoming traffic and collided with another vehicle; she was killed, and two others were severely injured.
A 54-year-old driver collided with a 63-year-old woman while overtaking on Felbertauern-Bundesstraße, causing her car to flip onto its roof. She was hospitalized with unspecified injuries.
A man confessed to a series of arson incidents involving agricultural properties and wooden structures in Going, Kitzbühel.
An intoxicated 58-year-old driver crashed into a stationary truck container, causing a dangerous situation; no injuries occurred.
A vehicle was caught speeding at 149 km/h in a 80 km/h zone in Viennas Floridsdorf area on the A22 highway.
Police apprehended a suspect who allegedly stole a bag; during the arrest, the suspect attacked an officer but was detained without injury.
A 45-year-old Serbian man wanted for serious robbery in Serbia was arrested by the Vienna state criminal police and taken to a correctional facility.
Five teenagers from Villach were identified for committing 14 thefts at a self-service kiosk, stealing food worth several hundred euros.
A truck rolled into a guardrail due to an unsecured handbrake, and the driver was found to have a blood alcohol level of 1.6 promille; his license was confiscated and further driving prohibited.
A 55-year-old driver in Bezirk Baden lost control of his car while overtaking, causing it to overturn. He was rescued by firefighters and airlifted to a hospital with injuries.
Truck driver in Bruck/Leitha was found impaired by marijuana and fatigue, had marijuana on him, was stopped, and his license was confiscated.
A man discharged a blank pistol in Steyr after approaching his ex-girlfriend to discuss their breakup; he was later apprehended with a high blood alcohol level.
Teenagers blew up a phone booth using an illegally obtained firecracker in Wilhering, Linz-Land. They were spotted by a neighbor and later apprehended by the police.
A parked car caught fire in Hausmannstätten due to a suspected technical defect, and the fire was extinguished by the local fire department.
A 93-year-old woman was critically injured in a house fire in Leoben caused by a defective heating blanket.
Car accident in Brandberg injured two Austrians severely after the vehicle crashed and overturned, requiring firefighters and medical assistance.
A 51-year-old woman was injured during a ski tour descent at Pinggel, Gschnitz and was airlifted to a hospital.
A fire broke out in an unoccupied laboratory building of the Technical University of Innsbruck, likely caused by improper disposal of cigarette stubs by a homeless man.
Unknown perpetrators used spray paint to graffiti the outer wall of a church in Villach.
A 22-year-old drove a friends car without permission, crashed into a garden fence and hedges in Bürmoos, then returned the car before confessing to the police.
Two 14-year-old boys confessed to intentionally damaging an expensive car in a parking garage, including smashing windows, vandalizing the interior, and jumping on the hood.
A 66-year-old man was seriously injured in a moped accident after crashing into a curb in Gaming, Bezirk Scheibbs.
A car collided with a traffic light at an intersection in Dornbirn, causing significant damage, and the driver fled the scene.
Two unidentified individuals injured a man by tripping him to the ground and stomping on him, causing fractures and ligament tears.
A car overturned after a collision with a parked vehicle in Wels, resulting in injuries to the driver.
A 17-year-old without a valid driving license drove off the road under the influence of alcohol in Gutau, causing minor injuries to a passenger.
Driver caught with a blood alcohol level of 1.24‰ during a traffic stop in Bad Hofgastein, license confiscated and driver reported.
A 29-year-old woman from Carinthia was reported for fraud after failing to deliver a smartphone sold online and cutting off contact with the buyer.
A 23-year-old passenger was slightly injured during a traffic accident involving multiple vehicles due to an illegal overtaking maneuver.
A driver under the influence of alcohol veered off the road, leaving the car stuck on railway tracks; no injuries reported.
A 35-year-old man was arrested at a homeless center in Vienna for causing a disturbance, resisting police orders, and threatening officers.
Four men were caught and arrested after attempting to dispose of a stolen safe from a pharmacy in Vienna; one confessed involvement.
A man shot a woman in the face with a blank gun during a dispute, injuring her, and was arrested on site.
A 32-year-old man wanted by the court was arrested during routine police checks at Praterstern station.
Traffic accident with personal and property damage on L306 near Frauenkirchen and Halbturn, involving a collision between two vehicles, resulting in one severe and one minor injury.
A car accident involving personal and property damage occurred in Parndorf, Austria, where two vehicles collided near a Shell gas station, injuring a 50-year-old woman.
Car collision in Klagenfurt injures three with significant vehicle damage reported.
A man fell asleep while cooking a pizza, causing smoke and triggering the fire alarm. He was hospitalized for suspected smoke inhalation.
A heavily intoxicated man fell six meters from a balcony while attempting to climb down and was seriously injured.
A 24-year-old driver hit a 79-year-old woman crossing the road, causing her injuries of unspecified severity.
A 26-year-old Afghan man fled police during an immigration check in Linz, causing an officer to fall and get injured during the pursuit. The man was eventually apprehended.
A pedestrian was hit by a car in Fornach, Vöcklabruck District, suffering injuries and being transported to a hospital.
Multiple vehicles were involved in an accident caused by an object on the road near Hallein; no injuries were reported, and the highway was temporarily closed for cleanup.
A small aircraft from Germany crashed near Pinzgau/Bruck, killing the 66-year-old German pilot and injuring his two daughters aged 8 and 11.
A 21-year-old vandalized several parked vehicles in Gleisdorf, apparently while intoxicated.
Multiple rear-end collisions occurred on the A9 highway near Graz, causing significant traffic delays and vehicle damage, though no injuries were reported.
A 39-year-old woman attempted to steal metal signs at the Christmas market in Graz, resisted arrest, and was suspected to be under the influence of substances.
A 31-year-old detainee who escaped from a detention center was arrested after a theft in a grocery store.
A 36-year-old man was robbed and assaulted in a restroom and later on the dance floor of a venue in Innsbruck. Three suspects were detained, and investigations are ongoing.
Two heavily intoxicated men, a 32-year-old German and a 20-year-old Austrian, were involved in a physical altercation at a nightclub toilet in Sölden, resulting in facial injuries for both.
A car collision occurred in Mieders involving an 18-year-old and a 73-year-old, leaving the latter injured and causing significant vehicle damage.
Multi-vehicle collision in Tösens, Austria on the Reschenbundesstraße B180 resulted in one fatality and several injuries.
A 23-year-old man hit a 20-year-old with a beer glass leading to injury, fled the scene, resisted arrest, and threatened police officers in Kitzbühel.
A fire broke out in a storage room in Hasenfeldstraße, Lustenau, causing smoke inhalation injuries to one person; the cause is still unknown.
A 36-year-old Polish man was arrested in Vienna on suspicion of attempted commercial theft and attempted theft.

A fire in a school classroom in Seeboden, caused by a student, was extinguished by staff with minor injuries; firefighters arrived after the fire was already out.
A car driven by a 33-year-old man collided with a parked car, causing property damage, with the driver found to be heavily intoxicated.
Two drivers collided with a spruce treetop that fell onto the L540 road; no injuries occurred.

A 61-year-old man was fatally injured by a train while performing maintenance work on the tracks in Kriechpoint, Vöcklamarkt.
Two cars collided head-on at an intersection, injuring all occupants who were transported to hospitals.
108 new police cadets were sworn in at the educational center in Graz, starting their rigorous two-year training program.

Two teenagers attempted to break into a cigarette vending machine in Innsbruck using a hammer but were caught by police and admitted their intent to steal cigarettes. No cigarettes were obtained, and the damage cost is unknown.

A 30-year-old man in Oberperfuss was trapped under a trailer while attempting to attach it to a tractor. He was freed by neighbors and his father and airlifted to a clinic with unspecified injuries.
An explosive substance was found in a laboratory in Kirchbichl, safely removed, and detonated by the bomb disposal unit.
A 23-year-old woman had a car accident on LB40 near Mistelbach, Austria, veering off the road and colliding with a tree, resulting in injuries.

A 15-year-old was arrested for breaking into a school in Rankweil, with further investigations linking him and two other individuals to a similar prior incident at the same location.
A pedestrian in Graz was hit by a car on a crosswalk, resulting in minor injuries, and the driver fled the scene.

A 25-year-old Italian employee at a delivery company in Hall in Tirol was identified and confessed to stealing at least two smartphones after an investigation including video surveillance and a witness statement.
Body of a missing 25-year-old Italian man, last seen on November 14, 2020, was found in the Inn river in Kundl; no evidence of foul play was identified.
A pedestrian was hit by a car at a crosswalk in Dornbirn; he initially reported no injury but later sought medical attention.
Polish father and son stole items, committed fraud, and caused damage in Sillian before being caught and partially compensating the damages.
An Afghan man was assaulted and robbed of cash in Villach after refusing to hand over his phone. He sustained minor injuries.

A hunting accident in Pfaffstetten resulted in a 50-year-old man being injured by shotgun pellets fired by a 28-year-old hunter. The man received medical treatment and the hunter faces charges of negligent bodily harm.
Two teenagers were threatened with a knife by two young men who attempted to rob them at Landhausplatz in Innsbruck.
Police stopped a wrong-way driver on A9 motorway in Steiermark after a dangerous pursuit during heavy traffic.
